good, you know？
translations.大丈夫。ちょっとつまづいただけ……痛っ！:
I'm fine. I just tripped a
little bit... Ouch！
translations.無理しちゃダメだって。ちょっと休んだ方がいいよ。:
Don't overdo it. Let's take a
break.
translations.大丈夫だよ、ひとりでも歩けるって。:
I'm really okay. I can walk by
myself.
translations.無理しちゃダメって言ったでしょ。だから、ほら。:
I said "Don't overdo it,"
didn't I？ Come on.
translations.神社なんて、初詣くらいしか来ないから、なんか変な感じだなあ。:
It feels strange to visit the
shrine when there are no
special festivals.
translations.そう？ 私は、けっこう来るよ。: Really？ I come here a lot.
translations.ふうん。じゃあ、御利益あるんだ？:
Hmm？ Then do you often offer
your prayer to the gods？
translations.うん。あのね……、あ、いい。やっぱり、なし。:
Yeah. Well... Ah, no. Never
mind.
translations.笑わない。ぜったい笑わない。:
I won't laugh. I absolutely
won't laugh.
translations.あのね……、あの……告白しちゃった日も、その前に来たの、ここ。:
Well... Um... I also came here
before I went to confess to
you.
translations.はい、なしなし。もうきかないの。うー、恥ずかしい。:
Okay, forget it. Pretend you
didn't hear it, okay？ Urgh,
this is embarrassing.
translations.小さいころさ、神社とお寺の区別がつかなくてさ。:
When I was a kid, I couldn't
tell shrines and temples
apart.
translations.そう？ 鳥居があるのが神社だよ？:
Really？ If you see the
archways, then it's the
shrine.
translations.そういう意味じゃなくて。ほら、神様と仏様の区別って言うか……。:
It's not like that... Well,
can you tell the Shinto gods
and the Buddha apart...？
translations.ああ。でも昔は、神様も仏様も、いっしょくただったらしいよ。:
I see. But in the past, didn't
the Shinto gods and the Buddha
co-exist？
translations.なんか、仏教が日本に入って来た時に、仏様を“異国の神様”として扱ったんだって。:
Somehow, when Buddhism first
came to Japan, people called
the Buddha "the Foreign God."
translations.つまり、その先はホラーと関係ないわけか？:
Which means they haven't made
this story into a horror
movie, right？
translations.もお、私だっていつもそんな話ばかりじゃありません。:
Hey, it's not like I'm only
interested in horror movies.
translations.うん……て言うか……納得いかない。なんで主人公は、あそこで彼女を追わないの？:
Well... I just couldn't get
it. Why didn't the guy chase
after his girlfriend then？
translations.物語の都合としては、別に変じゃないんだよ。あそこで彼女を追ったら、ヒロインと結ば:
It wasn't strange concerning
the whole plot. If he chased
after her, they wouldn't love
each other so much in the end.
translations.うん。ハッピーエンドにならないよね。:
Yeah, it wouldn't become a
happy ending then.
translations.でも、あそこで追わない主人公の気持ちが判んないの。普通、追うでしょ？:
But to think about the girl's
feelings... It's natural that
the guy must chase after her,
right？
translations.そう言われてみれば、そうだよね。:
When you put it that way, I
kind of agree with you.
translations.でしょ!? あそこで彼女の方を選んじゃうと思うのよ。そうじゃない理由が判んない。:
Right！？ He had chosen her
already. That's the part I
couldn't understand.
translations.いつも、そんなふうに考えながら観てるの？:
Do you always think this much
when you watch a movie？
translations.えっ!? あ……、うん、たぶん……。ヘンかな？:
Eh！？ Ah... Yeah, pretty
much... Is it strange？
translations.ううん。なんか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしいなあ、てね。:
No, I could expect this from
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.え……あ、なに……、あん。やだ、もう。:
Eh？ Ah... What？ Oh no...
Geez...
translations.どうしたの？ 面白くなかった？\n私はすっごく\n面白かったけど……。:
What's wrong？ Wasn't it fun？
I really enjoyed it, though...
translations.いや、面白かったんだけど、観てて疲れちゃって……。:
Well, it was fun, but I feel
tired after watching it...
translations.うん。凄いし、格好良いよねえ。よくあんなに動けるなって思う。:
Yeah, the hero was cool and
handsome. I can't imagine how
he can do all the action
scenes.
translations.やっぱり女性としては、ああいうマッチョって魅力的？:
As a girl, do you find that
kind of a macho guy
attractive？
translations.私が好きなのはね。アクション映画を観て疲れちゃうような人だよ。:
The one that I love is the guy
that gets tired from watching
an action movie, you know？
translations.ああ面白かった。なんか、久しぶりに大笑いしちゃった。:
Ah, it was funny. I feel like
I haven't laughed that much in
a while.
translations.●は、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方が面白かったけどね。:
For me, I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is funnier.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、普段あんまり大笑いしないから。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I don't usually see you
laughing out loud like that.
translations.あ……。ひょっとして私、大口開けて笑ってた？:
Ah... Did I laugh with my
mouth wide open？
translations.うそうそ。ごめん。ちゃんと口に手を当てて、おほほほ、って笑ってた。:
I'm just kidding. Sorry.
Actually you used your hand to
cover your mouth and you
laughed "Hohohoho" like this.
translations.大丈夫だよ。大笑いしてても可愛かったから。:
It's okay. Even if you laugh
out loud, you're still cute.
translations.でも恥ずかしい顔はずっと見られてたのよね。うー。:
But you were watching me doing
something embarrassing the
whole time. Urgh...
translations.楽しかったあ。映画館でアニメ観るなんて久しぶり。特に劇場用のアニメって、まだまだ:
It was fun. I haven't watch
animated movies at the theater
in a while. Many of them
aren't aimed just at kids.
translations.なんだか絵だってこと忘れて見とれちゃったよ。生きてるみたいだった。:
When I watched it, I even
forgot that they were just
drawings. They looked real and
alive.
translations.もともと“アニメート”っていう単語そのものが“命を与える”って意味らしいから。:
The word "animate" means "to
make alive," don't you know？
translations.生きてるように絵が動くって意味でアニメーションって名付けたんだろうね。:
The still drawings were made
alive by applying motions.
That's why they called it
animation.
translations.じゃあ今日の映画は、ちゃんとアニメしてたんだ。:
Then today's movie was really
well animated.
translations.なんか、凄かったねえ。あんなラストになるなんて思わなかった。:
Somehow, it was amazing. I
didn't expect it to leave such
long-lasting impression to me.
translations.へえ。珍しく興奮してる？:
Eh？ It's rare to see you
being excited like this.
translations.うん。知的興奮っていうの？ 脳ミソがキモチイイ！ ……て感じ。かな。:
Yeah. I think I'm up to the
intellectual challenge！ It
feels good to exercise my
brain... I think.
translations.そういえば、子供の頃はＳＦって、そんな風には楽しめなかったな。:
Speaking of which, when I was
a kid, I couldn't enjoy sci-fi
movies as much as I do now.
translations.そうね。ただ映像に感激したりして、話は理解できてなかったかも。:
Right. When we were kids, we
could only enjoy the graphics
but we didn't understand the
stories.
translations.これも、大人になっても楽しめるってやつかな。:
This is something that you
need to grow up enough to
understand, huh？
translations.ふふ、そうかもね。私たちが大人になってもずっと一緒にいられたら、今よりもっと楽し:
Hehe, I guess so. When we
become adults, if we're still
together like this, there will
be a lot of things await us,
right？
translations.こ……怖かったあ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、よく平気だよね。:
I-It was scary.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you seemed to be fine with it.
translations.そんなことないよ。怖かったよ。: Not at all. I was scared.
translations.でもさ、なんでホラーが好きなわけ？:
But then, why do you like
horror movies？
translations.んー、怖いのも好きなんだけど、ホラーだと登場人物がそれに立ち向かうでしょ？ そう:
Hmm, I like the scary parts,
and also the parts where the
movie characters have to fight
against what they fear.
translations.ふうん。……それじゃ、ひょっとして実話怪談は駄目な方？:
Hmm... Then you would be
scared if it were like a real
ghost story？
translations.あ……駄目。それ駄目。ああいうのは本当に怖いだけだから。:
Ah... I'd be scared. Very
scared. That's the real scary
thing.
translations.ふうん。あのさ、すっごく怖い話、知ってるんだ。キジマさんの話っていうんだけど……:
Hmm. But I've heard a very
scary story. It's about
Kijima-san that...
translations.やーっ！ やーっ！ やだ、やめて！:
Noooo！ Noooo！ No way. Stop
it！
translations.すごいすごい！ ４投連続ストライクだね！:
That's amazing！ You just had
4 strikes in a row！
translations.力で強引に倒してるだけなんだけどね。さあ、次は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の番だよ。:
I just threw it with full
strength. Now, it's
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
turn.
translations.うん。力はないけど、テクニックでがんばろっと。:
Hmm, I don't have the
strength, so I'll just try my
best with my techniques.
translations.ボールが自分からピンにぶつかっていくなんて凄いテクニックでしょ？:
My personal techniques to make
the ball go right to the pins
and hit them.
translations.結果がすべてよ。じゃ、行くね。:
The result is everything. Now,
here I go.
translations.（……なんであれでストライクになるかなぁ）:
(...How did she manage to get
a strike from that？)
translations.あ、駄目。そっち駄目！ 曲がれ！ 曲がれ！:
Ah, no！ Not that way！ Turn！
Turn！
translations.あは、見た？ 見てくれた？: Aha, saw that！？ How was it？
translations.ああ、あんなとこから曲がるなんて……。:
Wow, how did you make it turn
like that...？
translations.世界一周旅行に出掛けた人が一番遠くのお土産を買おうとして自分のうちの隣の店でコロ:
It's like a man who traveled
around the world, but ended up
buying souvenirs from a store
next to his house, right？
translations.（たとえの意味が、まったくわからない……）:
(Her comparison is even more
difficult to understand...)
translations.やっぱり敵わないなあ。もっと練習しなきゃ駄目かな。:
I really can't compete with
you. I probably have to
practice more.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の不思議投法は、それはそれで凄いと思うけど。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
mysterious throwing techniques
are quite amazing for me.
translations.不思議投法って……褒めてる？:
Mysterious throwing
techniques...？ Is that
praise？
translations.あんなの見たことないし。:
I've never seen something like
that before.
translations.そっか。でも他の人とじゃ経験できないでしょ？ 楽しくない？:
Really？ So, you can't see it
when you play with others,
right？ Do you have fun？
translations.楽しいは楽しいけど……。喜んでいいんだか悪いんだか。:
I'm having fun, but... I'm not
sure if you enjoy playing it
or not...
translations.私はあなたが楽しいなら楽しいよ。:
For me, if you're happy, so am
I.
translations.ほら。もう１ゲーム、やろ。:
Come on. Let's play one more
game.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、すごくノッてたね。意外だった。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you really got into the
groove. That was something.
translations.……でもね、もう駄目。力尽きちゃったよ。:
...But, I'm at my limit. I've
used up all my strength.
translations.そうみたいだね。ちゃんと歩ける？:
It seems so. Can you still
walk？
translations.ん……と。ちょっとキビシイかも。疲れ果てちゃった。:
Hmm... Seems quite difficult.
I'm burnt out.
translations.ね……ちょっとだけ支えてくれる？:
Hey... Can I lean on you for a
bit？
translations.じゃ、少しだけ……少しだけね。:
So, just a bit... Just for a
moment...
translations.えへへ。こうされるのイヤなのかな？:
Hehehe. You don't like it when
I do this？
translations.嫌じゃないけど……。: It's not that I hate it...
translations.……ふふ。支えてくれてありがとね。:
...Hehe. Thanks for letting me
lean on you.
translations.いいでしょ？ 音楽って言うより……語りかけてくるみたいな感じで。:
Great, wasn't it？ It told us
more stories than just regular
music, right？
translations.うん。今ならすごくよくわかる。:
Yeah. Now, I think I
understand it more.
translations.よかった。あんまり同意してくれる人がいなくて。:
That's nice to hear. Not many
people agree with my thoughts.
translations.正しい解釈かどうかは知らないけど、私にはそう聞こえるもの。:
Well, I can't really explain
why, but that's how I feel.
translations.うん。……うふふ。こういうの、ちょっと嬉しいかな。:
Yeah... Hehehe. I'm a bit
happy that I could talk to you
about something like this.
translations.もの凄くストレートだよね、ヒップホップって。剥き出しの言葉がそのままリズムにのっ:
Hip-hop is really
straightforward, right？
Putting rhythmic lyrics to
music.
translations.ねぇ。ヒップホップとラップの違いって、知ってる？:
Hey. Do you know the
difference between hip-hop and
rap？
translations.えっと……同じじゃないの？:
Umm... They're both the same,
aren't they？
translations.ふふ。あのね、ヒップホップっていうのは、文化形態のことなの。:
Hehe. Well, hip-hop is a
culture, okay？
translations.うん、ニューヨーク発の若者文化。ラップは音楽手法のひとつで、ヒップホップミュージ:
Yeah. It originated in New
York. Rap is a rhythmic style
that hip-hop artists use for
their music.
translations.そんなこと、よく知ってるね……意外。:
You're quite something,
knowing info like that.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大丈夫？ ほら、こっちこっち。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you okay？
Hey, over here.
translations.あ……うん。ふう、出られたあ……。:
Ah... Okay. Phew. We finally
got out.
translations.大丈夫？ 凄い混雑だったね。:
Are you okay？ That was some
crowd.
translations.うん。人気あるんだね、知らなかった。:
Yeah. I never knew this singer
was this popular.
translations.考えてみたらこの人の曲、街中でよく耳にするもんね。:
Now that I think about it,
I've heard her songs being
played all over town.
translations.うー、油断した。:
Urgh, I just didn't pay
attention.
translations.よくわからないで来ちゃったけど来てよかった。売れてる理由、ちょっとわかったかも。:
I'm glad I came here even if I
didn't have a clue. Now I
understand why her albums are
selling well.
translations.実は●も。ＣＤ買っちゃおうかなあ、って。:
Me too. Maybe I should grab a
copy of her CD, too.
translations.ふふ……。じゃあ、買いに行く時は、いっしょに行こ？:
Hehe... Let me know when you
go shopping for it. I'll tag
along.
translations.ああ面白かったあ。お腹痛くなっちゃった。:
Ah, that was fun. Now my
stomach hurts.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、あんまり大笑いとかしないもんね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I don't see you laugh
out loud like that often.
translations.うん。でも性格暗いわけじゃないのよ？ 笑う時には笑うんだから。:
Yeah. But it doesn't mean that
I'm a gloomy girl. I laugh
when it's time to laugh.
translations.判ってるって。それでどれが一番、面白かった？:
I know that. By the way, which
act did you think was the
funniest？
translations.そうね……。ええと、なんて人だっけ、切れ目なしに喋る人。:
Let me see... Umm, what does
he call himself again？ The
guy who talked without end.
translations.あれ、凄かったよね。息継ぎ、どうしてるのかな？:
That guy was awesome, don't
you think？
translations.さあ……？:
I wonder how he breathed. I
have no idea...
translations.韻を踏んだ言葉の連続だけであれだけ引っ張れるのって、本当に凄いよね。:
And all those rhyming words he
said made it even more
amazing.
translations.うん。お客を泣かせるより笑わせる方が大変なんだっていうし。:
Yeah. I think it's more
difficult to make the audience
laugh than to make them cry.
translations.人を笑わせようと思ったら、バカなことやって見せるだけじゃ駄目ってことを今日学んだ:
Today, I've learned that you
don't necessarily have to make
a fool of yourself to make
people laugh.
translations.（……そんなの学んでどうする気なんだ）:
(...Why did you need to learn
that？)
translations.大丈夫？ ハンカチ、要る？:
Are you okay？ Do you need a
handkerchief？
translations.うん、いい。持ってる……。: No, it's okay. I have mine...
translations.うん。なんか、すっごいイイお話だった。:
Yeah. That was some really
nice story.
translations.そうだね。あれだけ笑わせといて、最後はちゃんと感動させてくれたもんね。:
I guess. They made me laugh so
much, but they did make the
final part a touching one.
translations.あのね。観てるうちに、私があのヒロインみたいになっちゃったらって思って……。:
You know, while I was watching
the show, I was imagining
myself in the heroine's
shoes...
translations.カレシが死んじゃうの？ ……って、●じゃん！:
Then your boyfriend would be
dying？ ...That would be me！
translations.お願いだから、死なないでね？ ひとりになんかしないでね？:
I'm begging you. Please don't
die on me, okay？ Please don't
leave me behind, okay？
translations.……うん、死なない。絶対に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をひとりになんかしないよ。:
...Okay, I will not die. I
must not. I'm not leaving
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.どう？ うまく歌えたかな？: How was it？ Did I sing well？
translations.自分でもびっくり。小学生のころに覚えた振り付け、案外憶えてるんだね。:
I was surprised too. I even
remembered the dance moves
that I learned in grade
school.
translations.昔ＴＶで見たアイドルの映像と重なって見えたよ。ほんと凄い。:
I felt like I was watching an
old idol TV program. You were
amazing.
translations.考えてみたら、凄いよね。アイドル歌手って、歌って踊って笑顔なんだもん。:
To think about it, those idols
are amazing. They sing and
dance and keep smiling to the
audience.
translations.私にはアイドル歌手なんて無理だなぁ。:
It's impossible for me to be
an idol.
translations.もう。だからって、人前で歌って踊るのはナシだからね。:
Geez, even so, I won't sing or
dance for you in public,
okay？
translations.ふふ……、おそまつさまでしたあ。:
Hehe... That's all you can
say？
translations.うん、上手いなあ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、歌、上手いよ。:
Yeah, it was great.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
really is good at singing.
translations.そうかな。そんなに褒められたら、ちょっと照れ臭いよ。:
Is that so？ When you praise
me like that, I get
embarrassed.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってさ、上手に歌おうとか、考えてないんじゃない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
don't you think you're
good at singing？
translations.ん……ああ、そうかも。歌ってるうちに、歌詞の気持ちになっちゃう。かな。:
Huh？...Ah, maybe a little.
When I sing, I feel empathy
with the lyrics of the songs.
translations.だからだよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の歌……心に届いてくる。:
That's right,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
When you sing, I can feel
what's in your heart.
translations.だって……、あなたの心に届いて欲しくて歌ってるもん……。:
That's because... I'm trying
to tell you what's in my
heart...
translations.ねえ、この歌知ってる？: Hey, do you know this song？
translations.でもそれ、デュエット曲だったはずじゃ……？:
But this is a duet song, isn't
it...？
translations.だから聞いたんだけど？ 一緒に歌お？:
That's why I asked you first.
Shall we sing it together？
translations.大丈夫。外してもフォローしてあげるから。:
It's okay. If you miss a part,
I can cover it for you.
translations.ふふ。こういうの夢だったんだよね。:
Hehe. This feels like a dream,
huh？
translations.わあ……きれい。街全体がガラス細工みたい……。:
Wow... Beautiful. The whole
city looks like glasswork...
translations.あ、ほらこっち、ベイブリッジまで見えるよ。:
Ah, look over there. We can
see the Bay Bridge too.
translations.大丈夫？ どこも打たなかった？:
Are you okay？ Did you get
hurt？
translations.●は大丈夫。立てる？: I'm fine. Can you stand up？
translations.もうちょっと……だけ……。もうちょっとだけ、こうしてたいかな……。:
Just a little bit... more... I
want to stay like this just a
little bit more...
translations.そろそろ、てっぺんあたりだよ。: We are almost at the peak.
translations.ここまで上がって来ると、海の方まで見えるね。:
When we get up there, we'll
see the ocean too.
translations.うん。ねえ……そっち行ってもいい？:
Yeah. Well... Can I go over
there？
translations.うん、いいよ。揺れるから、気を付けて。:
Yeah, fine. It's gonna sway,
so be careful.
translations.あなたの髪……シャンプーの匂いがするね……。:
I can smell your shampoo from
here...
translations.ちょっと……あんまりしがみつかないで……。:
Wait... Don't cling on to me
this much...
translations.ねぇ、手ぇ出して。手をつないで行こうよ。ね？:
Hey, give me your hand. We
will walk hand in hand from
this point onward, okay？
translations.もう……。なんでこんなに脅かすのかなあ。:
Geez... Why do they keep
haunting us like this？
translations.（お化け屋敷だからな……）:
(Because we're in a haunted
house. That's why...)
translations.もう。こんなに怖がりだとは思わなかった。ごめんね。:
Geez. I didn't expect that it
would be this scary. I'm
sorry.
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、よく平気だね。:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
seems to be pretty
cool with this.
translations.私だって怖いけど……でも、あなたを放っておけないもの。:
I'm scared, too... But I can't
leave you alone.
translations.情けない……また出たっ!!:
I feel ashamed... Let's get
out of here！
translations.ほら、つかまって。ね？ もうすぐ出口だから。:
Come on. Just hold on to me,
okay？ We're almost at the
exit.
translations.うひゃーっ！ あはは！ すげー怖ぇっ！:
Whoaaaa！ Hahaha, that is
really scary！
translations.平気ー！ ちっとも怖くないよー！: I'm fine！ It's not so scary！
translations.あなたといっしょだったら、なんにも怖くないー！:
If I'm with you, I'm not
scared of anything！
translations.ごめーん。止まったら聞くー!!:
Sorry. If this stopped, I
might be able to hear
you！！！！
translations.ううー、怖かったあ。なんでみんな、あんな怖いものに乗りたがるんだろ……。:
Urgh... I was scared. Why do
people like this scary
thing...？
translations.ううん。……ちょっと楽しかった。スリルあったし。:
No....Maybe a little. It was
thrilling.
translations.うん。強烈だったよな。次はもっとゆっくりしたのに乗ろうか。:
Yeah. It might've been too
intense. Should we ride a
relaxing ride next？
translations.でも、もう一回くらいだったら、平気かも。:
But, I don't mind riding this
once more.
translations.それに、せっかく来たんだし。:
Since we are already here,
that's why.
translations.もう一回、挑戦してみない？:
Let's take this challenge one
more time.
translations.私ね、子供のころ、こういう賑やかなのって、苦手だったの。:
When I was a child, I didn't
feel comfortable with bustling
festivals like this.
translations.お祭りのあった次の夜にさ、同じ神社の前をたまたま通ることがあってね……。:
Because the night afterwards,
when I walked past the shrine
that just had the festival...
translations.ああ。落差が大きくて驚いたんだ？:
Ah, you were surprised how it
could be so much different
from the night before, right？
translations.うん。昨日はあんなに賑やかだったのに、って。暗くて静かで、怖くなっちゃった。:
Yeah. The night before was so
bustling, but the shrine after
was so dark and quiet that I
became scared.
translations.じゃあ、このパレードも、苦手？:
Do you also feel bad for the
parade we're watching now？
translations.ううん、楽しい。だって、あなたといっしょだもん。:
No, it's fun because you're
here with me.
translations.あなたとだったら、何だって楽しいよ、私。:
When you're with me,
everything becomes fun.
translations.うん……。人込みが凄くて、よく見えない。どうしよう……諦める？:
I can't... It's so crowded
here that I can't see
anything. What should I
do？...Just give up？
translations.じゃあ……人をかき分けて前にいく？:
Then... Shall we push
ourselves through the crowd to
get to the front？
translations.やってみようか。ちゃんと後ろについてきて。:
Shall we try that？ Just
follow my lead, okay？
translations.えっと、私は……それじゃ、背中押してあげる。:
Hmm, I'll also help by pushing
your back.
translations.よ……し。もう少し。:
All right... Just a little
bit.
translations.やった。抜けた？:
Yay. Are we away from the
crowd？
translations.これで見えるよね。:
You can see it from here,
right？
translations.うん。パレードよりもいいもの見ちゃったかな。かっこいいあなた。:
Um, I think I've seen
something more worthy than the
parade. It's your wonderful
action.
translations.あちゃあ……。すっごい人込みだな。こりゃ見られそうにないなあ……。:
Oh no... It's so crowded. I
guess we can't see anything
from here.
translations.でも、楽しみにしてたろ？ 肩車でもしてみる？:
But you really want to watch
it, right？ How about I give
you a piggyback ride？
translations.いいよ。あなた、ツブれちゃうよ。:
I'm fine. You probably can't
carry me.
translations.こう見えても体力には自信……あんまりないか。:
So you don't have confidence
in my strength, huh？
translations.ねえ。ちょっとそのへん、散歩しない？ 他のお客さん、みんなパレードに集まってるし:
Hey, how about we walk over
there while everyone else is
watching the parade？
translations.……うん、いいけど。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、それでいいの？:
...Um, that's okay. But,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
is it really okay with you？
translations.うん。私は……あなたがいてくれたら、別にパレードなんて、どっちでもいいから……。:
Yeah. For me... as long as I
have you by my side, I don't
really care much about the
parade...
translations.……そっか、わかった。歩こう。: ...I see. I got it. Let's go.
translations.あんな大きな滑り台に本当に行くの？:
Do you really want to try that
giant slide？
translations.下ってプールなんでしょ？:
It's just going straight down
to the pool, isn't it？
translations.そう。だから安心していいよ。:
Yeah, that's why we don't have
to worry.
translations.だから安心できないんだけど……。:
But that's what makes me
worried...
translations.見てるだけじゃダメ？: Can't I just take a look？
translations.一緒に滑ったほうが楽しいと思うけど。:
I think it's gonna be fun if
we slide down together.
translations.うーん……。じゃあ、一回だけ。一回で終わりだよ？:
Hmm... Then only once. Just
once and it's over, okay？
translations.ヤダもう……。鼻に水、入っちゃった。:
No... Water is getting in my
nose.
translations.うーん、駄目か。でもやっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がカナヅチってのは信じがたいなあ。:
Hmm, it's really impossible.
I still can't believe that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is such a hopeless swimmer.
translations.あん、もう。そう何度も言わないでよう。:
Ah, hey. How many times are
you going to say that？
translations.ん……と。体重、どのくらい？:
Hmm... Well, how much do you
weigh？
translations.ええっ!? 言うの？ うー……耳、貸して。:
Eh！？ Why did you ask？
Urgh... Lend me your ears.
translations.……身長と合わせて考えたら浮かないはずないんだけど。:
Considering your weight, you
might be able to float in the
water.
translations.うん。脂肪って水よりも比重が軽いから浮くはず……って、どうしたの？:
Yeah. Fat is lighter than
water, so you might be able to
float... How's that？
translations.ああー、いっぱい遊んだね。なんか、もうぐにゃぐにゃ。:
Ah, we've been playing a lot.
I'm getting a bit tired.
translations.うん。泳いだ後の疲れ方って独特だよね。脱力するって言うか……。:
Yeah, I always get tired after
swimming. It's like my energy
is drained out.
translations.すぅごくキモチイイー。このまま眠っちゃったらシアワセかも。:
But it feels so good. If I can
sleep now, I'll be so happy.
translations.眠っちゃったら、どうする。放ったらかして帰っちゃう？:
What if I did？ Would you
leave me here and go home by
yourself？
translations.まさか。そんなことしないって。: No way. How could I do that？
translations.ずっとこうやって、寝顔を見てるよ。:
I'd prefer watching your
sleeping face instead.
translations.あ、え、あっ。えーっと。そろそろ帰らないとね。うん。寝ちゃ駄目です。うん。:
Ah... Eh？ Ah！ Um, we should
go home now. Yeah, I can't
sleep here. Yeah...
translations.宇宙人とか、いるかも知れないね。:
There might really be space
aliens out there.
translations.うん……いても不思議じゃない感じ。:
Yeah... I wouldn't feel
surprised if there really
were.
translations.地球と同じような星も、あるかも知れない。:
There might be some planet
that is exactly the same as
the earth.
translations.日本みたいな国もあって……。:
It might have a country that's
the same as Japan...
translations.この街にそっくりな街があって……。:
With a city that's the same as
this city...
translations.あなたがいて……。:
And with someone just the same
as you...
translations.うん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もいて……。:
Yeah, and someone just the
same as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
too...
translations.こうやって二人でプラネタリウムを見上げて、同じこと話してるかも知れないね……。:
They might also be in a
planetarium now and are
talking about something like
this...
translations.こんなにたくさんの星があるんだなあ……。:
There really are a lot of
stars...
translations.でも、これでもほんの一部だよね。地球からは見えない星が、まだまだ無数にあって……:
But these are just some of
them. There are countless
stars that we can't view from
the earth.
translations.１３７億年前、それがたった一つの点から生まれたんだって。:
At one point, 13.7 billion
years ago, it all started.
translations.そう。宇宙も、地球も、私達も、たった一点の何もないところから生まれたんだよ。:
Yeah. The universe, the earth,
and even us. Everything
started from nothing at all.
translations.それから何億年も経って……●達が出会ったのか。:
It took that many billions of
years until we met...
translations.そう考えると、不思議だよね。:
To think about it, that was
quite amazing.
translations.あ……ん……、あれ!? あ、ごめん。私、寝ちゃった!?:
Ah... Hmm... Eh！？ Ah, sorry.
Did I fall asleep！？
translations.うん。気持ちよさそうに寝てたよ。:
Yeah. You seemed to enjoy your
rest.
translations.あん、ごめんなさい。星を見上げてたら、なんだか、すうって……。:
Ah, sorry. I was looking at
the stars, and somehow I
just...
translations.いいよ。大丈夫？ 立てる？:
It's all right. Are you okay？
Can you stand up？
translations.平気……あ、そう言えば変な夢、見ちゃった。:
I'm fine... Ah, I had such a
strange dream.
translations.夢？ 熟睡してたんだ？:
Dream？ So you were sound
asleep.
translations.うん。あのね、私がアンドロメダで、怪物に食べられそうになったところへ、あなたが…:
Yeah. Well, I was Andromeda in
my dream. And when I was about
to be eaten by a monster, then
you...
translations.ペルセウス？ ペガサスに乗って？:
Was I Perseus？ Did I ride on
Pegasus？
translations.ううん。……タヌキに乗ってた。:
No. ...You were riding a
raccoon dog.
translations.もし人類が滅亡したらさ……。:
What if mankind came to an
end...？
translations.なに？ いきなり。: What is it all of a sudden？
translations.ごめん。仮定の話。そしたらたったの数年で街を植物が埋め尽くすんだって。:
Sorry. It's just my
imagination. Like a few years
after that, plants would cover
everything in the city.
translations.数年？ 数十年じゃなくて？:
A few years？ Not like 10 or
more？
translations.うん、数年。道路も建物も、何もかも。:
Just a few years. They would
also cover the roads and the
buildings. Everything.
translations.うちの田舎の庭も、手入れしないと凄いことになるって言ってたし。それと同じだよ。:
Like the garden in my
hometown. If we didn't do
proper maintenance, the plants
would grow everywhere.
translations.結局、人間がいなくなったら自然なんてアッと言う間に元に戻るってことか。:
If there were no humans,
eventually, everything would
return to a natural state,
huh？
translations.そうなっても、別にいいけどね。:
Even if the world became like
that, I wouldn't care.
translations.あなたさえいてくれたらね。:
As long as you're with me now,
I'm okay.
translations.わっ、これ凄い。この花。これ、なに？:
Wow, this is amazing. What is
this flower？
translations.ええと……ヘレベリアス・スピリット。アオイ科だって。:
Let's see... It's called
rebellious spirit. It belongs
to the mallow family.
translations.大っきいよねえ！ ２０センチくらい？ もっとかなあ。:
It's huge！ About 20 cm？ Or
maybe larger than that.
translations.こんなの髪に飾ったら、重くて倒れちゃいそうだよね。:
If you used it as a hair
ornament, it'd be so heavy
that you might collapse.
translations.うん。あっ、髪に飾るなら、こんなのがいいな。ほら。:
Yeah. Ah, if I wanted some
hair ornaments, those would be
good. Look.
translations.ああ、小さくて可愛いね。白いウサギみたいにも見えるし。:
Ah, they're tiny and cute.
They even look like white
rabbits.
translations.なになに？ 名前は……ウサギゴケ？:
Let me see. The name is...
widow bunny？
translations.いろんな植物があるな。おっと、こっちは水辺の植物コーナーか。:
There are so many plants. Wow,
that's an aquatic- plants
corner over there.
translations.スイレンがきれい。ハスの葉っぱが、緑色のテーブルみたいね。:
The water lilies are
beautiful. That lotus's leaf
looks like a table.
translations.あ、葉っぱの上にカエルがいる。:
Ah, there's a frog on that
leaf.
translations.私、カエル苦手で……。:
I'm... not very good with
frogs...
translations.そうなんだ？ ……じゃあ言わない方がいいかな？:
Is that so？ ...Now, I don't
know if I should tell you or
not.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の足元にもカエルがもう一匹……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
there's another frog
near your feet...
translations.うわっ！ いきなり飛びつかないで！:
Whoa！ Don't jump all of a
sudden like that！
translations.クラシックなんて、あんまり聴く機会がないけど、たまに聞くと凄くいいよね。:
I don't usually get a chance
to listen to classical music,
but it'd be nice to listen to
every once in a while.
translations.歌詞も何もない音楽で泣きそうになっちゃうなんて、初めてかも。:
The music that didn't even
have lyrics could make me cry.
I think it was a first for me.
translations.古くたって、イイものはイイんだなあ。:
It's old, but the good things
remain good, huh？
translations.考えてみたら、何百年も伝えられてるんだから、当然かもね。:
Come to think of it... The
songs have been conveyed since
many hundred years ago, so
that's natural.
translations.後世に残るってことは、残すべき価値がある、って誰かが思ったってことでしょ？:
Things that have been passed
through generations mean that
they have their values,
right？
translations.あ、そうか。そう考える人が大勢いないと、残せないか。:
Ah, I see. If people didn't
think the songs were good, the
songs wouldn't remain until
now.
translations.古いものには、長い年月を経て遺されるだけの理由があるんだよ。:
There are reasons for the old
things to be passed to the
present, okay？
translations.うん、そうだね。あんなノッてるところ、初めて見た。:
Yeah, right. It was the first
time I saw you being in high
spirits like that.
translations.凄く可愛かったし、ファンの気持ちもわかるよ。:
The singers were cute. I
understand their fans' feeling
now.
translations.え？ あ、そうねえ。可愛かったよねえ。:
Eh？ Ah, right. They're cute,
huh？
translations.あの、いや。あくまでアイドルとして可愛いってことで……。:
Um, no. I mean they're cute as
idols...
translations.でも●にとっては▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のほうが……。:
But for me,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is much--
translations.うふふ、うそうそ。私だって好きなアイドルくらい、いるもん。:
Hehehe. I was joking. I also
have some guy as my idol,
okay？
translations.ミュージカルって、お芝居の最中に、いきなり歌い出すじゃない？:
For a musical show, they
usually sing abruptly during
the play, right？
translations.まあね。よく考えてみたら、おかしいと思うけど。:
Sort of. Come to think of it,
that's kind of odd.
translations.それなのに、ちっともヘンに見えないんだもん。それが不思議で。つい出ちゃう鼻唄とは:
Yet we didn't think that it
was odd at all. It's amazing.
It's different from when we
hear someone suddenly hums a
tune, huh？
translations.うん。そう考えると確かに不思議かも。:
Yeah. When I think about it,
it's quite amazing.
translations.試しに私たちも歌で会話してみようか？:
Shall we try to sing when we
talk？
translations.……やめよう。やっぱり実際にやったらヘンだ。:
...Better not. It'd be really
weird if we actually did that.
translations.そうそう。ばあんとか、どおんとか、音が凄かった。あれって本気でやってるの？:
Yeah, there were those "bam"
and "bang" noises. Did they
really hit each other for
real？
translations.んー、どうだろ。筋書きがあるとも言うけど……。:
Hmm, I wonder. I've heard that
they might have a script for
it...
translations.でも本当に投げたり蹴ったりしてたよ？ 当たってたし。:
But the punches and kicks were
real, right？ I saw them.
translations.……筋書きがあったとしてもあれは闘いだと思うよ、●は。:
...Even if they had a script
for it, I still think that it
was a real fight.
translations.そうだよね、痛くないわけないもんね。:
I think so too. It's not like
they didn't get hurt.
translations.テレビでは観たことあったけど……なんか……凄いもの見ちゃった気分。:
I've seen this on TV, but...
somehow... I still feel like
I've just watched something
amazing.
translations.……怖かったけど、また観たくなってきちゃった。:
...I was scared, but I still
want to watch it again.
translations.うん。また機会があったらね。:
Okay. If we have a chance, all
right？
translations.でもやっぱり、ちょっと怖いかな。:
But I think I'll be quite
scared, though.
translations.うーん、惜しかったなあ。応援が足りなかったかあ。:
Urgh, this is regrettable.
Maybe we didn't cheer for them
enough.
translations.うふ。でも接戦だったじゃない。１点差だよ？:
Yeah. But it was a close
match, right？ There was just
a 1 point difference.
translations.そうだね。あんな投手戦、ちょっと見られないもんね。:
Right. The battle between
pitchers like that was really
something.
translations.そう言えばさ、私、小学校のころ４番打ったことあるよ。学校で。:
Speaking of which, I used to
be batter no. 4 for my
school's team when I was in
grade school.
translations.ううん、でも実はね、そのころクラスで一番、背が高かったの。それで期待されちゃった:
No, actually I was chosen
because I was the tallest one
in my class. So it wasn't
unexpected at all.
translations.だから、全ッ然。全打席、三振。一回もバット振らずに。みんなに責められちゃった。:
I couldn't hit any balls.
Three strikes, batter out. I
couldn't hit a single ball.
Everyone blamed me.
translations.ふうん。別に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のせいじゃないのにね。:
Hmm. But it wasn't
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
fault.
translations.だから野球、嫌いだったの、本当は。でも、あなたとだったら、ちっとも嫌じゃなかった:
That's why I hate baseball.
But, if I come to watch it
with you, I feel like I don't
hate it that much.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、また来る？:
Really？ Then how about we
come to watch it again？
translations.すごい人だったね……大丈夫？:
It was so crowded... Are you
okay？
translations.うん……。でもちょっと、疲れちゃったかも……。:
Yeah... Just a little
exhausted, I think...
translations.同人誌なんてナメてかかってたけど、やってる人が、こんなにいるんだ……。:
I only read some of the comic
books' fan works, but there
were really a lot of artists
here...
translations.うん、映画のファンサークルの本。:
Yeah, some fan circle's books
for a movie.
translations.やっぱりホラーだったか。:
It must be a horror movie,
right？
translations.うん。もう２０年以上も前から続いてるサークルなんだって。:
Yeah, this circle has been
around for over 20 years.
translations.ひょっとして……その２０年分の同人誌を買ったとか？:
Do you... plan to buy all the
books that have been published
during these 20 years？
translations.まさか……でも、ちょっと気になるかな……。:
No way... But I was thinking
about that...
translations.あ、ほら。街の灯が見えるよ。:
Ah, look. We can see the
lights from the city.
translations.あの光の１つ１つに、人がいるんだよね……。:
For each light we see, someone
is there.
translations.私達も、離ればなれの光のところにいたんだ……。:
We were like the lights that
were scattered around
everywhere...
translations.ああ……うん。でも、出会った。:
Ah... Yeah. But we met each
other.
translations.いっぱい偶然が重なって……そういうの、運命って言うのかな。:
There were so many
coincidences... That might be
fate, I think.
translations.でも、もうどんな運命が来ても、私、あなたの側から離れないから。:
But no matter what fate will
bring to us, I will never
leave your side.
translations.海鳥だ。なんだろ……カモメかな？ ウミネコ？:
The sea birds. What are
they...？ Seagulls or
black-tailed gulls？
translations.あ、あ、あ。なんか寄ってきちゃったよ。え？ あ、どうしよ。:
Ah, ah, ah. They're coming
this way. Eh？ Ah, what should
we do？
translations.何か食べるもの欲しがってるんじゃない？:
Maybe they just want some
food, huh？
translations.え？ 食べるもの？ えっと、何かあったっけ、えっと……。:
Eh？ Food？ Well, do I have
anything？ Well... Ah.
translations.あ、あった。ほら、はい。お食べ。あ……あれ？:
Y-Yeah. Okay, here you go. Eat
it. E-Eh...？
translations.あーあ、行っちゃった。何あげようとしたの？:
Ah, they're gone. What did you
give them？
translations.夜の海ってさ、眺めてると怖くならない？:
Are you scared when you look
at the sea at night？
translations.ん……昼間は水面の光ばかりに気をとられてるけど、本当はその下があることに気づくっ:
Hmm... During the day, the
water's surface reflects
sunlight, and we never know
what lies under that
surface...
translations.うん、そう。何メートルも、物凄い量の水があって、光の届かない真っ暗な水の底がある:
Yeah, right. With this much
water, we won't know how deep
it goes and there are parts
that the sunlight will never
reach.
translations.そう考えると、ちょっと怖いよね。:
When I think about it, I start
to feel scared a bit.
translations.こっちが海の本当の姿じゃないかって、そう思えちゃって……だから夜の海って、怖い。:
It's like the sea we see
during the day isn't its true
form... That's why I'm scared
of the sea at night.
translations.でも人間だって、哀しみとか苦しみとか、いっぱい乗り越えた人の方が素敵だと思わない:
But isn't that like people？
We have sorrow and anguish.
But if we can overcome the
pain, life would be wonderful.
translations.うん……そうだね。そっか……だから昼間の海って、あんなにきれいなんだ。:
Hmm... That's right. I see.
That's why the sea during the
day looks so beautiful.
translations.もう怖くない？: Are you still scared of it？
translations.ん……まだちょっと怖いけど……。うん、でも、平気。ありがと。:
Hmm... I'm still a bit
scared... Hmm, but I'm fine
now. Thanks.
translations.あのね、どうして海辺で食べるヤキソバって、こんな美味しいんだろうなって。:
Well, why are fried noodles at
the beach tastier than usual？
translations.というか、どうして必ずヤキソバを売ってるんだろう？:
I wonder more about why we
have fried noodles sold at the
beach.
translations.そういえば、必ずあるよね、ヤキソバ。なんでヤキソバなんだろうね。:
Come to think of it, they
always sell noodles at the
beach. Why the noodles？
translations.タコヤキがない理由だったら判るんだけど。:
But I know why they don't sell
octopus dumplings here,
though.
translations.怒ったタコが海から攻めて来るから。:
If they do, the angry octopi
will come from the sea to
attack them.
translations.定番みたいなイメージがあるけど、実際に寝てる人を砂に埋めちゃったことってある？:
I've seen pictures with people
lying down and being buried
under the sand. But, do people
do that in reality？
translations.実際にはないな。ドラマとかではよく見るけど。:
Not in reality, I think. But
we often see something like
that in TV series.
translations.だよね。なかなか本当にやる機会ってないよね？:
Yeah. I think it's rare to
find a chance to do that,
right？
translations.ほら。だってせっかく思いついちゃったんだし。:
Come on. Since the idea came
up, we should try it.
translations.でもさ……埋まった首の下にカラダ作ったりしない？:
But, are you going to bury me
and then make a sculpture of
my body with the sand？
translations.うーん。……しようかな。身長２メートルくらいの筋肉ムキムキの人とか。:
Hmm... I think I will. Your
body would be about 2 meters
long, with lots of muscles.
translations.やっぱり遠慮しておきます。:
I think I'd have to refuse
then.
translations.じゃあ、タヌキだったら？:
What if I make your body look
like a raccoon dog？
translations.楽しかったねえ。なんか帰るのイヤになっちゃいそう。:
It was fun, huh？ Now I feel
like I don't want to go home.
translations.うん。だけど、学校は休みでもバイトはあるしね。:
Yeah. But, even if it's during
school break, we have to go to
work for our part-time jobs.
translations.ねえ。アルバイト、休みたいと思ったこと、ある？:
Hey, have you ever thought
about quitting the job？
translations.ふふ。あなたが来る前だよ。立ち仕事が辛くて。でもあなたが来てからは、思ったことな:
Hehe. That was before you
came. It was tough to stand
for long hours. But after you
came, I stopped thinking about
quitting.
translations.●がデキシーズの面接を受けてなかったら、今こうして２人でいることもなかったんだよ:
If I didn't get a job at
Dixie's, we would've never
met, huh？
translations.ううん。きっと他で出会ってたと思う。……うん……きっと出逢ってたよ……。:
No. We would have finally met,
I think....Yeah, we would have
absolutely met each other...
translations.んー、はぁ……今日は天気もよくて、気持ちいいね。:
Hmm, aaah... The weather is so
nice today. This feels good.
translations.散歩日和だね。:
An ideal weather for a walk,
huh？
translations.ほら、今日ならこのひろーい砂浜、ぜーんぶ貸し切り状態だよ！:
Come on. Today, let's pretend
that this whole long beach
belongs to us！
translations.珍しいなぁ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がこんなにはしゃぐなんて。:
This is rare... For
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ 
to be in high spirits
like this.
translations.うわ、近いよ。どうしたの？:
Whoa！ You're getting so
close？ What's the matter？
translations.ねぇ、波打ち際まで行かない？:
Hey, let's dash to the other
side of the beach.
translations.今日は、どうしたの？ いつもとちょっと違う気がするけど……。:
What happened to you today？
You're a bit different from
usual...
translations.ふふ。女の子はね、たまにこういう気分になるのっ。それよりほら、行こっ。:
Hehe. Girls sometimes change
their moods easily. Come on.
Let's go.
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、どうかした？ さっきから黙ってるけど……他の場所に行く？:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what's wrong？
You've been quiet for
a while. Shall we go
somewhere else？
translations.あ……ううん、違うの。そういうのじゃなくて……。:
Ah... No, you got it wrong. I
didn't mean to...
translations.話しても……笑わない？:
If I tell you, don't laugh at
me, okay？
translations.笑う……って、何か変なこと考えてたの？:
Laugh at you...？ Were you
thinking about something
weird？
translations.もぅ……ロマンチックな気分になってただけなのに、そういうこというんだ。ふーん。:
Geez... I was in such a
romantic mood and you ruined
it. Hmph.
translations.ごめん。えっと、そういうつもりじゃなくて……。:
Sorry. Well, I really didn't
mean to...
translations.……ふふ。しょうがないなぁ。許してあげようかな？:
...Hehe. I have no choice. I
should forgive you, right？
translations.もぅ、本気にしないの。ほら仲直りのついでに……。:
Geez. Don't take it too
seriously. Come on. To make up
for it...
translations.あそこまで、手をつないで一緒に歩く。それでおしまい。ね？:
You have to hold my hand and
we'll walk over there. Then
we'll be okay, all right？
translations.今の私たち、他人からみたらどうみえるのかな？:
I wonder what other people see
us as.
translations.ふふ。自信、無い？:
Hehe. You aren't confident
about that？
translations.私、年上だし……やっぱり、いろいろ考えちゃうよ。:
I'm older than you... And I've
always been worried about it.
translations.……●、やっぱり頼りないかな？:
Maybe because I'm not quite
reliable to you, right？
translations.ううん。そうじゃないの。そうじゃなくて……ごめんね、こんな話にしちゃって。:
No, that's not the case.
That's absolutely not the
case....Sorry that I brought
up this topic.
translations.お互い、気にしすぎなのかな？:
Maybe both of us are worried
too much.
translations.……うん、そうだね。でも……私、あなたのこと、好き、だよ？ それだけは……ね？:
...Yeah, that might be true.
But... I love you, you know？
That alone should be enough,
right？
translations.そう言えば、町の魚がマンボウ、てところあるよね。:
Speaking of which, there's a
town that has sunfish as a
symbol.
translations.町の魚？ 県の鳥みたいなもの？:
A symbol？ The same as state
birds, or something like
that？
translations.うん、そう。ええと、どこだったかな、思い出せない。:
Yeah, right. Hmm, I can't
recall the name of the town
though.
translations.町の魚って、どこの町でもあるのかな？:
Does every town have its own
town fish？
translations.どうかな？ 私達の町にもあるのかな？:
I wonder. Does our town have
one too？
translations.あっ。じゃあ、私の魚は？ 私のイメージだったら、何の魚かな？:
Ah, what about my fish？ What
kind of fish would fit my
image？
translations.怒ると膨れるから。: When you get angry and pout.
translations.マンボウってさ、飼育が難しいんでしょ？ なんか、やたら弱いって聞いたことあるよ。:
It's very hard to raise a
sunfish, right？ I heard that
they're very frail.
translations.ああ、うん。人間が手で触ったら手形が残るんだってね。:
Yeah. If someone touches it,
the handprint will be left on
its body.
translations.私もね、小さいころは体、弱かったんだ。そのくせ背ばかりヒョロヒョロ伸びて。:
I was quite weak when I was a
child. But instead, my height
grew very fast.
translations.それでも今ではちゃんと立派に育ったんだなあと思ってさ。:
I'm just thinking that you've
grown up to be such an elegant
person.
translations.むう。なぁんか視線がオヤジっぽいよ？:
Geez. You're looking at me
like a pervert.
translations.魅力的な恋人に熱い視線を送ってるつもりなんだけど。:
I just want to give my
charming lover a hot gaze.
translations.やっ……なっ……みりょ……もう、何言ってるのよ！:
No... C-Charming...？ Geez,
what are you saying？
translations.ペンギンって、あの歩く姿が可愛いよね。よっちよっちよっちってさ。:
Penguins are cute when they
walk like that. Like,
staggering, staggering.
translations.まあ、短いもんなあ、脚が。:
Well, their legs are pretty
short.
translations.でもあれって、脚の骨は、もっと奥まであるんだって。:
But they have more leg bones
hidden inside their body.
translations.へえ。肉に埋まってるってことか。:
Huh？ You mean more bones are
hidden under their feathers？
translations.うん。それでね、骨だけ見ると、空気イスしてるみたいに膝を曲げてるんだってさ。:
Yeah, and if we could view
their bones, we would see that
they are actually bending
their knees in the sitting
position.
translations.ふうん。じゃあ……よっと、こんな感じかな？:
Hmm？ Then... All right. Is it
like this？
translations.これで、歩いて、るのか。よっ、よっ、けっこう、辛いぞ、これ。:
Can... they... really...
walk... like... this？ It sure
is hard.
translations.あは、ペンギンみたいになってるよ。よっちよっちよっち。:
Aha, now try walking like a
penguin. Staggering,
staggering.
translations.うはあ、駄目だ、降参。なかなかやるな、ペンギン。:
Urgh, I can't. I give up. It's
difficult to be a penguin.
translations.ペンギンってさ……どうしてこんなに人間くさいんだろうね。ちょっと不思議。:
Why do penguins sometimes
behave like humans？ How
mysterious.
translations.中に人が入ってるんじゃないかと思うよね。:
Have you ever thought that
there might be a man hiding
inside it？
translations.まさか。でも本当にどうしてこんなに人間っぽいんだろ。動きとか。:
No way. But they really act
like humans. Look at the way
they move.
translations.直立してるから？ ほら、エリマキトカゲも人間ぽいし。:
Because they can stand
upright？ In that case, the
frill-necked lizards would be
like humans too.
translations.ああ、そうか。立ってるからか。:
Ah, right. They can stand
upright too.
translations.人間にも、ネコっぽい人とかクマっぽい人とかいるし。もちろんサカナっぽい人もね。:
There are people who behave
like cats, or bears, or
sometimes fish, huh？
translations.（サカナはちょっと違うような……）:
(I don't think you can include
fish...)
translations.ちょっと怖いよね。ガラスが割れちゃったら、溺れちゃう。:
This is a little scary,
right？ If the glass breaks,
we'll drown.
translations.ガラスじゃなくてアクリルかな、たぶん。:
It's not made of glass, but
acrylic, I think.
translations.あ、そうなんだ？ ガラスじゃないんだ？:
Ah, is that so？ It's not
glass？
translations.薄く見えるけど、本当はかなり分厚いんだってさ。:
Although it looks thin, it's
very thick actually.
translations.ふうん。でも……早く出た方がいいかも。:
Hmm, but... We should just
hurry and get out of here.
translations.ずーっと見上げてたら、首が痛くなってきちゃった。:
If I keep looking up like
this, my neck will hurt.
translations.はは、わかった。行こう。: Haha, I got it. Let's go.
translations.夜の海の中って、こんな感じで、しかも暗いんだよね。ちょっと怖いかな。:
The sea at night probably
feels like this, only darker,
right？ It's a bit scary.
translations.海のホラーなんて、ある？:
Are there any horror movies
about the sea？
translations.あるよ。あ、ほら、サメの映画とか。:
There are. Ah, how about the
ones with the shark？
translations.ああ。あれはパニック映画だと思ってた。:
Ah, but I think they're
thriller movies, not horror.
translations.そうなんだけど、サメの描き方って言うか、演出がホラー映画の怪物と同じなんだよね。:
That's true, but the way they
made that shark was the same
as the way they made the
monsters in horror movies.
translations.まだ知り合ってないのに、同じ映画観てたんだなぁって思ったら、ちょっと嬉しくなっち:
I was thinking that when we
watched that movie, we hadn't
met each other yet. I'm happy
that we watched the same
movie.
translations.そうだよね。たくさんの人が見てるはずだもんね。幻想的な風景にやられちゃったかも。:
I know. It's a very popular
movie and it's like everyone
has seen it.
translations.けっこう人、いっぱいだね。席、空いてないなあ……。:
It's quite crowded. There
aren't any empty seats.
translations.あ、あった。前の方、空いてる。先に席取っとくから、おいでよ。:
Ah, right there. The ones at
the front are empty. I'll run
to reserve those seats first.
translations.ほらもう、言ったのに。こっちおいでよ。はい、ハンカチ。:
See？ I was about to tell you.
Come here. Use this
handkerchief.
translations.そうか、だから前の方は席が空いてたのか。でもこれで……。:
I see. That's why the front
seats are empty. But this
is...
translations.あのね。水もしたたるイイ男って言うのは、ナシね。:
Some people say that guys look
best when they're soaking wet,
huh？
translations.ああ面白かった。イルカ、可愛かったね。あの高さで３回転だもん。凄い。:
Ah, it was fun. The dolphins
were cute. They could jump and
do triple turns. That was
amazing.
translations.どうする？ 他のお客さんが出て、ちょっと空くまで待つ？:
What do we do now？ Do we wait
until other guests leave, so
that it'll be less crowded？
translations.うん。……あ、ほら。イルカがこっち見てる。:
Okay....Ah, look. That dolphin
is looking at us.
translations.あ、ほんとだ。なあに？ なにかご用？:
Ah, really. What's up？ What
do you want from me？
translations.頑張ったのでお腹がすいたきゅー。何か食べたいきゅー。:
Are you working hard that
you're getting hungry？ What
do you want to eat？
translations.あはは。でも食べ物なんて、持ってたかな……？:
Ahaha. But I don't know if I
have anything edible with
me...
translations.持ってても、あげちゃ駄目だよ。:
Even if you have food, you
can't feed it.
translations.ちなみに何あげるつもりだったの？:
By the way, what do you intend
to feed it？
translations.ねえ、最初に会った時のことって、ちゃんと憶えてる？:
Hey, do you remember the first
time we met？
translations.あなた、かちかちに緊張してて、可愛かったなあ。:
You looked very nervous and
that was very cute.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だってあの時は、しっかりした歳上のお姉さん、て感じだったよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
At that time, you were like a
reliable older sister in my
opinion.
translations.なに？ 今はもうしっかりしてないってこと？:
What？ You mean I'm no longer
reliable now？
translations.そうじゃないけど。なんか……ちょっとね。:
I didn't say that. But... That
might be true.
translations.ふふ。あなただって、もう可愛いだけじゃないわよ。:
Hehe. Now you're not cute at
all.
translations.うん。遊び過ぎて疲れちゃったね。:
Yeah, we had so much fun and
now I'm exhausted.
translations.最初は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、もっと元気な人かと思ってたよ。:
At first,
I used to think that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was much more
energetic than I am.
translations.あー、それってなに？ 男みたいだってこと？:
Ah, what do you mean？ Am I
tough like a guy？
translations.そうじゃなくて。なんか、おとなしいけど頑丈、みたいな。:
I didn't mean it that way.
Although you're usually
docile, you're really strong.
translations.おんなじだよ。あなたの方こそ、そんなに元気小僧だとは思わなかったなあ。:
Same to you. I also think that
you're as energetic as a
little boy.
translations.そうそう。なんだか振り回されっ放しって感じ。だから元気小僧。:
Yeah, right. Somehow, you're
so much like a boy that I feel
like abusing you.
translations.あ、ううん。そうじゃなくて……そうじゃなくてね。……頼もしいってこと。:
Ah, no. Actually, you're
not....No, you're not.
...You're a reliable guy.
translations.このあたりって昔は日本であって日本じゃなかったんだって。:
In the past, the area around
here didn't belong to Japan,
you know？
translations.あ、聞いたことある。江戸時代に開港した時、外国の軍隊が駐留してたんだっけ？:
Ah, I've heard of this. In the
Edo period, when we opened the
ports, this was a foreign
country's army base, right？
translations.そうそう。戦後も進駐軍が接収してたとか、そういうの。:
Yeah. And we got it back after
the war.
translations.だからこのあたりって、英語ぺらぺらのお婆ちゃんとか、普通にいるみたい。:
That's why a lot of old people
here can speak fluent English.
translations.戦争とか進駐軍とかはよくわからないけど、英語ぺらぺらは、ちょっと羨ましいよね。:
I don't know much about wars
or military situations, but I
envy people who can speak
fluent English.
translations.そうなんだ？ 国際派目指してる？:
Really？ Do you aim to study
abroad or something？
translations.ほら。海外のホラー映画とかを字幕なしで観られるじゃない？:
Come on. It'd be nice if I
could watch foreign horror
movies without reading
subtitles, right？
translations.うわあ……すごい夕焼け。空が燃えてるみたい……。:
Wow... Beautiful sunset. It
looks as if the sky is
burning...
translations.今日も、いっぱい遊んだもんね。:
We really had so much fun
today.
translations.うん。……ちょっと寂しいな。:
Yeah. ...Now, I feel a bit
lonely.
translations.小さいころからね。夕焼けを見ると、ああ今日が終わっちゃうって思った。:
When I was a kid, whenever I
watched the sunset, I always
thought "Ah, today is about to
end."
translations.“今”だったものが“昨日”とか“この前”になるのって、ちょっと寂しい。:
The "present" moment will soon
become "yesterday" or "some
time ago." That's pretty sad.
translations.でもその代わり、“明日”とか“いつか”とかが、順番に“今”になるんだよ？:
But instead, "tomorrow" and
"the future" will replace the
"present," right？ I see...
translations.うん。あなたといっしょの、“今”だよね。:
Yeah. It'll be the "present"
that I'll be spending with
you, right？
translations.お、望遠鏡だ。こういうのって、どこにでもあるよな。:
Oh, telescopes. They put
telescopes everywhere
nowadays.
translations.私達の家って、どっちになるのかな？: I wonder where our houses are.
translations.ちょっと貸して。……ああ、見えた。ほら、こっち。:
Let me see. ...Ah, I see it.
Look. Right there.
translations.あれ？ やっぱりわかんないや。覗く時にズレちゃったのかな？:
Eh？ I can't see it. The
telescope's angle might've
moved when you handed it to
me.
translations.いっしょに覗けるといいのに。:
It'd be nice if we could use
the telescope together at the
same time.
translations.それじゃ、一緒に覗こう。レンズは２つあるんだし。:
We can do that. There are 2
lenses on the telescope.
translations.でも……、それじゃ顔がくっつくよ……。:
But... If we do that, our
faces will be very close...
translations.いいから。ほら、早く。: It's fine. Come on. Hurry up.
translations.（端から見たらバカップルに見えないかな……）:
(I wonder if other people will
see us as a sickeningly sweet
couple.)
translations.ほんとだ。ほら、下見て。豆粒みたいなのに、人がちゃんと歩いてる。:
Yeah. Look. When we look down
to the ground, we can see
things that look like tiny
dots, but they actually are
people.
translations.まさかあの人達も、上から見られてるとは思わないだろうなあ。:
I think they have no idea that
others are watching them from
here.
translations.あなただって、そうかもよ？:
If it were you, that would be
true.
translations.自分では気づかないうちに、色んな人に見られてるかも。:
You've never realized it when
others are looking at you.
translations.それは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲こそ。:
I think that applies to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
as well.
translations.ふふ。なんかバカップルみたい。:
Hehe. Somehow we are like an
idiot couple.
translations.んー、どうしようかなあ。試着してみようかなあ。:
Hmm, what should I do？ Should
I try this on？
translations.うん。このワンピなんだけど……似合うかな？:
Yeah, this one-piece... Will
it look good on me？
translations.そうだな……。悩むなら着てみたら？:
Let me see... If you can't
decide, why don't you try it
on？
translations.あ、こっちも良さそうだから一緒に持っていったら？:
Ah, this one looks nice, too.
Why don't you try this one as
well？
translations.えっ？ うん、こっちも着てみるね。: Eh？ Hmm, I should try it too.
translations.もう……あなたが選んでくれた服があると、余計に迷っちゃいそう。:
Geez... If this is what you
choose for me, I'm getting
even more choices now.
translations.これ、ちょっと試着してみてもいいかな？: Hey, shall I try this one？
translations.焦らない焦らない。一緒に入るわけじゃないんだから。:
Hurry up, hurry up. I'm not
asking you to get in there
with me though.
translations.いっしょに並んで鏡に写ってみるの。いつも歩く時みたいに。:
There's a big mirror there.
Let's walk there so I can see
how we look together.
translations.ああ、そういうことか。:
Ah, so this is what you
wanted.
translations.ねえねえ。私がこういうの付けたら、やっぱり変？:
Hey, if I used this, do you
think I'd look weird？
translations.ううん、リップ。スティックじゃなくて、筆で取って付けるの。:
No, it's for lips. It's like
lipstick, but it comes in a
brush form.
translations.ゴメン。よくわからないな。:
Sorry. I don't know much about
it.
translations.あっ、それなら好きなの選んでみて。直感でも良いから。:
Ah, then can you just pick the
color you like？ You can just
use your intuition.
translations.直感っていっても▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に似合うのだろ？ ……こっちとか？:
Will my intuition be good for
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
...How about this one？
translations.あ、これいいかも。自然な色だし。:
Ah, I think that's nice. It
has natural tone.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、唇きれいだから、こういうのがいいかも。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
lips are beautiful, so
I think this'll be good.
translations.わからないなんて言って……わかってるじゃない。:
You said you didn't know about
this, but actually you knew...
translations.どれ？ ああ……あのね、そのブラシみたいなとこで睫毛を撫でるの。:
Which one？ Ah... Well, that's
a brush that you can apply to
your eyelashes.
translations.そうするとね、睫毛が長くなったみたいに見えるの。やってみる？:
When you use it, it'll make
your eyelashes look longer.
You wanna try？
translations.ふふ。いいからちょっと動かないで……。:
Hehe. Come on. Just stand
still...
translations.ううん……変じゃない……。て言うか……可愛い……。:
No... Not weird... Actually,
you look very cute.
translations.うん。もう片方もやろうよ。ほら、顔出して。:
Yeah. Let's try it with the
other eyelashes. Come on. Let
me see your face.
translations.んー、勿体ないなあ。可愛いのに。:
Hmm... What a waste. You
really look cute.
translations.ねえ。これ、どうかな。:
Hey, what do you think about
this？
translations.ネックレス？ うん、シンプルで上品だね。:
A necklace？ Yeah, it looks
simple, yet elegant.
translations.うん。いいと思う。: Yeah, I think it looks nice.
translations.男の子には、ちょっと地味じゃないかな？: Isn't it too plain for a guy？
translations.もちろんあなたへのプレゼントだって。:
Of course, I'll buy it as a
present for you.
translations.そうじゃないけど、何か贈り物したくなる時ってない？:
No particular occasion. Can't
I just give you a present on a
whim？
translations.いいの。私はあなたがこれを着けてるところが見てみたいだけなんだから、いい？:
It's fine. I just want you to
wear this. Will it be okay？
translations.……うん。ありがとう。だけどやっぱり、今すぐには必要ないから。:
...Yeah, thanks. But I don't
think you have to buy it right
now.
translations.そう？ うーん。次までなくならないといいんだけど。:
Really？ I hope it won't be
gone the next time we come
here.
translations.そのうち、●からも何か贈るから。:
Anyway, I'll buy something as
a present for you, too.
translations.やだ。かえって気を使わせちゃったかな？:
No, I don't want you to go out
of your way for that.
translations.けっこう長居しちゃったね。: We've stayed here for a while.
translations.うん。それで何も買わないなんて、お店には迷惑だったかも。:
Yeah. If we don't buy
something, the shopkeeper
might get upset.
translations.でも特に欲しいものも、なかったわけでしょ？:
But there isn't anything in
particular that you want,
right？
translations.んー。そうでもない、かな。:
Hmm, that's not really the
case.
translations.そうなんだ？ なに？:
Really？ Then what do you
want？
translations.ナ～イショ。言～わない。: A secret~ I won't tell you~
translations.言ってくれたら買ってあげたのに？:
If you tell me, I'll buy it
for you.
translations.うん。そう言ってくれると思った。だから言わないの。:
Yeah, I knew you'd say that.
That's why I didn't tell you.
translations.あのね。女の子にとって、アクセサリー買ってもらうって特別なことなの。:
You know, for a girl, getting
an accessory from her
boyfriend is something very
special.
translations.でもね、本当に特別なのは、女の子が何を欲しがってるのか、好きな人がちゃんと見抜い:
But it's much more special if
her boyfriend could see
through her and pick the
accessory that she really
wanted.
translations.うん。だから特別なの。信じて待ってるからね。:
Yeah. That's why it's special.
I'll be waiting with my faith
in you.
translations.ああ、風がキモチイイ。空気の匂いが緑色だよ。:
Ah, the wind feels good. I can
smell fresh plants.
translations.それいいな。匂いが緑色か。:
That's good. The scent of
green, huh？
translations.そう言われると、するかな。:
When you say so, I think I can
feel it.
translations.ねえ。あなたにとっての私って何色？:
Hey, what do you think my
color is？
translations.急に言われても……そんなこと考えたことなかったし。:
If you ask me suddenly like
that, I can't think of an
answer.
translations.なにそれ？ 色じゃないよ？:
What？ That's not even a
color.
translations.うん。でもそんな感じ。何色でもなく、透明。:
Yeah, but that's what I feel.
Not any specific color, but
transparent.
translations.こういうところに来ると、思うんだけど……。:
When we come to a place like
this...
translations.何？ 湖畔が舞台になってる海外のホラーが多い理由？:
What？ Do you wonder why so
many movies use the lake shore
for horror scenes？
translations.実際にはそんなことないんだよ。幽霊屋敷ものとか、街全体が舞台の作品もあるし。:
There aren't that many lately.
Now, the scenes are usually
haunted houses or ghost towns.
translations.そういう話じゃ……。:
But I didn't mean to talk
about this...
translations.うーん、でも確かにこういう湖畔のキャンプ場でカップルがいちゃいちゃしてたら……。:
Well, there are many couples
that come to stay at the
lake's camp ground, and when
they start to get flirty...
translations.殺人鬼が出てきて、ぐさっ、ばきっ！ とかしそうかも。:
An evil murderer suddenly
appears. Cut！ Slash！ Or
something like that.
translations.それは……ありがちだけど……ちょっと想像の方向に偏りが……。:
I've seen movies like that but
it wasn't something I meant to
talk about...
translations.ほんとだ。こんなところで何の話してるんだろうね、私達。:
Yeah. I wonder why we're
talking about such things when
we're here.
translations.（何を思ったのか忘れてしまった……）:
(Now I forgot what I was about
to say at first...)
translations.こういうところでボーッとしてるとさあ、帰るの嫌になっちゃうよね。:
It feels so good to relax here
that I kind of don't want to
go home.
translations.テレビもマンガもゲームも……映画館もないけど、あなたがいるし。:
There are no TVs, comic books,
games, or even a movie theater
here, but I have you with me.
translations.ふたりっきりだね……。: It's just the two of us now...
translations.こんなふうに自然な水の匂いって、普通に生活してたら縁がないよね。:
The natural smell of water can
make us feel like it's so
pure.
translations.私、潮の匂いも好きだけど、こういうのも嫌いじゃないな。:
I prefer sea water's smell but
I don't hate this smell.
translations.うん、そうかもしれない。泳げないけどね。:
Um, maybe. But I can't swim,
though.
translations.あなたも私には水が似合うと思う？: Do you think I'm like water？
translations.透明な感じがするからかな。:
You give me the feeling of
pureness.
translations.……あの、ごめん。なんか、今、猛烈に照れちゃってる。:
...Um, sorry. Somehow I feel
quite embarrassed to hear
that.
translations.大丈夫？ 顔、真っ青だよ？: Are you okay？ You look pale.
translations.まさかこんな湖の船で酔うとは思わなかった……。:
I didn't think I'd get motion
sickness being on a boat in a
lake.
translations.疲れてたんだよ、きっと。そうだ。船員さん、呼ぼうか？:
It's probably because you're
tired. Shall I call the crew？
translations.……いい。でも横にはなりたい……。:
...I'm okay. I just want you
to be by my side...
translations.……それじゃ、こっち来て。ベンチで膝枕してあげる。:
...Well then, let's rest on
that bench. You can lie down
on my lap.
translations.そんな……悪いって……。:
I don't think that's good
though...
translations.いいから。ほら、頭のっけて。:
It's okay. Come on. Put your
head here.
translations.（うう、子供扱いだ……）:
(Urgh... She's treating me
like a child...)
translations.後ろ側の甲板は誰もいないんだ。へえ、穴場発見だね。貸し切りみたい。:
There aren't any people on the
rear deck. This is like our
private area.
translations.いつの間にか岸からこんなに離れてたんだ。:
I didn't realize that we were
this far away from the coast.
translations.このまま、どっか知らないとこまで行けたらいいのにね。:
It would be nice if this boat
took us to a place we've never
seen before.
translations.んー、湖だからなあ。行けてもせいぜい、向こう岸までだね。:
Hmm, it's just a lake. No
matter how far we go, at most
we'll just arrive at the other
side of the coast.
translations.もう。夢がないなあ。:
Geez. You're a guy with no
dreams.
translations.じゃあ今、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が●にくっついてるのも、夢の一部？:
Then is this a dream that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is so close to me,
right here, right now？
translations.ううん。これはね、現実の確認。夢じゃないんだなって。:
No, this is reality. It's not
a dream.
translations.●はまだ時々、夢じゃないかって思うよ。:
Sometimes, I still think that
this might be just a dream.
translations.それは絶対、夢じゃないよ。:
It absolutely is not just a
dream.
translations.あ。これ、どっち？: Ah, which way shall we go？
translations.へえ、地図なんて持って来てたんだ。やるう。:
Hmm？ You even carry a map
with you. Great.
translations.まあね。ええと、この別れ道が……さっきの川がこれで、こっちだから……。:
Well, let's see. It's this
crossroad... and we had walked
past this river...
translations.うん、ちょっとまって。……これが、こっちで……あれ？:
Hmm？ Wait a minute. ...This
is right here. ...Huh？
translations.あのね。右だよ。右の道が頂上。:
Hey, just go to the right. The
right path leads to the
summit.
translations.だって矢印。“頂上”って。:
Because there's an arrow with
a label "summit."
translations.ごめん、ちょっと座っていい？:
Excuse me. Can I sit for a
bit？
translations.どうしたの？ 座って休憩すると、後が辛くなるよ？:
What's the matter？ If we sit
and rest now, we'll feel more
tired later on.
translations.うん。でも……ああ、やっぱり靴擦れになっちゃった。:
Yeah. But... Ah, I knew it.
These shoes pinch my feet.
translations.ちょっと待って。傷テープは持って来てるから。:
Just a sec. I carry some
bandages with me.
translations.うん？ 傷テープは分かるけど、そのロウソクはなに？:
Huh？ I know that's the
bandage, but what's that
candle？
translations.うん。こうやって靴のカカトの内側にね、擦っておくと……。:
Well, if I use it to rub the
inside of my shoes around the
heels like this...
translations.靴の滑りを良くするのか。:
Ah, to improve the slip of the
shoe.
translations.さて。そろそろ降りようか。:
Now, it's about time to go
down.
translations.うん。でも、ちょっと残念。ここからだったら、夕陽がきれいだろうな。:
Okay. But what a pity. The
sunset view from here must be
really beautiful.
translations.でも夕陽を見てからだと、途中で暗くなって危ないよ。:
But if we stay to watch the
sunset, it'll get dark on our
way back. That'll be
dangerous.
translations.ねえねえ。いつかテント持って来て、ここから夕陽、見てみたくない？:
Hey, someday, how about we
bring a tent and stay here to
watch the sunset？
translations.それで、夜はテントで……あっ。:
And at night, in the tent...
Ah！
translations.うん……それじゃあ、お泊まりになっちゃうな……。:
Well... In that case, we'll be
spending a night together...
translations.紅葉って夏と秋の温度差が大きくないと、きれいに色づかないんだって。:
If the temperatures weren't
much different in summer and
fall, these leaves' colors
wouldn't be as noticeable.
translations.単純に涼しくなるだけじゃ駄目なんだ？:
So, they don't change colors
just because the weather
becomes cold？
translations.うん。夏の暑さに耐えたご褒美、みたいな感じなのかも。:
Well, it's kind of like a
reward for them for bearing
with the summer heat.
translations.うん。頑張ったからきれいな赤に染めてあげましょうって、山の神様が。:
Yes, it's as if the mountain
god gives them a beautiful red
color as a reward for trying
their best.
translations.哀しいこととか辛いこととかを乗り越えた人って、強くて美しいでしょ？:
When people have gone through
hardships, they will become
stronger and more beautiful,
right？
translations.あれも神様のご褒美なのかもね。:
That's also a reward from the
gods, I guess.
translations.紅葉って見てるとちょっと切なくならない？ て言うか、秋って切ないよね。:
Do you feel pain when you look
at these maple leaves？ Is it
because fall is such a painful
season？
translations.夏が賑やかだったから？:
Or is it because we enjoy the
summertime so much？
translations.あ、そうかな……。うん、そうかも。日曜日の夕方が憂鬱みたいなもんかな。:
Ah, that might be true... Um,
it's the same as the depressed
feelings on Sunday night.
translations.あと１２月の２６日とか、１月３日の夜とかも。:
Or, the day after Christmas or
the day after a long break on
New Year's.
translations.特別な時間が終わっちゃうのが切ないってことかな？:
It's like the special moment
is about to end, so it's quite
painful, isn't it？
translations.でもね、今の私は、毎日が特別なんだよ。:
But for me, everyday is the
special moment.
translations.うん。あなたと付き合い始めてから、ずっと。:
Yes, ever since I've been with
you, I've always thought that.
translations.……うん。●も毎日が特別だよ。:
...Yeah, every day is a
special moment for me too.
translations.わあ……けっこう急だねえ。どうする？:
Wow... This is so high. What
should we do？
translations.上級者向けだもんなあ。:
This course is for advanced
skiers.
translations.リフトで戻る？ 別に恥ずかしくないよ、そういう人いっぱいいるし。:
Shall we take the lift back？
I don't want to get
embarrassed in front of this
many people.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は平気なの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
can do this course, right？
translations.うん、私はね。あなたは大丈夫？:
Yeah, I can, but how about
you？
translations.格好いいとこ見せてね。:
Wanna show me how cool you
are, huh？
translations.リフト、結構並ぶね。:
There's a long line for the
lift, huh？
translations.うん、だいぶ待ちそう。あっ。:
Yeah, we'll have to wait a
while. Ah！
translations.あ、えっと、あの人結構かっこいいね。ほら、背の高い。:
Ah, um... That guy looks so
cool. See？ He's very tall.
translations.ふふ。雑誌で読んだんだけど、スキー場で見る人は普段よりかっこよく見えるんだって。:
Hehe, I've read from a
magazine that guys at the
skiing area are more handsome
than usual.
translations.だから、いつどこで見てもかっこいいあなたは、本当に素敵なんだよ。:
That's why a guy like you who
looks good no matter where you
are is even more wonderful.
translations.（上手く誤魔化されたような、照れるような……）:
(I'm not sure if she said that
to deceive me or because she
feels shy...)
translations.あのね、嫌なこととか辛いこととかあるたびに、雪が降って欲しいって思ってた。:
Well, whenever something bad
happens or when I feel sad, I
wish it would snow.
translations.うん。心の中にね、雪が降って積もって、嫌なものも全部隠して真っ白にして欲しいって:
Yeah. I wish the snow would
cover all the bad feelings in
my heart, making everything
pure white...
translations.でもそれじゃ、隠すだけだから。心の中は寒いままだった。:
But if that happened, my heart
would feel really cold.
translations.だけどね。もう雪なんか降らなくても平気だから、大丈夫になったの。:
Now, I don't think I need any
snow. Even if it won't snow,
I'll still be fine.
translations.うん。あなたがいるもん。いつだって、いっしょにいてくれるもん。:
Yeah. Because you're always
here by my side.
translations.美術館とか博物館って、なんか不思議な気分にならない？:
Do you feel amazed when you're
in an art gallery or a
museum？
translations.ここにある美術品って、それぞれの時代に、それぞれの人が、それぞれの目的で作ったで:
Different art works here were
created by different artists
for different purposes,
right？
translations.その中の誰一人として、ずっと未来に高校生のカップルが見に来るなんて、想像もしてな:
None of them would have
imagined that some high school
couples would come to
appreciate their works.
translations.なのに今、私達の前にある。それがね、なんだか凄く不思議。:
But the works ended up being
here in front of us. Don't you
think it's very amazing？
translations.ということは、●や▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が何かをのこして、何百年も先の人がそれを見るかも知:
Then if
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
and I create something,
maybe some people will be
looking at our work a few
hundred years later.
translations.うん。そういうことがあるんだったら、ちょっといいね。:
Yeah, if that really happened,
it'd be great.
translations.大丈夫？ もう出る？:
Are you okay？ Shall we leave
now？
translations.ううん、まだ半分も見てないし。ちゃんと見たい……。:
No, we haven't looked at half
of it yet. I want to see them
all...
translations.ありがと。持ってるから大丈夫……。:
Thanks. I already have mine,
so I'm fine...
translations.あっちこっち連れ回したからかな。ごめん。:
I've been dragging you along
to so many places. Sorry.
translations.あ……。ねえねえ。この絵の人、あなたにちょっと似てないかな？:
Ah... Hey, that person in the
picture looks like you.
translations.うん。雰囲気とか、けっこう似てるよ？:
Yeah, the ambience is quite
similar.
translations.このブロンズ像は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に似てる。:
This bronze statue looks like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.でもそんなに似てるんだとしたら……。:
But if they look like us that
much...
translations.他の人から見た私達って、その絵とこの像が並んでるみたいなもんだよ？:
When others look at us, they'd
think we're one of these art
pieces, don't you think？
translations.人間の首の骨って７つなんだけど、キリンの首って骨がいくつあると思う？:
Humans have 7 bones in our
neck. How many do giraffes
have？
translations.なんでそんな具体的にハンパな数なの？:
How did you come up with such
an odd number？
translations.残念でした。人間と同じで７個なんだって。１つ１つが大きいだけ。:
Wrong answer. They have the
same number of bones as
humans. It's just that each of
their bones is much larger.
translations.一部の例外を除いて、哺乳類はみんな同じ数なんだよ。:
Except for a few animals, most
mammals have the same amount
of bones.
translations.そうなんだ。だったらイルカも７つ？:
I see. So, do dolphins have
the same amount as well？
translations.イルカ？ イルカって……あれ、どこが首？:
Dolphin？ Dolphin... Eh？
Which part is their neck？
translations.キリンの模様ってさ、あれってやっぱり、保護色だよね？:
The giraffe's pattern is for
camouflage, right？
translations.でもさ、例えばシマウマだったら草むらに隠れたら効果あると思うけど、キリンはどこに:
But in case of zebras, they
use their patterns to hide
themselves among the grasses,
right？ How about giraffes？
translations.あんなにでっかいし、首も長いし、それにあのブチ模様だよ？:
They are so big and they have
long necks. What do those spot
patterns do？
translations.ええと……葉の生い茂った樹の陰？:
Well... So that they can hide
behind very tall trees？
translations.脚、丸見えだよ。:
Their feet will still be
visible.
translations.……うーむ。大自然の神秘だ。:
...Hmm, this is the mystery of
Mother Nature.
translations.そういうふうにまとめちゃうと簡単だね。:
You can simply put it that
way, I guess.
translations.ライオンてさ、強そうなイメージがあるけど、実際にはオスはほとんど働かないんだって:
Lions have an image of a
strong animal, but the male
lions are motionless when
confined in a cage.
translations.ふうん。じゃあ狩りで獲物を取ってくるのってメスだけなの？:
Hmm？ Only the female lions go
hunting, you mean？
translations.そう。他のオスが縄張りを荒らしに来たりしない限り、闘わないらしいよ。:
Yeah. The male lions will stay
in front of their dens and
will fight if other animals
come near.
translations.いざと言う時は頼りになるけど……てことなのかあ。:
You mean, they will be
reliable when the time comes,
huh？
translations.腕っぷしは強いけど生活力はない、て感じだよね。:
They are strong but they
aren't quite lively.
translations.お願いだから、そういう人にはならないでね。ライオンならいいけど、人間でそれは最悪:
I beg you. Don't be like them,
okay？ It's okay for the
lions, but if this were a
human, he would be the worst！
translations.●もともと強くなんてないし。:
I'm not the strong type to
start with.
translations.あんなのでかじりに来られたら怖いだろうな。:
It'd be very scary if it used
that mouth to bite us.
translations.あ、でもライオンに襲われた人って、かじられる時は不思議と安らかな気分だった、て話:
Ah, but I've heard that people
who survived lion attacks said
that they felt peaceful when
they were bitten by the lions.
translations.案外、他の生き物に食べられるっていうのは、安らぐことなのかもね。:
Unexpectedly, they said it
felt more peaceful than being
bitten by other animals.
translations.命の循環ってことかな？ でもそれが本当だとしたら、よく出来てるよね。:
It's the moment of life and
death, huh？ If that's true,
it'd be quite amazing.
translations.私は、あなたといっしょだったらライオンも怖くないよ？:
For me, if I'm with you, I
wouldn't be scared of the
lions.
translations.あ、ごめん。やっぱりちょっと怖いかも。:
Ah, sorry. Actually, I think
I'd be a bit scared.
translations.こういう小動物の目って、妙に寂しそうよね。かまってあげたくなっちゃう。:
These little animals do have
lonely eyes, don't you think？
translations.何かを訴えてくるよね。:
Seems like they're begging you
for something.
translations.うん、この目で見つめられると、逆らえないよね。:
Yeah, I can't go against them
when they stare at me like
that.
translations.どうしたの？ じっとして。:
What's the matter？ You're
staring at me.
translations.いや、動物をかまってばかりで●が寂しいから、目で訴えてみた。:
Because you're only concerned
about the animals. Now, I feel
lonely. I'm just trying to
appeal.
translations.ふふ。素直でよろしい、ちゃんとかまってあげるから。:
Hehe. If you're being
obedient, I'll take good care
of you.
translations.ふふふ！ ほんとに小動物みたい、あはは。:
Hehehe！ You're really acting
like an animal. Ahaha.
translations.ちょっとポニーにニンジンでもやってみようかな。:
Can we feed that pony some
carrots？
translations.あーあ、嫌われちゃったね。: Ah, it seems to hate you.
translations.こうなったら追い掛けて捕まえようか。: How about we chase after it？
translations.追いかけたらもっと逃げるに決まってるじゃない。可哀相だよ。:
If we chase, it's going to run
away again. This is pitiful.
translations.そうか。でも逃げられると結構ヘコむなぁ。:
I see. But I feel quite
disappointed that it ran away.
translations.ふふ。私のことは、追いかけなくてもいいよ。呼んだら、すぐに飛んでってあげる。:
Hehe, as for me, you won't
have to chase after me. Just
call and I'll come running to
you.
translations.今日も、素敵な日だった。それに、いろいろ気を遣ってくれて……ありがと、ね。:
Today has been another
wonderful day. You have taken
a good care of me... Thank
you.
translations.……ふふ。私が鍛えたおかげかな？ 悔しいけど、今日は完全敗北、すごく楽しかったよ:
...Hehe, is this because I've
trained you well？ Today's
date was perfect. I really
enjoyed it.
translations.今日のデート、もぅ、すっごく良かった！ もう、これ以上、私をメロメロにしちゃうの:
Today's date was really
great！ Hey, will you make me
fall in love with you even
deeper than this？
translations.楽しかったけど、終わっちゃうのが寂しいかな……また今日みたいに……ね？:
It was fun, to the point that
I feel sad that it has to
end... We'll have a date like
this again, right？
translations.今日もよくできました、ふふっ！\n次はもっと期待しちゃうけど、\nいいでしょ？:
You've done very well today,
hehe！ I can look forward to
our next date, right？
translations.今日はとっても満足！ ふふ、また、楽しもうね？:
I'm very satisfied with
today's date！ Hehe, I'm
looking forward to the next
one.
translations.今日、楽しかったな。ひょっとして気を遣わせちゃったかな？:
The date today was fun. I
think you understand me very
well.
translations.今日はご苦労様。楽しかったけど……もうちょっと頑張れるかもよ？:
Thanks for today. It was fun,
but... You'll have to try
harder, okay？
translations.うん、今日も楽しかった。でももーっと、一緒に楽しめたら、いいな？:
Um, today was fun. But we
should try to make it better
next time, okay？
translations.……今日、疲れてた？ あ、ううん、なんでもないの……。:
...Did you feel tired today？
Ah, no, never mind...
translations.今日の評価は、もう少しがんばりましょう……かな？ もっとしっかりね？:
My evaluation for today is...
You must try a little harder.
Be more serious about this,
okay？
translations.今日はちょっと空振りだったみたいね。次はがんばって？ ね？:
Today was quite a waste of
time, huh？ Let's try harder
next time, okay？
translations.私が……何か悪いことしたのかな……ううん、誰にだって、調子の悪い日はあるよね。:
Did I do something bad...？
Nah, everyone has this kind of
a bad day, I think.
translations.今日のデートは不合格。反省するように！:
Today's date was a failure.
Reflect on it！
translations.今日のデート、期待はずれだった……次は期待しても大丈夫？:
Today's date was
disappointing... Can I still
expect something on our next
date？
translations.まだここにいるの？ ほら、行こっ。:
Do you want to stay here？
Hey, let's go.
translations.あ、こっちこっち。通り過ぎちゃダメよ？: Ah, right here. Don't pass it.
translations.あ、もう着いちゃった。時間経つの、早いなぁ……。:
Ah, we have arrived. Time sure
flies...
translations.はい、到着……で、いいんだよね？:
Okay, we've arrived. It's
here, right？
translations.残念だけど、そろそろ切り上げないと……ね。:
It's unfortunate but we'll
have to leave soon, okay？
translations.今日はここまで……かな？ ふふ、もうちょっと一緒にいたいけど。:
I think this is it for today.
Hehe, I still want to stay
with you though.
translations.今日はこの辺でお開きかな？:
I think we'll have to leave
soon.
translations.そうだね。じゃあ、また今度。:
Yeah, let's go on a date again
then.
translations.今日はこの辺にしておく？: Will this be it for today？
translations.今日は……もう帰ろうか。: It's time to go home, right？
translations.今日はもう終わりにしよ。: This should be it for today.
translations.どこに行くの？ 決めてくれると嬉しいな……。:
Where shall we go？ I think
you should pick the location.
translations.はい、どこに行きたいのかな？:
Okay, where do you want to go
then？
translations.ふふ。ねぇ、どこにする？: Hehe. Hey, where shall we go？
translations.はい。どこに行くか、決めること。:
Okay, have you decided where
to go？
translations.ふふ。次、どこか行きたい場所、ある？: Hehe, where shall we go next？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、次はどこに連れて行ってくれるの？:
Hehe, where shall you take me
next？
translations.ふたりでいると、どこに行っても楽しいよね。:
No matter where we go, it's
fun when we are together.
translations.今度はどこ？ はい、３つ数えるうちに決めることっ。:
Where do we go next？ You have
time to decide until I count
to 3.
translations.他のところにも行ってみる？:
Is there a place you want to
go？
translations.何を観るか、あなたに決めてほしいな……。:
What do you want to watch？ I
want you to decide it.
translations.ふふ。今日はあなたの好きな映画、選んでみて。:
Hehe, today, I'll let you
choose the movie you want to
watch.
translations.今日はなに観る？ 私はなんでもいいよ、あなたと観られるなら。:
What shall we watch today？
I'm fine with anything you
choose.
translations.なにか観たいの……ある？:
Which one do you want to
watch？
translations.私が観たい映画……どれだと思う？:
Which one do you think I want
to watch？
translations.あわてなくてもいいから、面白そうなの選ぼう？:
Take your time and pick
something interesting, okay？
translations.映画……か。あ、ううん、観たくないわけじゃないから……。:
A movie, huh？ Ah, no, I
didn't mean that I don't want
to watch it...
translations.なんでもいいから決めちゃって。ただし、面白くなきゃダメ。:
Just pick whatever you want to
watch. But make sure it's an
interesting one.
translations.わかってるよね？ 盛り上げてくれる映画にしてね？:
You know, right？ Pick a nice
movie then.
translations.んー……ここで察しのいいカレシなら、もう１本のほうも一緒に観てくれるよね。:
Hmm... As a considerate
boyfriend, I wonder if you
still want to watch another
movie.
translations.ふふ。どうせだから、もう１本観ちゃう？:
Hehe, since we're here, how
about watching another movie？
translations.……ね。もう１本の方も、どうせなら……。:
...Hey, how about we watch
another one？
translations.もしここで、もう１本観たいっていったら、どうする？:
Since we're here, shall we
watch another one？
translations.どうする？ どうせだから、もう１本観ちゃう？:
What do you think？ If you
don't mind, shall we watch
another one？
translations.うん。その案に賛成っ。: Okay, I agree with that idea.
translations.どうしようかな……ふふ、冗談よ、冗談。:
What shall I say...？ Hehe,
just kidding.
translations.ええっと……あ、ううん。あなたがいいなら……。:
Well... Ah, nothing. If you
like it, I'm okay with it...
translations.そっか、あんまり気が乗らないけど……。:
I see. I don't quite like it,
but...
translations.私は……もっと別のでもよかったかな？:
I think I'd prefer something
else.
translations.あ、そろそろお昼にしない？:
Ah, how about we have our
lunch around here？
translations.そろそろお昼の時間だけど、なにか考えてる？:
It's almost lunchtime. Shall
we find something to eat？
translations.ふふ。お腹すいてきちゃった、お昼にする？:
Hehe, I'm getting hungry. Care
for lunch？
translations.そろそろ、お昼だけど……どうする？:
It's lunchtime... What shall
we do？
translations.ねぇ。今、何時だと思う？:
Hey, do you know what time it
is？
translations.そうか、お昼にしようか。: I see. Shall we have lunch？
translations.うん。どこかで食べよっか。:
Yeah, shall we find some place
to eat？
translations.ねえ。どこかで……お茶、しない？:
Hey, shall we stop by for some
tea？
translations.じゃ、喫茶店にでも入る？: Shall we go to a coffee shop？
translations.ちょっと疲れちゃった。お茶にしようか？:
I'm a bit exhausted. Shall we
have some tea？
translations.……女の子が少し疲れちゃった時、カレシならどうする？:
When the girlfriend gets a
little tired, what does the
boyfriend do？
translations.おなかすいてない？ そろそろ夕食の時間だと思うんだけど……。:
Aren't you hungry？ I think
it's almost dinnertime...
translations.そうだね、食べようか……。:
That's right. Let's get
something to eat.
translations.そっか、どこかで食べようか。:
Well, should we go to eat
something now？
translations.ねえ、おなか減ってない？ よかったら、どこかでご飯にしましょ。:
Are you hungry？ If you're
okay, let's get something to
eat somewhere.
translations.よかったら……どこかで夕食にしない？:
If you're okay, how about we
eat dinner somewhere？
translations.もうこんな時間だし、夕食にしない？:
It's about time, so why don't
we go somewhere for dinner？
translations.あっ、ほら着いたよ。:
Ah, looks like we have
arrived.
translations.ふふ、着いたね。何頼もうかな……。:
Hehe, we're here. I wonder
what I'll order...
translations.あっ、ここ？ ……ふふ。そんなにあわてなくても、お店は逃げないよ？:
Ah, here？ Hehe. You don't
have to rush like that. The
shop won't run away from you.
translations.もうちょっと一緒にいたいんだけど……だめ？:
I want to be with you
longer... Is it okay？
translations.もう少し……ふたりの時間、楽しみたいなぁ。:
I want to spend time with you
a little longer.
translations.うん。デート続行、だよね。:
Ah, you want to continue
today's date, right？
translations.私のワガママ、聞いてくれる？:
Can you listen to my selfish
request？
translations.うん。じゃあ、どこか行こう。:
Okay, then shall we go
somewhere？
translations.他の所にも遊びに行かない？:
Shall we go somewhere else
then？
translations.もちろん。じゃあ、どこ行こうか。:
Of course. Then where shall we
go？
translations.えっと……もう少し、一緒にいたいけど、いい……かな？:
Hmm... I want to stay with you
a little longer... It's okay,
right？
translations.どうしようかな……ふふ、いいよ。行こ。:
What should I say...？ Hehe,
fine. Let's go.
translations.まだ、他の場所にも行ってみようよ。:
I still want to visit other
places.
translations.……うーん。きっと予定もあるもんね……。:
...Hmm, you have something
else to do, huh...？
translations.あ……ごめんね。まだ一緒にいたいけど、時間が……。:
Ah... Sorry, I want to go with
you but I don't have time...
translations.うーん……もう少し、時間に余裕があったら良かった、ね。:
Hmm... It would be nice if we
had more time than this,
right？
translations.残念だけど、もう時間切れ。時間が経つの、ほんとに早いよね。:
Unfortunately, I don't have
time. Time really flies so
fast.
translations.あの……やっぱり、やめにしていい？:
Hmm... What if I can't go with
you...？
translations.うーん……やっぱりそれ、パス。また今度ね。:
Hmm... I'll have to pass.
Maybe next time, okay？
translations.ごめんね。今日はやっぱり、ナシにしてもいい……かな？:
Sorry, I think we shouldn't go
there today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の小さいころって、ちょっと想像出来ないよね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Somehow I can't picture how
you were when you were a
child.
translations.そう？ 普通に小さかったよ？:
Really？ I was just a normal
kid.
translations.んー、でも今のイメージからだと、わからないかも知れないね。:
Hmm, but if you look at me
now, you probably can't
imagine how I was back then.
translations.活発だったの？: So, you were an active kid？
translations.うん。いつも外で走り回ってたの。転んで擦りむいた傷とか、今も残ってるよ？:
Yeah. I always ran around
outside. I got a lot of scars
when I fell down that still
remain.
translations.へぇ……でも今はインドア派だよね？ どこで変わったの？:
Eh...？ But you're such an
indoor girl now, right？ Since
when have you changed？
translations.どこでかな……あ、あれかも。:
Since when...？ Ah, it might
be that...
translations.あのね。親戚の家で、古い映画を観たの。吸血鬼モノの。:
Well, I saw an old movie at my
relative's house. It was about
vampires.
translations.そう。それに出てくる吸血鬼を退治する人、お爺さんだったんだけど、すっごく格好よか:
Yeah. And there was an old man
who tried to eradicate those
vampires. He looked so cool.
translations.それからホラー観るようになって、本を読むようになって……気がついたら、こうなって:
Since then, I started watching
horror movies and reading
books... Before I realized it,
I turned out like this.
translations.へぇ……１本の映画で変わったんだ。:
Eh...？ You changed just
because of one movie？
translations.ふふ。出会いって、面白いよね。:
Hehe. It was such an
interesting encounter, right？
translations.そう言えば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、あんまり家族の話、しないよね。:
Speaking of which,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you don't talk about
your family much.
translations.そうかな？ でも、そういう話って聞いても楽しくないでしょ？:
Really？ But it's no fun
talking about them, right？
translations.そうでもないよ。どんな生活してるのか、興味もあるし。:
That's not the case. I'm
interested in everything about
your life.
translations.うーん……でも、普通だよ？ お父さんは普通の会社員だし、お母さんは普通の専業主婦:
Hmm... But, it's just
ordinary. My dad is a regular
company employee. My mom is a
housewife. See？ It's so
ordinary.
translations.ふふ。妹か弟がいると思ってた？:
Hehe. Did you think I had
younger sisters and brothers？
translations.うん、なんとなく。気を悪くしたらごめん。:
Yeah, somehow. Sorry if that
makes you feel bad.
translations.ううん。世話好きだからかな？ お姉ちゃんっぽいって、よく言われるし。:
No. I just like to take care
of people, I think. Many
people have told me that I act
like an older sister.
translations.カワイイところもあるのに？:
They should've told you that
you're cute.
translations.学校では、どんな感じ？ 友達は多い方？:
How's school？ Do you have a
lot of friends？
translations.ううん、それほどは……あ、でも最近、ちょっと気になる人はいる。かな？:
No, not many... Ah, but
lately, there's someone I'm
really interested in, I think.
translations.うん。年下なんだけどね。クールで寡黙で、いつも独りなんだけど、ちょっと格好いいの:
Yeah, a cool and aloof
underclassman who seems to
always be alone.
translations.今は全然、接点がないんだけどね。でも、ああいう人とは、いつか友達になれたらなあっ:
We've never talked but it'd be
really nice if we could be
friends.
translations.なんでもないよ。そうか。気になるクールな、男がいるんだ……。:
Nothing... I see. There's a
cool guy that you're
interested in...
translations.あ……ふふ。もしかすると男の子かも。:
Ah... Hehe. Or maybe he's a
guy...
translations.ふふ。大丈夫。本当に女の子だから。ね？:
Hehe. Don't worry. She's
really a girl, okay？
translations.中学のころの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、どんな感じだった？:
What were you like when you
were in junior high,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ふふ。今度、写真、見る？:
Hehe. Shall I show you my
photos？
translations.あ、見たいな。: Ah, I want to see them.
translations.へぇ、三つ編みか。なんかイメージ通りかも。:
Eh？ Braid？ Somehow I can
picture that.
translations.そう？ 学校が、ちょっと厳しくて。:
Really？ My school was very
strict with hairstyle.
translations.毎朝、髪を編むのが日課だったな。ふふ、懐かしい。:
I had to braid my hair every
morning. Hehe. It's nostalgic.
translations.（三つ編みの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か……見てみたいな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
with braids... I want to see
that.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が小学生のころって、どんな子だった？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
how were you when you
were in grade school？
translations.んー、ヘンな子だったかな。本ばっかり読んでたし。:
Hmm... I was such a weird
girl. I read books all the
time.
translations.やっぱりホラー？:
I suppose they must have been
horror novels？
translations.うん。あとミステリに、ＳＦとか。大人向けの文庫本も普通に読んでたよ。小学生で。:
Yeah, and I read mystery and
Sci-Fi novels, too. I also
read some paper back novels
when I was in grade school.
translations.難しい漢字は？:
Were there a lot of words you
didn't understand？
translations.ね？ ヘンな子でしょ？:
Yeah？ I was such a weird
girl, right？
translations.ううん、努力家だなぁって。:
No, you were such a diligent
girl.
translations.でもそういう子って、ほとんどいないから、やっぱりヘンな子って言われてたの。:
But most girls wouldn't do
things like that. People would
call them weird girls.
translations.子供はそういうところ、容赦ないからね。:
Even with little girls, people
would still say something like
that, huh？
translations.特に男の子って、好きな女の子にはイジワルするもん。:
Back then, boys in particular
were the worst. They always
teased girls they liked.
translations.ふふ。さぁ、どうでしょう？:
Hehe. Well, how should I
answer？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がホラーにハマッたのって、いつごろだったの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Since when did you start
to like horror movies？
translations.親戚の家でテレビを見たのが最初だけど……小学校の２年生くらいかな？:
The first one I saw was when I
watched TV at my relative's
house... I was in 2nd grade, I
think.
translations.それより前は？ やっぱりアニメとか観てた？:
How about before that？ Did
you watch anime and stuff？
translations.うん、普通に。でも、女の子の見るものより、男の子向けのほうが多かったの。:
Yeah, regularly. But I watched
the ones for boys more than
the ones made for girls.
translations.男の子向けって……ロボットモノとか？:
Boys' anime？ Like the ones
with robots？
translations.ううん。変身ヒーローモノ。:
No, the ones with superhero
transformations.
translations.特撮系？ へぇ、女の子なのに珍しいね。:
The ones with lots of special
effects？ Hmm？ It's rare for
girls to watch that.
translations.だから小さい頃の私って、すごくやんちゃだったの。男の子みたいに生傷が絶えなくて、:
I was a mischievous kid. I
always got fresh wounds and my
mom kept telling me to act
more like a girl.
translations.今とは全然違うね。:
That's totally different from
you right now.
translations.なんだか心ここにあらず、って感じだけど……。:
Somehow, I feel like you're
distracted...
translations.何か別のこと考えてる？:
Are you thinking about
something else？
translations.もしかして……怒ってたり、する？:
Could it be that... you're mad
at me？
translations.帰りたく……ないの？: Don't you want to go home？
translations.ふふ。考え事？:
Hehe. Got something to think
about？
translations.ふふ、こういう時は……わかるよね？:
Hehe, you know what to do now,
right？
translations.手を繋いでもいいけど、どうする？:
I don't mind us holding hands.
What do you say？
translations.ふふ、そんなに緊張しなくてもいいのよ？:
Hehe, you don't have to be
that nervous.
translations.そうだよ。だって……あなたの体温、直接感じちゃうから……。:
Yeah, it's like I can feel the
warmth of your body...
translations.別に。ただ……あなたの手、意外と温かいなぁって……ふふ。:
No. It's just... Your hand is
unexpectedly warm... Hehe.
translations.それに、男の子の手だね。ちょっとドキドキしちゃうな。ふふ。:
So this is what it feels like
to hold a guy's hand. My heart
is throbbing. Hehe.
