translations.ううん。そうじゃなくて、男の子なんだなぁって。そう思って……。:
No, that's not the case. I was
thinking that you are a man,
and...
translations.もっと強く握ってもいいのよ。: Can you hold my hand tightly？
translations.……ふふ、痛いくらい強く握ってこないんだ。ちょっと残念。ふふ。:
...Hehe, I thought you would
squeeze my hand until it
hurts. Too bad. Hehe.
translations.そうそう、そんな感じ……嬉しいな……。:
Right, right. Like that. I'm
happy.
translations.なんだか……ふわふわしてきちゃった……。:
Why am I feeling so happy like
this...？
translations.手を繋いでるだけなのに……おかしいよね……でも、ちょっといいかも。:
We're just holding hands...
This is weird... but it feels
good.
translations.……ふふ、ドキドキしてきちゃって。ほら……私の頬、赤いでしょ？:
...Hehe, my heart is
throbbing. Look... Isn't my
face all red？
translations.手を繋ぐと、心まであったかくなる気がするの。:
When you hold my hand, I can
feel the warmth going through
my heart.
translations.私の手を握る強さ、あなたの手のひらや指の感触……その全てが合格ってこと。:
You holding my hand. I can
feel the touch from your palm
and your fingers. This is such
a success.
translations.ふふ。恋人の欲目も入ってるけど、いいよね？:
Hehe. Something a little
cheesy like this is okay,
right？
translations.こうして手をつなげるなんて……すごく恋人っぽいじゃない。:
That we're holding hands like
this. We're really like
lovers, right？
translations.手が触れ合ってるだけなのに……もっと近づいたら、もっとドキドキしちゃう？:
We're just holding hands. I
wonder if it can be even more
exciting if we get closer.
translations.私の心臓、さっきから全然言うことを聞いてくれないの……。:
My heart... It won't listen to
my orders anymore...
translations.私たちって……ううん、なんでもない。:
Do we... Never mind, it's
nothing.
translations.もちろん、どう見たって恋人同士だよ。:
Of course. However I look at
it, we are lovers.
translations.恋人同士なんだから、絡めるのもアリじゃない？ ……ほら。:
We're lovers, so this is
natural, right？ ...Come on.
translations.こんな風に手を繋いでるんだもん、どこからどう見ても、恋人同士だよね？:
When we hold hands, no matter
how people look at us, we look
like lovers, right？
translations.着くのが待ち遠しいけど、早く着くのももったいない気がするね……。:
I feel like it's a bit
unfortunate that we've arrived
this soon...
translations.楽しい時間って、あっという間に終わっちゃうよね……。:
What a great time, it went by
so quickly...
translations.誰かさんが手をつないでくれなかったのが、一番の心残りかな？:
Someone here just doesn't want
to hold my hand. Isn't that
regrettable？
translations.手、つなぎたかったんだけどな？:
I kind of wanted to hold hands
with you.
translations.あ。見て見て、あの家の庭、素敵だと思わない？:
Ah, look there. Doesn't that
house have a very nice
garden？
translations.ふふ。私を見るのもいいけど、ちゃんと周りも見ないと、もったいないよ？:
Hehe. Although I want you to
always keep your eyes on me,
it's such a waste if you don't
look at your surroundings at
all.
translations.あ、ここの家、建て替えられたんだ。:
Ah, that house's
reconstruction has finished.
translations.ほら見て、玄関の表札。ハートマークの木彫りなんて……もしかして手作り？:
Look at the nameplate. It's
made of wood and has a heart
mark on it... Is it handmade？
translations.ほんとだ。もしかしてこの家の人、新婚夫婦かな？:
You're right. Could it be that
they're newlyweds？
translations.ふふ。私たちの新居も、ああいう感じになるといいね。:
Hehe. It would be nice to have
something like that when we
build our home.
translations.ねぇ、あのアパート、古い映画に出てきそうな感じがしない？:
Hey, look at that apartment.
It looks like the ones you see
in old movies, huh？
translations.言われてみれば……昭和って感じ、かな？:
It looks like it was built in
the Showa era, right？
translations.近くに銭湯あるかな？:
I wonder if there's a public
bath nearby.
translations.えっ？ 昭和のアパートって言ったら、銭湯が付きものでしょ？:
Eh？ I think people who lived
in apartments in the Showa era
relied on public baths,
right？
translations.あ……あのマンション、もしかして映画に出てたかも。:
Ah... That mansion... I think
I've seen it in a movie.
translations.ほら、あれ。あのベランダの感じ、絶対見たことあると思うんだけど。:
Look, right there. I know I've
seen that balcony from
somewhere before.
translations.あれか。いい感じのマンションだけど……なんの映画に出たか、覚えてる？:
That one？ It looks like a
nice mansion... Do you
remember which movie you saw
it from？
translations.確か建物全体が妖怪の体だって設定のホラー映画だと思うんだけど……うーん、どうだっ:
I think it was a horror movie
where the whole family became
ghosts... Hmm, which one was
that？
translations.あ……ねぇねぇ。あそこにある古い家、いかにもな感じでいいと思わない？:
Ah... Hey, hey. Do you think
that old house feels nice？
translations.あれ？ いかにもっていうのは、ホラーっぽいってこと？:
Eh？ Don't you think it
somehow belongs in a horror
movie？
translations.ううん。魔女の家って意味。:
Well... I was thinking it was
like a witch's hut.
translations.でも煙突がないからダメね、惜しいなぁ。:
But it's too bad that it
doesn't have a chimney. That's
disappointing.
translations.あ……ほら、そこの電線。あの小鳥のカップル。:
Ah... Look, there's a pair of
little birds on the power
cable.
translations.ふふ。ぴったり寄り添ってるけど……向こうからみたら、こっちのほうが寄り添って見え:
Hehe. They're cuddling close
together... I wonder if they
see us the same way as we see
them.
translations.えっと……そう見えるように、する？:
Well... Shall we show them
that we're cuddling close
together, too？
translations.もぅ……そういうことは、いちいち確認しないの。:
Geez... You could do something
like that without asking.
translations.……もしかして、こっち見てる？:
...Do you think they're
staring at us？
translations.うん……少し前から急に増えたよね。なんでだろう？:
Yeah... And there are more and
more of them coming this way.
Why's that？
translations.なんかイヤな感じが……とりあえず、急がない？:
I don't feel good about this.
Let's get out of here, okay？
translations.あ、うん。そうだね。ちょっと怖い気もするし……。:
Ah, okay. Somehow, this is a
little scary...
translations.あ……カワイー。塀の上の仔猫。可愛いねぇ。:
Ah... So cute... That kitten
on the wall is so cute.
translations.あれ、寝てるのかな？ それにしては尻尾が……。:
Eh？ Is it sleeping？ And look
at its tail...
translations.ふふ。夢の中でネズミでも追い掛けてるんじゃないかな？:
Hehe. It might be dreaming
about chasing a mouse, huh？
translations.あ、起きた……ふふ、不思議そうにきょろきょろしてる。やっぱり夢、見てたんだよ。:
Ah, it woke up... Hehe... It's
looking around restlessly. I
bet it really was dreaming.
translations.あ……置物だと思ったら犬なんだ。大きいなぁ。:
Ah... I thought it was an
ornament, but it's actually a
dog. It's big.
translations.そのわりに尻尾、嬉しそうに振ってるけど……。:
Look how it's wagging its tail
happily...
translations.ごめんね、遊んであげられないの。お姉さん、この子の相手で手一杯だから。ふふ。:
Sorry. This big sister already
has this one to take care of.
Hehe.
translations.ほら、あそこ……ああん、中に入っちゃった……。:
Look, right there... Aaaah, it
went in there...
translations.中って……まさか、あの中にいるの？ クジャクが？:
In there... You mean there's a
peacock in there？
translations.ペットなのかな？ でもクジャクを飼うなんて……気持ちはわかるけど、すごいね。:
Is it someone's pet？ ...But
do people raise peacocks as
pets？ That's amazing.
translations.あ、あの雲……ああん、消えちゃった。:
Ah, that cloud... No, it
disappeared.
translations.あなたそっくりの雲があったの。……そっか。あなたもいつか、消えちゃうんだ……。:
That cloud looked just like
you. I see... So you'll
disappear someday, too...
translations.あ……今の、流れ星？:
Ah... Was that a shooting
star？
translations.こんな時間に？: In the middle of the day？
translations.……あ、願い事するの、忘れてた。もったいない……。:
...Ah, I forgot to make a
wish. What a waste...
translations.なにをお願いしたかったの？:
What did you want to wish
for？
translations.あ、いい匂い……なんの匂いかな？:
Ah, something smells nice...
What was that smell？
translations.匂い？ 全然感じないけど……気のせいじゃない？:
Smell？ I didn't smell
anything... .Was it just your
imagination？
translations.え？ ほら、この……なんていえばいいのかな？ わからない？:
Eh？ Come on, the smell was...
I don't really know how to
describe it.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の髪からいい匂いがしてくるのはわかるけど……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I only know that your
hair smells nice...
translations.もぅ……そういう不意打ちはちょっと卑怯だぞ。:
Geez... That's like a surprise
attack. You're so crafty.
translations.ちょっと、ひと雨きそうな雲行き……かな？:
Wait, it looks like it's going
to rain... right？
translations.せっかくあなたと一緒に歩いてるのに……。:
I thought I could spend more
time walking with you...
translations.……降らないうちに急ぐ？:
...Let's hurry and go before
it starts raining, okay？
translations.ううん。もし降っても、ひとつ傘の下に……ね。ふふ。そういうの、嫌い？:
No. Even if it rains, we can
share this umbrella,
right...？ Hehe. Do you hate
that？
translations.ん……やだ、もぅ……目に何か入っちゃった……。:
Hmm... No, geez... Something
got in my eyes...
translations.んー、ダメかも。見てくれる？:
No, this is bad. Can you take
a look？
translations.あ、中学生のカップル……ふふ、ふたりとも顔が真っ赤。かわいいなぁ。:
Ah, a junior high couple...
Hehe, their faces are all red.
They're cute.
translations.私たちがもし、中学の時に出会ってたら……あんな感じになったのかな？:
If we met during junior high,
we'd probably look like that
too, right？
translations.……どうかな？ 多分、今と変わらないと思うけど……。:
...I wonder. I think we'd be
the same as we are now...
translations.ふふ。たまには中学生気分で、初々しいデート、なんてのもいいかもね？:
Hehe. It'd be nice if we could
act as innocent as those kids
every now and then, huh？
translations.……憧れちゃうなぁ。: ...I want us to be like that.
translations.ほら、あそこのおじいちゃんとおばあちゃん。きっと夫婦だよね……。:
Look. That elderly couple over
there. They must be husband
and wife...
translations.いいなぁ……私たちも、あんな風に歳をとれたら幸せだよね……。:
That's nice... If we can be
like that when we get old, I'd
be happy...
translations.あ、えっと……もしかしてあなた、そっくりの兄弟とか親戚、いる？:
Ah, well... Do you happen to
have a twin brother or a
cousin that looks like you？
translations.じゃあ、勘違いかな？ あなたそっくりの男の子が居て……びっくりしちゃった。:
Okay then... I just saw a guy
who looked exactly like you.
That's why I was surprised.
translations.……ふふ。ねぇ、あそこに赤い服を着たきれいな女の人、いるでしょ？:
...Hehe. Hey, that woman in
the red dress is very pretty,
right？
translations.うん……モデルかな？ あの体型であんな服……。:
Yeah... She might be a model,
right？ Look at her figure and
the clothes she's wearing...
translations.ふーん。そういうところに目がいくんだ？:
Hmph. So that's what you've
been looking at, huh？
translations.カワイイ……▼\nいいよ、可愛かったから\n許してあげる。:
So cute...▼ Okay, because
you're cute, I'll forgive you.
translations.ほら、さっき小さい女の子が走っていったでしょ？:
Come on. There was a girl who
just ran by, right？
translations.うん。……なんていうかな、幸せそうに笑ってた女の子だよね？:
Yeah... Somehow, she was
smiling happily, huh？
translations.恋、なのかな？ 小さくても女の子だもの。そう思ったら、微笑ましくて……ね。:
Could it be love？ Even for a
small girl, when she's in love
she can smile like that...
right？
translations.……ふふ。さりげなーく守ってくれるんだ。:
...Hehe. You protected me in
such casual manner.
translations.私はあなたのカノジョなんだなぁって、しみじみ感じただけ。:
Now you make me feel very glad
to be your girlfriend.
translations.うん……でも、改めて言われると照れるな……。:
Okay... Well, this kind of
makes me feel embarrassed...
translations.ねぇ、あのおじいちゃん、あんなに細いのに、すごく大きなバイクに乗ってるんだね。:
Hey, look at that grandpa.
He's so thin but he's riding a
very big motorcycle.
translations.あなたもああいうバイク、乗ってみたい？:
Do you want to ride that kind
of motorcycle, too？
translations.少しは……もし乗れるようになったら、後ろに座ってくれる？:
A little bit, I think... Will
you ride on the back of it if
I get one？
translations.ふふ、いいけど。バイクだと、家族が増えたときに困っちゃうよ？:
Hehe, sure. But wouldn't it be
a problem to travel by bike
when our family members
increase？
translations.あ、あの自動車、小さくて玩具みたい……。:
Ah, that car is so tiny, it
looks like a toy car...
translations.ほんとだ。ちょっと狭そうだよね、あの中って。:
Yeah. The interior seems to be
very small.
translations.でも小さいほうが運転も楽だろうし……。:
But I think a small car is
easier to drive...
translations.ふふ、そうだね。免許とったら、お姉さんがどこかに連れて行ってあげよっか？:
Hehe. Well, when I get a
driver's license, will you let
this big sister take you for a
ride？
translations.あれ、何千万もする外国の車だよね？:
Eh？ That's an extremely
expensive foreign car, right？
translations.うーん、よくわからないけど、高級車なことは間違いないね。:
Well, I'm not sure. But I can
tell that it's a luxurious car
for sure.
translations.もっと安くてカワイイ車のほうがいいのに……どうしてああいうの、欲しがるかな。:
I'd prefer a smaller and
cheaper one... I don't know
why people like those
expensive cars.
translations.気づかなかった？ さっきもサイレンの音、してたよ？:
Didn't you hear the sirens
just a while ago？
translations.もう。ぼーっとしてたら事故にあって、あなたが救急車で運ばれちゃうよ？ そんなのイ:
Geez, if you keep spacing out
like this, you might get in an
accident. I don't want to see
you in an ambulance, okay？
translations.ほら、今、通り過ぎた……あれ？ さっきまでそこに……。:
Look. It just passed by...
Eh？ It was there just a
second ago...
translations.（見間違いだよな……）:
(She probably mistook it for
something else...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ちょっと待って。靴のヒモ、ほどけちゃったから……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
wait a moment.
My shoelaces are
getting loose.
translations.ライオン……あ、着ぐるみ？ ううん、違うよね。お散歩？ あれ？ 首輪は？:
A lion... Ah, a costume？ No,
it can't be. Why is it walking
there...？ And with that
collar？
translations.どうしたの？ ありえないものを見たって感じだけど……？:
What's wrong？ I think you
just saw something impossible.
translations.あ、そうだ。高速ゾウガメっていう話、知ってる？:
Ah, right. Have you heard of a
giant turtle that moves at
high speed？
translations.ゾウガメが猛スピードで車道を走るっていう都市伝説で……見てる？:
Do you mean you've seen that
legendary, high-speed giant
turtle？
translations.……うん、今……きっと夢だよね。うん。夢だよ、夢。:
...Yes, just now... It must've
been a dream. Yeah, it must've
been a dream. A dream.
translations.（見間違い、だよな……？）:
(Did you mistake it for
something else...？)
translations.い……今……じ、自動車ぐらいのゴ……ゴキ……ううん、なんでもない。うん、なんでも:
J-Just now... That car-sized
cockroach... No, it's nothing.
Yeah, it's really nothing.
translations.だから、なんでもないの！ あんな大きいゴキ……が飛んでるなんて。絶対、ありえない:
That's why I said it was
nothing！ A cockroach can't be
that big... And it was
flying... That's impossible.
translations.今の、絶対にあの監督だったのに……有名なんだよ？ ホラーを撮らせたら世界一の映画:
That person just now was that
film director... The famous
one who made many horror films
that are known worldwide.
translations.見間違いだったかもしれないし、そんなに落ち込まなくても……。:
Didn't you just mistake
someone else for him？ You
don't have to be this
disappointed...
translations.うん……でも、握手して欲しかったなぁ……。:
Okay... But I should have
asked for a handshake, at
least...
translations.危なかった……誰だ、こんなもの落としたのは！:
That was dangerous... Who
dropped this thing？
translations.送ってくれてありがと。カレシの義務、果たしてるね？:
Thanks for walking me home.
Just like a boyfriend would
do, right？
translations.名残惜しいけど……バイバイだね。:
I don't want to leave, but...
Bye-bye.
translations.今日はありがとう。また誘ってね。:
Thanks for today. Invite me
again, okay？
translations.じゃあ、今日はここで……ね。: Well, this is it for today...
translations.今日は楽しかった。じゃあ、またね。:
Today was fun. Well, see you
later.
translations.帰りは気を付けてね。じゃあ、また……ね。:
Go home carefully. I'll see
you soon, right？
translations.ううん、今日は楽しかった。じゃあ、また。:
No problem. Today was fun. See
you later.
translations.じゃあ、今日はこれで……。: Okay, this is all for today...
translations.その、今日は……。: Then this is it for today...
translations.うん、その……ちょっと……。:
Um, well... Just a little
bit...
translations.デートの後なんだから……ね？:
This date is about to end,
right...？
translations.もぅ……どうして欲しいか、わからない？:
Hey... You really don't know
what I want？
translations.ふふ、惚れ直しちゃった……かな。:
Hehe. I feel like I'm falling
in love with you again...
translations.うん、また今度に……ね？:
Okay, let's do this later...
Okay？
translations.悪くないけど、もう少し……ね？:
It wasn't bad, but... Maybe a
bit more, okay？
translations.そういうぎこちないところも、悪くないよ？:
This clumsy part of you isn't
bad at all.
translations.ねぇ……よかったら、うちで勉強しない？ ほら、テスト近いじゃない。:
Hey... If it's okay with you,
how about you come to study at
my house？ We have tests
coming up, right？
translations.うちで勉強しない？ テスト勉強。どうせまだやってないんでしょ。:
Wanna come to study at my
house？ You haven't studied
for the coming tests, right？
translations.テスト勉強、ちゃんとやってる？ よかったらうちに来てしない？:
Have you studied for the
coming tests？ Wanna come to
study at my house？
translations.じゃあ……放課後ね。:
Then I'll see you after
school.
translations.じゃあ、放課後。うちに来てね？:
Then come to my house after
school.
translations.うん。じゃあ、放課後、うちまで、ね？:
Um, then let's meet at my
house after school.
translations.そっか……うん、頑張ってね。:
I see... Okay, do your best
then.
translations.そうなんだ。あとで後悔しても、しらないぞ？:
Really？ Don't regret it later
then...
translations.そっか、ひとりでがんばるんだ。えらいえらい。:
I see. You want to study by
yourself. Good student, huh？
translations.あれ、こんな所で……。そうだ、もし時間があるなら、これからうちでテスト勉強やらな:
Eh？ You're here... Right, if
you have time, how about
coming to my house to study
for the tests？
translations.テスト勉強か。確かにそんな時期だけど……。:
Study for the tests？ Right,
we have tests coming up...
translations.あれ、こんな所で……あ、テストの準備は？ うちで勉強しない？:
Eh？ You're here... Ah, have
you studied for the tests？
How about you come to study at
my house？
translations.そういえば、そろそろテスト勉強の時期か……。:
Right, it's almost exam time
again...
translations.あれ？ 奇遇だね。……そうだ、いいこと思いついちゃった。これからうちで勉強会やろ:
Eh？ I didn't expect to meet
you here. Right, I got a nice
idea. Let's study for the
exams together. How's that？
translations.そうか、そういえばテストが近いんだった……。:
Right, the exams are coming
up...
translations.うん……じゃあ、あとでうちに来てね。待ってるから。:
Well... Then come to my house
after this. I'll be waiting.
translations.じゃあ、準備して、うちに集合。あまり遅くならないようにね。:
Then let's meet at my house
later today. Don't be late,
okay？
translations.じゃあ、またあとでね。今日はじっくりお勉強しましょ。:
Then we'll meet after this. We
have to study hard, okay？
translations.そっか。突然だったもんね。ごめんね……。:
I see. It's sudden, huh？
Sorry...
translations.断っちゃうんだ。ふーん……なんてね。突然、無理言ってごめんね。:
You turned me down... Well,
it's probably so sudden.
Sorry.
translations.あらら。振られちゃったか。残念。じゃあ、また今度ね。:
A-ha... You rejected me. What
a pity. Maybe next time then.
translations.勉強でわからないとこがあるんだけど、一緒に勉強しない？:
I don't quite understand. How
about we study together？
translations.いいよ、教えてあげられるか自信はないけど。私の部屋でね。:
That's fine. Although I'm not
confident that I can teach
you, you can come to study at
my house.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ私の部屋に来なさい。教えてあげるから。:
Hehe, come to study at my
house. I'll teach you then.
translations.じゃあ、私のお部屋で。家庭教師みたいね。:
Then come to study at my
house. This is like I'm your
tutor, huh？
translations.中は初めてだよね、ちょっと恥ずかしいかな……。:
It's your first time here,
right？ This is a little
embarrassing...
translations.うん……じゃあ、お邪魔します……。:
Yes... Well, I'll have to
bother you today...
translations.そういえば入るのは初めてだね、いたずらしちゃ、ダメよ？:
This is your first time to be
here, right？ Don't do
anything mischievous, okay？
translations.ふふ……初めてね、入るのは。なんか緊張しちゃう。:
Hehe. It's the first time that
you're here. I feel a little
nervous.
translations.いらっしゃい。じゃあ、入って。:
Welcome to my home. Now, let's
get inside.
translations.うん。お邪魔しまーす。:
Okay, I have to bother you
today.
translations.この前みたいに、部屋の中じろじろ見たりしないでよ？:
Don't keep staring at things
in my room like you did last
time, okay？
translations.してないって……じゃあ、お邪魔しまーす。:
I won't... Then I have to
bother you today.
translations.はい、いらっしゃいませ。首をながくして、待ってたんだから。ふふ。:
Okay, welcome to my home. I've
always been waiting for you to
come here. Hehe.
translations.また大げさに……じゃあ、お邪魔しまーす。:
You're exaggerating again...
Then I have to bother you
today.
translations.普通の部屋でしょ？ 特に面白い物なんてないから、あんまり見ないでね？:
It's just a normal room,
right？ There's nothing
particularly interesting, so
don't stare.
translations.部屋の中では、座ってじっとしてること。これ、決まりだからね。:
The only thing you can do in
here is to sit down and stay
still, okay？
translations.ふふ……緊張してる？ もっと楽にしていいよ。:
Hehe... Are you nervous？ You
can make yourself more
comfortable.
translations.やっぱり、ちょっと落ち着かないね……ふふ。:
You really can't calm down,
can you...？ Hehe.
translations.そこ。そうやって部屋の中を見ない。けっこう恥ずかしいんだから……。:
Let's sit there. That way you
can't look around my room.
It's embarrassing...
translations.まだ緊張してる？ 実は私も。なかなか慣れないよね。:
Are you still nervous？
Actually, I'm not used to
something like this either.
translations.そこ、座っていいよ。始めよ。:
Shall we sit over there？
Let's get started.
translations.ほらほら早く座って。……何から始める？:
Hey, hey. Hurry up and take a
seat....Where shall we start？
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ勉強会、始めよっか？:
Now, shall we start our lesson
reviews？
translations.いくよ？ 大丈夫？:
Shall we start？ Are you
ready？
translations.問題は３問。全問正解だったら、ご褒美……あげちゃおうかな？:
There will be a set of 3
questions. If you answer them
all correctly, I'll give you a
reward... Do you feel
motivated now？
translations.あ、パス？ うん、わかった。: Ah, pass？ Okay, I got it.
translations.難しくないのに……ふふ。:
It wasn't a difficult one,
though. Hehe...
translations.しょうがないなぁ。じゃあ、これはパス……と。:
It can't be helped. So, we'll
skip this one.
translations.あ、すごい。全問正解だよ。ご褒美……あげるね。:
Ah, amazing. You got them all
correct. I'll give you a
reward.
translations.全問正解。やればできるんじゃない。じゃあ、ご褒美、あげないと……ね。:
You got them all correct. You
really can do it. Then I'll
have to give you a reward,
right...？
translations.全部当たったね。ふふ……それじゃあ、ご褒美は……。:
You got them all. Hehe... Then
my reward for this is...
translations.ふふ。今回のご褒美は、これだよ……。:
Hehe. Your reward this time is
this...
translations.待ってて、すぐ戻るから。:
Wait a second. I'll be right
back.
translations.残念……惜しかったね。あと１問だったのに……。:
Too bad... It's regrettable,
but you missed one question...
translations.１問不正解、ご褒美はあげられません。:
You made one wrong answer. I
can't give you a reward.
translations.１問間違えちゃったね。ご褒美……あげられないよ？:
You missed one question. I
can't give you a reward,
okay？
translations.もう、やめちゃうんだ……。:
Hmm, you want to quit,
huh...？
translations.ふふ。この調子だと、本格的に教え込まないとダメかな？:
Hehe... If it's like this,
I'll have to tutor you very
hard, huh？
translations.どんまい、どんまい。このくらいでへこたれてちゃダメだよ？:
Don't mind, don't mind. Don't
lose your heart with just
something like this.
translations.うん。あきらめないことが大事だよね。:
Yes, the most important thing
is not to give up.
translations.これじゃあ、あんまり勉強になってないんじゃない？:
You still haven't learned
anything much, right？
translations.しょうがないなぁ。じゃあ、もうちょっとやる気が出るようにしてあげるね。:
It can't be helped. Well, I'll
try to cheer you up a little
bit.
translations.……もっとそっちに行ってもいい、かな？:
...It'd be better if you come
a little closer.
translations.ふふ……ねぇ。わかるよね？:
Hehe... Hey, you know what to
do, right？
translations.ねぇ、ちょっと……ね？:
Hey, just a little bit...
Okay？
translations.これ、あなたにもらった服なんだけど……どうかな？ 似合ってる？:
This is what you gave me. How
is it？ Does it suit me？
translations.この服、見覚え無い？ じゃあ、ご感想、聞かせてもらおうかな？:
Do you remember this outfit？
Now, may I ask your opinion
about it？
translations.はい。ご褒美に、もらった服を着てみました。どうかな？:
Okay, as a reward, I'm wearing
the outfit you gave me. How is
it？
translations.たまには、こんな感じで……どうかな？:
Occasionally, I wear something
like this... How is it？
translations.ほら、どう？ いつもと違う私……なーんてね。:
Hey, how is it？ I look
different, right？
translations.こんな服着てみちゃいました。ふふふ……うれしい？:
I ended up wearing this.
Hehehe... Are you happy？
translations.もういいでしょ……ね？ これ、すごく恥ずかしいんだから……ね？:
It's enough, right？ This is
really embarrassing, you
know？
translations.はい、サービスはここまで。ふふ、そんな未練がましい目で見てもダメ。:
Okay, enough for the service.
Hehe. Looking at me like that
won't help.
translations.はい、もう終わり。ずっと着てたら、ありがたみがないでしょ？:
Okay, this is it. If I keep
this on for too long, it won't
be called a special anymore.
translations.どうする？ 次も全問正解なら、もしかしたら……ふふ。:
How about this？ If you get
more questions correct, I'll
wear something else. Hehe.
translations.うん。やっぱり、そうこなくっちゃね。:
Okay, I knew this would be
your answer.
translations.もう、こんなの特別だよ？:
Hey, this is very special,
okay？
translations.ほら、ここまでさせたんだから、やる気出さないと許さないよ？:
Hey, I've done this much for
you. If you still don't feel
motivated, I have nothing to
say.
translations.もぅ……そんな目でみないの。:
Hey... Don't look at me like
that.
translations.特別サービスだからね？:
It's a special service for
you, okay？
translations.いつまで見てるの？:
How long are you going to keep
looking？
translations.もうそろそろ、やめるからね。:
It's about time we should stop
this.
translations.……変なところ、見てないよね？:
...You aren't looking at
places where you shouldn't
look, right？
translations.やだ、どこ見てるの？: No, where are you looking at？
translations.なに？ あんまり変なとこ見ないでよ……ね？:
What？ Don't stare at places
where you shouldn't look,
okay？
translations.そんな熱心に見なくていいの。:
You don't have to stare so
enthusiastically like that.
translations.こんな服着てるからかな。いつもよりドキドキする……。:
Maybe it's because of this
outfit that my heart is
pounding so hard...
translations.こんな格好で……ちょっと恥ずかしいけど……。:
Wearing this outfit is just
too embarrassing...
translations.じゃあ、今日の所はこれぐらいでおしまい。: Then this is it for today.
translations.ふふ、すごくがんばったね。:
Hehe, you really tried your
best.
translations.結構、いい勉強になったんじゃない？:
We've studied a lot today,
right？
translations.がんばったから、花マルあげちゃう。:
You did your best. I'll give
you a "good job" stamp.
translations.もうちょっと、がんばらないとね？:
You'll have to try a little
harder, okay？
translations.テスト、このままだとちょっと心配かな……。:
I'm quite worried about the
coming exams...
translations.今日は調子が悪かったみたいだけど……うん、きっとなんとかなる。ね？:
Things didn't go well today
but I guess we can manage it
somehow, right？
translations.もぉ、これじゃ心配。家でもちゃんと勉強してね？:
Geez. You made me worried. You
must study after you get home,
all right？
translations.じゃあ、テストがんばってね。私もだけど……ふふ。:
Then do your best for the
tests. I'll do my best, too.
Hehe.
translations.テスト勉強は、この辺で切り上げるとして……もう帰る？:
I think we have covered
everything for the tests.
...You wanna go home now？
translations.できれば、\nもうちょっと一緒にいたいな: Can I stay for a while？
translations.それじゃあ、ちょっと待ってて。いいもの見せてあげる。:
Then wait a moment. I have
something to show you.
translations.結構、充実した時間だったね。:
We have spent our time
productively.
translations.こんなので勉強になったのかわからないけど……機会があったら、また来てね。:
I don't know why things turned
out to be like that... But if
there's a chance, let's do
this again.
translations.今日は……なんか、途中から変なことになっちゃったね。:
In the middle of our study, we
did some strange things...
translations.ねぇ、どうしたの？ 黙り込んじゃって……。:
Hey, what's the matter？
You've been so quiet...
translations.もぅ、ねぇったら。なにか言ってよ。:
Geez, at least say something
to me.
translations.私、怒るよ？ ……いいの？:
I'm getting angry. Are you
okay with that？
translations.ふふ、どうしたの？ だまりこんじゃって……。:
Hehe, what's wrong？ You've
become so quiet.
translations.もぅ、いつまでそうしてるつもり？ つまらないから、もう帰る？:
Geez, how long are you going
to be like this？
translations.ふーん、そう……。そうやって無視するんだ、私のこと……。:
Hmph, I see... You're ignoring
me then.
translations.おイタが過ぎる、……わよ？:
This is too much for a joke,
you know？
translations.本当にどうしちゃったの？ なにか考え事？ 悩んでることがあるなら、聞くよ？:
There must be something. Can
you tell me？ Is there
something that worries you？
I'll listen.
translations.もぅ、なにか言ってよ。言ってくれないとわからないんだから。:
Geez, say something. If you
don't tell me, how can I
know？
translations.わかった。今日はそういう気分なんだ。うん、わかった。:
Okay, so you want to be like
this all day, huh？ I
understand now.
translations.ふふ、さっきから黙ったままだけど、どうかしたの？:
Hehe, you've been quiet for a
while. What's wrong？
translations.……なんだか私も眠くなってきちゃった……ねぇ、本当は起きてるよね？:
...Now, I feel like I'm
getting sleepy. Hey, are you
still awake？
translations.ふふ。お姉さんが膝枕、貸してあげよっかなー？:
Hehe, maybe I'll let you sleep
on my lap. Shall I？
translations.ヒツジが１匹ぃ、ヒツジが２匹ぃ……たぬきが……たぬきは何匹だっけ……。:
One sheep... Two sheep... One
raccoon dog... Two raccoon
dogs...
translations.はぁ……私も眠くなっちゃった……かーえろっと。:
Hah, I'm so sleepy. I'm going
home.
translations.もう、どうしちゃったの？ さっきから黙り込んでるけど……。:
Hey, what's wrong？ You've
been quiet for quite a while.
translations.たぬき寝入りする子は、たぬき汁にしちゃうぞー。:
A kid who feigns sleep must be
punished.
translations.じゃあもう、一生そこでそうしてなさい。お母さん、帰るからね？:
Enough. You can keep being
like this your whole life.
Mommy is going home now.
translations.どうしたの？ さっきから静かだけど……。:
What's wrong？ You've been
quiet for a while...
translations.おーい、姉ヶ崎寧々のカレシさーん。なにか答えてくださーい。カノジョが泣いてますよ:
Hey, Anegasaki Nene's
boyfriend. Can you answer me？
Your girlfriend is going to
cry.
translations.おーい、ほんとに泣いちゃうよー。かわいく謝ってくれたら許してあげるよー。:
Hey, I'm really going to cry,
but I'll forgive you if you
apologize.
translations.なんか、たぬきにつままれたみたいね……あれ、キツネだっけ？:
What？ You look as baffled as
a raccoon dog... Or should it
be a fox...？
translations.ぽんぽこぽんぽこぽんぽこ……はぁ、帰るね。:
Raccoon dog, raccoon dog,
raccoon dog... ...Hah, I'm
going home.
translations.ねぇ……さっきから黙ってるけど……私、なにかしたかな？:
Hey, you've been so quiet. Did
I do something bad？
translations.ごめん。なにか気に障ることしたなら、謝るね。だから……ね？:
I'm sorry if I did something
that hurt your feelings. I've
apologized, so...
translations.ごめんなさい。私の悪いところ、全部直すから……。:
I'm so sorry. I'll fix
whatever I've done wrong.
translations.うん……私が全部悪いんだよね？ だから……なにも言ってくれないんだよね？:
Okay, this means everything is
all my fault, then. Otherwise,
you would have said something.
translations.ごめんね。今日は、帰ったほうがいいんだよね。うん。そうする。今日は、ごめんね。:
I'm sorry. I think I'd better
go home for today. Yeah, I
should. I'm sorry about today.
translations.……どうしたの？ さっきから黙り込んでるけど……私、なにかしたかな？:
...What's wrong？ You've been
so quiet. ...Did I do
something bad？
translations.それならそうと、言ってくれないと。: If I did, just tell me.
translations.黙ってちゃわかんないよ、ちゃんと言ってよ。:
If you don't tell me, I don't
know what I did. Just tell me.
translations.……そっか。今日は、そういう気分なんだね。うん、わかった。ごめんね、いろいろと。:
Okay, so you want to be like
this all day, huh？ I
understand now. Sorry about
everything.
translations.今日は帰るね。じゃあ……また、ね。:
I'm going home. Bye... See
you, okay？
translations.ねぇ……私、なにかしたかな？ あ、うん。ごめんね、急にへんなこと聞いて。:
Hey, did I do something bad？
Um, I'm sorry to say this all
of a sudden.
translations.そんな日も、あるよね。何かあったなら、私に甘えてもいいからね？:
There are days like this,
huh？ If something happened,
tell me and I'll comfort you.
translations.……そう、今日は甘えてもくれないんだね。:
...So, you don't even need me
to comfort you, huh？
translations.今日はこれで帰るね。えっと……じゃあ、また。ね？:
I'm going home. Well... See
you later, okay？
translations.どうしたの、急に。:
Why did you say that all of a
sudden？
translations.うん、あなたが嫌いになったわけじゃなくて……デートって、ムードも大切でしょ？:
Well, it's not that I hate
you, but for a date, the mood
is very important, right？
translations.はあ……今日はもう、これで終わりにしない？:
Hah... Can we call it a day
for today？
translations.せっかくのデートなのに……もう少しカノジョのこと考えてもいいと思わない？:
It's the long awaited date,
but... Don't you think you
should be more concerned about
your girlfriend？
translations.少し反省すること。いい？ じゃあね。:
You should reflect on this,
okay？ Bye.
translations.もう……せっかくのデートなのに。:
Geez... This is the long
awaited date, but...
translations.ムードって、大切なんだよ？ お姉さんだって、女の子なんだから。:
The mood is very important,
you know？ I'm a girl, after
all.
translations.うん。ちょっと無神経すぎた。だから今日はこれで終わり。次のデートまで反省してね？:
Yeah, a little too
insensitive. So, let's call it
a day for today. Reflect on
this until our next date,
okay？
translations.もう……せっかくのデートなのに、これじゃ台無しだよ？:
Geez... This is the long
awaited date, but it turns out
to be such a waste of time.
translations.私がダメだったのかな。年上なんだから、あなたのこと、リードしなきゃ。そうよね、私:
Maybe it's my fault. I am
older than you, so I should
take the lead... I just... I
just...
translations.そんなに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が気にしなくても……。:
You shouldn't worry too much,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.……帰る。帰って反省する……。:
...I'm going home. I'm going
to reflect on this.
translations.お花見に行ったのに、桜が全然咲いてない時って、どう思う？:
How would you feel if you went
to view cherry blossoms and
there weren't any of them
blooming？
translations.海水浴に行ったのに遊泳禁止だったり、栗拾いに行ったのにぜーんぶ拾われたあとだった:
Or if you went to the beach
and were forbidden from
swimming, or went skiing but
there was no snow. How would
you feel？
translations.答え。今の私の気分。次に期待……かな？ じゃあ、今日は帰るね。:
The answer is this is exactly
how I feel right now. I don't
know if I still have any hope.
I'm going home now.
translations.んー、こういう時って、どうすればいいのかな……やっぱりスパルタ式？:
Hmm, at a time like this, what
shall I do？ This is such a
difficult situation.
translations.ふふ。私、ちょっと甘やかしすぎたみたい。女の子って、もう少し雰囲気というか、ムー:
Hehe, I think I spoiled you
too much. For girls,
atmosphere and mood and stuff
like that are very important,
you know？
translations.ごめん、無神経だったかな。:
Sorry, I must be very
insensitive.
translations.うん。だから今日のデートはここまで。今度はお姉さんのこと、ちゃんと満足させてね。:
Yes, that's why I'm calling it
a day. Next time, you must
make this old woman feel
satisfied, okay？
translations.ねぇ……やっぱり私が年上だから、そういう気持ちになれない？:
Hey, is it because I'm older
than you that you still can't
get used to this？
translations.……ごめんね。今日のデート、ここまでにして……いいかな？:
...Sorry, let's call it a
day... I guess it's okay,
right？
translations.もしかして●、無神経だったかな。:
Could it be that I'm being
insensitive？
translations.ううん、いいの。……やっぱり私が年上だから、いけないんだよね。:
No, don't worry... Since I'm
older than you, things like
this can't be helped.
translations.ねぇ、今日のデート、これで終わりにしない？: Hey, can we call it a day？
translations.デートって感じがしないし……あなたもつまらないんじゃない？:
I'm not in the mood for a
date... Don't you feel bored
too？
translations.いいのよ。私の気がのらないことに変わりはないんだもの……じゃあね。:
It's okay. I'm really not in
the mood... Bye.
translations.えっ？ どうしたの、急に。:
Eh？ Why did you ask this all
of a sudden？
translations.私のリードが足りないのかなぁ、年下の男の子も満足させてあげられないか……。:
Maybe I'm not good enough to
make a younger guy feel
satisfied, huh...？
translations.いいの。ごめんね、冷めるようなこと言って。今日はもう帰るから、じゃあ。:
It's okay. Sorry to say
something like that. I'm going
home for today. Bye.
translations.あの噴水見ると、付き合う前のこと思い出さない？:
When you see this water
fountain, are you reminded of
the time before we started
dating？
translations.うん。バイトの行き帰りにここで会うこと、多かったもんね。:
Yeah. Before I went to work
for the part-time job, I often
ran into you here.
translations.本当は遠回りだったんでしょ？:
Actually, you went out of your
way to come here, didn't you？
translations.うん……でも、この場所好きだし。:
Yeah... But it was because I
really liked this place.
translations.それに、あなたにも会えるかなって。:
Plus, I was thinking that I
might be able to meet you
here.
translations.あの頃からそんなこと考えてたんだ？:
So, that was what you were
thinking since back then,
huh？
translations.もぅ……わかりきってること聞いちゃダメでしょ？ 恥ずかしいんだから……。:
Geez... Isn't it obvious？
Don't ask. It's embarrassing.
translations.あん、あげるもの何もないよ。ええと……あ、のど飴。:
Ah, I don't have anything to
feed you. Um... Ah, I have
this cough drop.
translations.のど飴、食べる？ おいでおいで。:
You wanna eat this cough
drop？ Come here, come here.
translations.……猫ってのど飴、食べるのかな？:
...I wonder if cats will eat
cough drops.
translations.ねえ。こうやって歩いてると、他の人からはどう見えるのかな？:
Hey, when we walk together
like this, what do people see
us as？
translations.ちゃんとカレシとカノジョに見えると思う？ それとも、お姉ちゃんと弟、みたいとか？:
Do they see us as a girlfriend
and a boyfriend, or an older
sister and her brother？
translations.だったら、それでいいんじゃないかな？:
So, just that fact is enough,
isn't it？
translations.……うん、そうだね。ごめんね、変なこと言って。:
...Yeah, you're right. Sorry
for saying something strange.
translations.そういえば神社って、階段、長いところ多いよね？:
Speaking of which, there are
many shrines that have long
stairs.
translations.うん。ここもそうだし……。天国に続く階段？:
Yeah, this shrine, too... Are
they like stairways to
heaven？
translations.あなたと並んで歩いてれば、どこだって天国よ。:
When you're walking by my
side, every place turns into
heaven for me.
translations.そういえばこの神社、どんな神様を祭ってるのかな？:
By the way, do you know what
this shrine was built for？ To
worship a specific God？
translations.んー、そういえば気にしたこと無いけど……もしかすると、縁結びの神様かな？:
Hmm, speaking of which, I
don't really know much, but I
think it enshrines the God of
Marriage.
translations.……もしかして、お参りしたの？:
...Don't tell me you've
already made your wish here.
translations.私、ここからの眺めって大好きなんだ。:
I really love the scenery when
I look from here.
translations.街が見下ろせるんだね。:
The overview of our city,
huh？
translations.昔から、ほとんど変わらないんだよ。ここからの眺めも。:
Our city hasn't changed much.
But it seems to have changed
when I look at the city from
here.
translations.へぇ……こうしてみると、静かでいい街だね。:
Hmm... It's such a nice,
peaceful city.
translations.でしょ？ あ、あれ見える？ あそこがね……。:
Isn't it？ Ah, look over
there. Over there...
translations.ああ、面白かった。正解だったね、これ。:
Ah, it was interesting. Just
perfect.
translations.うん。あんまり期待してなかったのにね。:
Yeah, I didn't expect that
it'd be this good.
translations.ふふ。あまり期待しちゃうとハズレの時、ショック、大きいものね。:
Hehe. If you expected too
much, you'd be shocked if it
turned out to be bad, right？
translations.うん。でも、今日はアタリだったかな。:
Yeah, but this one is going to
be a big hit, I think.
translations.うん。アタリかな。大アタリ。:
Yeah, a big hit. A real big
one.
translations.うーん、まあまあだったかな。あ、パンフレット買ってくるから待っててくれる？:
Hm, it was just so-so. Ah, I
have to buy a pamphlet. Can
you wait here？
translations.まあまあだったのに、買うの？:
It was so-so but you'll still
buy a pamphlet？
translations.観た映画はなるべく買うことにしてるの。すごくつまらなかった映画でもね。:
I buy pamphlets for any movie
I watch. Even for very boring
movies.
translations.つまらなくても買うんだ？:
You buy pamphlets for boring
movies too？
translations.すごくつまらない場合は、それだけでも面白いから。:
They are so boring that they
become interesting for me.
translations.つまらないのに、面白いか……。:
So boring that they become
interesting...？
translations.えっと……そんなに、気に入らなかった？: Um... You hated it that much？
translations.うん。俳優がダメ、映像もダメ、音楽もダメ、シナリオもダメ。もう、最悪。:
Yeah. Bad actors, bad
pictures, bad music, and bad
scenario. It was the worst.
translations.あ……ごめん。ちょっと好みじゃなかったから……良くないよね、こういう態度。:
Ah... Sorry. It wasn't to my
tastes, so I... This side of
me really isn't good, right？
translations.ふふ。どうせだから勝負しない？:
Hehe. How about we have a
match？
translations.いいけど……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ボウリング得意だっけ？:
No problem, but...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you good at bowling？
translations.優しいカレシなら、当然、ハンデのひとつやふたつ、付けてくれるよね？:
I know my gentle boyfriend
will at least give me some
handicaps.
translations.なるほど。じゃあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の点数は２倍ってことで。:
Indeed. Then I'll let
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
have twice the scores.
translations.ふふ。本気、出してね？ あなたのカッコイイところも見たいんだから。:
Hehe. Take it seriously,
okay？ I really want to see
how cool you can be.
translations.あっ、５－１０のスプリット……厳しいところ残したなぁ。:
Ah, it's a 5-10 split... This
is gonna be tough.
translations.ふふ。ここで決めたら、ご褒美あげる。:
Hehe. If you can get them
down, I'll give you a reward.
translations.うわ、すごい……本当に倒しちゃった。じゃ、約束通り……。:
Wow, amazing... You really got
them all. Now, as I
promised...
translations.ああん、またハズレた……どうして真っ直ぐ転がらないのかな？:
Ah, it went out again... What
can I do to bowl straight？
translations.むしろ普通に投げてここまで曲がるほうがすごいんじゃないかな？:
Isn't it rather amazing that
you could make a curve like
that？
translations.でもガーターはガーターだもん。ぶうぶう。:
But it went down the gutter.
It's a gutter ball. Boo boo.
translations.……ひょっとして、物凄い才能を物すごく無駄遣いしてない？:
...But it could be the hidden
talent that you've never found
out, right？
translations.久しぶりに堪能しちゃったって感じかな。:
It's been a while since I felt
this content.
translations.素でぶつかってくる感じ？ 目や耳だけじゃなくて、全身で感じるのがいいよね。:
Did it hit you？ It's much
better to feel it throughout
your body, instead of just
watching and listening.
translations.ふふ。あなたが誘ってくれるなら、ね。:
Hehe. If you ask me out,
okay？
translations.はぁ……ちょっと盛り上がりすぎて、少し疲れたかな？:
Hah... I was so pumped up that
I'm getting tired now.
translations.ふふ。私も久しぶりに興奮しちゃった。こう……ゾクゾクって感じ？:
Haha, I haven't had this kind
of thrill in quite a while.
Did it make you shudder？
translations.まあね……でも、私はあなたがいるだけでドキドキしちゃうから……。:
Sort of... But, my heart was
throbbing because you were
near me...
translations.あ……やだ。今のナシ！ ああ、もぅ……。:
Ah... No. Forget what I just
said！ Ah... Geez...
translations.うーん……ねぇ、もしかして、こういうの……好き？:
Um... Hey, did you... like
it？
translations.苦手っていうほどでもないけど……うーん、あんまり好きじゃないのは、確かかな？:
I didn't hate it, but... Well,
I just didn't really like it.
translations.あ、ううん。今日は楽しかったよ？ ただちょっと……ね？:
Ah, no. Today was fun. But,
maybe... You know...
translations.ねぇねぇ、今度はこれ歌わない？:
Hey, hey. Let's sing this song
next.
translations.これって昔の特撮ヒーローモノだけど……歌えるの？:
This is the song from an old
superhero series. ...You wanna
sing it？
translations.もちろん。あ……もしかして知らない？:
Of course. Ah... Don't tell me
you don't know this song.
translations.うん。せっかくのカラオケなんだから、盛り上がらなくっちゃ。:
Okay. Since we're already at
the karaoke, let's sing it out
loud.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のために入れたからね。はい、マイク。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I chose this for you.
Here's the microphone.
translations.ええっ!? だけどこれ、すっごい甘々のラブソングだよ!?:
Eh！？ But this is a very
cheesy love song！！？
translations.だから歌って欲しいんだ。ほら、始まるよ。:
That's why I want to hear you
sing it. Come on.
translations.はい。１曲入れたから、歌ってね。:
Okay, I entered a song for
you. You sing it, okay？
translations.そっか……わかった。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のために歌うよ。心をこめて。:
I see... Okay. For
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s sake,
I'll sing with all my heart.
translations.あ……なんか、私の方が照れ臭くなってきちゃった。:
Ah... Somehow, I'm the one who
feels embarrassed now.
translations.すごいな……けっこう遠くまで見通せるんだね。:
This is amazing... We can see
faraway places clearly from
here.
translations.神社の高台より、まだ高いよ。ほら。:
It's even higher than the high
ground of the shrine. Look.
translations.うん……。ありがとう、この街に来てくれて。:
Yeah... Thank you for coming
to live in this city.
translations.ねぇ、見て見て。一番高いところまでくると、このゴンドラだけ浮いている気がしない？:
Hey, look. When we are at the
top, don't you feel like our
car is the only one in the
air？
translations.言われてみれば……ちょっと不思議な感じだね。:
When you say so... This feels
quite amazing.
translations.私達のこと、他のゴンドラからも……見えないよね？:
People in the other cars won't
be able to see us here,
right？
translations.うん、ちょうど見えないんじゃないかな。:
Yeah, I don't think they can
see us.
translations.ふふ。変なことしたら、ダメだよ？:
Hehe. Don't do anything
perverted to me, okay？
translations.ふふ。あなたのそういうところ、カワイイ……。:
Hehe. This part of you is very
cute...
translations.へぇ……このお化け屋敷、よくできてるほうかな？:
Hey... I wish this haunted
house would be better than
this.
translations.ふふ。この程度で怖がってたら、ホラー好きだなんて言えないでしょ？:
Hehe, if I get scared by stuff
like this, I can't be a horror
movie fan, right？
translations.お、驚いただけよ？ うん。驚いただけ。:
I-I was just surprised. Yeah,
that was a surprise.
translations.全然怖がってないでしょ？:
You're not actually scared at
all, aren't you？
translations.ううん。ちょっと怖いのは本当だよ？ だからこうして、捕まるものが欲しいのです。:
No, I'm a little scared.
That's why I want you to hold
me like this.
translations.ふふ。こういうの、憧れてたんだ。:
Hehe, I've been longing for
this.
translations.だから、カレシができたら絶対するつもりだったの。もちろん、これからも……ね？:
If so, as my boyfriend, you
should do what I want, okay？
translations.手……、手、握ってくれない？:
My hand... Won't you take my
hand？
translations.このスタート前に上がって行く時って、緊張するよね。:
The first part when it's going
up like this makes me feel
nervous.
translations.うん。なんか、後悔しちゃったりしない？:
Yeah, do you regret choosing
this one？
translations.わあ……きれい……夢みたい……。:
Wow... Beautiful... This is
like a dream...
translations.本当に夢だったら、どうする？:
What if this were actually a
dream？ What would you do？
translations.全部。●といることも……。:
Everything. I would be just a
part of your dream...
translations.だったら……ずっと醒めないでいたいな……。:
In that case... I wouldn't
want to wake up, ever...
translations.小さいころ、これの真似したことがあるの。:
When I was a kid, I used to
try to imitate this.
translations.クリスマス・ツリーの電球を全身に巻いてね、ぴかぴか光ってきれいだった。:
I wrapped the Christmas tree's
light bulbs all around myself.
The sparkling light was so
pretty.
translations.危ないよ、それ。駄目だよ、そんなことしちゃ。:
That was dangerous. You
shouldn't have tried that.
translations.うん。すっごい怒られちゃった。真似しちゃダメだよ？:
Yeah. I was scolded badly. So,
don't ever try it, okay？
translations.私ね……あれに乗ってみたいなあって。小さいころ、夢だったの。:
When I was a kid, I dreamed
about riding on that car.
translations.へぇ……じゃあ●が免許を取ったら、ああいう車がいい？:
Hmm？ When I get a driver's
license, I'll buy that kind of
car, then.
translations.ぴかぴか、電球いっぱい付けて？:
Will you hang light bulbs
around it, too？
translations.え……？ ああ、そういうトラックあるね。:
Eh...？ Ah, I've seen a truck
with some light bulbs like
that.
translations.ふふ。車は、普通でいいかな？ 助手席に座るのが、私だけなら……ね？:
Hehe. I think just a normal
car would be fine. But you
must reserve the passenger's
seat for only me... okay？
translations.いや……水着の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も、すごくいいなぁって……。:
No... It's just that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks so nice in a swimsuit...
translations.ふふ。惚れ直した？:
Hehe. Are you falling head
over heels for me？
translations.直すどころか、ずっと惚れっぱなしかな？:
I'm already head over heels
for you.
translations.もぅ……それ、私の台詞だよ？:
Geez... That's my line, you
know？
translations.プールって、泳げなくても楽しめるからいいよね。:
It's nice that people who
can't swim can also have fun
in a swimming pool.
translations.泳ぎ、覚えようとか思わないの？:
Have you ever thought about
learning how to swim？
translations.そうよ。泳げなくたって生きていけるもの。だからいいのっ。:
Yeah, people live even if they
don't know how to swim. So I'm
good.
translations.そこまで断言しなくても……。:
You don't have to take it that
seriously...
translations.室内プールって日焼けの心配がないから、いいなあ。:
It's nice that we don't have
to worry about getting
sunburns at the indoor
swimming pool.
translations.そんなことないと思うよ。天窓からだって、けっこう光が射してるし。:
That's not true. It has a
skylight and we get some
amount of sunlight here.
translations.え、そう？ あん、水着の跡、残したくないんだけどなあ。:
Eh？ Really？ I don't want the
swimming suit's tanlines on my
body.
translations.ふふ。もしかして……見たい？:
Hehe. Don't tell me you wanna
see it.
translations.もぅ、本気にしちゃダメ。めっ。:
Hey, don't take it seriously.
Geez.
translations.うん。もう街中じゃ見られないけどね、こんなの。:
Yeah, we can't see something
like this if we stay in the
city.
translations.山の中なら、まだ見られるのかな……。:
I wonder if we can see them if
we're on the mountain...
translations.いつか見に行こうよ。空いっぱいの星。:
We'll go to see it someday. I
want to see the real starry
sky.
translations.ね……。手、つないでいい？:
Say... Is it okay to hold
hands？
translations.ふふ。これが本物の宇宙で、吸い込まれちゃいそうな気がして……ヘンだよね？:
Hehe... This really feels like
space and I feel like I'll get
sucked in. ...Weird, huh？
translations.本物の宇宙でも、絶対に離さないから。:
Even if we were really in
space, I wouldn't let go of
your hand.
translations.亜熱帯植物のコーナーだからね……でも、ちょっと暑いね。:
It's the subtropical plants
corner... Isn't it a bit too
hot？
translations.ふふ。ここは１年中、ずっと夏なんだよね？:
Hehe. So it's summer in here
all year round, huh？
translations.そうじゃないと枯れちゃうんじゃないかな？:
If not, maybe these plants
will wither, right？
translations.じゃあ、ここはずっと夏休みなのかな？:
It always feels like summer
break in here.
translations.ここに夏休みが閉じこめられてるんだ……ふふ、植物園って面白いところだね。:
It's like the summer break is
locked up in this place...
Hehe. This botanical garden is
interesting.
translations.空気がキモチイイね。やっぱり酸素が多いせいかな？:
The air here feels good.
Probably because there is more
oxygen in here.
translations.匂いも、外とすこし違うね。:
It smells different in here as
well.
translations.あ、ほんとだ……いい匂い……これ、どの花の匂いかな？:
Ah, that's true... Nice
smell... Which flower does
this smell come from？
translations.そうだね。じゃあ、ひとつずつ。:
Okay. Now then, let's check
them one by one.
translations.ふふ。私たち、チョウチョみたいね。花の香りに誘われるなんて。:
Hehe. We are like butterflies
being lured by flowers'
fragrances.
translations.人間も植物みたいに、光合成が出来ればいいのにね。:
It'd be nice if humans can do
photosynthesis like plants.
translations.それなら光と水と……あと、土があれば平気でしょ？ とっても平和になるんじゃないか:
In that case, we'll be okay
with just light, water, and
soil. Wouldn't that be
peaceful？
translations.でも、肌は緑色だよ？:
But then our skin would be
green.
translations.う……それはちょっと、やだな。うん。やっぱり人間は人間だよね。:
Urgh... I don't like that.
Hmm, humans are humans after
all.
translations.うん。満足満足。堪能した。:
Yeah, very satisfied. It was
really great.
translations.また来ようね。: I want to come here again.
translations.軽く見るつもりだったけど、結構真剣になっちゃったね。:
I was planning to relax here,
but I ended up being serious
with it.
translations.でもちょっと疲れちゃったかな。ねえ、おぶっていって。:
Now, I'm quite tired. Hey, can
you carry me on your back？
translations.もう！ 男の子のくせに情けないぞ。:
Hey！ You are a man. This is
shameful.
translations.うーん……人には、いろいろ好みがあるから、ね。:
Well... People really have
different tastes, right？
translations.もしかして、つまらなかったの？:
You thought it was boring,
then？
translations.ふふ、次はもっといいところへ連れてってね。:
Hehe. Next time, take me
somewhere fun, okay？
translations.知ってる？ この橋、恋人が手をつないで渡りきると幸せになれるんだって。:
Did you know？ If a couple
holds hands and walks across
this bridge, they will be
blessed with happiness.
translations.ふふ。でも、本当だとしたら、どうする？:
Hehe. But what if it were
real？
translations.もちろん、一緒に渡るよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と。:
Of course, I'd walk
across it together with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.じゃあ……私たちが最初の１組目？ ふふ。そういうのも、いいよね。:
Then... How about we become
the first couple to do this？
Hehe, it'll be nice, right？
translations.何度見ても……これ、すごいよね……。:
No matter how many times I
look, it's always amazing...
translations.うん。人間って、こんな大きなもの作っちゃうんだなぁって。:
Yeah. Something as big as this
can be built by humans.
translations.橋に見とれる▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に見とれてしまった。:
I'm fascinated by the look of
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
when you're fascinated
by the bridge.
translations.これだけ強いと飛ばされちゃうかな？:
If the wind is this strong,
maybe you can fly.
translations.もぅ。ちっちゃい子じゃないんだから飛ばされません。:
Hey, I'm not a little kid, so
I wouldn't fly.
translations.台風のたびに傘を広げて、“パラシュート！”なんてやってたのは小さい時だけなんだか:
I only used an umbrella as a
parachute during a hurricane
when I was a kid.
translations.陽射しが強いね……こういうのを突き刺さるような暑さって言うのかな？:
The sun is very strong... Is
this what people call the
burning heat？
translations.うん。１日で焼けちゃいそうだね。:
Yeah. You can get sunburnt if
you stay like this for the
whole day.
translations.私ね、焼けると鼻の頭から剥けちゃうんだよね、皮。:
When I get sunburnt, the skin
on the tip of my nose can be
peeled off.
translations.へえ。でも、ちょっとそれ、可愛いかも。見てみたい。:
Eh？ I think that's kind of
cute. I want to see it.
translations.やだ。男の子みたいで恥ずかしいよお。:
No. I'd look like a boy.
That's embarrassing.
translations.どうしたの？ 急に溜息なんかついて。:
What's wrong？ Why are you
sighing all of a sudden？
translations.だって、あなたとこうして海に来られて。それだけで私、幸せよ？:
But, to be able to come to the
sea with you like this, I'm
very happy, okay？
translations.サングラスでも持って来た方がよかったかな？:
Would it be good if I wore
sunglasses when I come here？
translations.陽射しが強いもんね。でも高校生がサングラスって、ちょっと不良っぽい。かな？:
The sun is very strong, huh？
But, for a high school
student, wearing sunglasses
would make you look like a
delinquent.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら似合いそうだよ、サングラス。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
would look good
with sunglasses.
translations.え、そう？ ワルっぽく見えちゃわない？:
Eh？ Really？ Wouldn't I look
like a bad girl？
translations.ううん。美人だから、プライベートのアイドルみたいになるんじゃないかな。:
No, you're pretty, so I think
you'd look more like a private
idol.
translations.あ……もう。おだてても何も出ないんだから。:
Ah... Geez. Even if you praise
me, I don't have anything for
you.
translations.でも、完全にふたりっきりなのって素敵じゃない？ しばらくこのままでいない？:
But isn't it wonderful to have
just the two of us here？
Let's stay like this for a
while, okay？
translations.もう、せっかくムード作ろうと思ったのに！:
Geez. I thought I could get
you in the mood！
translations.……でもほんとに寒いね、早めに帰ろっか。:
...But, it's very cold here.
We'd better go home.
translations.夏だと泳いだりできるけど……さすがに今は、なにもないね。:
In summer, people come here to
swim, but now... there's
nothing to do here.
translations.うん。人も少ないみたいだし……。:
Yeah. There aren't many people
coming here...
translations.ふふ。夏以外の海って、実は隠れたデートスポットなんだよ。:
Hehe. The off-season sea is
such a secluded date spot.
translations.だから……せっかくだし、お姉さんと砂浜でも歩いてみる？:
Well... Since you're already
here, how about you walk along
the beach with this big
sister？
translations.さすがに夏じゃないと、海は寒いね。:
When it's not summer, it's
very cold at the sea.
translations.そう？ それほどでもないけど。少し泳いでみない？:
Really？ I don't think it's
that cold. I even feel like
swimming.
translations.でも何の準備もしてないし……。:
But you didn't bring a
swimsuit...
translations.いいじゃない。生まれたままの姿で。ふたりしかいないし。:
Isn't it okay？ We didn't wear
anything when we were born.
It's just the two of us here.
translations.ふふ。冗談よ。……顔赤くしちゃって。可愛いんだから、もう。:
Hehe. I'm just kidding.
...Your face is red. That's so
cute. Geez.
translations.海にいるから……かな？:
Because it lives in the
ocean... doesn't it？
translations.んー、よく知らないけど……ほら、金魚も池で飼うと大きくなるでしょ？:
Hmm, I don't really know,
but... Let's see. Goldfish
that live in a pond usually
are big, right？
translations.だからきっと、マンボウも金魚鉢で飼えば小さくなる……かな？ うん、なるよ。きっと:
If we raised this sunfish in a
bowl, it would be very
small... I think. Hmm, I
believe so. Yeah.
translations.マンボウって、見てると眠くならない？:
Do you feel sleepy when you
watch the sunfish？
translations.ううん。でも、ゆったりしてるから、ずっと見てると眠くなりそうだなぁって。:
No, but it's quite relaxing to
watch these sunfish. If I keep
watching, I will surely fall
asleep.
translations.ああ。そういうの、ありそうだね。:
Ah, I kind of understand that
feeling.
translations.そっか……寝る時は羊を数えるんじゃなくて、マンボウを数えればいいんだ。:
Really...？ Instead of
counting sheep when you can't
sleep, counting sunfish might
be better.
translations.マンボウが１匹、マンボウが２匹……あれ？ マンボウって、匹でいいのかな？:
One sunfish... Two sunfish...
Eh？ How many sunfish have I
counted？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、カワイイもの好きだよね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you like cute animals？
translations.嫌いな女の子っていないんじゃないかな？:
Have you seen girls who hate
cute things？
translations.でも、あなたを好きな女の子は私だけ……なんていうのは、どう思う？:
But, for you, the only girl
you can like is me... What do
you say about it？
translations.●にはそれで充分だよ。:
For me, having you is more
than enough.
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、他の女の子たちの分、私がいーっぱい好きになってあげるね。:
Hehe. Then I'll love you much
more for the sake of other
girls too.
translations.こうやって見ると、ペンギンって意外と大っきいよね。:
When we look at the penguins
like this, they sure are huge.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のイメージだと、もっと小さかった？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did you imagine that
they would be smaller？
translations.うん。もっと、こう……手に乗るぐらい？:
Yeah, much smaller... Like, so
small that it could stand on
my palm.
translations.手乗りペンギン？:
A penguin that could stand on
your palm？
translations.あ、それもカワイイ。ふふ。手の上で羽根をピョコピョコってさせるの。:
Yeah, that would be cute.
Hehe. Would they go flapping
their wings while standing on
my palms？
translations.え？ あっ……もぅ、からかわないのっ。:
Eh？ Ah... Geez. Don't tease
me.
translations.まさに海中散歩って感じかな。:
It feels like we're really
walking under the sea.
translations.うん。海の中にいるみたい。:
Yeah, it's like we are under
the sea.
translations.ううん。私たちの知らないものが世界にあるだけ。きっと、まだまだたくさんあるんじゃ:
No, there are a lot of things
in this world that we haven't
seen yet, you know？
translations.そっか……うん、そうだね。:
Is that so...？ Yeah, that
might be true.
translations.ふふ。楽しみだね。これから二人で、知らない世界をいっぱい見てくなんて。:
Hehe, I'm really looking
forward to it. The day when we
both explore the world we've
never known.
translations.このトンネル、もっとずーっと長かったらいいのにねえ。:
This tunnel should be much
much longer than this, huh？
translations.うん。ここに住みたいくらい。:
Yeah, I even want to live in
here.
translations.将来はここに就職？:
How about finding a job here
in the future？
translations.働くのと住むのは別。あ……でも、専業主婦は同じなんだよね……うーん、同じなんだぁ:
Working and living are totally
different things. Ah... But
they're the same for a
housewife.
translations.ああん、イルカ可愛いなあ。乗りたくなっちゃうよ。:
Ah, the dolphins are cute. I
want to ride on them.
translations.乗らせてくれる水族館が、たしかあるよね？ ここは無理だけど。:
I think some other aquariums
might allow you to ride them,
but it's not allowed here.
translations.本当？ あん、いつか連れてってね。:
Really？ Hey, will you take me
to the other aquarium？
translations.乗るの？ でも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はカナヅ……:
You wanna ride on them？ But
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you can't swim...
translations.イルカって、イヌくらいの知能があるっていうけど、本当に賢いよね。:
Dolphins are as clever as
dogs, right？ They're pretty
smart.
translations.うん。でもイヌって言っても、どのイヌだろ。イヌの賢さも、いろいろ差があるでしょ？:
Yeah, but that depends. There
are many breeds of dogs, and
some are smarter than others,
right？
translations.なんとなくイルカに似てるかなあって。ふふ。あとで一緒に調べてみる？:
I think a dachshund would be a
nice match for a dolphin.
Hehe. Shall we try to
investigate this together？
translations.うわあ、いい眺め。あ、ベイブリッジが見えるよ。:
Wow, nice view. Ah, we can see
the Bay Bridge from here.
translations.へぇ、ちょうど船が来てて……絵になるな。:
Hmm？ A boat is coming at the
right moment. ...It looks a
like a scene in a painting.
translations.私ね、いつか大きな船で、何ヶ月もかけて一人旅するのが夢だったんだ。:
I used to dream of traveling
alone on a big boat and
spending a few months on it.
translations.うん、過去形。今の夢は……一人旅じゃないもん。:
Yeah, past tense. I don't
dream of traveling alone
anymore.
translations.うん。こんなとこまで潮風が届いてくるんだ。:
Yeah. We can feel the ocean
breeze even from here.
translations.私、海って好きだな。夜はちょっと怖いけど、でも、それもみんな好き。:
I like the ocean. Although
it's a bit scary at night, I
still love it.
translations.そうだね。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、海が似合うと思うよ。:
Right. I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
image matches
the ocean nicely.
translations.そう？ ふふ……あ、大きな船。いつか乗ってみたいな……。:
Really？ Hehe... Ah, I really
want to ride a big boat
someday...
translations.うん。キモチよすぎて、なんか眠くなってきちゃった。:
Yeah, it feels so good that
I'm getting sleepy.
translations.ん……ゆうべ、ちょっとね。:
Hmm... I didn't sleep much
last night.
translations.……あ。ひょっとして、遠足の前日とか眠れなくなるほうだった？:
...Ah, did it feel like the
day before a trip, and you
couldn't fall asleep？
translations.え、あ……そんなことないもん……。:
Eh？ Ah... That wasn't the
case...
translations.うわあ。いい眺めだねえ。:
Wow. Such a beautiful view
here.
translations.高さ５０メートル近いからね。展望台は、もうちょっと低いけど。:
This is nearly 50 meters high.
It's like an observatory, but
a little lower.
translations.うん。それでも充分だよ。高いよ。:
Um, I think it's high enough.
This is very high up.
translations.あ、向こう岸の公園の方まで見通せるんだ。こっち側にはスタジアム……だったかな？:
Ah, we can see the park on the
other side of the coast, too.
And that one over there is the
stadium, I guess.
translations.へえ。よく知ってるね。すごいすごい。:
Huh？ You know a lot. Amazing,
amazing.
translations.実は予習してきました。:
Actually, I studied the info
beforehand.
translations.あ、そうなんだ……ふふ、えらいえらい。:
Ah, I see... Hehe. Good job,
good job.
translations.ここでも売ってるのかな、温度計のお土産。:
Do they sell thermometers as
souvenirs here？
translations.タワーのミニチュアに温度計の付いた置物があるんだ。:
Like a miniature tower that
has a thermometer stuck on it.
translations.あ、知ってる。各地の色んなタワーに、似たようなのがあるんだよね？:
Ah, I've seen them. There are
different towers from all over
the world.
translations.ここにもあるのかな。:
I wonder if I can also find
them here.
translations.ふふ。地元だから気にしたことなかったけど……探してみよ。:
Hehe. It's our hometown's
tower, so I'm not quite
excited about it. ...But I'll
help you look.
translations.あは、着いた。実は私、エレベーター苦手なんだよね。特に下りが。:
Aha, we've finally arrived.
Actually, I'm not very
comfortable with an elevator,
particularly when it's going
down.
translations.うん。なんか地の底に吸い込まれそうな感じがして……。:
Well, it feels like I'm going
to be sucked down to the
bottom of the earth...
translations.着いたらそこには地底人がいて？:
If you were there, you could
meet with underworld people.
translations.あ……そっか。そう考えれば、逆に怖くないんだ。:
Ah... Right. If I think about
it that way, then I'm not
scared.
translations.あ、これいい。あん、こっちも可愛い。んんー目移りしちゃうなぁ。:
Ah, this is nice. Oh, that one
is also cute. Hmm, I really
can't choose.
translations.●のことは気にしないで、ゆっくり見ていいから。:
You don't have to worry about
me. Just take your time
choosing.
translations.うん、ありがと。きゃ、こんなのもあるんだ。いいなあ。:
Okay, thanks.
Kyaa！ They have this thing
too. This is nice.
translations.やっぱり女の子なんだなぁ。:
This is what girls are like,
huh？
translations.ううん。こっちの話。: No, I was talking to myself.
translations.ごめんね、どうしても気になって……あっ、こんなの隠れてた。こっちのと併せると可愛:
Sorry, I'm kind of worried
about you-- Ah！ This thing
was hidden here. It'll match
that one perfectly.
translations.●はいいよ。オシャレって柄でもないし。:
I'm okay. I don't really care
much about fashion.
translations.ダメだよ、そういうの。男の子だってそういうの気にする時代なんだから。:
No good. This is the era where
guys have to think about
fashion, too.
translations.あ、こういうの似合うんじゃない？ あ、これもいいな。ちょっと試着してみて。:
Ah, that one might suit you
well. Ah, this one is nice
too. Why don't you try them
on？
translations.だから、●としては……。: But, I said that I don't...
translations.ね、早くってば。あ、これもいいな。はい、着替えて。:
Hey, hurry up. Ah, this one is
also nice. Come on. Just try
them.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、メイクはしないと思ってた。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think you don't wear makeup.
translations.うん、基本しないよ。お風呂上がりとかに化粧水つけるぐらい、かな？:
Usually, I don't. I just apply
some facial moisturizer after
bath.
translations.うん、まあ、そう。いろいろね。:
Well, yeah. I apply some cream
there too.
translations.そっか。女の子も大変なんだなあ。:
I see. It's quite troublesome
to be a girl.
translations.ふふ。男の子が想像もしないような苦労してるんだから。:
Hehe. We have to go through so
many hardships that guys could
never imagine.
translations.私も社会に出たら、ちょっとはお化粧しなくちゃいけないんだろうなあ。:
When I go to a party, maybe I
need to apply some makeup.
translations.そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、化粧、ほとんどしないよね。:
Speaking of which,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you don't use cosmetics,
do you？
translations.ふふ。私がお化粧したところって、見てみたいと思う？:
Hehe. Do you want to see how I
look when I wear makeup？
translations.うん。もっといろんな▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、見てみたいし。:
Yeah. I want to see a lot
more different sides of
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そっか……うん、だったら、ちょっと考えてみるのも、いいかな？:
I see... Well, I might have to
think about it.
translations.アクセサリーかぁ……●もなにか買おうかな。:
Accessories, huh...？ Maybe I
should buy something, too.
translations.リングのほう。シルバーがいいかな。あんまり派手じゃないやつ。:
A silver ring might be better.
I don't want to be gaudy.
translations.銀製品って魔よけにもなるんだって。私もひとつ欲しいかな？:
Silver accessories can be used
as an amulet. Maybe I should
buy one too.
translations.じゃあペア・リングなんて興味ある？:
How about matching rings？ Do
you like them？
translations.あるある。うん、あります。: I do, I do. Yeah, I like them.
translations.えへ、思いっきり頷いちゃいますよ。:
Hehe, I really do agree if you
want to buy them.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、こういうの似合いそうだよね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think this will
suit you nicely.
translations.どれ？ あ、可愛い……あん、でもダメ。ピアスだから。:
Which one？ Ah, so cute... Um,
but it's useless. They are
pierces.
translations.あ、開けてないんだ。:
Ah, you don't have your ears
pierced.
translations.うん。ほら、ちょっと怖いでしょ、耳に穴を開けるなんて。:
Right. Isn't it scary to have
a hole in your ear？
translations.ホラーは平気なのに？:
But you're okay with horror
movies.
translations.それは別。でも可愛いなあ。んー、なやむぅ。:
That's different. But these
are very cute. Hmm, now I'm
regretting it.
translations.静かで、なんだか怖いくらいだね。:
It's so quiet that it's
somehow scary.
translations.うん。でも、ちゃんと命で満ちてるから……静かだけど、優しい静けさって感じかな？:
Yeah, but it's moving... It's
the kind of stillness where
it's actually moving gently.
translations.あ……そうだね。静かにしなきゃ。し～～っ。:
Ah... That's true. We must be
quiet. Shhh~
translations.あ、見た？ 今の見た？:
Ah, did you see it？ Did you
see that？
translations.さっきの売店でアユの串焼きとか売ってたし、きっとアユだよ。:
The store we just walked past
sold grilled salmon. It must
be a salmon.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、自転車は大丈夫？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
can you ride a bicycle？
translations.え？ 普通に乗れるけど……私、そんなに不器用に見える？:
Eh？ I can, but... Do I look
like someone who can't even
ride a bicycle？
translations.そうじゃなくて。ほら、あれ。レンタル自転車。:
That's not the case. Look.
There's a bicycle rental shop.
translations.あ……ふふ。２人用の自転車ってあるのかな？:
Ah... Hehe. I wonder if they
also have tandems.
translations.あるんじゃないかな。行ってみる？:
I doubt that. Let's take a
look.
translations.あは、キモチイイ。船旅みたい。:
Aha, this feels nice. It's
like I'm having a boat trip.
translations.海だともっと揺れるけどね。:
It would be swaying more than
this in the ocean.
translations.ああ。じゃあ今度さ、船でどこか行ってみる？:
Yeah. How about we take a trip
on a boat somewhere later？
translations.ふふ。そういうのは新婚旅行までとっておくつもりなの。だから……ね？:
Hehe. I was planning to do
that on my honeymoon. So, we
should wait... okay？
translations.あ、ほら。キャンプ場の人が手、振ってる……おおーい！:
Ah, look. Those people on the
camping ground are waving to
us... Hello！
translations.あ、鳥だ。きれい。なんて鳥だろうね。:
Ah, that bird is beautiful.
What's it called？
translations.うーん……●がわかる鳥って、ハトとスズメとダチョウと……あとニワトリくらいだから:
Hmm... I only know doves,
sparrows, and ostriches...
Also chicken if you count them
as birds.
translations.カメラ持って来れば、後で調べられたんだけど……携帯じゃ無理かな？:
If we had a camera, we could
take its picture and check
later... A cell phone camera
won't do, huh？
translations.ううん、いいよ。きれいだなあ、なんだろうなあって思ってるだけで、楽しいもの。:
No, it's fine. Since it was
pretty, I was just wondering
what it was called. I'm having
fun.
translations.よいっ、しょっと。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大丈夫？:
All right. Come on.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you okay？
translations.うん、平気。はあ、やっぱり、男の子、なんだね。:
Yeah, I'm fine. Hah, you
really are a man.
translations.ほら、手ぇ貸して。よいしょっ、と。:
Come on. Give me your hand.
All right.
translations.ううん。●の方こそ、もうちょっとゆっくり歩くよ。:
Don't worry. I'll also try to
walk slower.
translations.いい。頑張る。よぉし、行くぞお。:
Fine. I'll do my best. All
right, let's go.
translations.うん！ ありがとね、ここまで連れて来てくれて。:
Yes！ Thanks for taking me up
here.
translations.どういたしまして。じゃあ少し休憩しようか。:
You're welcome. Shall we rest
for a bit？
translations.うん、実は疲れちゃってたの。良かった、気づいてくれて。:
Yeah. Actually, I'm quite
exhausted. I'm glad you
noticed.
translations.長距離を歩く時って、あんまり膝を上げない方がいいらしいよ。:
When you have to walk for a
long distance, it's better if
you don't raise your knees too
high while walking.
translations.そうなの？ えっと、こんな感じ？:
Is that so？ Well, should I
walk like this？
translations.そうそう。地面と足の裏を並行に、宙を滑らせる感じで。:
Yeah. Like you have only a
small space between the ground
and the soles of your feet.
translations.あ、ほんと。ちょっと楽だよ。へえ。:
Ah, really. This is a little
more comfortable. Hehe.
translations.もうちょっと歩けそう？:
Can you still walk a little
longer？
translations.うん、大丈夫。でも……えへ、手はつないでて欲しい。かな。:
Yeah, that's okay. But...
Hehe... I kind of want us to
hold hands. How's that？
translations.きれいだねえ。山全体が夕焼けみたい。:
So beautiful. The whole
mountain now looks like a
sunset.
translations.こういう時にね、日本に生まれてよかったなあって思うよ、私。:
At a time like this, I feel
very lucky to be born as a
Japanese.
translations.春の桜と秋の紅葉か……。:
We have cherry blossoms in the
spring and maple leaves in the
fall, huh...？
translations.ふふ。今日は詩人だね。秋だから、かな？:
Hehe, you've become quite
poetic. Is it because of the
fall scenery？
translations.あれって、もみじかな？ きれいに赤くなってるね。:
Are those maple leaves？ They
are all red and so beautiful.
translations.ほんとだ。きれいに赤くなるんだな……。:
You're right. They are red and
beautiful...
translations.だからもみじの天ぷらって、おいしいのかな？:
I feel like they will taste
very good if we deep fry them.
translations.それは関係ないと思うけど。:
I don't think that has
anything to do with the colors
though.
translations.ふふ。こんな話してると、お腹すいてこない？:
Hehe, I'm getting hungry just
talking about this.
translations.いいお天気でよかったね。ちょっと雪が眩しいけど。:
It's great that the weather is
so nice. The snow is quite
dazzling.
translations.やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、スキーウェアも似合うな。:
As I thought.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks great in a ski suit.
translations.そう？ プライベートで遊びに来たアイドルみたい？:
Really？ Do I look like an
idol who comes here for a
private trip？
translations.もぅ……見え見えのお世辞ばっかり言ってると、雪に埋めちゃうよ？:
Hey, if you don't stop
flattering me like that, I'll
bury you under the snow.
translations.じゃあリフト乗ろうか。: Then shall we take the lift？
translations.あれ？ 高いとこ、怖かったっけ？:
Eh？ Are you afraid of high
places？
translations.ううん、平気なんだけど、乗り物系で高いのは、ちょっとだけ苦手なの。:
No, I'm fine with high places,
but I don't like to ride
vehicles on high places.
translations.そうだったんだ。ごめん、気づかなくて。:
I see. I'm sorry for not
noticing that.
translations.ううん。あなたと一緒なら、そんなに怖くないから。だから……手、握っても、いいよね:
Don't worry. I won't get
scared as long as you're with
me. So... Can we hold hands？
translations.うは、負けか……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、上手いなあ。:
Urgh... I lost...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you're very good at this.
translations.ふふ。小学校のころ、従兄弟のお兄ちゃんに教わったの。:
Hehe, my cousin taught me when
I was in grade school.
translations.ふぅん、従兄弟のお兄ちゃんか。:
Hmph. Your cousin？ He's a
guy, right？
translations.もう４０過ぎのオジサンだよ。結婚してるし……。もう一滑りする？ 次は一緒に、ね？:
He's now a 40-something uncle
and already married. ...Shall
we go for another round？
Let's ski along side each
other, okay？
translations.ううん、興味があるもなにも……これ、なんだろう？:
Nah, rather than interested...
I don't even know what it is.
translations.抽象美術は感じるものだから、今、あなたが感じてる通りでいいと思うよ？:
It's an abstract painting. So,
it can be anything you think
it is.
translations.そういうものなんだ。: So, that's how to view it.
translations.ふふ。あとでゆっくり聞かせてね。あなたがどう感じたのか。:
Hehe, take you time to look.
I'll ask you later what you
think about it.
translations.おー。この肖像画、どこから見ても、こっちを見てる……。:
Oh, look at that portrait. No
matter where you are, it still
looks like it's staring at
you...
translations.視線が付いてくる感じだね。:
It feels like those eyes are
following us.
translations.肖像画を見てる私たちが、肖像画に見られてるんだね。:
So, while we're looking at the
portrait, the portrait is also
looking at us.
translations.なんか、また絵が描きたくなってきちゃったな……。:
Somehow, I feel like painting
something...
translations.ううん、小さいころから好きなだけ。描けるわけじゃないよ？:
No, I used to like painting
when I was a kid, but I don't
paint anymore.
translations.ちょっと見てみたいな。: I want to see your paintings.
translations.だからぁ、今は描いてないのっ。もぅ……。:
I said I don't paint anymore.
Geez...
translations.あ、キリンの親子……カワイイなぁ。やっぱり子供って、カワイイよね。:
Ah, a baby giraffe and its
parents. They're so cute. A
baby is just cute, huh？
translations.うん、好き。遊んであげると、すごく楽しそうにするの。ほんとにカワイイよ？:
Yeah, I do. I really enjoy
playing with them. They're
just so cute, right？
translations.そっか……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら、いいお母さんになりそうだよね。:
I see... I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
could become a
very good mother.
translations.ふふ。その時のお父さんは、誰かな？:
Hehe, and who would be the
father of my baby then？
translations.キリンて首が長いだけじゃなくて、目もいいんだって。:
Giraffes not only have long
necks, they also have good
vision.
translations.じゃ、ずうっと遠くまで見えるんだ。:
So, they can see faraway
things, right？
translations.そうだね。自分自身が展望台みたいなものだし。:
That's right. And their bodies
are already like viewing
platforms.
translations.ちょっと想像できないな……。:
I can't imagine something like
that...
translations.ふふ。子供と大人の見る世界って、全然違うっていうでしょ？ キリンの世界って、どう:
Hehe, it's like how the world
in children's eyes are
different from adults' eyes. I
wonder what kind of world
giraffes see.
translations.きっと……私たちが一生知ることのないような世界なんだろうね。:
It's probably another thing in
this world that we both have
never experienced.
translations.でも、百獣の王なんだよね……。:
But, it's the king of beasts,
right...？
translations.王様だから、ごろごろ寝ててもいいんじゃないかな？:
It's good for the king to
sleep well too, right？
translations.仕方ないか。裸の王様だし。:
It has no choice, huh？ It's
just simply the king.
translations.ふふ。今、ちょっと巧いこと言ったと思ってるでしょ？:
Hehe. You've said something
clever just now.
translations.考えてみたらライオンって、でっかいネコなんだよね。:
To think about it, the lion is
just a giant cat.
translations.一応、猫科の動物だからね。:
It actually is in the same
animal family as cats.
translations.どのくらい小さくなったらカワイイのかな？ やっぱりネコくらい？:
How small in size does it have
to be for it to be as cute as
a cat？ About the size of a
cat？
translations.んー、逆にネコがどのくらい大きくなったら、そう思わなくなるのかな？:
Hmm, on the contrary, how big
does a cat have to be for it
to look like a lion？
translations.うちの田舎のネコ、６０センチくらいだけどカワイイよ？:
The size of cats around my
hometown is about 60 cm. Do
you think this size is cute？
translations.６０センチ!? それはカワイイとかいうレベル、越えてるような……。:
60 cm！？ That's probably too
big to be counted as cute...
translations.へえ。小動物がいっぱい放し飼いになってるんだ。:
Hmm？ There are a lot of small
animals running around.
translations.だって、ウサギさんもいるし……\nあ、あのポニーもカワイ～っ。:
There are those rabbits...
...Ah, and that pony is so
cute~
translations.そういえばカワイイもの、好きだったっけ。:
So, you love cute animals,
huh？
translations.うん、大好き。\n大好きすぎて、もうどうにか\nなりそう……はぁ……。:
Yeah, I love them. I love them
too much that I even want to
be one of them... Hah...
translations.わっ！ わっ！ どうしよっ、いっぱい集まってきちゃった！:
Wow！ Wow！ What should I do？
They are gathering around me！
translations.へぇ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、動物に好かれるタイプなのかな？:
Huh？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you are the type that
animals really like.
translations.あん、どうしよう。のど飴くらいしか持ってないよう。:
Ah, what should I do？ I only
have some cough drops with me
now.
translations.駄目だよ。食べ物あげるの禁止だし。:
Feeding food to them is
prohibited here.
translations.禁止されてなくても、のど飴は食べないと思うけど……。:
Even if it weren't prohibited,
I don't think you should feed
them cough drops either...
translations.ふふ、カノジョの水着、選びたいんだ。:
Hehe, you wanna pick out
your girlfriend's swimsuit？
translations.ビキニ以外考えられない: It has to be a bikini.
translations.通はワンピースなんだよ！:
A true connoisseur
chooses a one-piece！
translations.はいはい、男の子だもんね？:
Right, right. You're a
boy, after all, huh？
translations.ワンピースか……。ふーん、そっちの方がいいんだ。:
A one-piece... Hmm, so
you prefer that kind.
translations.一つ前のにしよう:
Let's go with
the last one.
translations.今着てるのがいい:
The one you have on
is good.
translations.そうそう。今日のテレビの占いでね。:
Well, there was a fortune
telling program on TV today.
translations.動物が走るやつ？:
You mean the one with the
running animals？
translations.そう、それそれ。それでタヌキさんが一番だったの。:
Yeah, that one. And the
raccoon dog was the winner.
translations.正解！ ふふ。今日はきっといいことあるよね。:
Correct！ Hehe. There must be
something good happening
today.
translations.そういえば今日、テレビの占いでね、もうちょっとって感じだったんだ。:
On the fortune telling program
today, I feel like it was so
close.
translations.テレビの占いって……ああ、あの動物が走るやつ？:
The fortune telling
program...？ Ah, the one with
the running animals？
translations.そう。途中までタヌキさんが一番だったのに逆転されて２位。結局、“中吉”:
Yeah. The raccoon dog was the
leader until midway. In the
end, it came out second. So,
it's "Moderate luck" for me.
translations.中吉ならよかったほうじゃないかな？:
Moderate luck is still nice,
isn't it？
translations.うーん。でもそれって普通だから……うーん。:
Hmm. But it's just too
general... Hmm.
translations.あれ？ 元気ないみたいだけど、何かあったの？:
Eh？ You don't look well. Did
something happen？
translations.うん……今日のテレビの占いでね。:
Yeah... For today's fortune
telling program...
translations.ああ、あの動物が走るやつ？:
Ah, the one with the running
animals？
translations.そう……あれでタヌキさんが逆転負けしちゃったの……。:
Yeah... The raccoon dog lost
today...
translations.つまり占いの結果がよくなかったのか……。:
Which means your fortune isn't
good today...？
translations.はぁ、今日はおとなしくしていたほうがいいのかな……？:
Hah, I should behave myself
today, right...？
translations.あ……どうしたの、こんなところで。:
Ah... What's up？ Why are you
here？
translations.私？ 私は気分転換にちょっと……。:
Me？ I'm here just for a
change of mood...
translations.●もそんな感じなんだけど……。:
I'm here for the same
reason...
translations.ふふ。まぁ……あなたにも会えたことだし、今日は良かったかな。:
Hehe. Well... Now that I met
you, I feel like today is a
nice day.
translations.ううん、なんでもない。じゃあ、私もう行くね。また、ね。:
No, never mind. Well, I have
to go. See you later, okay？
translations.ふふ。また気分転換？:
Hehe. Are you here for a
change of mood again？
translations.もしかして、ここに来れば、私に会えるかもって思ってる……とか？:
Did you come here because you
expected to see me... hmm？
translations.ううん、なんでもない。じゃあ、また……ね。:
No, never mind. Well, see you
later, okay？
translations.この後どこか行ければいいんだけど……。:
I wish I could hang out with
you a little longer, but...
translations.うん、帰らないと。ごめんね、じゃ……。:
Yeah, I have to go home now.
Sorry. Bye...
translations.あ……ふふ、こういうこともあるんだ。:
Ah... Hehe. You also come to
this place.
translations.映画、１人で観てたんだ。:
Did you come to watch a movie
alone？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も、これから１人で？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
too？ Did you watch
a movie alone？
translations.●……、ヘンなこと言ったかな？:
Did I... ask a weird
question？
translations.ううん、違うの。ただ……誘えば良かったのかなって。:
No, you didn't. It's just... I
was thinking that I should've
invited you here.
translations.ふふ、いいの。一緒には、また今度ね？:
Hehe. It's okay. We can come
here together next time, all
right？
translations.また会っちゃったね、１人？:
We meet again. Are you here by
yourself？
translations.うん、私はもう観終わっちゃって、帰るところ……。:
Yeah, but I just got out of
the theater and I'm about to
go home...
translations.そっか、タイミング合わないね。:
I see. Too bad. We couldn't
watch it together.
translations.ううん。次は、一緒に来ようね？:
Don't worry. We can come here
together next time, right？
translations.あ、また行き違い……？:
Ah, we run into each other
again...？
translations.ふふ、タイミング合ってるのか、合ってないのか、よくわからないね？:
Hehe. I'm not sure if we
should call this good or bad
timing.
translations.いいよ、気にしなくても。いつでも一緒に来れるんだから。:
It's okay. Don't worry. We can
come here together later
whenever we want.
translations.……ふふ、こんなところにカワイイ男の子、発見っ。:
...Hehe. I found this cute boy
right here.
translations.ふふ、そっか……良かった。体鍛えるのもいいけど、私のこともかまってね？:
Hehe. I see... That's good.
It's good that you're training
your body, but don't forget
about me, okay？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、私は行かなきゃ……。: Hehe. Now, I've got to go...
translations.私のことはどうでもいいの。それより、もしかして、ムキムキになろうとか思ってる？:
You don't have to concern
about me. Are you possibly
trying to get brawny？
translations.却下！ それだけはダメなんだからね！ 絶対だよ！:
I object！ I don't want you to
be brawny！ So, don't！
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。またここに……もしかしてダイエットとか？:
Ah,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You're here again...
Are you possibly trying
to lose weight？
translations.健康ブームだし、体鍛えるのはいいよ？ でも……。:
It's okay that you enjoy body
training, but...
translations.女の子にダイエットのことは聞かない！ これ、忠告だよ!?:
Don't ever talk to your
girlfriend about her weight！
This is the warning！
translations.もしかして、誰か私以外へのプレゼントを買いに来た、とか？:
Perhaps, you're buying
presents for some other
girls？
translations.もぅ……そんなに慌てなくたって……。:
Geez... You don't have to
fluster like that...
translations.いいの、信じてるもん……ごめんね、変なこと言って……。:
Fine, I trust you... Sorry
that I said something weird...
translations.あ、もう行かなきゃ……じゃあね？:
Ah, I have to go... See you
later, okay？
translations.私、もう行かなくちゃいけないけど……ふふ、こういうのも新鮮だね？:
I have to get going... Hehe.
It feels nice that we met like
this, right？
translations.あ……よく会うね、買い物？:
Ah... We often meet here. Are
you shopping？
translations.暇なんだ？: Got so much free time, huh？
translations.そうでもないよ、●もいろいろと、さ。:
No, I also have a lot of
things to take care of.
translations.そっか、時間があればどこかで話したいけど、もう行かなきゃ。じゃあね？:
I see. I want to hang out with
you a little more, but I have
to go now. Bye.
translations.もしかして……エントランスホールに好きなアイドルのポスターでも貼ってあった？:
Could it be that... there are
some posters of the idols you
like at the entrance？
translations.いいのいいの、私、そういうことに理解あるカノジョだから。:
It's fine. I'm a very
understanding girlfriend.
translations.そうよね。あなたもそういう年齢なんだし、目が移っちゃうのも仕方がないよね。:
I know. You're at the age that
would be interested in
something like that.
translations.いいのいいの、わかってるから。私への気持ちが一番なら、他の女の子見るくらい許して:
It's fine. I understand. If
I'm still your "number one," I
wouldn't mind if you also look
at some other girls.
translations.（だめだ、聞いてくれない……）:
(No good. She's not listening
to me...)
translations.言っとくけど、別に変なイベントじゃ……。:
Let me tell you first. I'm not
attending any weird event...
translations.んー？ 言い訳するのがあやしいなぁ。:
Huh？ It sounds even more
suspicious when you say that.
translations.ふふ。今日のところは信じてあげる。私もイヤな女になりたくないし。じゃあ、行かなき:
Hehe. I'll trust you this
time. I don't want to be an
evil woman. Well, I have to
go...
translations.ふふ、そんなに好きなら、今度デートのときに誘って？:
Hehe. If you like it this
much, how about we come here
together for a date next
time？
translations.考えておいて？ あ、私は用事の途中だから……じゃあね？:
Think about it, okay？ Ah, I
have to run an errand. ...See
you later.
translations.こーら！ ゲームセンターなんかで、なに遊んでるの!?:
Hey！ What are you doing at
the game center！
translations.学生の本分は勉強よ？ 遊んでるヒマなんてあるの!?:
A student's duty is to study,
right？ Do you have so much
time to play around！？
translations.なーんてね、ふふ。ちょっとお姉さんぶっちゃった。:
Just kidding. Hehe. I just
wanted to act like a big
sister.
translations.一度、言ってみたかったのよね、“遊んでないで勉強しなさい！”なーんてね。:
I've wanted to say this for a
long time. “Don't play. Go to
study！” Something like that.
translations.今日のところは多めに見てあげるから、遅くならないうちに帰るんだぞ？ いい？:
I'll let you off this time,
but you should go home before
it gets dark, okay？
translations.ふふ。やっぱり男の子は、こういうところ好きなのかな？:
Hehe. Guys really like to come
to this place, huh？
translations.ふふ。私はもう行くけど、カノジョのことも、ちゃんと相手してあげてね？:
Hehe, I have to go now. Don't
play until you forget your
girlfriend, okay？
translations.そこの少年、お姉さんと遊んでみない？:
Hey, that boy. Do you want to
play with this big sister？
translations.でも残念。お姉さんは忙しくて今日は遊べないのでした。じゃあね！:
Too bad. This big sister is
too busy today, so she can't
play with you. Bye now！
translations.お客様、何をお探しですか？:
Mister, what are you looking
for？
translations.ふふ。一度言ってみたかったんだ、コレ。ファミレスじゃ無理だもんね。:
Hehe. I've wanted to say it.
That line isn't what we use to
greet customers at a family
restaurant, right？
translations.こう……なんというか……冷やかし？:
I'm... just checking the
prices, okay？
translations.ふふ、あんまりお店に迷惑かけちゃダメだぞ？:
Hehe. Don't cause any trouble,
okay？
translations.うん、よろしい。私はまだ用事があるから、先に行くね？ じゃあ。:
Yeah, very well. I have an
errand to run, so I'm leaving.
Bye.
translations.お客様、探し物は見つかりましたか？:
Mister, have you found what
you were looking for？
translations.ふふ、また会ったね。どう？ 私のファミレス以外の接客。:
Hehe. We meet again. How's
that？ Is my service outside
the family restaurant okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったら、どこの店でも働けるよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
with your manners, you
can work at any place.
translations.ふふ、そんな風におだてても、商品の値引きはしないからね？:
Hehe. Even if you're trying to
flatter me, I can't cut the
price for you, okay？
translations.（店員の真似はまだ続いてたのか……）:
(So, she still enjoys playing
as a shopkeeper, huh...？)
translations.そういえば、結局なにを探してるのか聞いてなかったっけ……。:
By the way, you still haven't
told me what you were looking
for...
translations.よくここで会うね。そんなにこのお店、好き？:
We met here a lot. Do you like
this store that much？
translations.意外に、目的もなくブラブラするのに向いてるんだよね、ここ。:
I didn't plan to come here. I
was just walking aimlessly and
somehow I ended up here.
translations.ふふ、そっか。私は残念ながら目的があるから、もう行かなきゃ……じゃあね？:
Hehe. I see. Too bad I already
have my plans. I have to go
now. See you later, okay？
translations.あ、奇遇ね。なにか探しもの？:
Ah, I didn't expect to see you
here. Are you looking for
something？
translations.そんなの当り前じゃない、ＣＤ屋さんだもの。:
I know that. This store only
sells CDs.
translations.なに？ なにか不服なの？:
What？ Do you have a problem
with me？
translations.よし、許してつかわす。ふふ。:
All right. I'll forgive you.
Hehe.
translations.ふふ、でも今のあなた、カワイかったよ？:
Hehe. It's because you're so
cute, you know？
translations.ふふ、今度、私のお気に入りＣＤ、教えてあげようか。:
Hehe. This time, shall I show
you my favorite CDs？
translations.それで……私のことを考えながら聞いてくれると、嬉しいかな。:
And then... If you think of me
while you're listening to
them, I'll be happy.
translations.何？ ひょっとして音楽少年だっけ？:
What？ It's the Music Boy
again？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……別にそういうわけじゃ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
I'm not a Music Boy.
translations.多趣味な男の人って、ちょっと素敵かな？:
I think guys who are
interested in various things
are wonderful, you know？
translations.そうそう、ふふ、頑張ってね？:
Yes, yes. Hehe, do your best,
okay？
translations.（といっても、何を頑張ればいいんだろう）:
(And what am I supposed to do
my best for？)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。どうしたの？ こんなとこで。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What's up？ Why are you here？
translations.うん、私の好きな映画のグッズが置いてあるらしいんだけど、よくわからなくって。:
Well, the promotional items
for my favorite movie are out
today, but I can't find them.
translations.たまには見せてくれるのかな？ 頼りになるところ。:
Every once in a while, you try
to show me how reliable you
are, huh？
translations.ふふ、冗談。お願いします▼:
Hehe. Just kidding. Please
help me▼
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、偶然だね。また映画関係？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
what a coincidence.
Are you looking for some
movie related items again？
translations.うん、そんなところ……また付き合ってくれる？:
Yeah, that's right... Can you
accompany me for a while？
translations.ありがと。……ねぇ、よく来るの？ ここ。:
Thanks. ...Hey, you come here
a lot, huh？
translations.やっぱり、よく来てるよね……。:
Really. You come here a lot,
huh...？
translations.私の用事には付き合ってくれたけど、あなたの用事はなんなの？:
I'm here for some errands, but
what about you？ What are you
doing here？
translations.今日は偶然、たまたま、さ……。:
Today is totally a
coincidence. I only come here
occasionally...
translations.うん、そう。でももう行かなきゃ。:
Yeah. Ah, I have to get going
now.
translations.ここ、メイド喫茶だよね？:
This place is a maid cafe,
right？
translations.もしかしてファミレスよりも、こういうとこの方が好き？:
Perhaps, you like this place
more than a family restaurant,
huh？
translations.ううん。遠くからあなたが見えたから、追いかけてきちゃったの。:
No. I saw you from afar, so I
followed you.
translations.ふふ、冗談。びっくりした？:
Hehe. Just kidding. Did I
surprise you？
translations.あはは、びっくりしてる。カワイイ▼:
Ahaha. Did I scare you？ So
cute▼
translations.もう、勘弁してよ。: Hey, don't make fun of me.
translations.成績下がったら、デートしてあげない、かもよ？:
If your grades drop, I might
not go on a date with you.
translations.うん、努力する男の子って素敵だね。:
Yes, a man who tries his best
is wonderful.
translations.バイトがあるからって居眠りしたら……ダメだよ？:
You'll have to work today.
Don't fall asleep, okay？
translations.ふふ。小さなことからコツコツと、ね？:
Hehe. Just do small things
little by little, okay？
translations.数学や物理のできる男の子って、カッコイイと思うな……ふふ。:
I think a guy who is good at
math, and physics, and that
kind of stuff is cool... Hehe.
translations.はい、のど飴。疲れたらこっそり、ね？:
Here's a cough drop. You can
eat it when you get tired,
okay？
translations.それくらい、簡単にわかるよね？:
This is just the basic,
right？
translations.私の参考書、使ってみる？:
Do you want to use my
reference book then？
translations.あ、もうそんなところまで進んでるんだ……。:
Ah, you learned up to this
part already...
translations.去年の私のノート、見る？:
Do you want to read my notes
from last year？
translations.がんばりすぎると体に毒だから……ね？:
You'll ruin your health if you
overdo it, okay？
translations.去年のテストに出た問題教えてほしかったら……もっと頑張りなさい？:
I can tell you what were on
the exams last year, but you
must study harder than this.
translations.頭が疲れた時には甘いもの。はい、のど飴。:
Sweets are good for tired
brain. Here you are. A cough
drop.
translations.少年老い易く学成り難し……だったかな？:
There's a saying: Youthful
years pass quickly before one
accomplishes much learning...
translations.わからないところ、ある？:
Is there anything you don't
understand？
translations.怪我だけは気をつけて、ね？:
Be careful and don't hurt
yourself, okay？
translations.女の子ばかり見てたら……わかってるよね？:
If you lay your eyes on any
girl, I'll know, okay？
translations.応援してるからね？ ふふ。:
I'll be cheering for you.
Hehe.
translations.ふふ。青春してるね。:
Hehe. This is what we call
youth.
translations.お客様の目が届かないところでも笑顔を忘れずに、ね。:
Even when the customers aren't
watching, you have to keep
smiling, okay？
