translations.あ、もう。襟元、ちゃんとして？:
Ah, hey. Shall I fix your
collar for you？
translations.ふふ。最後まで気を抜かないように、ね。:
Hehe. Keep it up until the
end, okay？
translations.対応は丁寧にね？:
Be polite to the customers,
okay？
translations.あ、それは私がやっておくよ。: Ah, I can take care of that.
translations.ふふ。意外と様になってるね。:
Hehe. You look so good in this
job.
translations.こっちは私がやるから、向こうのほう、お願いできる？:
I'll take care of this side.
Can you clean up the other
side, then？
translations.ふふ、キレイになると気分がいいね。:
Hehe. It feels good when
everything looks pretty,
right？
translations.ふふ。これなら店長も褒めてくれるかも。:
Hehe. I think the manager will
praise you for this.
translations.ふぅ。これで終わり、かな？:
Phew. I guess our jobs are
done.
translations.心を込めて……ね？:
Put your heart into your job,
okay？
translations.あ、油には気をつけてね。:
Ah, be careful of the oil
there.
translations.ちゃんと手順通りに、ね？:
You must follow the
instructions, okay？
translations.忙しくても、丁寧にね？:
Even during the busy hour, you
still have to watch your
manner, okay？
translations.お疲れ様、頑張ったね。カレシができる人だと、私も嬉しいよ？:
You really did a great job.
I'm so happy to have such a
great boyfriend.
translations.ふふ、さすが。私のカレシさんだもんね？:
Hehe. Nice. As I could expect
from my boyfriend, right？
translations.頑張ったね、ご褒美は何がいい？ 頭をなでなでかな？ ふふふ。:
You did a great job. What do
you want as a reward？ Shall I
pat your head？ Hehehe.
translations.うん、よく頑張りました。えらいえらいっ。:
Yeah, you did a great job.
Very nice, very nice.
translations.そうそう、期待通り。:
Yes, yes. As I could expect
from you.
translations.そっか……残念だな……。次はもっと頑張らないと、ね？:
Well... What a pity... Try
again next time, okay？
translations.んー、努力が足りないかな？ もっと精進すること！:
Hmm... Still lacking effort,
huh？ You must devote
yourself！
translations.もぅ……慰められたいって顔してる。それは、もっと頑張ったあとだよ？:
Hey... You're making a face
like you want to be comforted.
Just try harder next time,
okay？
translations.もっとがんばりましょう、……ね？:
Just try harder next time...
okay？
translations.もっとできる子だと思ったんだけどな……。:
I thought you could do better
than this...
translations.惜しかったね。次はできるでしょ？:
That's regrettable. Maybe you
can do better next time.
translations.へぇ、運動得意なんだ。:
Hmm？ So, you're very good at
sports, huh？
translations.すごい、鍛えてるんだ。そういうの、憧れちゃう。:
Wonderful. You've been working
out, huh？ I admire that.
translations.たくましい男の人って、素敵……。: A strong man is so dreamy...
translations.大変よろしい。やっぱり男の子はスポーツもできないとね？:
Very well done. Men are
usually good at sports, huh？
translations.合格。運動が得意な男の子って、素敵よ？:
A success. Sporty guys are
dreamy, you know？
translations.勉強がんばってるんだ。その調子だよ。:
You really study hard. That's
good.
translations.すごい、成績優秀なんだね。憧れちゃうな。:
Wonderful. You got such
excellent grades. I admire
that.
translations.勉強できるんだ。もう、ナマイキ！:
You're good at studying. Geez.
That's unfair.
translations.成績いいんだね、私が教わった方がよかったりして？ ふふ。:
Your grades are great. Is it
because I taught you？ Hehe.
translations.へぇ、センスがいいんだね。:
Hmm？ You have very nice
sense.
translations.うん、よしよし。センスいいぞ。:
Yeah, great, great. You have
nice sense.
translations.あなたって、感性が豊かなんだね。素敵だと思うな。:
Your taste is very nice. I
think that's wonderful.
translations.いいセンスしてるんじゃない？ ふふ。:
You have very nice sense,
huh？ Hehe.
translations.やっぱりいいセンスしてる。私の目に狂いはなかったな。:
You have very nice sense. I
can tell by just looking.
translations.最近、素敵だって評判だね？:
Lately, people say that you
are cool, you know？
translations.またカッコよくなったんじゃない？ ３年の女子の間でも噂だよ。:
Aren't you cool？ Even the
girls in my grade are talking
about you.
translations.もう、そんなにカッコよくなっちゃって……どうしよう。:
Hey, if you're so cool like
this, what should I do...？
translations.ねぇ、自分でもカッコいいって思っちゃう？ カワイイ▼:
Hey, do you also think that
you're so cool？ That's cute▼
translations.カワイイからって、モテモテになるのはダメ！ いい？ ふふ。:
You're cute. But don't become
too popular, okay？ Hehe.
translations.そういえば、昔、うちの学校に茶室があったって知ってる？:
By the way, did you know that
our school used to have a tea
house？
translations.うん。女の子の中から希望者を集めて、お茶やお花を教えてたんだって。:
Yeah, and girls could go there
to learn tea ceremony and
flower arranging.
translations.ふうん。でも希望者なんていたのかなあ。何かそういうのって古いっていうか……。:
Hmm, but I wonder if any girls
still want to learn them now.
They are quite old
traditions...
translations.甘い。キミはまだまだ女の子のことを知らないな？:
Oh, you don't know anything
about girls.
translations.女の子はね、心のどこかで女の子らしくありたいって、思ってるの。:
Deep in girls' hearts, they
yearn to be more girlish.
translations.古いとか新しいじゃないんだよ。:
It doesn't matter if it's an
old or a new tradition.
translations.そう。お茶やお花っていうのは長い伝統がある、ひとつの美しさだから。:
Yes. Tea ceremony and flower
arranging have long history
and they both are beautiful
traditions.
translations.やっぱり女の子はね、美に対しては敏感なの。:
Girls are sensitive to beauty,
you know？
translations.つまり……綺麗になりたいっていうのと同じだってこと？:
In other words... It's the
same feeling as when they want
to be pretty？
translations.まあ、そんなところかな。ふふ、少しは女の子のことわかった？:
Well, it might be so. Hehe, do
you understand girls more
now？
translations.あなたももっといろいろ勉強しないと、ね。:
You really have to learn a lot
more, okay？
translations.この前、茶室のこと話したの、覚えてる？:
Do you remember that we talked
about the tea house earlier？
translations.ああ、希望者を集めて教えてくれていたって話でしょ。:
Yeah, girls who wanted to
learn traditional ceremonies
would go there, right？
translations.うん。その時指導してくれてたのって、古文の先生だったんだって。:
Yeah, and the one who taught
them was the classical
literature teacher.
translations.へえ。その先生、今はどうしているんだろ？:
Huh？ It's that teacher？
Where is she now？
translations.だいぶ前に定年退職したみたい。それで誰も使わなくなったから改装されちゃったのね。:
I think she has retired
already. And the room hasn't
been used, so it was
remodeled.
translations.ふうん。ちょっともったいなかったかな？:
Hmm. That seems like such a
waste.
translations.うん。もしまだその先生がいたらさ、お茶を点てる▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を見られたのかなって。:
Yeah. If that teacher were
still here, I might have a
chance to watch
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
in the tea ceremony.
translations.でも、確かに習う機会があるならやってみたいよね……。:
But, if I have a chance, I
might try to learn it...
translations.うん、そう思うと、ちょっと残念だったかな。:
Yeah, when I think about it,
this is quite regrettable.
translations.お茶を教えてくれていた古文の先生のこと、覚えてる？:
Do you remember we talked
about the classical literature
teacher last time？
translations.うん、だいぶ前に定年退職したんだよね。:
Yeah, you said she retired
already, right？
translations.それがね、先生を辞めた後、教室を開いて今でもお弟子さんを取ってるんだって。:
Yeah. Even after she retired,
students have continued using
the tea house.
translations.そんなに偉い先生だったの？:
So, they have a new teacher
then？
translations.みたいね。実は先生のほうは講師として来ていただけで、本職はそっちだったらしいの。:
It seems so. Actually, the
previous teacher was only a
lecturer, but this new one
seems to be a professional.
translations.へえ……それじゃ、教え方も相当本格的だったんだろうね。:
Eh...？ In that case, you can
learn how to do it the
professional way, huh？
translations.ねえ……この間、お茶を点てるのを見たいって、言ったよね？:
Hey... You said earlier that
you wanted to see me in a tea
ceremony, right？
translations.言ったけど、まさか……。: I did, but... Don't tell me...
translations.うん。習いに行ってみようかなって考えてるんだけど……どう思う？:
Yeah, I've been thinking
whether I should take the
class. What do you think？
translations.それは是非……って言いたいところだけど、なんか厳しそうじゃない？ 大丈夫？:
I wanted to say that you
should, but... Are you gonna
be okay？ This class must be
very strict.
translations.不安がないといえば嘘になるけど……。:
It'd be a lie if I say that I
don't feel uneasy about it,
but...
translations.でも、大和撫子って言葉には惹かれちゃうのよね……。:
But, you seem to yearn for an
ideal Japanese woman...
translations.お茶を習う話なんだけど……。:
Last time, I told you about
the tea ceremony course...
translations.うん。結局どうするの？:
Yeah, did you apply for it in
the end？
translations.あれはなし。実はね、調べてみたらお月謝がすごく高くて。:
I didn't. Actually, I already
checked it out and the monthly
tuition fee is very high.
translations.考えてみれば当然よね。ちょっと払える金額じゃなかったから。:
To think about it, that's
quite natural for such a
course. But I can't afford it.
translations.……そうなんだ、少し残念だな。:
...I see. It's a little
disappointing, huh？
translations.……でも、せっかく思い立ったのに……。:
...But, you've been thinking
about it for a while...
translations.絶対やりたかったわけじゃないし。憧れは憧れなんだけどね。:
It's not like I was dying to
learn it. I just wanted to try
and that's all.
translations.それにもっと大事なことに気づいたから。:
And I just realized one
important thing.
translations.習い事を始めちゃうと、放課後の時間がなくなるでしょ。:
If I took that course, we
wouldn't be able to spend time
together after school.
translations.この間、教材室の掃除をしてたら、面白いものを見つけたんだ。:
I was cleaning the teaching
material storage room earlier
and I found something
interesting.
translations.このあたりの、ずっと昔の地図。:
It's a map of this area in the
old days.
translations.社会科の先生もあるの知らなくてね。:
Even the social studies
teacher wasn't aware of its
existence.
translations.調べてみたら１００年以上前のものなんだって。:
When we examined it, it
happened to be more than a
hundred years old.
translations.それはすごいなあ。その頃はどんな場所だったんだろ？:
That's amazing. I wonder what
were around here during that
time.
translations.学校のあった場所は……実はね、大きな墓地だったの。:
The area where our school
located was actually... a
large cemetery.
translations.なんてね。ごめん、嘘。ほんとは林だったみたい。ちょっとつまんないよね。:
Not really. Sorry, I was
kidding. Actually, it used to
be a forest. That's quite
boring.
translations.まあ、そんなもんだよね。:
Well, so that's what our
school used to be.
translations.でも、ちょっと面白かったから、また機会があれば見てみようと思って。:
But, I find it fun. Maybe I
should show it to you if I
have a chance.
translations.今の地図と記号が違うから、結構難しいんだけど。:
But the symbols on the map are
different from the current
ones, so they are difficult to
understand.
translations.ふうん。また面白い発見があったら教えてね。:
Hmm. If you find anything
interesting from it, let me
know too, okay？
translations.古い地図の話、覚えてる？:
Do you remember the old map we
talked about？
translations.ああ、このあたりの１００年くらい前の地図のことだよね。:
Yeah, the hundred-year-old map
of this area, right？
translations.そう。この間、また掃除があったから見てみたの。:
Yeah. I looked at it again
when I cleaned that room.
translations.あのね、デキシーズのある場所って、昔何があったと思う？:
Well, what do you think the
location of Dixie's used to be
in the past？
translations.もう……そうじゃなくて、大きなお屋敷だったみたい。:
Geez... No. It used to be a
big residence.
translations.うん。すごい広い家で、お店のあったあたりは、ちょうど離れが建っていたのね。:
Yeah, it was a very big house
with a store built as a
separate building.
translations.離れっていっても、一軒家並みの大きさなんだけど。:
Although the buildings were
built separately, they were
still in the same big
residence.
translations.へえ……そりゃ、かなりの金持ちだったんだろうね。:
Hmm？ ...Then the owner must
be very rich.
translations.でしょうね。何だか社会の先生がすごく関心を持ったらしくて調べてみるって言ってた。:
That seemed so. Now, the
social studies teacher has
become interested in this. She
said she'd do some research
about it.
translations.何かわかったらまた教えてあげるね。ふふ。:
If I know some more info, I'll
tell you. Hehe.
translations.ねえ、この前話してた、お屋敷の話って何かわかった？:
Hey, did you find out anything
new about the old residence we
were talking about？
translations.社会の先生が調べてくれたんだけど……実はその離れには悲しい話があったのよ。:
The social studies teacher
researched about it, but... it
turned out to be such a sad
story.
translations.そうなんだ……どんな話？:
Is that so...？ What kind of
story？
translations.お屋敷には娘さんがいてね、好きな人がいたんだけど、親に反対されて無理矢理引き離さ:
The daughter of that
residence's owner had a lover.
But her parents didn't approve
them and forced them to
separate.
translations.……昔ならありそうな話だよね。特にそういう金持ちだったりすると。:
...Things like that happened a
lot in the past, right？
Especially with rich people.
translations.そうね……でね、娘さんはショックで病気になっちゃって……。:
Yeah... But, the daughter
couldn't stand the shock and
fell ill...
translations.それで屋敷の主人が他人に見られないようにって離れを建てたらしいの。:
Then the residence's owner put
her in one building and
wouldn't let anyone see her.
translations.うわあ、ひでえ……それじゃ監禁じゃないか。:
Whoa, that's cruel... Wasn't
that like a confinement？
translations.私たちって、そんな悲しいことがあった場所で働いてたんだね……はあー。:
And we're working at the place
where that residence used to
be... Hah...
translations.この間の離れの話だけど……。:
We were talking about the
separation earlier...
translations.それがね、もっと詳しく調べたら、後日談がわかったの。:
Actually, after some study, I
found that there was a sequel
to that.
translations.そう。娘さんとの仲を引き裂かれた男の人、数年後に戻って来たんだって。:
Yeah. That guy who was forced
to be separated from the
residence owner's daughter
came back some years later.
translations.一所懸命働いて、事業を成功させて……それで改めて娘さんとの仲を認めてくださいって:
He had been working very hard
and succeeded in his
business... Then he asked for
permission to become the
daughter's husband.
translations.もちろん、ふたりはめでたく結ばれたに決まってるでしょ？:
Of course, they could finally
become together. That's how it
should be, right？
translations.……ああ、そんな素敵な場所で働いているなんて感激よね。:
...Ah, we're working at such a
wonderful place. I'm very
impressed.
translations.そうだけど……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、この前とはずいぶん反応が違うなあ……。:
Anyway...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
This reaction is totally the
opposite of last time, huh...
translations.ねえ、お昼、購買部で買ったことある？:
Hey, have you ever bought
lunch at our school's store？
translations.何だか、ものすごい争奪戦が繰り広げられてるって聞いたんだけど、ほんとなの？:
I've heard that it's a very
high competition. Is that
true？
translations.結構有名な話だよ。人気のあるパンなんかはすぐなくなっちゃうから。:
That rumor's been around.
There's a very famous sandwich
that's always sold out in no
time.
translations.うーん、詳しくは知らないけど……カツサンドあたりかな？ よく売れてるし。:
Hmm, I don't know exactly.
But... I think it might be the
tonkatsu sandwich because it
sells so well.
translations.あ、それ聞いたことある。同じクラスの男子がね、他の子に売ってるって。:
Ah, I've heard about it. The
guy in my class bought it from
another student.
translations.売ってる？: He bought it from a student？
translations.人気商品だからプレミアを付けても買う人がいるみたいよ。:
Since it's very famous, some
people buy and sell it as a
premium item.
translations.つまり……商売しているわけか。うわあ、やるなあ。:
So... You can sell it like
that？ Wow, that sounds great.
translations.そこまでして食べたいなんて、よほどおいしいんだね、そのカツサンド。:
If people wanted to eat it
that much, this tonkatsu
sandwich must be really
delicious.
translations.ねえねえ、評判のカツサンド、この間、食べてみたよ。:
Hey, hey. I had eaten that
famous tonkatsu sandwich, you
know.
translations.でも、ちょっとボリュームがありすぎかも。それにやっぱり油が気になるかな。:
The size was a little too big.
And I felt like it was quite
oily.
translations.そうなんだ。運動部の連中なんかには好評みたいだけどね。:
I see. That's why it seems to
be very popular for the guys
in the sports club.
translations.まあ、体を動かす人ならそういうかもね。でも、ちょっと男の子向きかな。:
Well, for people who use a lot
of energy, it would suit them.
I think it was made for guys.
translations.ふうん……でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、よく買えたね？ 毎日、ものすごい騒ぎになるのに。:
Hmm...？ But,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
how could you buy it？ The
store is always very crowded.
translations.ふふ……あのね、人に頼んで買ってもらったの。:
Hehe... I asked someone else
to buy it for me.
translations.なーいしょ。ふふ。心配しないでいいよ。カレシとかじゃないから。:
It's a secret. Hehe. You don't
have to worry about who bought
it for me. It wasn't my
boyfriend.
translations.そ、そんなこと言わないでよ。●、いちおうカレシなんだから……。:
Y-You don't have to tell me
that. Your boyfriend is
here...
translations.気にしないの。そんなことでヤキモチ焼くなんて……カワイイ▼:
Don't worry. You're getting
jealous for something like
this. ...So cute▼
translations.うん？ あれ、どうしたのかな、心配そうな顔しちゃって。:
Hmm？ Eh？ What's wrong？ You
seem to be worried about
something.
translations.この間のカツサンドの話だけど……覚えてる？:
Do you remember... when we
talked about the tonkatsu
sandwich earlier？
translations.もちろん。おいしいけど、ボリュームがあるかなって、話よね。:
Of course. It was delicious
and the size was big.
translations.じゃなくて、それを買った時の話……なんだけど。:
Not that... But about who
bought it...
translations.ああ……ふふ。気にしてるの？:
Ah... Hehe. Do you care about
it？
translations.そりゃあ、気になるよ。だってあの争奪戦の中で買うのは女の子にはキビしいだろうし…:
Yeah, I do. It would be too
difficult for a girl to fight
the crowd and buy it for you,
so...
translations.そうしたら、男が買ってきたことになるだろ。気にするなっていうのが無理だよ。:
So, that person must be a guy,
right？ Don't tell me to stop
worrying about it, because I
can't.
translations.もう、私にはあなたしかいないのに、何で疑うの？ お姉さん、悲しいなあ。:
Geez. I have only you. Why
can't you trust me？ You make
this big sister sad.
translations.（そんなこと言われたって……無理だよ、絶対気になるってば！）:
(Even if you say it like that,
it doesn't work. ...I'm really
concerned about it！)
translations.ねえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。カツサンドの話だけど……。:
Hey,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
About the tonkatsu sandwich...
translations.まだ気にしてるの？ ほんとに何でもないってば。:
Are you still worried about
it？ It was really nothing.
translations.隠さないで話してよ。もう最近気になって、メシも満足に喉を通らないんだから。:
Don't hide it from me. I've
been so worried that I even
lost my appetite lately.
translations.そうだったんだ。あのね……先生よ。:
Is that so...？ Well... It was
the teacher.
translations.そんな……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が……まさか先生と……。:
No way...
Don't tell me that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
and the teacher are...
translations.違う違う、そうじゃなくて。:
No, no. It's not what you
think.
translations.あのね、お昼に先生のところへ行ったら、カツサンドを食べていたの。で、頼んで少し分:
I went to see the teacher
during lunch break and he
happened to be eating the
tonkatsu sandwich. So, I asked
if I could try it.
translations.そうだったのかあ……なんだ、よかったあ。:
Is that so...？ Somehow, I'm
relieved.
translations.あ……ほんとに心配してたんだね。悪いことしちゃったかな。お詫びに今度カツサンド奢:
Ah... So you were really
concerned. Was I really bad？
Maybe I should get a tonkatsu
sandwich for you as an
apology.
translations.（もうカツサンドはいいよ……）:
(I've had enough with this
tonkatsu sandwich...)
translations.突然ですが、質問です。恥ずかしがらずに正直に答えてください。いいですね？:
It might be sudden but I have
a question for you. Don't be
shy and just answer me
honestly, okay？
translations.あなたは制服姿の女の子が好きですか？ イエスかノーかで答えてください。:
Do you like a girl in a school
uniform？ Yes or No？ Answer
me.
translations.何、その質問？:
What kind of question is
this？
translations.いいから答えて。別にあなたの趣味をどうこう言うつもりはないから正直にね。:
Just answer me. I just want to
know your tastes, so tell me
honestly.
translations.と言われてもなあ……イエスともノーとも……。:
For something like that...
It's both "yes" and "no"...
translations.それじゃダメ。どっちかで答えて。怒ったりしないから、ね？:
That's not allowed. You must
choose one. I won't get mad,
okay？
translations.うーん……まあ、制服にもよるけど……どちらかといえば……。:
Hmm... Well, it actually
depends on the types of the
uniforms, but if I have to
choose...
translations.そうなんだ。やっぱり。はあー。: I see. As I thought. Hah...
translations.（い、いったい何なんだ、この質問は？）:
(W-What actually was that
question about though？)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、この間の質問、あれ、何だったの？:
Well,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
About what you asked me
earlier, what was that？
translations.ほら、制服の女の子が好きかってやつ。:
Come on. You asked whether I
like girls in uniforms.
translations.ああ、あれ。どうしようかな……知りたい？:
Ah, that. What was it...？ Do
you want to know？
translations.まあ、ね。あんな風に聞かれると、やっぱり気になるからさ。:
Yeah, sort of. Because you
asked me, I was a bit
concerned.
translations.うーん……でも言うと笑われそうだから。:
Hmm... But don't laugh if I
tell you, okay？
translations.じゃあ……あ、でもやっぱり止める。絶対、笑われるから。:
Then... Ah, I shouldn't tell
you. I know you'll laugh for
sure.
translations.（そんなことしないけど……でも、こんなに気にしてちゃ聞けないか……うーん、気にな:
(I won't laugh... She really
won't tell me, huh？ Hmm, now
I'm even more curious.)
translations.ねえ、また質問があるんだけど？:
Hey, I have another question
for you.
translations.また？ 今度は何？:
Another one？ What is it this
time？
translations.少し先の駅のそばに新しく学校ができたの知ってる？:
Did you know that there's a
new school at the next train
station？
translations.へえ、そうだったんだ。知らなかったよ。:
Eh？ Really？ I didn't know
that.
translations.ほんとに？ そこの駅から乗る子も結構いるみたいなんだけど、知らない？:
Really？ A lot of students
from that school get off at
this station. You don't
notice？
translations.そう……ならいいんだけど。あ、でもバイト先に来ることもあるよ？ ほんとに知らない:
I see... That's fine then. Ah,
but they came to the
restaurant we work at, too.
Are you sure you don't know？
translations.知らないってば……えーと、その学校、どんな制服なの？ それがわかれば……。:
I said I don't know... Well,
how's that school's uniform
look like？ I might have some
clues...
translations.私からそれを言うわけにはいきません……そんな敵に塩を送るみたいなマネなんて、とて:
I really can't tell you
that... I feel like girls from
that school are my rivals. I
can't tell you.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、いったい何の話をしてるんだ!?）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What are you talking
about！？)
translations.ねえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、例の新しくできたっていう学校のことだけど……。:
Hey,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
About the new school...
translations.まさか……見たの、あの制服？:
No way... You've seen those
uniforms already？
translations.赤のチェックと黄色のカーディガンの制服のこと？:
The uniforms with red plaid
skirts and yellow cardigans？
translations.そう……あーあ、とうとう見ちゃったんだ。:
Yes... Ah, you saw them at
last.
translations.あれがどうかしたの？ 別にヘンなデザインじゃなかったけど？:
What's wrong with them？ I
don't think the design is
weird or anything.
translations.ヘンというか……あれは反則、イエローカードだよ。:
Not weird...？ That was a foul
play. They deserve yellow
cards.
translations.スカートがね、短すぎ。あれじゃ、男の人、目のやり場に困るよ。男の先生とか、どうす:
Their skirts are too short.
That causes troubles for guys,
right？ What would happen to
male teachers there？
translations.（あ……そういえば、結構短かったな、あのスカート）:
(Ah... Speaking of which, the
skirts are really short.)
translations.だいたいね、若い子があんな格好するなんて卑怯だと思う。年齢だけでも有利だっていう:
I think it's bad for those
young girls to wear something
like that. They should wait
until they grow older.
translations.（若いって、同じ高校生じゃないか……）:
(Young girls？ They are also
high school students like
us...)
translations.ねえ、\n学校に幽霊が出るって話、\n聞いたことある？:
Hey, did you heard about a
ghost that appeared in our
school？
translations.ううん。\nそんな噂が広がってるの？:
No. Was it a rumor or
something？
translations.噂じゃなくて、\n現に何度も目撃されてるのよ。:
It wasn't a rumor. There were
many eyewitnesses.
translations.生徒だけじゃなく、\n先生や用務員さんも\n見てるんだって。:
Not only did the students see
it, but the teachers and the
janitors saw it as well.
translations.へえ、それはちょっと\n気になる話だね。\nどんな幽霊？:
Eh？ Now that sounds
interesting？ What kind of
ghost is it？
translations.小さな女の子。\n３、４歳くらいなんだって。\n放課後、学校の裏とか、\n人目に:
This one looked like a girl
about 3-4 years old. After
school, she would appear at
the backyard or some desolated
places.
translations.近所の子供が\n紛れ込んだんじゃないの？:
Could she be a kid in the
neighborhood？
translations.先生たちもそう思ったらしいん\nだけど、近くにそんな子が\nいる家はないんだって:
The teachers thought so, but
there isn't any girl that
looks like her in the
neighborhood.
translations.それは……で、その女の子は\n何をしているの？ \n何か悪さをしているとか？:
Then... What did that girl
do？ Did she do something
evil？
translations.害は出てないみたい。\nキャッキャッて楽しそうに\n笑って走り回っている\nらし:
She didn't hurt anyone. She
screamed and laughed with joy
while running around the
school...
translations.なんかヘンな話だなあ。\n幽霊にしても何だか\nイメージに合わないよね。:
That sounds weird. That
doesn't fit an image of a
ghost at all.
translations.あ、そうだ。新聞部が本格的に\n調査するらしいから、\n話を聞いてみようかな。:
Ah, right. People from the
newspaper club had started the
investigation. I might ask
them.
translations.この前話した、女の子の幽霊のこと、覚えてる？:
Do you remember the story
about a ghost that looked like
a girl？
translations.ああ、覚えてるよ。実はちょっと気になってた。何かわかったの？:
Yeah, I remember. Actually, I
was interested in it. Did you
get any more info？
translations.うん。何とね、新聞部の子が見つけたのよ。そればかりか話をしたんだって。:
Yeah. Somehow, the newspaper
club's member met her. And I
just talked with that member.
translations.幽霊と話した？:
Did that member encounter the
ghost？
translations.じゃなくて、普通の女の子だったの。:
Not a ghost. She was just a
normal girl.
translations.プールの裏でね、友達とはぐれたって泣いてたのを見つけたらしいの。:
She was crying at the back of
the swimming pool because she
got lost from her friend.
translations.なんだ……じゃあ、やっぱり近所の子が迷い込んできてたんだ。:
What...？ Then she was
actually a girl from the
neighborhood, huh？
translations.でもね、やっぱり近くにはその子の家なんてなかったのよ。警察の人が来て連れていって:
But there really isn't any
girl with her description
around here. In the end, the
police came to pick her up.
translations.ふうん。幽霊じゃないことはわかったけど、別な意味で不思議な話だね。:
Hmm, so we figured she wasn't
a ghost, but another mystery
appears.
translations.新聞部は、追跡調査を続けるって。:
The newspaper club will do the
follow-up investigation.
translations.（調査って、ウチの学校は変なところでノリがいいな……）:
(Investigation？ Students at
our school easily get obsessed
with some weird things...)
translations.ねえねえ、例の女の子の新しい情報が入ったのよ。聞きたい？:
Hey, hey. I got more info
about that girl. Wanna hear
it？
translations.お、待ってました。で、どうなの？ どこの子だかわかったの？:
Oh, I've been waiting for
this. So, what is it？ Did you
know where she came from？
translations.うん。でも、それがね、隣の県の子だったんだって。:
Yeah. Well, she was actually
from the nearby prefecture.
translations.隣の県？ あれ、でも３、４歳だって言ってなかった？:
The nearby prefecture？ Eh？
But she's only 3 or 4 years
old, right？
translations.そんな子がどうやってここまで？:
How did she come as far as our
school？
translations.その子のお母さんがこっちの病院に入院しているんだって。それでお見舞いに来た時、抜:
Her mother was admitted in the
hospital here. The girl
visited her mother and sneaked
out from the hospital.
translations.ということは……お見舞いに来るたび、わざわざこの学校まで来てたの？ でもなんで？:
So... She came to our school
after she visited her mother？
But why did she do that？
translations.夜になると入院先にお父さんが車で迎えに来ることになっていて、それまで学校で遊んで:
Her father would come to pick
her up at night, so she came
to our school to play while
waiting for him.
translations.なんだかよくわからない話だね。それにしても物騒だよね。そんな子がひとりでさ。:
Somehow this is not quite
understandable. Anyhow, it was
dangerous. That girl was
alone, after all.
translations.そうよね。事故に遭ったり、事件に巻き込まれなくてよかった。:
Yeah. I'm glad she didn't get
into any accident.
translations.ま、それはともかく、とりあえず幽霊騒動もこれで一件落着だね。:
Well, anyway. We can say that
it's another case closed for
this ghost story, right？
translations.あのね、この間まで続いていた幽霊騒動のことだけど……。:
Hey, about the ghost story
we've been talking about...
translations.その話、もう終わったんじゃなかったっけ？:
That story？ I think it's
already solved, right？
translations.そうなんだけど……実はね、女の子の話で新事実がわかったんだって。:
That's right, but... Actually,
there's a new finding about
that girl.
translations.うん。その子が言うには、病院から抜け出す時、一緒に抜け出していた友達がいたって言:
Yeah, from what that girl
said, when she sneaked out
from the hospital, she had a
friend accompanied her.
translations.友達？ 一緒に見舞いに来てたの？:
A friend？ Was it someone who
went to visit the patient at
the hospital？
translations.じゃなくて、知らない男の子だって。: No, it was an unknown boy.
translations.遊ぼうって誘われて、あんまり寂しそうだったから相手をしてあげたみたいんなんだけど:
He asked her to play with him.
He looked lonely, so she
decided to keep him company.
But...
translations.ちょ、ちょっと待ってよ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。何か嫌な予感が……。:
W-Wait,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Somehow I have a
bad feeling about this...
translations.お母さんが入院してた病院にね、重病の男の子がいたんだって……。:
At the hospital where that
girl's mother was admitted,
there was a seriously ill boy
there...
translations.あ、あのさあ、そのへんで止めない？:
W-Well, can we stop talking
about this now？
translations.女の子の話によると、一緒に抜け出したっていう子、その入院していた男の子そっくりな:
According to that girl, the
boy that sneaked out from the
hospital with her looked
exactly the same as that ill
boy... Yeah...
translations.新聞部が見つけた時、女の子は友達とはぐれて泣いてたって言ったでしょ。:
When the member from the
newspaper club found the girl,
she said she got lost from her
friend, right？
translations.ちょうどその時……。: So, her story could be true...
translations.し、知らない！ ●はそんな話、聞いてない。知らないから！:
I-I don't know！ I didn't hear
this. I don't know！
translations.ねえ、校務員室って行ったことある？:
Hey, have you ever been to the
janitor's room？
translations.掃除のときに道具借りに行ったことぐらいならあるけど。:
I used to go there to borrow
some cleaning tools.
translations.じゃあ、中のこと、詳しくは知らないわよね。ベッドがあって、台所もあって、寝泊まり:
So, you didn't see the
interior, right？ There's a
bed and a kitchen. You can
spend a night there, you
know？
translations.ああ、なるほど。でも、なんでそんなことを？:
Ah, I see. But how did you
know？
translations.実はね、ちょっと先生に頼まれたことがあって、最近、時々行ってるのよ。:
Actually, the teacher asked me
to go there, so I went there
at times.
translations.頼まれた？ 何を？:
You were asked to go there？
Why？
translations.校務員さん、指に怪我しちゃったんだって。それで調理が出来ないから、何かと不便みた:
The janitor's fingers were
injured, so someone has to
help him with the cooking.
translations.調理って、校務員ってそんなこともするのか。……まさか、それで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が……？:
Our janitor also has to
prepare the food？ Don't
tell me that's why
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
goes there...
translations.家庭科の先生から推薦があったらしいから。断るのも悪いからやってあげようかな、って:
The home economics teacher
asked me to do that, so I
couldn't refuse.
translations.そうかな。でも料理の練習にもなるし、少しなら余計に作ってもいいことになってるから:
Is that so？ But I can also
practice my cooking skills and
sometimes I can cook something
extra. It's rather helpful for
me.
translations.（助かる？ 何のことだろ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が食べる分なのかな？）:
(Helpful？ What does
she mean？ Does
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
eat food there too？)
translations.あ、そういえばさ、校務員さんの手伝いって、まだ続けてるの？:
Ah, by the way. Do you still
have to help the janitor？
translations.うん。最近、打ち解けていろんな話をするようになったよ。:
Yeah. Lately, I've been
chatting with him about a lot
of things.
translations.へえ。どんなこと話してるの？:
Eh？ What kinds of topics do
you talk about？
translations.音楽のこととか、映画の話とか。映画のことはすごく詳しいから楽しくて。:
Things like music and movies.
He knows a lot about movies so
I really enjoy talking to him.
translations.音楽に……映画？ へえ、そういうのに詳しいなんて結構意外だな。:
Music and... movies？ Eh？
That's quite unexpected.
translations.そうかな。別に普通だと思うけど。:
Really？ I think it's just
common.
translations.でも、校務員さんって、もう結構なお爺さんだったでしょ？:
But our janitor is quite an
old man, right？
translations.何言ってるのよ、それは前の人。今務めてるのは、まだ２０代くらいの若い男の人よ。:
What are you talking about？
That was the previous janitor.
The current one is a young
guy, around 20 years old.
translations.え!? それを早く言ってくれないと！:
Eh！？ You should've told me
earlier！
translations.別に気にすることないと思うけど。:
I think you didn't care about
that.
translations.あ、ひょっとして心配なの？ 大丈夫、私はあなた一筋だから。ね？:
Ah, could it be that you get
worried？ It's okay. I have
only you, all right？
translations.あのね、報告があるんだけど。:
Hey, I have something to tell
you.
translations.校務員さんの怪我、やっと治ったの。これでお役目は終わりね。:
The janitor's injury has
recovered, so I don't have to
help him anymore.
translations.ふふ。でもね、実は校務員さん、私が作る料理をすっかり気に入ってくれたみたいなの。:
Hehe. But it seems like the
janitor really likes my food.
He asked me to come to cook
for him sometime.
translations.受けようかなって思ったんだけど、でも、あなたが反対するだろうと思って。:
I was thinking about taking
his offer, but I'm sure you'll
oppose.
translations.だから断ったの。これ以上はできません、ごめんなさいって。:
So I refused. I told him I
couldn't do it anymore and
apologized to him.
translations.ふふ、今のはホッとしたため息？ もう、私の気持ちを信じて欲しいな。ほんとにあなた:
Hehe. Was that a sigh of
relief？ Geez. You should have
faith in me. I really have
only you.
translations.この間の、校務員さんの話だけど……。:
About the janitor that we've
talked about earlier...
translations.ううん。今はもう何も。でも、別の話が出てきてるのよ。:
No, nothing happened. But
there's something new.
translations.校務員さんが料理のことを事務室で話したらいいのよ。そしたら、事務員さんたちが気に:
Seems like the janitor talked
about my food at the staff
room. Now the teachers are
anxious to taste my food.
translations.このまま行くと、お弁当のリクエストが出るかも。そうしたらどうしようかな。:
I think they might ask me to
cook for them. I don't know
what to do if that happens.
translations.でも、それってすごい量作らないといけないんじゃない？:
That means you'll have to cook
lots of food for them.
translations.材料は負担してもらうつもり。あ、少しぐらいなら上乗せしてもいいかな？ ね、それで:
They'll pay me for the
ingredients and probably give
me some extra money too. Hey,
shall I buy something for
you？ Hehe.
translations.ほんとに……やる気なの、それ？:
Actually... You want to do it,
right？
translations.……ごめん。話があったのは事実だけど、今のは冗談だから。それに、そんな可愛い顔さ:
...Sorry. It's true about the
teachers, but the rest was
just a joke. Look how cute you
are. I can't continue teasing
you.
translations.最近、新学園七不思議が流行ってるって知ってる？:
Lately, our school's new Seven
Wonders have become very
popular, you know？
translations.ほら、よくあるじゃない。トイレの幽霊とか、増える階段とか、動く人体模型とか……。:
Come on. You've heard of them,
right？ Like the ghost in the
toilet, or the haunted stairs,
or the moving biology model...
translations.ああ、そういうの、どこの学校にもあるよね。:
Ah, most schools have
something like that.
translations.うちにもあったんだけど、そういうありきたりのじゃなくて、新しい七不思議を探そうっ:
Our school has them, too, but
not the conventional ones.
Currently, people are
searching for the new Seven
Wonders.
translations.そうなの？ でも、ああいうのって探そうとして見つかるものなのかな。:
Really？ But, are the Seven
Wonders something you can
search for？
translations.どうかな。でも、私は頑張って欲しいって思ってるんだけど。:
I doubt it. But, I feel like I
want to support these people.
translations.ああいうのって、学校生活のスパイスみたいなものだし、それに独創的な学校の怪談って:
It's something that will spice
up our school life, right？
And I think the original ghost
stories are wonderful.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、そういう話好きだなあ……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
really likes this kind
of thing, huh...？
translations.例の新学園七不思議を探そうって人たちだけど、ついに同好会を結成したんだって。:
The students who are searching
for our school's new Seven
Wonders have formed an
association.
translations.そう。新七不思議探究会っていうの。放課後なんかに集まって結構一所懸命やってるみた:
Yeah, "The New Seven Wonders
Research Association." They
hold meetings after school to
discuss their plans.
translations.暇だな、って言ったら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に怒られるかな。:
If I say that they're
just people who have too
much free time,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
will probably get mad at
me, right？
translations.別に怒りはしないけど、夢のない人だなとは思うかも。:
I'm not gonna get mad at you.
I'll just think that you have
no dream.
translations.夢で悪ければロマン。言い方はともかくとして、不思議なことに感激できる心って大切だ:
It's more like ambition than
dream. I'd say that you need
some ambition to look into
mysteries.
translations.私もね、同好会に入ってみようかなって思ったんだけど……。:
I was thinking about joining
them...
translations.……なんか、そういう話になりそうだと思った。:
...Somehow, I kind of expected
you'd say that.
translations.でも止めたの。バイト行けなくなっちゃうし、そうするとあなたと……。:
But I won't. I have the
part-time job and I have to
spend time with you...
translations.だから今回はパス。残念だけど、ね。:
So, I'll pass this time. Such
a pity, huh？
translations.ねえ、例の新七不思議探究会が新しい七不思議を見つけたらしいわよ。:
Hey, about the New Seven
Wonders Research
Association... I think they've
found something.
translations.七つじゃなくて、まだひとつなんだけど。裏庭に小さな花壇があるの、知ってる？:
Not seven of them, but only
one for now. There's a small
flower bed at the school's
backyard, right？
translations.知らないな。そんなの、あったっけ？:
I didn't know that. We have a
flower bed there？
translations.ずうっと前に誰かが作ったらしいんだけど、その後手入れもされずに放置されていたらし:
Somebody built it a long time
ago and it's always been
neglected. But recently, it
becomes clean and beautiful
again.
translations.それ、誰かが手入れしているだけじゃない？:
Someone might be taking care
of it, right？
translations.……やっぱりそう思うよね。うーん、この程度じゃ、とても七不思議なんて呼べないわよ:
...You think so too, huh？
Yeah, if it's like that, it
can't be called one of the
Seven Wonders.
translations.草花の好きな転校生でも来たのか？:
Maybe a new transfer student
who loves flowers？
translations.どうだろ？ でも、誰がやっているのかはちょっと興味があるな。調べてみようかな。:
I wonder. Has someone been
taken care of it？ I'm curious
now. I'd better look into the
matter.
translations.何だかんだ言って、こういう話題、好きなんだね。:
Anyway, you really like this
kind of story, huh？
translations.裏庭の花壇の話、覚えてる？:
Do you remember the flower bed
we talked about last time？
translations.ああ、覚えてるよ。誰かが手入れしてるってやつでしょ。:
Yeah, I remember. Someone has
been taken care of it, right？
translations.あれね、誰がやってるかわかったの。私、偶然だったんだけど、見ちゃったんだ。:
Well, I already knew who did
that. It was just a
coincidence, but I saw it.
translations.それがね、あなたの予想通り。:
It's exactly as you said
before.
translations.最近来た転校生に花の好きな子がいたみたい。荒れた花壇に耐えられなかったんだって。:
There's a new transfer student
who loves flowers and couldn't
stand it that the flower bed
was neglected.
translations.そりゃまた、ずいぶん乙女チックな話だね。その転校生って、どんな子なの。:
Most girls are like that,
huh？ Well, what kind of girl
is this transfer student,
then？
translations.何か勘違いしてない？ 男の子よ。:
You've misunderstood it
somehow. He's a guy.
translations.男の子にも花の好きな子ぐらいいるわよ。それも結構可愛い子なの。年上心をくすぐるっ:
There are guys who love
flowers, too. And he's very
cute. When I saw him, I felt
like something was tickling my
heart.
translations.ふふ、もちろん私は大丈夫よ。だって、あなたがいるし。:
Hehe. Don't worry. I already
have you.
translations.でも、あなたがいなかったら、思わず抱きしめちゃうかも。:
But if it wasn't for you, I
probably couldn't resist
hugging him.
translations.（カンベンして欲しいなあ、もう）:
(Hey, can you not say
that...？ Geez.)
translations.ねえ、前に話した、茶室の話、覚えてる？:
Hey, we talked about the tea
house earlier. Did you
remember？
translations.うん。昔の先生が女の子にお茶やお花を教えていたって話でしょ。:
Yeah, there was a teacher who
taught tea ceremony and flower
arranging to female students,
right？
translations.そう。今、柔道部が使っている、畳敷きの部屋あるじゃない。そこが茶室の後なんだって:
Yeah, and you know that our
judo club has a straw-matted
room, right？ That's where the
tea house used to be.
translations.茶室から武道室になったのか。そりゃ、ずいぶん変わったもんだね。:
The tea house has become a
martial arts room？ That's an
extreme change.
translations.でもね、そう改装したのも女の先生だったんだって。:
But the one in charge of the
judo club now is a female
teacher.
translations.学生時代に日本代表クラスの選手だったらしいの。で、柔道は礼儀も勉強できるし、護身:
She used to be a national judo
player. She said that for
judo, you have to learn the
etiquettes as well as the
moves.
translations.……その先生も女の子を集めて指導してたとか？:
...So, does she gather female
students and teach them？
translations.別に女の子だけじゃなかったみたいだけど。でも、男の子はゼロだったみたい。結構美人:
It's not restricted to female
students, but no male student
has ever joined. That's weird.
She's such a pretty woman.
translations.でも柔道でしょ？ あんまり美人だとかえってやりにくいよ。男には。:
But it's judo. No matter how
pretty she is, guys would feel
awkward to learn from her.
translations.そう言われればそういうものかも。……ふふ、男の子って、面白いね。:
I think that might be the
reason... Hehe. Boys are
interesting.
translations.ねえ、この間、柔道を教えていた女の先生の話したじゃない？:
Hey, I told you about the
female teacher who teaches
judo, right？
translations.実際のところ、どう思う？ 女の子がそういうのやるのって。:
What do you think about girls
who learn judo？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もやりたいの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
wants to learn judo, too？
translations.私はべつに。ただ、よくあるでしょ。護身術にって言って格闘技習う人。ああいうの、効:
Not really. But many girls
learn martial arts for
self-defense, right？ I think
that's such a good idea.
translations.どうだろ……でも、警察では女の人もやるんだし、やっぱ意味あるんじゃない？:
Really...？ But to think about
it, there are also a lot of
female police officers,
right？
translations.警察では専門家が教えてくれるからいいと思うんだけど……ほら、生兵法は怪我の元、っ:
Police officers have to go
through special trainings. A
smattering of knowledge can be
a dangerous thing, okay？
translations.渋いこと言うなあ。でも、万が一に備えて身の守り方ぐらい知っておくほうがよくない？:
Don't try to sound cool.
Anyway, I think it's a good
idea. You should at least be
able to protect yourself.
translations.下手に刃向かうと相手を怒らせるってこともあるし……私は誰かに守ってもらうほうがい:
It'd be worse if I tried to
fight back and ended up
provoking the attacker. I'd
rather have someone protect me
instead.
translations.……●、期待されてる？:
...Are you trying to put me
under pressure？
translations.うん、まあね。あ、でも無理して何か習ったりはしないでね。それで怪我されたりしても:
Well, sort of. But you don't
have to go as far as to learn
any martial arts. It'd be bad
if you got injured from that.
translations.ねえ、知ってる？ 今度女性の警察官が学校に来て護身術の指導をしてくれるんだって。:
Hey, did you know？ The female
police officers will come to
our school to teach
self-defense.
translations.うん。女の子にだけ。万が一に備えて、知識ぐらいあったほうがいいだろうってことで。:
Yeah, but the class is for
female students only. They'll
teach us some basic stuff.
translations.そういうの聞いたら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ますます強くなっちゃうなあ。:
Just hearing that
makes me feel like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
will become much stronger.
translations.ふふ。がっちり抑え込んで逃がさないから。:
Hehe. I might be able to block
someone from getting away from
me.
translations.……それ、妙にリアルだな。:
...Hmm, I think you can do
that.
translations.あ、そっか。格闘術を身につけておくと、そういう使い方もできるのか。なるほどなるほ:
Ah, really？ If I learn some
martial arts techniques, I can
do something like that. I see,
I see.
translations.（それは違うと思う……）:
(I think she got some wrong
idea...)
translations.この間、護身術の講習会があったの。:
Earlier, I attended a
self-defense class.
translations.いろいろタメになった。でも、やっぱり素人がすぐに出来るものじゃないと思ったけど。:
I learned a lot of things. But
I think self-defense isn't
something a novice can master
easily.
translations.警察の人も言ってた。無闇に抵抗すると危険なこともあるから、なるべく助けを求めるよ:
The police officer said that
it'd be dangerous to fight
recklessly. The best thing for
us to do is to call for help.
translations.それでね、素敵なカレシを見つけて、どこかに行く時は付いて来てもらいなさいって。ふ:
She also said that I should
find a nice boyfriend and ask
him to accompany me all the
time. She's funny.
translations.ということは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が言ってた方法が正しいってことか。:
And what did you tell her,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そういうことね。後は、カレシ次第かな。:
I told her it would be up to
my boyfriend then.
translations.うーん……てことは、やっぱり●、強くならないとダメ？:
Hmm... Which means I'll have
to become stronger...
translations.理想を言えばね。でも、私は今のあなたが好きだから、それでいいけど。:
That's the ideal. But I love
you the way you are now.
translations.万が一の時は一緒に誰かに助けを求めましょ？:
In case something happened, we
both could run and call for
help together.
translations.そういえばさ、例の新学園七不思議探究会はどうなったの？:
By the way, any updates on the
New Seven Wonders Research
Association？
translations.あ、それなりに活動はしているみたいだけど……。:
Ah, I think they've started
their activities...
translations.やっぱり急に探そうとしても見つからないのかな。:
I wonder if they can find
anything.
translations.というか……最近は探すんじゃなくて、新しく作るほうにシフトしてるみたい。:
Well... They had stopped
trying to find something. Now,
they're trying to create
something instead.
translations.自分たちの代で新しい七不思議を作って、それを次の学年に引き継いでもらうんだって。:
They're trying to create our
school's Seven Wonders and
pass them on to students in
the next generation.
translations.なるほど……でも、それはもう活動の主旨が変わってるよね。:
I see... But their mission
must have changed then.
translations.そうね。探究じゃなくて創作だから。私も何かネタないって、聞かれたことある。:
Yeah. It's not researching but
creating now. They even asked
me once whether I got any
subject for them.
translations.へえ。何か、考えてあげたの。:
Hmm？ Do you plan to come up
with something for them？
translations.うーん……アイディアはあるんだけど……自分で創っちゃうのって、邪道っていうか、ロ:
No... I have some idea, but
I'll feel like I'm cheating if
I make up the Seven Wonders by
myself. It's not
challenging...
translations.この間、新しい学園七不思議を作るっていう話をしたの、覚えてる？:
Do you remember that we talked
about the New Seven Wonders
Research Association last
time？
translations.うん。確か▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、あんまり気乗りがしないって言ってたよね。:
Yeah, but I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
wasn't much interested in it,
right？
translations.そう。それで、やっぱり断わることにしたんだ。:
Yeah. And I already refused to
join the group.
translations.そうなんだ。結構面白そうなのに。:
I see. But it seems pretty
fun.
translations.私も興味あったけど。でも、こういうのは意外にオーソドックスなのがいいんじゃないか:
I was interested in it, but I
think it would be better if
those people chose the
orthodox way.
translations.七不思議って、いわば学園生活の思い出でしょ。それがどの学校でも同じって事が大切な:
The Seven Wonders are
something to remind us of our
school, right？ The important
thing is that they should be
unique.
translations.将来、他の学校の人とこの話題が出た時、増える階段とか、動く人体模型なら、話も合う:
Most schools also have the
haunted stairs or the moving
biology model, right？ What if
we have something different？
translations.ああ、なるほど。たしかに浮いちゃうね。そうかあ、七不思議ってそんな役割もしてたん:
Ah, I see. In that case,
people will spread the rumors
about our school's mysteries.
Soon they will become the
Seven Wonders.
translations.残念なことは残念なんだけどね。いちおう七つ考えておいたし……。:
I'd say that it's such a pity
because I already thought up
seven stories...
translations.新七不思議探究会が解散するんだって。:
The New Seven Wonders Research
Association will be dissolved.
translations.うん。なんか熱心にやってた子が、図書館でそういうオカルトっぽい本ばかり借りてて、:
Yeah, parents of the most
active student in the group
found out that their kid
borrowed many occult books
from the library.
translations.親が心配しちゃって、原因を突き止めたら、同好会のせいだってわかって……。:
The parents got worried and
then they found out about the
association...
translations.よくある話だなあ。: Things like that happen a lot.
translations.正規のクラブならともかく、同好会だから、学校としてもかばいようがないみたいね。:
The research association isn't
an official club, so our
school can't do anything much
to help.
translations.私は断ったけど、別にやること自体はいいと思うのよね。頑張ってた人はショックだろう:
Although I don't want to join
them, I think they're nice and
hard-working people. This is
such a shock.
translations.まあ、仕方ないよ。大人の事情ってやつだし。:
Well, it can't be helped.
Adults also have their
concerns.
translations.はあ……大人の事情か。思わず“大人になんてなりたくなーい！”って叫んじゃいそう。:
Hah... Adult's concerns, huh？
Now I want to scream "I don't
want to become an adult！" out
loud.
translations.例の新学園七不思議探究会。解散しないで済みそうなんだって。:
In the end, the New Seven
Wonders Research Association
didn't have to be dissolved.
translations.うん。現国の先生がね、生徒たちの創造力を奪いたくないって熱弁を振るったみたい。自:
Yeah. The Modern Japanese
teacher helped them and
offered to be the group's
advisor himself.
translations.ふうん。そんな熱い先生もいるんだね。:
Hmm. We have such a dedicated
teacher here too.
translations.ただ、名前だけは変えることになったみたい。:
But they had to change the
group's name.
translations.もう七不思議を探究してないのにヘンでしょ？:
Because they wouldn't be
researching the Seven Wonders
anymore.
translations.なるほど。新しい名前は決まったの？:
I see. So, have they decided
on the new name？
translations.いいじゃない。都市伝説なら創作してもいいし。私も面白い話が出来たら持っていくつも:
Isn't it good？ If it's urban
legend, they can make up
something. I'm thinking about
offering my ideas to them,
too.
translations.年下の子とつき合うのって、難しいんだなあって思って。:
I think it's really hard to
date a younger guy.
translations.●、なんかマズイことやった？:
Did I do something bad to
you？
translations.え？ ……ああ、そうじゃないの。私の友達の話。カレシとケンカしちゃったみたいで。:
Eh？ ...Ah, no. It's just that
my friend had a fight with her
boyfriend.
translations.ごめんね。でも、やっぱり友達だから気になるのよ。仲直りできるといいんだけど。:
Sorry. But she's my friend so
I'm quite worried. I hope they
can reconcile.
translations.ケンカの原因は何だったの？:
What was the cause of their
fight？
translations.まだちゃんと聞いてないんだけど……デート中に大ゲンカになったんだって。:
I haven't asked her yet... But
it seems like they had a big
quarrel during their date.
translations.そうなのかあ……せっかくのデートなのにね。:
Is that so...？ So bad it
happened during a date...
translations.ね。はあ、心配だな……まるっきり他人事にも思えないし。:
Right？ Hah... She's my close
friend so I'm quite worried...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、元気ないみたいだけど、大丈夫？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You don't look well.
Are you okay？
translations.うん……ごめんね。ちょっと考えごとしてて。:
Hmm... Sorry. There's
something that worries me.
translations.●でよかったら、話聞くけど？:
If you want to talk, I can
listen to you.
translations.役に立つかわからないけど、何かできるかもしれないから聞かせてよ。:
I might not be of any help,
but at least I can listen to
your problem.
translations.そうね……実は、この間、話した友達の話。:
Well... Actually, it's about
the friend I talked about
before.
translations.ああ……あの、カレシとケンカしちゃったっていう？:
Ah... The one who got in a
fight with her boyfriend？
translations.そう……結局別れることになったんだって。あの後、すれ違いばかりですっかりダメにな:
Yeah... They finally broke up.
Now, they didn't even want to
see each other's face.
translations.すごく仲が良かったの。思わず妬いちゃうくらいね。それがたったひとつのことで。ほん:
They used to be so sweet that
I even got jealous of them.
Just one fight and they broke
up. ...I'll have to be
careful, too.
translations.ねえ、ちょっと聞いていい？:
Hey, can I ask you a
question？
translations.あなたには女の子の友達ってどれぐらいいる？:
How many friends do you have
that are girls？
translations.そう。いないことはないでしょ。クラスで仲のいい子とか。:
Yeah, it's impossible to have
none, right？ At least there
must be some girls you're
close to in class.
translations.まあ、少し話したり、宿題見せてもらうくらいなら……でも、一緒に遊んだりはしないか:
Well, I rarely talk to them.
At most I just take a look at
their homework, but I wouldn't
call them my close friends...
translations.あのね、先に行っておくけど、私、そういう友達は全然気にしないから。:
Well, let me tell you this
first. I don't mind at all if
you get close to those girls.
translations.前に話した友達だけど、カレシとのケンカの原因はそれだったらしいの。彼のところに女:
I talked to my friend earlier
and she quarreled with her
boyfriend because of this
issue. She got mad because a
girl called him.
translations.私、異性の知り合いや友達がいるのは当たり前だって割り切ってるから。そんなことで怒:
If you have any female
friends, just tell me and I
won't get mad at you. This is
something I want you to know.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、何だか嬉しそうだね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
somehow you look so happy.
translations.そう見える？ 悩みがひとつなくなったからかな……ほら、あの友達のこと。:
Really？ One of my worries has
gone... Well, it's about my
friend.
translations.えーと……あの、カレシとケンカしちゃった人のこと？:
Umm, is it the friend who
quarreled with her boyfriend
earlier？
translations.うん、そう。どうにか立ち直ってくれたから。実はね、新しいカレシができたみたい。:
Yeah, right. She got back on
her feet and she already has a
new boyfriend now.
translations.それがね、また年下の子なの。懲りないっていうか、すごいよね？:
And her new boyfriend is
another underclassman. It's
amazing, although I think she
didn't learn her lesson.
translations.ううん、違う。聞いてみたら、年下のほうがいいみたい。優しい子だし、きっと母性本能:
No. She told me herself that
she preferred younger guys.
She's a gentle girl, so maybe
her maternal instinct is
strong.
translations.ふーん。そういうものなんだ？: Hmm. So, is that how it is？
translations.あれ、何か引っかかる言い方？ 私は優しくないのかな？ いじめているばかりの意地悪:
Eh？ I can sense something
from that. Do you feel like
I'm not gentle？ Am I a mean
girl who always teases you？
translations.そんなことないよ……ごめん。: No, not at all... I'm sorry.
translations.もう、謝らないの。こんな冗談気にしちゃって……カワイイ▼:
Geez, don't apologize. I was
just joking. ...So cute▼
translations.そういえば、この間、都市伝説愛好会ができたでしょ。:
By the way, we talked about
the Urban Legend Lovers
Association before, right？
translations.ああ、昔の何だっけ？ ……七不思議調査会……だっけ？:
Ah, what was its previous name
again？ ...The Seven Wonders
Investigation Association？
translations.じゃなくて、新七不思議探求会。:
No. It was The New Seven
Wonders Research Association.
translations.ああ、そうだった。そういえば、何か話を作るって言ってたよね？ 何か出来たの？:
Ah, I see. By the way, they're
creating some urban legends,
right？ Did they come up with
something？
translations.あ、そっちはまだ思案中。それよりね、そのせいで今、新しい動きが生まれてるのよ。:
Ah, they're still discussing
about it. But because of that,
now we have a new movement.
translations.そう、別な同好会の結成。都市伝説愛好会みたいな、ちょっと変わった会を目指している:
Yeah, there's a formation of
another group. It's a little
different from the Urban
Legend Lovers Association
though.
translations.みたいってことは……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の知り合いがやってるの？:
How did you know about that,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
Is there someone you know in
this new group？
translations.友達にそういうの好きな子がいるのよ。軽い趣味だけどね。別にヘンな子じゃないんだけ:
It's my friend who has an
interest in some weird stuff.
It's her hobby but it doesn't
mean she's a weird girl or
anything.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も入るの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
will you join the group？
translations.どうかなあ。私はあんまり関心ないんだけど。彼女とは好みの方向も違うしね。ホラーと:
I'm not sure. I'm not that
interested. Her taste is
different from mine. Horror
and occult aren't the same
thing.
translations.この間、新しい同好会を作ろうとしている友達の話、したでしょ？:
Earlier, I told you about my
friend who started a new
association, right？
translations.ああ、覚えてるよ。その後、どうなったの？:
Yeah, I remember. What
happened after that？
translations.とりあえず名前は決めたみたい。黒魔術同好会、だって。:
She finally decided the
association's name. It's the
"Black Magic Lovers
Association."
translations.……その名前じゃ、さすがに認めてもらえないんじゃない？:
...I wonder if that name will
be acceptable.
translations.まあ、半分冗談だからね。友達もノリで決めたみたいだし。:
Well, part of it was just a
joke. My friend just decided
it on a whim.
translations.でも、何を研究するんだろ？:
But what kinds of activities
will the members do then？
translations.さあ……そのあたりもあんまり決めてないみたい。これから考えるって言ってた。:
Well... I don't think she has
decided on that yet. She said
she was still thinking about
it.
translations.魔女の格好して騒ぐとか？:
Will she try to dress up like
a witch？
translations.それじゃ、ただの仮装だよ、もう。:
That would be more like a
cosplay. Geez.
translations.ねえ、黒魔術同好会の話、覚えてる？:
Hey, do you remember that we
talked about the Black Magic
Lovers Association？
translations.友達がね、何をするか決めたんだけど、それが結構面白そうなの。:
My friend had decided on the
group's activities. This is
interesting.
translations.ほら、魔女とかって、他人を自由に操ったりするじゃない。映画なんかで見たことない？:
Come on. Witches can use some
magic to manipulate people,
right？ We've seen that in
movies.
translations.ひょっとして……あれ？ あの、相手の目をじっと見て……。:
Something like... when they
stare into other people's
eyes...？
translations.そうそう、それ。それがチャームの術ね。:
Yeah, something like that.
That's the charm magic.
translations.地味なことやるんだね。魔術なんだから火の玉爆発させたり、雷落とすのかと思った。:
That's pretty boring. Speaking
of black magic, I'd think of
fireballs or thunderbolts.
translations.ゲームのやりすぎ！ そんな物騒なものより、チャームのほうが遙かにいいわよ。:
You play games too much！
Instead of those dangerous
things, charm magic is much
better.
translations.だって、他人の心を支配できるのよ。:
Yeah, because you'll be able
to control others' hearts.
translations.浮気されることも裏切られることもない完璧な恋人が作れる……なぁんてね。そんなの意:
You can have a perfect lover
who will never cheat or betray
you... Sort of. As if it would
really work. Hehe.
translations.友達が作ろうとしていた黒魔術同好会のことなんだけど……。:
About my friend's Black Magic
Lovers Association...
translations.やっぱりダメだったみたい。何考えてるんだって、先生に怒られたって。:
Seems like it's no good. The
teacher got mad and questioned
what she was thinking.
translations.まあ、そうだよな。: Well, not a surprise to me.
translations.でもね、演劇部の顧問の先生が興味を持ってくれたみたい。:
But another teacher who's the
drama club's advisor got
interested in the idea.
translations.うん。演劇って舞台で観客を魅了するわけでしょ。仕草とか、言葉遣いとか、そういうの:
Yeah. When you perform on
stage, you need to capture the
audience's attention, right？
Same goes to when you give a
speech.
translations.それが黒魔術とどう繋がるの？:
And how are they related to
black magic？
translations.だから、友達はチャームの研究しようとしてたじゃない。それを魔法とかそういうんじゃ:
That's the charm magic my
friend wanted to research,
right？ It can be put into use
that way.
translations.ということは、その友達は……？:
And how is your friend
now...？
translations.演劇部の演出担当になったの。ふふ。そのうち、教えてもらおうかな。:
She's now in charge of
directing drama club's plays.
Hehe. I wonder if she'll tell
me what she finds out.
translations.異性を魅了する方法をマスターして……あなたに試してみてもいい？:
If I could master how to
captivate a guy, would it be
okay that I tried it on you？
translations.ねえ、占いって信じる？:
Hey, do you believe in fortune
telling？
translations.まあ、それも占いだけど、もう少しロマンチックなものにして。例えば星占いとか。:
Well, that's one type of
fortune telling. But I mean
the more romantic ones, like
horoscope reading.
translations.ああ、朝のテレビとかでもよくやってるよね。:
Ah, they have something like
that on TV in the morning.
translations.そうそう。週刊誌とかでも占いコーナーは絶対必須だしね。:
Yeah. Also, all weekly
magazines have to have fortune
corner.
translations.うーん、どうかな。もちろん、同じ星座の人なんて、それこそたくさんいるんだから、全:
Hmm, I don't know. There are
so many people with the same
horoscopes. The fortune can't
be accurate for everyone.
translations.でも、少しは当たるんだ。:
But sometimes they are
accurate, right？
translations.どちらかというと……重要なのは、当たるとか外れるとかじゃないんだけどね。:
But in my opinion, I don't
care much whether the fortunes
are accurate or not.
translations.ああいうのを見ることで、強気になれたり、逆に自分を戒めたりできるでしょ。そこが大:
I use them to give myself
assurance, or warn myself to
be cautious. Sometimes I use
them to make excuses for
myself, too. Hehe.
translations.占いっていえばね、この学校にすごく当たる占い師がいるって知ってた？:
About fortune telling, do you
know that there's a very
accurate fortune teller in our
school？
translations.うん。秘かに評判になってるみたい。英語の野上っていう先生なんだけど知ってる？:
Yeah. She's very famous. Do
you know the English teacher
named Nogami？
translations.そっか。初めは生徒の相談に乗っている時にやっていたらしいんだけど、だんだん評判に:
Really？ At first, she did
fortune telling when the
students came to consult with
her. Gradually, she becomes
famous.
translations.ふーん。その先生は何で占うの？ 星占い？:
Hmm？ What does she use for
her fortune telling？
Horoscope？
translations.じゃなくて、タロットみたいね。生徒相談室の当番になっている時、頼むとやってくれる:
No. It seems like she uses
tarot cards. She does her
fortune telling when she's on
duty at the student counseling
room.
translations.ほら、知らない？ トランプの元になったカードで、王様とか僧侶とかの絵が描いてある:
Come on. You don't know what
they are？ They are cards with
picture of a king or a monk
drawn on them.
translations.ああ、そういえば見たことある。で、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は占ってもらったの？:
Ah, I think I've seen them
before. But, do you want her
to read your fortune too,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.まだ。占ってもらいたいとは思うんだけど……あんまり当たる人だとちょっと怖いから。:
Not now. I was thinking about
it... But many people say that
her reading is accurate, so
I'm a bit scared.
translations.恋愛運を占ってもらって、もし……なんてことがあったら嫌だから、ね。:
What if she says that my love
fortune is bad...？ I really
don't want to hear that.
translations.この間ね、野上先生のところに行ってみたの。:
The other day, I went to see
Nogami-sensei.
translations.野上先生というと……占いが得意な先生だっけ。:
Nogami-sensei...？ The teacher
who's good at reading
fortune？
translations.それがね……実はカードが引けなかったの。:
Well... I couldn't draw any
card.
translations.えーと、それはつまり、占ってもらわなかったってこと？:
Hmm？ That means you didn't
get your fortune read？
translations.タロットっていうのは、心を落ち着かせてからカードを引くんだけど……私、それができ:
For tarot cards, you need to
be calm when you draw a
card... I just couldn't do
that.
translations.先生に心に迷いがあるって言われちゃった。それだと占っても、また迷っちゃうからダメ:
The teacher said that I had
doubts. Even if she read my
fortune, it'd make me feel
more confused, so she
wouldn't.
translations.へえ……結構本格的なことを言うんだね。:
Hmm？ That's a typical advice,
huh？
translations.どんな結果であっても受け入れる覚悟がないと引いちゃいけないんだって。なかなかそこ:
She said that I wasn't
prepared to acknowledge the
result, so I couldn't draw the
card. And we stopped like
that...
translations.どうしたの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、嬉しそうだね。:
What is it,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
You seem very happy.
translations.あのね、この間、とうとう野上先生に占ってもらったの。:
Well, I finally got my fortune
read by Nogami-sensei.
translations.結果はね……ラヴァーズの正位置。:
The result is... I got "The
Lovers" card.
translations.ふふ。教えてあげない。気になるなら、タロットの本を見て。:
Hehe. I won't tell you. If you
want to know, you can read a
tarot reading book.
translations.えー、そんなのないよ、教えてよ。:
Eh？ But I don't have such a
book. Tell me.
translations.……もう、わかってないなあ。:
...Geez. You really don't
understand a thing.
translations.つまりね、私の口から直接言うのは……ってこと。だから本を読んで。ね？:
It's something I can't say
directly... So you have to
read it from the book, okay？
translations.そういえば、あの出向店員の人、最近元気ないよね。:
By the way, the store
assistant who was just
transferred to our restaurant
didn't look happy lately.
translations.え、あのモミアゲが長い人？:
Eh？ You mean the one with
long sideburns？
translations.そうそう、妙にモミアゲが長い人。何かあったのかな。:
Yeah, the one with those weird
sideburns. I wonder what
happened to him.
translations.どうもね、付き合ってた彼女に振られたみたいなの。:
I heard that he was dumped by
his girlfriend.
translations.それがね、ずいぶんひどい振られ方したみたいで、ショックから立ち直れないみたいなの:
And I heard it was a cruel
break up and he took it pretty
badly. He still can't gain his
footing.
translations.それで、仕事の方にも、あんまり身が入らないみたい。:
That's why he's been
absent-minded during work.
translations.だから、今度シフトが同じになった時、フォローしてあげた方がいいかなって。:
So, next time you have to work
with him, you must watch out
for him too.
translations.なるほど……うん、注意してみる。:
I see... Okay, I'll keep that
in mind.
translations.そういえば出向社員のモミアゲさん、見た？:
By the way, did you see that
assistant with sideburns？
translations.見た。びっくりしたよ。: I did and I was surprised.
translations.あんなに長かったモミアゲを、きれいに剃ってきちゃうなんてね……。:
He used to have long
sideburns, but now he shaved
them off...
translations.●なんか、最初誰だかわからなくて、新人さんかと思っちゃったよ。:
At first, I couldn't recognize
him. I thought he was a new
employee.
translations.そこまで変わってないと思うけど……。:
I don't think he had changed
that much...
translations.でも、どういう心境の変化なんだろ？:
But why did he decide to do
that？
translations.話してるところ、偶然聞いちゃったんだけど、傷心から立ち直るためにバッサリやってみ:
I accidentally heard it while
he was chatting with others.
He was heartbroken so he
wanted to give himself a fresh
start.
translations.モミアゲを剃って新しい自分に生まれ変わった気分ですよ……なんて言ってたけど、ちょ:
He felt like he was reborn as
a new person after he shaved
his sideburns. ...That sounded
like a reckless decision to
me.
translations.それで店長がね、モミアゲが生え替わった頃には、傷ついた心も癒えているだろうって励:
The manager tried to cheer him
up by saying that when his
sideburn grew again, the wound
in his heart would slowly be
cured.
translations.結局、また伸ばすんだね、モミアゲ……。:
So, he'll grow his sideburns
again, huh...？
translations.そういえば最近、お店で“ナポリさん”見ないね。:
By the way, I haven't seen
"Mr. Napoli" at our restaurant
lately.
translations.あ、知らない？ お店の常連で、毎日必ずナポリタンを頼むお客様、いるでしょ？:
Ah, you don't know him？
There's a regular customer who
always orders Napolitan every
time, right？
translations.ああ、あの人。そういえば最近、見てないような……。:
Ah, that guy. Yeah, I haven't
seen him lately...
translations.そうなの。やっぱり、他のお店に行っちゃったのかな？:
Is that so？ Maybe he goes to
a different restaurant now.
translations.単にナポリタンに飽きただけなんじゃないかな？:
He might get bored of eating
Napolitan, right？
translations.ううん、それは絶対無い。彼のナポリタンに対する情熱は本物よ。:
No, that can't be the reason.
His passion for Napolitan is
real.
translations.だって１年以上、ずーっとうちのナポリタン、食べ続けてたのよ？ いまさら飽きたりす:
He's been eating our Napolitan
for over a year now. He can't
just get bored of it suddenly,
right？
translations.１年以上って……それは確かに飽きるとかいうレベルの問題じゃないよね……。:
Over a year...？ I think that
has passed the point where he
could get bored of it,
huh...？
translations.でしょう？ うーん、どうしちゃったのかな……？:
You think so, too？ Yeah, I
wonder what happened to him...
translations.そうだ、ねぇ聞いて。この前ね、あのナポリさんがやっとデキシーズに帰ってきたの。:
Ah, yeah. Did you know？
Earlier, Mr. Napoli has
returned to Dixie's.
translations.ああ。ナポリタンばかり食べ続けてたお客様……。:
Ah, the customer who always
orders Napolitan, right？
translations.うん、それでなにを頼んだと思う？:
Yeah. And guess what he
ordered this time.
translations.じゃあ、人違いだったんじゃない？:
Hey, could it be that you got
the wrong person？
translations.ううん。みんな、顔はよく覚えてたから、間違いないって。:
No, everyone remembered him.
It couldn't be the wrong
person.
translations.へぇ……じゃあ、好みが変わったんだね。人間だから、そういうこともあるよね。:
Eh...？ Then his favorite dish
has changed. I think it's just
common that people change
their mind, huh？
translations.……あなたにそういうこと言われれると、すごく不安になるんだけど……やっぱり飽きち:
...To hear you say that, I'm
feeling very insecure now...
Are you going to get bored of
me？
translations.た、食べ物の話ね……。:
B-But we were talking about
food...
translations.そういえば新しいメニュー、ちゃんと覚えた？:
By the way, have you
remembered the new menus？
translations.もぅ……覚えないとダメって教えたこと、忘れちゃった？:
Geez... You must remember
them, okay？ Did you forget
what I taught you？
translations.少なくとも消えたメニューは大急ぎで覚えること。そうじゃないと、お客様が注文してき:
At least you must remember
what dishes were taken off.
It'd cause problems if you
took those orders from the
customers.
translations.でも、機械に入力する時、無いこと、わかるわけだし……。:
But, when we key those items
into the machine, we'll know
that they are no longer
available...
translations.だーめ。そういう時って、使い方、間違ったかもって何度もやりなおしちゃうでしょ？:
No. If you wait until then,
you'd have to go back to take
the orders again, right？
translations.無駄にお客様を待たせちゃうってこと？:
You mean the customers will
have to wait longer？
translations.よくできました。もたもたしちゃうとお店の評判に関わるから、ね？:
It's very good that you
remembered. If the service is
slow, it'll affect customer
satisfaction, okay？
translations.うん……まずいな、急いで覚えないと……。:
Yeah... That'd be bad. I'll
have to try to remember the
new menus...
translations.デキシーズのメニュー、新しいのに変わってから少し経ったけど……もう覚えたよね？:
The menus at Dixie's have been
changed for quite a while.
Have you remembered them？
translations.ふふ。そうこなくちゃ。元指導係としては成長が気になっちゃうから。:
Hehe. That's good. As your
former supervisor, I feel like
you've grown up.
translations.でも覚えることが次々と出てきて……デキシーズって、バイトに期待しすぎてない？:
But the list of things to
remember keeps piling up.
...We're only working
part-time. Does Dixie's expect
too much from us？
translations.んー、そうかな？ 私はそう思わないけど……。:
Hmm？ Really？ I don't think
so...
translations.他のバイトでも同じような感じなのかな？:
I wonder if it's the same if I
work at a different place.
translations.どうかな？ でも、働いてお金をもらうのって、そういうことなんじゃないかな？:
I don't know. But if they pay
you to work, at least you have
to work hard for them, right？
translations.バイトでこれだと、社会人になったらどうなるんだろ……。:
If this is how I feel when I
work part-time, I wonder how
it'll be for my real job...
translations.ふふ。私、しばらくは共働きするつもりだから、お給料の安い仕事でも平気よ？:
Hehe. I don't mind working to
earn more money for our
family. You don't have to
worry much about your salary.
translations.そうだ。店長がね、今度入る新人、あなたに任せたいって言ってたわよ？:
Ah, right. The manager
mentioned that he'd have you
take care of the new employee.
translations.それって、●が指導係に!?:
So, I'll have to give the new
employee guidance！？
translations.ふふ。私としては、ちょっと心配かな？:
Hehe, I'm a bit worried about
that.
translations.そりゃあ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が●にしたみたいに、うまく教える自信は……。:
Well...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you think I can
guide anyone...？
translations.大丈夫だって。私だって、最初は不安だったんだから。:
You'll be fine. When I had to
guide you, I was also nervous
at first.
translations.うん。だから……そうだ。指導係の指導係、してあげよっか。:
Yeah. So... Right！ Should I
guide you how to guide
others？
translations.新人くんの指導、けっこううまくいってるみたいだね。:
It seems like everything is
going well with you and the
new employee.
translations.やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお陰……かな？:
That's thanks to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think.
translations.そう？ 私、大したことしてないと思うけど……。:
Really？ I didn't do anything
much for you...
translations.●が教わってた時のこと、いろいろと思い出しながらやってるから……さ。:
When I teach the new guy, I'm
trying to recall how you
taught me...
translations.ふふ。それってつまり……手取り足取り教えてるってことかな？:
Hehe... Which means you're
teaching him attentively,
right？
translations.覚えてない？ 食器洗浄機の使い方、教えた時とか……。:
Do you remember when I taught
you how to wash the
tableware...
translations.新人は男だし、近づいて手取り足取りってのは……。:
The new employee is a guy.
It's not good for me to teach
him closely like that...
translations.……もし女の子だったら、やってた？:
...If he were a girl, you'd do
that？
translations.やらないし、やれないよ。●には、もう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいるんだから……。:
I wouldn't. No, I mean I
couldn't. I already have
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.そうだ。この前、外国人のお客様が来たことあったけど、覚えてる？:
Ah, yeah. Earlier, there was a
foreign customer at our
restaurant. Do you remember
him？
translations.んー、いつのこと？ うちのお店って、外国人の常連さんもいるし……。:
Hmm... When was it？ There are
many foreign customers at our
restaurant...
translations.うん。あんまり目立たないけど、月に何度か家族連れでくるお客様がいるの。:
Yeah. They aren't very
conspicuous. But there are
customers who take their
family to our restaurant many
times a month.
translations.へぇ、意外と国際的なんだ。デキシーズって。:
Eh？ Dixie's is like an
international restaurant then.
translations.ふふ。それで、なにがあったの？:
Hehe. Anyway, why did you
bring this up？
translations.うん。そういう時、できれば英語で対応するべきなのかなって。“いらっしゃいませ”と:
Right. At that time, I was
hesitating if I should greet
him in English instead of
Japanese.
translations.どうかな？ 必ず英語を使う国の人だとは限らないし……。:
Well, not all foreigners speak
English...
translations.そっか……んー、あのお客様って、日本語、すごく上手かったからな……。:
That's true... Hmm, but that
customer could speak Japanese
fluently...
translations.そういうところに気を配れるようになってきたんだ……。ふふ、ちょっと嬉しいかな。:
You even paid that much
attention to the customer？
Hehe. I think I should be
happy about this.
translations.あ、そうだ。レストランなんかでは“ハロー”だけでいいみたい。:
Ah, right. I think it might be
okay to greet customers with
"Hello" at our restaurant.
translations.“いらっしゃいませ”を英語で言うとどうなるか。:
We say "Irasshaimase" to
customers, right？ How can we
translate it to English then？
translations.あ……前に話した外国人のお客様の話？ 調べてくれたんだ。:
Ah... We talked about foreign
customers earlier. So you've
been thinking about it.
translations.でも普通は“メイ・アイ・ヘルプ・ユゥ？”じゃなかったっけ。:
But I think it's more common
to greet them with "May I help
you？"
translations.うん、飲食店ではもっと軽く、挨拶だけなんだって“グッド・アフタヌーン”みたいに。:
Yeah. But at a restaurant,
maybe we should greet them
less formally. Like, "Good
afternoon."
translations.でもね、やっぱり日本語で“いらっしゃいませ”が一番じゃないかな。:
But I think I like to greet
customers with "Irasshaimase"
best.
translations.“あなたは日本語わからないでしょ？”って感じで失礼かも、日本語わかる人も多いんだ:
If we use English, it's like
we're thinking that they don't
understand Japanese. Many
foreigners can speak Japanese
well.
translations.それに中途半端に英語で対応して、英語話せる店員だって思われても、困るでしょ？:
And if we speak to them in
English, it'd cause troubles
to other employees who can't
speak English, right？
translations.ううん。バイト中のこと思い出しただけ。ほら、前に子供連れのお客様が来た時……。:
Nothing. I'm just thinking
about work. There was that
time when the parents brought
their kids...
translations.あの子たち、あなたの後について真似てばっかりいたよね。:
Those kids were following you
and imitating your moves.
translations.よっぽど●の動きが面白かったんだろうね……はぁ。:
They must think that I was
funny... Hah...
translations.ふふ。落ち込まないの。子供に好かれたってことでしょ？:
Hehe. Don't feel down. At
least the kids liked you,
okay？
translations.私は子供に好かれる人のほうが、嫌われる人よりずっと素敵だと思うけどなぁ。:
I think it's a wonderful thing
that kids like you.
translations.そういわれると……うーん、悪くなかったのかな？:
If you say so... Hmm... I
think it's not bad then.
translations.なに？ 急に笑いだしたりして……。:
What？ Why do you laugh all of
a sudden...？
translations.ごめん。バイト中のこと思い出して、ほら前に▲姉ヶ崎＊▲から離れなかった男の子。:
Sorry. I'm thinking about
what happened at work.
There was that kid who
didn't want to leave
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あぁ……あの男の子、可愛かったなぁ。:
Ah... That boy. He was so
cute.
translations.うん。お母さんはトイレで赤ん坊のおむつ、かえてたんだよね。:
Yeah, his mother went to the
restroom to change her baby's
diaper.
translations.でも、あの男の子、なんで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のスカート掴んで離れなかったのかな？:
And then that boy
somehow grabbed
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
skirt and wouldn't
let go of it.
translations.ふふ。男の子って、お母さんに甘えたいものでしょ？:
Hehe. Boys always like to
behave like a spoiled kid in
front of their mothers.
translations.それって……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がお母さんに見えたってこと？:
But... Does
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
look like his mother？
translations.もぅ……お姉さんならともかく、お母さんはないでしょ。:
Geez... I think he thought of
me as his older sister, not
his mother.
translations.あ、デキシーズが新しいお店出すって話、聞いてる？:
Ah, have you heard about
Dixie's new branch？
translations.ううん、初耳。どこに？:
No, this is the first time I
hear that. Where will it be？
translations.それがね、私たちのお店のすぐ近くになるみたい。:
Well, it's gonna be right next
to the one we're working at.
translations.それって……下手したらうちと競合しない？:
That means... It's going to be
our rival？
translations.ほら、うちって売り上げもいいし、シフトも自由に変えられるぐらい人も多いでしょ？:
Come on. Our branch sells well
and us employees have freedom
to choose our work shifts,
right？
translations.でも、もう１店舗増やすほどの人は余裕は……新規で募集もするんだろうけど……。:
But if there's a new branch,
they'll be hiring new people,
too...
translations.私もそう思うんだけど、本社が乗り気みたいで……店長も困ってるみたい。:
Yeah, I'm worried about that,
too. But the headquarters seem
to want to expand the
business... Our manager is in
trouble.
translations.そうなんだ……店長、あんなに頑張ってるのに……。:
Yeah... Our manager has really
been working hard...
translations.会社的には問題かもしれないけど……新店舗の話、なくなるといいよね……。:
If it's going to impact us, I
wish they would cancel this
new branch...
translations.今のお店の近くに新店舗ができるかもしれないって話があったでしょ？:
We were talking about the new
branch, whether they'd build
it or not, right？
translations.よしっ！ 店長もこれで一安心だね。:
Yeah！ Now, our manager can
feel relieved.
translations.何より私たちも安心だね。:
Rather, it's us who should
feel relieved.
translations.え、ひょっとしたら、２つの店舗で離ればなれになっちゃうかもしれないじゃない。……:
Eh？ If they built a new
branch, we might have to work
at different places. You
didn't think about that？
translations.もぉ、私はすっごく心配してたのに……。:
Geez, I've been worried all
this time...
translations.ごめん……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にいられないなんて、想像もつかなかった。:
Sorry... I've never thought
about not being together with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
at all.
translations.そういえば……最近ね、デキシーズに中学生の女の子、よく来ると思わない？:
By the way... Lately, there
are those junior high school
girls who often come to
Dixie's, right？
translations.言われてみれば……塾の帰りみたいだよね、なんとなくだけど。:
I think they just stop by
after their prep school.
translations.あの子たちのお目当て、あなただって気づいてる？:
They come because of you.
Didn't you realize that？
translations.仕方ないよねぇ。あなたってカッコいいし、可愛いし、ちょっと抜けてるけど、いざとい:
It can't be helped. You're so
cool and so cute. You get
clumsy at times, but you're
usually reliable at a crucial
moment.
translations.私、すごく不安なんだから……信じてるけど、やっぱり……ね？:
I feel very uneasy about
this... I trust you, but I
don't feel good about it...
okay？
translations.大丈夫だって。●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲一筋だからさ。:
It'll be okay. I have only
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.……うん。わかってる。でもちょっとだけ不安なんだってこと、覚えておいてね？:
...Yeah, I know. But I still
feel uneasy about it. So you
should keep that in mind,
okay？
translations.ところで……告白された？:
By the way... Someone
confessed to you, right？
translations.だから……ほら、お店に来るようになった中学生の女の子たち。:
Come on... There were those
junior high school girls who
often came to our restaurant.
translations.ああ、あの子たち……でも最近、来てないでしょ？:
Ah, those girls... But they
didn't come anymore, right？
translations.●が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と付き合ってるって、言っておいたから……かな？:
I told them that I'm dating
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
That's probably why...
translations.だって、付き合ってる人、いますかって聞かれたから……迷惑だった？:
Because they asked me if I was
already dating someone... Does
this cause you trouble？
translations.ううん。ただ……えっと……ちゃんと、カノジョだって、言ってくれた？:
No, it's just... Well... Did
you tell them that I'm your
girlfriend？
translations.ふふ、そういうことなら、どんなことでも許しちゃう。ふふ。:
Hehe. If you're like this, no
matter what you did, I can
always forgive you. Hehe.
translations.そういえば店長がデキシーズの制服、変わるかも知れないって言ってたけど……。:
By the way, the manager said
that the uniforms at Dixie's
might be changed...
translations.うん、そうみたいだけど……多分、変わらないんじゃないかな？:
Yeah, I heard that, too.
...But I'm not sure about the
change.
translations.もしかして新コスチュームのデザイン画、まだ見てない？:
So you haven't seen the
designs for the new uniforms？
translations.店長から話を聞いただけだから……へぇ、デザイン画もできてるんだ。:
I only heard about it from the
manager... Eh？ They even have
the designs ready？
translations.男性用はいいのよ。今とそんなに変わってないから。:
It's okay for male uniforms.
Nothing has changed much.
translations.……もしかして女性用がすごい？:
...Which means there's a big
change for female uniforms？
translations.うーん……見せる相手があなただけなら考えてもいいんだけどなぁ……。:
Hmm... If I only have to wear
it in front of you, I might
think about it...
translations.ふふ。あなたがどうしてもっていうなら、私も賛成しちゃおっかな？:
Hehe. If you insist that I
should wear it, I might try to
approve the new designs.
translations.あ、そうそう。デキシーズの新しい制服、没になったって話、聞いてる？:
Ah, right. Did you know that
the designs for Dixie's new
uniforms were rejected？
translations.もちろん。●、反対したから。:
Yeah. I also voted "No" for
those designs.
translations.ふふ……じゃあ、あのデザイン画、見せてもらったんだ。:
Hehe... So you've already seen
the designs, huh？
translations.いくらなんでも、あんなに布が少ない制服……もうファミレスじゃないよ、あれだと。:
If you have to wear a uniform
that short, our restaurant
won't be called family
restaurant anymore.
translations.実は私、サンプルを預かっています。今なら家で見せてあげられるよ？:
Actually, I have a sample of
those uniforms. I'm thinking
about trying it on and showing
it to you at my house.
translations.うっそでーす。ふふ。そんなに本気にされると、自作しちゃうぞ？:
Just kidding. Hehe. If you're
serious about it like that, I
should really get a sample,
huh？
translations.やっぱりカレシとしては、他の人に見られないなら……。:
As your boyfriend, I don't
want anyone else to see you
wearing it...
translations.もぅ……本当に冗談なんだから、ね？:
Geez... I told you I was just
kidding, okay？
translations.もう、デキシーズでのバイトも当たり前になってきた？:
Have you got used to working
at Dixie's yet？
translations.うん。でも、緊張感は忘れないようにしてるから。何度も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に注意されたから:
Yeah. I always keep
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
words in mind that I
shouldn't be so nervous.
translations.ふふ、さすがはうちで一番の有望株、だね。:
Hehe. As expected from our
restaurant's most promising
employee.
translations.店長もそう言ってるよ？ もし就職活動中の大学生なら、間違いなく正社員にするって。:
The manager said that, you
know？ He even said that if
you need a job after you
graduate, he'd hire you
full-time.
translations.お世辞だよ、それ。●なんてまだまだ……。:
That was flattery. I'm still
not that good...
translations.ううん、私から見てもしっかりしてるよ？ ほら、もっと自信持たなきゃ。:
No, I can see that you're very
reliable at work. Come on.
Have confidence in yourself.
translations.ふふ。そういう謙虚なところも、ポイントが高い理由なんだよ？:
Hehe. Modesty is one of your
good points.
translations.教えてくれた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだけ思うけど……。:
It's all thanks to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
for training me well...
translations.そういえばさ……ほら、前に店長が●のこと高く評価してくれているって言ったよね。:
By the way... Earlier, you
mentioned that the manager
gave me high evaluation for my
work, right？
translations.うん。なにか言われた？:
Yeah, did he say something to
you？
translations.店長、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことも褒めてたよ。すごく頼りになるって。:
The manager also praised
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
for being very reliable.
translations.そんなこと言って……無理矢理、そう言わせたんでしょ？:
For him to say that... Did you
force him to say it somehow？
translations.そんなことないよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、バイトの面倒、一手に引き受けてくれるから助かるっ:
I didn't. He trusted you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
that you can handle
everything. He mentioned that
you've been very helpful to
him.
translations.そっか……でも私としては、店長の評価よりあなたの評価が気になる……かな？:
I see... But I'm more
concerned about what he thinks
about you more than what he
thinks about me... somehow.
translations.ううん。うちの店長は口がうまいって。そう思わない？:
Nothing. I think our manager
is honey-tongued.
translations.うん。でも●としては▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が褒められて嬉しかったかな。:
Yeah, but I'm really happy
to hear him praise
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あ、クロちゃん……なはずないか。そうだよね。:
Ah, that's Kuro-chan... isn't
it？ I think it is.
translations.あれ？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、猫飼ってたっけ？:
Eh？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you have a cat？
translations.ううん。デキシーズの裏口によく野良猫が来るの。見たことない？:
No. It's the stray cat that's
usually around the back
entrance of Dixie's. Haven't
you seen it？
translations.そういえばゴミ捨ての時、時々見かけるな。:
I think I've seen it sometimes
when I took the trash out.
translations.裏口の近くって、あんまり人目に付かないし、日溜まりもあるからだと思うんだけど。:
There usually aren't any
people at the back entrance
and there are some sunny spots
for the cats.
translations.ああ、そういえば季節に関係なく猫がいるよね。:
Ah, that's why there are
always some cats around that
area.
translations.クロちゃんはね、野良猫のボスなの。体は小さいのに、みんな遠慮するのよ？:
Kuro-chan is the stray cats'
boss. It's so small but other
cats are afraid of it.
translations.へぇ……それだけ喧嘩に強いのかな？:
Huh...？ Maybe it's very
strong when it fights.
translations.喧嘩してるところ、見たことないけど……ふふ、今度クロちゃんに聞いてみようかな。:
I've never seen it fights
though... Hehe. I'd better ask
Kuro-chan next time.
translations.デキシーズ周辺の野良猫のボスだよね。●も前、見たよ。:
The stray cats' boss at
Dixie's？ I also saw him
earlier.
translations.野良猫のボスなのに？: But it's the stray cats' boss.
translations.意外でしょ？ お店の近くにある家におばあさんと一緒に入っていくところ、偶然見かけ:
Surprising, right？ I
accidentally saw it with an
old lady who lives at the
house near Dixie's.
translations.すごく可愛かったんだから。仔猫みたいにじゃれついてて。:
It was acting very cute, like
a little kitten, in front of
her.
translations.へぇ……ボスも飼い主には甘えるんだ。:
Huh...？ Even the boss also
behaves itself in front of its
owner.
translations.私もそうしたいなぁ。: I want to do that too.
translations.たまにはね、思う存分、誰かに甘えてみたいなぁ……って。:
Sometimes, I want someone to
act cute like that to me
too...
translations.えっと……うん。●でよければ……。:
Umm... Well, if I'm good
enough for you...
translations.ねぇ、カエルのお財布って、最近、流行ってるのかな？:
Hey, the frog purses are quite
popular lately, right？
translations.えっ？ カエルって……がま口のこと？:
Eh？ You mean purses that look
like a frog...？
translations.うん。ほら、最近、忘れ物に多いでしょ？ 小銭しか入らない小さいがま口。:
Yeah. They are very small so
people often lose them. They
can only hold coins.
translations.そういえば……でも、流行ってるのかな？ 聞いたことないけど。:
I think I've seen them... But,
I don't know if they're
popular or not. I've never
heard of them though.
translations.そっちの学年でも流行ってないの？:
So, they are not popular among
people in your grade, huh？
translations.男子では特に。女子は……どうかな？ あんまり親しい女の子もいないし。:
Not among the guys, but I
don't know about the girls. I
don't have any girls I'm close
to.
translations.授業で同じグループになった時に話す程度……かな？:
I only talk to them if we work
in the same group during
classes... That's all.
translations.そうかな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいたら、自然にそうなるよ。:
Really？ Since I already have
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think that's natural.
translations.そっか……うん、わかってる。: I see... Okay, I got it.
translations.年下のカレシって、周りの女の子から羨ましがられるんだけど……。:
Many girls envy me for having
a younger boyfriend, but...
translations.どうしたの急に。:
Why do you mention this all of
a sudden？
translations.……正直に言うけど、やっぱり不安なの。あなたに誰かが迫るんじゃないかって。:
...To tell you the truth, I'm
quite worried. When some girls
got close to you...
translations.ないない。全然ないから。バイト中も……あ、カエルの財布のこと、覚えてる？:
No, no. Nothing will ever
happen. Even at work... Ah, do
you remember the frog purse？
translations.忘れ物のこと？:
The one that the customer
forgot？
translations.うん、それ。あれの持ち主、ほとんどが主婦だったって聞いてる？:
Yeah. And did you know that
its owner is a housewife？
translations.あ……うん。そういえばあなた、おばさまからも大人気だよね。:
Ah, right... Speaking of
which, you're quite popular
among old women, huh？
translations.あれは遊ばれてるというか……●って迫られるってより遊ばれるほうが多くない？:
They get close to me because
they just enjoy teasing me, I
think.
translations.それに●は、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことが好きなんだから、誰に迫られても関係ないよ。:
But I already have
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
so it doesn't matter who
gets close to me, right？
translations.……ふふ。そこまで言われちゃったら、納得するしかないよ。ずるいなぁ、もぅ。:
...Hehe. If you say that, I
have no choice but to trust
you. You're so crafty. Geez.
translations.うん。毎年思うんだけど、一年の抱負って少し経つと忘れてしまうものでしょ？:
Well, I'm thinking about my
New Year resolution. We
usually forget about it soon
after New Year's Day, right？
translations.だから毎年、忘れない抱負にしようって考えるのよ。:
Every year, I try to come up
with a resolution that I must
not forget.
translations.でもね、絶対に忘れない抱負って、どういうものなのか全然わからないの。:
But then, I can't decide which
resolution I should choose to
be the one that I must not
forget.
translations.絶対に忘れない抱負かぁ。:
The resolution that you must
not forget？
translations.そうでしょ？ だから私、悩んでるうちに春になることが多いのよ。:
Right？ So I often have
troubles deciding my
resolution until spring.
translations.はぁ……今年はどうしようかしら？:
Hah... I wonder how it's going
to be this year.
translations.ねぇ、昔から不思議なんだけど……。:
Hey, I've been thinking that
it's weird...
translations.幼稚園で節分に、オニのお面とか作らなかった？:
Did you have to make a demon
mask for Setsubun festival
when you were in
kindergarten？
translations.それでなんだけど……豆もまくでしょ？ 鬼は外～って。:
That's the thing... Then you
threw beans at the demon,
right？ Like, "Demon, go
away~"
translations.うん。節分だし。:
Yeah. That's what we did on
Setsubun.
translations.でも、豆をまくのは鬼じゃないでしょ？ どうして全員で鬼のお面とか作るのかな？:
But, the ones throwing the
beans can't be the demon,
right？ So why does everyone
have to make a demon mask,
then？
translations.ね？ 全員で鬼になるわけじゃないのに、全員で鬼のお面を作るって、不思議でしょ？:
Hey, do you think it's weird
that everyone has to make a
demon mask while no one
becomes demon？
translations.うん、言われてみれば確かに。:
Well, when you say it like
that, I agree.
translations.ねぇ……男の子って、手の込んだプレゼントを重いって思うこと、あるよね？:
Hey... Do you think it's too
much for a boy if he has to
carry a lot of presents？
translations.●は素直にうれしいかな。:
I think I'll be really happy
with that.
translations.ううん、こっちの話。なんでもないから、気にしないで。:
No, I was talking to myself.
It's nothing, so don't worry.
translations.うふ。じゃあ、甘いものは甘いものでも、何か好きな甘いものとかある？:
Hehe. Then it's gonna be
something sweet. What kinds of
sweets do you like？
translations.うーん。特にこれというのは無いかな？:
Hmm. I don't think I have any
preference.
translations.男の子ってビター味が好きな人とかよくいるけど、そのあたりはどうかな？:
Many boys like dark chocolate.
How about that？
translations.もぅ、少しはヒントぐらいくれてもいいじゃない。:
Geez. Can you at least give me
a hint？
translations.そろそろバレンタインだけど何か欲しいものある？:
It's almost Valentine's Day.
Is there something you want？
translations.うーん……チョコが貰えればそれだけで嬉しいかな？:
Hmm... If you give me a
chocolate, I'll be very happy.
translations.他のものでもいいのよ？:
You can ask for something
else, too.
translations.だから、食べ物ならチョコでなくてもいいし……服とか靴とか、そういうものでも。:
Like, some desserts other than
chocolate... or even some
clothes, or shoes.
translations.うーん……でも、せっかくのバレンタインなんだし、やっぱりチョコかな？:
Hmm... But it's Valentine's
Day, after all. A chocolate
would be best.
translations.思いついたら言ってね。私、あなたにプレゼントすることが嬉しいんだから。:
If you think of something
else, tell me, okay？ I'll be
happy to give you any
presents.
translations.そろそろお雛様ね。ようやく春が来るって気がしない？:
It's almost time to put the
dolls on decoration. Do you
feel like spring's coming
soon？
translations.なんとなく、わかる気もするってぐらいかな。:
No. I just didn't get what you
mean at first.
translations.私の家、昔から２日の夜にバタバタしながらお雛様を飾るの。:
At my house, we're always busy
setting up the dolls display
two nights before the
festival.
translations.ふふ。箱はもう少し前に出しておくんだけど、飾り付けが後回しになっちゃって。:
Hehe. We take the dolls' boxes
out beforehand, but we usually
leave the boxes there after
we're done with the dolls.
translations.だから、前日までは部屋が木箱だらけだから少し殺風景なんだけど……。:
The room will look a bit
untidy for a while with all
the boxes in it...
translations.当日になるとお雛様が飾られて、家の中がパーッと、華やいだ感じになるの。:
On the festival day when we
decorate the doll, the room
will suddenly look brilliant.
translations.ああ、だから春なんだ。:
Ah, that's why you feel like
spring's coming.
translations.ええ。だから私、お雛様を見ないと冬が終わってくれないの。:
Yes. For me, until I see the
dolls on decoration, I don't
feel like winter's over yet.
translations.そういえばもうすぐホワイトデーだけど……。:
By the way, it's almost White
Day, but...
translations.いいのよ、別に。私はあなたと一緒に居るだけで充分なんだから。:
It's okay. If you can be with
me, that's enough already.
translations.ううん、本当にいいの。それに……ほら……。:
No, it's really okay. And...
Come on...
translations.だから……私以外の女の子へのお返しとか、あるんでしょ？:
Besides me... do you have to
give other girls return gifts,
too？
