Just normal stuff, like
reading books, or watching
DVDs, or studying.
translations.ちゃんと勉強してるんだ。:
So you really spend time
studying, huh？
translations.宿題ぐらいよ？ 毎日きっちり予習復習、なんてことまではやってないもの。:
Just doing my homework,
though. I don't really spend
much time reviewing lessons
and stuff.
translations.ふふ。もしかしてなにか想像してたの？:
Hehe. Is that different from
your imagination？
translations.うん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことだから家事全般、なんでもこなしてるイメージがちょっと。:
Yeah. I imagined that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
would be busy with housework
and stuff.
translations.あ、うん……それ、当たりかも。: Ah, hmm... I also do that.
translations.昔から料理も掃除も好きだったし、最近はずっと手伝うのが普通になってるの。:
I've always liked cooking and
cleaning, so it's natural for
me to help with household
chores at home.
translations.やっぱりそうなんだ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、そういうの似合うもんね。:
Exactly as I thought.
Something like that suits
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
best.
translations.ふふ。そんなこと言ってると、遠回しのプロポーズと勘違いしちゃうわよ？:
Hehe. If you say something
like that, I could mistake it
as your proposal, you know？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、家ではいつもなにしてるの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What do you do when you stay
home？
translations.たいてい部屋で本読んでるかな？\nあとＤＶＤと古いビデオ。\nもちろん映画のね。:
Usually, I stay in my room
reading books or watching DVDs
or old videos. Of course, they
are movies.
translations.うん。小さいころはヤンチャだったけど、気がついたらこうなってたの。:
Yeah. I was mischievous as a
kid but I've changed somehow.
translations.へえ。ヤンチャな▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、ちょっと想像出来ないなあ。:
Huh？ Mischievous
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I can't picture that.
translations.ふふ、そうよね。私もそう思うし。:
Hehe. Right. I also think you
can't.
translations.じゃあ、あんまり連れ出したりしない方がいい？:
So, you probably don't like it
when I ask you to go out with
me？
translations.あなたと会うの、すっごく楽しいもの。こんなこと、ちょっとなかったし……。:
I'm really happy when we're
together, so I don't mind
going out with you...
translations.もっと、いっぱい連れ出して、いろんなとこ連れていってくれるほうが嬉しい……かな？:
I'll be really happy if you go
out with me and take me to
many places... I think.
translations.ほら、人によって寝起きがいい悪いってあるでしょ？ あなたはどっち？:
Well, people have different
sleeping and waking up habits,
right？ How's yours？
translations.寝起き？ んー、そうだなあ……。:
Sleeping and waking up habit？
Well...
translations.●は朝型だから: A man must get up early！
translations.割と強い方かな。寝起きもいいほうだし。:
I can get up easily. I usually
don't have any problem waking
up.
translations.そっか……こういうとこは、しっかりしてるのよね。:
I see... You don't have any
problem with it, huh？
translations.ううん、いいの。悪いことじゃないものね。:
No. It's good. It's not a bad
thing at all.
translations.うーん……やっぱり朝は、弱いほうかな？:
Hmm... I can barely get up in
the morning.
translations.じゃあ、目覚ましだけだと起きられなかったりする？:
Well, how about using an alarm
clock？ You still can't get
up？
translations.んー、けっこうヤバいこともあるかな。:
Yeah. Many times, that still
doesn't help.
translations.だったら、誰かに起こしてもらえたら助かるなぁとか思ったりする？:
Then do you think it'd be nice
if someone's there to wake you
up？
translations.うん。優しく起こして欲しいって思うことはあるよ。:
Yeah. I've imagined that
someone would wake me up
gently.
translations.うん、当然優しく起こす。ねえ早く起きてよう、とか。:
Hmm, if I wake you up gently,
you can wake up early in the
morning, right？
translations.（モーニングコールでもくれるのかな？）:
(Is she going to give me a
morning call or something？)
translations.こう見えて●、朝型人間だから平気なんだ。:
Even though I look like this,
I'm a morning person. So
there's no problem.
translations.え……じゃあ、夜は早く寝ちゃうの？:
Eh...？ Do you go to bed early
at night？
translations.特にそう決めてるわけでもないけど、朝の目覚めはいつもバッチリだね。:
Not really. But in the
morning, I just always wake up
very early.
translations.ううん、なんでもない。出番はなさそうね……。:
No, never mind. It's just not
my turn yet...
translations.実は夜型人間だから、朝は逆に弱いかな？:
Actually, I'm a nocturnal
person. I always have problem
waking up in the morning.
translations.誰かに起こしてもらわないと目を覚まさないとか？:
Like you can't get up unless
someone's there to wake you？
translations.んー、そうだね。たまに目覚ましが頼りなく感じる。:
Hmm, maybe so. I can't rely on
my alarm clock all the time.
translations.そうなんだ……じゃあ、手伝ってあげようかな、朝起きるの。:
I see... Let me help waking
you up in the morning then.
translations.ふふ。楽しみにしててね。:
Hehe. Just look forward to it
then.
translations.もぅ……カノジョが起こしてるのに、寝ちゃうつもり？:
Geez... Your girlfriend is
waking you up. Do you intend
to keep sleeping？
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? な、なんで●の部屋に!?:
Ah,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！？
W-Why are you in my room！？
translations.もう、ちゃんと言ったでしょ。起こしに来てあげるって。:
Hey, I already told you. I'm
here to wake you up.
translations.そうだっけ？ うわ、パジャマ見られた？:
Is that so？ Whoa, you saw me
in my pajamas.
translations.いまさら何言ってるの。ほら、早く支度しないと置いていくわよ、お寝坊さん。:
Isn't it too late to say that
now？ Hey, if you don't get
ready, I'll be leaving, you
sleepyhead.
translations.ううーん……もう少し寝かせて……。:
No... Let me sleep a little
more...
translations.ダメだよ……●には▲姉ヶ崎＊▲っていうカノジョが……。:
No, we can't do this... I
already have
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
as my girlfriend...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? 起こしに来てくれたんだ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！？
You're here to wake me up？
translations.そ。夢の中で浮気するような誰かさんでも、ちゃんと約束は守るよ？:
Yeah, and I'm wondering who
you were having an affair with
in your dream.
translations.夢？ ……忘れちゃった、ははは。:
My dream？ ...I can't remember
it. Hahaha.
translations.言い訳はじーっくり、あとで聞いてあげる。:
I'll listen to your excuse
later.
translations.ねえ、もう起きたほうがいいと思うんだけど。:
Hey, I think it's about time
you should wake up.
translations.学校に遅れるよ？ ね、起きて。:
You'll be late for school.
Hey, wake up.
translations.朝、起こしに来てあげるって約束したでしょ？ 忘れちゃった？:
I promised to wake you up in
the morning. Did you forget？
translations.さっ、お布団から出て……キャッ！:
Now, get out of your blanket.
...Kyaa！
translations.もう、服、ちゃんと着て？ だらしないよ？:
Hey, fix your clothes first.
They're falling down.
translations.（恥ずかしいとこ見られたな……）:
(She saw me in such an
embarrassing condition...)
translations.うん、おはよう。なんか……夫婦みたいだね……。:
Yeah, good morning. Somehow...
This feels as if we are a
married couple...
translations.ほら、そろそろ起きて。: Hey, it's time to get up.
translations.もぅ……起きないと、イタズラしちゃうよ？:
Geez... If you don't get up,
I'll start teasing you.
translations.おはよう。ふふ、早く支度して？ 朝ごはん抜きにしちゃうよ？:
'Morning. Hehe, hurry and get
ready, otherwise, you won't
have time for breakfast.
translations.ふふ、寝グセがついてるわよ。: Hehe, look at your bed hair.
translations.もぉ、しょうがないなぁ。私がいないと、ダメだね？:
Geez, you're so helpless. I
really have to be take care of
you, huh？
translations.ねえ。あなたが今、お腹空いてたりすると、嬉しいんだけど……。:
Hey, I'll be happy if you feel
hungry now...
translations.昼休みだし、空いてるけど、どうして？:
It's the lunch break. Of
course, I'm hungry. But, why？
translations.あのね……ふふ。今日、お弁当作ってきたの。:
Well... Hehe... I made a lunch
box today.
translations.もしかして……●に？:
Could it be that... you made
it for me？
translations.カノジョのお手製弁当かぁ……感激だな。:
My girlfriend's homemade lunch
box, huh...？ I'm so
impressed.
translations.もう……そんなに大げさなものじゃないからね？:
Geez... You don't have to
exaggerate.
translations.おっ、うまそう。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、ほんとに家庭的なんだな。:
Oh, looks delicious.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is very family-oriented, huh？
translations.食べてみて。あと……味付け、これでいいか教えて欲しい……かな？:
You try it and let me know
whether you like how it
tastes, okay？
translations.うん。味もバッチリ。こういう薄味、好きなんだ。:
Okay, the taste is perfect. I
like it with light seasonings
like this.
translations.よかった……また作ってくるから、感想、聞かせてね。:
I'm glad... I'll make it for
you again, so I want to hear
your opinion.
translations.ふふ。実は今日、お弁当作ってきたの。:
Hehe, actually, I made a lunch
box today.
translations.弁当？ もらっていいの？: A lunch box？ Is it for me？
translations.条件は残さず食べること。いい？:
I have one condition, though.
You must eat it all. How's
that？
translations.あ、和風弁当？ いいなぁ、手作りって感じで。:
Ah, it's a Japanese style
lunch box. This is nice. It's
homemade too.
translations.身体にいいもの選んでたら、そうなっちゃったの。こういうの、苦手だった？:
I picked a menu that's good
for your health. I wonder if
you don't like it.
translations.まさか。……うん、味もいいよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って料理も得意なんだな。:
No way. ...Um, it's delicious.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is very good at cooking.
translations.ふふ。お料理って、やってみると結構楽しいのよ？ また作ってこよっか？:
Hehe, it's fun to cook. I'll
make some more for you later.
translations.ふふ。……あ、ほら、ちゃんと噛んで食べないと……お茶もあるからゆっくり、ね？:
Hehe... Ah, look！ You have to
chew it properly... I have
some tea too, so take your
time, okay？
translations.弁当？ もしかして作ってきてくれたの？:
A lunch box？ Could it be that
you made it for me？
translations.うん。付き合ってるんだし、これくらいはしないとね。ふふふ。:
Yeah, since I'm your
girlfriend, this is natural,
right？ Hehe.
translations.あ、和風弁当？:
Ah, a Japanese style lunch
box.
translations.私、和食好きなの。ちょっと地味だけど、健康にもいいから、ね。ほら、食べてみて。:
I love Japanese food. It's
simple but healthy, right？
Hey, why don't you taste it？
translations.地味だなんて……うん、うまい。さすが▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って感じかな。:
Simple, huh...？ Um,
delicious. As I could expect
from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふ。この際、お料理教室なんかに通っちゃおうかなぁ。:
Hehe, I'm thinking about
attending a cooking class.
translations.そんなとこに通わなくても、十分おいしいよ。:
You don't have to. This is
already very delicious.
translations.ほんと？ よかったあ。じゃあまた作ってこようかな。:
Really？ I'm glad. Then I'll
make some more for you later.
translations.今日は和風弁当よ。:
Today is a Japanese style
lunch box.
translations.やった！ これ好きなんだよね。いただきまーす。:
Yay！ I really like it. I'm
eating it now.
translations.ありがとう。お、今日は和風か。:
Thanks. Ah, today's menu is
Japanese food？
translations.ふふ。カレシの体のことを考えたら、やっぱり和食が一番でしょ？:
Hehe, I'm concerned about my
boyfriend's health, so
Japanese food is the best
choice.
translations.もう、誰もとったりしないんだから、ゆっくり食べるの。ね？:
Hey, no one is going to snatch
it from you, so eat slowly.
Okay？
translations.ありがとう。最近、この時が楽しみなんだよな。:
Thanks. I've been waiting for
this moment.
translations.ふふ。嬉しいこと言っちゃうんだね……今日はね、お味噌汁付きだよ？:
Hehe, you say something that
makes me happy again. Today, I
made some miso soup, too.
translations.おぉ、いい香り。早速、いただきまーす。:
Oh, it smells nice. I'll hurry
and taste it.
translations.あ、ちょっと、あわてて食べちゃダメ。火傷しちゃうよ。:
Ah, wait. Don't be hasty. It's
still very hot.
translations.ね、ちょっとこっち来て。: Hey, can you come this way？
translations.あのね、私、今日あなたにお弁当作ってきたの。:
Well, I made a lunch box for
you.
translations.●に!? 嬉しいな、いいの？:
For me！？ I'm so happy. Can I
really have it？
translations.うわ、豪華だなあ。飾り付けもおしゃれだし……。:
Wow, this looks wonderful. You
even made some decorations
too...
translations.味のほうは、どうかな？:
What do you think about its
taste then？
translations.いただきまーす……んっ、かなりいける。ばっちり！:
I'll try it now... Oh, this is
great. Perfect！
translations.ふふふ。男の子って、こういうこってりしたのが好きだと思って。:
Hehehe. I think guys like to
eat something like this.
translations.うん、うまい。ほんと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って料理もうまいんだな。:
Yes, it's delicious.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
food is very delicious.
translations.じゃあ、また作ってきてあげよっか？ おかずのリクエスト、あったら教えてね。:
Then I'll make some more for
you later. If you have any
special request, just let me
know.
translations.わからない？ いま、お昼休みでしょ？:
Don't you know？ It's the
lunch break, right？
translations.じゃあ、一緒に食べる？:
Then do you want to eat with
me？
translations.ふふ。そう思って、お弁当、作ってきたけど……どうする？:
Hehe, that's why I made a
lunch box for you. What do you
say？
translations.はい、どうぞ。洋風ランチにしてみたけど……こういうの、好き？:
Here you are. I tried making
this Western style lunch. Do
you like it？
translations.うん、好き、好き。ありがとう！\nいただきまーす。:
Yes, I like it. I like it！
Thanks！ I'm eating it now.
translations.うん、すっごくおいしい！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って料理上手だなあ。:
Yes, very delicious！
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is really good at cooking.
translations.わりと好きなんだ、こう見えても。でも、まだまだ練習しなきゃってカンジ、かな？:
Although I look like this, I
like to cook. But I think I
still have to keep practicing,
right？
translations.そんなに褒めると、あなたのこと、餌付けしちゃうよ？ ふふ。:
If you praise me like this,
I'll start stuffing you, you
know？ Hehe.
translations.あ、やっぱりここにいた。ふふ、予想通りすぎるぞ。:
Ah, you really are here. Hehe,
my guess wasn't wrong.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 昼休みにどうしたの？:
Eh,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Why are you here during the
lunch break？
translations.ふふ、問題です。私がお弁当を作ってきました。一緒に食べる？ 食べない？ 答えはど:
Hehe, I have a question. I
made a lunch box. Will you eat
it with me？ What's your
answer？
translations.ホント!? 食べる、食べる。:
Really！？ I'll eat it. I'll
eat it！
translations.洋風ランチ？ いいなぁ。こういうの好きなんだよな。:
Western style lunch？ This is
nice. I like it.
translations.やっぱり。味付けはどうか、感想、聞かせてくれる？:
I know. How does it taste？
Let me know what you think.
translations.いただきまーす。うん、味も言うことナシ！ 美味いよ、何が入ってるの？:
I'm eating it now. Um, nothing
to complain. It's delicious.
What did you put in it？
translations.いろいろ使ってるけど、一番入ってるのは愛情かな。:
I put so many things in there,
but the most important
ingredient is my love.
translations.ふふ。また持ってきてあげようか。嫌いなものとか、ある？:
Hehe, shall I make some more
for you later？ Do you have
anything that you can't eat？
translations.ちょっと工夫してみたんだけど……どうかな？:
I put my effort in it. ...How
does it taste？
translations.うん、旨いよ。特にこれとか、プロ並みじゃない？:
Um, delicious. A taste like
this is like it was cooked by
a professional.
translations.そこまでかなあ。……でも、よかった。ゆっくり食べてね。:
I don't think it's that good.
...Anyway, I'm glad. Take you
time to savor it.
translations.ありがとう。あ、洋風だ。へぇ……店で売ってる弁当みたい。:
Thanks. Ah, Western food.
Hmm...？ It looks like
something that could be sold
at a store.
translations.ふふ。見た目だけかもよ？:
Hehe, do you only appreciate
its appearance？
translations.そんなことないでしょ。……うん、やっぱり美味い！:
Of course not. ...Yes, it's
very delicious！
translations.ふふ、あんまり何度も言うとお世辞っぽく聞こえるよ。あ、ほっぺたに付いてるよ、もう:
Hehe. No matter how many times
you say this, it still sounds
so flattery. Ah, something's
sticking on your cheek. Geez.
translations.はい、今日のお弁当は、私が腕によりをかけてつくった洋風ランチです。:
Okay, today's lunch box is my
skillful Western style lunch.
translations.これ、全部▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が？:
You made the whole thing by
yourself,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ふふ。塩分カロリー控えめの健康メニュー。見直した？:
Hehe, I picked this one as
it's low in calorie and salt
content. How's that？
translations.見直すもなにも、ほんとにすごいな……。:
I have to look at you
differently... This is really
great.
translations.ふふ。あーんって、して欲しい？:
Hehe. Do you want me to feed
you？
translations.う、うん……今日ね、朝、少し時間が余ったから……お弁当を、ね。:
W-Well... I had some time in
the morning, so I prepared a
lunch box.
translations.そんなことないよ、すごく嬉しい。:
That's not the case. I'm
really happy.
translations.中華だけど平気かな？ 嫌いだったら、今日はごめんになっちゃうけど……。:
Is Chinese food okay for you？
I'm sorry if you don't like
it...
translations.全然平気。それにしても……これ、すごいね、店で買ったみたいだよ。:
It's absolutely okay. And...
This looks awesome. It's like
the one shown in the store.
translations.味はどうかな？ 味付けも頑張ったんだけど。:
I wonder how you'll like the
taste. I tried my best with
the seasonings.
translations.じゃあ、いただきます……うん、美味い！ すごくおいしいよ。:
Then I'll taste it... Yes,
delicious！ Very delicious！
translations.よかった……じゃあ、これからも作ってこよう、かな？:
I'm glad... Then I'll make
some more for you later,
okay？
translations.実はね、私、あなたにお弁当作ってきたの。:
Actually, I've made a lunch
box for you.
translations.えっ、本当？ やった、メシ代浮いたー。:
Eh？ Really？ Yay！ I'm so
happy~
translations.……そういうこと言うならあげない。:
...If you say too much, I
won't give it to you.
translations.もう、無駄にするのも勿体ないから、許してあげる。:
Geez, since I don't want to
waste my food, I'll forgive
you then.
translations.好き、好き。こういうの、ボリュームあっていいよね。:
I love it, I love it. This
looks good.
translations.味のほうは？ あ、正直に言っていいからね。怒らないから。:
How about the taste？ Ah, you
can tell me honestly. I won't
get angry.
translations.いや、そんな、おいしいよ！ すごいなあ。店開けるよ、繁盛間違いなし！:
Oh, it's very delicious！ This
is great. You should open a
restaurant. It'll sell really
well！
translations.もう、そこまで言われると、嘘くさく聞こえちゃうでしょ。……でも、喜んでくれてよか:
Hey, saying too much like that
would make it sound like
you're lying. Anyway, I'm glad
you like it.
translations.あ、いたいた。お昼、まだ食べてないよね？:
Ah, you're here. Have you had
your lunch yet？
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 昼飯なら、これから買いに行くところだけど……？:
Ah,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I'm about to go buy my lunch,
though...
translations.ふふ。実はね、お弁当作ってきたの。:
Hehe, actually, I've made a
lunch box for you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の手作り弁当って、ほんと？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
made a lunch box for me？
Really？
translations.うわあ、中華弁当だ。ボリュームたっぷり！ いただきまーす。:
Wow, a Chinese lunch box. You
made a lot！ I'll start
eating.
translations.味、どうかな。がんばって作ってみたんだけど、おいしい？:
How's the taste？ I tried my
best. Does it taste good？
translations.うまい……うま過ぎる……食べるのもったいないくらい。:
Delicious... So delicious that
I feel like I don't deserve
it.
translations.嬉しいこと言うんだから。私、舞い上がっちゃって、また作ってきちゃうよ？:
If you make me feel happier
than this, I could be
floating. I'll make some more
for you later.
translations.はい、今日は中華ね。冷めないように保温してあるから。:
Okay, today's menu is Chinese
food. I packed it in an
insulated box so it wouldn't
get cold.
translations.ありがとう。いただきまーす……あちっ！:
Thanks. I'll eat it now...
Ouch！ Hot！
translations.もう、言ってるそばから。もう少し落ち着いて食べられない？:
Hey, I've just told you. Wait
until it cools down a bit
before eating.
translations.そこまで言われちゃうと降参しちゃう。もう好きに食べて。あ、スープもあるからね。:
If you insist, just go ahead
and eat it. Ah, I made some
soup, too.
translations.はい、お弁当。今日はスタミナたっぷりの中華ランチ。:
Okay, your lunch box. Today's
the energy boosting Chinese
food.
translations.ふふ。それ、美味しい？ じゃあ、私のも食べてみる？:
Hehe. It's delicious, huh？
Then I'll try it too.
translations.でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の食べる分、無くなるよ？:
But I've already eaten
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
portion.
translations.つい作り過ぎちゃったから……今日は特別サービスで食べさせてあげる。あーんって口あ:
I made plenty, so how about
you treat me specially for
today？ Can you feed me then？
translations.最近、はまってるものってある？:
Do you have anything you're
interested in lately？
translations.えっと、最近だとアロマテラピーかな。:
Well, I'm quite into
aromatherapy lately.
translations.そう。年頃の女の子ってね、見せないだけで結構ストレス抱えてるんだよ？:
Yeah. A grown woman like me is
under a lot of stress, you
know？
translations.そっか。それでアロマテラピーなんだ。:
Really？ That's why you use
aromatherapy.
translations.うん。リラックスしたいっていうのはあるんだけど……本当はね、安かったから。:
Yeah. I can use it when I want
to relax... But actually, it's
very cheap too.
translations.うん。オイルとかキャンドルだけなら値段も安いし、気軽に楽しめるでしょ？:
Yeah, I only need to buy oils
and candles. They are
inexpensive so I can buy them
without worrying.
translations.女の子ってね、ちゃんとするだけでお金かかっちゃうんだから。:
Girls have to spend money on a
lot of things, you know？
translations.うん。もう部屋がそれ関係のものでいっぱいになっちゃった。:
Yeah, there are a lot of
related stuff in my room now.
translations.アロマポットとかお香とか、香水も。あ、最近はマッサージオイルもかな。:
There are aroma pots,
fragrances, perfumes... Ah, I
just bought massage oils as
well.
translations.だんだん本格的になってきたね。:
You're getting serious with
it, huh？
translations.まだまだ全然。お気に入りはいくらあっても足りないの。だから毎日研究中。:
No, not really. I can't
possibly buy everything I want
so I spend time studying about
the products every day now.
translations.そんなにのめり込んだら、かえってストレス溜まらない？:
If you're that serious about
it, wouldn't it cause you more
stress instead？
translations.どうして？ 楽しいよ？ あなたもやってみる？:
Why？ It's fun. You should try
it too.
translations.いやぁ……●にはストレスになりそうだし……。:
No... I think it will be
stressful for me...
translations.それじゃ、いい香りを見つけたらプレゼントしてあげるね。:
Well then, if I find some nice
fragrance, I'll give it as a
present for you.
translations.香りを見つけてあげるっていう約束、やめちゃっても構わない？:
Would you mind if I break the
promise about giving you a
nice fragrance？
translations.アロマテラピー、やめようと思って……。:
I'm thinking about giving up
aromatherapy...
translations.どうして？ あんなにはまってたのに？:
What's wrong？ You were really
into it.
translations.お金がね、かかり過ぎちゃったの。: I spent so much money on it.
translations.たくさん買いすぎたとか？:
Did you buy too many
products？
translations.しょうがないじゃない。お店に行くといろんな種類があるんだもん。:
It couldn't be helped. There
were a lot of things at the
store I went to.
translations.でね、うちのアロマグッズもらってくれる？:
Hey, do you want to take over
my aroma goods？
translations.それは……そのうちってことで……。: Well... If you want me to...
translations.アロマグッズだけど、どうなった？:
What happened to your aroma
goods？
translations.あ、ごめん。その約束、なしにしていいかな？:
Ah, sorry. Can you just forget
about them？
translations.もしかしてまたアロマテラピー復帰したの？:
Are you getting back to
aromatherapy again？
translations.うん。新しい香りを買うのをやめれば、長く楽しめそうだなって気付いたから。:
Yeah. I stop buying new
fragrance now. That way, I can
enjoy it longer.
translations.そうだよね。何ごともあれこれと手を出すと失敗するっていい例かも。:
Right. If you take things more
than you can hold, you might
lose them all.
translations.やっぱりお気に入りはひとつだけを、大切にしないとね。:
Have only one so that you can
treasure the one you have the
most.
translations.確かホラー映画、好きだったよね。最近のお薦めって、なにかある？:
Since you really like horror
movies, can you recommend me
some latest ones？
translations.あるにはあるけど……どういう感じのホラー映画が好き？:
I can recommend some, but...
What types of horror movies do
you like？
translations.たとえば……血がいっぱい出てくるグロテスクなもの。:
For examples... The grotesque
ones with lots of blood...
translations.じゃあ、ジワジワっとくる日本の怪談話みたいな映画は？:
Then how about something with
Japanese ghosts？
translations.もしかして、あんまり違うとか意識したこと、ない？:
Could it be that you don't
know the differences among
horror movies？
translations.実を言うと……ね。だから▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお薦めが見たいかなぁって。:
Actually, yes... Well, I just
want to watch movies that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
recommends.
translations.ふふ。そういうことなら、今度、何作か持ってくるね。:
Hehe. If that's the case, then
I'll bring some for you next
time.
translations.ほら、前にお薦めのホラー映画、持ってきてくれるって話が……。:
Hey, you told me that you'd
bring me some horror movies...
translations.あ、うん……ごめん。実はまだ絞り切れていないの。:
Ah, yeah... Sorry. Actually,
I'm still deciding.
translations.もしかして、あれからずっと選んでくれてたの？:
Don't tell me you've been
selecting movies for me since
that time.
translations.だって、映画って普通のものでも９０分や１２０分あるでしょ？:
But normally, a movie would
run around 90 to 120 minutes,
right？
translations.……さすがに何十作も見るのは無理だね。:
...You mean it's not good to
watch a lot of them one by
one？
translations.そんなに見続けたら疲れちゃうでしょ？ だから２、３作まで絞ろうとしてたの。:
If you keep watching them
continuously, you'd get tired.
That's why I'm trying to pick
only a few movies for you.
translations.でも、絞り切れてないんだ。:
But you have to spend time
selecting them.
translations.スプラッターの名作だけで５作もあるから……。:
I could narrow down the gore
films to 5 now...
translations.ごめん、もう少しだけ待ってもらえる？:
Sorry, can you give me some
more time？
translations.うん。映画そのものより、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお薦めが観たいから、さ。:
Okay. But I don't care much
about the movies. I just want
to watch what
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
recommends.
translations.……うん。ちゃんと選ぶから期待しててね。:
...Okay. I'll pick some nice
ones for you. So please wait.
translations.ごめん。私のお薦めホラー映画、あなたに貸す約束だったけど……あれ、無かったことに:
I'm sorry. I promised to pick
some good horror movies for
you, but... Can you just
forget about that？
translations.無理なら別にいいけど……なにかあったの？:
I don't mind... But, what
happened？
translations.……女の子が血みどろの映画が好きっていうの、やっぱり変だよね？:
...It must be really weird for
a girl to like movies that are
full of blood, right？
translations.いろいろ悩んでたら、ホラー以外の映画も好きなんだって思い出したんだけど……。:
I've been worried about it.
There are non-horror movies
that I like too, but...
translations.それなら別にホラー以外でもいいけど……？:
In that case, I can watch them
instead...
translations.うん……でもそれってあなたに変なところ見せたくないだけだと思うし……。:
Yeah... But I don't want to
show you my weird side...
translations.だから、ごめん。お薦め映画を貸す話、また今度でいい？:
That's why I'm sorry. Let's
discuss about this later,
okay？
translations.お薦めの映画を教えてくれるって話さ、どうしてやめにしちゃったの？:
About the horror movies that I
asked for your recommendation,
why did you want me to forget
about them？
translations.私、あなたの前で無理してるように見える？:
Do you think I'm overdoing it
when I'm with you？
translations.私、ちょっと猫被ってるのかも……そう思わない？:
You must think that I'm trying
to act like an innocent girl
in front of you, right？
translations.うーん……考えすぎなんじゃないかな？:
Hmm...？ You're just thinking
too much.
translations.あ……ふーん、そんなこと言うんだ。ちょっと傷ついちゃったな。:
Ah... Hey, if you say it like
that, you really hurt my
feelings.
translations.ふふ。確かに考えすぎてたみたい。ありがとう。ちょっとだけ楽になれた……かな？:
Hehe. I'm probably just
thinking too much. Thanks. Now
I feel a little relieved...
Maybe.
translations.例えば休みの日に、どこか行きたいところってある？:
If we have some days off, is
there any place you want to
go？
translations.温泉……なーんて言ったらどうする？:
A hot spring... What if I say
that？
translations.温泉って……このあたりにあった？:
A hot spring...？ Are there
any hot springs around here？
translations.どうかな？ ちょっと遠くまでいけば、有名なところもあるけど……。:
I'm not sure. But, if we can
take a long vacation, I know a
famous hot spring...
translations.だとしたら泊まりになっちゃうか。:
In that case, we'll have to
spend a night, right？
translations.行くとなったら、そうなっちゃうね。:
If we really go there, that's
unavoidable.
translations.そっか、じゃあ無理だね。:
I see. Then it's impossible
for us to go there now.
translations.そうだね、少しは。だから今はまだ近場で我慢かな。:
Well yeah, a little bit. For
now, we'll have to bear with a
short trip nearby.
translations.混浴の温泉って、どう思う？:
What do you think about a
mixed bath hot spring？
translations.私ね、お風呂ではゆっくりしたいから、混浴よりは別々がいいかなぁって思うの。:
I like to take a long bath, so
I think I'd prefer separate
bath rather than the mixed
bath.
translations.う、うん。●も、そうだね。うん、絶対にそう。:
O-Okay. I think it's the same
to me. Yeah, exactly the same.
translations.ふふ。素直に謝ったから許してあげる。:
Hehe. Since you obediently
apologized, I'll forgive you.
translations.前に温泉の話して思ったんだけど、あなたの肌っていつもすべすべだよね、何か特別なこ:
I was thinking about a hot
spring and I suddenly realized
how smooth your skin is. Do
you use anything special？
translations.なにもしてないけど……それに、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のほうがすべすべなんじゃない？:
I don't use anything
special... And I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
skin is much smoother.
translations.うーん……でも、こう見えて乾燥肌なの。寒くなってくるとすぐかさついちゃって。:
Hmm... But even though I look
like this, my skin is very
dry. It becomes flaky in
winter.
translations.あーあ、やぱり若い子には勝てないのかな……お姉さん、ちょっとショック。:
Aaah, I'm no match to the
young ones... This big sister
is shocked.
translations.気にしすぎだよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の肌、うちのクラスの女子よりキレイなんだし。:
You worry too much,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Your skin is much more
beautiful than any of my
female classmates'.
translations.……そうかな？ うん。あなたが言うんなら、そうなんだね……うん。:
...Is that so？ Yeah. If you
say that, I think I'm okay...
Yeah.
translations.（良かった……機嫌、悪くならなかったみたいで）:
(Phew... At least I didn't
upset her.)
translations.自分のクラスの女の子、少しはかわいいと思ったこと……あるの、かな？:
Have you ever thought that...
some girls in your class are
cute, or something？
translations.うーん……そういう目で見たこと無いから……。:
No... I've never looked at
them that way...
translations.じゃあ、いつもはどういう目で見てるの？:
Then how do you usually look
at them？
translations.どうって……クラスメートはクラスメートでしょ？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は違うの？:
How...？ Classmates are just
classmates, right？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is totally different.
translations.えっ!? わ、私？ うー、予想外の反撃かも……。:
Eh！？ M-Me？ Urgh. This is
such an unpredicted
counterattack...
translations.ちょっと本気で気になるんだけど……。:
But I'm a little bit concerned
about this, too...
translations.……うん、私もクラスメートはクラスメートみたい。言われてみて気づいたけど。:
...Well, it's the same for me.
Classmates are just
classmates. When I asked you,
I also realized it.
translations.そうなんだ……ちょっと安心したかも。:
I see... Now I think I'm a bit
relieved.
translations.ふふ。少なくとも、一緒に温泉に行きたいなんて思う男の子はあなただけよ？:
ZHehe. At least you're the
only boy I've ever thought
about going together to a hot
spring.
translations.よく雑誌なんかでおいしいラーメン屋の特集とかあるけど、ああいうの興味ある？:
There are noodle shops that
got featured in magazines. Are
you interested in them？
translations.うーん……まったく無いわけじゃないけど、それほどは。:
Hmm... Well, I'm not really
interested.
translations.でも、美味しいもの食べるの好きだよね？:
But you enjoy eating delicious
food, right？
translations.嫌いな人なんていないんじゃないかな？:
Is there anyone who doesn't
enjoy that？
translations.女の子ってね、ストレスが溜まると美味しいもの、お腹いっぱい食べたくなる生き物なの:
Sometimes when girls get
stressed, they like to eat
something delicious until
they're full.
translations.友達がね、部活のことでいろいろあって……励ましたいんだけど、いい店、知らない？:
My friend was upset about her
club activities. I want to
cheer her up. You know any
good restaurants？
translations.うーん……ごめん、力になれないみたいで。:
Hmm... I'm sorry that I can't
be of any help.
translations.ううん。もしかしてって、ふと思っただけだから。:
Don't worry. I was just
thinking that you might know.
translations.前に話してた友達を励ますって話、なんとかなった？:
How was the friend who you
were trying to cheer up？
translations.あ、うん。みんなでケーキ食べて、それで解決。ただ……。:
Ah, right. My friends and I
took her to eat some cakes and
she seemed to feel better.
But...
translations.また何かあったの？:
Did something else happen to
her？
translations.ううん、あったというよりされた……かな？:
No, not to her, but... to me,
I think.
translations.された？ 友達が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に何かしたとか？:
To you？ Did your friends do
something to you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.……私、あなたと付き合ってるでしょ？ みんな、そのことばっかり質問したの。:
...I'm dating you, right？ So
everyone was asking me about
that.
translations.う、うん。それは●も同じ、かな？:
O-Okay. I guess your friends
are the same as mine.
translations.ふふ。やっぱり？ そういうの、ちょっと恥ずかしいよね。:
Hehe. Really？ It's quite
embarrassing, right？
translations.恥ずかしいというより……照れくさい、かな。:
Rather than embarrassing, it's
more like they make me feel
awkward.
translations.もぅ……顔を赤くしながら、そんなこと言わないの。こっちまで……ね？:
Geez... Don't say it with your
face all red like that. You
make me feel awkward too...
translations.カノジョのいない男の子の友達って、何人ぐらいいる？:
How many friends of yours that
still don't have girlfriends？
translations.？ えっと……それなりに、かな？:
？ Well... There are some, I
think.
translations.実はね……私の友達なんだけど、誰か紹介しろってうるさいのが何人か……ね？:
Actually... My friends were
asking me if you could
introduce them to your
friends...
translations.なるほど。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の友達ってことは……１学年上の人だよね？:
I see. If they are
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
friends, then they are all one
grade above me, right？
translations.うん。年上が好きな子、他にいない？:
Yeah. Do you have any friends
who like older women？
translations.年齢は関係ないんじゃないかな？:
I don't think it has anything
to do with ages.
translations.じゃあ、今度みんなで押し掛けていい？ あなたの教室に。:
Then I'll take everyone to
your class next time. Is that
okay？
translations.ほら、私が教室に行くこと、あるでしょ？ それにみんな着いてくるだけ。いいかな？:
Come on. Sometimes I go to
your class, too. This time
I'll just bring some more
friends, okay？
translations.いいけど……うーん、大丈夫かなぁ？:
It's okay... Hmm... It should
be okay, right？
translations.前に話した友達なんだけど……。:
About the friends I talked
about earlier...
translations.あぁ誰か紹介しろっていう……。:
Ah, the ones you wanted me to
introduce to my friends...？
translations.それがね、急にみんな、カレシができちゃったのよ。:
Yeah, somehow all of them got
boyfriends already.
translations.部活の後輩とか、予備校の男友達とか……みんな、ダメ元で告白したらＯＫされたのよ。:
Like a guy in the club or at a
prep school. My friends took
the risk and confessed to
them, and the guys just said
okay.
translations.へぇ……それじゃあ、もともと好きな人、全員いたってこと？:
Eh？ Did your friends have a
crush on those guys to begin
with？
translations.そうみたい。もう、なんなんだろうね。ふふ。:
It seemed so. How could it
turn out like this？ Hehe.
translations.はは……でもさすが▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の友達だね。:
Haha... As I could expect from
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
friends.
translations.結局は人に頼らず自分たちで告白したんだよね、好きな人に。:
They didn't rely on others and
just went to confess to the
guys they love bravely.
translations.そうだね……うん、私もあのとき勇気出してよかった▼:
That's true... Yeah, I'm also
glad that I decided to confess
to you at that time▼
translations.最近、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の食が細い感じがするんだけど……気のせいかな。:
I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has lost her appetite lately.
...Is it just my imagination？
translations.えっ？ あ……ふふ、もしかして体のこと、心配してくれてるの？:
Eh？ Ah... Hehe. Are you
worried about my health？
translations.やっぱり体の具合、どこか悪いの？:
So it's really about your
health？ Are you sick？
translations.ううん、そのあたりは問題無し。食べないのも、わざとだから。:
No, there's nothing to worry
about. I just intentionally
eat less.
translations.もぅ……女の子がわざと食べないようにする理由、ひとつしか無いでしょ？:
Geez... When girls
intentionally eat less,
there's only one reason.
translations.もしかしてダイエット？:
Could it be that you're on a
diet？
translations.はい、正解。もっときれいになろうと努力している真っ最中なのです。:
Yes, correct. I want to be
prettier, so I'm trying to go
on a diet now.
translations.そうなんだ……でも、無理なダイエットは体に悪いっていうから、さ。:
I see... But it'll be bad to
your health if you overdo it.
translations.うん。そのあたりは注意してるから。ふふ、心配してくれてありがとう。:
Yeah, I'm aware of that. Hehe.
Thank you for worrying about
me.
translations.こんなこと言うと怒るかもしれないけど……確か今、ダイエット中だよね？:
If I say this, you might get
mad at me, but... Are you
still on a diet？
translations.うん、そうだけど。怒るかもって？:
Yeah, you're right. Why do you
think I'd get mad at you？
translations.もう充分やせてるのに、ダイエットする必要なんて無いんじゃないかな？:
You are already this slim, so
you don't need to go on a
diet.
translations.ごめん。でもほら、無理なダイエットは危ないってよく言うし。:
Sorry. But, come on. People
say that it's dangerous if you
overdo your diet.
translations.うん、そのあたりは注意してるから。:
Yeah, I'm being cautious about
it.
translations.●は……今のままの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が、充分キレイだと思うから、さ。:
I really think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
already looks very pretty like
this.
translations.……そんなに、私がダイエットするの、いや？:
...Do you hate it that much
that I'm on a diet？
translations.イヤじゃないよ。心配なだけで……ごめん、変なこと言って。:
I don't hate it, but I'm
worried about you... Sorry if
I say something weird.
translations.ううん……気持ちは、すごく嬉しいから。:
No... That really makes me
happy.
translations.男の子って、本当はポッチャリ系の女の子のほうが好きだっていう話、本当なのかな？:
I heard that most guys prefer
chubby girls. Is it true？
translations.えっと……どうかな？ 痩せすぎてる女の子は痛々しいっていうのはあるのかも……。:
Hmm... Let me think. I think
girls that are too skinny are
pitiful...
translations.そうなんだ……うーん、じゃあ、ダイエットは今日でおしまいっ。:
I see... Hmm. Then I'll stop
being on a diet from today.
translations.続けてたんだ……。:
So you've been on a diet all
along...
translations.うん。心配させないように、あなたといる時は……ね。:
Yeah. I didn't want to worry
you, so I pretended I wasn't
on a diet in front of you...
translations.ごめん、変なことに気をつかわせちゃって。:
Sorry that I caused you
trouble about something like
this.
translations.ふふ。私が自分でしたことなんだから、ね？ それに今日でおしまいなんだから。:
Hehe. It's something I choose
to do, okay？ And I've decided
to stop it today.
translations.そっか……でも、急にどうして？:
I see... But, why did you
decide to stop it all of a
sudden？
translations.もぅ……どんなに痩せても、あなたが喜んでくれなきゃ意味が無いでしょ？:
Geez... No matter how much
weight I lose, it'd be useless
if it doesn't make you happy,
right？
translations.最近、良く食べるよね。:
You've been eating a lot
lately.
translations.（あれ？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が焦ってる？）:
(Eh？ Why is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
getting fluster like that？)
translations.やだ、もしかして気づかれてる？ ダイエットのせいで胸がちょっとだけ……。:
No, did he notice it？ Because
I was on a diet last time, my
chest is getting smaller...
translations.き、気のせいよ。うん。お腹がすいて……そう、お腹がすいてるだけだから。:
N-No, it's nothing. Ah, I'm
just very hungry. ...Yeah,
it's because I'm very hungry.
translations.良かった、気づかれてないみたい……もぅ、鈍感なんだから。:
Phew, he didn't notice it...
Geez, he's such a thickhead.
translations.ううん、なんでもない。こういうのも恋愛の醍醐味かなって思っただけだから。:
No, I didn't say anything. I'm
just thinking that this is the
true charm of being in love.
translations.ねぇ、さっきまでいた女の人の服、どう思う？:
Hey, for the girl who was here
just now, what do you think
about her outfit？
translations.見てなかった？ 上から下までくすんだ赤っぽい色で統一してた人、いたでしょ？:
Didn't you notice her？ She
wore red from head to toe.
translations.んー、あんなに目立ってた人だよ？ 目移りしてなかったことは嬉しいけど……。:
Hmm？ She was conspicuous, you
know？ Anyway, I'm glad that
you didn't get distracted by
her...
translations.そうかな？ 原色だったらさすがに気づくけど……？:
Really？ If it was a primary
color, I should notice it...
translations.原色か……うーん、難しいよねぇ、原色の着こなし。:
Primary color...？ Hmm, it'd
be difficult to wear clothes
with a primary color.
translations.……もしかして最近、服に凝ってる？:
...Could it be that you're
getting obsessed with clothes
lately？
translations.それはもちろん……ね、女の子はいつだって気にしてるよ？:
That's a sure thing... Hey,
girls always care about
something like that, you
know？
translations.ねぇ、ここに来るときにすれちがった女の人、帽子を被っていたでしょうか？:
Hey, when we arrived here,
there was a woman wearing a
hat walking past us, right？
translations.うーん？ 被ってた……かな？:
Huh？ Was she wearing a
hat...？
translations.もぅ、覚えてないの？ すごく目立ってた美人だったのに。:
Geez... You don't remember
that？ She was really
beautiful.
translations.ふふ、謝らないで。私が知りたいのは、あなたの記憶に残る容姿って、どういうものかっ:
Hehe. Don't apologize. I just
wanted to know if she left any
impression on you.
translations.ふふ。私、あなたのそういうところにキュンってするな。:
Hehe. I really like this part
of yours.
translations.（あれ？ なんで機嫌がいいんだろう……？）:
(Eh？ Why does she look happy
like that...？)
translations.そっか……あんな美人だったのに、気にしなかったんだ。ふふ……。:
I see... Even for someone that
beautiful, he still didn't
care about her. Hehe.
translations.アクセサリー、いっぱい付けてる女の子って、どうかな？:
What do you think about girls
who wear a lot of
accessories？
translations.例えば……うーん、指輪をいっぱいつけてるような女の子は？:
For example... Right, how
about girls who wear a lot of
rings？
translations.うーん……指輪は、ちょっと微妙かな。:
Well... I think rings aren't
good.
translations.ほら、手をつなぐ時、邪魔になりそうだし……。:
Come on. Those rings will get
in the way when you hold
hands, right？
translations.あ……ふふ。服装より、そういうことのほうが気になるお年頃かな？:
Ah... Hehe. Instead of
appearance, that's what comes
to your mind first. You're at
such age to concern about
that, huh？
translations.あれー？ どうして照れているのかなぁ？:
Eh？ Why are you getting
embarrassed？
translations.あ、いいのよ。アクセサリーは基本的につけないことにしたから。:
Ah, don't worry. I'm not going
to wear any unnecessary
accessories.
translations.ふふ。抱きしめた時、固いものがゴツゴツしてたら興醒めしちゃうでしょ？:
Hehe, they'll get in the way
when you hug me. That will
ruin the mood, right？
translations.それともたくさん付けたほうがいい？ 歩くだけでうるさくなっちゃうぐらい。:
And it won't be good if I wear
a lot of them, right？ There
will be clanking noises while
I'm walking.
translations.だからあなたも……ね？:
So... you should keep that in
mind too, okay？
translations.う、うん……●もそんなには付けないようにする。:
O-Okay... I won't wear that
many accessories.
translations.でも、特別な指輪だったら話は別かな？ ふふ。:
But if it's the special kind
of ring, that would be another
story. Hehe.
translations.やっと気づいた？ ふふ。最後まで気づかなかったらどうしようって思ってたんだぞ？:
You finally realized it. Hehe.
I was thinking what I should
do if you still don't notice
it in the end.
translations.ごめん。匂いはもっと前に気づいてたんだけど……さ。:
Sorry. I noticed the smell a
while earlier, but I just
didn't know...
translations.どうかな？ あまり強いと下品になるから、本当に少しだけ付けてみたんだけど。:
Well, if the smell is too
strong, it'll feel like cheap
perfume, right？ I only
applied a little of it.
translations.うん、これぐらいが一番かな。:
Hmm, I think this amount is
about right.
translations.良かった。この香水、けっこう高かったし、苦手な匂いだったらどうしようって思ってた:
That's good. This perfume is
very expensive. I don't know
what I'd do if you don't like
it.
translations.もしかして……●のためにわざわざ？:
Could it be that... you bought
it because of me？
translations.ふふ。カノジョが自分のために女を磨いていくこと、カレシとしてはどうかな？:
Hehe. I wonder what my
boyfriend would think if I'm
trying to polish myself for
him.
translations.私も楽しいの。喜んでくれる人がいると、磨きがいがあるでしょ？ ふふ。:
I'm happy too. It's worth it
to try to polish myself for
someone, okay？ Hehe.
translations.今日のお姉さん、少しだけいつもと違うけど……気づいてる？:
Today, this big sister is a
little bit different. ...Did
you notice that？
translations.もぅ……ほら、見た目じゃないよ？:
Geez... Come on. It's not
something visible.
translations.正解。でも言わないと気づかれないんじゃ、張り合いないなぁ。:
Correct. But I had to tell you
before you could notice it.
This is not worth it, huh？
translations.ごめん。でも●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の匂いって好きだよ。:
Sorry. But I really love how
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
smells.
translations.もぅ。急に恥ずかしいこと言わないの。:
Geez. Why do you say something
so embarrassing all of a
sudden？
translations.……カノジョをくどいて、どうするつもり？:
...What did you intend to do
when you praise your
girlfriend like that？
translations.えっと……もっと仲良くなりたい、かな。:
Well... I just wanted to get
closer to her, I think.
translations.おばさんが？ そうでもないと思うけど……？:
Old ladies？ I don't think
so...
translations.そうなんだ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお母さん、香水には反対なんだ。:
I see... So
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
your mother doesn't want you
to use perfume？
translations.若いんだから素のままで勝負しなさいって……言われてみればそうだよね。:
She said that I'm still young,
so it's better to be more
natural... But, as you said,
she might be against it.
translations.若いって……高校生が考えることじゃないよ。:
Young, huh...？ But you're
already in high school.
translations.……あなたからみたら、年上でしょ？ やっぱりおばさんみたいなものじゃない？:
...From your point of view, an
older woman like me is an
auntie already, right？
translations.そんなことないよ。どちらかといえば……その、お姉さんというか……。:
No, that's not it. You're like
a big sister to me...
translations.……ふふ。ごめんね、困らせて。お姉さん、たまにはナーバスになる時もあるの。:
...Hehe. Sorry to make you
feel troubled. This big sister
sometimes gets worried about
something like this.
translations.今日、香水付けてきたんだけど……どうかな？:
I'm wearing perfume today...
What do you think？
translations.うん、気づいた。●は好きだよ、これぐらいの香り。:
Yeah, I noticed it. I like it.
I like this smell.
translations.ふふ。最初に付けた時も、そう言ってくれたよね。:
Hehe. You also said you liked
it when I used it for the
first time.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお母さん、許してくれたの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did your mother allow you to
use it？
translations.うん。ほら、私の場合、自分で働いたお金で買ってるわけでしょ？:
Yeah. Come on. I bought it
with the money I earned from
my job, right？
translations.あ……もし●のためなら、無理しなくても……。:
Ah... Could it be that you
splurged because of me...？
translations.私と一緒にいるんだよ？ あなたに私の匂い、移ってること気づいてる？:
You know something？ When
you're with me, the smell of
my perfume sticks to you, too.
translations.ふふ。カレシに匂いで印を付けていいのは、カノジョだけなんだよ？ 知ってた？:
Hehe. Only the girlfriend can
mark her boyfriend with her
smell, you know？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってブランドものに興味あったりする？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you interested in brand
name merchandises？
translations.あ、もしかしてプレゼントしようとか思ってるの？:
Ah, are you going to buy a
present for me？
translations.いちおう、ある……かな？:
I'm quite interested in them,
I think.
translations.やっぱり。女の子ってそうだよね。:
As I thought. Girls are like
that.
translations.ううん。ブランド品だからって意味じゃなくて、そういうのに触れて本当にいいものを選:
No, it's not because I want
brand name items. I just want
to polish myself so that I can
tell the good ones apart.
translations.ふふ。高いものをねだられるんじゃないかって思った？:
Hehe. Were you thinking that I
just like expensive stuff？
translations.大丈夫。私、自分の欲しいもの買うくらいのお金はちゃんと稼いでますから。:
Don't worry. If I want
something, I'll work and buy
it with my own money.
translations.残念。時間切れ。ちょっと悲しいかも。:
Too bad. Time's up. This is a
little sad.
translations.実は……エステに行ってきました。:
Actually... I went to a beauty
salon.
translations.うん。前に自分を磨くって言ったでしょ？:
Yeah. I told you before that I
wanted to polish myself,
right？
translations.本当に磨いて来ちゃったんだ……。:
So you really went there to
polish yourself...
translations.でもエステなんてお金かかるんじゃないの？ バイトしてるっていっても……。:
But doesn't it cost a lot to
go to a beauty salon？ Even if
you use your money from
part-time job...
translations.大丈夫。無料体験だったからお金は全然かかってないの。:
It's okay. I went there for a
free trial, so it didn't cost
any money.
translations.そうなんだ……びっくりした。:
Is that so...？ That's a
relief.
translations.でも入会を勧められちゃったし……どうしようかな？:
But they're trying to sell me
membership... What should I
do？
translations.（なんだかイヤな予感がするけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことだから大丈夫……かな？）:
(I have a bad feeling about
this, but if it's
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
she should be able to handle
it... right？)
translations.そういえばエステの入会はどうなったの？:
By the way, how about the
beauty salon membership？
translations.あれね、やっぱりやめちゃった。ちゃんと説明を聞いたらすごく高かったから。:
About that, I declined it.
When I checked the details, it
turned out to be very
expensive.
translations.そうだよね。それがいいよ。: Is that so？ That's good then.
translations.あれ？ もしかして反対だったの？:
Eh？ Could it be that you're
against it？
translations.きれいになってくれるのは嬉しいけどさ、最近の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってがんばり過ぎてるよう:
I'm happy that you tried to be
pretty for me, but,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I think you're overdoing it.
translations.●、今のままでも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと充分好きだし……。:
The way
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks right now makes me love
you so much already.
translations.もぅ。嬉しいこと言ってくれちゃって。よし、今日はお姉さんが奢っちゃう。:
Hey, you just said something
that makes me happy. Okay,
it's this big sister's treat
today.
translations.悪いよ。:
No, you don't have to treat
me.
translations.それでもエステを始めるより安いでしょ。ね？:
It's much cheaper than beauty
salon's membership fee, all
right？
translations.前にブランドものに興味があるかって聞かれたことがあったでしょ？:
You asked me before whether I
like brand name items or not,
right？
translations.バッグなんだけどね。お店で見かけて一目惚れしちゃって。:
It's a bag. I fell in love
with it the moment I saw it in
the store.
translations.でも……高かったんじゃないの？ それにエステの時はお金がかかりすぎるって。:
But it must be expensive. You
mentioned before that you
didn't go to the beauty salon
because it was too expensive,
right？
translations.それはそうだけど、自分磨きをやめたわけじゃないもの。いいものを見極める目はちゃん:
That's right. But it doesn't
mean that I should stop
polishing myself. Now I'm
trying to learn about high
quality items.
translations.それでも過剰なのはやめておいたほうがいいよ。:
That's probably too much.
You'd better stop it.
translations.そこはちゃんとわきまえてます。それにね……。:
I know when I should stop.
Plus...
translations.カレシのためにきれいになっていく自分を楽しめるのは、カノジョの特権なの。だからそ:
When a girlfriend is trying to
look better, it's all for her
boyfriend's sake. So you
should let me do this.
translations.友達から相談されたんだけどね、カノジョ以外の子と遊びに行く男の子ってどう思う？:
My friend came to consult with
me. What do you think if a guy
hangs out with another girl
who isn't his girlfriend？
translations.その男の子が友達のカレシで、別の女の子と遊んでるってこと？:
Are we talking about your
friend's boyfriend？ Is he
hanging out with another
girl？
translations.そう。カレシくんは、ただのクラスメイトだって言い張ってるらしいんだけど……。:
Yeah. He said that girl was
only his classmate though...
translations.浮気かもしれないってこと？:
But your friend doubted he
might be cheating on her？
translations.考え過ぎじゃないかな？ ほら、クラスメイトだったら一緒に遊びに行っても……。:
She might be thinking too
much. Come on. It's common to
hang out with a classmate...
translations.そういうのって普通にあること？ クラスメイトでも相手は女の子だよ？:
Is it that common？ You said
classmate but she's actually a
girl.
translations.えっと……とにかくまずはよく話し合ってみるしかないんじゃないかな？:
Well... I think the best thing
for her to do is to talk about
this with him, right？
translations.そうだよね。伝えてみる。あと……あなたもそういうことあるの？:
That's right. I'll tell her
you said that. And now... Do
you often hang out with your
female classmates？
translations.（……あれ？ ヤブヘビ？）:
(...Huh？ Why is it about me
now？)
translations.悩んでた友達って、あれからどうなったの？:
How was your friend after
that？
translations.うん。よく聞いてみたら、カレシくんにはそういう意識なかったんだって。:
Well, she talked to her
boyfriend and it seemed like
it was really nothing.
translations.浮気じゃなくて、ただのクラスメイトだったんだ。:
So he didn't cheat and the
other girl was just a regular
classmate？
translations.そういう意識の差っていうのかな？ ギャップを感じたらしくて、今度は男の子の気持ち:
She feels like the way he
thinks is different from hers.
It's like there's a big gap
and she doesn't understand
him.
translations.こういう時、どうやってアドバイスしたらいいのかな？:
I don't know what advice I
should give her this time.
translations.うーん。やっぱり話し合ってそういう意識の差を埋めていくしか……。:
Well... If she keeps talking
to him, the gap will become
smaller...
translations.そうよね。伝えてみる。あ、ところで……あなたと私にもギャップってあると思う？ 例:
That's right. I'll tell her
you said that. Ah, by the way,
do you think there's also a
gap between us？ For
example...
translations.恋愛相談してきた友達って、その後どうなったの？:
How is it going with the
friend who usually comes to
consult with you？
translations.順調みたい。だけど……。:
Everything goes well for her,
but...
translations.彼に誘われて行く場所がゲームセンターとかカラオケばっかりで刺激がないって。:
She said that her boyfriend
now kept taking her to either
the arcade or the karaoke box.
translations.……それって、ただのノロケじゃないのかな？:
...Maybe she just wanted to
brag about it, right？
translations.私もそう思うけど、自分から誘うべきかって相談されると答えないわけにはいかないし。:
That's what I thought. She
didn't ask me anything.
Otherwise, I'd suggest that
she should choose the
locations herself.
translations.そういう面倒見の良さが災いしてる気がするけど……。:
It wouldn't be good for her to
rely on you for everything...
translations.そうよね。そろそろ自分たちで考えろって言ってやらなきゃ。:
Yeah, you're right. I must
tell her to think for herself.
translations.だいたい年下の男の子の気持ちなんて私だってわからないのに……。:
Even for me, I still don't
quite understand a guy who's
younger than me...
translations.最近、恋愛相談されてる？:
Did you give your friend any
more advices about love？
translations.ううん。最近は向こうの様子聞くだけになってるかな？:
No. Lately, she just told me
how they were doing in
general.
translations.やっと解放されたんだ。:
So, she doesn't consult with
you anymore.
translations.でもね、おかげでただのノロケ話、何時間も聞かされてるんだけどね。:
But I still have to listen to
her when she brags about her
boyfriend.
translations.ふふ。だからお返しにこっちもノロケ返してあげちゃった。:
Hehe. That's why I also brag
about my boyfriend when I talk
with her.
translations.そう。すごく私のことを良くわかってくれるカレシがいますよって。ふふふ。:
Yeah. That you're the
boyfriend who really
understands me well. Hehehe.
translations.そう感じてがんばってくれるところが、あなたのいいところよね。:
I know you'll keep trying
harder after you hear me say
that. That's another good
point of yours.
translations.ふふっ、また話すこと増えちゃった▼:
Hehe. Now, I have one more
thing to brag about you▼
translations.ねぇ、『愛なき支配』ってドラマ、知ってる？:
Hey, have you ever watched
"Loveless Rule" series？
translations.名前だけは……昼にやってるやつだよね？:
I've only heard about it. It's
the daytime drama, right？
translations.うん、それ。それがね、すっごく面白いの。:
Yeah, that one. And it's very
interesting.
translations.毎日録画して、家に帰ってから観てるの。:
I recorded it everyday and
watched it when I got home.
translations.へぇ、●も観てみようかな。途中からでも楽しめる？ それか、よかったら録画したやつ:
Huh？ Should I watch it, too？
Is it okay if I don't watch
from the beginning？ Or could
you lend me the parts that you
recorded？
translations.んー、どうかな。あなたは観てもわからないかも。:
Hmm, let me see. I don't think
you'll understand it even if
you watch it.
translations.あ、そっか。やっぱ女の人向けに作ってるのかな。:
Ah, really？ So it targets
female audience, huh？
translations.むしろあなたには観て欲しくないかも……。:
I think I just don't want you
to watch it...
translations.それなのに話題にしちゃって、ごめんね。:
Sorry to bring up this
topic...
translations.あれ、なんか元気ない？:
Eh？ Somehow you don't look
well.
translations.うん、ちょっと思い出しちゃって……。女って、過去からは逃げられないのかな……。:
Um, I just recalled
something... Women can never
escape their past, right...？
translations.ドラマ。ほら、昼にやってる……。:
It's about the series. That
daytime drama...
translations.そう。不幸になることはわかってるのに、なんで今の幸せを手放してまで、過去にすがっ:
Yeah, I knew it'd be sad, but
I didn't understand why she
let go of her happiness to
cling onto her past...
translations.なんか、重そうな話だね。:
It seems like a serious issue,
huh？
translations.うん、重くて、切ないの。女はね、愛に生き、愛に溺れる生き物なの……。:
Yeah, serious and painful.
Women are born to love and to
be loved...
translations.（たしかに●は観ない方がいいかも……）:
(I think I'd better not watch
it...)
translations.そういえば、例の『愛なき支配』。デキシーズのスタッフでも話題になってたね。:
By the way, some staff at
Dixie's also talked about
"Loveless Rule."
translations.そっか。それじゃ内容話しちゃまずいよね。でもなんで？ あんなにハマってたのに。:
I see. So I shouldn't spoil
the plot. But, why？ You were
really into it earlier.
translations.もうね、切なすぎて、観ていられないの。続きは気になるんだけど、どうしても再生ボタ:
The story became more painful,
so I didn't want to watch it.
I wanted to know how the story
went, but I couldn't watch it.
translations.でも、最終回までにはなんとしても追いつかなきゃ。あぁ、どうなっちゃうんだろう。:
If it's like this, I won't be
able to catch up when the last
episode airs. Ah, what should
I do？
translations.『愛なき支配』、最終回観ちゃった。:
"Loveless Rule." I already
watched the final episode.
translations.続き観られるようになったんだ。どうだった？:
So you kept on watching it？
How did it end？
translations.ふふ、面白かったよ。結局ハッピーエンドだったの。:
Hehe. It was good. In the end,
it was a happy ending.
translations.へぇ、あそこから……。:
Eh？ But it was all painful
and stuff...
translations.うん、途中はどうなるかと思ったけど、最後はみんな幸せ。少し、キレイにまとめすぎか:
Yeah, I thought it'd turn out
bad, but in the end, everyone
was happy that I even thought
it was too forced.
translations.みんな幸せになれたんなら、それでいいんじゃないの？:
If everyone's happy in the
end, it's good, isn't it？
translations.でもね。恋愛って、辛かったり苦しかったり、ときには泣いちゃったりもするものじゃな:
But love should be harsh and
painful. It's something that
makes you cry occasionally,
right？
translations.ふふ、でもそれはドラマの話。私たちは、ずっと幸せでいようね▼:
Hehe. I was just talking about
that drama. For us, we'll
always be happy▼
translations.海外旅行に行くとしたら、どこがいい？:
If we were to be on a vacation
abroad, where would you like
to go？
translations.うん。ほら、そこに観光会社の広告、あるでしょ？ それで気になって。:
Yeah. See, there's an ad over
there for a sightseeing
company. That's why I asked
you.
translations.ああ、それで……うーん、でも、どこがいいのかな？:
Oh, because of that...？ Hmm,
where would be a nice place to
go...？
translations.南の島とか北欧のフィヨルドとか……あ、地平線を見に行くのも楽しいかも。:
We could go to an island to
the south. ...Oh, going to see
Scandinavian fjords may also
be fun.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、特に行きたいところってある？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
is there any place in
particular you'd like to
visit？
translations.うーんと……あっ、あなたの顔に水着が見たいって書いてあるから南の島がいいかも。:
Hm... Ah！ It's written all
over your face that you want
to see me in a swimsuit. An
island to the south would be
good.
translations.書いてないよ……！:
It's not written on my
face...！
translations.ふふっ。でも南洋リゾートって、いいよね。いかにも海外旅行って感じもするから。:
Hehe. But a South Seas resort
may be nice. Indeed, it gives
me the feeling of vacationing
abroad.
translations.海外旅行のパンフレットをもらってきたんだけど見る？:
I brought a brochure about
traveling abroad. You want to
look？
translations.この間の続き？:
Is this about what we were
talking the other day？
translations.そう。旅行会社の人かな？ チラシ、配ってたからもらっておいたの。:
Yeah. The agents from that
travel agency were handing out
fliers, so I took one.
translations.えっと……ハワイ、グァム、モルディブ……見事に南洋リゾートばっかりなんだけど。:
Let's see... Hawaii, Guam,
Maldives... They're nothing
but beautiful South Seas
resorts.
translations.ふふ。そういうところがいいんでしょ？:
Hehe. Those places are nice,
aren't they？
translations.それは……まぁ、イヤじゃないけど。:
That's... Well, they are not
bad.
translations.じゃあ、決定。良さそうなところ、探してみる？:
Then it's decided. Shall we
try looking for some nice
locations？
translations.本当に旅行に行くの？:
Are we really going to
travel？
translations.いつか行けるかもしれないでしょ？ たとえば……婚前旅行とか？:
Some day we might, right？ For
example... a trip before we
get married...
translations.ふふ。それくらい真剣に選んで欲しいなってこと。:
Hehe. I just wanted you to
seriously think about the trip
to that extent.
translations.そういうことか……びっくりした……。:
To that extent, huh...？ You
scared me...
translations.婚前旅行、南の島じゃなくてもいい？:
If it's a trip before we get
married, then is it okay if
it's not an island to the
south？
translations.あ、違う違う。ただの旅行。:
Ah, no. I mean an ordinary
trip.
translations.そうだよね……あ、もしかして、前にしてた海外旅行の？:
Okay... Oh, could this be
about the vacation we were
talking before？
translations.うん。予算がね、思いのほかかかるみたいだから。:
Yeah. But when it comes to the
budget, it sort of costs a
surprising amount.
translations.南の島ってそんなに高かったかな？:
Is going to a southern island
really that expensive？
translations.ひとつだけならね。でも、二日目に行く島はちょっと遠いから飛行機が必要だし、その後:
Yeah. It's necessary to take
an airplane because the
islands are very far apart.
And then, for shopping and
traveling...
translations.……もしかして行く場所。ひとつじゃないの？:
...Do you plan to go to more
than one place？
translations.ひとつに決められないの！ だから別のプランのほうがいいかもって。:
I've never said I'd go to only
one place！ That's why it's
better to have another plan.
translations.はぁ……リゾート地って、なんで離れてるのかな。全部近かったらいろいろ楽なのに。:
Hah... Why are the resorts so
far from one another？ If they
were closer, I could visit all
of them.
translations.この間からしてる旅行の話って、計画だけだよね？:
About the vacation we've been
talking about... It was just a
plan, right？
translations.うん。すぐに行くわけじゃないけど？:
Yeah, it doesn't mean we can
go travel any time soon.
translations.よかった……本気っぽかったから、さ。:
That's a relief. You seemed to
be very serious about it.
translations.ふふ。でも、いつか本当に行けたらいいなって思ってるのは本当だよ？:
Hehe. But I really think that
we can travel together
someday.
translations.それなら一緒に決める？ 婚前旅行の場所。:
Then let's decide it together
about a place for our trip
before we get married.
translations.面白いこと？ あっ、この間デパートに行ったらブライダルフェア、やってたの。:
Something interesting？ Ah,
when I went to a department
store earlier, there was a
bridal fair.
translations.ブライダルフェア？ 結婚関係のイベント？:
Bridal fair？ An event for
people who plan to get
married？
translations.うん。純白のウエディングドレスが並んでて、結婚式の相談にも乗ってくれるみたい。:
Yeah. They put a lot of
wedding dresses on display and
let you consult about the
wedding ceremony and stuff.
translations.へぇ、やっぱりそういうのって興味あるんだ？:
Hmm？ So you're interested in
something like that？
translations.女の子はみんな、ウエディングドレスに憧れるんじゃないかな？:
All the girls are yearning to
wear a wedding dress, I think.
translations.そっか……きれいだろうなぁ。:
I see... You must look
beautiful in it.
translations.心配しなくてもいつか見られるはずよ。すぐ横から。:
Don't worry. Some day you'll
see it when I'm standing
beside you.
translations.この間、前に話したデパートのブライダルフェアに行ってみたんだけど……。:
I told you about the bridal
fair earlier, right？ I went
there again...
translations.ああいうところって結婚の予定の無い人でも大丈夫なの？:
Is it okay for someone who
doesn't have any plan for
wedding to visit the fair？
translations.私もそう思って、結局、入り口の近くをウロウロするだけですぐに帰って来ちゃった。:
That was what I thought, so I
just took a peek from the
outside and then went home.
translations.やっぱり入りにくい？:
It was difficult to get
inside？
translations.さすがに……ね。結婚の予定なんか全然ないのに、ドレスだけ見せてくださいって言えな:
iWell, yeah... I don't think
they'll let me take a look at
wedding dresses if I don't
plan to get married.
translations.確かにそれだけだと迷惑かも。:
Yeah, it'd probably be just a
waste of time for them.
translations.それで誰かと一緒にいけばいいのかなぁって思ったんだけど……。:
I've been thinking that I
should go there with someone
then...
translations.ふふ。そこまではお願いしないわよ。冷やかしに付き合わせるのは可哀想だし……ね？:
Hehe. I wouldn't ask you to do
that. It would be bad for you
to have to accompany me there,
right？
translations.また行ってきたの。デパートのブライダルフェア。:
I went to the department
store's bridal fair again.
translations.今度は入ってみたの？: Did you get inside this time？
translations.うん。係の人と少し話もしたんだけど……最後にね。“学校を卒業してから来てください:
Yeah. I got a chance to talk
to the receptionist but I was
told to come back once I
graduate from high school.
translations.やっぱり学生だと子供扱いなんだ。:
They think high school
students are still too young,
huh？
translations.うん。いつも大人っぽいって言われてるから、ちょっと新鮮だったかな？:
Yeah. People usually say that
I'm like an adult. So that was
something new for me.
translations.でもね……結婚って、そんなに遠い話なのかな？:
But... I wonder if it'll be
that far for my wedding.
translations.好きな人とずっと一緒にいたいって思う気持ち、年齢に関係ないと思うんだけど……。:
Ages don't matter when we
think we're ready to spend our
lives with someone...
translations.それに私、まだ高校生だけど結婚はできる歳だよ？:
Although I'm still a high
school student, I'm actually
at the age that can get
married.
translations.え、あ、やだ。もぅ……あの冗談、まだ引きずってたの？:
Eh？ Ah, no. Geez... Are you
fussing over it？ I was just
kidding.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がなんだか寂しそうに見えたから……さ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looked so sad when you said
that...
translations.ふふ。寂しいはずないじゃない。私たち、本気で付き合ってるでしょ？:
Hehe. It's not something I
should feel sad about, right？
We're serious about each
other, right？
translations.ほら、だったら絶対、寂しいはずないよ。胸を張って、子供の遊びじゃないって言えるん:
See？ That's why it's not
something to feel sad about. I
can proudly say that we aren't
just toying with each other.
translations.……そうだね。●ももっと本気で▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とのこれから、考えるから……さ。:
...Yeah. I'll also think about
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
even more seriously from now
on...
translations.うん……ありがとう。これからも、この先も、ずーっと、一緒にいてね▼:
Okay... Thanks. We will always
be together, forever▼
translations.ねえ……聞いてもいいかな？:
Hey... Can I ask you a
question？
translations.えっ？ なんで急に、そんなこと……。:
Eh？ Why did you ask me all of
a sudden...？
translations.だって私、年上だし……後悔してないかなって。:
Because... I'm older than
you... I wonder if you ever
regretted it.
translations.後悔なんてするわけないよ。好きになるのに、年齢なんて関係ないし。:
I've never regretted it. I
love you. Our ages don't
matter.
translations.ほんとだよ、信じて。:
That's my true feeling. Trust
me.
translations.うん……ごめんね。ちょっと、気になっちゃって。:
Okay... I'm sorry. I was just
a little worried.
translations.……ねぇ、正直に答えて欲しいんだけど。:
...Hey, I want you to answer
this honestly.
translations.ホントはどういう女の子がタイプ？:
What type of girl do you
like？
translations.ほら、私、ちょっとお節介でしょ？:
Well, for me, I'm the nosy
type, right？
translations.そう、かな。気にならないけど……。:
Is that so...？ I don't think
you are...
translations.それに年上だから……ほら、男の子って年上より年下が好きじゃない？:
And I'm older than you... Come
on, most guys like younger
girls, right？
translations.そんなの、人それぞれだと思うけど。:
That depends on each person's
taste, though.
translations.無理して付き合ってたり、しない？:
Are you forcing yourself to go
out with me？
translations.そんなことは絶対に無いって。信用してよ。ね？:
Absolutely no. Trust me, can
you？
translations.わかった、信じる。ごめんね、変なこと聞いて。:
Okay. I'll trust you. Sorry
for asking such a weird
question.
translations.ちょっと聞いてもいいかな。: Can I ask you a question？
translations.恋人同士になることってどういうことだと思う？:
What do you think about
lovers？
translations.好きになるってことじゃないの？:
When people are in love, they
become lovers, right？
translations.えーと……相手を大事に思って、一緒にいたいって感じることじゃないかな？:
Well... When you think that
there's someone important to
you and you want to be with
that person. It's that
feeling.
translations.でも、いざ恋人になると揺れちゃったりするでしょ。自分でいいのかな、なんて……。:
But, lovers these days break
up very easily, right？ I
wonder if we'll be okay...
translations.……ふふ、あなたにはまだ、難しかったかな？:
...Hehe, this question is
probably still too difficult
for you, right？
translations.また子供扱いして……。:
You're treating me like a
child...
translations.人を好きになるって、なにがキッカケなのかな？:
What triggers it when people
fall in love？
translations.誰だって、最初は他人でしょ？ だけど、出会って、恋をすると、その人がかけがえのな:
In the beginning, they were
strangers, right？ But they
meet and fall in love. They
know it has to be this
specific person...
translations.そうだね。そう考えると不思議だよね。:
Right... When I think about
it, this is mysterious.
translations.うん……つい最近まで他人だったのに、その人じゃないとダメになっちゃうんだから……:
Yeah... We started out as
strangers, but then we knew
that it really had to be this
one person...
translations.昼も夜もずっとその人のことを考えて……苦しくて……嬉しいはずなのに寂しくて……。:
Days and nights, you only
think of this person... It's
painful. It makes you feel
happy and lonely at the same
time.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も、そうなの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
is that how you feel？
translations.ふふ。どうかな。でも、私もまだまだ夢見る少女でいたいかな、って。:
Hehe. Who knows？ I'm just a
dreamy girl.
translations.ね、そういえばもうすぐだね。:
Hey, by the way, it's coming
soon, right？
translations.え、違った？ あなたの誕生日のことだけど……。:
Eh？ Am I wrong？ It's your
birthday...
translations.そうか。意外と忘れるんだよね。:
I see. I totally forgot about
it.
translations.もう、自分のことなのに……あ、それより、なにか欲しいものある？:
Geez, it's your own
birthday... Ah, do you have
something you want？
translations.うーん、別にこれというのは無いかな。:
Hmm, there's nothing in
particular that I want.
translations.ダ～メ。こういう時は遠慮しないの。カレシの誕生日をお祝いするの、カノジョにとって:
No~ You can tell me. It's a
girlfriend's pleasure to
celebrate her boyfriend's
birthday, okay？
translations.ふふ。期待してもいいからね。:
Hehe. You can expect something
nice.
translations.（嬉しいような、その気合いの入り方が少し不安というか……）:
(She looks happy. Anyway, I
feel a little nervous to see
her being in high spirits like
that...)
translations.そういえば、誕生日のことだけど。:
By the way, about your
birthday.
translations.今まではどうだったの？ 教えてもらってもいい？:
How do you usually spend it？
Can you tell me？
translations.特にないけど、周りからおめでとうって言われる程度かな。:
I don't do anything special.
People just say "Happy
Birthday" to me and that's
all.
translations.それだけ？ お祝いとかしないの？:
That's all？ How about a
celebration？
translations.昔はともかく……。でも、そんなもんじゃない、みんな。:
I used to do that... but not
anymore.
translations.友達ならそれでもいいけど、カノジョとしては、ちょっと、ね。:
It's fine if your friends
don't celebrate it, but I'm
your girlfriend, so it's
different, okay？
translations.そうか。うーん、難しいなあ。:
Okay, then. I don't really
understand, though.
translations.……ふふ、おかしい。でも、何となくあなたらしくていいかな。:
...Hehe, you're weird. Anyway,
I think you're always like
this.
translations.いろいろ考えてみたんだけど……。:
I've been thinking about so
many things...
translations.あなたの誕生日の話。そろそろでしょ？:
About your birthday. It's
coming up, right？
translations.何かプレゼントはしたいな。何が欲しい？:
What should I get as a present
for you？ What do you want？
translations.急にそんなこと言われても……うーん、思いつかない。なんでもいいよ。:
If you ask me all of a sudden
like that... Well, I can't
think of anything. Anything's
fine, I think.
translations.もう、つまんない。何かあるでしょ、遠慮しないで言ってよ。:
Geez, this is boring. You must
have something that you want.
Just tell me.
translations.じゃあ……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とか？:
Then... What if I say I want
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.……？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいてくれればそれでいいよ？:
...？ If
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
can be with me, that would be
good enough.
translations.そういえば、誕生日のプレゼントなんだけど……。:
By the way, about the birthday
present...
translations.とりあえず、私のことは用意しておきます、ちゃんと会いに行くから。:
I'll celebrate your birthday
with you, so you just come to
see me on that day.
translations.あとはプレゼントだよね、どうしよう。:
And then, about the present.
What should I do？
translations.そんなに真剣に考えなくても……嬉しいけどさ。:
You don't have to think about
it that seriously. ...Anyway,
I'm happy that you think about
me.
translations.あなたに喜んでほしいのは、もちろんなんだけど、私のためでもあるのよ。:
I want to make you happy.
That's a sure thing. But, this
is also what I do for myself.
translations.カレシのために悩むのって、すごく楽しいの。だからね、もう少し私を楽しませておいて:
It's also fun for me to do
something for my boyfriend.
So, please let me enjoy it,
okay？
translations.はぁ……毎年、この時期になるとユーウツなの。:
Hah... Every year around this
time, I always feel depressed.
translations.もうすぐ私の誕生日でしょ？:
It's almost my birthday again,
you know？
translations.そうか。盛大にお祝いしなきゃ。:
Is that so？ We'll have to
have a big celebration.
translations.いいの。お祝いは……あんまりそんな気分じゃないから。:
It's okay. I'm not... in the
mood for a celebration.
translations.だって、またひとつ、おばさんになるんだから……。:
Because I'm getting closer to
be an old woman...
translations.だってさあ、例えば９０歳と９１歳のおばあさんなら、どっちも変わらないんじゃない？:
But when I'm 90 years old,
you'll be a 91 year-old
grandma. We won't be much
different, right？
translations.フォローになってないよ、それ……。:
You didn't have to try to say
anything about it...
translations.嫌がってても、結局、誕生日が来ちゃうのよね。:
Although I hate it, my
birthday is coming up.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、何か欲しいものある？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
is there something you want？
translations.あ、プレゼントしてくれるの？:
Ah, are you going to give me a
present？
translations.何がいい？ ●、奮発するから。:
What would you like？ I can
splurge for it.
translations.そういうのは、あなたが選んでくれないと。先にわかってたらつまらないでしょ。:
For that, I'll let you choose
for me. It'd be boring if I
know it in advance.
translations.でも、自分で選ぶのは自信ないな……女の子の欲しいものなんて全然わからないし。:
But I have no confidence. ...I
have no clue what girls want.
translations.好きな人が選んでくれたものなら、どんなものでも嬉しいんだけどな。女の子にとっては:
If it's what someone we love
chooses for us, anything will
make us happy. That's how
girls are...
translations.ね、普通でいいよ？ 普通のもので。:
Hey, just something simple is
fine. Just something simple.
translations.誕生日って、友達や家族に祝ってもらうのも嬉しいけど、やっぱり大事な人と過ごすのが:
I'll be happy to celebrate my
birthday with friends and
family but it'd be best if I
can celebrate it with the one
I love.
translations.自分にはそういう日はずっと来ないって思ってたんだ。:
But I've never thought I'd be
able to have that chance.
translations.まさか。だって▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、美人だからモテるでしょ？:
No way.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
is pretty, so you must be
popular among guys.
translations.モテないよ。私、お節介だから、すぐ人のお世話しちゃうだけ。それは恋じゃないもの。:
I'm not popular. I like to
meddle with people's business
and I think others think that
I'm weird.
translations.そうかなあ。世話って言うけど、本当に親身になるのって、好きじゃないとできないと思:
Really？ You like to take care
of people and you're
kind-hearted. Something like
that makes people fall in love
with you.
translations.ううん、何でもない。ちょっと幸せ感じちゃっただけ。:
No, it's nothing. I just feel
very happy.
translations.もうすぐだな、私の誕生日。:
My birthday is really coming
up.
translations.私は、あなたにおめでとうって言ってもらえれば、それでいいから。:
For me, if you just say "Happy
Birthday" to me, that will be
enough.
translations.こんな時ぐらい、カレシっぽいところ見せたいんだけど……。:
At that time, I want to show
you what a nice boyfriend I
am...
translations.それはもう十分にしてもらってるから。……すごく嬉しかった。:
What you did for me is more
than enough. You've already
made me happy.
translations.●、何かしたっけ？ 覚えてないんだけど……？:
Did I do something for you？ I
can't remember...
translations.いいの、覚えていなくても。私は絶対に忘れないから。それで十分。:
It's okay that you can't
remember it. I'll never forget
about it. That's good enough.
translations.ねえ、もうすぐ１年になるけど……。:
Hey, it's almost been a
year...
translations.私とあなたが付き合い始めてから、もうすぐ１年でしょ？:
You and I. It's almost a year
since we started dating,
right？
translations.もう１年？ 早いなぁ……。:
Already a year？ It's so
fast...
translations.やっぱり忘れてたんだ……あっという間だったのは私もそうだけど……。:
You really forgot about it...
But I also think that time
went by so fast...
translations.そっか……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と付き合い始めて、もう１年かぁ。:
Well... So, it's been a year
since I started dating
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
huh？
translations.でも、ちょっと不思議な感じがしない？ もっと前から一緒だった感じも……さ。:
Do you feel like it's so
amazing？ Actually, it's
always been amazing that I can
be with you...
translations.……うん。そう、だね。ふふ、ほんと、そうだね。:
...Yeah, I think so. Hehe.
Yeah, you're right.
translations.ね、１年前のこと、覚えてる？:
Hey, did you remember about
last year？
translations.私から告白して……あの時はすっごくドキドキしたなぁ。年上だから、断られるって思っ:
When I confessed to you, I was
really nervous. I thought that
you'd reject me because I was
old than you.
translations.あの時から始まったんだよね、私たち。:
So we've started dating since
then.
translations.今、こんなに近くにいるなんて……なんか驚いちゃうね。:
I'm quite surprised that we're
now getting this close...
translations.……これからも一緒に、ね。:
...We'll always be together
like this from now on as well,
right？
translations.うん……２周年も迎えられるといいな。私、どんどん歳を取るから、嫌われそう。:
Yeah... But just aim for the
next anniversary first. I'm
getting older and older and
you might start to dislike me.
translations.そんなことないよ！ ●はおばさんになっても、おばあさんになってもＯＫだからさ。:
That won't happen！ Even if
you become an auntie or a
grandma, I'll still love you.
translations.もう……いくらなんでもそこまでは気にしてません。……でも、本心で言ってくれてるん:
Geez... I've never given it a
thought that far. ...But I
think you really mean it. I'm
happy.
translations.ねえ、この１年で私、変わったと思う？:
Hey, do you think I've changed
during this one year？
translations.突然何の話？:
Why do you ask me all of a
sudden？
translations.ほら、好きな人とつき合うと、変わるっていうじゃない。だから私も変わったのかなって:
Come on. It's said that people
will change when they're
dating someone. So I wonder if
I've changed.
translations.どうかなあ。確かになんか変わった気もするけど……。:
Let me see. I feel like you've
changed somehow, but...
translations.あ、わからないんだ。ひどーい。:
Ah, so you can't tell. This is
cruel.
translations.何て言うか……大切なのは変わったかどうかじゃなくて……ああ、ごめん、上手く言えな:
How should I say it...？ It's
not that you totally changed,
but... Aaaah, sorry. I'm not
good at explaining.
translations.うん……昔からずっと同じ……ふふ。:
Yeah... You're the same as
always... Hehe.
translations.●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこともっと好きになってるけど、それでも変わってないかな。:
I love
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
more and more, but I think I
didn't change in other ways.
translations.そ、そういうことを真顔で言われたら……ああ、もうほんと、変わってないんだから。:
H-How can you say that with
such a straight face...？
Aaah, you really haven't
changed at all.
translations.この間の話、覚えてる？:
Do you remember what we've
talked about earlier？
translations.えーと……変わったかどうかって話？:
Well... When you asked me
whether you've changed？
translations.うん。あれから考えたんだけど、やっぱりあなたも変わっているのかなって。:
Yeah. I've been thinking about
it. Actually, I think you've
changed.
translations.ほら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲言ってたじゃん？ 誰かを好きになったら変わるって。なのに、変わ:
Come on,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You said that people change
when they're in love. But then
you told me I hadn't changed
at all.
translations.１年前のあなたの心には、私はいなかったでしょ。でも、今は違うかなって。:
A year before, I have no place
in your heart, right？ But
now, it's different.
translations.そうだね。うん、全然違うな。だって今は……。:
Yeah. Right, it's totally
different. And right now,
I'm...
translations.その先は言わないで！ 口に出して幸せが逃げたら嫌だから……。:
Don't say anymore！ I don't
want to be overjoyed by the
words from your mouth...
translations.ちょっと、聞いてもいい？: Can I ask you a question？
translations.何。あらたまって。:
What？ Why do you become so
formal？
translations.あのね……嘘つかないで、正直に答えてね。:
Well, answer me honestly.
Don't lie, okay？
translations.ええっ!? そんな……悪いわけないよ。:
Eh！？ There's nothing bad
about you, okay？
translations.本当は、年下の可愛い女の子が好きなんじゃない？:
Actually, you prefer a cute
underclassman, right？
translations.まさか。●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲一筋だよ。知ってるくせに……。:
No way. I have only
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
And you already knew that...
translations.本当？ 嘘ついたら、針千本飲ましちゃうからね。:
Really？ If you lie to me,
you'll be punished miserably.
translations.ときどき、思うんだけど……。:
I've been thinking about this
sometimes...
translations.あなたと同じクラスだったら、もっと楽しいのにって。:
Would it be fun if we were in
the same class？
translations.うーん……どうかな？ ちょっと想像つかないかも。:
Hmm... I wonder. I can't
picture it, though.
translations.それは私が年上だから？ 同級生の私って想像できない？:
Is it because I'm older than
you that you couldn't picture
being in the same class as
me？
translations.そんなことはないけど……でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はやっぱり年上のほうが……。:
That's not the case. ...But I
think it's good that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is older than me...
translations.ひょっとして、年上なら誰でも良かった……とか？ もしかして、年上派だったりする？:
Do you mean that any older
woman would do for you？ So
you just like older women in
general, huh？
translations.もちろん、誰でもいいわけないよ。:
No. Of course, it can't be
just anyone.
translations.いじわるなことしちゃったかな。ごめん、困らせるつもりはなかったから。……許してね:
I was just teasing you. I
didn't mean to make you feel
troubled like this. ...Forgive
me, okay？
translations.ねぇ、好きっていうキモチ、いつから始まると思う？:
Hey, do you think you can tell
when you start to love
someone？
translations.難しいな……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどう思う？:
This is difficult...
How about you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.んー、私の場合は……まず相手のことを知りたいって思うところから、かな？:
Hmm, in my case... It starts
when I want to know more about
that person, I think.
translations.興味を持つってこと？:
It means you start to be
interested in that person,
right？
translations.……もう、知りたくなくなったら、どうする？:
...And what will happen once
you don't want to know about
that person anymore？
translations.ふふ。それって、自分のこと気にしてる？:
Hehe. Could it be that you're
getting worried？
translations.それなら大丈夫。知れば知るほど、もっと知りたくなるから。:
It's okay. Whenever I learn
something about you, I even
want to know you more.
translations.男の子にとって女の子は永遠の謎でしょ？ でも、女の子にとっての男の子もやっぱり謎:
Boys always think that girls
are mysterious, right？ But
it's the same to girls when
they think about boys.
translations.そっか……ちょっと安心、かな。:
I see... Somehow I'm a bit
relieved.
translations.自分が好きになった相手が、自分のことを好きだってわかったら嬉しいよね？:
When someone you love loves
you back, you feel happy,
right？
translations.でもそれって、嬉しいだけ？ もっともっと好きになったりしない？:
But are you really satisfied
with that？ Don't you want
that person to love you more
and more？
translations.そのキモチが相手に伝わって、また自分に返ってくる……そういう感じ……。:
It's like you want that person
to know your feelings and
return the feelings to you...
translations.ふふ。よかったな、あなたのこと好きになって……。:
Hehe. I'm glad that I love
you...
translations.あなたを好きになったおかげで、どんどん自分が幸せになってく。:
It makes me feel happy just
because I love you.
translations.あなたもそう思ってくれてたら、嬉しいんだけど？:
If you feel the same way, I'd
be even happier.
translations.（そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に話したかな？ そろそろ●の誕生日だってこと……）:
(By the way, should I tell
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
about my birthday？)
translations.あの、さ。実は●、そろそろタン……。:
Well, actually, it's going to
be my bir--
translations.あ、そうだ。昨日、深夜にやってた映画、見た？ すごく古いロマンスものなんだけど。:
Ah, right. Did you watch the
late night movie last night？
It was an old romantic movie.
translations.えっ？ ううん。昨日は早く寝ちゃって……。:
Eh？ No, I went to bed early
last night...
translations.そっか……私も見てないの。もし見てたら、感想、聞きたかったんだけどなぁ。:
Really...？ I didn't watch it
either. I was thinking you
could tell me what you think
about it.
translations.そっか。それはそうと、そろそろ●の……。:
I see. By the way, it's almost
my bir--
translations.あ！ ねぇねぇ、そういえばさ……。:
Ah！ Hey, hey. Speaking of
which...
translations.（上手く切り出せないな。また今度でいいか……）:
(I can't cut into her
conversation. I'll just talk
about it later...)
translations.（……よし。今日こそ●の誕生日のこと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に言おう）:
(...Okay. Today, I'll tell
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
about my birthday.)
translations.あ、そうだ。お誕生日会ってどう思う？:
Ah, right. What do you think
about a birthday party？
translations.小学校の頃なら話はわかるんだけど……うちのクラスにね、まだやる子がいるの。:
It's understandable if you're
in grade school... But my
classmate actually held it.
translations.ちょっと恥ずかしいと思わない？\nもう高校生なのにお誕生日会\nって。:
Don't you think it's
embarrassing for a high school
student to hold a birthday
party？
translations.でも、大事な友達だったら、お祝いとかしたいと……思わない？:
But you want your close
friends to celebrate your
birthday with you, right？
translations.（そういえば、まだ言えてないんだよな……●の誕生日のこと……）:
(Speaking of which, I still
couldn't tell her about my
birthday...)
translations.ふふ……どうしたの？ なにか私に言いたいこと、あるんじゃない？:
Hehe... What's wrong？ Do you
have anything you want to tell
me？
translations.（でも前に、誕生日を祝うのは恥ずかしいって言ってたし……）:
(But she said before that
celebrating a birthday was
embarrassing...)
translations.もしかして、私には言えないようなこと？:
Could it be something that you
can't tell me？
translations.そんなことないよ。たいしたことじゃないんだ、ほんとに。:
That's not the case. It's just
not that important.
translations.ふーん。全然たいしたことじゃないの？:
Hmm？ So it's not important,
huh？
translations.そうなんだ。じゃあ、私も気にしないね。ふふ。:
I see. Then I don't have to
care about it, right？ Hehe.
translations.（もう少しで●の誕生日だけど……ここまでくると言えないな……）:
(It's almost my birthday.
But... I still couldn't tell
her about it...)
translations.どうかした？ すごく落ち込んでるみたいだけど。:
What's the matter？ You look
very down.
translations.あ、ううん。たいしたことじゃないから……。:
Ah, no. It's not anything
important, so...
translations.ごめん……あ！ ひょっとして最初から？:
Sorry... Ah！ Could it be that
you knew it all along？
translations.ふふ。これでもお姉さん、誰かさんのカノジョなんだけどなぁ。:
Hehe. Who do you think I am？
I'm your girlfriend.
translations.もしかして……お祝いしてくれる予定は……？:
Have you already planned about
my birthday...？
translations.（そういえば、そろそろだっけ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日……）:
(By the way, it's almost
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday...)
translations.そうだ。あなたのクラスで外国の石けんって流行ってる？:
Right. Are foreign soaps
popular among your
classmates？
translations.もちろん、女子によ？ 石けんにこだわる男子なんていないだろうし。:
Of course, I mean among the
girls. I don't think there are
any guys who fuss over soaps.
translations.うーん、女子のことはよくわからないけど、聞いたことないような……？:
Hmm, I don't know about the
girls. I haven't heard anyone
mentioned about soaps,
though...
translations.私のクラスで話題になってるの。使うと肌がすべすべになる石けんがあるって。:
The soaps are very popular in
my class. People say they make
your skin soft and smooth.
translations.私、もうおばさんだから。お肌も気を付けないと、すぐ荒れちゃうし。:
I'm already an old woman, so I
have to worry about my skin.
translations.ふふ、それぐらい気をつけてるってこと。:
Hehe, I'm pretty concerned
about it.
translations.（歳のこと気にしてるんだ……誕生日のこと、言いにくいな）:
(She's that concerned about
her age... I shouldn't mention
her birthday now.)
translations.（そうだ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日のこと、まだ切り出せてなかったんだ）:
(Right. I haven't talked about
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday yet.)
translations.んーっ？ どうして目が泳いでるのかなぁ？:
Huh？ What's wrong？ Why do
you look nervous？
translations.ふふ。私には話せないことなんだ。ふーん。そうなんだ。:
Hehe. So, it's something you
can't tell me？ Hmm... I see.
translations.冗談よ、冗談。ふふ。変なこと言われたわけじゃないんだから、怒るわけないでしょ？:
Just kidding, kidding. Hehe,
if it's not something
perverted, I won't get mad at
you, okay？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日、もうすぐだ……）:
(It's going to be
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday soon...)
translations.んっ？ どうしたの、気合い入れちゃって。:
Hmm？ What's the matter？ You
seem to be nervous.
translations.あ……まさか私のこと、嫌いになった？ それとも飽きちゃった？:
Ah... Don't tell me you don't
love me anymore. Are you
getting bored of me？
translations.じゃあ、他に好きな人ができちゃった？ 同級生？ それとも下級生？:
Then did you fall in love with
someone else？ Who？ Your
classmate or someone in lower
grade？
translations.……本当にそうなったら、すぐ言ってね。二股されるより、ずっといいから。:
...If that happened, you must
tell me, okay？ It's better
than two-timing.
translations.ねぇ……最近、私と話す時、ちょっと気にしてること、あるよね？:
Hey... Lately, I think you've
been trying to say something
to me, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日が気になるってわけじゃなくて……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
but you don't like to talk
about your birthday...
translations.ふふ。私がまたおばさんになること、気にしてるって思ってるんだ。:
Hehe... I think that you won't
like it if I become an old
woman.
translations.そっか……あなたから見て、そんなに気にされるほどおばさんなんだ、私……。:
I see... So from your point of
view, you really see me as an
old woman...
translations.違うよ、そうじゃなくて……●はただ、その……。: No, that's not it... I just...
translations.うん、わかってる。ごめんね、悩んでるあなたが、すっごくカワイイから、ついイジメち:
Yeah, I know. Sorry. You're
cute when you look troubled. I
couldn't help teasing you.
translations.まさか今まで？:
Don't tell me you've been
teasing me all along.
translations.ふふ。誕生日、期待してるからね。:
Hehe. I'll be looking forward
to my birthday.
translations.あ、そういえば、もうすぐ１年だね……。:
Ah, by the way, it's almost
been a year now...
translations.ふふ。次の質問に正解したら許してあげるけど。:
Hehe. If you answer the next
question correctly, I'll
forgive you.
translations.私があなたに告白したのは、何月何日でしょう？:
What was the date and month I
confessed to you？
translations.ご、ごめん……日付まではさすがに……。:
S-Sorry... I can't remember
the exact date...
translations.女の子って、記念日にこだわるものだって知ってる？:
Did you know that girls always
fuss over something like an
anniversary？
translations.……反省します。えーと、多分、１年くらい前の……あ。:
...I'll reflect on this.
Well... It was about a year
ago... Ah！
translations.やっと、わかったみたいね。そう、もうすぐつき合って１周年。今度は忘れないでね。:
You finally realized it, huh？
Yeah, we've been together for
a year. Don't forget about it
again, okay？
translations.（そっか、もう１年か……）:
(I see. It's been a year
already...)
translations.もう１年経つのか……あっという間だな……。:
A year has gone by... It's
just a blink of an eye...
translations.そうだね。思ってたより早かったかな……５年でも１０年でも続けたいね。:
Yeah. It's really fast... Soon
it'll be 5 years... and then
10 years...
translations.５０年経つと何だっけ？ 金婚式？:
How about after 50 years？
Does it called "golden wedding
anniversary"？
translations.それは結婚した場合……そんなに長く付き合ってると、私、おばあちゃんになっちゃうよ:
That's for the case that we
got married... If we stay
together until then, I'll be
an old grandma.
translations.その頃には●もおじいちゃんだから。: And I'll be an old grandpa.
translations.……ふふ。きっと可愛いおじいちゃんだね。安心して。私がちゃんと介護してあげるから:
...Hehe. You'll surely be a
cute grandpa. Don't worry.
I'll take care of you.
translations.なんで●が介護されるの？ 逆の場合だってあり得るんじゃない？:
Why？ It's more likely that
I'll be taking care of you,
right？
translations.どうかな。でも、私は厳しいかも。ちゃんとした介護ができないと、怒っちゃったりして:
I wonder. But it'd be hard for
you. If you wouldn't take care
of me properly, I'd surely get
mad at you.
translations.こうやって２人で並んで歩いていることって、すごく不思議だよね。:
It's quite mysterious that we
are walking together like
this, right？
translations.そうかな？ 恋人なんだし、自然だと思うけど。:
Really？ We are lovers, so I
think this is just natural.
translations.でも１年前は赤の他人でしょ？ バイト先で会わなきゃ、同じ学校だってことさえも知ら:
But a year ago, we were
strangers. If we didn't meet
at work, we wouldn't have
known that we were in the same
school.
translations.ねえ、実はもっと若い女の子と付き合いたかったとか、思う？:
Hey, have you ever thought
that you wanted to date a
younger girl？
translations.まさか。●には▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が一番だよ。:
No way. For me,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is always the only one.
translations.仮にだけど、もし私がバイト先を変えていたら、年上の男の子に会ったのかな？:
Supposed that I changed my job
back then, would I be able to
meet someone older？
translations.そうしたら今歩いている相手はあなたではなくなって……なんかすごい運命だよね。:
If that happened, the one
walking with me now wouldn't
be you... Somehow this might
be our fate.
translations.あれから１年が経って、私はあなたと一緒にいる。:
It's been another year that
we've been together.
translations.あなたは時々、他の子によそ見をしたりするけど……。:
Although sometimes, you like
to look at other girls...
translations.ないない！ 勝手に作らない。: No, no！ Don't make that up.
translations.でも、こんなやり取りも嬉しいなんて。私、あなたとつき合って良かった。来年も、再来:
But I'm very happy. I'm glad I
can be with you. Next year,
and the year after that, we'll
still be together, right？
translations.ねえ、思いついたんだけど、次の１年は役割変えてみない？ 私がお兄ちゃんって甘える:
Hey, how about we switch roles
during next year？ You'll be
an older brother who spoils
me.
translations.どちらかと言うと、●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にお姉さんでいて欲しいんだけど……。:
If I can choose, I want
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
to be an older sister and
spoil me...
translations.そっか。自覚はあったんだ。ふふ……どうしよっかなぁ。:
Really？ You know you're
spoiled, huh？ Hehe. What
should I do？
translations.突然なんだけど、質問があるの。:
This might be abrupt, but I
have a question.
translations.最近、考えちゃうんだけど……本当に私で、よかった？:
I've been thinking about this
lately. ...Am I good for you？
translations.……急にどうしたの？:
...Why do you ask all of a
sudden？
translations.だって……カノジョにするなら同級生や年下のほうが楽しくない？:
Because... Wouldn't it be more
fun if your girlfriend is in
the same grade or younger than
you？
translations.そんなことないよ。一緒にいてほしい人に、歳は関係ないって。:
No, that's not true. Ages
don't matter when it comes to
someone I want to spend time
with.
translations.それならいいんだけど……やっぱり、気になるの。:
That's good then... But, I'm
really worried.
translations.でも私から告白したし……。:
But I was the one to confess
to you...
translations.順番は関係ない、●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が好きだよ。:
Who confessed first doesn't
matter. I love
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
okay？
translations.あ、ちょっと、こんなところで！ もう、恥ずかしいなあ……。:
Ah, wait. How did you say that
here！？ Geez, this is
embarrassing...
translations.ねえ……私に告白されたとき、どう思った？:
Hey... What did you think when
I confessed to you？
translations.どうって、もちろん嬉しかったよ？:
What did I think？ Of course I
was happy.
