translations.ホント？ 私ってこういう性格でしょ？ こう……お姉さんっていうか……。:
Really？ But I was always like
that, right... Like, acting
like your older sister...
translations.その、押しかけ女房みたいっていうか……そういうの、嫌いな人っているでしょ？:
Did you think I was acting
like your stalker...？ That'd
be detestable, right？
translations.どうかな？ でも●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だから好きなんだけど……。:
Hmm？ But because
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
That's why I love you...
translations.……励ますためにわざと言っていない？:
...Did you intentionally say
that to cheer me up？
translations.……私、自信持っても、いい？:
...Then I can have confidence
in myself, right？
translations.そっかあ……ふふ、ちょっと元気出てきたかも。:
Really？ ...Hehe. Now, I feel
a little better.
translations.人を好きになるって、理屈じゃないのよね……。:
The feeling of being in love
is difficult to understand,
right...？
translations.こう……ココロの奥がツーンとするっていうか……電話が鳴ると、ついソワソワしちゃう:
Like... It feels like
something is piercing through
your heart. Or whenever the
phone rings, you feel very
nervous...
translations.私が私じゃないみたいで……いつもドキドキして、このままおかしくなりそう！ ってい:
It feels like you're not
yourself... Your heart keeps
beating so fast and you think
you become weird.
translations.ごめん。話がよくわからないんだけど……。:
Sorry. I don't understand what
you mean...
translations.例えば、って話なんだけど、そういう感じ、しない？:
They are just for examples.
But have you ever felt like
that？
translations.ツーンとしてソワソワしてドキドキ？ ……歯医者に行った時みたいな感覚？:
With something piercing,
nervous feeling, and heart
beating fast？ ...I feel like
that when I go to the dentist.
translations.じゃなくて！ もう、どういう想像力してるのよ。:
Not that！ Geez. What's in
your head！？
translations.この間の話なんだけど……覚えてる？:
Do you remember what we talked
about earlier？
translations.歯医者の話だっけ？:
When we talked about the
dentist？
translations.覚えてはいるみたいだけど、私のしたい話とはちょっとずれてるかな。:
Seems like you remembered. But
what I was trying to say was
not about that.
translations.ねえ、ちょっと聞くけど、私のこと、好き？:
Hey, can I ask you a
question？ Do you love me？
translations.うん……そうだよね。やっぱり、そう言うと思ってた。:
Okay... I see. I thought you'd
say that.
translations.当り前だよ、そんなの。:
It's obvious that I'd say
that.
translations.今の言葉を、息をするみたいに普通に言ってくれる。それが人を好きになるってことなん:
You just said that word
naturally. Yeah, that's what
you'd do when you love
someone. Thank you...
translations.●の？ うん、まだすぐじゃないけどね？:
My birthday？ Yeah, it's
pretty soon, right？
translations.もぅ……せっかくの誕生日なんだから、盛り上がってくれないと寂しいじゃない。:
Geez... It's your own
birthday. If you don't act
more exciting about it, it'd
be boring.
translations.ふふ。照れなくてもいいの。ほら、今ならどんなお願いでも聞いちゃうよ？:
Hehe. You don't have to feel
embarrassed. I can take any
request from you, okay？
translations.バイト代も貯金してるから、ちょっと高いものでもＯＫだよ？:
I got some savings from
part-time job. It's okay if
you want to request something
expensive.
translations.い、いいよ。あんまり高い物もらうと、遠慮しちゃうっていうか。:
N-No. I don't want anything
expensive.
translations.うーん……そうだね。逆に引いちゃうよね、高すぎると。:
Hmm... Right. If it's
something too expensive, you
wouldn't feel good about it.
translations.うん、気持ちは嬉しいけどさ。:
Yeah. Just your feeling is
more than enough.
translations.そうだ。この間の話だけど……。:
Right. What we talked about
earlier...
translations.そう、なにか欲しいもの、ある？:
Yeah. Is there something you
want？
translations.欲しいもの……なんでもいいよ。:
Something I want...？
Anything's fine for me.
translations.そんなの、つまんない。……じゃあ、なにかして欲しいことは？:
Really？ This is boring.
...Then is there anything you
want me to do for you？
translations.して欲しいこと？ 部屋の掃除……かな。:
Something I want you to do for
me？ How about cleaning my
room...？
translations.もぅ……本気でお祝いしたいんだよ？:
Geez... I seriously want to
celebrate your birthday for
you.
translations.ごめん……少し考えてみる。:
Sorry... I'll try to think
about it.
translations.ごめん、考えてはいるんだけど、やっぱりこれっていうのが……。:
Sorry. I've tried to think
about what I want, but...
translations.掃除、して欲しい？:
You want me to clean your
room？
translations.それは冗談というか、単なる思いつきというか……。:
I can't tell whether you're
joking or not...
translations.よくよく考えると、カノジョの特権だと思わない？ カレシの部屋の掃除って。:
To think about it, isn't it a
girlfriend's privilege to
clean her boyfriend's room？
translations.そうかもしれないけど、でもいいって。さすがに●のほうが恥ずかしいし……。:
That's true, but... Is it
really okay？ I think I feel
embarrassed about it...
translations.んー、イヤなら仕方ないけど……興味あるなあ……。:
Hmm... If you don't want me
to, then I won't do it.
...Although I wanted to see
your room...
translations.考えてみたけど、部屋の掃除はやり過ぎだよね……。:
To think about it, it'd be too
much if I really go to clean
your room, right...？
translations.うん、あまり押しかけ女房みたいにはなりたくないし……。:
Yeah, I don't want to act like
a stalker or something like
that...
translations.そうは思わないけど、やっぱり恥ずかしいよ……。:
I wouldn't think of you like
that. I just feel
embarrassed...
translations.とにかく、そっちは気持ちだけもらっとくよ。:
Whatever. I'll only accept
your feelings in this case.
translations.ふふ。じゃああとは気持ち以外のプレゼントも用意しなきゃ。:
Hehe. Then I'll have to
prepare some present that
contains more than just my
feelings.
translations.くれるの？: Will you give me a present？
translations.もちろん、今から楽しみにしておいてくれる？:
Of course. You can start
looking forward to it.
translations.そういえば、そろそろ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日だよね。:
By the way, it's almost
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日、もうそろそろじゃん。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday is pretty soon,
right？
translations.はぁ、またひとつ、歳とっちゃうんだな……。: Hah... I'll be a year older...
translations.（そんなに気にすることないのに……）:
(She doesn't have to concern
about it that much...)
translations.（そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、誕生日の話を避けたいみたいだけど……）:
(By the way, I think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has been avoiding topics about
her birthday...)
translations.悪気は無いんだけど……やっぱり気になるから、聞いてもいい？:
I don't have any bad
intention... but I'm really
concerned. So, can I ask
you...？
translations.えっと……誕生日の話、そんなにイヤ？:
Umm... Why do you hate to talk
about your birthday so much？
translations.イヤ。すっごくイヤ。: I hate it. I really hate it.
translations.やっぱり……●が年下だから？:
Is it because... I'm younger
than you？
translations.あなたがどうとかじゃなくて……ほら、女はそういうこと気になるものなの。:
It's not because of you.
...Come on. Women all care
about their ages.
translations.うん、わかってる……でも、お姉さんは微妙なお年頃なの。だから……ね？:
Yeah, I know that... But this
older sister is really worried
about her age, all right？ Got
it？
translations.また誕生日の話だったら、私、泣いちゃうよ？:
If you talk about my birthday
again, I'll start crying.
translations.……怒るんじゃなくて、泣くの？:
...You won't get mad but
you'll cry instead？
translations.でも……どう言えばいいのかよくわかんないけど、できればお祝いしたいわけで。:
But... I don't know how to say
this, but I really want to
celebrate your birthday.
translations.……うん、それは……わからないわけでもないけど。:
...Hmm. It's not like I don't
understand you.
translations.……じゃあ、気持ちだけ受け取るってことで、どうかな？:
...Well, how about I only
accept your feelings for
this？
translations.うん。気持ちだけでも、お姉さん、すっごく嬉しいから。ふふ、本当だよ？:
Yeah, just your feelings would
make this big sister happy
enough. Hehe. Really.
translations.ねえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。誕生日さ、プレゼントぐらいは……。:
Hey,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
How about a birthday
present...？
translations.まだその話？ だからね、気持ちだけで充分だから……。:
You're talking about this
again？ I told you that your
feelings alone would be
enough...
translations.でも、考えたんだ。逆なら、どうかなって。:
But I've been trying to think
about it backwards.
translations.●だったら、なんでも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にお祝いしてもらうだけで嬉しいなって。:
Yeah. If it was me and
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
did something for me on my
birthday, I'd be very happy.
translations.ふふ。そんなに思ってくれてるんだ。:
Hehe. You have been thinking
about it that much.
translations.わかった。そこまで言われたら断れないし。でも、期待しちゃうぞ？ 覚悟はいい？:
Okay, I got it. If you've
tried this much, I can't
reject it. But now I'm
expecting something good. Are
you well prepared？
translations.１年間、あっという間だったなぁ……。: A year passed by so fast...
translations.どうしたの、突然？:
Why are you saying that all of
a sudden？
translations.１年も続いたなんて、不思議ね。:
It's mysterious that it really
continued on for a year.
translations.やっぱり忘れてるんだ。よーく思い出して。１年経ったのは、わ・た・し・た・ち。:
You really forgot it. Think
about it. It's been a year for
us！
translations.……あっ！ そういえば１年前だっけ!?:
...Ah！ So, that was one year
before！？
translations.ふふ。１年前の今頃だよね、付き合い始めたの。あのときはドキドキしたなぁ。:
Hehe. We started dating around
this time last year. I was
really nervous back then.
translations.こっちもドキドキしたよ。まさか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に告白されるなんて……。:
I was nervous too.
To think that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
confessed to me...
translations.……付き合わなきゃ良かったなんて、思ってる？:
...Have you ever thought that
it'd be better if we weren't
together？
translations.そんなこと全然思わないから、こうしていられるんだと思うんだけど……どうかな？:
I've never thought about
something like that. It's good
that we're together like this,
right？
translations.ふふ。その答え、合格。:
Hehe. I give you a passing
score for that answer.
translations.恋人なんだから、自然じゃない？:
We're lovers, so it's natural,
right？
translations.そういう意味じゃなくて……好きになって、告白して、お付き合いして……。:
I didn't mean it that way... I
mean the fact that I fell in
love with you, confessed to
you, and started dating you...
translations.確かに最初は他人だったからなぁ。:
Yeah. We were just strangers
to begin with.
translations.会えば会うほどかけがえのない人になっていくし……こんなことって、あるんだね。:
Once I met you, gradually you
had become the person I
couldn't live without... Was
it the same to you？
translations.それは●も同じだよ。: Yeah, it was the same to me.
translations.本当？ 飽きたりしない？ 私、年上だし……。:
Really？ Aren't you getting
bored of me？ I'm older than
you...
translations.そんなわけないじゃん。: No, I won't get bored of you.
translations.……そっか。うん。私も毎日が新鮮に感じる。きっと今の私、すっごく幸せなんだろうね:
...I see. Yeah, it still feels
fresh every time I meet you. I
feel like I'm such a lucky
person.
translations.ねえ、私たちの１周年記念、しなくていいのかな。:
Hey, can we not celebrate our
anniversary？
translations.特にしなくていいんじゃない？:
We don't really have to
celebrate it, right？
translations.えっ？ もしかして興味がないの？:
Eh？ So, you don't care about
it？
translations.そうじゃなくて、５年だって１０年だって続くんだから。:
Well, soon it'll be our 5th
anniversary, and then 10th
anniversary and so on.
translations.そう考えてくれてるのは嬉しいけど、この先のことも考えて、やっぱりお祝いするべきだ:
I should be happy to hear
that. But if we think about
the future, we should keep
celebrating it from now on.
translations.あなたが事故に遭いませんようにとか、詐欺に巻き込まれませんようにとか、そういうこ:
Who knows when you might get
in an accident, or being
tempted by other girls？ I
wish these would never happen.
translations.●って、そんなに災難に遭いやすそうに見える？:
Do I look like someone who'd
easily get into accidents？
translations.どうかな……あれ？ 何だか言ってたら不安になってきたような……。:
I don't know... Eh？ Now that
I said it, I've become quite
worried...
translations.（なんか記念日とはだんだん違う方向に……）:
(How did our topic change from
the anniversary to this...？)
translations.この間はつい不安になっちゃったけど、事故なんてそう遭わないよね。:
I've been worried since then,
but it seems like you didn't
get in any accident, right？
translations.うん……まあ、油断はできないけどね。:
Yeah... But I still have to
always be careful.
translations.でもね、別のことはありそうな気がして。:
Anyway, now I have another
thing to worry about.
translations.あなたが若い女の子に誘惑されたり、その子の方を好きになったり……。:
What if some young girl
entices you and you also like
her...？
translations.でも、私は耐えるからね。多少の火遊びくらいなら……。:
In that case, I'll try to bear
with it. If you just want to
flirt with her...
translations.もぅ、そんなことしないってば。: Hey, don't tease me like that.
translations.やるね……満点だよ？:
Great... You get a perfect
score.
translations.もぅ、こんなにドキドキさせて……どうするつもり？:
Hey, what do you intend to do
to make my heart throb like
this？
translations.なんだか恋人みたいじゃない？ 私たち……。:
This makes us look like
lovers, right？
translations.少し恥ずかしいかな……。:
This is a little bit
embarrassing...
translations.うーん……まだまだ頑張れるんじゃない？:
Um... You're trying your best,
huh？
translations.意外に……慣れてたりする？:
You seem to be quite
experienced with this...
translations.うーん……あ、いいのよ？ 気にしなくても。:
Um... Ah, this is fine. Don't
worry.
translations.よくできました、かな？: You think that was good, huh？
translations.次は……もっと……ね？:
Next time... I want more,
okay...？
translations.これは……ダメなんじゃない、かな？:
Hey... This is... not too bad,
I guess.
translations.頑張ってくれたよね？ それはわかるんだけど……。:
You're trying hard, right？ I
know it, but...
translations.もう少し、なんとかしてほしいな。:
You should do something about
this...
translations.マシには、なったかな……。:
Is there anything better than
this...？
translations.もっとちゃんと考えなきゃ、ダメ！:
You'd better consider more
about this. Stop！
translations.隣、行ってもいいかな？: Can I stay by your side？
translations.動かないで……もっとそばに行ってあげる。:
Don't move... I'm going to get
closer to you.
translations.ふふ、どうしたの？ 顔、ちょっと赤いよ？:
Hehe, what's wrong？ You face
is getting red.
translations.ね、もっとくっつかない？:
Hey, don't you want us to get
closer？
translations.あなたの体温、感じたい……。:
I can feel your body
temperature...
translations.ちょっとだけ……近くに行くからね？:
I'll get closer to you just a
little bit, okay？
translations.私の顔……なにかついてる？:
Is there something sticking on
my face？
translations.ふふ。それから……どうするつもり？:
Hehe... What do you intend to
do？
translations.ふふふ、私のコト、そんなに好きなの？:
Hehehe. Do you like me that
much？
translations.まだ……ちょっと、恥ずかしいかな。こういうの。:
Not yet... This is getting
awkward.
translations.緊張しないで……ね？ もっとリラックスして。:
Don't be nervous, okay？ Just
relax.
translations.積極的なのって……すごく嬉しいな。:
I'm so happy when you take
charge like this...
translations.もっと……近くてもいいよ。: You can come closer to me...
translations.ふふ、大丈夫？ ちゃんとできる？:
Hehe, are you okay？ Can you
do it？
translations.拒まないから……安心して。:
I'm not going to refuse, so
don't worry.
translations.もっと側にきても、いいよ？:
You can come closer to me. I
don't mind.
translations.触れてもいいよ？ あなたなんだから……。:
I don't mind if you want to
touch me...
translations.もっと触れ合いたい……。: I want you to touch me more...
translations.私じゃ……ダメなのかな。: I don't think this is good...
translations.そういう気分じゃ、ないんだ……。:
I'm not in the mood for
this...
translations.もぅ……こっちはそういう気分なのに……。:
Hey... I was really in the
mood...
translations.もっと近づきたかったんだけどな。:
I wanted to get closer to you,
but...
translations.だーめ。いまは、まだ、ね？:
No~！ We are not ready for
this, okay？
translations.こういうの、まだ照れるの。そういう気分のときもあるんだから。:
This is still quite awkward.
Maybe we should consider the
mood.
translations.今は、ね。また今度してあげるから。:
Not now. Maybe we can do this
later.
translations.ダーメ。ふふ、イジワルしちゃった。: No！ Hehe. I was teasing you.
translations.もう少し、いいでしょ？:
A little bit more might be
good, right？
translations.ふふ、まだ足りないんだけどな？:
Hehe, this is still not
enough.
translations.ふふ、すぐこうなるんだから。:
Hehe, now I've become like
this.
translations.ずっと……側にいてあげるね。:
Stay by my side forever,
okay？
translations.そんなに……見ちゃダメ。: Don't look at me like that...
translations.恥ずかしいから……あんまり見ないで。:
It's embarrassing... Don't
look at me.
translations.ふう……なんだか安心しちゃうね……。:
Phew... Somehow, I feel
relieved now...
translations.もっと……いいんじゃない？:
Some more... would be nice,
right？
translations.ずっと、こうしててね。: Let us be like this forever.
translations.また……するの？: You want to do this again？
translations.女の子には、優しく、だよ？:
You should be gentle to a
girl, you know？
translations.キス、しないの？: Are you going to kiss me？
translations.しても、いいんだよ？: I don't mind if you do it.
translations.まだ、ガマンしてるの？: Are you trying to hold it？
translations.いま、同じこと考えてたでしょ。:
We are thinking about the same
thing, aren't we？
translations.やり方は、わかるよね？: You know what to do, right？
translations.お願い……もう一度、いいでしょう？:
Please... Once more. That's
okay, right？
translations.これ、好きになっちゃった……。: I like this more and more...
translations.ねえ、もう１回だけ……お願い。:
Hey, one more time... I beg
you.
translations.もう１回しちゃお。ねっ？: Do it one more time. Okay？
translations.ねぇ、足りないでしょ？:
Hey, this is not enough,
right？
translations.もっと……あなたを感じたいの……。:
More... I want to feel you
more...
translations.もっと近くで……ね、いいでしょう？:
Come closer... Hey, it's okay,
right？
translations.心臓がパンクしちゃいそう……。:
I feel as if my heart is going
to burst out...
translations.心が満たされるって、こういう気持ちなんだね。:
It feels like my heart has
been filled up.
translations.ふたりの距離が縮まった……って、思わない？:
Do you feel like the distance
between us has become
shorter...？
translations.もっと……あなたを知りたいな……。:
More... I want to know you
more...
translations.幸せすぎて怖いくらい……どうしてくれるの？:
I'm too happy that I feel
scared... What will you do
then？
translations.これからも、ずっとそばにいてね？:
You will be by my side
forever, right？
translations.まだドキドキしてる、聞こえちゃった？:
My heart is throbbing. Can you
hear it？
translations.大好き、だよ？ ふふ、知ってるよね……。:
I love you. Hehe, you know it,
right？
translations.もうずっと……離しちゃダメだよ？:
We will never be apart,
right？
translations.また次も、いいよね？:
You can keep doing this,
okay？
translations.今度は、もっとしちゃおうかな……？:
Will it be more than this next
time...？
translations.恥ずかしいけど……それより、嬉しかった。:
It's embarrassing, but at the
same time, I'm happy.
translations.私、とっても満たされてるよ、あなたのおかげで。:
I really feel satisfied.
Thanks to you.
translations.ふう……なんだか頭がクラクラしちゃった。:
Phew... Somehow, this makes me
feel dizzy.
translations.好き……いつまでも、こうしていられればいいんだけど……。:
I like this... I wonder how
long we can keep doing this...
translations.私、あなたにメロメロになっちゃったみたい……。:
I feel like I'm madly in love
with you now.
translations.いつも……涙が出そうになるの、ヘンだよね。:
I'm in tears again. This is
weird, huh？
translations.ずっとずっと、側にいてね？:
You will always be by my side,
right？
translations.あなたとひとつになったみたいで、安心する……。:
I feel like I've become one
with you. Such a relieving
feeling...
translations.今後に期待しておくから……。:
I'll have some expectation
from now on...
translations.タイミング、ちゃんとわかってる？:
You know the right timing,
huh？
translations.あなたは良くても……私が良くないこともあるよ？:
There are things that you like
but I don't.
translations.楽しいことは、取っておくのもいいよね。:
We should hold on to the fun
moment, okay？
translations.今日はちょっと残念……またね。:
Today is not good... Maybe
later.
translations.あんまり焦らないで。ゆっくりいきましょ？:
Don't rush it. We should take
it slowly, right？
translations.うん……のんびりいけば、いいんじゃないかな……。:
Well... It's better if we take
some more time...
translations.今日は、タイミングが合わなかったね。:
It's such a bad timing for
today.
translations.もっと考えなきゃ、ダメよ？:
You have to consider it more,
okay？
translations.ん……カラダがしびれちゃった……。:
Hmm... My body has gone
numb...
translations.私、こんなに、熱くなってる。: I feel so warm like this.
translations.今日みたいなキスが、またできたらいいね。:
I hope we can kiss like this
again.
translations.あなたを、独りじめしたくなっちゃった。: I want to keep you to myself.
translations.もうなにも言わないで……嬉しくて、泣いちゃうから。:
I can't say a word now... I'm
so happy that I'm going to
cry.
translations.ずっとこのままそばにいてくれないと、許さないから▼:
I won't allow you to stay away
from me even for a moment▼
translations.いつものことなのに……なんだろう、今日は特別嬉しいの……。:
We do this so often but why do
I feel very happy like this
today？
translations.もっと、あなたのこと知りたい。私のことも、全部教えてあげるから……。:
I want to know more about you.
I will also tell you
everything about myself...
translations.まだ頭がぼおっとしてる……好きよ、大好き。:
Everything in my head turns
blank now... I love you. I
really love you.
translations.私のこと、ずっと離さないで……ずっと、ずっと、離さないでね？:
You will never leave me...
Never ever going to leave me,
right？
translations.ダメ……このままじゃ私、あなたのこと離せなくなっちゃう。いい？:
No... If you do this, I won't
be able to stay away from you.
Is that okay？
translations.もう、あなたから、離れられないよ……。:
Hey, I don't want you to ever
leave me...
translations.もう私、あなたしか目に入らない……あなたのせい、だからね……。:
Now, I can't take my eyes off
of you... It's your fault...
translations.私きっと今、世界中で一番幸せ。きっと、これからもだね。全部、あなたのおかげ。:
I feel like I'm the luckiest
person in the world. Of
course, that's because of what
you did.
translations.もう、カラダが言うこと効かなくなっちゃう……ズルいよ。私のこと、こんなにまでしち:
Hey, can't you sense my body
language？ You're so crafty.
You made me become like this.
translations.女の子ってさ、恋をすると詩とか書いちゃうのかな。:
Do girls like to write some
poems when they're in love？
translations.あ、ううん、なんでも……。あまり書かないんじゃないかな、普通。:
Ah, no. It's nothing... I
don't think I'd do something
like that...
translations.薄着になるとさ、服が透けちゃったりするよね。:
When you wear a thin blouse,
it's easy to see through it.
translations.……もぅ、いきなり何言い出すの？:
...Geez. What are you saying
all of a sudden？
translations.うん……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も気を付けてねってこと。:
Well... I'm just thinking that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
should be careful with it.
translations.あ、独占欲？:
What？ You want to monopolize
me？
translations.人間に尻尾が生えるとしたら、どこから生えるのかな……。:
If humans have tails, where do
you think the tails will grow
from...？
translations.このへんかな……それとも、このへん……？:
Will the tails grow out from
here...？ Or here...？
translations.あ……ははは、なんでもない。:
Ah... Hahaha. I didn't do
anything.
translations.あ、センセ……じゃなくて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。なんでもないよ。:
Ah, Teacher... No. I mean
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
It's nothing.
translations.だったらいいけど、いきなり“網タイツ”なんて独り言は言わないほうがいいわよ？ 変:
If so, that's good. Just don't
mumble something like "fishnet
stockings" to yourself. People
will think you're a pervert.
translations.えっ!? な、なに、それ？:
Eh！？ W-Why did you call me
like that？
translations.もぅ、すぐ笑ってごまかそうとするんだから……ふふ、でもカワイイから許しちゃう。:
Geez. Don't deceive me with
that laugh. ...Hehe, but
you're cute, so I can forgive
you.
translations.ふふ……温泉って、いいよね。:
Hehe... Hot spring is nice,
right？
translations.昨日ね、お風呂に温泉の素、入れてみたの。ふふ、肌の感じ違うと思わない？:
Yesterday, I tried some hot
spring bath set when I took a
bath. I could feel that it was
different from normal bath.
translations.うん、うなじがキレイだった……。:
Yeah, and you were so
pretty...
translations.え、何か言った？: Huh？ What did you just say？
translations.ううん。たしかにいつにも増して肌がキレイかな、ははは。:
No. I mean if you use it
often, your skin will become
so pretty. Hahaha.
translations.いいから、ちょっとそのままでいてね……。:
Just stand still for me,
okay...？
translations.う、うわっ！ ●の首筋に何かっ!?:
W-Whoa！ What are you doing
with my neck！？
translations.襟元が乱れてたから直しただけよ？ どうしたの、慌てちゃって。ふふ。:
Your collar is a mess, so I
fixed it for you. Why do you
get flustered like that？
Hehe.
translations.あ、ありがとう……はぁ、びっくりした……。:
Ah, thank you... Hah... I was
scared...
translations.ねぇ、私最近太ったかな……？:
Hey, do you think I've gained
weight...？
translations.ぜんぜん！ 見ててもわかんないよ。:
Not at all！ That's not how
you look to me.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、いつも若くてスリムだよ！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is always young and slim！
translations.どうしたの？ 深刻な顔して。:
What's wrong？ Why do you look
so serious？
translations.今、行きたいところとかある？ 食べたいものとか、あとは……えっと……。:
Is there a place you want to
go？ Or something you want to
eat？ Or...
translations.……ふふ、急にどうしたの？:
...Hehe. What is this all of a
sudden？
translations.●に何か不満とかあるかなって……。:
Is there anything that you're
not happy about me...？
translations.もぅ、一緒にいてくれれば、それでいいよ？:
Geez. Just having you with me
like this is more than enough,
okay？
translations.どうしたの、風邪？ ●、看病しようか!?:
What's wrong？ Are you having
a cold？ Do you want me to
nurse you！？
translations.えっ？ ううん、平気。少し喉がムズムズしただけで……あ。それとも、看病してみたい:
Eh？ No, I'm fine. My throat
just felt a little itchy...
Ah, do you really want to
nurse me？
translations.うん、すりりんご、食べさせてあげるからさ。:
Yeah, I can feed you some
grated apple too.
translations.もぅ、私はそんな子供じゃありません。: Geez. I'm not a kid anymore.
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\n●に何か用？:
Eh？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Is there anything you want？
translations.用ってほどじゃないけど……\nほら、今日は……ね？\n迷惑じゃなければ……。:
I don't want anything, but...
Hey, you know what day it is
today, right？ I hope I'm not
bothering you...
translations.ちょっと失敗したかも\nしれないから……もし、\n美味しくなかったら、ごめんね。:
I did something wrong when I
made it... Sorry if it doesn't
taste good.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\n作ったんなら、\n美味しいに決まってるよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
made it for me. I'm sure that
it'll taste good.
translations.だから……ちょっと、\n失敗しちゃったの。\n味見してみたけど、\nあなたの舌に:
I said I did something wrong.
It's edible, but I don't have
any confidence that you'd like
it.
translations.いいや、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の\nチョコレートは絶対美味しいね。\nそう決めた！:
No way. If
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
made it, I'm sure that it'll
taste good！
translations.あーん、もう、いじわる……\nでも、ちょっと嬉しいかも。\nふふ、ありがとう。:
Hey, stop teasing me... But,
you made me happy. Hehe.
Thanks.
translations.あっ、いたいた。\nもぅ……もしかして\n今日が何の日か忘れてる？:
Ah, you're here. Come on...
Did you forget what today is？
translations.……ふーん。そうなんだぁ。\nやっぱり忘れてたんだ。:
...Hmm. So, you really forgot
about it.
translations.私、お付き合いしている人に\n手作りチョコレート、\nあげるつもりだったんだけど:
I'm looking for a person who
will take my homemade
chocolate. I don't know if I
got the wrong guy here...
translations.今日はバレンタインデーか！\nごめん、思い出した！:
Today's Valentine's Day！
Sorry. I just realized it！
translations.無理して\n受け取らなくてもいいよ？\n他にも受け取ってくれる人、\nどこかにい:
You don't have to force
yourself to take it. I think
there might be someone else
who wants this.
translations.ください！\nごめんなさい！\nお願いします！:
Please！ I'm sorry. Please
give it to me！
translations.ふふ。素直に謝ってくれる\n可愛いカレシには\n……はい、ご褒美。:
Hehe, for such a boyfriend who
obediently apologizes to me...
Here's your reward.
translations.あ、みーつけた！\nもぅ、探したんだから。:
Ah, I found you！ Hey, I've
been looking for you.
translations.可愛い男の子限定の\nスペシャルなチョコレートが\nあるんだけど……どうする？:
I have this special chocolate
for a cute boy. What should I
do with it？
translations.……あ、今日、\nバレンタインデーか。\nありがとう、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
Ah, today is Valentine's Day.
Thank you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.でもその前に……\n今年、他の子からもらった？\n今のうちに白状するなら、\n大:
But before I give this to
you... Confess now. Did you
receive any chocolates from
other girls before this one？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に\n言われるまで\n忘れるぐらいだから……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I didn't even realize about it
until I met you.
translations.……じゃあ、今年のチョコ、\n私の１個だけ？:
...Then you only got just one
chocolate this year, from me,
right？
translations.じゃあ……こほん……\nいつも一緒にいてくれて、\nありがとう。\nいーっぱいの:
Then... Ahem... Thank you for
always staying by my side. Can
you accept my love-filled
chocolate？
translations.うん……ありがとう、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\nすごく、嬉しいよ。:
Yes. Thank you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm very happy.
translations.あっ、いたいた。そこの後輩くん。ちょっとちょっと。:
Ah, that boy right there. Wait
a minute.
translations.いいから、ほら……はい、チョコレートっ。:
Hey, come on... Here's your
chocolate.
translations.一応、義理ってことで……そんなに深く考えないでね？:
I just give this out of
obligation, so you don't have
to concern about it so much.
translations.でも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲から貰えるなんて……うれしいよ。:
But,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
gave it to me. I'm happy.
translations.ふふ。そんなに喜んでもらえると、こっちとしても嬉しいかな。あ……もしかして、甘い:
Hehe. If you're that happy,
I'm very glad too. Ah... Don't
tell me that you love eating
sweets.
translations.好みがあったら教えてね。今後の参考にするから。ふふ。:
If you like it, just tell me.
I can use it for reference
next time. Hehe.
translations.うん。\n今日はホワイトデーだから、\nバレンタインデーのお返しを\n……さ。:
ell, today is White Day. So, I
have a Valentine's Day's
return gift for you.
translations.わあ……\nあ、でも、無理してない？\n大丈夫？:
Wow... Ah, but did you overdo
it？ Is this okay？
translations.そんな心配はいいから。\n開けてみてよ。:
Don't worry about that. Just
open it.
translations.うわぁ……\nこれ、本当に貰っていいの？\nうれしい……。:
Wow... Is it really okay for
me to take this？ I'm happy...
translations.ありがとう。大切にするね。: Thanks. I'll take care of it.
translations.えっと……\nプレゼントは気持ちだもんね。\nありがとう。:
Well... It's the feeling that
matters... Thanks.
translations.（あまり喜んでくれなかった\nみたいだ……）:
(She doesn't seem to like it
that much...)
translations.あなたから\nお返しをもらえるなんて、\n感激しちゃった。:
Now, I'm very impressed that
you even gave me a return
gift.
translations.感激って……\nそんなにたいしたもの\nじゃないよ、ホントに。:
Impressed...？ This is not
such a big deal, really.
translations.でも、私のために\n選んでくれたんでしょ？\nそう思うと、すごく幸せなの……\n:
But you must've put some
effort into choosing this for
me, right？ Thinking about
that makes me happy. ...Is it
weird？
translations.おかしくないけど、\nちょっと照れくさい\nというか……。:
It's not weird... But it makes
me feel a little awkward.
translations.私だって……\nふふ、来年になっても、\nまだ照れくさいのかな？:
But for me... Hehe, I wonder
if you'll still feel awkward
next year.
translations.もう来年の話？:
Are we talking about next year
already？
translations.だって、\n１年に１度のイベントでしょ？\nはぁ……来年のチョコ、\nなんにしよ:
Because this only happens once
a year, right？ Hah... What
kind of chocolate shall I make
next year？
translations.今日はホワイトデーだからさ。\nバレンタインデーのお返しを\n持ってきたんだ。:
Today is White Day, so I have
this Valentine's Day's return
gift for you.
translations.ふふ。どうしてもお返しが\nしたいっていうなら、\n受け取ってあげてもいいかな？:
Hehe. If you want to give it
to me that much, I should take
it, right？
translations.うん、どうしても\nお返しがしたいから……さ。\nほら、開けてみてよ。:
Yes, I really want to give it
to you. Come on. Open it.
translations.わぁ、素敵……\nふふ、私の好み、\nよくわかってるんだ。\nちょっと意外かな？:
Wow, wonderful... Hehe. You
really know my taste. This is
a little unexpected.
translations.まあまあの選択、かな？\nふふ。: Not so bad, I think. Hehe.
translations.お返しなんかもらって……\nかえって悪いこと\nしちゃったかな？:
Is it bad that I even take a
return gift from you...？
translations.そんな、遠慮しないでよ。\n●のほうこそ、チョコ、\nすごく嬉しかったから……。:
Don't worry about that. I was
really happy when I got a
chocolate from you.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。じゃあ、\n来年はもっと大きなチョコ、\n用意しないとね。:
Hehe. Thanks. Then I'll make a
bigger chocolate for you next
year. You'd better be
prepared.
translations.もちろん、\nそれに見合うお返し、\n期待していいんでしょ？:
Yes. And then I can expect
something big as a return gift
too, right？
translations.ふふ。冗談よ、冗談。\nその気持ちだけで、けっこう満足\nしちゃってるんだから…:
Hehe. Just kidding. Just your
feeling is more than enough
for me, okay？
translations.うん……じゃあ、\n来年も無理しない程度に、\nお返しするよ。:
Okay... Then next year, I'll
try to find a return gift that
is not too impossible to
afford.
translations.あっ、いたいた。\nおーい、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
Ah, there you are. Hey,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あ、何か用？\nふふ、なんの用かなぁ、\n思いつかないなぁ。:
Ah, you got some business with
me？ Hehe. I wonder if it's
what I'm thinking.
translations.お見通しみたいだけど……\nはい、\nホワイトデーのプレゼント。:
I guess it is... Here you go.
Your White Day present.
translations.うん、ありがとう！\n本当はとーっても、\n楽しみにしてたの！:
Yay, thanks！ I've been
looking forward to it. Really.
translations.開けてみてよ。\n気に入るかどうか\n不安だけど……。:
Open it. I'm not sure if you'd
like it or not.
translations.わあ……ありがとう！\nあなたって、もしかして\n私の心、読めたりする？:
Wow... Thanks！ Did you read
my mind when you chose this？
translations.あ……これ、\n私のために選んでくれたんだ。\nふふ、ありがとう。:
Ah... You chose this for me.
Hehe. Thanks.
translations.あなた、もしかしたら\nホワイトデー忘れてるん\nじゃないかって思った……。:
I thought that you might
forget about White Day...
translations.あーあ、\nおしおきセットが\n無駄になっちゃった。:
Hah... I can't use the
punishment combo that I've
prepared then.
translations.ホワイトデーを忘れてたら、\nもっと楽しいことに\nなってたのにぃー。:
It'd be better if you really
forgot about White Day！
translations.ふふ。\n忘れてたほうがよかったかもよ？\nだって、私の気がすむまで……\nいろ:
Hehe. I wish you'd forget.
That way, I could make you do
a lot of things to make up for
it.
translations.ぷっ……\nもぅ、顔が真っ赤。\nふふ、カワイイ……。:
Haha！ You face is all red.
Hehe. So cute...
translations.うん、今日はホワイトデーだから……はい、プレゼント。:
Well, today is White Day,
so... Here's your present.
translations.わぁ、ありがとう。ふふ、ここで開けもいい？:
Wow, thanks. Hehe. Can I open
it now？
translations.素敵……こんなお返しもらえるなんて……思ってなかった。:
Wonderful... I didn't expect
that I would get this as a
return gift.
translations.ふふ。素敵なお返し、ありがとう。:
Hehe. Such a wonderful gift.
Thanks.
translations.（あまり喜んでくれなかったみたいだ……）:
(She doesn't seem to like it
that much...)
translations.でも……お返しなんて、しなくていいのに。かえって悪いことしちゃったかな？:
But... You didn't have to give
me this return gift. Did I
make you feel bad about this？
translations.でも、私のプレゼントはただのチョコだよ？:
But, what I gave you was just
a chocolate.
translations.でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の心がこもったチョコだから……。:
But, that chocolate
was filled with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
love...
translations.あ……なんか変なこと言っちゃったかな？:
Ah... Did I say something
weird？
translations.（あっ、しまった！ ホワイトデーなのに、お返しを用意してなかった……）:
(Ah！ No way！ I forgot to
prepare a present for White
Day...)
translations.ううん、なんでも……ところで、ほら、その……忘れたというか……。:
No, nothing's wrong... By the
way, I kind of forgot about
today...
translations.……そう。別にいいの。お返しをもらうのが目的じゃないから。私はいいの。一方通行で:
...I see. Never mind. I didn't
expect to get anything back.
I'm fine. It's just a one-way
gift then...
translations.（●は三国一の大馬鹿者だー！）:
(I'm the most idiotic guy in
the world！)
translations.あ……ふふ、どうしたの？ 私を見るなり慌てたみたいだけど？:
Ah... Hehe. What's wrong？ You
looked panic the moment you
saw me.
translations.えーと……ほら、今日の、あれを……。:
Um... You see... Today is...
that...
translations.ふーん。つまりあなたにとって、その程度ってことなんだ。わかりました。:
Hmm... So, that's what you
think about today, huh？ I get
it now.
translations.あ、どうしたの？ なんだか慌ててるけど。:
Ah, what's wrong？ Why do you
panic like that？
translations.あの……ごめん！ 今日がホワイトデーだってこと、すっかり忘れちゃって……。:
Um... Sorry！ I totally forgot
that today is White Day...
translations.そうなんだ……いいのよ。気にしなくても。ちょっと楽しみにしちゃってたけど……。:
I see... Fine then. Don't
worry. I was just looking
forward to it for nothing...
translations.その……ごめん！ ホワイトデーのお返し、用意するの忘れました！:
Um... Sorry！ I forgot to
prepare White Day's gift！
translations.あ……そう。そういうことなら、仕方ないよね。うん、私は別に……ね？:
Ah, I see. If that's the case,
it can't be helped then. Don't
worry about me... okay？
translations.いよいよ競技開始か。なんだか妙に緊張するなあ。:
The match is about to start.
Somehow, I feel nervous.
translations.あっ、いたいた。学年は違うけど、お互い頑張ろうね。:
Ah, you're here. We're in
different school years, but we
both must do our best.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。応援に来てくれたとか？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Did you come here to cheer for
me？
translations.ふふ。あなたの活躍、見に来てあげたの。:
Hehe. I want to see you while
you're participating in the
events.
translations.うん、ありがとう……よし、頑張るぞ！:
Okay, thanks... All right.
I'll do my best！
translations.あっ、でも、怪我をしないように気をつけること。どこか痛くなったら言うのよ？:
Ah, but you must be careful
and don't hurt yourself. If
you get hurt, you must tell
me.
translations.大丈夫だって。危険なこと、やるわけじゃないし。:
It's okay. It's not like I'm
going to do anything
dangerous.
translations.うん……とにかく、無理はしないで頑張ってね。:
Okay... Do your best but don't
overdo it, okay？
translations.やっぱり私が見込んだだけはあるかな？ ふふ、すごい活躍だったね。:
As I could expect from you.
Hehe. Such great effort you
made.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の応援のおかげだよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
it was because you were
cheering for me.
translations.可愛いこと言ってくれちゃって。なでなでしてあげようか？:
You're saying something cute
like that. Do you want me to
pat your head？
translations.い、いいよ。みんなが見てるから……。:
N-No, I'm fine. Everyone's
looking this way...
translations.（普段から鍛えてた甲斐があったな……）:
(I'm glad I've been working
hard on this...)
translations.ごめん、応援してくれたのに。:
Sorry. Even though you were
cheering for me...
translations.ううん。頑張ったじゃない。それだけで充分でしょ？:
No, you already tried your
best, right？ I think that's
good enough.
translations.その気持ちがあれば次は大丈夫。応援してるから。ね？:
Next time you can do better,
right？ I'll keep cheering for
you, okay？
translations.ねえ、友達から聞いたんだけど……あなた、美男子コンテストに出るの？:
Hey, I heard from my
friends... Are you
participating in the Most
Handsome Man Contest？
translations.うん……話、そっちにまでいってるんだ。:
Yeah... Even your friends
heard about it, huh？
translations.すごいのね、驚いちゃった。:
This is amazing. Such a
surprise.
translations.なんだか担ぎあげられて……どうせ、すぐに落選するって。:
I'm a bit pressured. ...I
think I'll fail to qualify in
the very first round.
translations.どうかな？ もしかしたら、いいところまで行くかもしれないよ？:
Why？ I think you have the
quality to be the most
handsome man.
translations.うーん、ちょっと頑張ろうっかな？:
Okay, now I think I'll just
try my best.
translations.ふふ。私も応援してるから、頑張ってね。:
Hehe. I'll be cheering for
you, so you must do your best.
translations.おめでとう！ 本当に優勝しちゃうなんて！:
Congratulations！ You really
won the contest！
translations.そんなことないよ？ 私は断然、あなたがかっこいいって思ってるんだから。:
That's not true. I can tell
you that you're absolutely
handsome.
translations.ふふ。これからも素敵な男の子でいてね。:
Hehe. Please continue being a
wonderful man, okay？
translations.（普段から見た目に気をつかってた甲斐があったな……）:
(It's good that I always take
care of my appearance.)
translations.（コンテスト、ダメだった……）:
(The contest result was
totally no good...)
translations.惜しかったね……あともう少しだったのに。:
This is regrettable... You
were so close.
translations.周りの出場者、かっこいい人ばっかだったし。:
All the participants were much
more handsome than me.
translations.そんなことないよ。私は、あなたの方が……。:
That's not true. For me, you
are...
translations.審査員に見る目がないのよ。もぅ、なんでわかんないのかな……。:
The judges probably have bad
eyesight. Geez. They just
couldn't see it...
translations.（もう少し見た目に気をつかった方がいいかな……）:
(I should've paid more
attention to my appearance.)
translations.メリークリスマス。素敵な夜ね。:
Merry Christmas. Tonight is
such a wonderful night.
translations.メリークリスマス。みんなでお祝いするのもいいもんだね。:
Merry Christmas. It's nice to
celebrate this occasion with
everyone here.
translations.そうね。たまにはこういうのもいいかも。:
Yeah. It's nice to have
something like this
occasionally.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のドレス、すごく似合ってるね……大人の女性って感じで。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
dress is really nice. It makes
you look mature and feminine.
translations.あの……私からのクリスマスプレゼント、あるんだけど……。:
Well... I have a Christmas
present for you...
translations.ありがとう。●も用意してるよ。:
Thanks. I also have a present
for you.
translations.わぁ……素敵……私、今年のクリスマス、きっと一生忘れられないと思う……。:
Wow... Wonderful... I'll never
forget this year's Christmas
for the rest of my life...
translations.わあ、ありがとう。私、こういうものも好きよ。: Wow, thanks. I also like this.
translations.えっと……ありがとう。あなたが頑張って選んでくれたんだよね？:
Well... Thanks. You really
tried your best to pick this
one for me, right？
translations.プレゼントって、サンタクロースとか？:
Present？ You mean a present
from Santa Claus？
translations.（しまった、何かプレゼント用意しておいた方がよかったか？）:
(Oh no. I should've gotten
something for her.)
translations.ねぇ、少し……いいかな？:
Hey, you still have some
time...？
translations.じゃあ、私はそろそろ帰るね……。: Okay, I have to go home...
translations.メリークリスマス。すごく賑やかなパーティーだね。:
Merry Christmas. It's such a
lively party, huh？
translations.メリークリスマス。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、そのドレス似合ってるね。:
Merry Christmas.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you look good in that dress.
translations.あら、ありがとう。お世辞も言えるようになったんだ。:
Eh？ Thanks. You really
flattered me.
translations.ふふ、今日はクリスマスだから、素直に聞いてあげる。:
Hehe. Since today's Christmas,
I'll take it as your honest
opinion.
translations.そういえば、プレゼントあるんだけど？:
By the way, I have a present
for you.
translations.ほんと？ ●も用意してるんだ。:
Really？ I also have a present
for you.
translations.わあ……ふふ、これなら、合格。ありがとう。大切にするね。:
Wow... Hehe, this is nice.
Thanks. I'll treasure it.
translations.ふふ。合格、かな。ありがとう。意外とわかってるんだ、私の好み。:
Hehe. I think it's nice.
Thanks. Somehow, you know what
I like.
translations.うーん……もう少しがんばりましょう、かな？ ふふ、来年に期待ね。:
Hmm... Maybe you should try
harder next time. I'm looking
forward to next year's
present.
translations.あ、そういえばね……プレゼント！:
Ah, speaking of which... About
the present！
translations.プレゼント？ ●のとこにはもうサンタクロースは来なくなったな……。:
Present？ I don't think Santa
Claus will give me any...
translations.このあと、付き合ってくれる？:
Can you accompany me after
this？
translations.私はそろそろ帰るから、じゃあ……。: I have to go home now. Bye...
translations.メリークリスマス。ずいぶん盛大なパーティーだね。:
Merry Christmas. It's such a
magnificent party.
translations.メリークリスマス……そのドレス、すごく、似合ってるね。:
Merry Christmas... That dress
really suits you well.
translations.ふふ、急にお世辞なんて……今更口説いてどうするつもり？:
Hehe... You're flattering me
all of a sudden. Do you want
anything？
translations.ありがとう。他の誰かにほめられるより、あなたにほめてもらえるのが一番嬉しいな。:
Thanks. Even though others
also praised me, I wasn't as
happy as when I heard your
compliment.
translations.そうだ。寧々サンタからのクリスマスプレゼントがあるんだけど？:
Right. Are you ready to get a
present from Santa Nene？
translations.ありがとう、●もサンタ役の準備はできてるよ？:
Thanks. I've also prepared to
be Santa Claus myself.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ交換だね？:
Hehe. How about we exchange
the presents？
translations.わあ……あなたからこんなに素敵なプレゼントがもらえるなんて……うん、一生の宝物に:
Wow... To receive such a
wonderful present from you...
Yes, I'll treasure this all my
life.
translations.……ふふ。これからの成長に期待、かな？:
...Hehe. I probably have to
wait until you're more mature,
huh？
translations.ね、サンタさんになれる準備はできてる？:
Hey, have you prepared to take
the role of Santa Claus？
translations.はは。サンタクロースなんてもう卒業したよ。:
Haha. I'm too old to believe
in Santa Claus.
translations.一緒に行きたいとこがあるんだけど、このあと付き合ってくれないかな？:
I still want to be with you.
Will you accompany me a little
longer？
translations.あ、もう帰らなきゃ……じゃあね？:
Ah, I have to go home... See
you later.
translations.メリークリスマスっ！ パーティー、楽しんでる？:
Merry Christmas！ Are you
enjoying the party？
translations.あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……ドレス、すごく似合ってるね。:
Ah,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
You look nice in that dress.
translations.えっ、そう？ ちょっと恥ずかしいな……。:
Eh？ Really？ This is a little
embarrassing...
translations.静かな聖夜もいいけど、こういうパーティーもいいよね。:
A serene holy night would be
nice, but having fun in a
party like this isn't bad.
translations.あなたには一緒にクリスマスを過ごす人、いないの？:
You don't have anyone you want
to spend your Christmas with？
translations.いないよ。でも、こうやって▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と話できたから悪くないかな？:
No. I think it's not bad that
I can spend time talking with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
like this.
translations.もう、口が上手いんだから。年上をからかうものじゃありません。めっ！:
Geez, that's sweet talking.
Don't tease me. Take this！
translations.（また子供扱いされてしまった……）:
(She treats me like a child
again...)
translations.わあ……見て。ツリーが輝いて、とってもきれい……。:
Wow... Look. The Christmas
tree is sparkling. It's
beautiful...
translations.ライトアップされるだけで、ずいぶん印象が変わるね。:
When the lights are on, it
gives totally different
impression.
translations.ちょっと冷えるけど、やっぱり暗くなってから見に来てよかったね……くしゅん。:
It's a little cold here, but
I'm glad we've stayed here
until it got dark... Achoo.
translations.風邪ひく前に帰ろうか？:
Let's go back or you might
catch a cold.
translations.ううん。私は大丈夫。もう少し一緒にいたいし……。:
No, I'm fine. I want to stay
with you a little longer...
translations.大丈夫……あ、じゃあ、手、つないでくれる？:
I'm fine. ...Ah, hey. Can you
hold my hand？
translations.ありがとう。うん、すごく暖かい……えへへ。:
Thanks. Yeah, it's so warm...
Hehehe.
translations.ほんとだ……なんだか●も暖かくなってきた。:
Yeah... Somehow, I also feel
warmer.
translations.……来年もまた、一緒にこうしてたいね。:
...Next year, let's do
something like this again,
okay？
translations.うん、来年も。:
Yeah, we'll do this again next
year.
translations.もちろん。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲さえよければ、一生……ね。:
Of course. If it's okay with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
we'll keep doing this our
whole life... Okay？
translations.私……ね。あなたの恋人でよかった……。:
I'm... really happy to have
you as my lover...
translations.うわあ……ふふ、こんなロマンチックなところ、一緒に見るのはまだ早すぎたかな？:
Wow... Hehe, is it too soon
for us to be at such a
romantic place like this？
translations.ふふ。それぐらいキレイだってこと。私ね、クリスマスをこういうところで、素敵なカレ:
Hehe. So beautiful. For me, it
would be like a dream if I
could spend Christmas here
with a wonderful guy.
translations.……そりゃ、●だと理想のカレシとは言えないと思うけど……。:
...I know I'm not the perfect
boyfriend for you and...
translations.ふふ。なに言ってるの？ 理想よりも素敵だって言ってるの。:
Hehe. What are you saying？
You are even more than
perfect, you know？
translations.想像もしていなかったほど、可愛くて、素敵で、頼りがいのあるカレシ……。:
More than I had ever imagined,
you're such a cute, wonderful
and reliable boyfriend...
translations.私がからかってると思ってる？ それならそれでいいけどね、ふふ。:
Do you think I'm teasing you？
That's fine then. Hehe.
translations.うん……期待に応えられるように頑張るよ。:
Well, I'll try my best to live
up to your expectation.
translations.ふふっ、その意気、その意気。また来年もよろしくね。:
Hehe, keep it up, keep it up.
Let's keep it going for the
next year.
translations.再来年も、その先もね。:
And the year after that, and
years after that.
translations.うん。これから先もずっと、一緒にクリスマスのお祝いができる、世界一かっこいい男の:
Okay, I'll be looking forward
to celebrate Christmas with my
"most handsome boyfriend in
the world" every year.
translations.見て見て、ツリーが輝いてる。すごくきれい……。:
Look, look. The lights on the
tree. So beautiful.
translations.私ね、恋人と一緒にここでクリスマスをお祝いするのが夢だったの。:
I used to dream about
celebrating Christmas with my
boyfriend.
translations.実際のカレシが●なんかだと、そんなに嬉しくないよね……。:
So, you're not quite happy to
celebrate it with your
not-so-dreamy boyfriend in the
real world, huh...？
translations.もぅ、そんなことないよ。ふふ、今日はどうしたの？ すねてる子供みたい。:
Hey, how could that be？ Hehe,
what's wrong with you today？
You've been pouting like a
kid.
translations.それは……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がキレイだから……。:
That's because...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is very beautiful today...
translations.……うん、ありがとう。でもね、あなたは私の夢のカレシより、ずーっと素敵なカレシな:
...Um, thanks. But you're even
more wonderful than the
boyfriend in my dream, you
know？
translations.本当だってば。こんなに可愛いカレシとのクリスマスなんて、考えたことなかったもの。:
Really. I had never imagined I
could spend Christmas with
such a lovely boyfriend like
you.
translations.それに……これから、もっともっと素敵な男性になっていくところ、近くで見られると思:
And... I know that you will
become an even more wonderful
man in no time...
translations.ふふ。私が保証する。あなたは絶対、すっごく素敵な男性になれるって。:
Hehe, I guarantee. You will
surely become a lovely,
wonderful man.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に言われると、なんだか自信が湧いてくる……かな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
if you say so, I should have
confidence in myself, right？
translations.でも……あなたが素敵な男性になったとき、隣にいるの、私なのかなぁって、そう思うこ:
But... when you become such a
wonderful guy, I wonder if the
person beside you will still
be me... Hmm？
translations.そんなの決まってるよ。ずっと一緒にいてほしいのは、●のほうなんだから。:
That's a sure thing. I'm the
one who has to beg you to
always be with me.
translations.……ふふ、ありがとう。じゃあ、２人だけの約束ね？ 来年も、再来年も、ずっと一緒に:
...Hehe, thanks. Then shall we
make a promise that we will
always celebrate Christmas
together from now on？
translations.うん、約束する。ずっと一緒に……。:
Sure, I promise. We will be
together forever...
translations.寒い……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はそろそろかな。:
It's cold...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is not here yet.
translations.あけましておめでとう、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今年もよろしく。:
Happy New Year,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Please be nice to me this year
as well.
translations.あのさ。晴れ着、すごく似合ってる。: Um, you look good in a kimono.
translations.じゃあ、初詣行くか。:
Then let's go for the shrine
visit.
translations.ねえ。今年はなにをお願いしたの？:
Hey, what did you wish for
this year？
translations.たぶん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と同じこと。:
Most likely, the same as
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ん？ 顔、赤くなってるけど、もしかして寒い？:
Hmm？ Are you cold？ Your face
is all red.
translations.あ、ううん、そうじゃなくて、だから……もぅ……。:
Ah, no... I'm not... I'm
just... Geez...
translations.うん。でも、ちゃんとお参り出来て、よかったよ。:
Yeah. But we finally made it
to pay respect to the shrine.
translations.ねえねえ。あなたは初詣のお参りが済んだら、これで今年も大丈夫って思う方？:
Hey, hey. If we properly pay a
visit to the shrine on New
Year's, everything will go
smoothly this year, right？
translations.ん……と、私はね、今年も一年頑張るから見ていてください、ってお参りするの。:
Um, well. For me, I prayed
that I will also work hard
this year, so please watch
over me.
translations.うん。あなたは、そうじゃない？:
Um, is it not the same for
you？
translations.●は、今年も一年よろしくお願いします、て感じかな。:
For me, it's more like,
"Please help me again this
year."
translations.じゃ私も、あなたにお参りしとこっと。:
Then let me make my wish with
you this time.
translations.うん。今年も一年よろしくお付き合いお願いします。:
Yes. For this year, please
continue being my nice
partner.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ごめん。待たせちゃった……かな？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Sorry. Did I make you wait？
translations.ぜんぜん。それより▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、やっぱり浴衣似合うな。:
Not at all. By the way,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you
really look good in a yukata.
translations.じゃあ、神社行くか。: Then let's go to the shrine.
translations.うわあ。思ったより人が多いね。:
Wow, there are a lot more
people than I expected.
translations.うん。油断してたら、はぐれちゃうかも。:
Yeah. If we aren't careful, we
might get separated from each
other.
translations.だって、ほら。はぐれたら大変だもん……。:
Because... Come on. It'll be
so much trouble if we get
separated...
translations.ふふ。離れないように、ちゃんと掴んで……ね？:
Hehe. Grab my hand tightly so
you won't get lost, okay？
translations.そう言えば、男の子って、お面、好きだよね。:
Speaking of which, boys like
masks, don't they？
translations.そう？ あー、そう言えば●も小さいころは、よく買ってもらったっけ。:
Huh？ Ah, yeah. When I was a
kid, my parents usually bought
them for me.
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、買ってあげようか？:
Hehe. Then shall I buy one for
you？
translations.いいよ。さすがにもう、恥ずかしいから。:
I'm fine. It's too
embarrassing to wear one at
this age.
translations.縁日だからいいじゃない。ほら、一緒に選ぼっ。おそろいにするんだから。ね？:
It's a festival, after all.
Come on. Let's choose matching
masks, okay？
translations.うん、凄いね。……あれ？ 泣いてる？ どうしたの？:
Yeah, it's amazing... Eh？ Are
you crying？ What's the
matter？
translations.あ、うん、ごめん。あんまりきれいで、涙出てきちゃった。:
Ah, sorry. It was so beautiful
that I just started crying.
translations.うん。来年の夏もまた、二人で見れたらいいね。:
Yeah. Let's come and watch it
again next summer, okay？
translations.うん。来年もまた、二人で見ようね。:
Yeah. Let's come watch this
again next year.
translations.ふふっ。ねえねえ、その対になる言葉って、知ってる？:
Hehe. Hey, did you know that
it's a paired word？
translations.うん。“かぎや”だよね。:
Yes. "Kagiya" is the other
word, right？
translations.そうそう、正解。“たまや”も“かぎや”も、昔の有名な花火職人の屋号なんだよ。:
Right, that's correct.
"Tamaya" and "Kagiya" are the
name of historic fireworks
factories.
translations.じゃあ、どっちが先に出来たかは知ってる？:
Then do you know which one was
formed first？
translations.あ、ほら。次の上がるよ。:
Ah, look. The next ones are
up.
translations.そう言えば昔、この神社で肝試しやったことあるよ。中学のころ。町の子供会で。:
By the way, I used to join a
test of courage with other
kids in this town at this
shrine when I was in junior
high.
translations.へえ、普通は嫌がるよね、そういうことされるの。:
Huh？ Usually, the shrine
wouldn't allow something like
that.
translations.宮司のお兄さんが、当時の町会長だったの。それで通ったみたい、企画が。:
The priest's brother happened
to be the town mayor at that
time. So, they had this
planned up.
translations.で、参加したんだ？ 怖かった？:
And you joined it？ Were you
scared？
translations.怖かったよお。だって人が来るまで、ずーっとひとりで暗いところに座ってるんだもん。:
Very scared. I was sitting
alone waiting for people to
come.
translations.え？ だってオバケだもん。隠れてて脅かさないと駄目でしょ？:
Eh？ Because I was the ghost.
If I didn't hide myself until
people came so I could scare
them, it would be meaningless.
translations.あ！ 参加って、そういう意味だったのか!?:
Ah！ When you said you joined,
you meant it like that！？
translations.うん。ちなみにバケネコ。ネコ耳くっつけて。:
Yeah. And I was a haunted cat,
so I had to put cat ears on.
translations.ううー。やっぱり、ちょっと重かった。イカ焼き……。:
Urgh... This grilled squid
really filled my stomach...
translations.ワタ菓子とトウモロコシだけでやめておけば良かったかも。:
I should've stopped after the
cotton candy and popcorn.
translations.まだイカ焼きも半分残ってるけど……。:
And you still have half of the
grilled squid left...
translations.いいよ。●が食べてあげる。:
It's okay. Let me finish that
half for you.
translations.同じだけ食べてるのにね。やっぱり男の人なんだね。:
You ate the same food yet you
still can eat this. This is
what men are made for, huh？
translations.夜道をカノジョ一人歩かせるわけにはいかないしさ。:
I can't possibly let my
girlfriend walk home alone at
night.
translations.じゃあ、ベイブリッジに行くか。:
Then let's go to the Bay
Bridge.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。えっと……今学期も、よろしく。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Um... Please treat me well
this semester, too.
translations.うん、こちらこそ。学校始まっても、バイトもしっかりね？:
Okay, likewise. With the new
semester starting, you can't
slack off on your job, okay？
translations.ふふ。お休みが嬉しくてたまらないって顔だね。:
Hehe, seems like you really
can't wait for the school
break, huh？
translations.でも、お休みだからって遊びすぎたらだめだよ？ 規則的な生活を心がけてね？:
But you can't keep playing
around the whole break, okay？
You have to maintain your
daily activities.
translations.（うーん、いつもながら子供扱いだ……）:
(Hmm, she always treats me
like I'm a child...)
translations.（テストの結果が発表されてるはずだな……）:
(I think the exam results have
been announced...)
translations.（今回のテストはバッチリだったな）:
(I did perfectly for the exams
this time.)
translations.あ、いたいた。テスト結果、見たよ。あんなに成績がいいなんて驚いちゃった。:
Ah, you're here. I saw the
exam results. Your grades are
so good that I was surprised.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……今回はたまたまヤマがあたっただけで。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
I was lucky that I guessed the
right answers.
translations.ううん、あなたの努力のたまものだよ。ふふ。:
No, I know you really worked
hard. Hehe.
translations.（今回のテストは良くもなく悪くもなく……、平凡だったな）:
(The result isn't too bad, but
isn't good either... Quite
mediocre.)
translations.あっ、テストの結果発表見たよ。今回はなかなか頑張ったね。:
Ah, I saw the exam results.
You did okay, huh？
translations.勉強以外にもやるべきことはたくさんあるしね。でも、あなたはもっと頑張れる人だと思:
There were many things to do
besides studying, huh？ But I
know you could do better if
you tried.
translations.（もう少し頑張ってみようかな……）:
(Next time, I should try to
study harder...)
translations.見られちゃったんだ。面目ない……。:
You saw the result... I'm
ashamed.
translations.恥ずかしがることないよ。テストは自分の力試しなんだから、次に頑張れば……ね？:
It's not something to be
ashamed of. The exams only
measure your proficiency. Just
try harder next time, okay？
translations.（はぁ……次は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にいいところ見せたいな）:
(Hah... Next time,
I want to show
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
how well I can do.)
translations.あっ、いたいた。ちょっといいかな？:
Ah, you're here. You got a
minute？
translations.ほら、今日はあなたの誕生日でしょ？ だから……はい。:
Hey, today is your birthday,
right？ So... Here you are.
translations.気に入らなかったら、言ってね？ 次からは気をつけるから。:
If you don't like it, please
say so. I'll be more careful
next time.
translations.そんな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のくれたものなんだし、嬉しいに決まってるよ。:
No way, it's something
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
picked for me. I'm definitely
happy.
translations.……うん、ありがとう。でも私、あなたの好み、もっと知りたいから……ね？:
...Okay, thanks. But I want to
know more about your taste,
okay？
translations.あっ、いたいた。もぅ、私に探させるなんて生意気だよ？:
Ah, you're here. Geez, how
cheeky you are to make me look
for you.
translations.もぅ……今日、あなたの誕生日でしょ？ だから、はい、これ。プレゼント。:
Geez... Today is your
birthday, right？ So... Here
you go. Your present.
translations.おもちゃコーナーも回ってみたんだけど……もうお兄さんだし、ちゃんと高校生っぽいも:
I was looking around the toy
corner. But now I see that
you've grown up, I should've
picked something more suitable
for you.
translations.ふふ、冗談よ。ちゃんとしたもの、選んだつもりだから。:
Hehe, I was kidding. I'm sure
I picked the right thing for
you.
translations.あっ、いたいた。探したよ。:
Ah, you're here. I've been
looking for you.
translations.もぅ……今日はあなたがまたひとつ大人に近づく日だよ？:
Geez... Today, you're one step
closer to becoming an adult,
right？
translations.ふふ、正解。正解者には……はい、プレゼント。:
Hehe, correct. Since you
answered it correctly...
Here's your present.
translations.ふふ。こうやって、どんどん素敵な男性になっていくんだね……。:
Hehe. If it goes on like this,
you'll become a wonderful man
in no time...
translations.それって恋人っていうより、母親の台詞みたいな……。:
You sound more like my mother
than my lover...
translations.ふふ、気分的には恋人半分、母親半分ってところかな？:
Hehe. I think I feel like I'm
both your lover and mother.
translations.あっ、いたいた。ちょっとだけいいかな？:
Ah, you're here. Do you have a
moment？
translations.確か今日って、あなたの誕生日だよね？ だからプレゼント、持ってきたんだけど……。:
Today is your birthday,
right？ I have a present for
you...
translations.迷惑だったら、受け取らなくてもいいけど……どうする？:
But if it troubles you, you
don't have to take it, okay？
translations.迷惑だなんて！ 嬉しいよ、ありがとう。:
It doesn't trouble me！ I'm
happy. Thanks.
translations.よかった……じゃあ、はい。お誕生日おめでとう。:
That's good to hear... Then
here it is. Happy birthday.
translations.本当にありがとう。プレゼント、大切にするよ。:
Thanks so much. I'll treasure
it.
translations.えっと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどこに……あっ、いたいた。:
Hmm,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Where is she...？ Ah, right
there.
translations.ほら、今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日だから……はい、プレゼント。おめでとう。:
Hey, today is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday, so... Here's a
present for you. Happy
birthday.
translations.あ……覚えててくれたんだ。ふふ、開けてもいい？:
Ah... You remembered it. Hehe,
can I open it now？
translations.……ありがとう。私、一生の宝物にするね……。:
...Thanks. I'll treasure this
my whole life...
translations.ありがとう。私、こういうの好きだから嬉しい。:
Thanks. I like it. I'm so
happy.
translations.……あなたからのプレゼントだもんね。私、好きになってみせる。:
...It's a present from you, so
I'll try to be fond of it...
translations.……ふふ。私の誕生日、覚えててくれてありがとう。感激しちゃった。:
...Hehe, thanks for
remembering my birthday. I'm
impressed.
translations.大げさだよ。当たり前のことだし……。:
Don't exaggerate. This is just
natural...
translations.でも、当たり前のことでも……やっぱり、感激しちゃうよ。:
Although it's natural that you
remembered it, I'm still
impressed.
translations.ふふっ、ごめんなさい。でも本当に嬉しいの。すっごく嬉しくて……。:
Hehe, sorry. But I'm really
happy. Very, very happy...
translations.その……●としても喜んでくれて、嬉しいかな。:
Then... I'm also happy that
you're happy.
translations.……来年も、再来年も、あなたと一緒に誕生日を祝えたらいいなぁ。:
...Next year, and years after
that, I want to celebrate my
birthday together with you.
translations.じゃあ、来年のプレゼントも考えておかなくちゃ。:
Then I'll start to think about
what present to get for you
next year.
translations.……えっと、無理はしないでね？ プレゼントも嬉しいけど、私、あなたと一緒にいられ:
...Well, just don't overdo it,
okay？ Although the present
makes me happy, having you
with me is more than enough...
translations.よし……プレゼントの準備はオッケーだな。:
All right. I've already
prepared the present.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ 今日は、誕生日だから……はい、おめでとう。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Today is your birthday, so...
Happy birthday.
translations.あ……ふふ、お祝いしてくれるんだ。開けてみてもいい？:
Ah... Hehe, you came to greet
me. Can I open this？
translations.私の欲しいもの、よくわかったね。あなたと通じ合ってるって感じが嬉しいの。:
You really know what I wanted.
I'm really happy that you
understand me so well.
translations.ふふ。私のこと、わかってるんだ。ありがとう。:
Hehe, you know what I want.
Thanks.
translations.……もう少し教育しないとダメなのかな？:
...Maybe you should have asked
for advice, huh？
translations.でも、プレゼントなんてよかったのに……。:
But you didn't have to give me
any present...
translations.そうはいかないよ。一応、●はカレシなんだし……。:
I wanted to. I'm your
boyfriend, right...？
translations.ふふっ、そんなこと言っていいの？ 私の誕生日、本当は明日なのに。:
Hehe. Are you sure？ But, my
birthday is tomorrow.
translations.うん、嘘。ふふっ、あなたの驚いた顔、カワイイ……。:
Yes, I'm kidding you. Hehe.
You're so cute when you're
shocked...
translations.だって、本当に可愛いんだもの。でも、嬉しいのは、本当だよ？:
See, you're really cute.
Anyway, I'm very happy. Really
happy.
translations.うん……喜んでくれて、こっちも嬉しいよ。:
Okay... I'm very glad that
you're happy.
translations.うん、ほら、今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日だから……はい、おめでとう！:
Um, well, today is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday, so... Here.
Happy birthday！
translations.ふふ。うん、ありがとう。開けてもいい？:
Hehe. Yeah, thanks. Can I open
it？
translations.わぁ、素敵……私のこと、わかってくれているんだ……うん、ありがとう。一生の宝物に:
Wow, wonderful... You know
what I like... Thanks. I'll
treasure it my whole life.
translations.ふふ。いい趣味してるんだ。ありがとう、大切にするね。:
Hehe, you have such good
taste. Thanks. I'll treasure
it.
translations.うーん……あ、気にしないでね、ありがとう。:
Hmm... Ah, don't mind me.
Thanks.
translations.いつになったら渡してくれるのかなって、ドキドキしちゃった。:
I was very nervous thinking
about when you would give it
to me.
translations.もしかして、とっくに気付いてた？:
Could it be that you already
knew about this present？
translations.うん。私、こう見えてもあなたのことについては敏感なんだから。:
Yeah, although I look like
this, I'm very sensitive when
there's something with you.
translations.ふふ。タイミング、考えてくれたんだ？:
Hehe. So you were waiting for
the right timing, huh？
translations.それが一番嬉しいの。私のこと、こんなに大切に思ってくれているんだって……。:
That makes me very happy. You
really care so much about
me...
translations.そんな……これでもカレシなんだから、それくらいは……。:
That's... because I'm your
boyfriend. I should do as
much...
translations.ふふ。だから嬉しいの。私のカレシがすっごく素敵な人なんだってわかったから……ふふ:
Hehe. I'm so happy to have
such a wonderful boyfriend.
Hehe... Thanks so much for the
present.
translations.えっと……確か今日、誕生日だよね？ だから……はい、おめでとう。:
Well... Today is your
birthday, right？ So... Here.
Happy birthday.
translations.えっ……私にプレゼント？ うわぁ、嬉しい……ありがとう！ 開けてみてもいい？:
Eh？ ...A present for me？
Wow, I'm so happy... Thanks！
Can I open it？
translations.素敵……ふふ。あなたと私って、好みが同じなのかな？:
Wonderful... Hehe, I wonder if
your taste and mine are alike.
translations.あなたが選んでくれたんだ。ふふ。私、こういうのけっこう好きよ。ありがとう。:
You picked this one for me,
huh？ Hehe, I like it. Thanks.
translations.でも、あなたが私の誕生日を覚えてるなんて、ちょっとびっくりしちゃった。:
But I'm very surprised that
you remembered my birthday.
translations.迷惑だった？: Was I a bother for you？
translations.ううん。とっても嬉しい。感激しちゃった。:
No, I'm very happy and very
impressed.
translations.だって、女の子にとって記念日って、すごく大切でしょ。だから、祝ってもらえて、すご:
But for girls, an occasion
like this is very important.
That's why I'm very happy that
you celebrate it with me.
translations.ふふ。これからもその優しさだけは、忘れないでね？:
Hehe, from now on, please keep
being kind to me like this,
okay？
translations.うん、努力します……。:
Okay, I'll put my effort into
it...
translations.（しまった！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日なのに、プレゼントを用意してなかった……）:
(Oh no！ Today is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday. I forgot to prepare
a present for her...)
translations.なんだか落ち着かないみたいだけど……どうかしたの？:
You look flustered somehow...
What's wrong？
translations.そう……なんでもないんだ。うん、わかった……なんでもないんだね。:
I see... It's nothing. Okay, I
understand... It's nothing,
huh...？
translations.どうしたの？ なにかすごい間違いに気が付いたって感じだけど？:
What's wrong？ You seem like
you just realized some big
mistake.
translations.ふーん、そうなんだ。じゃあ、私は誕生日を祝ってくれる優しいカレシ、探しに行っても:
Hmm？ I see. Then I should go
look for some nice guy who
would celebrate my birthday
with me, huh？
translations.もぅ……忘れたら忘れたって正直に言うこと。いい？ それに、私がどれだけ楽しみにし:
Geez... If you forget about
it, just say so, okay？ And
reflect on how much I've been
looking forward to this.
translations.（そういえば今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誕生日だな……）:
(By the way, today is
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
birthday...)
translations.どうしたの？ さっきからなんだかそわそわしてるけど？:
What's wrong？ You've been
fidgety since a while ago.
translations.……そう。うん。なんでもないなら、別にいいんだけど。:
...Really？ Hmm, if it's
nothing, then it doesn't
matter.
translations.（やっぱり……がっかりさせちゃったよな。どうしよう……）:
(As I thought... She's very
disappointed. What should I
do...？)
translations.今日は私たちが\nお付き合いを始めた日かあ\n……早いねぇ。:
Today is the anniversary that
we started dating... It's so
fast.
translations.うん。なんだか\nあっという間だったよね。:
Yeah, it was like a blink of
an eye.
translations.あの日、勇気を出して\nよかったな……あ、でも、\n本当に迷惑じゃなかった？:
I'm glad I gathered up my
courage to confess to you.
...Ah, but are you sure that I
didn't cause you any trouble
for that？
translations.まさか。\nすごく嬉しかったよ。:
How could that be？ I was
really happy.
translations.記念日だから……プレゼント\n用意したんだけど……。:
As it's our anniversary, I've
prepared a present for you...
translations.ほんと、嬉しい。\nじゃあ、交換……。:
I'm so happy. Then let's
exchange them...
translations.わあ……ありがとう！\nまた、あなたとの思い出、\nひとつ増えちゃった……。:
Wow... Thanks！ I have another
piece of nice memory with
you...
translations.……うん、\n２人の記念の品だもんね。\n大切にするね。:
...Hmm, well. It's a piece of
memory between us. I'll
treasure it.
translations.毎年……\nこれからも毎年、\nお祝いしたいな……。:
Every year... I want to
celebrate this occasion every
year, from now on...
translations.この日が来るたびに、\nまた私たちの仲が\n深まってくんだね……。:
This day of next year, our
relationship will become even
stronger, right...？
translations.私たち、この日に\n付き合い始めたんだよね……\nふふ、思い出すだけで\nドキド:
Today is the day that we
started dating, right？
...Hehe, does your heart throb
when you think about it？
translations.あの時、勇気を出して\nよかったな……こんな年上の\nイジワルなお姉さんなんて、:
I'm glad I gathered up my
courage to confess to you.
...I actually thought that you
wouldn't accept this malicious
big sister.
translations.そんなわけないよ。\n●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと……。:
How could that be？
I also loved
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。\nこれからもずっと\n仲良くしようね。:
Hehe, thanks. Our relationship
will last forever, right？
translations.あと私から、\n記念日のプレゼント。:
And I have an anniversary
present for you.
translations.うん、ありがとう。\n●からも……。:
Oh, thanks. I have one for
you, too...
translations.わぁ……ふふ、私の喜ばせ方、\nわかってきたんだ。\nこれだともう少し優しくして:
Wow... Hehe, you know what can
make me happy. If you're like
this, I have to consider being
nicer to you.
translations.ふふ。まずまず、かな？: Hehe, not so bad, I guess.
translations.……この様子だと、\nまだまだいろいろ\n教えてあげないとダメかな。:
...If you're like this, I
think I'll have to give you
more guidance.
translations.一年後が楽しみだな。:
I can't wait for the next
anniversary.
translations.だって、\n毎年お祝いしたいでしょ？:
But don't you want to
celebrate this every year？
translations.ふふ、\nだから今から楽しみなの！:
Hehe, that's why I said I
can't wait！
translations.今日は私たちが\n付き合い始めた記念日……\n今年もあなたと一緒に\n過ごすこと:
Today is the anniversary that
we started dating. I'm so
lucky to be able to spend this
day with you.
translations.あの時の私、すごく勇気を\n出したんだから。自分でも\n信じられないくらいに。:
I still can't believe that I
really gathered up my courage
to confess to you on that day.
translations.おかげで\n一緒にいられるんだから、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の勇気に\n感謝しないとね。:
And because of that, we can be
together like this.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
I have to thank you for your
courage.
translations.よろしい。\nこれからもその気持ちを\n忘れないでね？ ふふ。:
Very well. Then you must never
forget this feeling, okay？
translations.あとね……\n私から記念日のプレゼント。:
And... I've prepared an
anniversary present for you.
translations.ありがとう。\n●からもあるよ。:
Thanks. I also have one for
you.
translations.わぁ……\nふふ、私の好きなものを\nお見通しなんだ。\n嬉しいなぁ……\nふふ:
Wow... Hehe. You know very
well what I like. I'm so
happy. ...Hehe.
translations.あら、素敵。\nありがとう、大切にするね。:
Oh, wonderful. Thanks. I'll
treasure it.
translations.……うーん\n……まあ、いいかな。\nうん、ありがとう。:
...Hmm. Well, I think it's
fine. Yeah, thanks.
translations.来年も、お祝い出来るよね？:
This time next year, we can
celebrate this again, right？
translations.来年も？ 再来年も？:
Next year, and then the year
after, too？
translations.もちろん、そのまた次もね。:
Of course. And years after
that too.
translations.素敵……\n今から楽しみだな。:
Wonderful... I'm really
looking forward to it.
translations.（しまった。今日は●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が付き合い始めた記念日じゃないか？）:
(Oh no. Today is the
anniversary that I
started dating
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
isn't it？)
translations.ん、どうしたの？ なんだか慌ててるみたいだけど？:
Hmm？ What's wrong？ Why do
you get flustered like that？
translations.あのさ、記念日って延期に……できないよね。:
Well, we can celebrate our
anniversary some day later,
right？
translations.……記念日ってなんのこと？ 私、わからないから……じゃ……。:
...But our anniversary is
today. I don't care anymore...
Bye...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、泣きそうだよ！ なんてことしたんだ、●は！）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
seemed like she wanted to
cry！ How on earth did I
forget this！？)
translations.どうしたの？ あ……ふふ、そうなんだ。ふーん。:
What's wrong？ Ah... Hehe, I
see. Hmm...
translations.そうなんだ。忘れちゃうような記念日なんだ。ふーん。その程度だったんだね、あなたに:
I see. You seem to have
forgotten about our
anniversary. Hmm, so this
shows how important I am to
you, huh？
translations.（これは傷つけちゃったな……どうしよう……）:
(I really hurt her feelings...
...What should I do？)
translations.ねぇ……あ、もしかして体の調子、良くない？ 顔色、悪いみたいだけど……。:
Hey... Ah, are you sick？ You
don't look well...
translations.そうじゃなくて……あの、今日のイベントを、うっかり……。:
That's not the case... Well, I
forgot about today...
translations.……そう。うん、わかった。私なら大丈夫だから、気にしないで。じゃあね……。:
P...I see. Okay, I understand.
You don't have to worry about
me. I'm fine. Bye...
translations.よい子は寝る時間よ。ひとりじゃ眠れないの？ 身体はこんなに大きいのに、赤ちゃんみ:
It's bedtime for a good kid.
Can you sleep by yourself？
You're such a big kid but you
act like a baby.
translations.ダメねえ、こんな時間まで起きてるなんて。不良になっちゃうわよ。お布団にくるまって:
No good. You stay up until
this late. This is bad. Go to
your bed and sleep. Have a
nice dream.
translations.おはよう。早起きなのね。私？ 私も、なんだか眠れなくって、起きちゃった。:
Morning. You woke up so early.
Me？ I couldn't sleep, so I
got up early.
translations.朝って気持ちいいね。今日も、とってもいい一日になりそう。:
It feels good when you wake up
early, right？ This must be a
wonderful day.
translations.おはよう。あのね、私、夢を見たの。どんな夢か聞いてくれる？ あのね……、あー、や:
Morning. Do you want to know
what I dreamed about last
night？ Well... No, it's too
embarrassing. I can't tell
you.
translations.ちゃんと朝ご飯食べた？ 寝坊しても、ご飯はキチンと食べないとね。:
Have you eaten breakfast？
Even if you oversleep, you
still have to eat your
breakfast, okay？
translations.なんか気持ち良くて、寝ちゃいそう。あなたは大丈夫？:
I slept well last night. How
about you？
translations.１日はまだまだこれからだよ、何かいいことが起こるかな？:
Today has just begun. I wonder
if something good will happen.
translations.お腹空いてない？ ご飯は３食、キッチリ食べないとダメだよ？:
Are you hungry？ You must
properly eat 3 meals a day,
okay？
translations.今日、夜は何してる？ 意味はないの。聞いてみただけ……なんだけどね。:
What are you going to do
tonight？ No hidden meaning...
I just wanted to know...
translations.もうすぐ今日も終わっちゃうかな。遅い時間でも、会えるようになれればいいのにね？:
Today almost ends. It would be
good if we could also hang out
late at night, huh？
translations.あーあ、あなたともっと一緒にいたいな……まだまだ足りないんだよ？:
Ah, I want to stay with you
more. I feel like this is not
enough.
translations.あ、こんな時間にも会えちゃった。これだけで今日は、いい日だったよ？:
Ah, we meet even at this time.
Just like this, you made my
day, you know？
translations.夜更かしはお肌によくないのよね。最近、気をつけてるんだ。:
Staying up late is bad for my
skin, you know？ I have to be
careful.
translations.夜って、いろんなこと考えちゃうね。私もいつも、いろいろ考えちゃうの……。:
Do you always think about
various things at night？ I
have a lot of things to think
about, you know？
translations.こんなに遅くまで頑張ってるの？ 身体こわさないように、気をつけてね。:
Are you still working hard at
this late hour？ Watch your
health, okay？
translations.ねえ……もう、寝ましょ？:
Hey... Shall we go to bed
already？
translations.あんまり夜更かししてると、明日が大変だよ。そろそろ、お布団に入りなさいね。:
If you don't sleep now, you'll
be in trouble tomorrow. You'd
better go to bed.
translations.よかった、来てくれて。ずっと待ってたの……私の気持ちは、ずっとずっと変わらないよ:
Great. You're here. I've been
waiting the whole time... My
feelings for you have never
changed, you know？
translations.こんなにずっと一緒だと……恋人じゃなくて、家族？ 家族ってつまり……ふふ。:
We've been together like
this... We are more like a
family than lovers. You know
what I meant by family,
right？ Hehe.
translations.もしかして、セーブしないで電源切った？ そんなことまで教えた覚えはないんだけどな:
Did you turn the power off
without saving？ I don't
remember I ever taught you to
do something like that.
translations.ねぇ、またセーブしないで電源切った？ おしおきしちゃうよ？:
Hey, you turned the power off
without saving again？ You
deserve scolding.
translations.でもそうだな、「ネネごめんなさい」って言えたら、許してあげようかな？:
But if you say "Nene
gomennasai" (Nene, I'm sorry)
to me, maybe I'll forgive you.
translations.ほーら、言えるでしょ？: Hey, you can say it, right？
translations.違います……ほら、もう一度。:
That's not right... Hey, say
it again.
translations.えらいえらい、ちゃんと言えたね。:
Very good, very good. You said
it right.
translations.次からはちゃんと、必ずセーブしてから電源を切ってね？:
Next time, you must save
before turning the power off,
okay？
translations.もう、言えないんだったら、おしおき。:
Hey, you didn't say it. You
deserve scolding.
translations.ねぇ、セーブしないで……電源切ったの？ やめてほしいな、それ……。:
Hey, you turned the power off
without saving, right？ I want
you to stop doing that...
translations.セーブしないで電源切ったでしょ？ そういうの、キライだな。:
You turned the power off
without saving, right？ I
really hate that.
translations.もしかしてセーブしないで電源切ったの？ そういうこと、しちゃうんだ……。:
Don't tell me you turned the
power off without saving.
Don't do that...
translations.また……？ セーブしないで電源切るのはやめてって、言ったよね？:
Again...？ I told you not to
turn the power off without
saving, right？
translations.もぅ、またセーブしないで電源切ったでしょ。次やったら怒るからね。:
Hey, you turned the power off
without saving, right？ I'll
be angry if you do that again.
translations.またセーブしないで電源切った……こんな子になっちゃうなんてなぁ……。:
You turned the power off
without saving, again... So
you are this kind of person,
huh...？
translations.またやった……。私なら、セーブしないで電源切っても許してくれると思ってる？:
You did it again... Did you
think I could forgive you when
you turned the power off
without saving？
translations.またセーブしないで電源切ったな？ もう怒ったからね。:
You turned the power off
without saving, again. I'm
getting mad now.
translations.もう！ だからセーブしないで電源切っちゃダメだってば！:
Hey！ I told you that you must
not turn the power off without
saving！
translations.「好き、好き、大好き」って言って？ そうしないと、会わないから。:
"Suki, Suki, Daisuki." (I love
you, love you, love you.) Say
it, or I won't meet you.
translations.「好き、好き、大好き」って言わないと、会ってあげません！:
"Suki, Suki, Daisuki." (I love
you, love you, love you.) Say
it. Otherwise, I won't meet
you！
translations.「好き、好き、大好き」って言うこと。そしたら……ね？:
"Suki, Suki, Daisuki." (I love
you, love you, love you.) Say
if for me, okay？
translations.ねぇ、言ってごらん？: Hey, can you say it for me？
translations.「好き、好き、大好き」、ね？ 言えるでしょ？:
"Suki, Suki, Daisuki." You can
say it, right？
translations.そうじゃなくて……もう一回お願い。:
Not like that... Please say it
again.
translations.だーめ。ほらもう一回、ね？:
No. Come on. One more time,
okay？
translations.そうそう、よくできました。:
That's right. You did a good
job.
translations.こんなこと、これが最後だよね？:
This is the last time you
would do this, right？
translations.もう二度としないこと！ いい？:
You will never do this again！
Okay？
translations.今回はもういいけど……もうやっちゃダメだからね？:
I'll let you off this time,
but never do this again,
okay？
translations.そーいう態度でくるなら、こっちにも考えがあるからね。:
If you keep doing things like
this, I'll have to do
something, too.
translations.はぁ……なんで黙っちゃうのよ……。:
Hah... Why are you being
quiet？
translations.何度もセーブしないで電源切るのって……私のせい？:
You turned off the power
without saving so many
times... Did I do something
bad？
translations.セーブしないで電源切ったな？ もう何度目だろ……。:
You turned off the power
without saving again. How many
times already？
translations.何度も教えたでしょ？ セーブしないで電源切らないでって。:
I told you so many times.
Don't turn off the power
without saving.
translations.「ネネを一番愛してる」って言ってくれないかな？ そうしたら、許しちゃうから……。:
Will you say "Nene wo ichiban
aishiteru" (I love Nene the
most) for me？ If you do, I'll
forgive you.
translations.許してほしければ、「ネネ一番愛してる」って言いなさい？:
If you want me to forgive you,
say "Nene wo ichiban
aishiteru" (I love Nene the
most) now.
translations.「ネネを一番愛してる」って言わないと、許してあげない！:
Say "Nene wo ichiban
aishiteru" (I love Nene the
most) or I won't forgive
you！
translations.ね、お願いだから……言って？: Hey, I beg you... Say it.
translations.ほら、ちゃんと言って？ お願いだから……。: Hey, just say it. I beg you...
translations.そうじゃないよ？ ほら、ちゃんと言って。:
That's not right. Hey, say it
now.
translations.そっか……言ってくれないんだ……。:
I see... You won't say it for
me...
translations.そぅ……言う気はないんだね。:
I see... You don't want to say
it.
translations.次は……「愛してる」って３回言ってくれないかな？:
Next... Can you say
"Aishiteru" (I love you) 3
times？
translations.じゃあ次はね……「愛してる」って３回言ってくれたらいいな？:
The next one is... Can you say
"Aishiteru" (I love you) 3
times？
translations.そうじゃないってば！: I told you it wasn't right.
translations.もう、やめてね？ 私の思い出、消さないでほしいから……。:
You won't do this again,
right？ I don't want you to
delete our memories...
translations.もうダメだよ、こんなこと。思い出は、ずっととっておかなきゃ。:
You won't do this again,
right？ You must treasure our
memories.
translations.もうヤだからね、こんなこと。わかってくれるよね？:
I don't like this. Do you
understand？
translations.私……私が悪いのかな？ あなたがこんなことするなんて……。:
D-Did I do something bad that
made you do this to me...？
translations.ちょーっとあなたのこと、信用し過ぎてたかも。:
I trusted you too much, I
guess.
translations.あなたのこと信じてたのに。私、バカみたい……。:
I thought I could trust you.
I'm such an idiot...
translations.ふふ、甘えたい歳ごろ？:
Hehe, you wanna be a spoiled
child？
translations.なに？ 小さい子みたいに。:
What？ You're acting like a
kid.
translations.ふふ。なにがしたいの？: Hehe, what do you want to do？
translations.もうちょっとだけ、こうしててくれる？:
Can we stay like this a little
longer？
translations.ごめん。ちょっと、このまま……。:
Sorry. Can we stay like
this...？
translations.ちょっとイイ、かな。うん。: I think this is good. Yeah.
translations.ごめん、そういうのナシでいい？: Sorry, can we not do this？
translations.受け付けない、かな。:
This is not acceptable, I
think.
translations.ごめん、やっぱりそういうのは……。:
Sorry, this is totally not
good...
translations.ふふ。私が喜んでると思う？:
Hehe, do you think I'll be
happy？
translations.ごめん、それは……ね？:
Sorry, this is a little... You
know...？
translations.ある意味面白い……かな？:
Was that supposed to be
funny？
translations.んー、今それ、却下。:
Hm, for this, I have to
refuse.
translations.うん、もう。なに？ いきなり。:
Um, what is it all of a
sudden？
translations.ふふ。いい気分。: Hehe, I'm in a good mood.
translations.あ、駄目駄目。見ないで。: Ah, no. Don't look at me.
translations.なあに？ 甘えちゃって。:
What？ You want to be
spoiled？
translations.こーら。甘えないの。:
Hey, I'm not going to spoil
you.
translations.恋人っぽくしたいの？:
You wanna act more like
lovers？
translations.もっとくっつきたいの？ ん？:
You want to come closer to me,
huh？
translations.そういうのは、まだ早くない？: Isn't it too soon for this？
translations.ごめんね。気分じゃないの。:
Sorry, I'm not in the mood for
that.
translations.ふうん。そういうこと、するんだ。: Hmm, you want to do this...
translations.けっこう大きいんだね……手……。:
It's quite big... I mean your
hand...
translations.はいはい。そんなに握りしめないの。:
Okay, okay. You don't have to
grab my hand that tightly.
translations.いいよ。その代わり、しっかり握っててね。:
Fine, in return, you'll have
to grab my hand tightly.
translations.ずっと離さないでいてもいいよ。:
You can keep holding my hand
forever.
translations.あ、ごめんなさい。そういうのは……ね。:
Ah, sorry. This is just... You
know？
translations.えーっと……そうしてないと駄目？: Hmm... Can we not do this？
translations.納得した？ じゃあ、離そうね。:
Do you understand？ If so, let
go of me.
translations.熱いよ。体温より熱いかも。:
It's warm. Even warmer than my
body temperature, I think.
translations.気をつけないと、日焼けしちゃいそうだね。:
If we don't be careful, we
might get sunburn.
translations.うう～。近づかれると暑いってば。:
Urgh. The weather is too hot
for us to walk close to each
other.
translations.暑くても、あなたの体温ならいいかも。:
It's hot, but I don't mind
getting more heat from your
warm body.
translations.いっしょに冷たいもの食べたいね。:
I want to eat something cold
now.
translations.暑いとき、男の子は得だね。:
In such hot weather, it's good
to be a boy, right？
translations.汗かくのも、キモチイイかも。:
Although I'm sweating, this
feels good.
translations.暑いときこそダイエットのチャンス、なぁんて。:
It's a chance for me to lose
some weight in such hot
weather, I think.
translations.なんか……手の感覚なくなっちゃう。:
Somehow... My hands have
become numb.
translations.寒い時に手つなぐと、キモチイイね。:
It feels good to hold hands in
such cold weather, right？
translations.コタツが恋しくなっちゃう。:
I want to get under my
blanket.
translations.手、握っていいよ。:
I don't mind if you hold my
hand.
translations.もっと、こっち来ない？ ほら、くっついて……。:
Wanna come closer？ Come on
here...
translations.手が冷たくなってるよ。握ってあげようか。:
My hands become cold. Will you
hold them？
translations.あったかくなってきた？ ふふ……。:
Wanna make me feel warm？
Hehe...
translations.なんだか、怖いのに……わくわくする。:
Somehow, I'm scared... I'm
getting nervous.
translations.だめ。動くと危ないよ。:
No, it's too dangerous to
move.
translations.大丈夫だから、ね？ いっしょにいるよ？:
This is okay. We are together,
all right？
translations.ちょっと怖いけど……いっしょなら、ね？:
I'm a bit scared... But we
will stay together, right？
translations.やじゃないよ。やじゃないけど……。:
I'm not scared. I'm not
scared...
translations.ごめん。それ、嬉しくない。:
Sorry. I'm not happy with
that.
translations.腕にぶら下がっても平気かな？:
If we swing arms while
walking, will we feel better？
translations.あんまりくっついたら、歩きにくいよ。:
If you get any closer, it will
be difficult for us to walk.
translations.もうちょっと、くっついてもイイ……かも？:
We should get closer to each
other, right？
translations.それ、やめよ……。ね？ 照れる。:
Stop doing this, okay？ It's
embarrassing.
translations.あ？ 照れてる？ ねえねえ。:
Ah, are you getting
embarrassed？ Hey, hey.
translations.ねえ。もっとくっついて欲しい？:
Hey, do you want me to stay
closer to you？
translations.えへ。腕、組んじゃったり？:
Hey？ Do you want to hold onto
my arm？
translations.くっついたら暑いって。:
The weather is too hot for us
to get closer.
translations.気が済んだ？ じゃ離れましょー。:
Do you feel better now？ So I
guess it's enough.
translations.んーと、もういい？ まだ？:
Um... Is this enough？ Not
yet？
translations.なに？ 迷子にならないように？:
What？ You don't want to get
lost, huh？
translations.はいはい引率のお姉さんですよ。:
Okay, okay. This big sister
will lead your way.
translations.そんなに強く握ったら……。:
If you grab me firmly like
this...
translations.ん？ 手が寂しい？:
Huh？ Do your hands feel
lonely？
translations.ふふ。寂しくなっちゃったかな？:
Hehe, I wonder if you feel
lonely.
translations.うん。離さないでいてあげる。:
Okay, I won't let go of your
hand.
translations.……んー、別にいいんだけど……。:
...Hmm, I think this is fine,
but...
translations.んんー、ごめん。また今度ね。:
Hmm, sorry. Maybe we'll do
this next time.
translations.もしもし？ 視線が下がってない？:
Hello？ What are you staring
down there？
translations.下ばっかり見ちゃダメ。:
Don't keep staring at my lower
body parts.
translations.刺激が強いかも？:
Do you feel motivated or
something？
translations.どうして、そこばかり見るの？:
Why do you keep staring
there？
translations.そんなことしか考えてないのかな？:
I wonder if you only have one
thing on your mind.
translations.あ。防虫剤の匂いがするかも。:
Ah, you might smell the insect
repellant.
translations.平気？ 歩きにくくない？:
Are you okay？ Doesn't this
make it difficult to walk？
translations.ちょっといい感じ。かな？:
This feels quite good, I
think.
translations.邪魔になってない？ 平気？:
Doesn't that bother you？ Is
it okay？
translations.こういうのって……ちょっと好き。かも。: I kind of like it like this...
translations.他の人からはどう見えるのかな？:
I wonder how others would see
us as.
translations.なんか、独占されてるって感じ。:
I feel like you monopolize me
somehow.
translations.えへへ。ぎゅっ、てしちゃうぞ。:
Teeheehee. You hold my hand
tightly.
translations.んん……組まないと駄目？:
Hmm... Will it be bad if we
don't hold hands？
translations.そういうのは、まだ。ね？:
Let's hold this for later,
okay？
translations.へえ……、硬いんだね、指。:
Hmm...？ You really hold my
hand tightly.
translations.悪くないね、こういうのも。:
Doing this is not bad, I
guess.
translations.あれ？ 手に汗かいてない？ ふふ。: Eh？ You hand is sweaty. Hehe.
translations.うん、大丈夫。離さないから……。:
Um, fine. Just don't let go of
my hand...
translations.もっと強くしてもいいよ？:
You can grab my hand tighter
than that.
translations.んーん、まだ早いよ。ね？:
Hmm... This is too soon,
okay？
translations.なんかちょっと恥ずかしい、かな。:
This is a little too
embarrassing, I think.
translations.あ……そんなに見ないで。:
Ah, don't look at me like
that.
translations.んふふ。ちょっと恥ずかしいよ。:
Hehe, this is a little
embarrassing, you know？
translations.んーん。ちょっと趣味が偏ってない？:
Hmm... Does this suit your
tastes？
translations.足元ばっかり見ないの。: Don't keep staring at my legs.
translations.下ばっかり見てると猫背になるよ？:
If you keep looking at my
lower body part, you'll become
a hunchback.
translations.次はいつ会えるかな……。:
When can I see you next
time...？
translations.ふふ。大丈夫、寂しくないよ。:
Hehe. I'm fine. I don't feel
lonely.
translations.大丈夫。また逢えるから。ね？:
It's okay. We'll meet again,
okay？
translations.名残惜しい？ ふふ、また今度ね。:
You don't want to leave？
Hehe, we'll meet again.
translations.あの……帰りたくなくなっちゃうんだけど……。:
Um... I still don't want to
leave...
translations.続きはまたにしよ。ね？:
Maybe we can do this later,
okay？
translations.あれ？ 帰るの嫌になっちゃった？:
Eh？ You don't want to leave,
huh？
translations.腕なんか組んじゃったら帰れないよ？:
If you keep holding my arm, I
can't go home.
translations.あ、引き止めようとしてる。かな？:
Ah, maybe we should wait until
later.
translations.えへ。次に会うとき、ね？:
Hehe, maybe we'll do this next
time, okay？
translations.うん。またいっしょに遊ぼうね。:
Um, let's have a good time
together again.
translations.それって、帰したくないってこと？:
Does this mean that you don't
want to go home？
translations.髪、触るの好きなの？ふふ。:
You like to touch my hair,
huh？ Hehe.
translations.なんでおでこ？いいんだけど。:
Why are you touching my
forehead？ It's okay though.
translations.腕？ どうして？ふぅん、好きなんだ。:
My arm？ What is it？ Hmm, you
like it？
translations.手と手が触れ合ってるのって……いいよね。:
It feels nice when our hands
touch...
translations.好きだよ……あなたに髪、触られるの。:
I like it when you touch my
hair...
translations.触られたおでこから全身に幸せが広がっていく感じ……。:
When you touch my forehead, I
can feel a stream of happiness
running through my whole
body...
translations.腕組むのはいいけど、一生離さないのが条件！なぁんてね。:
It's fine to walk arm in arm,
but we must stay like this
forever！ Just kidding.
translations.あなたじゃなかったら、絶対に髪なんて触られたくないんだからね。:
This is only for you. I won't
let anyone else touch my hair.
translations.だめ、耳触られると、あなたのこと感じ過ぎちゃう……。:
No, when you touch my ear, I
feel overly sensitive...
translations.ねぇ？ あなたのこと、ずーっと私の腕の中に閉じ込めてもいい？:
....Hey, can I keep holding
you like this forever？
translations.もう、女の子が髪を触らせるって、結構特別なことだよ？:
Hey, touching a girl's hair is
something very special, you
know？
translations.耳熱い……ほんとに熱出ちゃったら、あなたのせいよ？:
My ears are getting hot... If
I get a fever, it must be your
fault.
translations.その手で、私の心もずっと捕まえておいてね……。:
When you grab my hand, you
grab my heart as well. Never
let go, okay...？
translations.え、おでこ……なんか恥ずかしいけど、全然イヤじゃないよ？:
Eh？ My forehead... This is
embarrassing, but I don't hate
it at all.
translations.何？ 私の耳、触ってると気持ちいい？:
What？ Do you feel good when
you touch my ears？
translations.ぎゅって強く握ってあげようか？家に帰っても、私の感触がずっと残るように。:
Can you hold my hand tightly？
I want to keep feeling your
touch even when I've arrived
home.
translations.ねぇ私のおでこ、熱いよね？熱じゃなくて、あなたのせいだからね？:
Hey, is my forehead very
warm？ It's because of you,
not because I have a fever.
translations.だめ……あなたに腕掴まれると……私逆らえないから……。:
No... When you grab my arm
like that... I just can't
resist...
translations.この手がこのまま離れずに、ずっとあなたがそばにいてくれたらな。:
I wish you would never let go
of my hand and would stay with
me like this forever.
translations.よかった……\n来てくれたんですね。:
I'm glad... You came here for
me.
translations.急に呼び出したりなんかして\nすみません……。:
Sorry for suddenly calling you
out...
translations.べつにかまわないけど、\n●に話って？:
I don't mind. What do you
about？
translations.今日は、センパイに\n渡したいものがあって……。:
Today, I have something to
give you, Sempai...
translations.あなたを見つめる私の眼差し\n……私を見つめるあなたの\n眼差し……。: My gaze as I look upon me...
translations.重なり合う視線が織り成す、\nあぁそれは螺旋の迷宮。:
Our glances overlap. Ah... It
is a spiral maze.
translations.あなたの手は、\nこのラビリンスから\n私を救ってくれる？:
Will you rescue me from
labyrinth？
translations.それともあなたの鎖が、\n私の心を牢獄に\n閉じ込めてしまう？:
Or will my heart be locked
away by your chain of love？
translations.どちらでも構わない。\nあなたの魔法の瞳が、私を\n永久に放さないことに、\n変:
It doesn't matter which one.
Either way, your magical eyes
eternity...
translations.ち……違うんです！ \nやだ！ 私ったら、\nそそっかしくて……。:
T-That's not it！ Oh no！ How
could I be so careless...？
translations.こっちが本番です！ \nこっちを読んでください！:
This is the real one！ Please
read this one！
translations.空は とっても 青いのに\n私のココロ 曇り空。:
The sky is so blue, but my
heart is cloudy.
translations.わざと１０歩早く歩いても\n知らん顔して追い越すの。:
Intentionally taking 10 fast
steps, I walked past him
pretending to look
indifferent.
translations.乗り遅れたバスの\n背中を見送るような\n気持ちに気づいて\nＬｏｎｅｌｉｎｅｓ:
The feeling is like when you
look at the bus that you have
missed. It's the loneliness.
