translations.手紙なんですけど、\nやっぱりなかったことに\nしてください……。:
For this letter... Please
pretend this didn't happen！
translations.こういうのは、やっぱり……\n自分の口から伝えないと\nいけないと思うんです！:
Because this should really...
I think this is something that
should be said in person.
translations.だから、作戦変更です！ \n今日は……その……なんか\nパニクっちゃって……。:
So, I'm changing my strategy！
Today I am... Um... Now, I
panic...
translations.もう少し、頭の中を\n整理したらまた、お話を\n聞いてもらえますか？:
In a little while, after I
arrange my thoughts, will you
listen to what I have to say？
translations.それじゃあ、\nありがとうございました！:
Well then, thank you very
much！
translations.あ……\n私、まだ自己紹介して\nなかったですよね？:
Ah... I haven't introduced
myself yet, have I？
translations.姉ヶ崎 寧々。\n１４歳、中学２年生。\n現在、片思い進行形です！:
Anegasaki Nene, 14 years old,
eighth grader. Currently in
unrequited love！
translations.いいよなぁ～、本当に\n告白されてみたい……。:
How nice~！ It felt like a
real confession...
translations.（これ……\n受け取ればいいよな？）:
(I guess... I should
just take this？)
translations.さぁ！ 私をつかまえてごらんなさ～い!! ふふふ！:
Now！ Catch me if you can~！！
Hehehe！
translations.（おっ……！ これは、ひょっとして!? よーし！ もっと水をかけちゃお！）:
(Oh...！ It's my chance. All
right, I'll soak her！)
translations.もう！ ダメったら！ 濡れちゃうじゃない！:
Geez！ I said "No"！ I'm
soaking wet！
translations.まだ、まだ～！ ほ～れっ！:
Not yet, not yet~！ Take~
this~！
translations.あ～あ。もう～！ びしょ濡れになっちゃったじゃない！:
Aaaah~ Geez~！ Look. I'm all
wet now！
translations.あ……ゴメンゴメン！ やりすぎちゃった？:
Ah... Sorry, sorry！ Maybe I
went too far.
translations.乾かさなくっちゃ……ちょっと、待ってて。:
I have to dry my shirt... Wait
a minute.
translations.と、見せかけて……。:
Actually, this is the real
thing...
translations.はっ!? なんだ、夢か……。:
Huh！？ What？ It was a
dream...？
translations.（よし、シャツに水をかけてイタズラだ！）:
(All right, I'll prank her
by splashing her shirt！)
translations.先生？ ……って、なんだここ？ ●は……小さくなってる!?:
Teacher？ ...Why are you
here？ And... how did I become
this small！？
translations.もう、どうしたの？ 具合でも悪い？:
Geez, what's wrong？ Are you
feeling sick？
translations.じゃあ、お遊戯始めますよ？:
Then let's start the game,
okay？
translations.……さすがにそれは、ちょっと……。:
...I don't think I can do
that...
translations.ちゃんとやらないとダメよ。めっ。はーい、頭に手をあててぇ……ポンポコリ～ン♪:
You must do it properly. Okay,
put your hands on your head...
Pompoko-rin~
translations.（●が子供の頃もこんな事して喜んでたのかな？）:
(When I was a kid, did I enjoy
doing something like this？)
translations.よく出来ましたあ。じゃ次はポンポコジャ～ンプ。:
That was great. The next one
is Pompoko-jump.
translations.ペッタンしゃがんで、尻尾をぷる～ん。:
First, you sit like this, and
swing your tail~
translations.尻尾をぷる～ん、て……あれっ？ 先生の……お尻から……。:
Swing your tail~ Eh？ Teacher,
that thing on your back...
translations.はい、もう一度。尻尾をぷる～ん。:
Okay, once more. Swing your
tail~
translations.尻尾！ タヌキの尻尾!!:
A tail！ That's a raccoon
dog's tail！！
translations.そうよ？ キミにだって尻尾あるでしょ？:
Yeah？ You also have it,
right？
translations.え？ ……あっ！ ●にも尻尾が!?:
Eh？ ...Ah！ I also have a
tail！？
translations.ふふ。タヌキなんだから、みんなにあるんだよ？:
Hehe. We're raccoon dogs.
Everyone has a tail.
translations.し、知らなかった。●、タヌキだったのか……。:
I-I didn't know that. So, I'm
a raccoon dog...？
translations.私もタヌキ、あなたもタヌキ、みいんなタヌキ、ポンポコリ～ン♪:
I'm a raccoon dog. You're a
raccoon dog. Everyone's a
raccoon dog. Pompoko-rin♪
translations.そ、そうか。うん、●もタヌキなんだ……。:
O-Okay. Yeah, I'm also a
raccoon dog...
translations.はい、それじゃ最後に……ポンポコビ～ム！:
Okay, now for the last time...
Pompoko-beam~！
translations.そりゃそうだ、夢だよな。:
Right, it must have been a
dream.
translations.なんでこんな夢、見るかな。タヌキって……。:
Why did I see that dream？ And
why a raccoon dog...？
translations.でも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の保母さん、ちょっと良かったかも。:
But if I could have
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
as my day-care teacher, that'd
be nice.
translations.今日から新しい先生がくるらしいけど、どんな先生かな？:
A new teacher is coming today.
I wonder how this new teacher
will be.
translations.キレイ目癒し系だったらいいのにな……。:
If we get a pretty teacher,
that'd be nice...
translations.（こういうセクシー系も悪くはないな……）:
(A sexy teacher like her isn't
bad at all...)
translations.Look at me.私を見て……？ いいわね？:
Look at me. Just look at me...
Okay？
translations.（ハートかタヌキ？ じゃあ、とりあえずハートで）:
(Heart or raccoon dog？ I
think I'll go with heart.)
translations.（先生に続けて同じことを言えばいいのか……）:
(I just have to repeat after
her, huh...？)
translations.コラっ！ まだ少し早いわよ？ おませさん……。:
Hey！ That's too soon for you,
you know...？
translations.それじゃあ、今日の授業はおしまい。See you later！:
That's it for our class today.
See you later！
translations.先生！ 最後にタヌキでお願いします！:
Teacher！ Hit me with that
raccoon dog, please！
translations.こんな夢見たなんて、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には言えないな……。:
I can't possibly tell
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
about this dream...
translations.（やめておこう、またムチが飛んでくる……）:
(I'd better stop now or she'll
keep hitting me with that
whip...)
translations.マイクに向かって“I love you”と声を出そう:
Say "I love you"
into the microphone.
translations.マイクに向かって“I need you”と声を出そう:
Say "I need you"
into the microphone.
translations.マイクに向かって“I want you”と声を出そう:
Say "I want you"
into the microphone.
translations.凄いな……これ、\n誰が作ったんだろ？:
Amazing... I wonder who built
it.
translations.その声は……ひょっとして、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？:
That voice... Could that be
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.バカモノっ！ \nオレサマは王様だぞ！:
You idiot！ I'm the king
here！
translations.な……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? \nこれはまた小さく\n可愛くなって……。:
What...？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！？
You're so tiny and so cute...
translations.なんか文句あるのか！: You got a problem with me！？
translations.ないない。ところでここは、\nいったい？:
No, not at all. By the way,
where is this？
translations.ここか？ ここは\nオレサマの秘密基地だ！:
This？ This is my secret
base！
translations.さては、\nチョーチョーブインだな!?: You must be a secret agenda！
translations.オレサマの秘密基地を\n調べに来たんだろ!? \nそーだろ!!:
You sneaked into my secret
base to steal my information,
right！？
translations.う、うるさいっ！ \nまぁ、そうとも\n言うけどな……。:
S-Shut up！ Well, I think you
can say it that way...
translations.とにかく！ \nチョーチョーブインじゃ\nないなら誓いの言葉を言え！:
Anyway！ If you're not the
secret agenda, then say your
vow！
translations.オレサマの国の国民なら\n誰でも知ってるぞ！:
Everyone in my kingdom knows
it！
translations.キッサマ～！ やっぱり\nチョーチョーブインだな！:
You~！ You must really be a
secret agenda！
translations.うるさい！ \nメッタメタのギッタギタに\nしてやっからな～！:
Shut up！ I'm going to beat
you black and blue and cut you
into pieces~！
translations.やべ！ 逃げよっと！: Oh no！ I have to escape！
translations.ふぅ……\nメッタメタのギッタギタに\nされるとこだった……。:
Phew... She almost beat me
black and blue and cut me into
pieces...
translations.小さい頃の\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\nさすがにあそこまでは\nヤンチャじゃなかったよな:
That little
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was such a mischievous kid.
translations.じゃあ、オマエを\n家来にしてやる！: Now, you can be my servant！
translations.ははぁ！ \nありがたきお言葉！:
Haha！ It's my honor. Thank
you very much.
translations.では早速、オマエに\n任務をあたえる！:
Now, hurry up. You have your
duty！
translations.えぇっと……玉ねぎ３個と\nジャガイモ３個、\nにんじん２本……それと\n牛肉２:
Well... Go to buy 3 onions, 3
potatoes, 2 carrots... And 250
grams or beef...
translations.とにかく！ \nこのメモのモノを\n買って来い！:
Anyway！ Just take this memo
and buy everything listed in
it！
translations.買い物……ですか？:
You want me to... go shopping
for you？
translations.そうだ！ オレサマの仕事は\nオマエがやる！ オマエの\n仕事は自分でやれ！:
Right！ If it's my duty, you
do it for me！
translations.やべ……！ \n敵が攻めてきたっ！:
Oh no...！ The enemy is
attacking！
translations.こら、寧々！ \nまたこんな所で！ \n買い物はどうしたの!?:
Hey, Nene！ You're still
there！？ I told you to go
shopping for me！
translations.か、買い物はさ……今から家来が\n行くとこだったんだ……。\nなっ！ なっ！:
For that... I'm getting my
servant to buy it now...
Right？ Right！？
translations.また、この子は\nそんな事言って！ \nもういいから帰ってきなさい！:
You're doing this again！？
Enough. Go home now！
translations.ごめんなさいね、ほんっと。\nこの子は男の子みたいな\n真似ばっかして！ \nほ:
I'm really sorry. This girl's
always acting like a boy. Hey,
go home！
translations.ずいぶんとヤンチャな\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったな。:
That
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was such a mischievous kid.
translations.それはそうと……\nメニューは、カレーか。:
By the way... From the
ingredients, was her mom going
to make curry？
translations.もぅ……ここは温泉。２人でこっそり来たんじゃない。:
Geez... This is the hot
spring. We secretly came here.
translations.ふふ、まだ寝ぼけてるんだ。ほら、日も落ちたから……月がね、とっても綺麗なの……。:
Hehe. You must still be half
asleep. Look. It's already
dark. ...The moon is very
pretty tonight...
translations.こういう、ゆったりした旅もいいよね……。:
Having a peaceful vacation
like this is nice, huh...？
translations.（それよりも……月明かりに照らされた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の横顔……キレイだなぁ）:
(The best thing is... to see
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
face when the moonlight is
shining on her. She is so
pretty...)
translations.はぁ、風も気持ちいいし……お風呂上がりにちょうどいいね。:
Hah... The wind feels good...
Especially after getting out
of the hot bath, you know？
translations.（……風に乗って、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲から石鹸の香りが……）:
(...I can smell
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
soap from the wind...)
translations.ああ、風がキモチイイ。:
Ah, the wind really feels
good.
translations.あなたが寝ている間に、また温泉に入ってきたの。もう３回も入っちゃった。のぼせちゃ:
I got into the hot spring
again after you fell asleep. I
was in there 3 times already.
Now, I'm feeling dizzy. Hehe.
translations.あなたも後でもう一度入ってきたら？ 寝ている間に汗もかいたでしょ？:
You should go there after
this, okay？ I think you were
sweating while you slept.
translations.あ、そうだ。あなたがお風呂から上がったら、夕涼みをかねて外を歩かない？ お月見散:
Ah, right. How about we take a
walk outside after you get out
of the bath？ It's not bad to
walk under the moonlight,
right？
translations.（今日の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、すごく大人っぽいな……●のカノジョだなんて、なんか嘘みたい:
(Today,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
looks very mature... I can't
believe she's really my
girlfriend...)
translations.ふふ。あなたと２人っきりの旅行、最初は考えちゃったけど、来て、正解だったな。また:
Hehe. I had dreamed of a trip
with just the two of us before
and now it came true. Let's go
somewhere together again,
okay...？
translations.（……●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にふさわしい男なのかな？ なんだか急に心配になってきたな…:
(...Am I an
appropriate man for
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Somehow, I'm starting
to worry...)
translations.どうしたの？ さっきから、ボーッとしてるよ？ ふふ。もしかして、まだ、おねむ？:
What's wrong？ You suddenly
spaced out. Hehe. Are you
still sleepy？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、どうして●なんかと付き合ってくれてるの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
why are you dating someone
like me？
translations.どうして、って……そんなの決まっているじゃない。それは……。:
Why...？ You asked me？ Of
course, it's because...
translations.そう、なんだろうけど……なんで好きなの？:
Okay... But... Why do you love
me？
translations.カッコよくて、優しくて、可愛いけど頼りになって、私のこと大事にしてくれて、それか:
...cool, kind, and cute. But
you're also very reliable.
Moreover, you treasure me.
Also, you...
translations.ちょ、ちょっとちょっと。●は真剣に……。:
W-Wait, wait. I'm asking you
seriously...
translations.あ、夢か……本当に、そう思ってくれてたらいいな……。:
Ah, a dream...？ If that's
really what she thinks about
me, that'd be great...
translations.（風呂上りの風が気持ちいいな……）:
(The breeze feels nice
after a bath...)
translations.今日は腹いっぱい食ったな……。: I ate a lot today. I'm full...
translations.おーい、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ こんな真夜中にどうしたの？:
Hey,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
What are you doing here in the
middle of the night？
translations.最近、この辺は例の事件で、危ないっていうのに。:
Lately, there have been
horrible incidents going on
around here. It's dangerous.
translations.大丈夫って……？ ぜんぜん大丈夫じゃないよ。:
Okay...？ I don't think it's
okay at all.
translations.それに顔も真っ青だよ、どこか具合が悪いの？:
And you look so pale. Are you
sick？
translations.とにかく、ひとりじゃ危ないし、家まで送っていくよ。:
Anyway, it's dangerous for you
to be alone. I'll walk you
home.
translations.何言ってんだよ！ 忘れるわけないじゃん！:
What are you saying！？ How
can I forget about you！？
translations.ダメなの……アナタとは、もう逢えない……。:
Because... I don't want to see
you anymore...
translations.バカ言ってないで、帰るよ、ほら！:
Don't be ridiculous！ I'll
walk you home. Come on！
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をよく見てみよう）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
I'd better look at her
carefully.)
translations.私は穢れてしまったの……だから、もう放っておいて……。:
I'm such a disgrace... So,
please leave me alone...
translations.吸血鬼に襲われる事件って、まさか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が？:
The incident
was that a vampire was
attacking people... Don't
tell me it was you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
translations.やめて……そんな目で私を見ないで！:
Stop it... Don't look at me
like that！
translations.私は太陽にさえ見捨てられたの……だから、アナタも……私の事なんか、もう忘れて？:
Even the sun has abandoned
me... You, too... You should
just forget about me.
translations.なにバカ言ってんだよ！ 愛する▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を……見捨てられるわけないじゃないか！:
Don't speak nonsense！ How can
I abandon my beloved
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！？
translations.その言葉を胸に……、私は闇の中でひとり生きていきます。永遠に……。:
I'll always remember your
words even when I have to live
my life alone in the darkness,
for eternity...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をひとりになんかさせない……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
I can't leave you alone...)
translations.●も吸血鬼になる！ そして永遠に、ふたりで生きていこう！:
Make me a vampire, too！ Then
we both can live together for
eternity！
translations.ダメよ……、そんな事、できるわけないじゃない！:
I can't... I absolutely can't
do that！
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲といられるなら、●はかまわない。さぁ、思いっきり吸ってくれ！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I don't mind that as long as I
can be with you. So, go ahead
and suck my blood.
translations.そう？ じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて！ 実はお腹、ぺっこぺこだったのよね～。:
Really？ Now then, I'll do as
you wish！ Actually, I'm
pretty hungry~
translations.えっ!? ホントに？ なんていうかさ……ほら、その……。:
Eh！？ Are you doing this for
real...？ Well, um...
translations.あ……あのね？ 今日、何食べた？:
U-Um... What did you eat
today？
translations.何って……ギョウザだけど？:
What...？ I only ate some
dumplings.
translations.ふぅ……助かった……あれ？ なんだ夢か。:
Phew... I'm safe... Eh？ It
was a dream？
translations.……これって、見捨てたわけじゃないよな？:
...I didn't really abandon
her, did I？
translations.（あれ？ あの首元の傷は？）:
(Huh？ What's that wound
on her neck？)
translations.（食べられる前に息を吐いて気持ちを落ちつけよう……）:
(I should breathe out and
calm down before I
get eaten...)
translations.首元の傷をタッチしろ:
Touch the wound
on her neck.
translations.はい、パンケーキとドリンクバーのセットですね。かしこまりました～。:
Okay, you'd like the pancakes
and drink set, right？ Please
wait a moment~
translations.もぅ……なにしてるの、じゃないでしょ？ 仕事中なんだから、しっかりしてなきゃダメ:
Geez... Don't ask me that
question. We're in the middle
of work, so you'd better pay
full attention.
translations.ふふ。はい、お寝坊さんは３番テーブルの片付け、お願いね。:
Hehe. Okay, for a sleepyhead
like you, can you clean up
table 3 for me？
translations.お待たせいたしました。ご注文はお決まりでしょうか？:
Thank you for waiting. Have
you decided what you'd like to
order？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の制服、いつもより少し小さいような……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
current uniform is a bit
tighter than her usual one...)
translations.ありがとうございました。またのご来店、お待ちしております。:
Thank you very much. Please
visit us again. We'll be
waiting.
translations.ランチタイムが過ぎれば一休みできるから、しっかり頑張るんだぞ？ うふふ。:
You can take a break after the
lunch hour, so just keep it
up, okay？ Hehehe.
translations.うん……あ、５番テーブルから呼び出し？:
Okay... Ah, customers at table
5 are calling you.
translations.きゃ、やだっ……どうしよう……壊れちゃったみたい……。:
Kyaa. No... What should I
do...？ It seems to be
broken...
translations.ちょっと見せて……本当だ。これ、閉じないな……。:
Let me take a look... Yeah,
you're right. I don't think
you can close it.
translations.そんなことはないんじゃないかな？ 単に制服が小さかっただけで。:
That can't be true. I think
this uniform is just smaller
than your usual one.
translations.でも私、学校の制服も入学したときより、サイズ、大きくなってるし……。:
But I also just changed my
school uniform to a bigger
size. I'm getting bigger than
when I entered high school.
translations.いや、それは太ったんじゃなくて成長したんだよ、若いんだから。:
No, it's not because you're
getting fat, but it's because
you're growing taller. You're
still a young girl.
translations.もちろん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はぜんぜん太ってないって。:
Of course.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
isn't fat at all.
translations.よかった……あなたに太ったと思われたら、どうしようかと思った……。:
Thanks... I don't know what
I'd do if you thought I was
fat...
translations.若いっていうのも、本当？:
Did you mean it when you said
I'm still a young girl？
translations.よかった！ じゃあ、仕事に戻らなきゃ。:
Thanks！ Now, I'm going back
to work.
translations.待って、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ ファスナー壊れたまま！:
Wait,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Your zipper is going to break
apart！
translations.慌てる▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も可愛かったな……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was cute when she flustered...
translations.どうしたの、そんな顔して。: Why are you making that face？
translations.卒……だって▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の卒業はまだ……。:
Graduation...
But it's not time for
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
graduation yet...
translations.ううん。もう卒業なの。ほら、桜も……。:
No. I've already graduated.
Look at the cherry blossoms...
translations.あ？ ああ、本当だ。そっか……もう卒業なんだ。:
Huh？ Ah, you're right. I
see... So it's time for the
graduation already.
translations.うん。これであなたから、卒業できるね。:
Yeah. And from now on, I'm
done with you.
translations.うん、おめでと……えっ？ 今、なにから卒業するって……？:
Yeah, congrat-- Eh？ What did
you just say？ You're done
with what...？
translations.私、あなたから卒業するの。:
From now on, I'm done with
you.
translations.哀しいけど……でも、卒業するの。しないといけないの。:
It's sad... But I've already
graduated and I have to leave.
translations.そんな、急にどうして!?: What？ Why is it so sudden！？
translations.だってあなた、もう私のこと必要ないんでしょ？:
Because you don't need me
anymore.
translations.そんなことない！ そんなことないよ!!:
That's not true！ That's
absolutely not true！！
translations.うそ、ずっと会ってくれないくせに。:
You're lying. You didn't come
to see me at all.
translations.ううん……もういいの。わかってるから。:
Never mind... It's fine now. I
already understand.
translations.……あれ？ もしかして今の……夢？ よかった……。:
...Eh？ Was that... a dream？
What a relief...
translations.……ここ、どこだ？ って、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ どうしたの？:
...Where am I？ Huh？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What's the matter？
translations.……ん、ちょっと風邪ひいちゃったみたい……ごほ、ごほ……今日はお見舞いに来てくれ:
...Hmm, seems like I got a
cold... *cough* *cough* Thank
you for coming here to visit
me today.
translations.風邪？ 具合はどう？: A cold？ How do you feel now？
translations.うん、少しよくなってきたから……。:
Well, I think I'm getting a
little better...
translations.本当？ えっと、熱は……？:
Really？ Then do you still
have a fever...？
translations.そっか……そうだ。栄養をつけたほうがいいよね。何か食べたいものはある？:
I see... Right. You should eat
something, okay？ Is there
anything you want to eat？
translations.食欲あまりないんだけど……あ。:
I lost my appetite... But...
Ah.
translations.すりりんごが……食べたいな……。:
I want to eat some grated
apple...
translations.すりりんごね、わかった。ちょっと台所借りるよ？:
Grated apple？ Got it. Can I
use your kitchen？
translations.……ふふ、じゃあ甘えちゃおっかな……。:
...Hehe. I'll let you spoil me
for today...
translations.わかった、ちょっと待ってて。: Okay, just wait a little bit.
translations.なに？ なんでも言ってよ。:
What is it？ Just tell me what
you want.
translations.まだ、起きるのが辛くて……食べさせて、くれる？:
I still can't get up... Can
you feed me？
translations.えっと……自分では食べられない？:
Well... You can't eat by
yourself？
translations.……あなたにね、食べさせてほしいかなって……だめ？:
...I just want you to feed
me... You can't？
translations.だ、だめじゃないよ！ ……じゃあ、口を開けて。はい。:
O-Of course I can！ ...Then
open your mouth. Okay.
translations.むーっ。そこ、お口じゃないよ……イジワル。:
Hmph. That's not my mouth...
Don't tease me.
translations.ん……ふふ、おいしい。ねえ、もっと……ね？ はい、あ～ん。:
Hmm... Hehe, yummy. Hey, I
want more... Now, ahhhhh~
translations.（病気で弱ってるからかな？ 今日の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、子供みたいでなんだかカワイイなぁ:
(Is it because she is sick and
weak that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is acting like a kid now？
She's cute.)
translations.そんな、大げさだよ。:
You don't have to praise me so
much.
translations.……おいしかった。どうもありがとう。なんだか元気になってきたみたい。:
...Delicious. Thanks so much.
Somehow, I think I'm getting
much better.
translations.うん、よかった。食欲が出てきたなら、安心かもね。すぐ治るよ。:
That's good. If you have an
appetite now, you'll recover
soon.
translations.もう少しだけ、治ってほしくないかな……。:
I want to stay sick like this
a little longer...
translations.子供みたいに甘える▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、すごく可愛かったな……。:
When
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
was acting like a spoiled
child, she was so cute...
translations.そうだ。あなたって、どういうタイプの女の子が好きなの？:
Ah, right. What type of girl
do you like？
translations.ワガママも聞いてくれちゃうような？:
The type that usually does
whatever you ask？
translations.じゃあ、やっぱり年上ってことなのかな？:
Then would an upperclassman be
okay？
translations.そういうことに……なるかな。: For that... I guess it's okay.
translations.そっか。あんまり気にしなくてもいいのかな……。:
I see. So I shouldn't have
been worried then...
translations.落ち着いてて、大人っぽくてさ。:
I mean the calm and mature
type.
translations.優しくて大人しいタイプかな？ あんまり騒々しいのは、ちょっとさ。:
The kind and obedient type, I
think. I don't like a
boisterous girl.
translations.落ち着いてて、大人っぽくて？:
So, you like a calm and mature
girl？
translations.んー、だったらあのままでも良かったのか……。:
Hmm, then will it be fine like
this...？
translations.はっきりしてて、感情をぶつけられる感じとかさ。:
You usually express your
feelings clearly.
translations.たまにイジめられちゃっても？:
You don't mind that I tease
you sometimes？
translations.ふぅん、そうなんだ……うん、答えてくれてありがと。:
Hmm, I see... Okay, thanks for
your answer.
translations.そう言えば……あなたの好きなタイプって、どういうの？:
By the way, what type of girl
do you like？
translations.優しくて、大人しい子が好きかな？:
The type that usually does
whatever you ask？
translations.ううん。意外と、主導権握りたいほうなんだなって。:
No, I've just never imagined
you as the type that likes to
take the lead.
translations.今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が理想的、かな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You're my ideal woman, I
think.
translations.もう……そんなお世辞言って……。:
Geez... Don't flatter me like
that...
translations.お世辞じゃないよ。優しくて包容力があってさ、やっぱそういう人が好きだな。:
I didn't flatter you. You are
kind and broad-minded. I
really like this kind of girl.
translations.ちょっと言うのが恥ずかしかったけど。:
It's kind of embarrassing to
say this though.
translations.ふふ。照れてるの、カワイかったよ？:
Hehe. Are you embarrassed？
You're so cute.
translations.どうしたの？ 何かあった？:
What's the matter？ Did
something happen？
translations.ううん、違うの。映画が……。:
No, it's not like that. The
movie...
translations.今観てきた映画に感動しちゃって……思い出したらまた泣けてきちゃった。:
I was so impressed with the
movie I just saw... When I
thought about it, I started
crying.
translations.そっか。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、登場人物に感情移入する方？:
I see. So
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
do you feel sympathy for the
characters in that movie？
translations.普段はあんまり……今回のは特別かな。:
Usually, I'm not like this.
But this time, it's different.
translations.でも思い出して泣いちゃうなんて、相当いい映画だったんだな。:
A movie that can make you cry
just by thinking about it...
It must be a good movie.
translations.どんな映画？: What kind of movie is it？
translations.純愛ものだよ。生徒に恋をした女教師の話。:
It's about pure love. A female
teacher has fallen in love
with her student.
translations.そっか、その教師に感情移入しちゃったんだ。:
I see. So you feel sympathy
with that teacher？
translations.あ、私もう行くね。こんな顔だし。じゃあね。:
Ah, I have to go. My face is a
mess now. Bye.
translations.（……よし、フロア落ち着いたな。休憩しよう）:
(...Okay, not many customers
now. I'll take a break.)
translations.よし、ネネちゃん可愛い！ これならカレもメロメロだよね!?:
Okay, Nene-chan. You're so
cute！ He'll surely fall madly
in love with you！
translations.まぁ、なんとなく。何してたの？:
Um, somehow... What were you
doing？
translations.えっと、その……そう！ 身だしなみのチェック。制服とか、髪とか。:
Well, um... Right！ It was an
appearance check！ Like
checking the uniform, and
hair, and stuff.
translations.あぁ、接客業だもんな。:
Ah, that's important for a
restaurant, right？
translations.でも、なんかメロメロがどうとか……。:
But, then... What about
falling madly in love...？
translations.それは……ほら、お客様をメロメロにしないとね！:
That's... a reminder that we
can't fall madly in love with
the customers！
translations.わ、私もう行くから！ じゃあね！: Ah, I have to go！ See you！
translations.さて、今日も頑張って働くか！:
Okay, I'll keep working hard
again today！
translations.あのね、ちょっとお願いがあるんだけど？:
Well, I have a favor to ask of
you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が、●に？ 珍しいな、何？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is asking for my help？ This
is rare. What is it？
translations.もとは私が店長から頼まれたんだけど……。:
The manager asked me to do
this, but...
translations.いいよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は他にも色々やってるしさ。:
Fine. I know
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
already has plenty of things
to take care of.
translations.あ、やっぱり？ ●ももう一人前だな。:
Ah, really？ Now, I've become
such an able man.
translations.もう、調子にのっちゃって。:
Hey, don't get ahead of
yourself.
translations.だったら、他にも色々お願いしちゃおうかな。:
But, maybe I shall ask you to
help with something else, too.
translations.アレに、コレに……楽ができて助かるなぁ。:
There's this... And that... If
you can do them all, that will
be helpful.
translations.ふふ、冗談よ。でも最近頑張ってるからご褒美あげよっかなぁ。:
Hehe, I'm kidding. But, you've
been working hard lately.
Maybe I should give you a
reward.
translations.……変なこと考えた？ そんな子にはご褒美はなし。:
...Are you imagining something
perverted？ A kid like this
doesn't deserve a reward then.
translations.ううん、なんでもないの。コーヒーが熱かっただけ。:
No, it's nothing. This coffee
is just too hot.
translations.なんだ、びっくりした。: Is that so？ I was startled.
translations.私、猫舌なの。おどろかせちゃってごめんね。:
I can't handle hot food. Sorry
if I scared you.
translations.へぇ、意外。完璧な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がね。:
Hmm？ That's unexpected from a
perfect woman like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.猫舌ぐらいで、そんな……。:
Just because I can't handle
hot food...？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の弱点見つけちゃった！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has weak points, too！ I've
found one！
translations.そういうこと言うんだ、可愛くないぞ。:
Saying it like that, you
aren't cute at all.
translations.●もたまには仕返ししないと。:
Occasionally, it's my turn to
retaliate.
translations.あなたこの前、自分のミスオーダーのピザ、勝手に食べてたわよね。:
Earlier, there was a wrong
order for a pizza, and you
secretly ate it.
translations.あとその制服、先週から洗ってないでしょ。店長にバレたら怒られちゃうよ？:
And you haven't washed your
uniform since last week,
right？ The manager will be
very angry if he knows this.
translations.もっとあるけど、聞きたい？:
There are more. Do you want to
hear？
translations.えっと……●、仕事に戻るから！:
Hmm... I'm going back to
work！
translations.▲主人公＊▲。おでかけ？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Are you about to leave？
translations.そんなとこ。あ……ボタン取れかかってるの、みっけ。:
Me, too. Ah... You button is
falling off, see？
translations.ほんとだ。まぁいいや、取っちゃえ。:
You're right. It's okay,
though. Just leave it like
that.
translations.（やっぱ美人だよな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
really is such a beautiful
girl.)
translations.これぐらい、言えばつけてあげるのに。:
For something like this, you
could've asked for my help.
translations.（面倒見がいいよな）:
(Also, she's very good at
taking care of things...)
translations.ありがと。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って裁縫も得意なんだな。:
Thanks.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you're good at sewing, too.
translations.そんなことないよ。女の子だもん、普通だよ。:
No, I'm a woman, so this is
just natural.
translations.でも、あっという間だったな。:
But, you got it done in no
time.
translations.何？ もっとくっついてて欲しかった？:
What？ You wanted me to stay
like that longer then？
translations.それじゃ、お姉さんはもう行くから。気をつけてね？:
Now, this big sister has to
get going. Be careful on your
way home, okay？
translations.頭高くして。私が鼻おさえておいてあげるから。:
Raise you head. I'll hold your
nose for you.
translations.いいよ。こんなの鼻にティッシュでもつめとけば……。:
I'm fine. Just put some tissue
on it and I'll be fine...
translations.だーめ、それだと抜くときまた傷つけちゃうんだよ。:
No, you'll bleed again when
you take the tissue off.
translations.いいから、少し大人しくしてなさい？:
It's fine. Just be a little
obedient, okay？
translations.（にしても膝枕って……）:
(Did I fall asleep on her
lap...？)
translations.（痛かったけど、ちょっとラッキーだったな）:
(It hurts, but somehow I feel
so lucky.)
translations.げ、失敗。悪い、●が取りにいくから！:
Urgh, out. Sorry. I'll get the
ball.
translations.どういたしまして。ここの部って男女で練習するんだ？:
You're welcome. So guys and
girls are practicing together
in this club.
translations.ウチの部、そこらへん適当なんだよ。:
I think it's good like this
for our club.
translations.ふぅん。それにしてもキレイな子だよね……。:
Hmm... And, that girl is very
pretty, huh？
translations.ううん、なんにも。じゃあね、がんばって。:
No, never mind. See you later.
Do your best.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もいたのか、気づかなかった。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you're also here. I didn't see
you.
translations.ほら、向こうにテニス部の仲間がいたから声かけようと思ったんだけどさ。:
Look, that girl right there is
my teammate in the tennis
club. I was about to call out
to her.
translations.そのとき▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に声かけられたから、びっくりしたよ。:
When
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
called me, I was really
surprised.
translations.そっか、邪魔しちゃったね。:
I see. So, I interrupted you,
huh？
translations.邪魔だなんて、別に用があったわけじゃないし。:
No, you didn't. I didn't
really have any business with
her.
translations.ううん、私もう行くから。あなたはあの子の方に行ってあげて。:
Never mind. I'm leaving. You'd
better go talk with that girl.
translations.（ほんとに行っちゃった、気にしないでいいのに）:
(She's gone... There's nothing
she should get upset about.)
translations.（ここの掃除が終わったら、次は裏手か……）:
(Once I'm done with this, I'll
have to sweep the other side
then...)
translations.ぜんぜん、こんなの朝飯前だって。:
Not at all. This is just a
piece of cake.
translations.そうなんだ。お仕事の邪魔しちゃ悪いから行くね。:
I see. I shouldn't bother you
while you're working. I'll get
going now.
translations.よし、ここはこんなもんでいいか。:
All right. I think I'm done
with this.
translations.ここの掃除。ぜんぜんキレイになってないから、やり直し。:
This area is not clean yet.
You have to redo it.
translations.いいじゃない。それくらい、朝飯前なんでしょ？:
Isn't it okay？ This is just a
piece of cake, isn't it？
translations.わたし、消毒液と絆創膏取ってくるから。:
I'll get some disinfectant and
bandages for you.
translations.怪我したの？ 手当てしてあげる。:
Did you get injured？ Shall I
take care of your wounds for
you？
translations.いいって、今テニス部の仲間がやってくれるから。:
It's okay. My teammate is
getting a first aid kit for
me. But, I...
translations.いいってば。部外者にやってもらうのも、悪いしさ。:
It wouldn't be good to bother
someone outside the tennis
club to do this.
translations.もう。じゃあ、あの子にやってもらいなさい！:
Geez. Just let that girl take
care of you then！
translations.（なんか怒るようなこと言ったか？）:
(Did I say something to make
her angry？)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。そこの整理終わったらさ、次受付入って。:
▲主人公＊▲,
When you finish sorting this
shelf, can you help me over
there？
translations.頼んだよ。: I'll leave it to you then.
translations.よし、とっとと終わらすか。:
All right, I'd better hurry
and get this done.
translations.うん、本借りに。……今の子、可愛らしいね。:
No, I came to return a book.
...That girl is cute, huh？
translations.そう、かな？ 下級生だけど委員じゃ先輩だから、●は仕事教わったりしてる。:
You think so？ She's a first
year student, but as a library
committee, she's my senior.
translations.あなたの教育係ってこと？:
So she's like your supervisor
then？
translations.あーもう、貸し出し記録つけ終わんない！:
Ah, geez. I can never finish
these lending records！
translations.いつも仕事溜めてるからそうなるんだ。:
Because you've left them
undone for a long time.
translations.うるさいなぁ、それより手伝ってよ。:
Shut up already. Just help me
do it.
translations.自業自得だから、いいんだよ。甘やかしたら、本人のためにもならないし。:
She should learn from her
mistakes. I can't spoil her.
This is for her sake.
translations.そりゃまぁ、同じ委員の仲間だし。:
Well, we have to work together
as library committee members.
translations.▲小早川＊▲、何してんだ？:
▲小早川＊▲.
What are you doing here？
translations.なんでもいいじゃん、お父さんかっつーの。:
None of your business. Are you
my dad or what？
translations.だからお父さんかっつーの。:
Again, are you my dad or
what！？
translations.やれやれ、あんまりうるさく言うとほんとに嫌われるかな。:
Oh my, if I don't scold her a
little bit, she won't like it,
huh？
translations.誰がうるさいって？: Who do you want to scold？
translations.誰でも年上から小言言われるのは嫌いかもね。:
No one likes to be scolded by
older people, you know？
translations.うん。あなたも私のこと鬱陶しいなんて思ってる？:
Yeah. Have you ever thought
that I caused troubles for
you？
translations.（何を気にしてるんだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は。:
(What is it that
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is worried about...？)
translations.もしかして、●に会いに来たとか？:
Could it be that you come here
to see me？
translations.んなわけないじゃん、バカじゃないの？:
How could that be？ Are you an
idiot？
translations.私はね、あなたがいるからここのバイト続けてるんだよ。:
For me, you are the reason I
continue working here.
translations.もう、すぐ騙されすぎ。: Geez, of course it was a joke.
translations.全部嘘ってわけじゃないけどね。:
Not that the whole thing is a
joke though.
translations.デキシーズでのバイトも、今日で最後だね。:
Today will be your last day to
work at Dixie's, right？
translations.うん、今までありがとう。:
Yeah, thanks for your help up
until now.
translations.あなたが来てくれたおかげで、色々助かったなぁ。:
Ever since you've started
working there, you've helped
me a lot.
translations.もちろん。あとね、バイトが前より楽しくなった。:
Of course. And since then,
I've enjoyed my job even more.
translations.ほんと？ ●も楽しかったな。:
Really？ I also enjoyed
working there.
translations.ふふ。これからはお客様かな？:
Hehe, next time, visit us as a
customer, okay？
translations.じゃあ、またね。弟ができたみたいで、嬉しかったよ。:
See you later. I'm really
happy to have a little brother
like you.
translations.（ほんと、お姉さんみたいな人だったな……）:
(Right, she's like an older
sister to me...)
translations.あぁ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の１年遅れでね。:
Yeah, it's one year after
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s.
translations.うん、そう。私が、卒業するまでに勇気が出せたらな。:
Um, right. I should have
gathered up my courage before
I graduated.
translations.でも。もう、さよならするから。: But, it's time for us to part.
translations.このままずっとお姉さん役なんて、辛いから……。:
I can't continue acting like
your older sister...
translations.私も、お姉さんから卒業したかったな……。:
I am now graduated from being
your sister...
translations.一緒に帰ろうと誘う:
Ask her to go home
together
translations.今帰り？ 一緒に帰ろうよ。:
About to go home？ Let's walk
together then.
translations.ふふ、いいわよ？ どこか寄っていくのも、いいかもね？:
Hehe, that's fine. We can stop
by some places too, okay？
translations.今日は寄るところがあるから、ごめんね？:
There's a place I have to
visit today. Sorry.
translations.今帰り？ 一緒に帰ろうか？:
About to go home？ How about
walking home together？
translations.うん、もちろん。でも他に一緒に帰る子、いるんじゃないの？:
Okay, of course. Are you sure
you don't want to go with
another girl？
translations.一緒に帰りたいんだけど、今日はダメなの。ごめんね？:
I really want to go with you
but I can't. Sorry.
translations.いいわよ？ もうちょっとカワユク言えたら。:
Okay. But you must ask me with
a cutesy face.
translations.ふふ。今の顔、カワユかったからＯＫだよ▼:
Hehe. That face. It's cutesy,
so okay▼
translations.ごめんね、今日はダメ。でも次も誘ってくれなきゃ許さないからね？:
Sorry. I can't today. But you
have to ask me again next
time, okay？
translations.ナマイキなんだ。でも可愛いから許しちゃうのでした。ふふ▼:
What a cheeky request. But
since you're cute, I'll
forgive you. Hehe▼
translations.もうナマイキ言って。そんな子とは一緒に帰ってあげません。:
You said something cheeky
again. I don't want to go home
with a boy like you.
translations.ふふ、冗談。今日はちょっと用事があるの、ごめんね？:
Hehe. Just kidding. I have
something to do today, so
sorry, okay？
translations.ごめんなさい、今日はちょっと……。せっかく誘ってくれたのに。:
Sorry. I can't today. Even
though you asked me...
translations.いいわよ？ 悪い人からちゃんと守ってくれる？:
Okay. You'll protect me from
bad guys, right？
translations.ふふ、私のカレシなんだもんね？:
Hehe. As expect from my
boyfriend, huh？
translations.今日じゃなければ、大丈夫なんだけどな。残念。:
It would be good if it wasn't
today. Too bad...
translations.送ってくれるの？ うれしい。頼もしいカレで幸せです。ふふ▼:
Are you walking me home？ I'm
glad to have such a reliable
boyfriend. Hehe▼
translations.今日は用事があるから、ダメなの。また今度ね。:
I got something to do today,
so I can't. Maybe next time.
translations.いいよ。一緒に帰れて、うれしい。:
Fine. I'm glad we can walk
home together.
translations.ごめんなさい、今日は用事。じゃあね。:
Sorry, I got something to do.
Bye.
translations.よろしい。カレシなんだから、ちゃんとエスコートしてね。:
Okay. You're my boyfriend, so
you'll escort me, right？
translations.今日は用事あるから、ダメだな……。また今度ね。:
I have something to do today,
so I can't... Maybe next time,
okay？
translations.送ってくれるんだ。はい、よろこんで。:
So, you'll walk me home. Okay,
it's my pleasure.
translations.ごめんね？ 今日はもう帰らないといけないの。またね。:
Sorry. I really have to hurry
home today. See you later.
translations.今帰り？ 一緒に帰ろうよ？:
About to go home？ Let's walk
together then.
translations.そうじゃなくて。もう、ちゃんとカノジョのこと考えなさい。:
No. Hey, at least you should
care more about your
girlfriend.
translations.よかったら、一緒に帰らない？ どう？:
If you're okay, how about we
walk home together？
translations.そう。なら、いいの。それじゃ。: I see. Then it's okay. Bye.
translations.ねぇ、一緒に帰ってくれない？ いいわよね？:
Hey, how about going home
together？ You're okay,
right？
translations.ふふ、そう言ってくれると思った。:
Hehe, I thought you'd say
that.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、一人で帰るね。:
I see. Then I'll go home
alone.
translations.今から帰るなら、私と一緒に帰らない？:
If you're going home now, how
about we walk together？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、お姉さんがエスコートしてあげる▼:
Hehe. Then let this big sister
escort you▼
translations.よかった。待ってたんだけど、一緒に帰る？:
Oh, great. I've been waiting.
How about going home
together？
translations.そっか。次は一緒に帰ってくれるとうれしいな。じゃあね。:
I see. I'd be glad if you
could go with me. Maybe next
time... Bye.
translations.カノジョから下校のお誘い受けたら、カレシはどうするのかな？:
Your girlfriend is asking you
to walk home together. What do
you say？
translations.あ、そういうこと言うんだ。今日はいいけど、次はお願いね？:
Ah, so that's your answer.
Today, I'll let you go, but
please go with me next time,
okay？
translations.ね、今日は一緒に帰りたい？:
Hey, wanna go home together
today？
translations.うん、一緒に帰りたい。:
Okay, I want to go home with
you.
translations.素直で大変よろしい▼:
An obedient guy is really
nice▼
translations.それじゃしょうがないか。また今度だね。:
It can't be helped then. Maybe
next time.
translations.実は待ってたの。一緒に行かない？:
I've been waiting for you.
Shall we go together？
translations.あぁ、いいよ。一緒に行こう。:
Yeah, that's okay. Let's go
together then.
translations.ごめん。今日は急ぐから、一緒には……。:
Sorry, I have to hurry to
school. If we go together...
translations.そっか。じゃあ、気を付けてね。:
I see. Be careful on your way
then.
translations.ね。学校、一緒に行くでしょ？:
Hey, how about we go to school
together？
translations.そう？ じゃあ、私はゆっくり行くね。:
Really？ Then I'll take my
time walking there.
translations.学校まで連れて行ってあげようか？:
Shall I tag along when you
walk to school？
translations.ふふ。じゃ、ついてきなさい？: Hehe. Then you can follow me.
translations.あ、そうなの？ じゃあ、しょうがないか。:
Ah, really？ It can't be
helped then.
translations.今日も１日、がんばってね？:
Let's do our best again today,
okay？
translations.●だけど。今から会える？:
It's me. Do you want to meet
somewhere right now？
translations.もちろん。私も会いたい……。:
Of course. I also wanted to
see you.
translations.じゃ、今から▲デート場所▲で。:
Then let's meet at the
▲デート場所▲.
translations.ごめんなさい。今からは無理なの、残念だけど。:
I'm sorry. I can't meet you
now. So unfortunate.
translations.そっか、わかった。じゃあ、また今度。:
Is that so？ I see. Then talk
to you later.
translations.もしもし、●。あのさ、今から会えないかな？:
Hello. It's me. Do you want to
meet somewhere right now？
translations.冗談。ふふ、だまされちゃって。:
Just kidding. Hehe. You fell
for it again.
translations.はは。じゃ、今から▲デート場所▲で。:
Haha. Then let's meet at the
▲デート場所▲.
translations.了解。すぐ来なさいね？:
Roger that. You must hurry
there, okay？
translations.んー、タイミング悪いな。今はダメ。:
Hmm. Bad timing. I can't go
now.
translations.あのさ。今から会えないかな、大丈夫？:
Well, I was thinking about
meeting you somewhere now. Is
it okay？
translations.はぁい、すぐ行くからね？:
Yes~！ You must hurry there,
okay？
translations.今はちょっとダメだなぁ。: I think I can't go now.
translations.残念。またにしてね？:
Too bad. Let's meet some time
later, okay？
translations.ちょっと待って……うん、いいよ。:
Of course. I also wanted to
see you.
translations.じゃ、▲デート場所▲で。:
Then let's meet at
▲デート場所▲.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、しょうがないね。:
I see. Then it can't be
helped.
translations.ごめんね。また今度お願い。:
Sorry. Please ask me again
next time.
translations.うん。遅れちゃダメよ？:
Okay. Don't be late, all
right？
translations.ちょっと急かな、今手が離せないから。:
t's too sudden. I'm in the
middle of some work and I
can't go.
translations.えっと……大丈夫。よかったね？\nふふ▼:
Well... Okay. This is great,
isn't it？ Hehe▼
translations.ちょっと用があるから……また今度だね。:
I got something to do... Maybe
next time, okay？
translations.うん。どうしてかは、自分で考えて。:
Yes. Do you know why？ Think
about it.
translations.（機嫌悪そうだったな……）:
(She seemed to be in a very
bad mood...)
translations.へぇ、会いたいんだ？: Hmm？ Do you want to meet me？
translations.会いたくない。切るね。:
I don't want to meet you. I'll
hang up now.
translations.会ってあげたいとは思うんだけどね……。:
I guess you're thinking that I
want to meet you, huh？
translations.でもやっぱり会いたくないの。じゃあね。:
But, I really don't want to.
Bye.
translations.もしもし。えっと、寧々だけど。今から会えない？:
Hello. Um, Nene speaking. Do
you want to meet somewhere
right now？
translations.いいよ。じゃあ……▲デート場所▲で。:
All right. I'll see you at the
▲デート場所▲.
translations.ごめんなさい。どうしても、会いたくなっちゃって。:
I'm so sorry. I just really
wanted to meet you.
translations.●も会いたいな。じゃ、またあとで。:
I wanted to meet you, too. See
you then.
translations.そっか、急過ぎたね。ごめんなさい。:
I see. I know it was sudden.
Sorry.
translations.もしもし、私。今から会える？:
Hello, it's me. Can we meet
now？
translations.私、早く会いたいな？:
I really want to meet you as
soon as possible.
translations.そうなの？ しょうがないか。:
Really？ It can't be helped
then, huh？
translations.私、寧々だよ。今から会お？:
This is Nene speaking. Can we
meet now？
translations.ふふ、いい子いい子。またあとでね。:
Hehe. Nice kid, nice kid. See
you then.
translations.そう、いきなりだもんね。: I see. It was sudden, huh？
translations.おはよう。朝から呼び出してごめん。:
'Morning. Sorry for calling
you out early in the morning.
translations.おはよう。ぜんぜん、いいよ。あなたが会いたいんだったら。:
'Morning. I'm okay with it. I
also wanted to meet you.
translations.おはよ。そんな眠たそうな顔しないの、シャキっとしなさい？:
'Morning. What's with that
sleepy face？ You should feel
refreshed.
translations.もう、寝グセついてるよ？ カワイイんだから▼:
Hey, you came here with your
bed hair. So cute▼
translations.ごめん、急に呼び出して。:
Sorry for calling you so
sudden.
translations.私、あなたのカノジョだもん。呼び出されたら、出てくるよ？:
I'm your girlfriend. I'll see
you whenever you want, okay？
translations.カノジョ呼びつけるなんて、生意気じゃない？ ふふ▼:
You get used to calling your
girlfriend out already, huh？
Hehe▼
translations.そんなにカノジョに会いたかったの？ ふふ▼:
You wanted to see your
girlfriend this much. Hehe▼
translations.ごめん、こんな時間に呼び出して。:
Sorry for calling you out at
this late hour.
translations.会いたいんだったら、時間なんて関係ないよ。:
When we want to meet up, the
time doesn't matter.
translations.いいよ。わがままだって許しちゃうから。:
It's okay. I can forgive your
selfishness.
translations.おはよう。ごめんね、朝から。:
'Morning. Sorry for calling
you out so early.
translations.おはよう。いいって、そんなの気にしないで。:
'Morning. You don't have to
worry about that.
translations.おはよ。朝から呼びだしちゃったけど、大丈夫？:
'Morning. I called you out
quite early. Are you okay？
translations.急に呼び出すのって、迷惑かな？:
I called you out all of a
sudden. Did I bother you？
translations.そんなわけないって。恋人なんだからさ。:
Not at all. We are lovers,
right？
translations.お、ちゃんと来たね？: Oh, you really came to see me.
translations.急いで来てくれたの？ うれしいな。:
You hurried here, huh？ I'm so
happy.
translations.まぁその、早く会いたいしさ。:
Well, because I wanted to see
you as soon as possible.
translations.ねぇ、こんな時間に呼び出すのって、迷惑かな……。:
Hey, did I bother you when I
called you out at a time like
this？
translations.まさか。うれしいって。:
No. I'm really happy that you
called me.
translations.会いたいときに会ってくれるカレシって、私好きだな？:
I really love a boyfriend who
always comes to see his
girlfriend whenever she wants.
translations.はは。これからも努力するよ。:
Haha. I'll try my best from
now on too.
translations.遅いのに出てきてくれて、ありがと。褒めてあげちゃう。:
Thanks for coming out even at
a late hour like this. I
should give you a compliment.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。あの、お願いがあるんだけど。:
▲主人公＊▲.
I have something to ask you.
translations.▲新主人公▲。って呼んじゃ、ダメかな。:
▲新主人公▲.
Can I call you like this？
translations.よかったぁ。恥ずかしいけど、勇気出してよかった▼:
I'm glad. It's a little
embarrassing but I just wanted
to try it▼
translations.うーん、別の呼び方がいいかな……。:
Hmm... How about trying
something else...？
translations.▲新主人公▲ってのはどう？:
▲新主人公▲.
How about this one？
translations.それは、やめにしたいかな。:
I think you'd better stop
that.
translations.今のままでいいんじゃないかな。:
Isn't it already good the way
it is？
translations.これからあなたのことこう呼ぶけど、いい？:
If I call you like this from
now on, what would you say？
translations.ふふ。そうやって、私の言うこと聞いてくれちゃうとこ、好きよ？:
Hehe. I like it when you
listen to what I say like
this.
translations.もう、せっかく切り出したのに。:
Geez. I was being daring and
all.
translations.▲新主人公▲。って呼ばれたら、うれしい？:
▲新主人公▲.
Are you happy when I call you
like this？
translations.ほんと？ じゃあ、呼んじゃう。:
Really？ Then I'll call you
this way.
translations.うん。じゃあこれからは、こう呼ぶね？:
Okay, so I'll call you this
way from now on.
translations.これはさすがに……イヤ？:
How about I called you like
this？ You like it？
translations.すごく恥ずかしいんだけど、喜ぶかなって。:
It's so embarrassing but I
think you might like it.
translations.（せっかくだし、ここは思い切って……）:
(Well, since she asked, I'd
better choose what I like...)
translations.それよりも……▲新主人公▲、なんてどうかな……。:
I'd rather go with
▲新主人公▲.
How's that？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。……あなたが、こう呼んで欲しいなら。大丈夫。:
▲主人公＊▲.
If you like this name, I'm
fine with it.
translations.うん、そうだよ。びっくりした。: Yeah, no good. You scared me.
translations.（ちぇっ、これはダメだったか……）:
(Tsk. So this is no good,
huh...？)
translations.あ……そっか。いいの、忘れて。:
Ah... Really？ Fine. Just
forget it.
translations.ほら、どうなの？ こういうの。: Hey, how do you like it？
translations.やっぱりね。こういうのが好きなんだ。: Right. I knew you'd like this.
translations.もう、喜んじゃって。カワイイ▼:
Hey, you're that happy. So
cute▼
translations.もー、しょうがないなぁ。: Well, I have no choice, huh？
translations.なるほどね、そうきたか……。:
I see. So you like it like
that...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと、そろそろ別の呼び方してみるかな……？）:
(The way I call
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
now... Shall I try changing
it...？)
translations.やっぱり、このまま: I should keep it the same
translations.うん。あなたがそう呼びたいなら、いいよ。:
Okay. If you want to call me
like that, it's fine.
translations.恥ずかしがらなくてもいいって！: You don't have to be shy！
translations.そうじゃなくて。本当に……無理。:
That's not the case. ...Just
don't call me like that.
translations.もう、ハシャいじゃって。:
Hey, you don't have to be that
happy.
translations.それはちょっとないなぁ。:
I don't think that's a good
idea.
translations.はは、ウケた？ いいよねこれ。:
Haha, you like it？ It's good,
right？
translations.いいよ。もう一回呼んでみて？:
That's okay. Can you call me
again？
translations.ふふ、喜んじゃって。カワイイ▼:
Hehe. You look so happy.
You're cute▼
translations.他の呼び方がいいな。だから、ね？:
You shouldn't call me like
that, okay？
translations.うーん、あなたのお願いだしなぁ。: Well, if you really want to...
translations.そうそう、お願い聞いて？: Yes, yes. I really want to.
translations.でもやっぱりダメ。ほんとにイヤなんだもん。:
But, no. I really don't like
this name.
translations.ちょっと今からいくところがあって、急いでるの。:
I'm on my way somewhere, so
I'm in a hurry.
translations.そっか。呼びとめてごめん。: I see. Sorry for stopping you.
translations.ちょっとキャッチがうるさくて、てっきり。:
With such a pick up line, I
thought...
translations.（あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だ。今日シフト入ってたっけ？）:
(That's
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Did she have a shift today？)
translations.今日シフト入ってたっけ？: Did you have a shift today？
translations.ううん。急に休みの人が出たから、ヘルプ。:
No. Someone couldn't make it
so I came in.
translations.ふふ。じゃあサポートしてくれると助かるな。:
Hehe. Then it would help if
you support me.
translations.オッケー、●でよければ。:
Okay. If you are all right
with me.
translations.（別に、気にすることじゃないか）:
(It's not what I need to worry
about.)
translations.（あれ、これってどうするんだっけ……）:
(Oh, how was I supposed to do
this...？)
translations.あのさ、これってどうするんだっけ……。:
Um, how am I supposed to do
this...？
translations.どういたしまして。少しずつ覚えていってね。:
You're welcome. Keep learning
it a little at a time.
translations.わかった、頑張るよ。: Got it. I'll do my best.
translations.あ、もう行かなくて大丈夫？:
Ah, don't you need to go
soon？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。先生から頼まれごと。ちょっとそこまで。:
▲主人公＊▲.
I'm doing an errand for a
teacher.
translations.なんか手伝う？:
Is there anything I can help
you with？
translations.ううん、大したことじゃないから。: No, it's not a big deal.
translations.結構長く話しちゃったね。そろそろ行こうかな。:
We talked for quite a bit. I
guess I'll get going.
translations.そう？ じゃあ、●ももう行くよ。:
Yeah？ Then I guess I'll get
going too.
translations.あ、そろそろ行かなきゃ。: Ah, I have to get going.
translations.そうなの。呼び止めてごめんね。:
That's right. Sorry for
stopping you.
translations.（そういや、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も今休憩か。休憩室にいるかも）:
(That's right.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is taking a break, too. She
might be in the break room
now.)
translations.（ま、いいか。外の空気でも吸おう）:
(Well, whatever. I'll get some
fresh air outside.)
translations.ないけど、休憩のタイミング同じだったなって思って。:
No, I just think that we both
are taking breaks at the same
time.
translations.私は、そろそろ戻るね。:
It's about time for me to go
back.
translations.（●ももう少ししたら仕事戻るか……）:
(I should also go back to work
soon...)
translations.なんか、お疲れだね？:
Aren't you looking a bit
tired？
translations.もうすぐお客さん落ち着きそうだから、頑張って。ね？:
The customers will settle down
soon, so do your best. Okay？
translations.（よし！ もう少し頑張るか）:
(All right！ I'll work hard
for a bit more.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。どうしたの？ なんか元気ない？:
▲主人公＊▲.
What's up？ You don't seem
very energetic.
translations.そう？ 腹が減ってるから、それでかな？:
Really？ I'm hungry, so maybe
that's why.
translations.ふふ、男の子だね。じゃあ、いいものあげる。先生には内緒ね。:
Hehe, just like a boy. Then
I'll give you something good.
Keep it a secret from the
teacher.
translations.のど飴。あまりお腹の足しにはならないかもだけど。:
A cough drop. It might not
help your hunger much though.
translations.（うん、少しは空腹も紛れるかな……）:
(Yeah, I think it helped a
bit.)
translations.ふふ、冗談。いじめちゃった。:
Hehe, just kidding. I was
teasing you.
translations.あ、もう行かなきゃ。じゃあね。:
Ah, I have to get going. See
you later.
translations.あ、ごめんね。呼び止めて、立ち話させちゃって。もう行くから。:
Ah, I'm sorry. I stopped you
and kept you occupy. I guess
I'll be going now.
translations.いいって、そんなの。:
I had a good time chatting
with you.
translations.どこでも会えるのにね。あなたのこと見かけると……ううん、じゃあね。:
Seems like we can see each
other everywhere. When I see
you around, I... No, never
mind. See you later.
translations.結構長く話しちゃったな。:
We've been talking for a
while.
translations.ほんとだ。じゃあ、もう行くね。バイバイ。:
Yeah. I've got to go now.
Bye-bye.
translations.だって楽しいんだもん。用があるから、もう行くね。バイバイ。:
But teasing you is fun. I've
got something to do, so I have
to get going. Bye-bye.
translations.（もう行っちゃった、なんか遊ばれてるな……）:
(She left... Somehow, she
seemed to enjoy teasing me...)
translations.あれ、仕事？ 休憩中だよね。:
Eh？ Are you working？ You're
taking a break？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、色々任されてるもんな。よし手伝うよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
has a lot to take care of.
I'll help you then.
translations.ほら、二人でやればすぐ終わるじゃん。:
See？ When we did this
together, we could get it done
faster.
translations.ありがとう。ごめんね、休憩終わっちゃうよね。:
Thank you. Sorry for making
you work during your break.
translations.ちょっと手伝って欲しいんだけど。: I think I need your help.
translations.うーん、いいけど。お願いは？:
Okay but you have to ask me
nicely.
translations.（お客さん多いな、この調子じゃ休憩はしばらく無理か）:
(So many customers today. I
guess I won't have time for a
break.)
translations.もう休憩でしょ？ 行ってきなさい。:
It's your break time, right？
You should rest.
translations.でもこの混み具合じゃ……。:
But it's so crowded like
this...
translations.生意気言わないの。休むときは休む、ほら。:
Just be obedient. Break time
is break time. Go.
translations.うん、わかった。ありがとう。: Okay. I got it. Thank you.
translations.（未だに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には世話になりっぱなしだな）:
(Even now,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is still taking care of me...)
translations.●に用？ だったら中に入ってくればいいのに。:
Is there anything you want？
Why didn't you just come in？
translations.うん。でも上級生が教室まで会いに来たら迷惑かなって。:
Well, it might not be good if
a student of higher grade get
in the classroom.
translations.あぁ、もう席つかないと。: Ah, class is about to start.
translations.ごめんなさい。チャイムが鳴るまで話しちゃって、もう行くから。:
Sorry. I've been here until
the bell rang. I've got to go.
translations.そんな気にしなくたっていいよ。:
Don't worry about that. It's
okay.
translations.（なんか視線を感じる……）:
(I feel like someone is
staring at me...)
translations.来ちゃった。ちゃんと私に気付くなんて、えらいえらい。:
I'm here. You're great to
notice that I'm here.
translations.もう行くね。また、来るかも。:
I have to go. I'll drop by
again, I guess.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。どうしたの、教室まで来るなんて。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What's the matter？ Why did
you come to my class？
translations.もちろん、あなたに会いに来たんだよ？: Of course, I want to see you.
translations.よし、じゃあ行くね。また来るから。:
Okay, I have to go. I'll drop
by again.
translations.周り、人いなくなったな。って思って。:
I'm thinking that there aren't
any people around.
translations.断れないの、わかってるくせに。: You know that I can't refuse.
translations.いいけど、あまり調子に乗っちゃダメよ？:
Yes... But don't get carried
away, okay？
translations.はい、これで終わり。いい？:
Okay, now it's enough. All
right？
translations.わかってると思うけど、今回は特別よ？:
I think you already know that
this is special just for
today, okay？
translations.もう、仕事中なのに……。: Hey. We are at work now...
translations.でも、いい？: But we can do it, right？
translations.仕事中だってこと、忘れちゃダメよ？:
Just don't forget that we're
at work now, okay？
translations.このくらいにしておこうか。: Do you think this is okay？
translations.ダーメ。人、来ちゃうから。:
No！ What if someone came
here？
translations.すぐ調子にのるんだから、もう。:
You're getting carried away
again. Geez.
translations.人が来る前に、おしまいにしましょ。:
Let's stop it before someone's
here.
translations.こんなの、今回だけだからね？:
This is special just for this
time. Really.
translations.あ、ニヤけちゃって。いいことあったんだ。:
Ah, you smiled. Something good
must've happened.
translations.今日の情報共有は、どんな感じ？:
How should we proceed about
today's meeting？
translations.もうアレばっかり。キス、キス、キス。ふふふ。:
It's always that thing with
him. Kiss, kiss, kiss. Hehehe.
translations.最近アレがご無沙汰かも。キスしてくれないんだよね。:
He's been neglecting me. He
didn't even kiss me.
translations.カレったら、上手なの。キスがすっごく。:
My boyfriend's kissing skills
are great.
translations.カレ、もうちょっと上手くなればいいんだけどなぁ、キスが。:
I think it'd be good if he got
better at kissing.
translations.スキンシップが好きみたい。ふふふ。:
I think he likes to touch me.
Hehehe.
translations.スキンシップ……上手くないのが、ちょっとね。:
Skinship...？ He's not very
good at it.
translations.いっぱいデートしてるの。いーっぱい。:
We date very often. Very, very
often.
translations.んー、もっとデートしたいんだけどなぁ。:
Hmm, I want to go on more
dates with him.
translations.カレとデートすると、すごく楽しいよ。:
I always have fun when I go on
dates with him.
translations.デート……気まずくなることが、よくあって……。:
Date...？ Sometimes he made me
feel terrible...
translations.私の服、すっごく気にするの。ふふふ。:
He really cares about what I
wear. Teeheehee.
translations.私が着てる服には、あまり興味ないみたいね。:
He doesn't seem to care about
what I wear.
translations.もっと、たくさん話したいなぁ。: I want to talk more with him.
translations.デートスポットを全部制覇しちゃいました！ ふふふ。:
We've visited all the
available date spots！
Teeheehee.
translations.ここのところ、同じ場所でのデートが多いんだぁ。:
He likes to take me to the
same places over and over.
translations.メールたくさんくれるの。ふふふ。:
He sent me a lot of messages.
Teeheehee.
translations.カレのメール少ないから。会えないときが、ちょっとね。:
He rarely sends me messages.
It's painful when we can't
meet.
translations.カレ、私のこと呼び出して話したがるの。ふふふ。:
He likes to ask me to hang out
with him. Teeheehee.
translations.そういえば、あまり呼び出したりしてくれないなぁ。:
Speaking of which, he rarely
asks me to hang out with him.
translations.しちゃいました。ながーいキス！ ふふふ！:
We did it. Very long kisses！
Teeheehee！
translations.一緒に勉強することが多いかな、私の部屋で。:
We study together a lot in my
room.
translations.部屋で一緒に勉強すると……ご褒美あげちゃうんだ。:
When we study together in my
room, I usually give him some
rewards.
translations.部屋で一緒に勉強してると……そのまましちゃうの、キス。:
Whenever he comes to study in
my room, we end up kissing...
translations.デートしてると、すぐ時間がたっちゃうの。だから帰りが遅くなっちゃう。:
Our dates usually end quite
late, so we have to hurry
home.
translations.デートして、そのまま喫茶店に寄って話すことが多いな。:
During the dates, we usually
stop by at coffee shops.
translations.カレね、ショートヘアが好きなの。だから好みに合わせてるんだ。:
He likes short hair. So I just
do what he wants.
translations.カレはロングが好きだから、私も伸ばしてるの。:
He likes long hair. That's why
I'm growing mine.
translations.カレ、かわいい服が好きだから。私も着ちゃうんだ。:
He likes cute clothes, so I'm
wearing them.
translations.カレ、落ち着いた服が好きなの。だから努力してます、ふふ。:
He likes casual clothes. I'm
trying to wear them. Hehe.
translations.カレ、サッパリした服が好きなのよね。結構助かるかな。:
He likes simple clothes. I
think that saves me the
hassle.
translations.カレの服の好みがよく変わるから、大変。:
His clothing preference keeps
changing. It's very hard for
me.
translations.わかんない、かな。まだ付き合い始めたばかりだもの。:
I don't really know. After
all, we've just started
dating.
translations.恋人らしくはなってきたけど、まだこれからかな。:
We're getting more like
lovers, but I guess it's still
a long way to go.
translations.カレのことどんどん好きになってきてる……。:
I love him more and more each
day...
translations.もうね、隣にカレがいて当たり前なの。そんな感じ。:
I always want him to be beside
me. It's that kind of feeling.
translations.もう離したくないなぁ、カレのこと。:
I don't want to be separated
from him.
translations.大好き。だからもうずっと一緒にいたいんだ。:
I really love him. That's why
I always want to be with him.
translations.もうカレに会えないでいると、ダメになっちゃうの私。:
When I can't meet him, it
feels like I can't do
anything.
translations.私、もうカレのことしか見えないの。他はもう、どうだっていいの。:
As long as he's with me, I
don't really care about
anything else.
translations.あなたの話も聞かせてくれるんでしょ？: I want to hear about you, too.
translations.聞かせて聞かせて。:
Let me hear it. Let me hear
it！
translations.こんなことも聞いちゃうけど……。:
I want to ask you this
question...
translations.カレとの将来って、考えてるのかな？:
Have you thought about your
future with your boyfriend？
translations.まだ、そこまでは……わからないな。:
I haven't thought about that
yet.
translations.うん。カレとなら、ずっと続けたいな。:
Yes. I want to be together
forever with him.
translations.もちろん。もうね、ぜーったい離れたくないよ。:
Of course. Let's see. I'll
never want to be separated
from him.
translations.こんな感じ、かな。ふふふ。:
It feels like this, I guess.
Teeheehee.
translations.色々あるよねぇ、付き合ってると。:
There's so much going on when
we go out with someone.
translations.おはよう。今日もあなたと一緒、ふふ。:
'Morning. I can be with you
again today. Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、何話すの？:
Hey, what shall we talk
about？
translations.ふふ。ううん、あなたがいるだけで嬉しくなっちゃった。:
Hehe. Just having you here
makes me happy.
translations.今日は、何話そっか。:
What shall we talk about
today？
translations.さて、夜はまだまだ長いよ？:
Well, the night is still very
long, right？
translations.もう夜だね、どうする？:
It's dark already. What's your
plan？
translations.こんな遅くにお話？ しょうがないなぁ。:
You wanna chat at this late
hour？ I have no choice, huh？
translations.おはよう。今日も一緒にがんばりましょ？:
'Morning. Let's do our best
again today, okay？
translations.今お昼だよ、お寝坊さんだなぁ。:
It's noon now. What a
sleepyhead.
translations.こんな時間に起きるなんて、大丈夫？:
You just woke up at this
hour？ Are you okay？
translations.え、今起きたんだ。今夜寝られないよ？:
Eh？ You just got up？ You
won't be able to sleep at
night then.
translations.なに、起きちゃったの？ 怖い夢でも見た？:
What？ You just woke up？ Did
you have a nightmare？
translations.おはよう。早起きなんだね、どうしたのかな。:
'Morning. You got up very
early. I wonder why.
translations.朝になって寝るなんて、感心しないなぁ。:
Going to bed in the morning
isn't something to be proud
of, you know？
translations.お昼寝？ 私と添い寝なんてどう？ ふふ、冗談。:
Are you taking a nap？ Wanna
sleep with me then？ Hehe, I'm
kidding.
translations.もう寝るの？ 生活リズム、大丈夫？:
Are you going to bed now？ Is
your life rhythm okay？
translations.おやすみなさい。明日も会えるといいね。:
Good night. It would be good
if we meet again tomorrow.
translations.おやすみなさい。いつもこんなに遅いの？:
Good night. Do you always
sleep late？
translations.今から寝るんだ、起きられるかな？:
If you go to bed now, can you
wake up in the morning？
translations.そういえば……ううん、なんでもないの。: By the way... No, never mind.
translations.ねぇ、何か聞きたいことあったりしない？:
Hey, don't you have anything
you want to ask？
translations.もう、そんなに見つめないで。:
Hey, don't stare at me like
that.
translations.楽しみじゃない？ 今度のデート。:
Are you looking forward to our
coming date？
translations.私も。いっぱい楽しもうね。: Me, too. I really can't wait.
translations.楽しみじゃないんだ。もう！:
You aren't looking forward to
it！？ Come on！
translations.前のデートね、楽しかったと思わない？:
Do you think our recent date
was fun？
translations.でしょ？ またあんなデートしたいな。:
Right. I want to have a date
like that again.
translations.そうなの、私だけか。: Really？ It was just me, huh？
translations.ふふ、大事にするからね。:
Hehe, I'm going to treasure
it.
translations.え？ プレゼントのことだよ？:
Eh？ I mean the present you
gave me.
translations.今ね、誰のこと考えてたの？:
Who are you thinking about
right now？
translations.そう、キレイだもんね。:
Huh？ She must be a pretty
girl.
translations.ふふ、調子いいこと言っちゃって。でも嬉しい。:
Hehe, you really said it. But
this makes me happy.
translations.今度のバレンタイン、やっぱり期待してる？:
Are you expecting something on
Valentine's Day？
translations.さーてどうしましょう？ ふふ、冗談。:
Well, what should I do then？
Hehe, just kidding.
translations.クリスマスが近いけど？ カノジョと一緒に過ごしたり？:
Christmas is coming soon. Are
you going to spend your time
with your girlfriend？
translations.なんだ。いいです、一人で待ってるから。:
What？ Fine. I'll spend my
time alone then.
translations.もうすぐ私たちの記念日だね。覚えてるよね？:
It's almost our anniversary.
Do you remember that？
translations.ありがとう。覚えててくれて、うれしいな。:
Thank you. I'm glad that you
remember it.
translations.もうすぐ誕生日じゃない？ 楽しみにしてる？:
It's almost your birthday. Are
you looking forward to it？
translations.お祝いしようね、二人で。:
We'll celebrate together, just
the two of us.
translations.あのね、もうすぐ私の誕生日だよ。覚えてるよね？:
Hey, it's almost my birthday.
Do you remember it？
translations.ふふ、期待しちゃうから。:
Hehe. I'll be expecting
something from you then.
translations.もうすぐ今年も終わるね。いい１年だったかな？:
Soon this year will be over.
Has it been a wonderful year？
translations.うん、あなたのおかげで。私も。:
Yeah, because of you, it has
been a great year for me, too.
translations.もうすぐ新学期だね、待ち遠しい？:
Soon the new semester will
start. You want it to come
faster？
translations.そう？ 学校でも一緒にいようね。:
Really？ We can spend time
together at school too,
right？
translations.そっか、私たちはどこでも会えるもんね。:
I see. We can meet anywhere
outside school, too.
translations.もうすぐテストだけど、勉強は大丈夫？:
Tests are coming up. Did you
study？
translations.もう、今からでも準備すること。:
Hey. You still have time to
get ready.
translations.もうすぐ春ね。春は好き？:
Soon it'll be spring. Do you
like spring？
translations.うん。春っていい季節だもんね。:
Yeah. Spring is such a
wonderful season, right？
translations.そうなの？ でも私と一緒なら、ね。:
Really？ But I'll be with you,
okay？
translations.もうすぐ夏ね。夏は好き？:
Soon it'll be summer. Do you
like summer？
translations.海に行ったり山に行ったり、たくさん楽しもうね。:
We can go to the ocean and the
mountain. A lot of enjoyable
things to do.
translations.そっか、暑いのは苦手かな。:
Is that so？ You dislike the
heat？
translations.もうすぐ秋ね。秋は好き？:
Soon it'll be fall. Do you
like fall？
translations.ご飯おいしいもんね、私は気をつけなくっちゃ。:
Food tastes delicious in fall.
I must be very careful.
translations.寒くなるしね、でも私があっためてあげる。:
It's getting cold. But I'm
with you, so I'll make you
feel warm.
translations.もうすぐ冬ね。冬は好き？:
Soon it'll be winter. Do you
like winter？
translations.そうよね。なんといってもクリスマス、かな。:
Right. The most important
thing is we have Christmas in
winter, huh？
translations.あのね、好きな色、教えてくれない？:
Hey, can you tell me your
favorite color？
translations.そうなんだ。うんうん、覚えよっと。:
I see. Okay, okay. I'll
remember it.
translations.変わった色が好きなんだね。:
You like such a weird color,
huh？
translations.あのね、好きな食べ物、教えてくれない？:
Hey, can you tell me your
favorite food？
translations.私と一緒。食べ物の好みが同じだと、便利よね。ふふ。:
I love it too. It's convenient
when we have the same
preference. Hehe.
translations.そっか、私はダメなんだよね……。:
I see. I don't think I can eat
that...
translations.へぇ、食べたことないかも。:
Huh？ I don't think I have
ever eaten that.
translations.ねぇ、私の服なんだけど、どんなのが好み？:
Hey, what kind of outfit do
you like me to wear？
translations.そっか、覚えておく。けど期待するのはほどほどにね。:
I see. I'll remember that. But
don't have too high
expectation, okay？
translations.えぇ？ それってやっぱり。エッチなんだから。:
Eh？ That's such a perverted
idea.
translations.ふふ、なら参考にしちゃう。:
Hehe. I'll remember this for
later, then.
translations.あのね、どんな映画が好きか、教えてくれない？:
Hey, can you tell me what kind
of movies you like？
translations.やった、同じだね。今度観に行こうね。:
Yay, we like the same genre.
Let's watch a movie together
next time.
translations.私の趣味じゃないけど、そういうのを観てみるのもアリかな。:
I'm not interested in that
genre, but I might have
watched some.
translations.そうなんだ。私、観たことないなぁ。:
Is that so？ I think I've
never watched it.
translations.イベントホールのイベントって、どういうのが好きなの？:
What kind of event you like to
see at the event hall？
translations.そっか。それなら一緒に行きたいな。:
I see. We should go there
together then.
translations.うーん、あなたが好きなら、行ってみてもいいかも。:
Hm, if you like it, I don't
mind going with you.
translations.あれ、そんなのやってたっけ？:
Eh？ They have that kind of
event, too？
translations.デートって、どんなところでするのが好きなの？:
Where do you like to go for a
date？
translations.ふふ、いいね。私もそういうとこに連れてってもらいたいな。:
Hehe. That's nice. I also want
you to take me there.
translations.そうなの？ あなたが好きなら、楽しくなる。かな。:
Really？ But if you like it,
it might be fun... Right？
translations.ふふ、そっか。でもね、あなたと一緒ならどこでもいいんだ▼:
Hehe. Is that so？ But I can
go to any place that you
like▼
translations.あのね。私を動物に例えたら、なにになるかなぁ？:
Hey, if I were an animal, what
kind would I be？
translations.えー、タヌキ？ うん、可愛いもんね。:
Eh？ Raccoon dog？ Yeah, it's
cute.
translations.あ、そうなんだ。そんな風に見えるんだ。:
Ah, I see. That's how you
think about me, huh？
translations.あなたが好きなお店、教えてほしいな。:
Can you tell me your favorite
store？
translations.私も一緒。だったら、一緒に行きたいよね？:
I like it, too. We should go
there together, okay？
translations.よくわからないけど、あなたが好きなら行ってみようかな。:
I don't know much about it.
But if you like, maybe I'll
try going there.
translations.うん、わかってる。でも何度だって聞きたいの、それ。:
Okay, I know. But I won't get
bored of hearing it.
translations.私も！ 私もだよ？ 私も、大好き。:
Me, too！ I love you, too. I
love you so much.
translations.もう、はぐらかして……。:
Hey, are you avoiding my
question...？
translations.あのね……私の、どこが好きなの？:
Hey... What do you like in
me？
translations.そっかぁ。嬉しいけど、ちょっと恥ずかしいな。:
I see. I'm so happy. It's a
little embarrassing though.
translations.もう、エッチ。でも、イヤじゃないよ？:
Hey, pervert. But, I don't
really hate it.
translations.もう、ちゃんと答えてくれないんだ。:
Hey, can't you give me a valid
answer？
translations.あのね……私とキスするのって、好き？:
Well... Do you like it when we
kiss？
translations.直球だなぁ、でも私も好きなんだよ？ ふふ。:
So frank, huh？ But I also
like it. Hehe.
translations.ふぅん、私だけ盛り上がってたのかな……。:
Hmm？ I'm the only one who
enjoys it, huh...？
translations.正直だね。でも私も正直になっちゃお♪:
You're so honest. But I think
I should be honest, too♪
translations.いいの。聞かなかったことにして。ね？:
That's fine. Pretend you
didn't hear it, huh？
translations.ねぇ、キスするとき、人目って気になるんじゃない？:
Hey, do you mind people
staring when we kiss？
translations.いいんだけど……ときにはもっと大胆に、ね？:
That's fine. Occasionally, we
should try something daring,
okay？
translations.あのね。これからも二人でたくさん色んなことしたいね？:
Well, from now on, let's do
many things together, okay？
translations.そうだよね、いっぱいしようね？:
That's right. Let's do a lot
of things.
translations.将来の夢って、ある？:
Do you have a dream for your
future？
translations.そっか。それが叶うまで、隣で見てたいな。:
I see. I want to be by your
side at the time your wish is
granted.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、私と一緒にこれから見つけよう？:
I see. Then how about we try
to find our dreams together？
translations.あのね。もしかして、なんだけど。あなたの初恋って、私？:
Well, could it be... that your
first love is me？
translations.そっか……嬉しい。それと、ごめんね。:
I see... I'm so glad. Sorry
for asking.
translations.そう。もちろん、そうでも構わないよ。:
I see. Of course, I don't mind
about that.
translations.あのね、初めて会ったときのことって、覚えてる？:
Hey, do you remember the first
time we met？
translations.忘れるわけないよね。ぜったい、忘れない。:
It's not something you can
forget, right？ I'll also
never forget.
translations.あのね、初めてのデートって覚えてる？:
Hey, do you remember our first
date？
translations.私もはっきり覚えてるな……。結構緊張してたんだよ？:
I also remember it well. I was
really nervous at that time.
translations.あはは。まさか本気じゃない、よね？:
Hahaha. That can't be true,
right？
translations.ねぇ……私があなたに告白したときのことって、覚えてる？:
Hey... Do you remember when I
confessed to you？
translations.今でも変わらず……ううん、今の方が、もっと好きだよ。:
My feelings have never
changed... No, actually, I
love you more now.
translations.まさかね、照れてるだけだよね？:
That can't be. You're just
being shy, right？
translations.このタイミングでそういうこと聞いちゃうんだ。: Why are you asking this now？
translations.好き▼ 当たり前でしょ。:
I love you▼ You didn't have
to ask.
translations.もうね、大好き。愛しちゃってます▼:
I love you so much. I'm so in
love with you▼
translations.そうね、赤とか黄色みたいな、暖かい色が好きかな。:
Well, I like red and yellow.
Pretty much the warm-tone
colors.
translations.えっと、青とかの落ち着いた色が好きだな。:
Um, blue and other calming
colors.
translations.服を試せるお店が好きだな。:
I enjoy the stores that I can
shop around for clothes.
translations.アクセサリーのお店かな。女の子だもん。:
I like accessory shops, I
think. I'm a girl, after all.
translations.コスメのお店かな。私も結構大変なんです、ふふ。:
I like cosmetic stores. But,
applying make-up is hard, even
for me. Hehe.
translations.かわいい服が好き。誰のせいでこうなったと思う？:
I like wearing cute outfits.
It's because someone here
likes this style.
translations.清楚な服が好きかな。落ち着いた女ですから、ふふ。:
I like neat-and-tidy outfits.
They make me look feminine.
Hehe.
translations.カジュアルな服が好きなの、開放的になれるしね。:
I like casual outfits. I can
move freely when I wear them.
translations.今日、たくさん話できたね。ふふふ。:
We've talked a lot today.
Hehehe.
translations.今日、だいぶ話せたね。よかった。:
We've spent some time talking
today. I'm glad.
translations.今日、少ししか話せなかったね。また今度にしよ。:
We've only talked a little bit
today. See you later, okay？
translations.わかりました。ちゃあんと起きるのよ？:
I got it. I'll wake you up
right at that time.
translations.時間だよ、起きて？ ほら、遅れちゃうよ？:
It's time. Are you awake？
Hey, you're gonna be late！
translations.ねぇ、起きて。……あなた、お・き・て▼:
Hey, wake up. ...My dear, wake
up▼
translations.あの、起こす時間、忘れちゃったの。ごめんなさい。:
Um, I forgot to wake you up.
Sorry.
translations.これで起きなかったら知りません。起きなさーい!!:
If you don't wake up after
this one, I won't care
anymore. Wake up！！
translations.わかった、時間になったら呼ぶからね。:
I got it. When it's time, I'll
wake you up.
translations.あ、遅れちゃった。ごめんね、もう時間だよ。:
Ah, it's too late. Sorry, it's
time to wake up already.
translations.ねぇ、そろそろ行った方がいいよ。カノジョが待ってるから▼:
Hey, you'd better go now. Your
girlfriend will be waiting▼
translations.ほら、約束してるでしょ？ ね？:
Hey, you've promised to meet
someone now, right？
translations.覚えてるなら、ちゃんと行ってあげて。:
If you remember what to do,
you'd better go now.
translations.あのね、ジャンケンしない？ ３回勝負で勝ったらご褒美だよ。:
Let's play rock-paper-
scissors. If you win best out
of 3, I'll give you a reward.
translations.はい、私の勝ちだから、命令聞いてね？ ふふ、冗談。:
Okay, I won. You have to
follow my orders then. Hehe.
Just kidding.
translations.私の負けかぁ。それじゃあご褒美だね。:
I lost, huh？ I'll give you a
reward then.
translations.特別だからね。こんなの、あなただけだからね？:
This is special, okay？ I only
do this for you.
translations.えっと……朝のような、そうでないような。:
Um... It seems to be morning,
or maybe not.
translations.別にどうでもいいんだけど、夕方ね……。:
It doesn't matter but it's
evening now...
translations.暗いんだから夜。子供でもわかるでしょ？:
It's dark, so it's at night.
Even a kid would know this.
translations.はぁ、もう真夜中なのに……。:
Hah, it's in the middle of the
night, okay？
translations.姉ヶ崎寧々が午前０時をお知らせいたしまーす。:
Anegasaki Nene can tell you
that it's midnight.
translations.夜の１時だね、夜更かしして大丈夫？:
It's 1 o'clock at night. Is it
okay to stay up late？
translations.午前２時。寝付けないのかな。:
2 A.M. Aren't you going to
sleep？
translations.午前３時。そろそろ寝た方がいいんじゃない？:
3 A.M. You'd better go to bed
soon.
translations.おはよ、ちゃんと早起きしてるんだね。６時だよ。:
'Morning. You really woke up
so early. It's 6 A.M.
translations.８時。今日も頑張っちゃおうね？:
8 A.M. Do your best today as
well, okay？
translations.９時。今日は何をするのかな？:
It's 9 o'clock. What's your
plan for today？
translations.お昼だよー！ 午前中、がんばれたかな？:
It's noon！ Did you do your
best in the morning？
translations.１時。午後もはりきって！:
1 P.M. Keep it up for the
afternoon！
translations.２時。ねむかったら、少し休憩するのもいいかもね？:
2 P.M. If you're getting
sleepy, maybe it's good to
take a break.
translations.おやつの時間だよ、３時です。:
It's snack time. Now it's 3
P.M.
translations.５時です。落ち着いた？:
5 P.M. now. Has everything
calmed down？
translations.６時。これからどうしよっか？:
6 P.M. What's your plan after
this？
translations.７時。今日のご飯は何ですか？ ふふ。:
7 P.M. What's for dinner
today？ Hehe.
translations.８時。宿題はやった？:
8 P.M. Did you finish your
homework？
translations.９時。まだ何かしてるかな？:
9 P.M. What are you still
doing at this time？
translations.今日もあと１時間で終わり！ 明日に備えようね。:
Just one hour left for today！
Get ready for tomorrow.
translations.あなたにしかできないことが、あるよ？:
There are something that only
you can do, okay？
translations.しょうがないね、次がんばろ。:
It can't be helped. Next time,
do your best.
translations.えらいえらい、よくがんばった。:
Great, great. You did a good
job.
translations.もう少しだけ、やってみよ？: Can you still keep on going？
translations.やり遂げよ？ 私が褒めてあげるから。:
You can do it！ I'll be
supporting you.
translations.疲れたら、私のとこにおいで？: If you feel tired, come to me.
translations.寝たいときは、寝るのが一番。:
When you want to sleep, the
best thing to do is to sleep.
translations.あなたはできる子だよ？: I know you are an able man.
translations.イヤなことは忘れちゃえ。:
Whatever makes you feel bad,
forget it.
translations.泣いちゃえ。慰めてあげるから。:
If you want to cry, cry. I'll
comfort you.
translations.好・き▼ふふ……好・き▼:
I love you▼ Hehe... I love
you▼
translations.好き好き大好きっ▼:
I love you. I love you. I love
you so much▼
translations.瞳、そらさないで……。:
Don't take your eyes off of
me...
translations.好きって、言って？: Can you say you love me？
translations.言うなれば、聖なる公衆電話だね？:
Do you know that there's a
sacred public telephone？
translations.いいよ、ロンダリングしてあげる。:
It's okay. I can wash it for
you later.
translations.以上で本日の反復横とびを終了しまぁす。:
The exercise program for today
has ended here.
translations.もっと良く見せて、その分度器。:
Just look at the protractor
carefully.
translations.すごい、こんなにもりそば……。:
Wow, there are a lot of
noodles...
translations.横、もっと横……そう、ゲームセット！:
More. A little more... Yeah,
game set！
translations.あはは！ なんでそんなにプロフェッショナルなの？:
Ahaha！ You are a
professional, huh？
translations.結局、南極なの？:
Have you ever played Antarctic
Adventure？
translations.さて、次のお便りは……おっとここでまた来週。:
Okay, the next news is... Oh,
this will be announced next
week.
translations.ダメ、目にしみるから。: No, this will sting your eyes.
translations.今の天気は？ ……そう、日本晴れ！:
What's the weather like
today？ ...Yes, beautiful
weather！
translations.ライオンより狩りが上手なのは？\n……そう、ハイエナ！:
What animals are better at
hunting than lions？ ...Yes,
hyenas！
translations.あがりはお茶、ムラサキは？\n……そう、しょうゆ！:
When is a door not a door？
...Yes, when it's ajar！
translations.……なに？ 今は少し、そっとしておいて欲しいな……。:
...What？ I'd like to be
left alone for a bit...
translations.んー？ そろそろ謝る気になった？:
Hmm？ Are you finally
ready to apologize？
translations.ケンカしたままなんてやだよ？ 仲直りしたいな……。:
I hate fighting with you.
I want to make up...
translations.今日は、私の誕生日だよ？ 覚えてた、よね？:
Today's my birthday,
you know？ You remembered,
right？
translations.今日は私の誕生日なんだから、ちゃんとお祝いしてね？:
It's my birthday today,
so you'd better celebrate
properly, okay？
translations.私の誕生日だよ？ ふふ、期待してるから。:
It's my birthday, y'know？
Hehe, I'm expecting
big things from you.
translations.ねえ、カノジョの誕生日って、忘れちゃうもの？ ……はぁ。:
Hey, is a girlfriend's
birthday really something
you just forget？ ...Sigh.
translations.ひょっとしてカノジョの誕生日忘れてた？ カレシ失格じゃない？:
Did you seriously forget
your girlfriend's birthday？
That's a boyfriend fail.
translations.私の誕生日忘れてたの？ 寂しかったな……。:
Did you forget my birthday？
I was so lonely...
translations.お誕生日だね、おめでとう。ふふ、言えてよかった。:
Happy birthday.
Hehe, I'm so glad
I got to say it.
translations.お誕生日おめでとう。今日はいつもより甘えてもいいよ？:
Happy birthday. You can
let me spoil you more
than usual today, okay？
translations.ハッピーバースデー!! ……ちょっとはしゃぎ過ぎ？:
Happy birthday!!
...Was I a little
too excited？
translations.あなたの誕生日、出来ればお祝いしたかったかなあって……。:
I was really hoping I could
celebrate your birthday
with you...
translations.カノジョなんだから、カレシの誕生日ぐらい祝わせてほしかったな。:
I'm your girlfriend.
I wish you'd at least let me
celebrate your birthday.
translations.あなたの誕生日、過ぎちゃった。来年は一緒に過ごしてね？:
Your birthday passed.
Let's spend it together
next year, okay？
translations.覚えてる？ 今日って、私たちが初めて会った日なの。:
Remember？ Today is the day
we first met.
translations.今日は私たちが初めて会った日だよ、覚えてたよね？:
Today's the day we first
met. You remembered, right？
translations.初めて会ったのって、今日だったんだよ？ ずっと忘れないでね。:
Today is the day we first
met, you know？ Don't you
ever forget it.
translations.今日だよね、私たちが付き合い始めたのって。:
Today's the day we started
dating, isn't it.
translations.今日は、私たちが付き合い始めた記念日だよ。これからも覚えててね。:
Today's our anniversary.
Make sure you keep
remembering it, okay？
translations.憶えてる？ 今日って、二人が付き合い始めた日なんだよ？:
Remember？ Today's the day
we started dating, y'know？
translations.今日って、初めてキスした日……なんだよね。:
Today's the day we had
our first kiss... isn't it.
translations.ふふ。今日は私たちが初めてキスをした記念日……覚えてた？:
Hehe. Today's the anniversary
of our first kiss...
Did you remember？
translations.今日はとっても特別な記念日だよ？ ……キスの。:
Today's a very special
anniversary, you know？
...For our kiss.
translations.月曜日。さあ、また一週間がんばろうね。:
It's Monday. Let's do
our best this week.
translations.火曜日。うーん、まだちょっと休みボケかな？:
It's Tuesday. Hmm, I might
still be in weekend mode.
translations.ちょっと中だるみの水曜日。駄目駄目、がんばらなきゃ。:
Wednesday slump.
No, no, I've gotta
do my best.
translations.木曜日。週末の予定って、立ってる？:
It's Thursday. Do you have
any plans for the weekend？
translations.金曜日。今週ももうすぐ終わりだね。:
It's Friday. This week is
almost over, huh.
translations.土曜日だね。週末って、ちょっとわくわくするよね。:
It's Saturday. Weekends
are always a little
exciting, aren't they.
translations.土曜日だよ。一週間、お疲れ様でした。:
It's Saturday. Good job
getting through the week.
translations.ふふ、日曜日だね。何して過ごす？:
Hehe, it's Sunday.
How should we spend it？
translations.日曜日。やりたいことがいっぱいあるなぁ。:
It's Sunday. There's so
much I want to do.
translations.ねえねえ。雪割草って、知ってる？:
Hey, hey. Do you know
what a hepatica flower is？
translations.ああ、今日もあったかくて、キモチイイなあ。あふぅ……。:
Ahh, it's nice and warm
again today. Phew...
translations.今日も暑いけど、頑張ってね。:
It's hot again today,
but hang in there.
translations.秋に始まる恋は絆が深いんだって。どう思う？:
They say love that starts
in autumn has a deep bond.
What do you think？
translations.この季節の虫の音って、ちょっと好き。かな。:
I think I kinda like
the sound of the bugs
this time of year.
translations.寒いね。あったかいシチューなんて、食べたいかな。:
It's cold. I'd love to eat
some warm stew right now.
translations.ちゃんとあったくしてる？ 風邪なんて引いちゃだめだよ。:
Are you keeping warm？
Don't go catching a cold.
translations.あけましておめでとうございます。って、ちょっと照れちゃうね。:
Happy New Year. Saying it
like that is a little
embarrassing, huh.
translations.素敵な初夢、見ちゃった。どんなだったかは、ナイショ。:
I had a wonderful first
dream of the year. What
was it about？ It's a secret.
translations.初夢？ ふふ、教えて欲しい？ ねぇ、教えて欲しい？:
My first dream？ Hehe,
wanna know？ Hey,
do you wanna know？
translations.初夢には、もちろんあなたがでてきたよ。あなたは？:
You were in my first dream,
of course. What about yours？
translations.セリ・ナズナ・ゴギョウ・ハコベラ……えっと、それから何だっけ？:
Seri, nazuna, gogyo,
hakobera... umm,
what came after that？
translations.成人式。振り袖もいいけど袴もいいよね……ふふ、どっちが好き？:
Coming of Age Day. Furisode
are nice, but hakama are
too... Hehe, which do you like？
translations.さあ、お正月気分も今日でおしまいっ！:
Well, today's the last day
of the New Year's mood!
translations.節分だね。どうして鬼って、豆が怖いのかな？:
It's Setsubun. I wonder why
demons are scared of beans？
translations.暦の上では、今日から春。まだちょっと寒いけどね。:
According to the calendar,
it's spring from today.
Still a bit cold, though.
translations.クニツクリの神話って、ちょっと照れちゃうよね……。:
The myth of Kunitsukuri
is a little embarrassing,
isn't it...
translations.ああ、ついにこの日が来ちゃったよ。ドキドキするな。:
Ahh, the day is finally
here. My heart is pounding.
translations.バレンタインデーか、どうしようかな……。ふふ、どうして欲しい？:
Valentine's Day, huh...
What should I do... Hehe,
what do you want me to do？
translations.さあ、ついに当日。覚悟しててね！ ……ふふ。:
Well, the day is finally
here. Be prepared! ...Hehe.
translations.今日から３月だね……えっ？ 違うの？:
It's March starting today...
Huh？ It's not？
translations.梅の花って、キレイだよね……。:
Plum blossoms are
so pretty, aren't they...
translations.今日は女の子の日だから、いつも以上に優しくしてね。ふふ。:
Today is Girls' Day, so
you have to be extra nice
to me. Hehe.
translations.今日が何の日か……ううん、なんでもないの。:
Do you know what day
it is... No, never mind.
translations.ふふ。今日はホワイトデー。なにをしてくれるのかな？:
Hehe. Today is White Day.
I wonder what you're
going to do for me？
translations.３倍返しが基本だよ。だからいつもの３倍、一緒にいようね。:
Returning the favor threefold
is standard. So let's spend
three times as long together.
translations.今日は春分、一日きっちり真ん中分けの日。でも春だし、昼から眠いね……。:
Today's the spring equinox,
split right down the middle.
But it's spring, so I'm sleepy...
translations.今日から春休み。まずは何する？:
Spring break starts today.
What should we do first？
translations.私、しばらく遠くに行くの……。あ、嘘だからね？:
I'm going far away for
a while... Ah, I'm just
kidding, okay？
translations.あなたなんて大っきら……だめ、嘘でもこんなこと言えないね。:
I absolutely ha... No, I
can't say that, even as a lie.
translations.私、実はもっと年上なの……なんて、信じた？:
I'm actually much older
than I look... Kidding!
Did you believe me？
translations.あっと言う間に終わっちゃったね、春休み。もうちょっと遊びたかったかな。:
Spring break ended in a
flash. I kinda wanted to
play a little more.
translations.桜の季節、気分も上向くよね。:
Cherry blossom season
really lifts your spirits.
translations.今日は昭和の日。えっと、もともとは……なんだっけ。:
Today is Showa Day.
Umm, originally it was...
what was it again.
translations.もうすぐゴールデンウィーク。今年は何連休かなあ。えーと、イチ・ニイ……。:
It's almost Golden Week.
How many days off is it
this year？ Let's see, 1, 2...
translations.憲法記念日か、ちょっとピンとこないね。:
Constitution Memorial Day,
huh. Doesn't really ring
a bell.
translations.今日はみどりの日。外でゆっくりすごしてみる？:
Today is Greenery Day.
Wanna spend some time
relaxing outside？
translations.あ、鯉のぼり。あなたはいつまであげてたの？:
Ah, carp streamers. Until
what age did you put
them up？
translations.暦の上では、今日から夏です。ちょっと楽しみ。:
According to the calendar,
summer starts today.
I'm a little excited.
translations.ねえねえ。花屋さんがね、カーネーションでいっぱいだったよ。:
Hey, hey. The flower shop
was full of carnations.
translations.体育祭か、ちょっと憂鬱。:
The sports festival, huh...
I'm a little depressed.
translations.一年で一番お昼の長い日。なんかお得な気分だよね。:
The longest day of the year.
Makes you feel like you
got a good deal, huh.
translations.今日から半袖。少し身軽になった感じ。:
Short sleeves from today.
I feel a little lighter.
translations.父の日のプレゼント。去年はネクタイ、一昨年はカフス……今年はどうしよう。:
Father's Day presents. A tie
last year, cufflinks the year
before... What should I do now.
translations.海開きだって。今年も海に行けるといいな。:
The beaches are opening.
I hope we can go to the
ocean again this year.
translations.織姫さまと彦星さん……今年はちゃんと、会えるのかな？:
Orihime and Hikoboshi...
I wonder if they'll be able
to meet this year？
translations.もうすぐ夏休み。でも遊んでばかりじゃ駄目だよ？:
It's almost summer break.
But you can't just play
all the time, okay？
translations.今日から長ぁい夏休み。何しようかな。:
A loooong summer break
starts today. What should
we do？
translations.暦の上では今日から秋。でもまだ暑いね。:
According to the calendar,
it's autumn from today.
Still hot, though.
translations.花火の季節だね、今年は観に行けるかな。:
It's fireworks season.
I wonder if we can go
see them this year.
translations.お盆だね。このあと少しは涼しくなるかな。:
It's Obon. I wonder if it'll
cool down a bit after this.
translations.夏休みも今日でおしまい。宿題、ちゃんと終わってる？:
Summer break ends today.
Did you finish all your
homework？
translations.秋のお彼岸。おはぎの用意しなくちゃ。:
Autumn equinox. I need to
get some ohagi ready.
translations.敬老の日。私も歳をとったら、可愛いおばあちゃんになりたいなあ。:
Respect for the Aged Day.
When I get old, I want to
be a cute grandma.
translations.今日は秋分、一日が真ん中でわかれる日だね。:
Today is the autumn equinox,
the day split right down
the middle.
translations.今日から冬服に衣替え。でもまだ、ちょっと暑いかな？:
Changing to winter uniforms
today. But it's still a bit
hot, isn't it？
translations.月にはウサギじゃなくてカニがいるっていう国もあるんだって。想像力って、すごいよね:
Some countries say there's
a crab on the moon instead
of a rabbit. Imagination is
pretty amazing, huh...
translations.トリック・オア・トリート！ ふふ。お菓子くれないと、悪戯しちゃうよー。:
Trick or treat! Hehe.
If you don't give me a treat,
I'll play a trick on you.
translations.文化の日。今日は読書でもする？:
Culture Day. Wanna do
some reading today？
translations.まだそんなに寒くないけど、暦の上では今日から冬だよ。:
It's not that cold yet, but
according to the calendar,
winter starts today.
translations.七五三。子供のころ、一週間かけて千歳飴食べたな。:
Shichi-Go-San. When I was a kid,
it took me a whole week
to finish my chitose candy.
translations.勤労感謝の日。働いてる人って素敵だね。:
Labor Thanksgiving Day.
Working people are amazing.
translations.文化祭といえば、何を連想する？:
What do you think of when
you hear 'culture festival'？
translations.もうすぐ冬休み。イベントいっぱいだね。:
It's almost winter break.
There are so many events.
translations.一年で一番、夜の長い日。カボチャは好き？:
The longest night of the year.
Do you like pumpkins？
translations.今日は天皇誕生日。でも、日本中でお祝いされるって、どんな気分なのかな？:
Today is the Emperor's Birthday.
I wonder what it feels like to be
celebrated by all of Japan？
translations.今日から冬休み。わくわくするね。:
Winter break starts today.
I'm so excited.
translations.イヴの夜って、何だかどきどきするね。あなたも、かな？:
Christmas Eve night makes
my heart pound. Does it
do that to you too？
translations.ふふ。今日はクリスマスイヴだよ。当然、なにか考えてるよね？:
Hehe. Today is Christmas Eve.
You've got something planned,
right？ Naturally.
translations.イヴの夜って、ロマンチック……ふふ。雪、降らないかな。:
Christmas Eve night is so
romantic... Hehe. I wonder
if it'll snow.
translations.今年一年、いろいろお疲れ様でした。来年もよろしくね。:
Good job with everything
this past year. I look forward
to being with you next year too.
translations.もぅ……やっと会えた。寂しくて泣きそうだったんだから。:
Jeez... I finally get to see you.
I was so lonely I thought
I was gonna cry.
translations.あら、お久しぶりですね。……もぉ、もっと会いに来て！:
Oh my, it's been a while.
...Jeez, come see me more often!
translations.よかった、来てくれた。もうこんなにほっておかないで？:
I'm so glad you came.
Don't leave me alone for
so long again, okay？
translations.私のこと、忘れちゃったのかと思ってた……。そんなことないよね。:
I thought you might have
forgotten about me...
That's not true, right.
translations.もう、カノジョをこんなにほっておくなんて。オシオキが必要なんじゃない？:
Jeez, leaving your girlfriend
alone for so long. Don't you
think you need to be punished？
translations.あ、来てくれた。心配してたんだよ？:
Ah, you came. I was
worried about you, y'know？
translations.もぅ、そんなに私が好きなの？:
Jeez, do you really like
me that much？
translations.何度も会いに来てくれるんだね。:
You really come to see me
a lot, don't you.
translations.あ……、今日はどうするの？: Ah... what are we doing today？
translations.そろそろかな……ううん、こっちの話。:
It's almost time... No,
just talking to myself.
translations.もうすぐ……うん、頑張ろう。ふふ、何をかは秘密。:
Almost... Yeah, I'll do my best.
Hehe, what I'm doing is a secret.
translations.また会えるって思ってたよ。: I knew I'd see you again.
translations.あれからどうしてた？: What have you been up to？
translations.すぐ始まるから、慌てないでね？:
It's starting soon, so
don't panic, okay？
translations.ごめん。なんだかちょっと、わくわくしてる。:
Sorry. I'm just a little
excited for some reason.
translations.あ、来た……うん、そっか。: Ah, you're here... Yeah, I see.
