translations.お待ち申し上げておりました。……なんて。:
I have been awaiting your
arrival. ...Just kidding.
translations.少し待ってね。準備してくるから。:
Wait a sec. I'm gonna
go get ready.
translations.そう……会いに来たんだ。: I see... You came to see me.
translations.私に会いたかった？ ふふ。:
Did you want to see me？
Hehe.
translations.ふふ、無理して会いに来なくていいのに。:
Hehe, you didn't have to push
yourself to come see me.
translations.今日はずっと一緒だよね？:
We're gonna be together
all day today, right？
translations.私も……会いたかった、かな？ あはは。:
I guess I... wanted to see
you too？ Ahaha.
translations.えへへ。待ってたよ。: Ehehe. I was waiting for you.
translations.もう。待たせ過ぎ。:
Jeez. You made me wait
too long.
translations.あ、きたきた。えへ、いらっしゃい。:
Ah, there you are.
Ehe, welcome.
translations.また会えたね。それだけで幸せだよ。:
We get to meet again.
Just that makes me happy.
translations.お帰りなさい。食事にする？ お風呂にする？ 言ってみたかったの、ふふ。:
Welcome home. Would you like
dinner？ Or a bath？ I've always
wanted to say that, hehe.
translations.今日、あなたが来るまでの時間も楽しかったな。何話そうかって、ずっと考えてたの。:
I had fun waiting for
you today. I kept thinking
about what to talk about.
translations.今日あなたが来るの、ずっと楽しみだった。ふふ。:
I've been looking forward
to you coming over today.
Hehe.
translations.今日、来てくれてよかった。最近ちょっとそっけないかなって、思ってたから。:
I'm so glad you came
today. I was starting to
think you'd been a little
cold lately.
translations.なんか久しぶりに来た気がするな。:
It feels like it's been
a while since I was here.
translations.久しぶりなんです。もう、寂しかったのに。:
It has been a while.
Jeez, I was so lonely.
translations.やっぱりここって、なんか落ち着くな。:
Being here really does
calm me down.
translations.ほんと？ そう思ってもらえると、うれしいな。:
Really？ I'm so happy
to hear you say that.
translations.もうずいぶん経ったね、私たち。:
It's been quite a while
for us, hasn't it？
translations.私たち、だいぶ慣れてきたかな？:
Have we gotten pretty
used to each other？
translations.私たちは、まだこれからだよね。:
We're still just getting
started, aren't we？
translations.あ、ごめんね。付き合いだして、どれくらい経ったか考えてたの。:
Ah, sorry. I was just
thinking about how long
we've been dating.
translations.そっか。何があったかな……。:
I see. What all has
happened...？
translations.まずは、デート。どんな場所に行ったっけ。:
First, our dates. Where
all did we go again？
translations.ここらへんで行けそうなところ、全部行ったよね。:
We've been to just about
everywhere around here,
haven't we？
translations.ここらへんは、大体行ったんじゃないかな。:
I think we've been to
most places around here.
translations.あんまり数は多くないよね。開拓した方がいいのかも。:
We haven't been to that
many. Maybe we should
explore some new spots.
translations.思い出たくさん作ったもんね。どこも、楽しかったな。:
We've made so many
memories. Everywhere we
went was fun.
translations.思い出はいっぱいあるけど、もっと色んな季節に、色んな場所に行きたいな。:
We have lots of memories,
but I want to go to more
places in every season.
translations.まだまだ足りないよね。もっともっと色んなところに行こ？:
It's still not enough.
Let's go to way more
places together, okay？
translations.思い出もっと欲しいよ。ね、お願い。:
I want to make even more
memories. Please？
translations.デート以外にも、大事なことあるよね？:
There's something else
important besides dates,
right？
translations.たくさんしたおかげで、ラブラブになれたじゃない？:
Doing it so much is what
made us so lovey-dovey,
isn't it？
translations.たくさんしちゃったもんね。もっとでもいいんだけど。:
We sure have done it a
lot. Though I wouldn't
mind doing it more.
translations.でもまだ足りないよ。遠慮してる？:
But it's still not enough.
Are you holding back？
translations.もっともっとしてもいいと思うんだけどなあ。安心させて？:
I think we could do it
way more often. Won't you
put my mind at ease？
translations.あとは長ーいキスもね。あんなの何度もしちゃうんだから。:
And those loooong kisses,
too. We've done that so
many times.
translations.あとは長ーいキスもね。……思い出しちゃった。:
And those loooong kisses,
too... Just remembering
them makes me blush.
translations.私からのおねだりも、何度もしちゃったね。ふふふっ。:
I've begged you for them
plenty of times, too.
Hehehe.
translations.私から何度もおねだりしたこともあったよね。ふふ。:
There were times when I
begged you for them over
and over, too. Hehe.
translations.（聞いてるだけでドキドキしてきた……）:
(Just listening to her
is making my heart race...)
translations.そういえば……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は何か一緒にしたいことって、ある？:
Come to think of it...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, is there anything
you want to do together？
translations.したいことか……どうして？:
Something I want to do...
Why do you ask？
translations.うん。なんか特別、思い出になることってないかな……って。:
Well, I was wondering if
there was some special way
we could make a memory...
translations.じゃあ……言っちゃう。あなたと旅行に行きたいな。もちろん、お泊まりの。:
Alright... I'll just say
it. I want to go on a trip
with you. Overnight, of
course.
translations.じゃあ、言っちゃおうかな。あなたと、旅行に行きたい。:
Alright, I'll just say it.
I want to go on a trip
with you.
translations.それじゃあね……またあなたと、旅行に行きたいな。:
In that case... I want to
go on another trip with
you.
translations.旅行……それって、二人で？:
A trip... You mean, just
the two of us？
translations.うん、また行きたい。: Yeah, I want to go again.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。この水着、どう？ あなたが選んでくれたんだから、似合ってるよね？:
▲主人公＊▲. How's this swimsuit？
You picked it out for me,
so it looks good, right？
translations.似合ってる似合ってる！ ●の見立ては間違ってなかった！:
It looks great! ●'s
judgment was spot on!
translations.やった！ じゃあ、もっと見て？:
Yay! Then you should look
a little closer, okay？
translations.（こんな感じかな……）:
(I guess it'd go something
like this...)
translations.ねえ、この日焼けあと……。こういうのがいいの？:
Hey, these tan lines...
Is this what you like？
translations.いい、いい！ 最高!! ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！:
Yes, yes! You're the best!!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.ふふ。あなたが喜んでくれるなら、恥ずかしくなんてないよ？:
Hehe. If it makes you
happy, I'm not embarrassed
at all, you know？
translations.じゃあ、お風呂。お先にね？ ……のぞかないでね？:
I'm gonna take a bath.
I'll go first, okay？
...No peeking, alright？
translations.は～、気持ちいい～。ねえ、ほんとにのぞかないの？:
Ahh, this feels so good~
Hey, are you really not
gonna peek？
translations.ねえ、お風呂行ってくるけど。一緒に入る？:
Hey, I'm gonna go take a
bath. Wanna join me？
translations.い、いいよ！ 一人で入るから。:
N-No thanks! I'll go in
by myself.
translations.そう？ ……ねえ、一緒に入りたいな？:
Really？ ...Hey, I want to
take one together, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。お風呂上がったよ。:
▲主人公＊▲. I just got out of
the bath.
translations.格好がどうかしたの？ どこか変？:
What about it？ Does it
look weird or something？
translations.ふふ、わざと？ ちゃんとお願いすれば、一緒に入ってあげるのに。:
Hehe, did you do that on
purpose？ If you ask nicely,
I'll let you join me.
translations.（ないない！ 何考えてんだ、●は……）:
(No way! What the heck are
you thinking, ●...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。何か考え事？:
▲主人公＊▲. Are you thinking
about something？
translations.あ、最近話題のゲーム。知ってる？:
Oh, that game everyone's
talking about lately.
Do you know it？
translations.そっか、じゃあ今度やってみようかな。:
I see. Maybe I'll give it
a try sometime.
translations.これからもあなたは、私のそばにいるよね？:
You're going to stay by
my side from now on, too,
right？
translations.先のことはわからない:
I don't know about the
future.
translations.ふふ、もう……。うれしいなあ……。:
Hehe, jeez... I'm so happy
to hear that...
translations.わからないの？ もう、そばにいてほしいの！:
You don't know？ Jeez, I
want you to stay by my
side!
translations.ふふ、イヤって言っても、私が離れないんだけどね？:
Hehe, even if you say no,
I'm not letting you go,
you know？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。あなたと一緒で、よかった……。:
▲主人公＊▲. I'm so glad I'm
with you...
translations.（あ、そういえば今日エイプリルフールだ）:
(Oh, right, today is
April Fools' Day.)
translations.（よし、とりあえず軽くいっとくか）:
(Alright, I'll just go with
something light for now.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。実は●、デキシーズのバイトやめようと思うんだ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Actually, ●,
I'm thinking of quitting
my job at Dexee's.
translations.（……さすがにもうちょっとひねればよかったかな）:
(...Maybe I should've put
a bit more thought into it.)
translations.お店に不満がある？ たしかに店長はちょっとアレだけど、みんないい人だし。待遇だっ:
Are you unhappy there？
Sure, the manager is a bit...
you know, but everyone is
nice. And the pay isn't bad.
translations.それに……私がいるのに。もしかして、それも原因なの？:
Besides... I'm there.
Could that be the reason too？
translations.（まあいっか。あとでちゃんと話そう）:
(Well, whatever. I'll clear
things up with her later.)
translations.（そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の誤解をとかないと）:
(Right, I need to clear up
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s misunderstanding.)
translations.あ、いた。ねえ、バイトやめるって？:
Ah, there you are. Hey,
are you really quitting？
translations.もったいなーい。ここだと可愛い制服着れるのに。:
What a waste. You get to
wear a cute uniform here.
translations.ストップストップ。それ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲から聞いたんだよね。他に何か言ってた？:
Stop, stop. You heard that
from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, right?
Did she say anything else？
translations.んー、怒ってたような～、悲しんでたような～。:
Hmm, she seemed kind of
angry~, kind of sad~.
translations.そっか……ごめん、ちょっと。:
I see... Sorry, excuse me
for a bit.
translations.あ、君。やめちゃうんだって？ 困ったなー、次の子募集しないと。:
Ah, you. You're quitting？
That's a problem, I need
to hire someone new.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。聞いて、さっきの話。あれは……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Listen, about
earlier. That was...
translations.ごめん。私、戻らないと。バイト終わったら、詳しく聞くからね。:
Sorry, I have to go back.
I'll hear all about it
after work, okay？
translations.うん……ごめん！ あれ、嘘なんだ！:
Yeah... Sorry!
That was a lie!
translations.今日、エイプリルフールだし。:
Today is April Fools',
after all.
translations.ふふ、騙された。あの子達もグルだよ？:
Hehe, you fell for it.
Those girls were in on it
too, you know？
translations.ううん、店長は素で信じてる。あとでフォローしなきゃ、ほんとに辞めることになっちゃ:
No, the manager actually
believed it. If we don't
clear it up, you'll really
end up quitting.
translations.そっか、はあ……。やられた。: I see, sigh... You got me.
translations.嘘つくにしても、単純すぎ。明らかにその場の思いつきなんだもん。:
Even for a lie, it was too
simple. It was obviously
made up on the spot.
translations.ふふ、かわいい。そうだな～じゃあ、騙そうとしたお詫びちょうだい？:
Hehe, cute. Let's see~
Then, how about an apology
for trying to trick me？
translations.そういえばゴールデンウィークだけど……。:
Come to think of it,
it's Golden Week...
translations.ああ、そういえばそうか。どうかしたの？:
Ah, right, it is.
What about it？
translations.５月３日から５日までの３日間。毎日恋人となが～いキスをすると……。:
For three days from
May 3rd to 5th. If you share
a loooong kiss with your
lover every day...
translations.二人の仲がぐ～っと進展するんだって。:
Your relationship will
progress a looot.
translations.（あのずっと続くやつかな……）:
(She must mean the one
that goes on forever...)
translations.私たち、できるかな。: I wonder if we can do it.
translations.ゴールデンウィークのキス。前に話したでしょ？:
The Golden Week kiss.
I told you about it before,
right？
translations.もう、気付かずに、あんなにしてたんだ……。:
Jeez, you were doing it
that much without even
realizing...
translations.でもこれで、二人の仲がぐ～っと進展しちゃうね？:
But with this, our
relationship will progress
a looot, right？
translations.（言われてみると、なんか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ともっと親密になれた気がする……）:
(Now that she mentions it,
I feel like I've gotten
closer to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.覚えてないんじゃ、だめだよね……。ゴールデンウィークのキス。:
If you don't remember,
it's no good... The Golden
Week kiss.
translations.結構期待してたのに……。もう。:
I was really looking
forward to it... Jeez.
translations.（今日はプール開きだ。別の学年と合同だから、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とも……）:
(Today the pool opens.
It's a joint class with
another grade, so maybe
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.やっぱり……変？ 私、スクール水着って似合わなくて……。:
Is it... weird after all？
I don't really look good in
a school swimsuit...
translations.ううん！ これはこれで、おっけー！:
No! This is totally fine
in its own way!
translations.あなたがそう言ってくれるなら、そう思うことにする。ふふ、じゃあね。:
If you say so, I'll believe
it. Hehe, see you later.
translations.（プールの授業、これからも楽しみだな！）:
(I'm looking forward to
pool classes from now on!)
translations.何見てるの？ どうせ似合わないって思ってるんでしょ？:
What are you looking at？
You think it doesn't suit
me anyway, right？
translations.すごく魅力的で……見とれてた。:
You're so attractive...
I was mesmerized.
translations.こういうのって、あなたの好みじゃないのかな？:
Is this kind of thing
not your type？
translations.そんなことない……その、好みだよ。:
That's not true... um,
it is my type.
translations.ふふ、よかった。あ、あと余所見はダメだからね？:
Hehe, good. Ah, and no
looking at anyone else,
okay？
translations.私、やっぱりダイエットした方がいいかな？:
Should I go on a diet
after all？
translations.でも私よりスタイルいい子、いっぱいいるよ？:
But there are lots of girls
with better figures than
me, you know？
translations.それは、違うよ。細けりゃいいってもんじゃないし。:
That's not true. Being thin
isn't everything.
translations.だって、水の中見えちゃうでしょ？ 他の子の水着とか。:
Because you can see
underwater, right？
Like other girls' swimsuits.
translations.そうかもしれないけど……大丈夫だよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲以外は興味ないし。:
That might be true, but...
it's fine. I'm not interested
in anyone but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.よく水泳教室とかで、先生が子供の手を持ってバタ足させるじゃない？:
You know how in swimming
classes, the teacher holds
the kid's hands and makes
them kick their legs？
translations.ちょっとやってみたいな？: I kind of want to try it？
translations.あなたって、水着姿もかっこいい……。:
You look cool in a
swimsuit too...
translations.ええ？ どうしたの、急に。:
Eh？ What's with that,
all of a sudden.
translations.あれ……今私、声に出してた？:
Huh... did I say that out
loud just now？
translations.もう、忘れて？ じゃなくて、忘れなくてもいいけど、変に思わないでね？:
Jeez, forget it？ Wait, no,
you don't have to forget it,
but don't think it's weird,
okay？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……どうしたんだろ、キョロキョロして）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I wonder what's
wrong, looking around like
that.)
translations.ふふ。あのね、やっぱりあなたが一番かっこいいかなって。:
Hehe. You know, I think
you're the coolest after all.
translations.ええ？ そうかな、どうだろ……。:
Eh？ You think so,
I wonder...
translations.私が言うんだから間違いないの！ ね？:
I'm the one saying it, so
there's no mistake! Right？
translations.ちょっと他の子に見せるのもったいないな。:
It's a bit of a waste to
show it to other girls.
translations.そんなことないよ……。というかそれはこっちの台詞じゃ。:
That's not true... Or rather,
that's my line.
translations.ねえ、お店に笹飾り置いてるじゃない？:
Hey, they have bamboo
decorations at the store,
right？
translations.そういや、忘れてた。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
Come to think of it,
I forgot. What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私もなんだよね。今日までだし、何か書こうかな。:
Me too. It's until today,
so maybe I'll write
something.
translations.じゃあ、何か思いついたら教えて。ね？:
Then, let me know if you
think of something. Okay？
translations.うん、考えたんだけど……やっぱり私たち二人のこと、書かない？:
Yeah, I thought about it...
Shouldn't we write about
the two of us after all？
translations.あなたと私が、ずっと恋人同士で、幸せでいられるようにって。:
That you and I can stay
lovers and be happy forever.
translations.内容には賛成だけど、それを店の笹に？:
I agree with the sentiment,
but on the store's bamboo？
translations.さすがにそれは……。いくらみんな知ってても、●にも恥じらいってものが。:
That's a bit... No matter
how much everyone knows,
don't you have any modesty,
●？
translations.むー。私には恥じらいがないってこと？:
Hmph. Are you saying I have
no modesty？
translations.（しまった……こりゃ挽回しないと）:
(Oops... I need to recover
from this.)
translations.あのさ、短冊吊るしてきた。「二人がずっと幸せに」……って。:
Um, I hung a tanzaku.
"May the two of us be
happy forever"...
translations.脚立借りて笹のてっぺんに。それだとさすがに下からは見えないから。これじゃ、ダメか:
I borrowed a stepladder
and put it at the very top.
You can't see it from below
that way. Is this no good？
translations.ううん、うれしい。ごめんね、気にしててくれてたんだ。なのに私……。:
No, I'm happy. Sorry, you
were thinking about it.
And yet I...
translations.いいって。機嫌なおってよかった。:
It's fine. I'm glad you're
in a better mood.
translations.（終わった……。これだけのために学校来るなんて、面倒だな登校日は……）:
(It's over... Coming to
school just for this, school
days are a pain...)
translations.（でもせっかくだし、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のとこ行ってみようかな……）:
(But since I'm here, maybe
I'll go see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。今そっちに行こうと思ってた。:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I was just
thinking of going to you.
translations.うん、先越されたな。: Yeah, you beat me to it.
translations.そっか……ふふ、なんかうれしい。:
I see... Hehe, I'm kind of
happy.
translations.上級生の教室入るのって、少し緊張するよ。:
Entering an upperclassman's
classroom makes me a little
nervous.
translations.そんなあなたが見たくなって、ちょっと意地悪しちゃった。:
I wanted to see you like
that, so I was a little
mean.
translations.ふふ、呼んじゃった。: Hehe, I called out to you.
translations.さすがにちょっと恥ずかしかった。:
That was actually a little
embarrassing.
translations.やっぱり？ 私もちょっとね。ふふっ。:
Right？ Me too, a little.
Hehe.
translations.あなたに会えるから、登校日も悪くないな？:
Since I can see you, school
days aren't so bad, right？
translations.そっか……。それなら、来た甲斐があったよ。:
I see... Then it was worth
coming.
translations.もう、だらけてるぞ？ 背筋伸ばす！:
Jeez, you're slacking off？
Straighten your back!
translations.あれ、ちょっと元気ない。休みぼけ？:
Oh, you look a bit down.
Vacation blur？
translations.はい、飴あげる。がんばれ。:
Here, have a candy.
Do your best.
translations.練習してたの、ちゃんと見てたよ。成果が出せるといいね？:
I was watching you practice.
I hope you can show the
results？
translations.あなたが出るときはぜーんぶ見るからね。かっこいいとこ見せて？:
I'll watch everything when
you're up. Show me your
cool side？
translations.あれ、ごめん。じゃあ……ほら、リラックスリラックス。:
Oh, sorry. Then... here,
relax, relax.
translations.あのね。二人三脚の代役頼まれちゃった。:
You know. I was asked to be
a substitute for the
three-legged race.
translations.うん、それでね。できれば、パートナーはあなたがいいの。:
Yeah, so. If possible,
I want you to be my partner.
translations.うん、私がパートナーじゃ、あなたの足手まといになっちゃうけど。:
Yeah, if I'm your partner,
I'll just drag you down
though.
translations.そんなことないよ。●でよければ。:
That's not true. If you're
fine with ●.
translations.じゃあ本番前に軽く合わせる練習しとこう。:
Then let's practice matching
our pace a bit before the
real thing.
translations.いいよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にケガがなくてよかった。:
It's fine. I'm glad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
didn't get hurt.
translations.気にしないで。……でもなんで、保健室じゃなくて教室？:
Don't worry about it. ...But
why the classroom instead of
the nurse's office？
translations.救急道具、持ってたし。それに……。:
I had a first-aid kit.
And besides...
translations.二人きりになれるでしょ？ さっきのあなた、かっこよかったよ？:
We can be alone, right？
You were cool earlier,
you know？
translations.今日、何の日かわかる？:
Do you know what day it is
today？
translations.やっぱりそうか。あのね、ハロウィンだよ。:
I thought so. You know,
it's Halloween.
translations.ああ、そういえば。気づかなかった。:
Ah, come to think of it.
I didn't realize.
translations.馴染みないもんね。……興味もない？:
It's not very familiar,
right. ...No interest either？
translations.何するのかよくわかんないけど、できたら面白いんじゃないかな。:
I don't really know what to
do, but it might be fun if
we could.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、おっけーかな。:
I see. Then, it's okay
I guess.
translations.（観たいテレビもないな。どうしよ……）:
(There's nothing on TV
I want to watch. What should
I do...)
translations.いたずら、される方だったりして？:
Maybe you're the one being
tricked？
translations.不意打ちだよ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……。:
That was a surprise attack,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.ふふ、やってみたかったんだ。ごめんね、驚かせて。:
Hehe, I wanted to try it.
Sorry for surprising you.
translations.たしかに驚いたけど……楽しかったよ。またやる予定ないの？:
I was certainly surprised
but... it was fun. Any plans
to do it again？
translations.ありません！ 私だって恥ずかしかったんだから。:
No! It was embarrassing for
me too.
translations.じゃあね、送ってくれてありがと。:
See you, thanks for walking
me home.
translations.（運営委員の仕事、がんばったもんな。成功するといいな……）:
(I worked hard on the
steering committee. I hope
it's a success...)
translations.私のクラス、お化け屋敷なの。私は受付。:
My class is a haunted house.
I'm at the reception.
translations.へー、いいな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はホラー好きだし、よかったね？:
Heh, nice. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ likes
horror, so that's good,
right？
translations.私は本当は脅かす役がよかったのに。色々口出しし過ぎて、厄介払いされちゃったの。あ:
I actually wanted to be the
one scaring people. I meddled
too much and got brushed off.
Ah geez, it's frustrating!
translations.ふう、もう着替えてくる。またあとでね。:
Phew, I'm going to change.
See you later.
translations.（文化祭、何事もなく終わってよかった。あとはパーティーだけだ）:
(I'm glad the school festival
ended without any issues.
Now it's just the party.)
translations.お疲れ様。運営委員の仕事、もういいの？:
Good work. Are you done with
your steering committee job？
translations.じゃあ……ひとつお願いしてもいい？:
Then... can I ask you
one favor？
translations.？ うん、●にできることなら。:
？ Yeah, if it's something
● can do.
translations.じゃあまずは、ここを抜けだす！:
Then first, let's sneak out
of here!
translations.静かだな……。なんで、こんなとこに？:
It's quiet... Why are we
here？
translations.言わせないの。二人きりになれるから、でしょ？:
Don't make me say it.
Because we can be alone,
right？
translations.……うん、そうだね。なんか、あのときみたいだ。:
...Yeah, that's right.
It's kind of like that time.
translations.そりゃ……。ここで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に言われたこと、忘れるわけないし。:
Well... I couldn't possibly
forget what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ told me
here.
translations.忘れたら、ただじゃ済まないよ？:
If you forget, you won't
get off easy, you know？
translations.忘れないよ。たぶん、一生。:
I won't forget. Probably
for the rest of my life.
translations.そっか……じゃあ、もっとムードのあるところ選べばよかった。でも余裕なかったしな。:
I see... then I should've
chosen a place with more
mood. But I didn't have the
leeway.
translations.そうだったんだ、わかんなかった。: Is that so, I didn't know.
translations.うん。それに……今だって、余裕ないよ？:
Yeah. And besides... even
now, I don't have any leeway,
you know？
translations.そうは見えないけど。:
It doesn't look like it
though.
translations.ないの。早くキスしたくて、うずうずしてる。:
I don't. I'm itching to
kiss you quickly.
translations.おはよう。今日から夏期講習だね、無理はしないで？:
Good morning. Summer classes
start today, don't push
yourself too hard？
translations.もう。ちょっとは……してもいいかな。:
Jeez. Maybe you can...
a little.
translations.おはよ！ 今日から夏期講習、ビシビシいくよ？:
Morning! Summer classes
start today, I'm going to
be strict, okay？
translations.ふふ、冗談。私が見てないとこでも、ちゃんとするんだよ？:
Hehe, just joking. Make sure
you do it properly even when
I'm not looking, okay？
translations.おはよ。夏期講習、今日からがんばろうね？:
Morning. Let's do our best
in summer classes starting
today, okay？
translations.もう、私に言ってもしょうがないでしょ。でも疲れたら、甘えさせてあげる。:
Jeez, there's no point
telling me that. But if you
get tired, I'll let you
lean on me.
translations.おはよう。どう、夏期講習は？:
Good morning. How are the
summer classes？
translations.ふふ、それはそうだよ。でもがんばって。応援するから。:
Hehe, that's true. But do
your best. I'll cheer for
you.
translations.おはよ！ 夏期講習、疲れてない？:
Morning! Aren't you tired
from summer classes？
translations.私へのサービスもあるんだから、へばってちゃダメだよ？:
You have to service me too,
so you can't be exhausted,
okay？
translations.うん、勉強どころじゃないよ。:
Yeah, I can't focus on
studying.
translations.もう、わがまま聞いてあげたいけど……ちょっとガマンして？:
Jeez, I want to indulge you
but... endure it a little？
translations.おはよう。冬期講習始まるけど、寒さには気をつけてね？:
Good morning. Winter classes
are starting, but be careful
of the cold, okay？
translations.気をつけても寒い……。:
Even if I'm careful,
it's cold...
translations.ぎゅってしてあげるから。それで許して？:
I'll hug you tight.
Forgive me with that？
translations.おはよ！ 冬期講習始まるけど、寒さに負けちゃダメだよ？:
Morning! Winter classes are
starting, but don't lose to
the cold, okay？
translations.ガマンしてるの。お姉さんだからね？ ふふ。:
I'm enduring it. Because I'm
the older sister, right？
Hehe.
translations.おはよ。冬期講習、始まるね。体調は大丈夫？:
Morning. Winter classes are
starting. Are you feeling
okay？
translations.辛くなったら、私が代わりに受けてあげる。な～んてね？:
If it gets tough, I'll take
them for you. Just kidding？
translations.おはよう。風邪、ひいてない？:
Good morning. Haven't caught
a cold？
translations.体調悪くなったら、すぐ言ってね。私の、大事な人なんだから。:
If you feel sick, tell me
right away. You're my
important person, after all.
translations.おはよ！ 寒さには慣れた？:
Morning! Got used to the
cold？
translations.少しは。でもやっぱ寒いよ。:
A little. But it's still
cold.
translations.あんまり情けないこと言ってると、おしおきしちゃうぞ？ ふふ、がんばれ！:
If you say too many pathetic
things, I'll punish you, you
know？ Hehe, do your best!
translations.おはよ。今日も寒いな。くっついてもいい？:
Morning. It's cold today
too. Can I stick close to
you？
translations.ふふ、素直でよろしい。じゃあ遠慮なく。:
Hehe, good that you're
honest. Then I won't hold
back.
translations.おはよう。春期講習始まるね。ぼーっとしてたら、あっという間だよ？:
Good morning. Spring classes
are starting. If you space
out, it'll be over in a
flash, you know？
translations.あっという間に終わってくれると、楽でいいなあ。:
It'd be nice and easy if it
ended in a flash.
translations.もう。ふふ、でも私もおんなじ。:
Jeez. Hehe, but I'm the
same.
translations.おはよ！ 今日から春期講習。居眠りするたびにおしおきだからね？:
Morning! Spring classes
start today. I'll punish you
every time you doze off,
okay？
translations.おはよ。春期講習始まるけど、集中してたらすぐ終わるよ？:
Morning. Spring classes are
starting, but if you focus
it'll end quickly, you know？
translations.集中……できるかな？:
I wonder if I can...
concentrate？
translations.あなたなら大丈夫。がんばって。:
You'll be fine. Do your
best.
translations.おはよう。春期講習、眠くない？:
Good morning. Spring classes,
aren't you sleepy？
translations.ふふ、私も。でもあとちょっと、一緒にがんばろう？:
Hehe, me too. But just a
little more, let's do our
best together？
translations.おはよ！ 春期講習、ちゃんと勉強してる？:
Morning! Spring classes,
are you studying properly？
translations.あ、元気いいんだ。じゃあ私の分もお願いしちゃおうかな？:
Ah, you're energetic. Then
maybe I'll ask you to do
mine too？
translations.おはよ。春はやっぱり眠いね。大丈夫？:
Morning. Spring is sleepy
after all. Are you okay？
translations.ふふ、大丈夫じゃないね。お願い、元気出して？:
Hehe, you're not okay.
Please, cheer up？
translations.そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。コンテストのこと聞いた？:
Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Did you hear about the
contest？
translations.もう……またそんなのばっかり。:
Jeez... it's always stuff
like that.
translations.なんか話題になってるみたいだからさ。一部で。:
It seems to be a hot topic.
In some parts.
translations.あなたは、その一部に含まれてるの？:
Are you included in those
parts？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が選ばれるかもしれないし、気にはなるかな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ might be chosen, so
I'm a bit curious.
translations.それって、喜んでいいのかな。:
Is that something I should
be happy about.
translations.……まあカレシとしては複雑な気分だけど。:
...Well, as your boyfriend
I have mixed feelings.
translations.勝手に決められたんじゃ、辞退のしようもないよね。:
If it was decided without
asking, there's no way to
decline.
translations.複雑だけど……やっぱうれしいよ。カノジョが魅力的だってことだし。:
It's complicated but... I'm
still happy. It means my
girlfriend is attractive.
translations.別にこんなのに選ばれなくても、魅力的なカノジョだけどさ。:
Even if you weren't chosen
for this, you're an
attractive girlfriend though.
translations.ふふ、もう。私にとっては、その言葉の方がうれしいよ。:
Hehe, jeez. To me, those
words make me happier.
translations.お疲れ様～。今日もがんばってるんだ？:
Good work~. Working hard
again today?
translations.ふふふ、調子いいよ。お姉さんの心配なんて、しなくていいんだから。:
Hehehe, I'm doing great.
No need to worry about
your big sister.
translations.うん、まあまあ。元気元気。:
Yeah, I'm alright.
Doing just fine.
translations.疲れてるといえば、疲れてるかな。心配するほどじゃないよ？:
I guess you could say
I'm a little tired.
Nothing to worry about,
though？
translations.うん、近くに来たから。どうかなって？:
Yeah, I was in the area.
Just wondering how
you were doing.
translations.私があなたに会いに来るのに、理由なんていらないんだもん。:
I don't need a reason
to come see you, you know.
translations.会いたい、から。ごめんね。:
Because... I wanted to
see you. Sorry.
translations.そういうこと聞かないの。会いたいからに決まってるでしょ。:
Don't ask things like that.
It's obviously because
I wanted to see you.
translations.会いたくなっちゃった♪いいよね？:
I just wanted to see you♪
That's okay, right？
translations.いつも無理させてるから。はい、差し入れ。:
You're always pushing
yourself. Here, a snack.
translations.差し入れ、持ってきたんだ。はい。:
I brought you a snack.
Here.
translations.よければ、これ使って。いつも頑張ってるごほうび。:
Use this, if you'd like.
A reward for always
working so hard.
translations.ごめんね。手、止めさせて。私戻るから。:
Sorry for interrupting
your work. I'll head
back now.
translations.じゃあ、戻るね。これでもっとがんばれるでしょ？ ふふふ。:
I'll head back now.
This should help you work
even harder, right？ Hehe.
translations.仕事、辛くない？ 無理そうだったら、手伝うからね。それじゃ。:
Is work tough？ If it's
too much, I'll help you.
See you later.
translations.ごめんね、邪魔して。もう行くから、がんばって。:
Sorry for bothering you.
I'll get going now,
so keep up the good work.
translations.じゃあ、もう行くね。私が見てなくても、頑張ること。:
I'll get going now.
Make sure you work hard,
even when I'm not around.
translations.私、もう行くね。また来るから、がんばって。:
I'm going to head out.
I'll come by again, so
keep up the good work.
translations.あれ？ 今日って何かあったんだっけ。:
Huh？ Was there something
special going on today？
translations.いいのかな、こんなにしてもらって。いつもごめんね。:
Is it really okay for me
to accept all this？
Sorry, and thank you.
translations.もう、気遣い過ぎだよ？ うれしいのは、もちろんだけど。:
Jeez, you worry about me
too much, you know？
I'm really happy, though.
translations.開けてもいいよね？ ふふ、何かな……。:
I can open it, right？
Hehe, I wonder what it is...
translations.私のこと、なんでも見透かされちゃってる気分。欲しかったんだ、これ。:
I feel like you can read
me like a book. I've
really been wanting this.
translations.あ、いいなこれ。ありがとう。:
Oh, this is nice.
Thank you.
translations.うん、気持ちはうれしいな。ありがとう。:
Yeah, the thought alone
makes me happy. Thank you.
translations.じゃあこっちは、私から。お返しだよ。:
Then this one is from me.
To return the favor.
translations.実はね、私もあるんだ。どうかな？:
Actually, I have something
for you too. How is it？
translations.ふふ。ちゃんと記念日祝えたね。うれしい。:
Hehe. We got to celebrate
our anniversary properly.
I'm so happy.
translations.あのね、最近私のこと、どう思ってるかなって。少し冷たい気がして……。:
Well, I was wondering what
you think of me lately.
You've felt a little cold...
translations.聞いておいたほうが、いいと思ったの。:
I just thought it would be
best to ask.
translations.これ以上、不安にさせないで……。:
Don't make me worry
any more than this...
translations.（うーん、本気で傷ついてる？ たしかに最近冷たくしてたかも……）:
(Hmm, is she really hurt？
I guess I have been a bit
cold lately...)
translations.本当にごめん、もうしない！:
I'm really sorry, I won't
do it again!
translations.そんな気にするなって！: Don't worry about it so much!
translations.……悪いのはそっちだろ？:
...Aren't you the one in the
wrong here？
translations.また、ガマンしないとダメなの？:
Do I just have to put up
with it again？
translations.ガマンとか、そんなんじゃ……。もうしないって。:
It's not about putting up
with it... I said I won't
do it again.
translations.……ごめん、少し考えさせて。:
...Sorry, let me think
for a bit.
translations.わかった。ガマンするから。:
All right. I'll put up
with it.
translations.ガマンって……。もうしないよ。:
Put up with it... I won't
do it again.
translations.（許してくれたんだよな？ なんか納得いってない気もするけど……）:
(She forgave me, right？
I feel like she's still not
totally convinced, though...)
translations.ねえ最近、私に冷たくない？:
Hey, haven't you been cold
to me lately？
translations.気のせいじゃないと思うんだけど。:
I don't think it's just
my imagination.
translations.ただ謝ってほしいわけじゃないよ。ちゃんと考えてほしいの。:
I don't just want an
apology. I want you to
really think about it.
translations.最近のこと、思い出してみて？:
Try thinking back on
how you've been lately？
translations.（これは本気だ……。たしかに最近冷たくしてたかも……）:
(She's serious... I guess
I have been a bit cold
lately...)
translations.たまには……本気のオシオキ、必要かもね。:
Maybe sometimes... you need
a real punishment.
translations.ええ!? ちゃんと反省するって！:
What!? I swear I'll
reflect on it!
translations.言葉だけじゃ、足りないこともあるの。じゃあね。:
Sometimes words just aren't
enough. See you.
translations.はあ……。今回はそれでいい。:
*Sigh*... I'll let it go
this time.
translations.「やった、助かった！」なんて思ってたら、承知しないからね。:
If you're thinking
'Yay, I'm saved!',
you're gonna get it.
translations.最近ね、私に冷たい気がするんだけど……。どう？:
I feel like you've been a bit
cold to me lately... What do
you think？
translations.どう、って……そうかな？:
What do I think...?
Have I really？
translations.聞いてるのは私だよ？ ちゃんと答えてほしいな。:
I'm the one asking you, you
know？ I want a real answer.
translations.何か心当たり、ない？: Do you have any idea why？
translations.（本気っぽいな……。たしかに最近冷たくしてたかも……）:
(She seems serious... I guess
I have been a bit cold lately...)
translations.そう言えば、許してくれると思った？:
Did you think saying that
would make me forgive you？
translations.……甘えん坊もここまで来ちゃうか。たまには厳しくしないと、ダメな子になっちゃうね:
...You really are a spoiled boy.
I guess I need to be strict
sometimes, or you'll go bad.
translations.またそれで許されちゃうんだ。調子にのってない？:
You think that'll get you off
the hook again. Aren't you
getting a little carried away？
translations.（あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……。まだ怒ってるかな？）:
(Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she
still mad at me？)
translations.ごめん。まだ整理できてないから。:
Sorry. I haven't sorted out
my feelings yet.
translations.（まだ怒ってるかもしれないし、いいか……）:
(She might still be mad,
so I'll pass...)
translations.イヤ。なんでかは、わかるでしょ？: No. You know why, don't you？
translations.えー？ まだ許してあげてないのに？:
Huh？ But I haven't forgiven
you yet.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。あのさ、デートに行こうよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, let's go on a
date.
translations.ダメ……。まだそんな気になれない。:
No... I'm not really in
the mood for that yet.
translations.デート。そんなお願い、できる立場かな？:
A date. Are you really in
a position to ask that？
translations.一応、出てあげる。なに？:
I'll answer, for now.
What is it？
translations.何かしようって心がけはよろしい。でもまだダメ。:
Points for trying to make
it up to me. But still no.
translations.（電話だ……。あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。もう、怒ってないのかな？）:
(A call... Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Is she not mad anymore？)
translations.デートの約束してたよね。覚えてる？:
We had a date planned,
right？ Remember？
translations.それ、やっぱりやめよう？ 私、こんな気持ちのままじゃ行けない。:
Let's call it off, okay？
I can't go feeling
like this.
translations.そういえば今度、デートの約束してたけど……。:
So, about that date we
had planned...
translations.前に約束してたデート。楽しみにしてる？:
That date we planned. Are
you looking forward to it？
translations.残念、中止だね。それじゃ。:
Too bad, it's canceled.
See you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。あのさ、今から会えない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey, can we meet
up right now？
translations.……会えないよ。会ってもどうしたらいいか、わかんない。:
...I can't. Even if we met,
I wouldn't know what to do.
translations.じゃあ、あと１０秒でここまで来れる？:
Well, can you get here
in 10 seconds？
translations.どんなときでも一生懸命なのは、いいことだけど……。:
It's good that you always
try your best, but...
translations.そうやってがんばってると、イヤなことも忘れちゃう？ ……なんてね。:
Does working hard like that
make you forget the bad stuff？
...Just kidding.
translations.私とのことも、それくらい真剣に考えててくれれば……。:
If only you thought about us
that seriously...
translations.困ってても、助けてあげないから。:
I'm not gonna help you,
even if you're in trouble.
translations.すごいね。……気にしてないのかな。:
Wow. ...I guess you really
don't care, huh.
translations.そんなことでがんばっても、許してあげない。:
Working hard at that
won't make me forgive you.
translations.よくできました。カノジョの扱いは、全然ダメだけど。:
Good job. Though your skills
as a boyfriend are terrible.
translations.そんな顔しても、慰めてあげない。:
Making that face won't make me
comfort you.
translations.あらあら、一人じゃ何もできない？:
Oh my, can't you do anything
by yourself？
translations.（あ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だ……。まだ怒ってるかな？）:
(Ah, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Is she still mad？)
translations.（今はほうっておこう）:
(I should leave her alone
for now.)
translations.……こんなときでもふざけるんだ。:
...You're still messing around
at a time like this.
translations.もう、のんびりしちゃって。: Jeez, you're taking it so easy.
translations.私のために、たくさんがんばってくれた。: You worked so hard for me.
translations.うん、もう▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと不安にさせたくないから。:
Yeah, I don't want to make
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ worry anymore.
translations.ごめんね、辛い思いさせて。私がいつまでも引きずってたから。:
I'm sorry for hurting you.
I just couldn't let it go.
translations.悪いのは、●だよ。最初から●がしっかりしてれば。:
● is the one at fault. If only
● had it together from the start.
translations.ううん、もういいの。私、あなたがいないとダメなんだもん……。:
No, it's fine now. I just...
I can't be without you...
translations.うん、●も。やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと好きだ。:
Yeah, ● too. I really do
love ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん。今はそれが聞ければいいよ。:
Yeah. That's all I need to hear
right now.
translations.がんばったね。私、結構ひどいこと言ったのに。:
You really tried your best.
Even though I said some
pretty awful things.
translations.悪いの、●だから。ごめん。:
It's ● who's to blame.
I'm sorry.
translations.そう、悪いのはあなた。……なのにな。:
Right, it's your fault...
And yet.
translations.喧嘩してる間のイジワル、ちょっとは楽しかったけど……。:
Being mean to you while we
were fighting was a little
fun, but...
translations.それじゃ満足できないんだもん。あなたと仲良くしてるほうがずっと楽しい。:
That's not enough for me.
It's much more fun when
we're getting along.
translations.うん、反省したよね。:
Yeah, you've thought about
what you did, right?
translations.うん……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと怒らせて当然だよ。ダメなカレシで、ごめん。:
Yeah... It's only natural
I made ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ mad. I'm a bad
boyfriend, sorry.
translations.ダメなカレシか……。そんなカレシのこと許しちゃうのは、ダメなカノジョなのかな……:
A bad boyfriend, huh...
I wonder if forgiving a
boyfriend like that makes
me a bad girlfriend...
translations.うん。やっぱり私、ダメみたい。もう別のこと考えてる。:
Yeah. I guess I really
am bad. I'm already thinking
about something else.
translations.寂しかった分、取り返したいの。:
I want to make up for
the time I was lonely.
translations.お見舞いに来たんだけど、大丈夫？:
I came to visit.
Are you okay?
translations.ごめん。急におしかけて。:
Sorry for dropping by
so suddenly.
translations.ううん、うれしい。ちょうど、会いたかったから。:
No, I'm happy. I really
wanted to see you.
translations.でも来るってわかってたら、ちゃんと準備したのに。:
But if I knew you were
coming, I would have
prepared properly.
translations.病人がそんなことしないでよ。むしろ●がなんか手伝うって。:
Don't push yourself when
you're sick. ● will help
you instead.
translations.いいよ、そんなの。来てくれただけで、充分。:
It's fine. Just having you
here is enough.
translations.あんまり長くいると、悪いよね。そろそろ帰るよ。:
I shouldn't stay too long.
I'll get going soon.
translations.うん、ごめんね。おかまいできなくて。:
Yeah, sorry. I couldn't
even host you properly.
translations.だからいいって。じゃあ。:
I told you it's fine.
See ya.
translations.●。具合どう？ お見舞いに来たんだけど。:
●. How are you feeling?
I came to visit.
translations.うん、もうだいぶ。あ、残念？ 看病したかったとか？:
Yeah, mostly. Ah,
disappointed? Did you want
to take care of me?
translations.そんな、元気なのがいいに決まってるって。看病が必要なら、もちろん喜んでするけど。:
No way, it's obviously
better that you're well.
Though if you needed me to,
I'd gladly take care of you.
translations.そっか……もっと具合悪そうにしてればよかった。失敗したな。:
I see... I should have
acted sicker. My mistake.
translations.あ、ごめん長居して。もう帰るよ。:
Ah, sorry for staying long.
I'll go home now.
translations.冗談。風邪、うつしちゃうもん。気をつけてね？:
Just kidding. I'd give
you my cold. Be careful,
okay?
translations.ありがとう。待ってて、今あけるね。:
Thanks. Hold on,
I'll open the door.
translations.うん、そんなに辛くないよ。そろそろ寝るのも飽きたなって思ってた。:
Yeah, it's not too bad.
I was just starting to get
tired of sleeping.
translations.じゃあ、いいタイミングだった？: So I came at a good time？
translations.うん、完璧。話相手、お願いね？:
Yeah, perfect. You'll keep
me company, right？
translations.無理はしない程度に。:
As long as you don't push
yourself.
translations.ごめん、結構長く話してた。無理してない？:
Sorry, we've been talking
a while. Are you okay？
translations.してないよ。むしろ気分はよくなったみたい。:
Not at all. If anything,
I think I feel better.
translations.そっか。でもそろそろ帰るよ、体は疲れてるだろうし。:
I see. But I should get
going soon, you must
be tired.
translations.うん、ありがとう。帰ったらちゃんとうがいと手洗い、してね？:
Yeah, thanks. Make sure to
wash your hands and gargle
when you get home, okay？
translations.ねえ。お見舞いうれしいけど、私のことばっかりでいいの？:
Hey. I'm happy you came
to visit, but is it okay
to just focus on me？
translations.いいよ、一番大事なことだから。:
It's fine, you're the most
important thing to me.
translations.かっこつけすぎ？:
Was I trying too hard to
act cool？
translations.退屈だな……。外出たい。:
I'm bored... I want to
go outside.
translations.なんか余裕。立場逆転したみたいで、ちょっと悔しい。:
You're so calm. It's like
our roles are reversed, and
it's a little frustrating.
translations.はは、じゃあ今のうちに味わっておくよ。:
Haha, then I'll enjoy it
while it lasts.
translations.私のお見舞いもいいけど。ちゃんと勉強してる？ バイトは大丈夫？:
It's nice you're visiting
me, but are you studying？
Is your part-time job okay？
translations.そんなこと気にしなくていいよ。今は自分の体のことでしょ。:
You don't need to worry
about that. Right now you
should focus on yourself.
translations.でも、気になっちゃうんだもん。: But I can't help but worry.
translations.ちゃんとやってるよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は心配しなくてもいいって。:
I'm doing fine. You don't
need to worry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん……なんかそれも寂しいな。早く治そっと。:
Yeah... but that's kind of
lonely too. I should get
better soon.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。もう治ったのか？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Are you already
feeling better？
translations.心配かけてごめんね、もう大丈夫。:
Sorry to make you worry,
I'm fine now.
translations.お見舞いもありがとう。でもやっぱり寂しかったから……。:
Thanks for visiting me,
too. But I was still
lonely, so...
translations.ああ。病気の間の分も、一緒にいよう。:
Yeah. Let's spend time
together to make up for
when you were sick.
translations.もちろん。おかげさまでね？ お見舞いありがと。:
Of course. Thanks to you,
right？ Thanks for visiting.
translations.弱ってたとこ見せちゃったからな……。今度は仕返し。:
I let you see me all weak
and helpless... Now it's
time for payback.
translations.心配してくれて、ありがとう。もう大丈夫だよ？:
Thanks for worrying about me.
I'm completely fine now.
translations.今度は私が心配してあげる番かな。看病したいし。:
I guess it's my turn to worry
about you now. I want to
take care of you, after all.
translations.……●、風邪ひかないとダメ？:
...●, do you have to
catch a cold for that to
happen？
translations.ふふ、うそ。ひいちゃダメ。元気なのが一番でしょ。:
Hehe, just kidding. Don't
catch one. Being healthy
is the most important thing.
translations.（退屈だ……。もう家にいるのも飽きた）:
(I'm so bored... I'm tired
of just sitting around at home.)
translations.うん、お見舞い。迷惑じゃなければ。:
Yep, I came to check on you.
If I'm not bothering you,
that is.
translations.ありがとう、わざわざ。:
Thank you for going out
of your way.
translations.心配でがまんできなくて、ごめんね。:
I just couldn't stop worrying.
Sorry about that.
translations.ううん。退屈してからさ、ちょうどよかった。:
No, it's fine. I was getting
bored, so your timing is
perfect.
translations.あ、つい長話しちゃった。治りかけでも、体に悪いよね。:
Ah, I ended up talking too long.
Even if you're recovering,
it's bad for you to overdo it.
translations.そんなことないと思うけど……。: I don't think that's true, but...
translations.気付いてなくても、体はきっと疲れてるよ。もう帰るから、ゆっくり休んで。:
Even if you don't realize it,
your body is definitely tired.
I'll head home now, so get
some rest.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のためにも、早く治さなくっちゃな）:
(I need to get better fast,
for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s sake.)
translations.お見舞いだよ。具合どう？:
I came to check on you.
How are you feeling？
translations.来てくれたんだ、ありがと。: You came to see me. Thank you.
translations.うん。てっきりもっと弱ってると思ったのにな。:
Yeah. I totally thought you'd
be a lot weaker, though.
translations.身構えないの。看病してあげるつもりだったんだから。:
Don't be so on guard. I was
planning to nurse you back
to health.
translations.結構話しちゃった。具合悪くならないうちに帰るね。:
We ended up talking a lot.
I'll head home before you
feel worse.
translations.ほんとに感謝してるんだったら、ちゃんと休んで早く治すこと。:
If you're really thankful,
make sure to rest up and
get better.
translations.もちろん、お見舞い。ふふ、待ってた？:
Of course, I came to see you.
Hehe, were you waiting
for me？
translations.うん、思ったより元気そう。部屋もちゃんとしてて、ちょっと残念。:
Yeah, you look better than
I expected. Your room's tidy
too, which is a shame.
translations.色々、世話焼きたかったんだけどな。:
I was hoping to dote on you
a whole bunch.
translations.あ、そろそろ帰るね。具合悪くさせちゃったら、お見舞いの意味ないもん。:
Ah, I should get going.
There's no point to my visit
if I make you feel worse.
translations.だーめ。お姉さんの言うこと聞いて、ちゃんと休みなさい？:
No way. Listen to your big
sister and get some proper
rest, okay？
translations.うん、いい子いい子。じゃあね。:
Yep, good boy.
See you later.
translations.具合どう？ 眠い？ 私、いない方がいいかな。:
How are you feeling? Sleepy?
Should I leave you alone?
translations.じゃあ、何かしてほしいことある？:
Okay, is there anything
you want me to do?
translations.何もしなくていいから、いてよ。:
You don't have to do
anything. Just stay.
translations.ねえ、まだよくならない？:
Hey, are you feeling
any better yet?
translations.だいぶいいけど。まだ完治じゃないかな。:
A lot better, but I'm not
completely cured yet.
translations.じゃあ、色々試してみよっか。あやしい民間療法とか。:
Then let's try a few things.
Like sketchy folk remedies.
translations.……だって、あなたが病気だと寂しいんだもん。:
...Because I get lonely
when you're sick.
translations.あなたって、意外に手がかからないんだね？:
You're surprisingly low-
maintenance, aren't you?
translations.もっと色んなことお世話できると思ったのに。:
And here I thought I'd get
to take care of you more.
translations.今想像してるのとは、たぶん違うこと。:
Probably not what you're
imagining right now.
translations.お待たせ。おかげでもう元気。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
I'm all better now.
translations.よかった……。ほんとに大丈夫？:
Thank goodness...
Are you really okay?
translations.ああ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のお見舞いのおかげ。:
Yeah, thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
coming to visit me.
translations.ふふ、だったらうれしい。: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
translations.うん、復活。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげで。:
Yep, fully recovered.
Thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そっか……。弱ってるとこも、もう少し見てたかったかな。:
I see... I kind of wanted to
see you weak a bit longer.
translations.ちょっとだけ。でも元気なあなたの方が好きだよ？:
Just a bit. But I like you
better when you're healthy.
translations.心配かけてごめん。元気になったよ。:
Sorry for worrying you.
I'm all better now.
translations.そりゃもう。おかげで、早く▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と出かけたくなってる。:
Of course. Now I just want to
hurry and go out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.よろしい。ちゃんと効果出てるね？:
Good. Looks like it worked
perfectly, didn't it?
translations.このゲームは、ＤＳ本体の時計に連動して進むんだよ。だから、時計をちゃんと合わせて:
This game runs in sync
with your DS system clock.
So, you have to make sure
it's set right before
you start playing.
translations.もし時間がずれてたら一度電源をＯＦＦにして、ＤＳ本体の時計を合わせてきてね？:
If the time is off,
turn the power off and
fix your DS system clock,
okay？
translations.そっか。じゃあ、ゲームの時間をあなたの生活に合わせて決定して。嘘ついちゃヤだよ？:
Got it. Then, set the
game time to match
your daily schedule.
No lying, okay？
translations.本当に、これで大丈夫？:
Are you sure this
is right？
translations.うん、これで終わりだよ。お疲れさま。:
Yep, that's all of it.
Good job.
translations.デートの約束をずらしたいんだけど……。:
I was hoping we could 
reschedule our date...
translations.どうしよっかな？ ……なんてね、大丈夫だよ。:
Hmm, what should I do? 
...Just kidding, that works.
translations.そっか、ありがとう。じゃあ、そういうことで。:
Alright, thanks. 
It's a plan, then.
translations.う～ん、ダメっぽいな。: Hmm, I don't think I can.
translations.そう、いいよ。声が聞けてうれしかった。じゃあね？:
That's okay. 
I was just happy to hear 
your voice. Bye.
translations.もう、なあにそれ？ 何かあったら、ちゃんと言ってね。じゃあ。:
Jeez, what was that about? 
If something's wrong, 
you have to tell me. Bye.
translations.……実は声が聞きたくて電話しただけ。なんつって。:
...I actually just called 
to hear your voice. Kidding.
translations.もう、冗談でしょ。でもいいよ。じゃあ、またね。:
Jeez, you're joking, right? 
But it's fine. 
See you later.
translations.（これでよし。忘れないようにしないと）:
(Alright, that's settled. 
I'd better not forget.)
translations.（これでよし。何度も変更するのは悪いし、今回はこれで最後にしよう）:
(Alright, that's settled. 
I feel bad changing it so 
much. This is the last time.)
translations.旅行の日程をずらしたいんだけど……。:
I was hoping we could 
reschedule our trip...
translations.うん、大丈夫。なんとかなるよ。:
Yeah, it's fine. 
I can make that work.
translations.そっか、よかった。ごめんな、それじゃあ。:
Oh, good. Sorry about that. 
See you later.
translations.ごめん、その日はダメ……。: Sorry, I can't do that day...
translations.ねぇ今日の夜、テレビで『地獄の盆踊り』が放送されるんだけど。:
Hey, 'Hell's Bon Dance' is
airing on TV tonight.
translations.盆踊り。カルトホラーの傑作って言われてるの。一緒に見ない？:
Bon Dance. They say it's a
cult horror masterpiece.
Wanna watch it together？
translations.夜、一緒に？ テレビで映画を？ その……いいけど……。:
Tonight, together？ A movie
on TV？ I mean... sure...
translations.それぞれの。オープニングが始まったらメールするね。:
Our own rooms. I'll text
you when the opening starts.
translations.そう。シーンの感想やお互いの悲鳴なんかをメールで送りながら見るの。きっと楽しいか:
Yep. We'll text our thoughts
and screams to each other
while we watch. It'll be fun.
translations.それって、要するに……実況中継？:
So basically... we're doing
live commentary？
translations.ああ、『地獄の盆踊り』、今晩が楽しみ～。:
Ah, 'Hell's Bon Dance'...
I can't wait for tonight~
translations.そうそう、この前の『地獄の盆踊り』怖かったねー。:
Oh yeah, 'Hell's Bon Dance'
was so scary the other day.
translations.なんだかお笑い映画だったような。:
Felt more like a comedy
movie to me.
translations.怖かったくせに。『ゾンビでたー』とか『いきなり血まみれー』とかメール送って来たで:
You were scared! You texted
me stuff like 'A zombie!'
and 'So much blood!'
translations.まあ、同じ映画を見ながらメールを送り合うって、けっこう楽しかった。:
Well, texting each other
while watching the same
movie was pretty fun.
translations.それでね、今日の深夜は、『ドラキュラ侍・蝙蝠剣』やるの、また一緒に見ない？:
So, 'Dracula Samurai: Bat
Sword' is on late tonight.
Wanna watch it together again？
translations.タイトルからにして、とんでもないＢ級のようなそんな気が……。:
Just from the title, I get
the feeling it's a terrible
B-movie...
translations.Ｃ級かＤ級、うーん、Ｚ級かな。:
More like C or D... Hmm,
maybe a Z-movie.
translations.聞きたかったんだけど、前に一緒に見た『ドラキュラ侍』のあの剣、なんで塩に弱いんだ:
I've been meaning to ask,
why was that sword in
'Dracula Samurai' weak
to salt？
translations.その理由は、前作の『血を吸うナメクジ』を見てないとわからないかも。:
You probably wouldn't get it
unless you saw the prequel,
'The Bloodsucking Slug'.
translations.前作があったのか……。ドラキュラとナメクジって統一性がないって言うか共通項もない:
There's a prequel...?
Draculas and slugs don't
exactly have much in common.
translations.ナメクジは吸わないんじゃ。: I don't think slugs do that.
translations.『血を吸うナメクジ』だから吸うの。どっちも血が大好きっていう共通項。:
It's a 'Bloodsucking Slug',
so it does. They both love
blood. That's what they
share.
translations.ふふ、納得する必要あるかな？:
Hehe, do you really need
to be convinced？
translations.（たしかにそれが正しい姿勢かも……）:
(That's probably the right
attitude to have...)
translations.『血を吸うナメクジ』のＤＶＤ、買ったんだけど見る？ 貸してあげる。:
I bought the DVD for 'The
Bloodsucking Slug'. Wanna
watch it？ I'll lend it
to you.
translations.買ったの？ と言うか、そんなのＤＶＤで出てたんだ。:
You bought it？ Or rather,
that actually got a DVD
release？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、バイト代、そういうＤＶＤに使ってるとか？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do you spend your
paychecks on DVDs like that？
translations.そんなことないよ。ＤＶＤはいつもはレンタルだから。:
Of course not. I usually
just rent them.
translations.あなたが見てないって言うし。それならって……私もまた見たかったし。:
Well, you said you hadn't
seen it. So I figured...
And I wanted to watch it
again.
translations.ＤＶＤでもメールしながら見たほうがいい？:
Should we text each other
while watching the DVD, too？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が「そうして」ってお願いしてくれたら。:
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ asks me
to, that is.
translations.そういう甘えかた、子供みたい。:
Acting all spoiled...
You're like a little kid.
translations.携帯電話って色んな機能がありすぎて全部使い切れてないって思うんだけど……。:
Cell phones have so many
features these days, I don't
think I use them all...
translations.テレビが見られるっていっても学校やバイト先じゃ使えないし。:
Like, you can watch TV,
but I can't exactly do that
at school or work.
translations.機能が取り替えられたらいいのにね。これが要らない代わりにこういうのを付けてって。:
I wish we could swap out
features. Like, 'I don't
need this, give me this.'
translations.あなただってサバ缶を開ける時に、カンキリどこだって探したことあるでしょ？:
Haven't you ever wanted to
open a can of mackerel and
couldn't find the opener？
translations.ほーらカンキリが携帯電話に付いてたら便利だって思い始めてる。:
See？ Now you're starting
to think a phone with a
can opener would be handy.
translations.便利かもしれないけど……本当に便利かなあ？:
It might be handy, but...
would it really be？
translations.そうそう携帯電話にあったらいい追加機能、またひとつ思いついたの。:
Oh, I just thought of
another add-on feature
I'd want for my phone.
translations.今度のは絶対に必要なもの、どうして今までなかったのってみんなが思うくらい。:
This one is an absolute
must-have. People will
wonder how they ever lived
without it.
translations.……ハンコ？ 携帯電話のどこにつけるの？:
...A hanko？ Where would
you even put that on a
phone？
translations.宅配便が来た時に、あれ、印鑑どこかなってちょっと慌てたこと、ない？:
Haven't you ever panicked
when a delivery arrives
and you can't find your
stamp？
translations.ほーら印鑑が付いてたら携帯電話はもっと便利だって思い始めてる。:
See？ Now you're starting
to think a phone with a
hanko would be handy.
translations.だから、ハンコ、携帯のどこに付くの？:
But where would the hanko
even go on the phone？
translations.それはメーカー次第だけど、使わない時は収納されてるのがいいよね。:
That's up to the maker,
but it'd be nice if it
tucked away when not in
use.
translations.（そりゃそうだろうけど、そういう問題じゃ……）:
(I mean, sure, but that's
not really the issue...)
translations.印鑑付きの携帯電話、もし発売されたら大ヒット商品になると思わない？:
Don't you think a phone
with a built-in hanko
would be a massive hit？
translations.だったらどんな機能があったらいいと思う？:
Then what kind of feature
do you think would be
good？
translations.携帯電話の形からすると電動髭剃りかな、サラリーマンにも重宝されてヒットするんじゃ:
Given the shape of a phone,
maybe an electric razor？
Salarymen would love it,
so it'd probably be a hit.
translations.そんな機能女の人は使わないよ。:
Women wouldn't use a
feature like that.
translations.靴ベラが付いてたらけっこう便利かも。:
A shoehorn might be
pretty handy.
translations.いつも足に使うものを顔に当てるのはちょっと抵抗あるかな。:
I'd be a little hesitant
to put something I use on
my feet against my face.
translations.それも女の人はあまり関係ない機能かな。:
That's another feature
women wouldn't really care
about, I think.
translations.やっぱり印鑑じゃない？: See, it has to be a hanko.
translations.そうそう、昔の携帯電話って肩から下げてたんだって。:
Oh yeah, I heard people
used to carry cell phones
slung over their shoulders.
translations.肩からってどういうこと？:
Over their shoulders？
What do you mean？
translations.ショルダーバッグみたいに。重さも３キロくらいあったみたい。:
Like a shoulder bag.
Apparently they weighed
around three kilos, too.
translations.３キロって、鉄アレイでも入ってたのかな。:
Three kilos？ Did they have
dumbbells in them or
something？
translations.本当にバッグの機能があったんじゃないかな。中身もセットになって売ってたんだって。:
Maybe they really did work
like bags. I heard they
were sold with things
inside.
translations.それこそ、カンキリも印鑑も、電動髭剃りも、靴ベラもプラスドライバーも入れておける:
Then you could fit a can
opener, a stamp, an electric
shaver, a shoehorn, and a
Phillips screwdriver in it.
translations.そうか！ きっと時計もラジオもカメラもそこに入っていたんだな。それが少しずつ減っ:
Oh! And a clock, a radio,
and a camera must've been
in there too. Then they
slowly got smaller...
translations.今の小さなサイズになった。ふふ。:
Until they became the size
they are today. Hehe.
translations.いつも一緒だよね。バイト先でも、ほとんど同じシフトにしてるし。:
We're always together.
We even work most of the
same shifts at our job.
translations.ふふっ、残念だけどね。それでこうやって学校の行き帰りも一緒で。:
Hehe, sadly. But we still
commute to and from school
together like this.
translations.私たちってイチャイチャしているように見えるかな？:
Do you think we look like
we're all over each other？
translations.気にするほどじゃないと思うけど……。誰かに何か言われた？:
I don't think it's anything
to worry about... Did
someone say something？
translations.……もうちょっと、離れて歩かない？ イチャイチャしてるように見えちゃうかも。:
...Should we walk a bit
further apart？ We might
look too lovey-dovey.
translations.前もそんなこと言ってたな、何かあった？:
You said something like
that before. Did something
happen？
translations.ああ、仮面の殺人鬼が出てくる。:
Ah, the one with the
masked killer.
translations.Ｊ惨が湖に遊びに来た若者たちを次々に……。:
J-Son goes after the teens
visiting the lake, one by
one...
translations.大丈夫だよ、ここ湖じゃないし。:
It's fine, we're not at a
lake.
translations.Ｊ惨はニューヨークにも行くし、宇宙にも行っちゃうし、それに……。:
But J-Son goes to New York,
and even to space! And...
translations.いつも真っ先に狙われるのはイチャイチャしてるカップルなんだよ。:
The ones who get targeted
first are always the
lovey-dovey couples!
translations.だから、してたら危ないかなって。:
So I thought it might be
dangerous if we are.
translations.ああもう、危ないから離れなさいっ。:
Geez, it's dangerous, so
stay away!
translations.前に言ってたＪ惨シリーズなら、何作か●もテレビで見たけど。:
If it's that J-Son series
you mentioned, ● saw a
few of them on TV.
translations.真っ先に狙われるのはイチャイチャしてるカップルだったでしょ？:
The ones targeted first
were the lovey-dovey
couples, right？
translations.イチャイチャ、って言うか典型的なバカップルだよな犠牲者たちは。:
Lovey-dovey... Or rather,
the victims are usually
your typical dumb couples.
translations.まず、ふたりでよく笑うな。:
Well, first, they laugh
together a lot.
translations.どこに行くにも一緒にいたり。:
And they're always together
wherever they go.
translations.キャンプで、ひとつのテントに一緒に泊まったり。:
And they stay in the same
tent when they go camping.
translations.そんなところで別々なんて怖くてイヤだな。あなたが一緒じゃないと。:
I'd be too scared to sleep
separately in a place like
that. I need you with me.
translations.いいんじゃない、楽しいし。:
Isn't that fine？ It's fun,
at least.
translations.もしＪ惨が出たら……心配なのは、あなたなんだよね。:
If J-Son does show up...
You're the one I'm worried
about.
translations.生き残るのはいつも女の子で、男の子はみんな全滅なんだから。:
Because the girls
always survive, and the
boys get wiped out.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が無事ならいいじゃん。:
As long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
safe, it's fine.
translations.よくない！ あなたも助からなきゃ。:
No it's not！ You have
to survive too.
translations.●も死にたくないけど……あのさ、そろそろＪ惨以外の映画見たらどうかな。:
I don't want ● to
die either, but... hey,
maybe it's time we watch
something else.
translations.うん、昨日観た１４作目でもうシリーズも終わりだし。:
Yeah, the 14th one we
watched yesterday was
the end of the series
anyway.
translations.そんなにあったんだ。そりゃ全部見てたら影響受けるよな……。:
There were that many？
Yeah, watching all of
them would definitely
mess with your head...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ずっと元気でいてね。:
▲主人公＊▲. Promise me you'll
always stay safe.
translations.絶対、死んだらイヤだよ。:
I absolutely don't want
you to die.
translations.もちろん、死なないよ、ずっと！:
Of course, I won't die,
ever！
translations.……今の、なんだかバカップルっぽかったね。:
...That just now felt
kind of like a silly
couple thing to say, huh.
translations.あとはコンビニとかで？:
And the rest is from
convenience stores？
translations.コンビニが多いかな……たまにスーパーも行くけど。:
Mostly convenience
stores, I guess... I go
to the supermarket
sometimes, though.
translations.商店街では買い物しないの？:
You don't shop at the
shopping district？
translations.商店街で買い物するってなんか奥さんみたいでさ、照れ臭いって言うか……。:
Shopping there makes me
feel like a housewife.
It's kind of
embarrassing...
translations.商店街、いいお店いっぱいあるよ？ 野菜も果物もお魚も。:
There are lots of great
stores there, you know？
Vegetables, fruits, and
fish.
translations.果物はともかく、野菜も魚も、料理するの大変だし。:
Fruits aside, veggies
and fish are a pain to
cook.
translations.煮たり焼いたり炒めたり。簡単だよ？:
Boiling, grilling,
stir-frying. It's easy,
you know？
translations.簡単じゃないよ。……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がやってくれるならともかく。:
It's not easy... Unless
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ does it for me.
translations.ちゃんと栄養のバランス考えて食べてる？:
Are you making sure to
eat a balanced diet？
translations.大丈夫だって。コンビニだけじゃないし、ほら、デキシーズでも遅番だと食事出るしさ。:
I'm fine. It's not just
convenience stores.
Dexee's gives me meals
on the late shift, too.
translations.そうだけど心配、バランス偏ってそう。:
I know, but I'm worried
your diet is unbalanced.
translations.学校なら購買部でパン買うし。コーヒー牛乳も買う。:
At school, I buy bread
at the store. I get
coffee milk, too.
translations.サバ缶とか……。ちゃんと弁当も買うし、バランス考えて。:
Canned mackerel... I buy
bentos too, keeping
balance in mind.
translations.コンビニのお弁当でどう考えて？:
How do you balance a
convenience store bento？
translations.昨日は唐揚げ弁当だったから今日はトンカツ弁当、とか、そういうふうに差をつけて。:
Like, yesterday was a
fried chicken bento, so
today is tonkatsu. I mix
it up like that.
translations.唐揚げとトンカツで差があるの？:
Is there really a
difference between fried
chicken and tonkatsu？
translations.あるよ、ぜんぜん違う、鳥類と哺乳類だし。鶏と豚は鳴き声も違うし。:
Yeah, they're totally
different. One's a bird,
one's a mammal. Chickens
and pigs sound different.
translations.もう、笑い事じゃないのに。:
Jeez, it's not a
laughing matter.
translations.ご飯を炊くときにさ、「手首のところまで」ってあるじゃん。:
When cooking rice,
there's that 'up to your
wrist' rule, right？
translations.研いだお米に入れる水の量ね。:
The amount of water you
add to the washed rice.
translations.そうそう。あれ、そんなアバウトな説明じゃダメだよな。:
Yeah. That kind of vague
explanation is no good,
right？
translations.……ダメって、昔からそう言われて。:
...No good？ That's what
people have always said.
translations.今はもう昔じゃないんだから昔のこと信じてるだけじゃダメだって思うんだ。:
It's not the old days
anymore, so just blindly
believing old sayings is
no good.
translations.ご飯を炊くときの、あの「手首のところまで」の伝説だけどさ。:
You know that legend about
measuring the water for rice
up to your wrist？
translations.神話でもいいんだけど、ヘンだよ。なんでみんな信用しているのかな？ 大嘘なのに。:
Or myth, whatever. It's weird.
Why does everyone believe it？
It's a total lie.
translations.嘘じゃないと思うけど……。: I don't think it's a lie...
translations.プロレスラーの手と●の手、倍くらい違うよ。「手首まで」なんて基準としていいかげん:
A pro wrestler's hand is twice
the size of yours, ●!
'Up to the wrist' is so sloppy!
translations.あなたが使ってるの最近の炊飯器よね。:
You use a pretty modern
rice cooker, right？
translations.引っ越したときに買った最新型。電子なんとかってやつ。:
I bought the newest model
when I moved. An electronic
something-or-other.
translations.そういうの、わざわざ手首を入れて水の量を計る必要なくて目盛りまで入れればＯＫで。:
You don't need to stick your
hand in those. Just fill it
to the line and you're set.
translations.次は成功するから。: You'll get it right next time.
translations.童話の世界に。でもね、ガラスの靴ってどう考えても履けないと思うの……。:
In fairy tales. But honestly,
there's no way anyone could
actually wear them...
translations.靴がガラスだって考えて。……ほら、割れた。割れちゃった。:
Imagine shoes made of glass.
...See, they broke.
They'd shatter.
translations.強化ガラスだったんだよ。自動車の窓や高層ビルの窓に使うような。:
They were tempered glass.
Like what they use for car
windows or skyscrapers.
translations.大昔だからそんな技術はありません。:
It was a long time ago.
They didn't have that tech.
translations.ガラスの靴の破片で足の裏は血まみれに……ああ、怖いっ。:
The glass shards would leave
your feet completely bloody...
Ah, how scary.
translations.本当のことを考えると怖いなってこと。:
I'm just saying, it's scary
when you think about reality.
translations.前にガラスの靴の話したけど……。:
We talked about glass slippers
before, right...？
translations.靴が割れて足が血まみれ……。:
The shoes breaking and leaving
your feet bloody...
translations.それはもういいって。あれさ、履く人間が軽かったんじゃない？:
Enough of that already. Maybe
the person wearing them was
just really light？
translations.うん、ガラスの靴を履いても大丈夫なくらい、スリムで軽量で。:
Yeah, slim and light enough
that wearing glass slippers
would be perfectly fine.
translations.じゃあ私が履いたら、やっぱり血まみれ？:
So if I wore them, would I
end up bloody after all？
translations.思ってないって。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も履けるよ。大丈夫！:
I did not! You could wear
them too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You'd be fine!
translations.嘘ばっかり。そんな人間いるわけないもん。:
Liar. There's no way a person
like that exists.
translations.（そりゃ元が冗談だしなあ……）:
(Well, it was a joke to
begin with...)
translations.ふふ、映画の中に。もし透明になれたら、何をしたい？:
Hehe, in movies. If you could
turn invisible, what would
you want to do？
translations.なにか変なこと考えてる？:
Are you thinking about
something weird？
translations.はあ、まずは透明になる方法より、嘘発見器が必要かな。:
*Sigh*... I think I need a lie
detector more than a way
to turn invisible.
translations.信用ないな。:
You really don't trust
me, huh.
translations.じゃあ嘘発見器発動。……嘘ついたら、もうキスしてあげない。:
Lie detector activated...
If you lie, no more kisses
for you.
translations.そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は透明になれたら何かしたいことある？:
Come to think of it, is there
anything ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would want
to do if invisible?
translations.透明人間の話？ ……私は泳ぎの練習かな。:
The invisible man stuff?
...I'd probably practice
swimming.
translations.だってこの年になって泳ぎの練習なんて、恥ずかしいよ。:
Because practicing swimming
at my age is embarrassing.
translations.プールで水飛沫だけ上がってたら怪しいよな、よけい目立つような。:
It'd be pretty suspicious to
just see splashes in a pool.
You'd stand out even more.
translations.じゃあ、誰もいないプールで。:
Then I'd do it in an
empty pool.
translations.……それなら透明じゃなくてもいいんじゃ。:
...You wouldn't need to be
invisible for that, then.
translations.途中で誰か来たら困るし。:
It'd be bad if someone showed
up in the middle of it.
translations.じゃあ●が付いてる。:
Then ● will be right
there with you.
translations.透明人間相手に？ どこにいるか、ちゃんとわかるかな。:
With an invisible person?
Are you sure you'd know
where I am？
translations.わかるよ。●が、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと見失うわけないし。:
I'd know. There's no way
● would ever lose
sight of ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふっ、調子いいこと言って。:
Hehe, you're such a smooth
talker.
translations.流れ星に願いを唱えるとそれがかなうって言うよね？:
They say if you make a wish
on a shooting star, it comes
true, right？
translations.三回唱えないと～、ってやつね。:
The one where you have to
say it three times, right.
translations.流れ星って一瞬だからな。:
Shooting stars are only there
for a second, after all.
translations.小さい頃、早口言葉練習したんだけど。:
I practiced tongue twisters
when I was little for it.
translations.オモチャが欲しかったんだけど商品名が長すぎてダメ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
I wanted a toy, but the product
name was too long, so no.
What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.キッズビーズのスーパープリティセット。一回言うだけで精一杯。:
The Kids' Beads Super Pretty
Set. Just saying it once was
hard enough.
translations.そう言えば、流れ星への願い事、練習してる？:
Come to think of it, have you
been practicing your wish for
a shooting star？
translations.練習しようって言い出したの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だろ？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was the one who
suggested we practice, right？
translations.考えてみたら……お願いするほど欲しい物なんて、なくて。:
Thinking about it... there's
nothing I want badly enough
to wish for.
translations.そうなの？ ほら、服とかＤＶＤとか。:
Really？ What about clothes
or DVDs or something.
translations.流れ星にお願いするなら、お店なんかじゃ買えない宝物じゃないと……。:
If I'm wishing on a star, it
has to be a treasure you can't
just buy in a store...
translations.うん、それにね。その宝物はもう持ってるから、いいの。:
Yeah. Plus, I already have
that treasure, so I'm good.
translations.それって、どんな？: What kind of treasure is it？
translations.たまに思い出すと……ドキドキしちゃう。:
Sometimes when I remember
it... my heart starts pounding.
translations.あなたに……告白したときのこと。:
When I... confessed my
feelings to you.
translations.●は、ただ嬉しかったけど。:
● was just happy
about it, though.
translations.もう、こっちは清水の舞台から飛び降りる気分だったのに。:
Jeez, and here I felt like I was
jumping off the stage at
Kiyomizu.
translations.清水の舞台ってさ、実際見てみると、そんなに高くないよな。:
You know, the stage at
Kiyomizu isn't actually all
that high in person.
translations.じゃあ私のドキドキも、大したことなかった？:
So my pounding heart wasn't
that big of a deal, then？
translations.違う違う！ そういうことじゃなくて。:
No, no! That's not what
I meant at all.
translations.高いもん。すっごく高い、１００キロくらい。:
It is high. Super high.
Like, 100 kilometers high.
translations.そうそう、清水の舞台って約１１メートルなんだって。:
Oh yeah, I heard the stage
is only about 11 meters.
translations.はは、ごめん。１１メートルだったら、アクションスターなら飛び降りちゃうな。:
Haha, sorry. At 11 meters,
an action star could
probably jump off it.
translations.普通の人は無理だね。マットを敷けば、少しは安全かな。:
A normal person couldn't.
Maybe it'd be a little safer
if you laid out some mats.
translations.それなら●でも骨折か捻挫ですむかも。:
Then maybe even ●
could get away with just a
broken bone or a sprain.
translations.マットだけじゃなくて避難訓練で使う救助袋も用意して……。:
Not just mats, you'd need a
rescue chute like they use
in evacuation drills...
translations.なんなら梯子を使うとか。:
Or I could just use
a ladder.
translations.梯子は梯子で心配。腰にザイルを結んで、あとは……。:
A ladder is scary too.
Tie a rope around your
waist, and then...
translations.えっと……実際に飛び降りなくてもいいよね。:
Uh... I don't actually
have to jump off it, right？
translations.うーん……飛び降りながら「好きだー！」って叫んでくれたら、かっこいいな？:
Hmm... it'd be pretty cool
if you yelled 'I love you!'
while jumping, wouldn't it？
translations.今日も、忙しかったね。:
We were pretty busy
again today, huh？
translations.さすがの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も\nまいってる？:
Is even the great ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
feeling a little beat？
translations.んー、\nリフレッシュしたいなー。:
Hmm...
I'd love to go somewhere
and recharge.
translations.リフレッシュか……。\nでもこの状況だと、\nそんなに休めないよな。:
Recharge, huh...
But with how things are,
we can't take much time off.
translations.そんなに長くなくても。\n１泊ぐらいで、どこか\n旅行にでも行けたらな……。:
It wouldn't have to be long.
If we could just take a trip
for a night or so...
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。\n実は懸賞で当たったんだ。\n熱海に一泊二日。:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I actually won a prize.
A two-day trip to Atami.
translations.●たち二人で……\n行かない？:
Do you want to go...
just the two of us, ●？
translations.……二人で？ \nちょっと、考えるね。:
...Just the two of us？
Let me think about it.
translations.さっきの、旅行の話だけど。:
About that trip
you mentioned earlier.
translations.さっきリフレッシュって\n言ったとき、ちょっとだけ\n考えてたの。二人だったら、:
When I said I wanted to
recharge earlier, I was
actually thinking about it.
How nice it'd be with you.
translations.そっか……。\nそうだ、いつにする？:
I see...
Oh right, when should we go？
translations.週末がいいかな。\n日程は決めていいよ？:
The weekend might be best.
You can decide the dates.
translations.えーと、デートは\n別の日にするとして……。:
Let's see, we'll have our
date on another day...
translations.じゃあ。\n▲月▲▲日▲からの\n一泊二日で！:
Alright.
A two-day trip starting
on ▲月▲ ▲日▲!
translations.（●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n初めての旅行か……）:
(● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
our first trip together...)
translations.実は当たったんだ。\n熱海旅行。:
I actually won a prize.
A trip to Atami.
translations.え……すごい。\n偶然、だよね。:
Wow... that's amazing.
What a coincidence.
translations.うん、●もびっくり。\nでさ、せっかくだし……\n一緒に行かない？:
Yeah, you're surprised too,
huh, ●. So, since I won...
want to go together？
translations.（まあ、デートはまた今度だな）:
(Well, we can always go on
our date another time.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と\n旅行に行けるぞ！）:
(I get to go on a trip
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!)
translations.今から、旅行の買い物に行かない？ 急だった、かな？:
Want to go shopping for
the trip right now？
Is it too sudden？
translations.旅行の？ そうか、色々準備しないとな……よし、行くか！:
For the trip？ Right, we need
to get ready...
Alright, let's go!
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、ショッピングモールで。:
Hehe. Let's meet
at the mall.
translations.女の子にそういうこと聞かないの。:
You shouldn't ask a girl
things like that.
translations.（うーん、誘ったのはそっちなのになあ……）:
(Hmm, even though she's
the one who invited me...)
translations.（待てよ。夏、海に旅行に行くんだから……）:
(Wait. We're going on a
summer beach trip, so...)
translations.水着買わないと！: I need to buy a swimsuit!
translations.ならいいけど、買い忘れ、ないようにね？:
If you say so. Just don't
forget anything, okay？
translations.水着？ あ、もう……。しょうがないなあ。:
A swimsuit？ Oh, jeez...
You're hopeless.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に任せておけばなんとかなっちゃうな。:
I guess everything works out
if I leave it to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.こーら、楽しないの。手伝ってあげるから、ちゃんと準備するの。:
Hey, no slacking off. I'll
help you, so prepare properly.
translations.んー。もうすぐ旅行かあ。:
Hmm. The trip is
almost here.
translations.まさか。●もすっげー楽しみ！:
No way. I'm super excited
too, ●!
translations.ふふ、だよね。当日まで、元気にしてるんだよ？ じゃあね。:
Hehe, I thought so. Stay
healthy until then, okay？ Bye.
translations.おはよう。晴れてよかったー、気持ちいい日だね。:
Morning. I'm glad it's
sunny. It's a beautiful day.
translations.おはよ。ほんと、旅行日和だね。:
Morning. It really is
perfect weather for a trip.
translations.おはよう。暑さ対策、ちゃんとしてきた？:
Morning. Did you make sure
to prepare for the heat？
translations.おはよ。うん、たぶん大丈夫。:
Morning. Yeah, I think
I'm good.
translations.おはよう。涼しくて気持ちいい。旅行にぴったりの日だね。:
Morning. It's nice and cool.
Perfect day for a trip.
translations.おはよ。ほんと、いい天気でよかった。:
Morning. I'm really glad we
got such good weather.
translations.おはよう。寒いな～、風邪ひかないでね？ 私も気をつけるから。:
Morning. It's cold~ Make sure
you don't catch a cold, okay？
I'll be careful too.
translations.気付いてくれた？ 似合ってると、いいんだけど……。:
You noticed？ I hope it
looks good on me...
translations.やったあ……。ほっとしちゃった、ありがと。:
Yay... That's a relief.
Thank you.
translations.え、そう……かな。あなたが言うなら、そうなのかな。:
Oh, you think... so.
Well, if you say so,
it must be true.
translations.（うん、前の方がよかったよな）:
(Yeah, the old way
was definitely better.)
translations.今日の服、変じゃないかな？:
Does my outfit today
look weird？
translations.よかった……。がんばったんだ。:
Thank goodness...
I put a lot of effort in.
translations.あは……失敗しちゃった。: Haha... I guess I messed up.
translations.（うん。●は別のがいいな）:
(Yeah. I think ●
looks better in other stuff.)
translations.ちゃんと反応したね？ ふふ、よろしい。:
You actually noticed？
Hehe, good boy.
translations.よかったー。これでも苦労したんだぞ？:
I'm glad. I actually worked
hard on this, you know？
translations.もう、ちゃんと見てない。:
Jeez, you're not
looking closely enough.
translations.……好みに合わないなら、しょうがない、か。:
...If it's not your taste,
it can't be helped, huh.
translations.今日の服は、どう？ 感想聞きたいな。:
How's my outfit today？
What do you think？
translations.も～。はあ、まあ嘘つかれても困るもんね。:
Jeez. Well, it'd be bad
if you lied to me, I guess.
translations.新しいネネさんでーす。どうかな？:
It's the brand-new Nene!
How does it look？
translations.はあ、いきなり大不評？:
Wow, terrible reviews
right off the bat？
translations.今日の服はどうかな。似合ってる？:
How's my outfit today？
Does it look good on me？
translations.ふふ、これでも色々考えたんだからね？:
Hehe, I actually put a lot
of thought into this, y'know？
translations.そんな言い方……もう。:
You didn't have to say it
like that... Jeez.
translations.う～……。でも立ち直んなきゃ。:
Aww... I'll just have to
bounce back from this.
translations.（そういえば今日は……）:
(Come to think of it,
today is...)
translations.ふふ。こんな日に旅行することになるなんてね。:
Hehe. I can't believe we're
taking a trip on a day like this.
translations.うん、まだ少し時間あるね。:
Yeah, we still have
a little time.
translations.はじめてだもん。余裕もって行動しなきゃ。:
It's our first time. We need
to leave plenty of time.
translations.特急の旅行って、雰囲気あるね。:
Traveling by limited express
really has a nice vibe to it.
translations.うん、ちょっと渋い。: Yeah, it's got a classic feel.
translations.渋い？ ふふ、私は嫌いじゃないな。:
Classic？ Hehe, I certainly
don't mind it.
translations.うん。●も、好きになるかも。:
Yeah. You might end up
liking it too, ●.
translations.乗り換え、どっちだっけ？: Which way was our transfer again？
translations.やっぱり新幹線より、こっちがいいなあ。:
I definitely prefer this
over the bullet train.
translations.この時間も、大切な旅行の思い出だもんね。:
This time is a precious memory
of our trip, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の荷物ってさ、結構少ない？:
Your luggage is pretty light,
isn't it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん……そうかも。最低限のものしか持ってきてないから。:
Yeah... I guess so. I only
brought the bare minimum.
translations.さすが……なんかコツあるの？:
Impressive... Do you have
some kind of trick for it？
translations.私も、特に慣れてるわけじゃないんだけどね。:
Well, it's not like I'm super
used to this or anything.
translations.現地で用意できるものは持ち歩かないようにしたり……とかかな。:
I just try not to carry things
we can get when we arrive...
Stuff like that, I guess.
translations.うーん、なんだか余裕を感じる。:
Hmm, you seem so prepared
and relaxed about it.
translations.もう、そうやって当てにして。:
Jeez, you're already relying
on me like that.
translations.いざってとき頼りになるのは、やっぱり男の子でしょ？:
When push comes to shove,
the guy is supposed to be
the reliable one, right？
translations.ねえ、今日の私たちは、ハネムーン中の新婚さんなの。こういうの、いや？:
Hey, today we're newlyweds
on our honeymoon.
Don't you like that？
translations.なんだい、おまえ？ ……なんか変だな。:
What is it, dear？
...This feels weird.
translations.そっちは自然にしてていいよ。それでも私は、楽しめちゃうから。:
You can just act natural.
I'll still have fun with it.
translations.そう……。別に知ってる人なんて、いないのに。:
Really... Even though
no one we know is here.
translations.そうだけど……気分的にさ。:
I know, but...
I just feel self-conscious.
translations.まもなく熱海に到着いたします。本日もご利用いただきまして、まことにありがとうござ:
We will soon be arriving
in Atami. Thank you for
riding with us today.
translations.少し。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、緊張しない？:
A little. Aren't you
nervous, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.してるよ？ でも、それよりもっとわくわくしてる。:
I am. But I'm even more
excited than nervous.
translations.思いっきり、楽しもうね。:
Let's enjoy ourselves
to the fullest.
translations.前来た時のこと、色々思い出すなあ……。:
It brings back memories
of the last time we came...
translations.がんばって、前より楽しくしちゃおうか？:
Let's try to make it even
more fun than last time？
translations.まじで？ ●たち大丈夫かな。:
Seriously？ I wonder if
we'll be okay, ●.
translations.楽し過ぎて、倒れちゃう？ それでもいいよ。:
Pass out from having too
much fun？ I'm fine with that.
translations.えっと。まずはどこ行くんだっけ。:
Let's see. Where are we
going first again？
translations.行きたいところ、あるの。:
There's somewhere
I want to go.
translations.おー、ほんとにロープウェイだ。: Oh, it really is a ropeway.
translations.他に人、乗ってこないといいな……。: I hope no one else gets on...
translations.これが途中で止まったら……。: If this stops in the middle...
translations.二人きりになれるのは嬉しいけど。こんな高いところではいやだな。ふふ。:
I'm glad we get to be alone,
but I'd rather not be up
so high. Hehe.
translations.ここに来たかったの。あいじょう岬。:
This is where I wanted
to come. Aijo Cape.
translations.えっと……ここに錠前をかけると、二人はずっと幸せになれる、ってことか。:
Let's see... If we lock a
padlock here, we'll be happy
together forever, right？
translations.ここまで来てやらないわけないって。:
We can't come all this way
and not do it.
translations.うん、ちゃ～んと愛情込めてね？:
Yeah, make sure you put
lots of love into it, okay？
translations.ここにかけた錠前、奉納されるんだ。:
The padlocks locked here
get dedicated at a shrine.
translations.私たちのも、きっとそうだね。:
Ours will probably be
like that too, huh.
translations.だからまたここに来れた？:
Is that why we were able
to come here again？
translations.ねぇねぇ……あれってもしかして……。:
Hey, hey... Is that
what I think it is...
translations.私、聴いたことあるよ？ 知ってる？ すごーくエッチなところなんだって。:
I've heard of it, you know？
They say it's super naughty.
translations.ウソです！ 良い子は入っちゃダメ！ もうっ……。:
I'm kidding! Good boys
aren't allowed in! Geez...
translations.ねえ、ここから熱海の街を見渡せるみたい。:
Hey, looks like you can see
all of Atami from here.
translations.ほんとだ。ふーん、上から見るとこんな感じなんだな……。:
You're right. Hmm, so this
is what it looks like
from above...
translations.たしかにいい景色なんだけど……。:
It's definitely a
nice view, but...
translations.やっぱり。景色といったら夜景かなって。:
I just think night views
are the best.
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ次行こう。:
Well, let's head to
our next spot.
translations.そうだ。そろそろ昼にしない？:
Oh, right. Should we
get some lunch soon？
translations.そういや、ここにもデキシーズってあるのかな？:
Come to think of it, I wonder
if they have a Dexee's here？
translations.わかったって。: I got it, I got it.
translations.面白いとこにあるんだな。景色もいいし。:
It's in a pretty interesting
spot. The view is nice, too.
translations.ふう……。こっち着いてから動きっぱなしだったね。:
Phew... We've been on the move
since we got here, huh.
translations.いくら近くっても、一泊二日じゃなあ……。:
Even if it's close by,
two days and one night is...
translations.あんまりゆっくりしてられないか。: Not much time to relax, huh.
translations.だな。まだまだはじまったばっかだもんな。:
Yeah. But we've still
only just begun.
translations.着替えてくるね。ここで待ってて？:
I'm gonna go change.
Wait here for me, okay？
translations.（うーん。見渡してみても、やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が一番だな）:
(Hmm. Even looking around,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is definitely
the best.)
translations.ふふ、待たせちゃったね。:
Hehe, sorry to keep
you waiting.
translations.さすがって何？ もう。:
What's that supposed
to mean？ Geez.
translations.どう、水着。ご希望に、沿えたかな？:
So, the swimsuit. Is it
everything you hoped for？
translations.（そういや▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。日焼け対策ってしてるのかな）:
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Is she wearing sunscreen？)
translations.日焼け止め塗らないと！:
You need to put on
some sunscreen!
translations.ここはサンオイルだ！:
Tanning oil is
the way to go!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。日焼け止め塗った方がいいんじゃない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Shouldn't you
put on some sunscreen？
translations.あ、ほんとだ。忘れちゃった。:
Ah, you're right.
I completely forgot.
translations.自分で塗るよ？: I'll put it on myself, okay？
translations.これサンオイルだけど……。日焼けした子が好み？:
This is tanning oil...
Do you like tanned girls？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら、きっと日焼けしても似合う！:
I'm sure you'd look great
with a tan, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.そうなのかな。うーん、あなたがそう言うなら。:
You think so？ Hmm, well,
if you say so.
translations.シーズンじゃなくても、人がいるね。:
There are still people here
even though it's off-season.
translations.ふふ、自覚足りない？:
Hehe, lacking a bit
of self-awareness？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が隣にいるの、当たり前過ぎてさ。:
Having you next to me just
feels so natural, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.もう、上手いこと言って。:
Jeez, you sure know
what to say.
translations.ふう……。あ、そろそろ行くか。:
Phew... Ah, should we
get going soon？
translations.まだ行くところたくさんあるからな。:
We still have a lot of
places to go, after all.
translations.熱海の桜って、有名なんだっけ。:
Atami is famous for
its cherry blossoms, right？
translations.うん。熱海桜っていうくらいだから。:
Yeah. They're even called
Atami cherry blossoms.
translations.そっか、結構色んなとこに植えられてるもんな。:
Right, they're planted
all over the place here.
translations.お花見もできそうだね。:
Looks like we could do
some cherry blossom viewing.
translations.いつか、色々できたらいいね。:
It'd be nice to do all sorts
of things someday.
translations.あ、お土産屋さん。ちょっとのぞいてみよっか？:
Ah, a souvenir shop.
Wanna take a quick look？
translations.それもいいけど……今買うと荷物にならない？:
That sounds nice, but...
won't it be heavy to carry？
translations.この後の予定もあるし……。:
We have plans
after this, too...
translations.時間なら、まだ大丈夫でしょ？:
We still have plenty of time,
don't we？
translations.そうだけど……早くホテルに行った方が、二人きりに……。:
True, but... if we get to the
hotel sooner, we'll be alone...
translations.ふふっ、じゃあちょっとのぞいてこよっと。:
Hehe, then I'm gonna go
take a quick peek.
translations.（わかってて、やってるのかな……）:
(I wonder if she's doing
this on purpose...)
translations.うわ、これ登るのか……。何段あるんだ？:
Whoa, we have to climb
this... How many steps
are there？
translations.それ知ったら、くじけちゃいそう。:
If I knew that, I think
I'd just give up.
translations.それもそうか……。ゆっくり行こう。:
Fair point... Let's take
it nice and slow.
translations.ごめん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。だめだ、限界……。:
Sorry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I can't... I'm at my limit...
translations.……そうだね、これ以上は、私も。:
...Yeah, me too. I don't
think I can go any further.
translations.下りのことも考えたら、無理しない方がいいよな……。:
Considering we have to
go back down, we probably
shouldn't push it...
translations.上の方、紅葉してるみたいだね。でもしょうがないか……。:
Looks like the leaves are
changing further up.
But it can't be helped...
translations.ごめんね、私が運動不足だから。:
Sorry, it's because I'm
so out of shape.
translations.●の方こそ……。:
I should be the one
apologizing, ●...
translations.はあ……。ありがとう、荷物持ってくれて。一人じゃ、無理……。:
Phew... Thanks for carrying
my bags. I couldn't have
done it alone...
translations.はは、これでも一応運動部だし。:
Haha, I am in a sports
club, after all.
translations.紅葉、キレイだね。苦労した後だと、余計にそう感じるのかも。:
The autumn leaves are
beautiful. Maybe they look
even better after all
that hard work.
translations.それもあるのかも。ちゃんと見てかないと。:
Maybe so. We'd better
take a good look.
translations.ここ、源頼朝と北条政子がデートをした場所なんだ。:
This is where Minamoto no
Yoritomo and Hojo Masako
used to go on dates.
translations.うんうん。ここでお参りすれば、幕府開けちゃうよ？:
Uh-huh. If you pray here,
you might just be able to
start your own shogunate？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲との仲がもっと進展しますように）:
(Please let my relationship
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ grow deeper.)
translations.（なんだろう。前より▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と親密になった気がする！）:
(I wonder what it is. I feel
closer to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ than before!)
translations.うん。ご利益ありそう♪:
Yeah. I think we'll get
some divine favor♪
translations.熱海に来たら、これ見ないとね。:
You can't come to Atami
without seeing this.
translations.でもなー、カップルでこれを見るのって、ちょっと複雑かも。:
But man, seeing this as a
couple is a bit awkward.
translations.人によっては、そうかもね。:
For some people,
maybe it is.
translations.私は……嫌いじゃないな。尽くす女って。:
I... don't really dislike it.
A woman who devotes
herself to her man.
translations.ふーん。そういう話なんだ？:
Hmm. Is that what the
story is about？
translations.ごめん、知らないの。見た目の印象だけ。:
Sorry, I don't actually
know. Just going by how
it looks.
translations.暴力はダメだけど……私は責められても、尽くしちゃう……かな。:
Violence is a no-go, but...
Even if he blamed me, I
think I'd still devote
myself to him...
translations.そんな、責めたりなんて。:
I'd never blame you
for anything.
translations.うん、もちろん。あなたは優しいもん。:
Yeah, of course.
You're too sweet for that.
translations.あ、そろそろホテル行かないと。:
Ah, we should head to
the hotel soon.
translations.もうそんな時間？ たくさん回ったもんね。:
Is it that time already？
We did look around a lot.
translations.でも先はまだまだ！:
But the trip's not
over yet!
translations.うん、まだまだ。: Yeah, not by a long shot.
translations.うん、ここに泊まるんだよ。: Yeah, this is where we're staying.
translations.ここに２人で泊まるんだよな。:
So it's just the two of us
staying here, huh.
translations.私たち、ホテルの人にほんとの夫婦って思われてるかな。:
Do you think the hotel staff
thinks we're really married？
translations.どうかな。ラブラブっぷりじゃ、本物に負けてないと思うけど。:
I wonder. Though I think our
lovey-dovey vibes could rival
the real thing.
translations.ふふ、自覚あるんだ。: Hehe, so you're aware of it.
translations.じゃあ、今日も見せつけちゃお？:
Then let's show off a little
more today, shall we？
translations.私がチェックインするから、あなたはゆっくりしてて。:
I'll handle the check-in,
so you just relax.
translations.いいから、やらせて？: Come on, let me do it？
translations.それでは、お部屋へご案内いたします。: Right this way to your room.
translations.奥様、お荷物をどうぞ。:
Please allow me to take
your bags, ma'am.
translations.台帳の名前、あなたの苗字にしちゃった▼:
I put your last name down
in the registry▼
translations.どっち？ 二人が泊まる部屋でしょ？:
Whose？ It's the room we're
both staying in, right？
translations.だって……せっかく一緒の旅行なのに別々なんて、そんなの。ヤだよ。:
I mean... we're on a trip together.
I'd hate it if we were in
separate rooms.
translations.ずっと、一緒にいよ？: Let's stay together the whole time？
translations.ふふ、どうして部屋に入るたびに緊張するの？:
Hehe, why do you get so nervous
every time we enter a room？
translations.そんなだと、私が緊張する暇がないんだよね。:
When you're like that, I don't
even have time to be nervous.
translations.私だってドキドキしてるのに。それに気付かないぐらいに、硬くなってるんだもん。:
I'm feeling nervous too,
you know. But you're so
stiff you haven't noticed.
translations.責めてるんじゃないよ。そういうとこも、カワイくて好き。:
I'm not blaming you.
I think that part of you
is cute, too.
translations.お茶いれるの。\n毎日でもいいんだけどな。:
I wouldn't mind making
tea for you every day...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。●、ホテルの中、探検してくる。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm gonna go explore
the hotel for a bit, ●.
translations.うん、ついてきてもつまんないだろ？:
Yeah, it'd be boring if
you tagged along, right？
translations.一緒じゃなきゃ、やだ。:
I don't wanna go if
we're not together.
translations.旅行の間、別々に行動なんて許さないよ？:
I won't let us do things
separately on our trip,
you know？
translations.うん、テレビでもつけるか。今何やってるっけ。:
Yeah, maybe I'll turn on
the TV. What's on now？
translations.せっかくの旅行なのに、テレビなんて観ないの。……私がいるのに。:
We're on a special trip,
so no watching TV.
...Not when I'm here.
translations.デートで一緒に映画観たりするのとは……。:
But watching a movie
together on a date is...
translations.どうしたの？ やっぱ疲れた？:
What's wrong？
Are you tired after all？
translations.それもあるけど、ちょっとお昼食べ過ぎたみたい。:
That too, but I think I
ate a bit too much for
lunch.
translations.うん。そんな大したことじゃないから……一応、胃薬飲むね。:
Yeah. It's nothing major...
I'll take some stomach
medicine to be safe.
translations.晩御飯も美味しかったら、どうしよう……。:
What if dinner is super
delicious too...？
translations.食事までまだ時間あるし。先に風呂入っちゃおうか。:
We still have time before
dinner. Should we take a
bath first？
translations.お風呂……そうだね。そうしよっか。:
A bath... Yeah.
Let's do that.
translations.ここ、時間によって男女のお風呂が入れ替わるみたい。:
It looks like the men's
and women's baths swap
depending on the time.
translations.今は男湯がローマ風呂で、女湯が花のお風呂。:
Right now the men's is the
Roman bath, and the
women's is the flower bath.
translations.なんか強そうじゃん？:
Doesn't it sound kinda
cool and strong？
translations.ふふ、じゃあ行こ。準備するね。:
Hehe, let's go then.
I'll get ready.
translations.ああ、じゃあ先出てる。:
Ah, I'll head out first
then.
translations.（カノジョと一緒に風呂か……まあ別々だけど）:
(Taking a bath with my
girlfriend... well,
separately.)
translations.待ち合わせしようか。お風呂あがったら、ここで待っててほしいな？:
Let's meet up after.
I want you to wait for me
right here, okay？
translations.あー、わかるわかる。いいね、それ。:
Ah, I get it.
Yeah, sounds good.
translations.私長いから、ゆっくり入っててね？:
I take a while, so take
your time in there, okay？
translations.（今日結構歩き回ったし、ゆっくりしよう）:
(We walked around a lot
today, so I should relax.)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はまだか。まあ、普通はそうだよな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s not out yet.
Well, that's normal.)
translations.（にしても長い……女の子の風呂って、なんで長いんだろうな）:
(Still, it's been a while...
Why do girls take so long
in the bath？)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ごめん、やっぱり待たせちゃった。:
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry, I kept you
waiting after all.
translations.うん、あなたの浴衣姿もかっこいい▼:
Yeah, you look pretty cool
in yours too.▼
translations.豪華だね。うーん、たくさん食べちゃいそう……。:
It's so fancy. Mmm, I feel
like I'm gonna eat a lot...
