translations.次は足を前後に開いて、手は腰に。右足をひざを曲げて前に、左足をひざを伸ばして後ろ:
Next, step forward, hands

on hips. Bend your right

knee, keep your left leg

straight, and stretch

your Achilles tendon.
translations.最後に両足を肩幅に開いて、前屈したら、ゆっくりつま先を触って……体を起こして腰に:
Finally, feet shoulder-width

apart, bend forward and

touch your toes... then

stand up, hands on hips,

and lean back.
translations.はい、これでストレッチ終了。できるだけ体を動かすようにしようね。:
Okay, stretches are done.

Let's try to keep our bodies

moving as much as we can,

alright？
translations.ふふっ、腕立て伏せ、したいの？: Hehe, you want to do some push-ups？
translations.最近、運動不足だから一緒に運動、しない？:
I haven't been getting enough exercise lately. 
Want to work out together？
translations.ねぇ、腕立て伏せしたいから、付き合って？:
Hey, I want to do some push-ups. 
Will you keep me company？
translations.ふふ、優しいんだ。じゃあ、始めよっか。:
Hehe, you're so sweet. 
Let's get started, then.
translations.そう。じゃあ、また今度……次は一緒にやろうね？:
I see. Well, maybe next time... 
We'll do it together then, okay？
translations.１セットで腕立て１０回。何セット、できそう？:
One set is 10 push-ups. 
How many sets can you do？
translations.最初はそのくらいが良さそうだね？:
That sounds like a good amount 
to start with, right？
translations.うんうん、このくらいはできたほうがいいね。:
Yeah, it's good to be able to do 
at least that much.
translations.途中できつくなったら言うんだよ？ ファイト！:
Let me know if it gets too tough, okay？ 
You can do it!
translations.ふふっ、男の子だなぁ。よし、チャレンジチャレンジ。:
Hehe, you're such a boy. 
Alright, let's see what you've got.
translations.じゃ、始めよっか。一緒に声、出して行こうね。:
Let's get started, then. 
Count out loud with me, okay？
translations.声、聞こえないぞ？: I can't hear you, you know？
translations.ふふ、次、いくよ？: Hehe, ready for the next one？
translations.リタイアしても怒ったりしないよ？:
I won't be mad if you need to 
tap out, you know.
translations.大丈夫？ 無理はダメよ？:
Are you okay？ 
Don't push yourself too hard.
translations.ファイト、もう少し！: Keep it up, just a little more!
translations.あなたならできるよ！: I know you can do it!
translations.最後のセットだよ、いい？: This is the last set, ready？
translations.すごいね……惚れ直しちゃった。ふふ。:
Wow... I think I'm falling for you 
all over again. Hehe.
translations.お疲れさま。この感じで、続けていけるといいね。:
Good work. 
It'd be great if you can keep this up.
translations.ほら、こっちにおいで？ 汗、拭いてあげる。:
Here, come closer. 
Let me wipe your sweat.
translations.これくらいできると、気持ちいいね？:
It feels pretty good when
you can do this much, right？
translations.私もしたくなっちゃった。ね、数えてくれる？:
Now I want to do it too.
Hey, will you count for me？
translations.もう、ダメかも……。:
I think I'm...
at my limit...
translations.はぁっ。お姉さん、疲れちゃった……運動不足、だね。ふふふ。:
Haa. Your big sister is all
tired out... I must be out
of shape. Hehehe.
translations.ふぅ、お疲れさま。また今度、一緒に運動しようね。:
Phew, good work. Let's
exercise together again
sometime.
translations.はぁ、汗かいちゃったね……シャワー、浴びてきていい？:
Haa, I got all sweaty...
Mind if I go take a shower？
translations.一緒に浴びちゃおっか。ふふ、嘘です。またあとでね？:
Maybe we should take one
together. Hehe, just kidding.
See you in a bit？
translations.なぁに？ 腹筋したいの？ ふふ。:
What is it？ You want to
do some sit-ups？ Hehe.
translations.１セットで腹筋１０回ね。何セットする？:
One set is 10 sit-ups.
How many sets will you do？
translations.ふふ、一緒にゲームする？ いいよ、しよ？:
Hehe, wanna play a game
together？ Sure, let's play.
translations.ねぇねぇ、一緒にゲームして？:
Hey, hey, play a game
with me？
translations.ふぅん、冷たいんだ。ふふっ、ウソウソ。また今度ね？:
Hmm, so cold. Hehe,
just kidding. Next time,
okay？
translations.ふふ、今日は負けてあげないんだから。:
Hehe, I'm not gonna let you
win today.
translations.じゃあ、ハンデつけてあげちゃおっか。ふふふ。:
Well then, maybe I should
give you a handicap. Hehehe.
translations.さて、どうしましょう。: Now then, what should we do.
translations.ふふ、負けないよ？:
Hehe, I won't lose,
you know？
translations.女の子には優しくしないと、嫌われちゃうぞ？ ふふ。:
If you aren't nice to girls,
they'll end up hating you.
Hehe.
translations.本気、出しちゃおうかなぁ。ふふっ。:
Maybe I should go all out.
Hehe.
translations.あれ……やめちゃうんだ。次は、ゆっくりやろうね。:
Oh... you're quitting. Let's
take it easy next time.
translations.面白かったね？ どうしよう、もう１回、しちゃう？:
That was fun, wasn't it？
What do you think, wanna
go another round？
translations.ふふ、さすが。じゃあ、また最初からいくよ？:
Hehe, I'd expect no less.
Alright, from the top again？
translations.ん、そうだね。今日はいっぱい楽しんだもんね。:
Mhm, you're right. We had
plenty of fun today,
after all.
translations.また近いうちに遊ぼうね。お疲れさま。:
Let's play again soon.
Good work.
translations.辛いこと……あった？:
Did you have...
a rough time？
translations.ううん。いいよ、何にも言わないで……。:
No. It's okay, you don't
have to say anything...
translations.私を見て？ これから私が言うこと、ちゃんと聴いてて。:
Look at me？ I need you to
listen closely to what I'm
about to say.
translations.少し、長くなるかもしれないけど。いい？:
It might be a little long,
but... is that okay？
translations.世界中の王子様が、私の元にプロポーズしに来るの。世界中から、旅をしてね。:
Princes from all over the
world come to propose to me.
Traveling from everywhere.
translations.カッコいい王子様も、頭がいい王子様も、とびっきり優しい王子様も、たーくさん。いい:
Handsome princes, smart
princes, incredibly sweet
princes, so many of them.
Got it？ Princes from all
over the world, you know？
translations.でもね？ それでも、あなたにはかなわないの。:
But you know what？ Even
then, they can't compare
to you.
translations.私は、あなたがいいの。: You're the only one I want.
translations.うぅん……わかりづらかったかな……じゃあ、例えば……。:
Hmm... maybe that was hard
to understand... Then,
for example...
translations.もし、素敵なお家をもらえるとするでしょ？:
What if I was offered a
gorgeous house？
translations.広ーくて、きれいなお庭があって、立派なキッチンと、可愛いワンちゃんまでいたりして:
Super spacious, with a
beautiful garden, a fancy
kitchen, and even a cute
little dog.
translations.道行く人が、みんなうらやましがるような素敵なお家。:
The kind of amazing house
that makes everyone walking
by jealous.
translations.でもね、そこにあなたが居ないなら、私はちっとも欲しくない。私は、あなたの傍の方が:
But you know, if you're
not there, I wouldn't want
it at all. I'd rather be
by your side.
translations.それは、私があなたを愛してるってこと。: It means that I love you.
translations.これからあなたにどんなことが起きて、誰が何を言っても、私はあなたを愛してる。:
No matter what happens to
you from now on, or what
anyone says, I love you.
translations.がんばってとか、元気出してとか……言いたいことはたくさんあるけど、:
I have so many things I
want to say, like 'do your
best' or 'cheer up'...
translations.でも本当に憶えていて欲しいのは、いつもそのことだけ。:
But the only thing I really
want you to remember is
just that.
translations.私が、あなたを愛してる。あなたの傍にいる。:
That I love you. And that
I'm right here by your side.
translations.また、なにもかも嫌になっちゃうようなことがあったら、いつも、そのことを思い出して:
If you ever feel like you
hate everything again,
always remember that.
translations.あ、そんなのも、いいかも……。:
Ah, that might be nice,
too...
translations.もう、なにも知らないのね。先生が教えてあげるから。:
Jeez, you don't know
anything, do you？
Sensei will teach you.
translations.あらあら……先生の言うことが聞けないの？ 黙って、教えた通りに……ね？:
My, my... Can't you
listen to Sensei？ Just be
quiet and do as I taught
you... okay？
translations.まったく、しょうがない子ね。先生が手伝ってあげないと、何もできないんだから。:
Goodness, you're a
hopeless kid. You can't
do anything unless
Sensei helps you.
translations.先生、言うこときかない子にはおしおきしちゃうわよ。覚悟しなさい。:
Sensei is going to punish
kids who don't listen.
Prepare yourself.
translations.どう？ よく観察して、勉強してね。:
How's that？ Observe
closely and learn from it.
translations.ご主人様……いつまでも、お仕えします。:
Master... I will serve
you forever.
translations.私のお料理、どうですか？ たくさん食べてくれると、嬉しいです。:
How is my cooking？ I'd be
happy if you ate a lot.
translations.ご主人様って、なんだか子供みたい。ふふっ。:
Master, you're kind of
like a child. Hehe.
translations.ダイエットしたいなあ……でも、ついおかわりしちゃう。:
I want to go on a diet...
but I end up getting
seconds.
translations.おいしいご飯、しあわせ……。:
Delicious food makes me
so happy...
translations.ふたりで食べたら、もっとおいしいのに……。:
It'd be even more
delicious if we ate
together...
translations.授業が終わったら、会いにいきたいな。:
I want to go see him
after class is over.
translations.お腹が空いて、集中できないよ……。:
I'm so hungry, I can't
concentrate...
translations.なんでこんなに眠いのかなあ。夢の中にいるみたい。:
Why am I so sleepy？ It
feels like I'm in a dream.
translations.好きって、もっとたくさん言いたいのに。:
I want to tell you I love
you a lot more...
translations.もう、離れたくないよ……。:
I don't want to let go of
you anymore...
translations.そういえば、もう書き初めってする機会ないね。:
Come to think of it, we
don't really get to do
New Year's calligraphy
anymore.
translations.そうだな……今やれって言われても、自信ないかも。:
Yeah... If someone told
me to do it now, I
probably wouldn't be
very confident.
translations.紙に向かって、精神統一。邪念を払って一気に筆を走らせる。:
You face the paper and
focus your mind. Clear
your thoughts, then let
the brush fly.
translations.はは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は達筆そうだよな。美人書道家ってイメージ。:
Haha, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I bet you
have great handwriting.
You give off 'beautiful
calligrapher' vibes.
translations.そんなにほめても、何にも出てこないぞ？:
Flattery will get you
nowhere, you know?
translations.でもね、ほめてもらったところ悪いんだけど、あまり得意じゃなくて。:
Well, I hate to ruin
the compliment, but I'm
actually not that good
at it.
translations.字を書くのはいいんだけど、墨をするのがね。書き初めって墨汁使わないじゃない？:
Writing the characters
is fine, but grinding
the ink is tough. You
don't use bottled ink
for that, right?
translations.墨をするだけでヘロヘロになっちゃうの。ほら、私って運動苦手だし。:
Just grinding the ink
wipes me out. You know
I'm not good at
exercising.
translations.成人式、どうしようかな……。:
I wonder what I should
do for the coming-of-
age ceremony...
translations.だって、まるで今年やるみたいな言い方するから。:
Because you made it
sound like you're doing
it this year.
translations.そんなわけないでしょ。これからのこと。:
Of course not. I mean
for the future.
translations.はは、だよね。やっぱり何着るか、とかそういうこと？:
Haha, right. Like what
you're going to wear?
translations.そう、どっちがいいかな？:
Yeah, which do you
think is better?
translations.んー、やっぱり着物じゃないの。他に着る機会もそんなにないし。:
Hmm, probably a kimono,
right? You don't get
many chances to wear
one.
translations.スーツもステキだと思うんだけど、スーツはいつでも着られるもんね♪:
A suit would look great
too, but you can wear
a suit anytime, right?♪
translations.２月といえば節分か……。:
February means Setsubun
is coming up...
translations.歳の数だけ食べるって、嫌がらせよね。:
Having to eat your age
in beans feels like a
cruel joke, doesn't it?
translations.そんなこと気にしなくてもいいのに。:
You really don't need
to worry about that.
translations.歳の数だけ食べるっていってもさ、それって結構多いよな。厳密に守らなくてもいいんじ:
Even if you're supposed
to eat your age, that's
a lot of beans. I don't
think you have to
follow it that strictly.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、いくつ食べる予定？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how many are
you planning to eat?
translations.もう、引かないでよ！:
Jeez, don't look so
put off!
translations.（可愛いって思っただけなんだけどな……）:
(I just thought it was
cute, though...)
translations.はぁ……まだまだ寒いし、春はまだ遠いなあ。:
Sigh... It's still so
cold. Spring feels so
far away.
translations.もう。お年寄りみたいなこと言わないの。:
Jeez. Don't talk like
an old man.
translations.だってじゃありません。春はすぐそこまで来てるよ。気づいていないだけで。:
No 'buts'. Spring is
just around the corner.
You just haven't
noticed it yet.
translations.学校の近くのお家に梅の木があるでしょう？ あそこに小さなつぼみがほころびかけてた:
You know that house
near the school with
the plum tree? I saw
some little buds
starting to open up.
translations.へえ、ぜんぜん気づかなかった。いつも通り過ぎるだけだから。:
Wow, I didn't notice
at all. I always just
walk right past it.
translations.探せば小さな春は、たくさん見つかると思うよ？:
If you look closely,
I bet you can find lots
of little signs of
spring.
translations.そうだな……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がもっと薄着になれば、春を感じるかも？:
Hmm... Maybe I'd feel spring
if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ dressed a bit lighter？
translations.今でも立派な女の子なんですけど。:
I'll have you know I'm still
a proper girl.
translations.今はさすがにしてないよ。小さい頃はやってたけど。:
Well, not anymore. I did
when I was little, though.
translations.（結局過去形なんじゃ……）:
(So it is past tense,
after all...)
translations.そういうことじゃないの、気持ちの問題。:
That's not the point.
It's about how I feel.
translations.そう、顔に出てたの。:
Yep, it was written
all over your face.
translations.（心の声と会話しないで……）:
(Please don't reply to
my inner thoughts...)
translations.ね。春の花って言ったら、なにを思い浮かべる？:
Hey. When you think of spring
flowers, what comes to mind？
translations.やっぱり？ でもまだ桜には早いよね、今は桃の節句って言うでしょ？:
I knew it. But it's too early
for cherry blossoms, right？
It's the Peach Festival now.
translations.そういえば庭に咲いてる家もあるよね。:
Come to think of it, some
houses have them blooming
in their yards.
translations.私はね、お花屋さんに小さな鉢植えが売ってたから、つい買っちゃった。:
I saw a little potted plant
at the florist the other day,
and I just had to buy it.
translations.小さなつぼみがついててね、それがだんだんほころんでくのを見てるのが、楽しいの。:
It has tiny buds on it.
It's so much fun watching
them slowly open up.
translations.へえ。●も見てみたいな。:
Wow. I'd like to see ●'s
too.
translations.ふーん……それは、私の家に来たいってこと？:
Hmm... Does that mean you
want to come over to my place？
translations.そうよね、写真に撮って見せてあげるだけでもいいわけだし。ね？:
Right, I could just take a
picture and show you. Right？
translations.（それはそれで不満が残るな……）:
(I wouldn't exactly be
satisfied with just that...)
translations.ご近所の幼稚園で、この前、入園式があったの。みんなちっちゃくてかわいいの。:
There was an entrance
ceremony at the local
kindergarten recently.
They were all so tiny and cute.
translations.そういえば、そんな時期か。:
Come to think of it,
it is that time of year.
translations.まだ集団に慣れてない感じが、初々しくて……ん……？ どうかした？:
They looked so innocent, not
used to being in a group yet...
Hm...？ What's wrong？
translations.今の表情、すっごく優しそうで、良かったなって。:
You just had this really
gentle look on your face.
It was nice.
translations.本心だって。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、幼稚園の先生なんかぴったりかも。:
I mean it. I think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would
make a perfect kindergarten
teacher.
translations.絶対！ やさしいネネ先生は子供たちに懐かれると思うな。:
Definitely! I bet the kids
would love their sweet
Ms. Nene.
translations.でもまずは、たくさんの子供に囲まれるよりも……。:
But before being surrounded
by lots of kids...
translations.一人で充分、かなって。: I think just one is plenty.
translations.４月のこと、卯月っていうじゃない？:
You know how April is called
Uzuki in the old calendar？
translations.ああ、元は旧暦の４月のことだっけ。:
Yeah, originally the fourth
month of the lunar calendar,
right？
translations.前にね、それを卵月って読んじゃったことがあって。:
Well, once I accidentally
read it as Tamago-zuki
(Egg Month).
translations.はは！ たしかに、字が似てるもんな。:
Haha! The kanji do look
pretty similar.
translations.もう、すっごく恥ずかしくって。顔真っ赤になっちゃった。:
Ugh, it was so embarrassing.
My face turned bright red.
translations.昔……小学生とか？ だったら読めなくても当然じゃないの？:
Like... elementary school？
Then it's no surprise you
couldn't read it.
translations.もうちょっと昔じゃないかな？:
Maybe a little less
long ago than that？
translations.もうちょっと……かな？:
Maybe a little more...
recent than that？
translations.そろそろ母の日だけど、なにを贈るか、考えてる？:
Mother's Day is coming up.
Have you thought about
what to get her？
translations.その顔。忘れてたでしょ？:
That look on your face.
You totally forgot,
didn't you？
translations.笑ってごまかそうとしてもダメです。ちゃんと感謝の気持ちを表さないと。:
Laughing it off won't work.
You need to properly show
your appreciation.
translations.何を贈ればいいのかわからないんだよね。こう、離れて暮らしてると、特にさ。:
I just don't know what
to get. Especially since
we live so far apart.
translations.それは気持ちの問題だと思うな。:
I think it's the thought
that counts.
translations.カーネーションに何かメッセージを一言添えるだけでも喜ばれると思うよ？:
I'm sure she'd be happy with
just a carnation and a
little message attached？
translations.そっか。何か考えてみるよ。:
Yeah. I'll try to think
of something.
translations.うん。喜んでもらえるといいね。: Yeah. I hope she likes it.
translations.うん。端午の節句だもんね。:
Yeah. It's for Children's Day,
after all.
translations.それそれ。あれって、葉っぱも食べるものなのかな？:
Right, right. Are you
supposed to eat the leaf
on those, too？
translations.私は……食べないけど。: I mean... I don't eat it.
translations.クラスで葉っぱも食べるって言い張る奴がいるんだよ。:
There's a guy in my class
who insists you're
supposed to.
translations.えー……あ、それもしかして桜餅と勘違いしてるんじゃない？:
Huh... Oh, maybe he's
confusing them with
sakura mochi？
translations.桜餅は塩漬けの桜の葉を使うから、食べる人もいるけど、柏餅の葉は普通食べないと思う:
Sakura mochi uses salted
cherry leaves, so some eat
them. But I don't think you
usually eat kashiwa leaves.
translations.へえ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って和菓子の知識もあるんだ。:
Wow. You even know a lot
about traditional sweets,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.知識ってほどじゃないよ……うーん、なんだか食べたくなってきちゃった。どうしてくれ:
I wouldn't call it a lot...
Mmm, now I kind of want
some. What're you gonna
do about it？
translations.あなたがお菓子の話なんかするからでしょ、もう！:
It's because you brought up
sweets in the first place,
jeez!
translations.何かプレゼントしないの？:
Aren't you going to get him
a present？
translations.まあ、ほら、離れて暮らしてるとさ。:
Well, you know, since we
live so far apart and all.
translations.離れてるからこそ、だと思うけどな？:
I think that's exactly why
you should get him
something？
translations.ジューン・ブライドの季節だね？:
It's the season for
June brides, isn't it？
translations.そっか。やっぱそういうの憧れるの？:
Oh, right. Is that something
you dream about？
translations.聞くまでもなく、当たり前。毎年６月になるたびに思ってるもん。いいなあ、憧れるなあ:
It goes without saying.
Every June, I find myself
thinking about it.
'How nice, I want that too.'
translations.どうかな、小学生になった頃にはもうそうだった気がする……もっと前からかな。:
Hmm, I feel like I was
already thinking that in
elementary school...
Maybe even earlier.
translations.そんなに小さい頃から？ ●はその頃なんて、結婚がなんなのかもわかってなかった気が:
Since you were that little？
I don't think ● even
knew what marriage was
back then.
translations.私もそんなに変わらないかも。きっとわかってなかったんだと思うな。今はもっと具体的:
I probably wasn't that
different. I doubt I really
understood it either.
It's much more concrete now.
translations.……歳もそうだけど、具体的になったのは……相手、かな。:
...Age is part of it, but
what became concrete is...
my partner, I guess.
translations.もうすっかり夏か。そろそろ冷房がないと厳しいね。:
It's full-on summer now.
It's getting pretty tough
without the AC.
translations.ただ、女の子にとっては頭を悩ませる季節でもあるのよね。:
But for girls, it's also
a season that causes a lot
of headaches.
translations.どこも冷房がよく効いてるでしょう？ あまり薄着だと、身体が冷えちゃうの。:
The AC is blasting
everywhere, right？ If we
dress too light, we end
up freezing.
translations.そっか、女の子にはそんな苦労もあるんだな。:
I see. Girls have to deal
with that kind of struggle,
huh.
translations.そう。薄着でラッキー、なんて単純なことじゃないんだから。:
Right. It's not as simple
as 'lucky, they're
dressed light'.
translations.えっ……うーん……それならギリギリＯＫ、かな。:
Eh... Hmm... I guess that's
barely acceptable, then.
translations.夏祭りには浴衣を着て、一緒に行きたいね。:
I want to wear a yukata and
go to the summer festival
together.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の浴衣姿か……いいよな、やっぱり。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a yukata...
Yeah, that's definitely
nice.
translations.浴衣って、そんなに鼻の下伸びるようなもの？ 可愛いとは思うけど。:
Is a yukata really something
that makes you drool that
much？ I mean, it's cute, but...
translations.ううん、すっごくだらしない顔してて……でも少し……。:
Uh-huh, you had a really
sloppy look on your face...
But it was a little...
translations.カワイかったかも▼:
Maybe it was a little
cute...▼
translations.（え……ちょっと複雑）:
(Uh... I have mixed feelings
about that.)
translations.最近一段と暑いよね。もう一歩も外に出たくなくなるよ。:
It's gotten even hotter
lately. I don't even want
to step outside anymore.
translations.でも冷房の効いた部屋の中にばかりいたら、冷房病になっちゃうよ。:
But if you stay cooped up
in the AC all day, you'll
end up getting sick.
translations.心頭滅却すれば火もまた涼し……な～んてね。:
Clear your mind, and even
fire will feel cool...
Just kidding.
translations.暑いのには変わりないけど、身体のためには設定温度を高めにするとか、工夫してるよ。:
It's still hot, of course,
but I try to set the temp
a bit higher for my health.
translations.そっか。●も少し気をつけた方がいいのかな……。:
I see. Maybe ● should
be a little careful too...
translations.そう。自律神経系はおかしくなったら、なかなか調子が戻らないから。:
Right. Once your autonomic
nervous system gets messed
up, it's hard to recover.
translations.そうなったら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と遊びにも行けなくなるし。:
If that happens, I won't be
able to hang out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ふふっ。調子いいんだから。:
Hehe. You sure know
what to say.
translations.でもそうね、あなた一人の体じゃないんだから。ね？:
But it's true, your body
isn't just yours anymore.
Right？
translations.ね。夏休みも終わりが近いけど、宿題はちゃんとやった？:
Hey. Summer vacation is
almost over. Have you been
doing your homework？
translations.バッチリ……と言いたいところだけど。:
I'd love to say I'm all
done, but...
translations.もうっ。ギリギリでやらない方がいいよ。:
Geez. You shouldn't leave it
until the last minute.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と遊ぶのが楽しすぎて……。:
I was having too much fun
hanging out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.言い訳は聞きません。でも……たしかに私の責任もあるか。:
No excuses. But... I guess
I'm partly to blame, too.
translations.冗談だって。宿題が残ってるのは、●の責任だから。:
I'm kidding. It's ●'s
fault you still have
homework.
translations.こういうときは、お姉さんがしっかり面倒見ないといけないんだけど……。:
This is when your big sister
should step in and make sure
you get it done, but...
translations.実は、私もぜんぜん終わってなくて……。:
Actually, I haven't finished
mine at all either...
translations.これもあなたのせい、だからね。:
And this is your fault,
too, you know.
translations.夏休み中、だらけてたんじゃない？:
Were you slacking off
during summer vacation？
translations.まだ生活リズムが戻らなくてさ。:
My sleep schedule still
isn't back to normal.
translations.早く夏休みボケを直さないと授業中に居眠りなんてことになっちゃうよ。:
Snap out of your summer daze
soon, or you'll end up
falling asleep in class.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はぜんぜん夏休みボケはなさそうだね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't seem to have
any summer daze at all.
translations.規則正しい生活を心がけてましたから。:
That's because I made sure
to keep a regular routine.
translations.生活リズムが乱れると、お肌に悪いし、普段から夜更かし厳禁。:
A bad sleep schedule is bad
for my skin, so staying up
late is strictly forbidden.
translations.この前、コンビニに行ったら、もう中華まんが売ってたよ。:
I saw steamed buns at the
convenience store the other
day. They're already out.
translations.食欲の秋ってことらしいけど、年々早くなってるような気がするな。:
Autumn is the season for
appetites, but it feels like
it comes earlier every year.
translations.……食欲の秋、か。もうそんな時期なのよね。:
...Autumn appetites, huh.
It's already that time
of year.
translations.ダイエットしようと思ってる女の子には、一番辛い時期なんだから。:
It's the hardest time of
year for girls trying
to diet.
translations.そっか。でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は今よりやせる必要ないと思うけど。:
I see. But I don't think
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ needs to lose
any weight.
translations.あなたがそう思ってくれてるのはうれしいんだけど……。:
I'm happy you think so,
but...
translations.やっぱりね、これはどちらかというと自分自身の問題なの！:
At the end of the day,
this is more of a personal
issue!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は気にしすぎだよなあ）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ worries about it
way too much.)
translations.ふふ、そろそろセールが始まる時期だからね。:
Hehe, it's almost time for
the sales to start.
translations.男の子だって、もっと好きになっていいと思うけど？:
I think boys should learn
to love them more, too.
translations.そうかもしれないけど、やっぱかなわないよ。会場は戦場なんて言う人もいるよね。:
Maybe, but we can't compete.
Some people even say the
venue is like a battlefield.
translations.私にはそこまでは無理かな。できるのはせいぜい、早くから並ぶくらい。:
I don't think I could go
that far. The most I can
do is line up early.
translations.並べるだけすごいよ。●なんか、行列見ただけであきらめそうだもん。:
It's amazing you can even
line up. ● would probably
give up just seeing the
line.
translations.女の子はきれいになるためには努力を惜しまないからね♪:
Girls will spare no effort
when it comes to being
pretty♪
translations.ねえねえ。気づいたら、商店街がすっかりハロウィンの飾り付けになってるの。:
Hey, look. The shopping
street is completely decked
out in Halloween
decorations.
translations.へえ。もうそんな時期なんだ。でも……はは。:
Wow. It's already that time
of year. But... haha.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が妙にはしゃいでるところが、ちょっと可愛かったから。:
It's just that it was kinda
cute seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ so excited.
translations.もうっ。私だってはしゃぐときくらいあるんだから。:
Geez. Even I get excited
sometimes, you know.
translations.もしかして仮装なんかもしてみたいとか？:
Are you thinking about
dressing up or something？
translations.そうね……ハロウィンなら魔女のコスプレなんかどう？:
Let's see... Since it's
Halloween, how about
a witch costume？
translations.絶対可愛い、見てみたいな。:
That'd definitely be cute.
I'd love to see it.
translations.ふふ。じゃあ……機会があったら、ね？:
Hehe. Well then...
If I get the chance, okay？
translations.並木道なんかを歩いてると、もうすっかり秋も終わりなんだなって思わない？:
When you walk down
tree-lined streets, doesn't
it feel like fall is over？
translations.この前、葉っぱが色づいたかと思ったら、気づけばもう散り始めか。:
Just the other day the
leaves were changing colors,
and now they're falling.
translations.もの悲しいけど、でも落ち葉に覆われた道もあれはあれでキレイよね。:
It's a little sad, but
a path covered in fallen
leaves is beautiful
in its own way.
translations.銀杏のにおいは、ちょっと厳しいときがあるけど。:
The smell of ginkgo nuts
can be a bit tough to
handle, though.
translations.もうっ！ デリカシーのない人は嫌いです。:
Geez! I don't like people
with no tact.
translations.せっかく人がロマンチックになってるのに。:
And here I was trying
to be romantic.
translations.ううん、好きよ？ 茶碗蒸しに入れたり、そのまま焼いて食べるのも。:
No, I like them？
In chawanmushi, or just
roasted on their own.
translations.そうね……あ、もう。そういう問題じゃなくて！:
I guess... Ah, geez.
That's not the point!
translations.そろそろ期末テストの準備、始めないとね。:
We should probably start
prepping for finals soon.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲でも期末テストの準備が必要なんだ？:
Even ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ needs to prep
for finals？
translations.それはもちろん。私、そこまで成績優秀じゃないよ？:
Of course. My grades aren't
actually all that amazing？
translations.そうだっけ。なんとなくそんなイメージがあるんだよね。:
Really. I just kind of had
that image of you.
translations.授業は結構真面目に受けてると思うし、ノートはしっかりとるし、宿題も……まあちゃん:
I take classes pretty
seriously, take good notes,
and... well, I do my
homework properly.
translations.優等生と成績優秀者は違うもん。:
Being an honor student
and getting top grades
are two different things.
translations.いざテストとなると、どうしてもね。なんでかなあ？:
When it comes to the
actual test, I just...
I wonder why？
translations.うーん、本番に弱いとか。:
Hmm, maybe you choke
under pressure.
translations.そういうことなのかな。うーん……。:
I wonder if that's it.
Hmm...
translations.そうね。編み物も本格的な冬には間に合わなかったみたい。:
Yeah. Looks like my knitting
won't be done in time
for real winter.
translations.ふふ。勘違いしないの。誰にもあげる予定なんてありません。:
Hehe. Don't get the
wrong idea. I'm not planning
to give it to anyone.
translations.だって大切な人にあげるときには、やっぱり喜んで欲しいもの。:
Because when I give
something to someone
special, I want them
to be happy with it.
translations.だから、うまく編めるように現在特訓中。:
So I'm currently training
hard so I can knit well.
translations.……ホッとした？ 上手くなったら、ちゃんと、ね？:
...Relieved？ Once I get
good at it, I'll make you
one, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の家って、大掃除の準備とかしてたりする？:
Are you getting ready for
the big cleaning at your
place, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そうね、できるとこから……っていう感じかな。:
Well, I guess I'm just
starting with what I can...
translations.へえ、実は意外と散らかってたりして？:
Oh？ Is it actually
surprisingly messy？
translations.もうっ。そんなことないから。:
Jeez. It's not like that
at all.
translations.そういうあなたはどうなの？ 普段見えないところの汚れ、大丈夫？:
What about you？ Are the
hidden spots in your
room doing okay？
translations.うちは……そこまでは酷くないと思うよ。:
My place... I don't think
it's that bad.
translations.でも、年の瀬にあわてて大掃除をするより、今から少しずつ整理しておいた方がいいと思:
But wouldn't it be better
to tidy up a little at a
time now, rather than
rushing at the end of
the year？
translations.お正月特番、見た？ 芸能人・新春ひみつ芸大会。:
Did you see the New Year's
special？ The Celebrity
Secret Talent Show.
translations.えー、そんなノリ？ 私なんて最初から最後まで見入っちゃって、ごはん食べるの忘れそ:
Aw, that's it？ I was so
glued to it from start
to finish that I almost
forgot to eat.
translations.そんなに好きなんだ、ひみつ芸。:
You really like those
secret talents, huh.
translations.うん、いつも楽しみにしてるの。毎年どんどん難易度の高い技に挑戦する人がいて、その:
Yeah, I always look forward
to it. Every year someone
tries an even harder trick,
and it just doesn't feel
like the new year until
I see it.
translations.ああ、いつも最後に出てくる芸人だろ？ わかるわかる。:
Oh, the comedian who always
comes on last, right？
I know what you mean.
translations.あとね、緊張してる新人さんを見ると頑張れ～って思うし、ドラマのわき役ばかりやって:
Plus, seeing nervous
rookies makes me want to
cheer them on, and seeing
actors who usually play
extras stand out makes me
feel like they've grown up
so much...
translations.ねぇ、おせち料理って子供には苦手なものが多いと思わない？:
Hey, don't you think a
lot of New Year's food
is hard for kids to eat？
translations.そうかもね。煮物とか酢の物とか。:
Maybe. Like the simmered
dishes and pickled stuff.
translations.私も小さい頃はあまり好きじゃなくて、ほとんど手をつけなかったの。そしたらお母さん:
I didn't really like it
when I was little either,
so I hardly touched it.
After that, my mom
stopped making it...
translations.ああ、そういうのあるかも。:
Ah, I can see that
happening.
translations.お雑煮は作るけど、おせちはなし。代わりに元旦の夜はいつも手巻きずしだったの。:
She'd make ozouni, but
no osechi. Instead, we
always had hand-rolled
sushi on New Year's Day.
translations.へぇ、それもいいな。●の周りもおせち食べないって人、多いよ。:
Oh, that sounds nice too.
A lot of people around
● don't eat osechi
either.
translations.私の代では、ちゃんと子供でも食べられるようなおせちに挑戦しようかな。:
Maybe when it's my turn,
I'll try making osechi
that even kids can enjoy.
translations.うん。もちろん、あなたの好みも考えるからね。:
Yeah. And of course,
I'll keep your tastes
in mind too.
translations.ねぇ、立春を過ぎると春が近づくって言うけど、実際はそんなことないよね。:
Hey, they say spring is
near once the first day
of spring passes, but
that's not really true,
is it？
translations.一応そういうことになってるらしいけど。:
I guess that's how it's
supposed to work, though.
translations.天気予報やニュースで、今日は立春です、なんて聞くとあったかくなるって期待しちゃう:
When you hear on the news
or weather forecast that
today is the first day of
spring, you expect it to
get warmer, right？
translations.もう春かーなんて思っちゃうよな、寒いのに。:
Yeah, you end up thinking
it's already spring,
even though it's still
cold.
translations.そうなの。３月の初めか、せめて２月の終わりくらいならわかるんだけど。:
Exactly. I'd understand if
it was early March, or at
least late February.
translations.立春って２月の初めだっけ？:
The first day of spring is
in early February, right？
translations.そうだよ。だから、もう春が近づいてるはずなんだけど……。:
Yeah. So spring is
supposed to be getting
closer, but...
translations.今年もぬか喜びか……。:
Premature excitement again
this year, huh...
translations.うん。寒いね……。ね、手にぎってもいい。:
Yeah. It's cold... Hey, can
I hold your hand？
translations.……あ、今立春の印象が少し良くなったかも。:
...Ah, my impression of
the first day of spring
might've just gotten a
little better.
translations.寒くないと思えば寒くないの。ほら、シャキッとしなさい？:
It's only cold if you think
it is. Come on, stand up
straight, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はしっかりしてるな。いつも思うんだけど、女子の制服って寒くない？:
You're so tough, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I always wonder though, aren't
girls' uniforms freezing？
translations.ううん。首元と腰回りをしっかり温めとけば、足出してても平気だよ？:
Nope. As long as you keep
your neck and waist warm,
bare legs are fine, see？
translations.でもなぁ、見てるこっちがなぁ……。:
I don't know, it makes me
cold just looking at them...
translations.そうやって他の子も見てるんじゃないでしょうね？ 寒そう、とか言って足をじーっと…:
You aren't looking at other
girls like that, are you？
Staring at their legs while
saying they look cold...
translations.まぁ、つい目がいくことは……。:
Well, sometimes my eyes
just wander...
translations.えっと、そんな変な意味じゃなくて！:
U-Um, I don't mean it in
a weird way or anything!
translations.知らない。: I don't want to hear it.
translations.（あああ、だから違うって……）:
(Agh, I said it's not like
that...)
translations.春分の日は毎年日付が変わるって知ってた？:
Did you know the date of the
vernal equinox changes
every year？
translations.２１日の時もあったよ。●もあれって思って調べたんだ。:
It's been the 21st before.
I figured you'd be curious
too, ●, so I looked it up.
translations.そうなんだ。どうして日付が変わるの？:
Is that so. Why does the
date change？
translations.……ごめん、調べたんだけど覚えてないや。なんかややこしくて。:
...Sorry, I looked it up,
but I forgot. It was
complicated.
translations.残念。そこでスラスラ答えられたら、カッコいいのにな～。:
Too bad. You would've looked
so cool if you could answer
that smoothly~.
translations.そうして素直に落ち込んじゃうあなたも、カワイイから好きよ▼:
But I love how you get so
honestly bummed out too.
You're so cute, ▼.
translations.大丈夫？ もしかして花粉症？:
Are you okay？ Do you have
hay fever or something？
translations.ううん、違うの。ちょっとムズムズしただけ。……っくしゅ！:
No, I don't. My nose just
tickled a little. ...Achoo!
translations.風邪じゃないか？ それか、やっぱり花粉……。:
Are you sure it's not
a cold？ Or maybe it is
hay fever...
translations.違うったら、絶対花粉症なんかじゃないんだから。まだ風邪のほうがマシ。:
I said no, it's definitely
not hay fever. I'd rather
it be a cold.
translations.そう？ その様子だと元気そうだし、どっちかっていうと花粉……。:
Really？ You seem pretty
energetic, so if anything
it's probably hay fever...
translations.もう、怒るよ？:
Jeez, I'm gonna get mad,
you know？
translations.花粉症は、自覚したら終わりって言うでしょ？ 一度なったら毎年続くんだよ？:
They say hay fever beats you
once you admit you have it,
right？ Once you get it, it
comes back every year!
translations.自覚とかそういう問題？:
Is it really a matter of
admitting it or not？
translations.そういう問題なの。毎年気付かないフリして乗り切ってるんだから。……っくしゅ！:
It is. I've been getting by
every year by pretending I
don't notice it. ...Achoo!
translations.ふふ。この時期はテレビが忙しくて。:
Hehe. TV keeps me pretty
busy around this time
of year.
translations.ああ、新番組？ なんか面白そうなのやってる？:
Ah, the new shows？ Is there
anything good on？
translations.それを探してる途中なの。特にドラマは１回目を逃すと大変でしょ？ 録画がたまっちゃ:
I'm in the middle of looking
for some. Especially with
dramas, it's awful if you
miss the first episode,
right？ My recordings are
piling up...
translations.うん。一応友達の評価も参考にするけど、やっぱり自分の目で確かめないと。１回目はい:
Yeah. I take my friends'
opinions into account, but I
have to see for myself. Even
if the first episode is meh,
the second might be good...
translations.それだと、結局ずっと見ちゃうんじゃない？:
If you do that, won't you
end up watching them all？
translations.さすがに３回見てつまらなかったらやめるよ？ ３回まで見て判断かな。:
If it's boring after three
episodes, I'll drop it.
Three is my limit.
translations.テレビっ子なの。見逃して悔しい思いするの、嫌だもの。:
I'm a TV addict. I just
hate the feeling of missing
out on something good.
translations.春はやっぱりお花見だよね。:
Spring is all about cherry
blossom viewing, right？
translations.そうだね。でも、そろそろ桜も散るんじゃない？:
Yeah. But aren't the cherry
blossoms about to fall？
translations.花は桜だけじゃないよ？ 菜の花とか、チューリップとか、タンポポとか、いろいろある:
Cherry blossoms aren't the
only flowers, you know？
There's canola flowers,
tulips, dandelions...
Lots of kinds.
translations.春が過ぎたらアジサイ、ひまわり、コスモス……。:
After spring, there are
hydrangeas, sunflowers,
cosmos...
translations.あれ？ 春はお花見って話じゃなかったっけ。:
Huh？ I thought we were
talking about spring.
translations.桜はなくてもお花見はできるって話。ね？:
I'm saying we can go flower
viewing without cherry
blossoms. Right？
translations.（要するに、いつでもデートしたいってこと？）:
(So basically, she just
wants to go on dates all
the time？)
translations.そろそろ夏の準備をしなくちゃ……。:
I should start getting
ready for summer soon...
translations.夏の準備？ 水着を出すとか？:
Ready for summer？
Like getting your
swimsuit out？
translations.もう。湿気対策をしなくちゃってこと。今のうちにやっておかないと、すぐカビだらけに:
Jeez. I mean dealing with
the humidity. If I don't do
it now, mold will grow
everywhere.
translations.ああ、梅雨はジメジメするしな。:
Ah, the rainy season is
pretty damp, huh.
translations.押し入れに湿気取りを置いたり、お風呂に防カビ剤を塗ったりしておくと後が楽なの。:
Putting dehumidifiers in
the closet and anti-mold
spray in the bath makes
things easier later.
translations.へぇ。●んちもやっといたほうがいいかな？:
Huh. Should ● do that
at home too, I wonder？
translations.もちろん。近いうちにいろいろ買いに行くつもりだから、やってあげようか？:
Of course. I'm going
shopping for supplies soon,
so want me to do it for you？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が？ うれしいけど……それは悪いよ。:
For ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I'd love that,
but... I'd feel bad.
translations.そう？ もう、遠慮なんてしなくていいのに。:
Really？ Jeez, you don't
have to hold back with me.
translations.そういえば、最近鯉のぼりってあんまり見ないな。:
Come to think of it, you
don't see koinobori much
lately.
translations.そうだね。ねぇ、ちょっと前までデキシーズでこどもの日フェアをやってたでしょ？ お:
Yeah. Hey, Dexee's was
having a Children's Day
fair recently, right？
With koinobori flags on
the kids' meals.
translations.ああ、ミニ鯉のぼりをおまけにつけたりしてたな。:
Ah, they were giving out
mini koinobori as a bonus.
translations.あれを見て、お母さんに質問してる子がいたの。これなあにって。:
I saw a kid asking their
mom about it. They were
like, 'What's this？'
translations.……ということは、鯉のぼりを知らない？:
...Which means they didn't
know what koinobori are？
translations.そうだったみたい。最近の子はそうなのかなぁ。:
Seems like it. I wonder if
kids these days are all
like that.
translations.へえ……そういう節句なんかは、子供に教えてあげてもいいと思うけどな。:
Huh... I think it'd be good
to teach kids about those
seasonal festivals, though.
translations.●も行事にそう詳しいわけじゃないけど、常識としてさ。:
● might not know much
about events either, but
it's just common sense.
translations.頼もしいなぁ。いいパパになりそうだね？:
How reliable. You'll make
a great dad, won't you？
translations.今ぐらいが一番昼の時間が長い時期だね。:
This is the time of year
when the days are longest.
translations.うん。夏はいつまでも明るいから、しょっちゅう門限を破っちゃって……。:
Yeah. It stays light out so
late in summer, I used to
break my curfew a lot...
translations.小学生の間は５時までに家に帰りなさいって言われてた。:
In elementary school, I was
told to be home by 5.
translations.へぇ、門限破ったら、やっぱり怒られたりした？:
Huh. Did you get yelled at
when you broke it？
translations.少しね。でも、ちゃんと謝ればすぐ許してくれたから。:
A little. But they'd forgive
me right away if I properly
apologized.
translations.男の子は大変なの？: Is it tough being a boy？
translations.大丈夫？ 具合悪いとか？:
You okay？
Are you feeling sick？
translations.ううん、そうじゃないの。ただね、ずっと低気圧が続くから身体が重くて。:
No, it's not that.
It's just, with this low
pressure system, my body
feels so heavy.
translations.ああ、梅雨だからな。……低気圧のせいなの？:
Ah, it is the rainy season.
...Is it really because of
the low pressure？
translations.うん。雨が降りそうな時とか降ってる時は、身体が重くなって頭がぼんやりすることがあ:
Yeah. When it's raining or
about to, my body gets heavy
and my head gets foggy.
Does that happen to you？
translations.ジメジメして気持ち悪いとは思うけど……。:
I mean, the humidity feels gross,
but...
translations.そうなんだ。友達にも低気圧の影響を受ける子結構いるけど、女子特有なのかなぁ。:
I see. A lot of my friends
are affected by low pressure
too. Maybe it's a girl thing？
translations.●の周りにそんな奴いたかな……。それ、病院に行かなくていいの？:
Is there anyone like that
around ●...? Are you sure
you don't need a doctor？
translations.天気のせいだし。なんとなくダルいだけだから。:
It's just the weather.
I just feel a little sluggish.
translations.……気のせいじゃなくて？:
...Are you sure it's not
just in your head？
translations.違います。あなたと違ってデリケートなんだから。:
It's not. Unlike you,
I'm actually delicate.
translations.ねえ、海の日って、なんなんだろうね。:
Hey, what do you think
Marine Day is all about？
translations.海と言えばやっぱり……。:
When you think of the ocean,
it's gotta be...
translations.そうじゃなくて……それも否定はしないけど。:
No, that's not it... Though I
won't deny it either.
translations.あ、今想像したでしょ。デレッとした顔してる。:
Ah, you just imagined it.
You've got a goofy look
on your face.
translations.してないよ！ ……ちょっとだけしたかも。:
No I don't! ...Okay, maybe
just a little.
translations.正直でよろしい。じゃあ海の家かな？ かき氷とか、焼きそばとか。:
I appreciate your honesty.
Then maybe beach houses？
Shaved ice, yakisoba...
translations.それもいいよな。でもさ、やっぱり海って言ったら……。:
That sounds good too.
But still, when you talk
about the ocean...
translations.んー、白い雲に青い空？ 眺めてると気分いいよね～。:
Hmm, white clouds and
blue skies？ It feels so nice
just looking at them~.
translations.わかるわかる。でも見るだけじゃなくて……。:
I get that. But it's not just
about looking...
translations.もちろん、波の音と潮の香りもいいよね。海風最高！ ね？:
Of course, the sound of
the waves and the smell of
the tide too. Sea breezes
are the best! Right？
translations.（泳ぎの話題を避けてるのかな……）:
(Is she trying to avoid
talking about swimming...?)
translations.どうしたの？ サラリーマンみたいなこと言って。:
What's wrong？ You sound like
a middle-aged office worker.
translations.えっ、そういうイメージ？: Eh, is that the image you get？
translations.違うの？ 会社の人たちが、お世話になってますってあちこちに贈り物してる感じがする:
Isn't it？ It feels like
company workers sending gifts
around to say 'thanks for
your support'.
translations.実際はそうかもしれないけど……。子供の頃はお中元って楽しみじゃなかった？ ジュー:
That might be how it
actually is... But weren't
summer gifts fun as a kid？
Like the juice boxes.
translations.そうなのかな？ うちではお中元のやりとりってそんなに記憶にないなぁ。:
Really？ I don't have many
memories of exchanging
summer gifts at my house.
translations.お父さんのお仕事によるんじゃないかな？ 年末のお歳暮なら、親戚同士でやりとりして:
I think it depends on
your dad's job. For year-end
gifts, it seems relatives
exchange them.
translations.お中元が楽しみなら、私から贈ってあげようか。ジュースセットがいいのかな？:
If you like summer gifts
so much, want me to send
you one？ Would a juice set
be good？
translations.えっ、いいよ。子供の頃の話だって。:
Eh, no thanks. I was talking
about when I was a kid.
translations.ふふ、今だって子供なんだから、変わらないでしょ？:
Hehe, you're still a kid
now, so nothing's changed,
right？
translations.もう残暑お見舞いかなぁ……。:
I guess it's time for late-summer
greeting cards...
translations.おじいちゃんとおばあちゃんにだけね？ いつも暑中お見舞いが届くから。:
Just to my grandpa
and grandma, though？
They always send me one.
translations.うん。季節の挨拶以外にも、誕生日カードを送ってくれたり。:
Yeah. Along with seasonal
greetings, they also send
me birthday cards.
translations.かわいがられてるんだな。:
They really dote on you,
huh.
translations.ふふ。でもね、孫は筆不精で、いつもお返事が遅れちゃうの。今から書くならもう残暑お:
Hehe. But their grandkid
is terrible at writing, so
my replies are always late.
If I write one now, it'll
be a late-summer greeting.
translations.そういうの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はマメにやってそうなのに。:
You seem like the type to
be on top of that stuff,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.マメなのはあなたにだけよ。あーあ、メールならパッと返信できるのになぁ。:
I'm only on top of things
when it comes to you.
*Sigh* If only I could just
shoot them a quick text.
translations.（今、さらっと嬉しいことを……）:
(She just casually said
something super sweet...)
translations.お盆の時期になると、怒られたことを思い出すなぁ……。:
Whenever Obon rolls
around, I remember this
one time I got scolded...
translations.知らないおじさん。すごい剣幕で遠くから走って来て、散々怒鳴られちゃった。:
By some old guy I didn't
know. He came running at
me looking furious and
yelled his head off.
translations.怖いな、それ……。何やったの？:
That's scary... What did
you even do？
translations.小学生の頃、近所の子たちと虫取りをしててね。赤とんぼがたくさん飛んでて、みんなで:
I was in elementary school,
catching bugs with the
neighborhood kids.
There were tons of red
dragonflies, so we caught
a whole bunch, and then...
translations.そう。ご先祖様が乗ってるっていうでしょ？ 私、その時に初めて知ったの。:
Right. They say our
ancestors ride them, right？
I didn't know that until
then.
translations.それで怒られたんだ。:
So that's why you got
scolded.
translations.うん。虫かごの赤とんぼを一斉に放して、みんなで何度もあやまったんだよ。ご先祖様ご:
Yeah. We let all the
dragonflies out of our
cages at once and
apologized over and over.
We were like, 'We're so
sorry, ancestors!'
translations.おじさんも怖かったけど、夜はもっと怖かったな。幽霊が出てきて怒られるんじゃないか:
The old guy was scary, but
nighttime was even worse.
I was terrified a ghost
would come scold me.
translations.はは、子供だもんな。:
Haha, well, you were just
a kid.
translations.だから今でも赤とんぼはちょっと苦手。かわいいとは思うんだけどね。:
So I'm still a little bad
with red dragonflies even
now. I do think they're
cute, though.
translations.もう秋なんだね。昼間はまだ暑いけど。:
It's already autumn, huh.
Even though it's still hot
during the day.
translations.夜に涼しい格好して寝ると、途中で寒くなって起きるんだよな。:
If I sleep in light clothes,
I end up waking up cold in
the middle of the night.
translations.ダメだよ、ちゃんとあったかくして寝ないと。風邪ひいちゃうよ？:
You can't do that. You need
to sleep warmly, or you'll
catch a cold, you know？
translations.でも寝る時は暑いんだよなぁ。:
But it's so hot when I first
go to bed.
translations.もう、心配だな。こんな時、一緒に住んでたらお布団かけてあげるのに。:
Jeez, you worry me. If we
lived together, I'd make
sure to tuck you in.
translations.そんなこと言って、●が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に布団かけてあげてたりして。:
You say that, but I bet
● would be the one
tucking ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in.
translations.私はそんなに寝相悪くありません。:
I don't toss and turn
that much in my sleep.
translations.●だって寝相悪いわけじゃ……。:
It's not like ● tosses
and turns either...
translations.そうなの？ ふーん、確かめてやるんだから。:
Is that so？ Hmm, I'll just
have to see for myself.
translations.９月は動物愛護週間があってね、あちこちでいろんなイベントをやるんだって。:
September is Be Kind to
Animals Week, so they hold
all sorts of events all
over the place.
translations.そうなんだ。どんなことやるんだろ。:
Oh, really？ What kind of
events do they have？
translations.イベントスペースで動物とのふれあい広場を開いたり、学校や老人ホームなんかに出張ペ:
Petting zoos in event
spaces, traveling pets
visiting schools and
nursing homes... All sorts.
translations.へぇ、詳しいな。:
Wow, you know a lot about
this.
translations.学校の掲示板にポスターが何枚も貼ってあるもの。見たことあるでしょ？:
There are tons of posters
on the school bulletin
board. You've seen them,
right？
translations.えっ？ ウサギに、ネコに、タヌキに、アルパカに……あんなにかわいい子たちを覚えて:
What？ The bunnies, the cats,
the raccoons, the alpacas...
You don't remember those
adorable little guys？
translations.うーん、ごめん。そんなにかわいいポスターなんだ？:
Uh, sorry. Are the posters
really that cute？
translations.それはもう、きゅるんってしてふわふわで……あ～、思い出しただけでかわいすぎる～▼:
Oh, they're so soft and
fluffy with big, round
eyes... Agh, just thinking
about them is too cute~
▼
translations.なあ、栗ってどうやって食べればいいと思う？:
Hey, what do you think is
the best way to eat
chestnuts？
translations.そうね、栗ごはんにしたり、湯がいてそのまま食べたり、甘露煮にしたり……いろいろあ:
Hmm, you could make
chestnut rice, boil them
to eat as is, or make
candied chestnuts...
There's lots of ways. Why？
translations.そんな季節だなーと思ってさ。:
Just thinking it's that time
of year, you know.
translations.じゃあなにか作ってあげようかな……。:
Maybe I'll make something
for you, then...
translations.お菓子もありかな。売り物みたいなモンブランは難しいけど、栗入りのパウンドケーキく:
Sweets could work, too.
A store-bought Mont Blanc
might be tough, but I could
make a chestnut pound cake.
translations.へぇ、すごいな。そういうのをスラスラ思いつくだけでもすごいよ。:
Wow, that's amazing.
Just coming up with that
so easily is impressive.
translations.ほめすぎだよ……。:
You're praising me
a little too much...
translations.いいのかな。なんかねだったみたいになっちゃったけど……。:
Is that okay？ I feel like
I kind of begged for it...
translations.ねだられるのも嬉しいし、作ってあげるのも嬉しいの。なにか考えておくね。:
I'm happy when you ask,
and I'm happy to make it
for you. I'll think of
something.
translations.体育の日は晴れることが多いって、ホントかな？:
Is it true that it's usually
sunny on Sports Day？
translations.じゃあ、体育の日を七夕にすれば、織姫と彦星は会う確率が上がるかもね。:
Then if we made Sports Day
into Tanabata, Orihime and
Hikoboshi might have a
better chance of meeting.
translations.はは。確かにそうだけど、七夕は７月７日じゃないと意味ないんじゃない？:
Haha. True, but doesn't
Tanabata have to be on July 7th
to mean anything？
translations.そうなの？ 体育の日は１０月１０日だったのが、１０月の第２月曜日に変わったよね？:
Does it？ Sports Day used to
be October 10th, but they
changed it to the second
Monday in October, right？
translations.それとこれとは違うと思うけど……多分。:
I think that's a bit
different... Probably.
translations.七夕が１０月で、体育の日が７月でもいいと思うけどな。:
I think it'd be fine if
Tanabata was in October and
Sports Day was in July.
translations.７月は運動するにはちょっと暑いんじゃないかな……:
July might be a little
too hot for exercising,
though...
translations.じゃあ、体育の日をなくして７月７日はラッキーセブンの日。１０月１０日は七夕でどう:
Then let's get rid of
Sports Day. July 7th can
be Lucky Seven Day.
October 10th is Tanabata.
How's that？ We don't need
Sports Day, right？
translations.これからもっと寒くなるんだな……。:
It's only going to get colder
from here on out...
translations.くっついてればあったかいよ？ ふふ。:
It's warm if we snuggle up,
you know？ Hehe.
translations.ずっとくっついてるわけにもいかないだろ？ 授業中とか。:
We can't be snuggled up
all the time, right？
Like during class.
translations.それはさすがに無理だけど……。でも教室はあったかいでしょ？:
Well, obviously we can't
do that... But the classroom
is warm, right？
translations.場所によるんだよなー。窓際とか結構すきま風入ってくるし。反対にヒーターの近くは暑:
Depends on where you sit.
It gets pretty drafty by
the window. But it's hot
near the heater.
translations.男の子は寒がりだし、暑がりだよね。こらえ性がないんだから。:
Boys are so sensitive to
both the cold and the heat.
You have no endurance
at all.
translations.今年の冬は、人間カイロが横にいるから安心だね。ほら、ポカポカだよ？:
This winter, you'll be fine
with a human heat pack right
beside you. See？ Nice and
toasty, right？
translations.もう、調子いいんだから。:
Jeez, you're such a smooth
talker.
translations.インフルエンザ予防接種のお知らせ、回ってきた？:
Did you get the notice about
flu shots？
translations.ああ。ホームルームでプリント配られた。:
Yeah. They handed out
printouts in homeroom.
translations.あれ、絶対にやらなきゃいけないのかな。:
Do we really have to get
them？
translations.絶対ってことはないだろうけど。注射苦手だっけ？:
I doubt it's mandatory.
Are you bad with needles？
translations.インフルエンザにかかる確率なんて、そう多くないと思うのよね。当日、風邪引いたフリ:
The chances of actually
catching the flu aren't that
high, right？ Maybe I'll just
pretend to have a cold on
the day of.
translations.受けたほうがいいよ。もしかかったら大変だろ。:
You should get it.
It'll be awful if you do
catch it.
translations.大丈夫、この勘は絶対当たる気がするの。ここは勝負するべきだと思うのよね。:
It's fine, I have a really
good feeling about this.
I think it's worth the
gamble.
translations.ふふ、違うったら。冬至の支度。当日はお風呂に柚子を入れて、かぼちゃを食べるんだよ:
Hehe, no. It's for the 
winter solstice. You put 
yuzu in the bath and eat 
pumpkin on the day, right？
translations.うん。昔の人が決めたことがずっと続いてるってことは、ちゃんと意味があるんだよ。だ:
Yeah. If something people 
decided long ago is still 
around, it must have a 
real meaning. So I want to 
cherish things like that.
translations.へぇ、なんかいいな。●もやろうかな……。:
Wow, that sounds nice. 
Maybe I'll try it too, 
●...
translations.やり始めると楽しいよ？ めんどくさがり屋の人には向かないかもしれないけど。:
It's fun once you start, 
you know？ Though it might 
not be for lazy people.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をマネすればいいんだから、簡単だよ。:
I can just copy you, 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so it'll be easy.
translations.もう、横着して。じゃあ、必要なこと教えてあげる。:
Geez, you're so lazy. 
Fine, I'll teach you 
what you need.
translations.年越しそばっていつも食べてる？:
Do you always eat 
toshikoshi soba？
translations.もしかして夕食代わり？ かき揚げ乗せたりしてボリュームたっぷりとか。:
Is it instead of dinner？ 
Like a big portion with 
kakiage on top？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は違うの？:
Is it different for you, 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うちはいつも夕食は普通で、おそばは年を越してから食べるの。１人分をみんなでちょっ:
We always have a normal 
dinner, and eat the soba 
after midnight. We share 
one portion between us.
translations.そうなんだ。じゃあ寝る直前に食べるってこと？:
I see. So you eat it 
right before bed？
translations.そうなるかな。年に１回のことだから、その日くらいいいかなって思うんだけど。:
I guess so. It's only 
once a year, so I figure 
it's fine for that one day.
translations.へぇ……。家によって色々あるんだろうね。:
Wow... I guess every family 
does it differently.
translations.そうだね。でもこだわりがあるわけじゃないから。２人で１番いい方法を見つけようね。:
Yeah. But I'm not super 
strict about it. Let's 
find the best way for 
the two of us.
translations.この間友達がさ、カノジョが束縛して困るって言ってた。:
A friend of mine was
saying his girlfriend is
too clingy and it's a pain.
translations.……困る、か……。\nやっぱり、あなたも束縛されたらイヤよね？:
...A pain, huh...
I guess you'd hate being
tied down too, right？
translations.そうだよね。\n……わたしも気をつけた方がいいのかな。:
I thought so.
...Maybe I should be
careful about that too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はそんなことないんじゃないかな。:
I don't think you're
like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ならいいけど……。\n……でもね、その彼女の気持ち、わかるな。:
That's good, then...
But you know, I get how
his girlfriend feels.
translations.女の子って、毎日不安でいっぱいだから。\n今日は電話が無かったとか、メールが来な:
Girls are full of anxiety
every single day.
Like, if he didn't call,
or didn't text...
translations.うーん……よし！ じゃあ、●も、もっとマメになるよ。:
Hmm... Alright!
Then I'll be more attentive
to you too, ●.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。\nだけど、無理しないでね。:
Hehe, thank you.
But don't push yourself
too hard, okay？
translations.不安になったり、悩んだりするのって、恋愛の醍醐味でもあるから。\nほら、付き合っ:
Getting anxious and
worrying is part of the
thrill of romance.
It makes it feel like
we're really dating, right？
translations.付き合うって、\nどういうことだと思う？:
What do you think it
means to date someone？
translations.急じゃないよ。\nわたしの今の研究課題。\nあなたは考えたことないの？:
It's not out of nowhere.
It's my current research
topic. Have you never
thought about it？
translations.じゃあ、質問を変えます。\nカノジョと女友達の差は？:
Then I'll change the
question. What's the
difference between a
girlfriend and a friend？
translations.そりゃ、付き合ってるのが\nカノジョで、他が友達だよ。\nだから……なんだろ？:
Well, a girlfriend is
someone you're dating,
and the rest are friends.
So... what is it？
translations.ほら、考えずには、\nいられなくなってきたでしょう？\nふふ、しっかり悩んで答え:
See, now you can't help
but think about it, can
you？ Hehe, think hard
and give me an answer.
translations.……？\n●には▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と\n他の人って区別しか\nないんだけどな……:
...？
For ●, the only
difference is between
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ and everyone else...
translations.（やった！ \nで、結局付き合うって\nどういうことなんだ……）:
(Yes!
But what does dating
actually mean in the end...)
translations.あ、シャツにシミがついてる。:
Ah, there's a stain on
your shirt.
translations.どこ……、ホントだ。食べこぼしかなあ。:
Where... Oh, you're right.
Must be from eating.
translations.これはなかなか落ちないかも。\nああ、私がそばにいて、見逃してたなんて。:
This might be tough to
get out. Ah, to think I
was right here and missed
it.
translations.うん、これからはあなたの服、私が洗濯してあげる。:
Yeah, from now on, I'll
do your laundry for you.
translations.いいって。そんなの悪いよ！:
It's fine. I'd feel bad
making you do that!
translations.どうして悪いの？\n付き合ってるんだから、当然でしょ？:
Why would you feel bad？
We're dating, so it's only
natural, right？
translations.うん、それとも洗濯物見られるの恥ずかしい？:
Yeah. Or are you
embarrassed to have me
see your laundry？
translations.（……付き合うって、すごいんだな）:
(...Dating is a pretty
big deal, huh.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、眠そうだけど大丈夫？:
You look sleepy, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Are you okay？
translations.……ごめん。\n昨日、なかなか寝付けなくって、睡眠不足気味なの。:
...Sorry.
I couldn't fall asleep
last night, so I'm a bit
sleep-deprived.
translations.●で良かったら話してよ。:
If you're okay with ●,
tell me.
translations.ありがとう。\nでもね……思い出せないの。:
Thank you.
But... I can't remember.
translations.……何を悩んでいたのか。\n違うのよ、冗談じゃなくて、本当に眠れないくらい悩んで:
...What I was worried
about. No, I'm not joking,
I was really worried enough
to lose sleep over it.
But then, one thing after
another kept popping into
my head.
translations.この前あなたに会ったとき、どの靴はいてたっけとか、占い見てないのに雑誌すてちゃっ:
Like what shoes I wore
when I saw you last, or
how I threw away a magazine
without checking my
horoscope... And then, I
forgot what I was worried
about in the first place...
translations.えっと、じゃあ特に悩み事は無いってこと？:
Um, so does that mean you

don't have any worries？
translations.ううん、それを思い出せないのが、今の悩み。:
No, my current worry is

that I can't remember it.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、いつもよりテンション高い？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you in a better

mood than usual？
translations.そうかな？ いつもと一緒だけど。あなたは、二人で一緒にいても楽しくないの？:
Am I？ I feel normal.

Aren't you having fun with me？
translations.そんな。●だって、楽しいよ。:
Of course I am.

I'm having fun too, ●.
translations.よろしい。\nふふ、でも本当はね、今日は特別。考え事がひとつ片付いたの。:
Good.

Hehe, but today is actually

special. I finally sorted

out something on my mind.
translations.へー、考え事ってなに？:
Oh？ What were you

thinking about？
translations.ダメよ、そんな簡単に女の子の考えてること、知ろうだなんて、甘い甘い。:
No way. You're too naive if

you think you can learn

a girl's secrets that easily.
translations.そういうもんか……。仕方ないな。:
Is that how it is...

Guess I'll let it go.
translations.ちょっと、まさか、それでおしまい？\n粘りが足りないんじゃない？:
Wait, you're just giving up？

Shouldn't you be a little

more persistent？
translations.男の子って、何考えてるか、すぐわかるよね。:
It's so easy to tell what

boys are thinking.
translations.どうしてって、今、言ってたよ？:
What do you mean？

You just said it out loud.
translations.やだ。声出ちゃってた……。: Oh no. I said it out loud...
translations.……あのね、ダイエット中なのに、友達に誘われたの、ケーキバイキング。どうしようか:
...Well, I'm on a diet, but

my friend invited me to a

cake buffet. I'm so torn.
translations.ははっ、別に行ってくれば、いいじゃん。: Haha, why don't you just go？
translations.簡単に言わないの！ 女の子にとっては大問題なんだよ……うう……やっぱりダメっ！:
Don't say it like it's easy!

It's a huge deal for girls...

Ugh... I really shouldn't!
translations.そうか、じゃあ、我慢――: I see, then you should just—
translations.そうだよね、我慢は良くないよね。やっぱり、行ってくる。:
You're right, holding back

isn't good. I'm gonna go.
translations.（そっち？ ……ほんと、女の子って何考えてんだろ）:
(That's your takeaway？

...I really don't get girls.)
translations.ねぇ……教えて欲しいことがあるんだけど、いい？:
Hey... there's something I

want to ask you. Is that okay？
translations.ええっと、あなたがこれまでに、一番ドキドキしたのって、どんなとき？:
Um, when was the time your

heart pounded the most？
translations.ドキドキ？ うーん、やっぱり▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に告白されたとき、かな。:
Pounded？ Hmm, probably when

you confessed to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あ、だめ。\nそれ以上言ったら、私がドキドキしちゃうから、ね……。:
Ah, stop.

If you say any more, my

heart will start pounding...
translations.はは……。\nでも、なんでそんなこと知りたかったの？:
Haha...

But why did you want to know？
translations.あのね、カレシは常にドキドキさせるのが大事って聞いたから。でも私のほうがドキドキ:
Well, I heard it's important

to always keep your boyfriend's

heart racing. But it seems

mine is the one racing now.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどういうときにドキドキする？:
When does your heart pound,

▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.急にどうしたの？ 何か企んでるでしょ？:
Why the sudden question？

You're scheming something,

aren't you？
translations.それって……？ \nもしかして……。:
Wait, does that mean...？
Could it be...
translations.あのね、私、校内新聞の取材を受けたの。:
Hey, I was interviewed
for the school paper.
translations.毎月、掲示板に貼りだされる、あれ？:
The one they put up on
the bulletin board？
translations.うん、３年女子の代表として答えて欲しいって、頼まれて。:
Yeah. They asked me to
answer as a rep for the
3rd-year girls.
translations.「女の子がドキドキするとき。女子の本音特集！」だって。:
"When Girls' Hearts Race:
A Feature on Girls'
True Feelings!"
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の本音かぁ。楽しみだな！:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s true feelings, huh.
I can't wait to read it!
translations.ふふ、私の特集のわけないでしょ。女子のだよ。:
Hehe, it's not a feature
on me. It's on girls.
translations.え？ ……でも、その取材には▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が女子を代表して答えたんだよね？:
Huh？ ...But you answered
as the representative for
the girls, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん、私は匿名だし、写真もないから。\nあ……。:
Yeah, but I'm anonymous
and there's no photo.
Ah...
translations.だめ！ 絶対見ちゃだめだからね。約束よ。:
No! You absolutely can't
look at it. Promise me.
translations.ちょっといい？ あなたは、ドキドキするのと安らぐの、どっちが好き？:
Hey, can I ask you
something？ Do you prefer
excitement or comfort？
translations.そうだな、●は安らぐ方かな……今はなんとなく。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
Hmm, I guess for ●,
it's comfort... at least
for now. What about you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私も一緒。やっぱり穏やかな気持ちでいたいな。:
Same here. I want to feel
calm and peaceful.
translations.でも、自分じゃなくて、彼女をドキドキさせたいってのはあるかも。:
But I think I'd rather
make my girlfriend's
heart race than my own.
translations.そう、なんだ……。\nドキドキもいっぱいあるよね。怖いのとか、びっくりとか……恥:
I see... There are lots
of ways to make a heart
race. Like fear, or
surprise... or even
embarrassment.
translations.●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の恥ずかしいドキドキが見たい。:
● wants to see your
embarrassed side, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.変な想像してるでしょう。ダメだよ。:
You're imagining something
weird, aren't you？ No way.
translations.ねえ、あなたは私に秘密にしてることない？:
Hey, are you keeping any
secrets from me？
translations.ホントに？ まあいいでしょう？:
Really？ Well, I guess
that's fine.
translations.ふふ、気になる？ 彼氏のウソを見抜く方法、クラスの子に教えてもらったの。それをち:
Hehe, curious？ A girl in
my class taught me how to
spot a boyfriend's lies.
I just wanted to test it...
translations.ふふっ、なんで固まってるの？ \nいいじゃない誰にも秘密くらいあるでしょ。でもウ:
Hehe, why did you freeze
up？ It's okay, everyone
has secrets. But lying is
a no-no.
translations.なあ。その方法、●にも教えてくれない？:
Hey. Won't you teach that
method to ● too？
translations.残念でした。これは“彼氏の” ウソを見抜く方法だよ。:
Too bad. This is a method
for spotting a boyfriend's
lies.
translations.ねえ、ちょっとお願い。\n私の目を見て。:
Hey, do me a favor.
Look into my eyes.
translations.私の目に映ったあなたが見える？:
Can you see your reflection
in my eyes？
translations.んっ……紹介するね、彼が私の大好きな人なの。:
Mhm... Let me introduce
you. He's the person I
love the most.
translations.ふふっ、どう、素敵な告白でしょ？\n大好きなシーンなの。:
Hehe, isn't that a lovely
confession？ It's my
favorite scene.
translations.映画かなにか？\nドキドキしたよ。:
From a movie or something？
My heart skipped a beat.
translations.やった！ 成功ね。\n本当にかわいい告白でしょ？:
Yay! It worked.
It's a really cute way to
confess, isn't it？
translations.うん、そうだな。\n……でも、●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲からしてもらった告白の方がいいな。:
Yeah, I guess so.
...But ● likes the
confession from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ better.
translations.……。\nもう、ずるいよ、急にそんなこと言って。\n……私がドキドキしちゃうじゃ:
...Jeez, that's not fair,
saying that out of nowhere.
...Now you've got my
heart pounding.
translations.あのね、あなたに嬉しい報告があるの……。:
Hey, I've got some
happy news for you...
translations.うん、最近ね、お客様に年相応に見られるようになったの。:
Well, lately, customers
have been seeing me
as my actual age.
translations.へー、そうなんだ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が嬉しいなら、●も嬉しいよ。:
Oh, really？ If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is happy,
then ● is happy too.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。\nでも、私が変わったとしたら、それはあなたのせいだと思う。\:
Hehe, thanks.
But if I've changed,
I think it's your fault.
Because we're always
together.
translations.そうなのかな……？ \nじゃあ、●も周りから見ると何か変わった？:
You think so...?
Then, does ● look any
different to other people？
translations.うん、頼もしくなったよ。\n……あ、そうか。:
Yeah, you've gotten
more reliable.
...Ah, I get it.
translations.ふふ、ううん。\n今、わかっちゃったの。だって、私が年相応に見えてきて、あなたが:
Hehe, nothing.
I just figured it out.
I'm looking my age, and
you're looking more
reliable... See what I mean？
translations.そういえば、最近、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と別のシフトに入ること、多いような……？:
Come to think of it,
haven't I been scheduled on
different shifts from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
translations.あれ、もしかして、今頃気づいたの？ 遅い。私は気になって、店長に確認したくらいだ:
Oh, are you just now
noticing that？ So slow.
I was so curious about it,
I even asked the manager.
translations.そうだったんだ。で、なんだって、店長。:
Oh, really.
So, what did he say？
translations.うん。やっぱり、意図的に別にしてる日があるって。:
Yeah. It turns out he's
intentionally scheduling us
separately on some days.
translations.なんで？ ふたりでいると、怠けてるって思われてるとか？ 仕事中は私語とかしてない:
Why？ Does he think we're
slacking off together
or something？ We don't chat
while working.
translations.その逆みたい。私と一緒に仕事するより、私がいないときに、あなたにホールの責任者と:
Actually, it's the opposite.
Rather than working with me,
he wants you to take charge
of the floor when I'm not
there. He may not look it,
but he really watches his
staff.
translations.そうだったのか……ああ見えて。でも、別々じゃ、一緒の店で働いている意味ないな……:
Is that so... He doesn't
look it. But if we're
separated, there's no point
working at the same place...
translations.ほんと、あなたのせいだよ。\nあなたがどんどん仕事できるようになっちゃったから。:
Honestly, it's your fault.
You've gotten too good at
your job. How are you
going to make it up to me？
translations.ええ！ そんなこと言われても……。:
What! Even if you say
that...
translations.……な～んて。\nちゃんと店長に言っておいたから、大丈夫。\nなるべく、ふたり一:
...Just kidding.
I already talked to the
manager, so it's fine.
He said he'll put us on the
same shift when possible.
translations.このごろ、バイト、すごくがんばってるね？:
You've been working really
hard at your part-time job
lately, haven't you？
translations.そうかな？ \nでも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には全然かなわないよ。:
You think so？
But I still can't hold a
candle to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.どうして？\n私はもちろんだけど、お店のみんな、あなたのこと、すごく評価してるよ:
Why not？
Not just me, but everyone
at the restaurant really
values you.
translations.そりゃ嬉しいけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲みたいに、お客様に好かれたり、覚えられるようになる:
I'm glad to hear that, but...
Getting customers to like
and remember me like they
do ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I feel like hard
work alone isn't enough.
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。でも、気づいてないの？ あなたがお目当でお店に来てる女の子もい:
Hehe, thanks. But haven't
you noticed？ There are girls
who come to the restaurant
just to see you.
translations.こーら！ そこに反応しないの。\nほら、週末の夕方に、お母さんと一緒にくる子。:
Hey! Don't get all excited
about that. You know, the girl
who comes with her mom on
weekend evenings.
translations.あの、ランドセルしょった……:
You mean the one with
the elementary school
backpack...
translations.ふふ、分かり易い反応。\nでも、ちょっと心配かな、将来有望かもしれないし。:
Hehe, you're so easy to
read. But maybe I should be
a little worried. She might
be quite a catch in the
future.
translations.この前、廊下で会ったとき、変な雰囲気になっちゃって、ごめんね。:
Sorry things got so awkward
when we bumped into each
other in the hallway the
other day.
translations.……ああ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の友だちに冷やかされたとき。気にしてないよ。:
...Oh, when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friends
were teasing us. I don't mind.
translations.それに、お互い様じゃない？ ●が友だちと一緒のときに、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に会っても、あ:
Besides, it goes both ways,
right？ When ● is with
friends and runs into ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
it gets just as awkward.
translations.うーん、私たちまでギクシャクしちゃうのよね。:
Yeah, it even makes things
awkward between us.
translations.うん、なんかやたら視線感じるし。:
Yeah, I always feel like
everyone is staring at us.
translations.みんな、私たちがふたりのとき、どんな感じかとか考えてるのかも……。:
Maybe everyone is wondering
what we're like when it's
just the two of us...
translations.ああ、こんな話しちゃったら、もっと意識しちゃうね。:
Ah, talking about it just
makes me even more
self-conscious.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の周りって、たくさん人がいるよな。:
There are always so many
people around ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh.
translations.やっぱり？ 最近すごく増えた感じがするでしょ。\nでね、その理由がわかったの。知:
I knew it？ You feel like it's
increased a lot lately, right？
I found out why. Wanna know？
translations.こないだ紹介された子がいるんだけど、その子が言うには、私は成功事例なんだって。:
I met a girl recently,
and according to her,
I'm a success story.
translations.金９ドラマの「1こ下の彼」って知ってる？:
Do you know that Friday 9pm
drama, 'A Year Younger'？
translations.友だちが話してるの聞いたような……。:
I think I've heard my friends
talking about it...
translations.私も観てないんだけど、タイトル通りの内容でね。みんなそのカップルに憧れてるみたい:
I haven't seen it either, but
it's just like the title.
Everyone admires that couple.
So, they're interested in us.
translations.……もしかして、●のこと、色々聞かれたりする？:
...Do you get asked a lot
of things about ●？
translations.そんな心配そうな顔して……大丈夫。いつもの私たちのこと、話してるだけだから。:
Don't look so worried...
It's fine. I just talk about
our usual selves.
translations.最近お店の控え室で、ふたりきりの時間、多いと思わない？:
Don't you think we've had a
lot of alone time in the break
room at work lately？
translations.でしょう？\nふふ、実はこの間、偶然聞いちゃったんだ、あの子たちが話してるとこ。:
Right？ Hehe, I actually
overheard the other girls
talking the other day.
translations.できるだけ、私たちを一緒の休憩にできるように、補充やゴミ出しのタイミングを考えて:
They timed the restocking
and trash duty so we could
take our breaks together.
translations.へー、なんか嬉しいな。ちょっと照れくさいけど。:
Oh, that's kinda nice.
A little embarrassing, though.
translations.でも、それだけじゃないの……、常連のお客様にも私たちのこと話してるみたい。:
But that's not all...
They've been talking about us
to the regulars, too.
translations.どうしよう、お客様から、とわの市の全体に広がっちゃったら……:
What if it spreads from the
customers to all of
Towano City...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、楽しそうに見えるけど……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems to be
enjoying it, though...)
translations.あのね、この前友だちに、遊園地に誘われたの。:
Hey, a friend invited me to
the amusement park the
other day.
translations.うん、でも……あなたも一緒にって。:
Yeah, but... they said
you should come, too.
translations.そう、ダブルデートっていうの？ どう思う？:
Yeah, a double date, I guess？
What do you think？
translations.ダブルデートか……\nたまには、他のカップルを見るのもいいのかも。:
A double date...
Maybe it's good to see other
couples once in a while.
translations.あのね、その子も同じ事言ってたの。他のカップルを見るのもいいって。\nそれって、:
You know, she said the same
thing. That it's good to see
other couples. That means
we'll be observing each other,
right.
translations.普段の私たちを見せるのって……、勇気がいるな。:
Showing our usual selves...
takes some courage.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がそうなら、やめとこっか。\n乗り気になったとき、こっちから誘えばい:
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ feels that way,
let's pass. We can invite them
when we feel up to it.
translations.そうね、ありがとう。\n私はずっとふたりでいいかも知れないな。:
Yeah, thanks.
I might be fine with just the
two of us forever, honestly.
translations.新しいアルバイトの子が決まったみたいね。:
Looks like they hired a new
part-timer.
translations.……\nなんでウキウキしてるのかな？\nかわいい女の子だといいなって、思ってるん:
...
Why are you so excited？
You're hoping it's a cute
girl, aren't you？
translations.性別は関係ないよ。\nほら、なんか転校生が来るみたいな。:
Gender doesn't matter.
It's just like when a transfer
student comes.
translations.でも、残念でした。うちのお店に付き合ってる人がいるんだって。:
But, too bad for you. She's
dating someone at our shop.
translations.残念じゃないって！\n……で、誰と付き合ってるの？:
I said it's not too bad！
...So, who is she dating？
translations.じゃなくて、キッチンの子みたいね。:
Just kidding, it seems to be
a guy from the kitchen.
translations.ふふ、デキシーズの先輩カップルとして、ちょっと気になっちゃうな。:
Hehe, as the senior couple
at Dexy's, I can't help
but be a little curious.
translations.ねえ、男の子も他のカップルが気になったりする？:
Hey, do guys ever get
curious about other couples？
translations.うーん、●はそれほど……。\nなんで？:
Hmm, ● doesn't really...
Why do you ask？
translations.女の子は気になっちゃうのよね。仲良しなカップルがいると、負けてなるものか！ って:
Girls just can't help it.
When we see a close couple,
we think 'I won't lose!'.
translations.ふふ、そう。あんまり見過ぎて、目が合っちゃったりすると、お互い意味もなく会釈した:
Hehe, yeah. If we stare too
much and make eye contact,
we just nod at each other
for no reason. It's funny.
translations.ははっ、そんなことしてるんだ。\n●は、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲しか見てないからわかんなかっ:
Haha, so that's what you do.
● only has eyes for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
so I had no idea.
translations.あ、ずるいんだ。\nあなたばっかりいい子で。:
Ah, no fair.
You're always playing
the good boy.
translations.いい子ですから！: Because I am a good boy!
translations.はいはい。じゃあ、いい子いい子してあげる。:
Yes, yes. Then I'll give
the good boy some pats.
translations.あれ、周りなんか気にならないんでしょ？\nほら、もっとこっちに来ないと、よしよし:
Oh, I thought you didn't
care about the people
around us？ Come closer,
or I can't give you your
pats. Hehe.▼
translations.（……絶対、他のカップルに負けてないと思う）:
(...I'm absolutely sure we
aren't losing to anyone.)
translations.長く付き合ってると、色んな経験ができるんだね。:
When you're together a long
time, you get to experience
all sorts of things.
translations.んー、そうだな。これまでだって、色んなことしたよな。:
Hmm, yeah. We've already
done so many things
together.
translations.そうね、でも、なかなかできないこともあるの。\n……朝ごはん。:
True, but there are still
things we can't easily do.
...Like breakfast.
translations.あ、うん。お昼はお弁当を作ったり、夜は一緒に食べたりできるけど……ほら、朝ごはん:
Yeah. I can make you lunch,
and we can eat dinner
together, but... breakfast
is a bit difficult, right？
translations.いつか毎日一緒に食べられるようになるかな……。:
I wonder if we'll be able
to eat it together every
day sometime...
translations.うん、そうね。なるよね。ありがとう。:
Yeah, you're right. We will.
Thank you.
translations.この間ね、クラスの子たちに、ベテランカップルなんて言われたの。:
The other day, my classmates
called us a veteran couple.
translations.●たち？ \n……そこまで長いかな？:
You mean us, ●？
...Have we really been
together that long？
translations.でもね、一番長く付き合った期間が、１ヶ月なんて子もいたから。:
Well, one of them said their
longest relationship was
only a month.
translations.ふーん、そりゃそうか。:
Hmm, I guess that
makes sense.
translations.それでね、長いとか短いとか、話してたら急に怖くなってきちゃった。\nだってそれっ:
And, you know, talking about
long or short relationships
suddenly made me scared.
Because that implies there's
an end, right？
translations.言われてみればそうだよな。:
Now that you mention it,
yeah.
translations.私はそんなこと考えられないけど、あなたは？:
I can't even imagine that,
but what about you？
translations.もちろん、●だって。\nなんだったら、一生でも。:
Of course ● can't either.
I'd be fine with forever.
translations.ははっ、そう。\n健やかなるときも、病めるときも――:
Haha, exactly.
In sickness and in health—
translations.その命ある限り。\n……\nこの続きは、いつか、ね。:
As long as we both
shall live.
...
We'll save the rest
for later.
translations.最近思うの。いつの間にあなたといるのが、自然になったのかなって。:
I've been thinking lately.
When did being with you
become so natural？
translations.いつってのは難しいな。:
It's hard to say
exactly when.
translations.会ったばかりの頃は、ぎこちなかったり、うまく気持ち伝えられなかったり、色々あった:
When we first met, we were
awkward and couldn't express
our feelings well... We went
through a lot, didn't we？
translations.あの頃のじれったい感じも、よかったね、今思うと。:
Looking back, that
frustrating feeling wasn't
so bad either.
translations.やっぱり●は今の方がいいな。:
I think ● prefers how
things are now, though.
translations.違うのよ、私だって今の方がいいの。でもね、ちょっと前の自分たちなのに、かわいく思:
No, I prefer how things are
now too. But don't you think
our past selves were cute？
It makes you want to cheer
them on.
translations.そうだな、あの頃の●たちに頑張ってもらわないと、今がないから。:
True. If the past us, ●,
hadn't tried our best, we
wouldn't have the present.
translations.あ、そんなＳＦ映画ありそうね。\n遠い未来の私たちが、今の私たちを応援してくれて:
Ah, I bet there's a sci-fi
movie like that. Like our
far-future selves are
cheering us on right now.
translations.遠い未来の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か、どんな……:
The far-future ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh...
I wonder what you'll...
translations.こら、変な想像しないこと。:
Hey, don't go imagining
anything weird.
translations.ねぇ、歯磨き粉はどういうの使ってる？:
Hey, what kind of toothpaste
do you use？
translations.ドラッグストアに行ったら、すごく気になる歯磨き粉があったの。:
I saw this really interesting
toothpaste when I went
to the drugstore.
translations.試してみようかなぁ。それとも……。:
I wonder if I should try it.
Or maybe...
translations.試してもらおうかな？: Maybe I should have you try it？
translations.ねえ、アボカド味の歯磨き粉の話、覚えてる？:
Hey, do you remember what
I said about the avocado
toothpaste？
translations.ドラッグストアで見つけた話。前に……あ、忘れたフリ？:
The one I found at the drugstore.
Before... Ah, are you
playing dumb？
translations.やっぱりそうだ。心配しなくてもいいよ。自分で試したから。:
I knew it. Don't worry.
I tried it myself.
translations.そうなの？ なんだ、ごめんごめん。: You did？ Oh, sorry about that.
translations.……もう、簡単に引っかかっちゃって。嘘です、まだ買ってません。:
...Jeez, you fell for that
so easily. I'm lying,
I haven't bought it yet.
translations.そんなにイヤだったんだ。当たり前かぁ。:
You really didn't want to try it.
Makes sense, though.
translations.あのさ。アボカド歯磨き粉の話って、どうなった？:
Hey. Whatever happened with
that avocado toothpaste？
translations.あ。私の言ったこと、覚えてたんだ。えらいえらい。:
Ah. You remembered what I said.
Good boy.
translations.実はね。まだ買ってないの。もう１個、気になるの見つけちゃって。:
Actually, I haven't bought it yet.
I found another one
I'm curious about.
translations.一度に買うのは勇気がいるから、どっちにしようか迷ってるところ。:
It takes courage to buy both
at once, so I'm debating
which one to get.
translations.ああ、前に言ってた……炒りゴマじゃなくて、そっちにしたんだ。:
Ah, the one you mentioned
before... You chose that
over the sesame.
translations.うん、こっちの方が怖いもの見たさっていうコンセプトに合うかなって。:
Yeah, I figured this one fit
the concept of morbid
curiosity better.
translations.はは、そんなコンセプトだったんだ。で、どうだったの？:
Haha, so that was the concept.
So, how was it？
translations.あれを使うくらいなら、本物で歯磨きするほうがいいな。:
I'd rather brush my teeth
with a real avocado
than use that.
translations.うん。アボカドの悪いところを最大限に活かしました、っていう味。:
Yeah. It tasted like they
maximized all the worst
parts of an avocado.
translations.興味あるなら、使ってみる？ 私は結局一度しか使ってないから、たくさん残ってるよ？:
Want to try it if you're curious？
I only used it once,
so there's plenty left.
translations.うん。友だちがカレシとケンカしたみたいで……巻き込まれちゃった。:
Yeah. A friend got into a fight
with her boyfriend...
and I got dragged into it.
translations.巻き込まれたって……大丈夫？: Dragged into it... Are you okay？
translations.うん……。ケンカの原因……なんだと思う？:
Yeah... What do you think
caused the fight？
translations.目玉焼きにかけるのはソース？ しょうゆ？:
Sauce or soy sauce
on fried eggs？
translations.ね？ 何がきっかけでケンカになるかわからないから……気をつけないとね。:
Right？ You never know what'll
start a fight, so...
we should be careful.
translations.目玉焼きにかけるものでケンカした友だちの話、したでしょ？:
Remember my friend who fought
over fried egg toppings？
translations.うん、聞いた。まさか……またケンカしたとか？:
Yeah, I remember.
Don't tell me...
they fought again？
translations.当たり。今回の理由はなんだと思う？:
Bingo. What do you think
the reason was this time？
translations.はずれ。夜、寝るときに真っ暗にするかしないか。:
Nope. Whether to sleep in
pitch black or not.
translations.うん。本人たちにとっては大事なことらしいの。:
Yeah. Apparently it's a
big deal to the two of them.
translations.へえ、他のカップルのことはよくわかんないな。:
Huh, I really don't get
other couples.
translations.ね、私たちはそんなことでケンカしないもんね。:
Right？ We'd never fight
over something like that.
translations.……で、あなたはどっち派？ ケンカにはしないから、言ってみて？:
...So, which side are you on？
We won't fight over it,
so tell me？
translations.（ここは黙っておいた方がいい気がする……）:
(I feel like I should
probably stay quiet here...)
translations.うん、ソースとしょうゆの……。: Yeah, the sauce and soy sauce...
translations.ああ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の友だちのカップルか。:
Oh, you mean ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friend
and her boyfriend.
translations.そうそう。今はラブラブ期らしいんだけど。:
Right. Apparently they're
in their honeymoon phase
right now.
translations.うん、でもいつ何がきっかけでケンカが始まるかと思うと、気が気じゃなくて。:
Yeah, but I'm on edge
wondering what'll start
their next fight.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は心配性なんだよ。本人たちは意外と楽しんでるんじゃない？:
You worry too much, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
They're probably enjoying it.
translations.う～ん、そうかも。私がオロオロするの面白がってたりしたら、許さないんだから。:
Hmm, maybe. If they're just
enjoying watching me panic,
I won't forgive them.
translations.でもその友だちの気持ち、ちょっと分かるかも。:
But I think I might
understand how your
friend feels.
translations.えっと……さあ、なんとなく？:
Uh... I don't know,
just a hunch？
translations.もう、お姉さんをからかわないの。:
Jeez, don't tease
your big sister.
translations.そういやさ。寝るとき真っ暗にするかしないかって話……。:
By the way. About whether
to sleep in pitch black
or not...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどっち派なの？: Which side are you on, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.あれ？ 言わなかったっけ。: Huh？ Did I not tell you？
translations.うん。どっち？ って聞かれたけど。:
Yeah. You asked me
which side I was on, but...
translations.どっちでも平気ってこと。: It means I'm fine with either.
translations.この前お買い物に行ったときにね、ポイントカードを忘れて、損した気分になっちゃった:
When I went shopping
the other day, I forgot my
point card and felt like
I missed out.
translations.あるある。その時に限って、金額が多かったり。:
That happens. And it's
always when you're
spending a lot, too.
translations.そう、やっぱりカードは全部持ち歩こうかな。:
Yeah, maybe I should just
carry all my cards with me.
translations.やっぱり多い？ 減らしたほうがいいかなぁ。:
Is that a lot? Maybe I
should cut down on them.
translations.（減らすのは難しそうだなあ）:
(Doesn't look like she'll
be able to cut down...)
translations.そういえば、ポイントカードどうなった？ 全部持ち歩いてるの？:
By the way, what happened
with the point cards? Are
you carrying them all?
translations.そうしてたんだけど……かさばっちゃってダメ。お財布が大変なことになっちゃって。:
I tried, but... they're too
bulky. My wallet became a
total disaster.
translations.みんなどうしてるんだろ？:
I wonder what everyone
else does?
translations.結構悩んでる人多いんじゃないかな、そういうの。地道に使う店を減らすしかないかも。:
I think a lot of people
struggle with that. You
might just have to narrow
down where you shop.
translations.でも少しでもいいお買い物したいし。ほら、生鮮品が安いお店、日用品が安いお店、あと:
But I want to get the best
deals. Like, one store has
cheap produce, another has
cheap daily goods, and
there are sale days... I
can't just pick one!
translations.へえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はいい主婦になるな。:
Wow, you're gonna make a
great housewife, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そう、かな……。いい主婦って、どう思う？:
You... think so? What do
you consider a good
housewife?
translations.●はいいと思うよ。色々考えてやり繰りするのって。:
I think you're great,
●. You really think
things through and manage
well.
translations.そっか、うん！ それなら、このままでも……いいかな。:
I see, yeah! In that case,
I guess things are fine as
they are...
translations.（最初の問題は全然解決していないけど……ま、いいか）:
(That doesn't solve the
original problem at all,
but... oh well.)
translations.ポイントカードのこと、前に相談したじゃない？:
You know how I asked you
about my point cards
before?
translations.友だちにも聞いてみたんだけど、３０枚は持ちすぎだって。:
I asked my friends, and
they said thirty is way
too many.
translations.あまり行かないお店から、抜いていくってのはどう？:
How about taking out the
ones for places you don't
go to much?
translations.そうね。一年以上行ってないお店のは、お家に置いておこうかな。:
Good idea. I'll leave the
ones for stores I haven't
been to in over a year at
home.
translations.うん。もっと長く行ってないところの方がいい？ ２年とか？:
Yeah. Should I make it
longer? Like two years?
translations.２年!! それは確実に持ち歩かなくていいと思うよ。:
Two years?! You definitely
don't need to carry those
around.
translations.（ほとんど、有効期限が切れてそうだな……）:
(I bet most of them are
already expired...)
translations.相談したポイントカードのこと、あなたの言うとおりだった。:
About those point cards...
you were totally right.
translations.うん。それに、結構有効期限が切れてるカードもあったから。:
Yeah. Plus, a lot of them
were actually expired.
translations.やっぱり……。そんなことだと思ったよ。:
I figured... I had a feeling
that might be the case.
translations.ううん。物持ちがいいのって、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしくて、いいよな。:
No. Taking good care of
things is very you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I like it.
translations.なんか上手いこと言ってるけど、本当かな？:
That sounds like a smooth
line. Do you really mean
it?
translations.本当だよ、物持ちがいいのも、節約家なのも。:
I do. I like that you take
care of things and that
you're thrifty.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲みたいな奥さんなら、安心だな。:
Having a wife like you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, would be really
reassuring.
translations.（ただ、お小遣いも節約されそうだけどな）:
(Though she'd probably be
thrifty with my allowance,
too...)
translations.どんなの作ってるの？:
What kind of accessories
are you making？
translations.天然石を使ったブレスレットとか、ネックレスとか。けっこう楽しいよ。:
Bracelets and necklaces
using natural stones.
It's pretty fun.
translations.へーっ。見てみたい！:
Oh wow.
I wanna see them!
translations.えっと、ごめんね。今は手元に残ってないの。友だちが欲しいって言うから。:
Um, sorry. I don't have
any on me right now.
My friends wanted them.
translations.あげちゃったのか、しょうがないな。:
You gave them away？
Well, can't be helped.
translations.うん、それをつけたら成績が上がったとか、告白がうまくいったとか。ちょっとスゴイこ:
Yeah, they say their grades
went up, or their confessions
succeeded. It's kinda crazy.
translations.そうやってみんなは言うんだけど……。ただの普通のアクセサリーなんだけどな。:
That's what everyone says...
But they're just normal
accessories, really.
translations.じゃあ、試しに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が自分で身につけてみたら？:
Then why don't you try
wearing one yourself, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.自分で作ったものは自分で実験？:
Experiment on myself
with my own creations？
translations.じゃあ、試してみよっかな。: Maybe I'll give it a try.
translations.前に言ってた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の幸運アクセサリー、どう？:
How's that lucky accessory
you mentioned before, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.効果検証中だったんだけど、また友だちにあげちゃった。:
I was testing its effects,
but I gave it to a friend.
translations.お茶したときに、パッと見て“それいいね、ちょうだい！”って。いいねって言われると:
We were having tea, and she
took one look and said,
"That's nice, I want it!"
When they say that, I just
wanna give it to them.
translations.そっか……じゃあ効果検証は無理か。:
I see... Guess testing
the effects is impossible.
translations.だって、身につけてたら、きっとみんな褒めてくれるだろ？:
I mean, if you wear it,
everyone's gonna compliment
it, right？
translations.じゃあさ、同じ物を何個か作ってみれば？ そうすればしばらくはもつかも。:
Then why not make a few
of the same thing？ That way
they might last a while.
translations.そういえば幸運のアクセサリーは？:
By the way, how are those
lucky accessories？
translations.うん、あれはねもういいの。作ったけど……また、あげちゃったから。:
Yeah, about those... I made
some, but I gave them
away again.
translations.何個か作るって言ってたよね？:
Didn't you say you were
going to make a few？
translations.そっか……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、お願いされると断れないもんな。:
I see... You really can't
say no when asked, huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.それに、途中からあげなくなったら、不公平になっちゃうでしょ？:
Besides, it'd be unfair if
I suddenly stopped giving
them out, wouldn't it？
translations.なるほど……でもさ、あげてばっかりだと材料費もばかにならないんじゃない？:
Makes sense... But if you
keep giving them away, won't
the material costs pile up？
translations.請求するわけにもいかないしね。:
And I can't exactly
charge them for it.
translations.でも好きでやってたことだし。効果の真偽はわからないけど、みんな喜んでくれたから、:
But I did it because
I like it. I don't know if
they really work, but
everyone was happy,
so it's fine.
translations.（うん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が幸せならそれでいいか……）:
(Yeah, as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is happy, I guess it's fine...)
translations.そういえば……最近ね、アクセサリーのお礼って、みんながお菓子とか手作りの小物とか:
Come to think of it...
lately, everyone's been
giving me sweets and
handmade trinkets as thanks.
translations.あ、ってことはまた御利益があったってこと？:
Oh, does that mean they
brought good luck again？
translations.そんな、大げさだよ。確かに……、みんな願い事が叶ったって言ってるけど。:
That's exaggerating. Though...
they did say their wishes
came true.
translations.すごいな。やっぱり、自分の分も作ったら？:
That's amazing. You really
should make one for yourself.
translations.ううん、いいの。ちょっと私も考えたんだけど、特に私、お願い事ないから。:
No, it's fine. I thought
about it, but I don't really
have any wishes right now.
translations.うん、だって今のままで幸せだし。あんまり欲張ると、ほら、だいたいこういう話のオチ:
Yeah, because I'm happy
as I am. If you get too
greedy, well, these stories
usually end with the greedy
person failing, right？
translations.確かに、昔話の定番かも。:
That's definitely a classic
fairytale trope.
translations.でしょ？ だから私はいいの。だって、今の幸せを手放したくないもの。:
Right？ So I'm good.
I don't want to let go of
the happiness I have now.
translations.うん、●も。今のままがずっと続けばいいや。:
Yeah, me too, ●.
I hope things stay just
like this forever.
translations.ねぇ、ちょっと前から回転ずし、流行ってるよね？:
Hey, conveyor belt sushi
has been pretty popular
lately, hasn't it？
translations.商店街や駅の近くで看板をよく見るから。:
I've seen a lot of signs
for them around the station
and shopping street.
translations.そういえば、何件か新しいの見かけるな。:
Now that you mention it,
I have seen a few new ones.
translations.でしょ？ やっぱり日本人はお寿司が好きなんだね。:
Right？ I guess Japanese
people really do love sushi.
translations.うん。少し固めに握った、お酢の利いたご飯だといいな。:
Yeah. I like it when the
rice is packed a bit firm
and has a good vinegar kick.
translations.へえ、こだわりがあるんだ？:
Oh, so you're pretty
particular about it？
translations.ちょっとね。ご飯が甘すぎたり、べちょっとしてたりすると、あーあって思っちゃう。:
A little. If the rice is
too sweet or mushy,
it's just a letdown.
translations.ネタの味を損なわない程度に酸味が利いてて、食べにくくない程度に握られて……。:
It needs enough acidity to
not ruin the topping, and be
packed just right to eat...
translations.（ちょっとどころか、すごくこだわってるかも）:
(That's not just a little.
You're super particular...)
translations.駅の近くに、また新しい回転ずし屋さんができたみたい。:
Looks like another new
conveyor belt sushi place
opened near the station.
translations.すごく人が並んでて、何かと思って見てみたら、新しい回転ずし。:
There was a huge line, and
when I looked to see what
it was, it was a new place.
translations.並んでるの、小さい子供がいる家族連れが多かったよ。:
Most of the people in line
were families with little
kids.
translations.そっか。子供にとってもファストフードよりは、体にいいかもしれないな。:
Makes sense. It's probably
healthier for kids than
regular fast food.
translations.じゃあ、私たちの子供はファストフードの代わりに回転ずしだね。:
Then our kids will have
conveyor belt sushi instead
of fast food.
translations.回転ずしって、やっぱり人気あるんだな。:
Conveyor belt sushi really
is popular, isn't it.
translations.うちのクラスにも、ファミレス代わりに利用する奴、結構いるみたいだから。:
A lot of people in my class
seem to use them instead
of family restaurants.
translations.うん……。うちの近所も、ファミレスだったところが回転ずしになったんだよね。:
Yeah... A family restaurant
in my neighborhood actually
turned into a sushi place.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、そのうちデキシーズも……。:
I see. Then maybe Dexee's
will eventually...
translations.はは、それはないか。うち、結構流行ってるしな。:
Haha, probably not.
We're doing pretty well.
translations.なくなったりしないよ、絶対。:
It'll never disappear.
I'm sure of it.
translations.あなたに出会った、思い出の場所だもの。なくなるなんて、私……。:
It's where we first met.
It's full of memories.
