If it disappeared, I'd...
translations.あ……ごめんね、暗くなっちゃって。いいの、気にしないでね。:
Ah... sorry for getting so
gloomy. It's fine, don't
worry about it.
translations.そうだ、この前は無神経なこと言って、ごめん。:
Oh, right. I'm sorry for
being so insensitive the
other day.
translations.デキシーズに代わって回転ずしが、とか。:
About Dexee's being replaced
by a sushi place.
translations.ああ……。やだ、もしかして気にしててくれたの？:
Ah... Oh no, were you
worrying about that？
translations.そりゃ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を悲しませたんだし。:
Well yeah, I made you sad,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.でもね、あの後思ったの。形がなくなっても、思い出はそのまま残るじゃないって。:
But I thought about it
later. Even if the place is
gone, our memories remain.
translations.そう。私たちが変わらない限り、ね？:
Right. As long as we don't
change, that is.
translations.なんて、ちょと不吉なこと言っちゃった。店長が聞いたら泣いちゃうかも。:
Listen to me, saying such
ominous things. The manager
might cry if he heard me.
translations.ヤケ酒ってどんな味なのかな。:
I wonder what stress drinking

tastes like.
translations.普通のお酒と味が変わるのかな？:
I wonder if it tastes

different from normal alcohol？
translations.酒の味自体わからないからな……。何か嫌なことでもあった？:
I don't even know what normal

alcohol tastes like...

Did something bad happen？
translations.ううん、単なる興味。よくね、ドラマなんかでそういうシーンがあるでしょ？:
No, just curious. You see

scenes like that in dramas

a lot, right？
translations.ヤケになって飲む酒だから、美味くはないと思うけど。:
You're drinking out of

desperation, so I doubt

it tastes very good.
translations.でも、ヤケになってる時にわざわざ美味しくないものを飲んだりする？:
But would you go out of your

way to drink something gross

when you're already upset？
translations.……ん？ 本当は美味しいけどヤケになってるから不味く感じるんじゃないか？:
...Hm？ Maybe it's actually

good, but being upset makes

it taste bad to them？
translations.じゃあ、ヤケ珈琲とかヤケミルクでもいいの？:
So, would stress coffee or

stress milk work too？
translations.別に構わないと思うけど……。ヤケ酒が美味しいかどうかの話だったよね？:
I guess that'd be fine...

Weren't we talking about if

stress drinking tasted good？
translations.あ、そうそう。でも、お酒が飲めるようになるまで、きっとわからないよね。:
Ah, right. But I guess we

won't know for sure until

we're old enough to drink.
translations.ねぇ、ヤケ食いって楽しいよね？:
Hey, stress eating is fun,

isn't it？
translations.ヤケ酒の話の続き？:
Is this a continuation of the

stress drinking talk？
translations.うん。お酒はわからないけど、食べ物のことならわかるから。:
Yeah. I don't get alcohol,

but I definitely understand

food.
translations.前も聞いたけど、何か嫌なことがあったわけじゃないんだよな？:
I asked this before, but...

nothing bad actually

happened, right？
translations.それがね、限定コスメを友達と買いに行ったら、私たちの目の前で売り切れちゃったの。:
Well, my friend and I went

to buy some limited-edition

cosmetics, and they sold out

right in front of us.
translations.もうガッカリしちゃって、こうなったらヤケ食いしようって、ファミレスに行くことにな:
We were so bummed out, we

decided to go to a family

restaurant and stress eat.
translations.うん、すごく。だから、ヤケ酒もきっと楽しいし、美味しいんじゃないかなって思ったの:
Yeah, super fun. So I figured

stress drinking must be fun

and tasty too.
translations.（それとこれとはちょっと違う気もするけど……どうなんだろ）:
(I feel like those are two

different things...

but who knows.)
translations.甘酒をたくさん飲んだらヤケ酒になるのかなぁ。:
I wonder if chugging amazake

counts as stress drinking.
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、まさかヤケ酒に憧れてるなんて言わないよな？:
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, don't tell me you're

actually admiring the idea of

stress drinking？
translations.えっ、どうして？: Huh, why do you say that？
translations.この前から妙にこだわってる気がするから……。:
You've just been weirdly

fixated on it lately...
translations.もしかして、心配させてる？: Oh, was I making you worry？
translations.ごめんごめん。実はね、大人の気持ちを理解するのが課題なの。:
Sorry, sorry. The truth is,

my current assignment is to

understand how adults feel.
translations.友達との課題。大人じゃないとわからないシチュエーションをどこまでリアルに想像でき:
It's with my friends. We see

how realistically we can

imagine situations only

adults understand.
translations.お弁当の時間によく話すんだけど、ヤケ酒については全然理解できないんだ。今の、一番:
We talk about it at lunch,

but I just don't get stress

drinking. It's my hardest

assignment right now.
translations.（……女子の遊びって不思議だ）:
(...Girls have weird ways of

having fun.)
translations.この前言ってた課題って、他にどんなのがあるの？ 友達とやってるっていう……。:
What other assignments do

you have like the one you

mentioned？ The one with

your friends...
translations.大人シチュエーション？ そうね、つい最近話したのは、上司と部下の板挟み、かな。:
Adult situations？ Let's see,

recently we talked about

being caught between a boss

and a subordinate.
translations.そこから発展して、リストラにあったサラリーマンの気持ち。:
And from there, we moved on

to the feelings of a

laid-off salaryman.
translations.あ、なんだか興味ないみたい。:
Ah, you don't seem very

interested.
translations.そんなことないって。女子の妄想力は逞しいなって思ってただけ。:
That's not true. I was just

thinking about how wild girls'

imaginations can be.
translations.逞しいよ？ 例えば、あなたと私が大人になったら……。:
It is, you know？ Like,
if you and I were adults...
translations.続きは大人になってから教えてあげる▼:
I'll tell you the rest
when we're adults.▼
translations.今度ね、デキシーズでブログを始めるんだって。:
Dexy's is going to start
a blog soon.
translations.そう。店長がね、親しみやすいお店になればって。:
Yeah. The manager wants
to make the shop feel
more approachable.
translations.でも、ああいうのって管理とか大変なんじゃない？:
But isn't managing stuff
like that a lot of work？
translations.うん……私もそう思ったんだけど、なんとなく引き受けちゃった。:
Yeah... I thought so too,
but I somehow ended up
taking the job.
translations.もう、そんなにびっくりして。私が引き受けたのは、文章を書くだけだよ。ご心配なく。:
Geez, don't look so
surprised. I only agreed
to write the posts.
Don't worry.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のブログか……、人気出そうだな）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s blog, huh...
I bet it'll be popular.)
translations.この前言ってた、デキシーズのブログだけど、評判いいみたい。:
That Dexy's blog I
mentioned before seems
to be doing really well.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が書いてるんだよな？:
You're the one writing
it, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん、原稿はね。でもブログのタイトルは“デキシーズ店長日記”になったから。:
Yeah, the drafts. But
the blog is titled
'Dexy's Manager Diary'.
translations.え？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って店長じゃないよな？:
Huh？ But you're not
the manager, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.店長はすぐ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に頼るからな。:
The manager's always
relying on you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.心配してくれてるの？ ありがとう。でもね、私も楽しんでるから。:
Are you worried about me？
Thanks. But I'm actually
having fun with it.
translations.うん。お客様からのコメントがあると、うれしいし。:
Yeah. It makes me happy
when customers leave
comments.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が楽しいならいいか）:
(Well, as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is having fun.)
translations.この前ね、ブログを見て、お店に来たってお客様がいたの。:
The other day, a customer
came in saying they read
the blog.
translations.お店に来てくれたのはうれしいんだけどね。そのお客様が、“店長さんどこ？”って。:
I was happy they came,
but then they asked,
'Where's the manager？'
translations.まさか、店長目当てってこと？:
No way, they came for
the manager？
translations.ブログを読んで、ファンになったらしいの……。店長がすごく困ってた。:
Apparently they read the
blog and became a fan...
The manager was so lost.
translations.はは、困った店長見たかったな。:
Haha, I would've loved to
see the manager like that.
translations.たしかにちょっと面白かったけど……でも、お客様にも悪い気がするから、ちょっと店長:
It was a little funny,
but... I feel bad for the
customer, so I'll talk
to the manager.
translations.うん、何かあったら●も協力するから。:
Yeah. I'll help you out
too if anything happens,
●.
translations.店長から聞いたけど、ブログ閉鎖するんだって？:
I heard from the manager,
but you're closing
the blog？
translations.うん、もともと期間限定だったし。:
Yeah, it was only for a
limited time anyway.
translations.ちゃんと店長が引き次いで、やってもらえばよかったのに。:
The manager really should
have just taken it over.
translations.店長はもう少し続けようか、なんて言ってたんだよ。:
The manager actually said
we should keep it going
a little longer.
translations.じゃ、店長が閉鎖させたんじゃないの？:
Then it wasn't the manager
who closed it？
translations.だって、正式にウェイトレスブログにしようって言うから。:
Because they wanted to
make it an official
waitress blog.
translations.……まあ、人気は出るだろうけどね。:
...Well, I'm sure it would
be popular.
translations.そのために制服のデザインも変えるとか……。なにやらされるのかわかんないし、閉鎖で:
He even talked about
changing the uniform
design for it... I don't
know what he'd make me
do, so I figured closing
it was for the best.
translations.そういえばこの間、クラスの女子が、セールセールって騒いでた。:
Come to think of it,
the girls in my class were
making a fuss about a sale.
translations.女の子は買い物好きだからね。:
Well, girls do love
to shop, you know.
translations.私だって、女の子なんですけど……。:
I'm a girl too,
you know...
translations.ごめん、ちょっと意地悪しちゃった♪:
Sorry, I was just teasing
you a little bit♪
translations.（セールの話は……まあいいか）:
(I guess the sale talk
is over... Oh well.)
translations.この間友だちと、セールにいってきたんだけどね。:
I actually went to a sale
with my friends the other
day, though.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もやっぱり、好きなんだ。:
So you really do like
them too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そうね。「お買い得！」とか、「限定！」とかに弱いかも。:
I guess so. I might have a
weakness for things like
'Bargain!' or 'Limited!'
translations.で、何かいいものあった？:
So, did you find
anything good？
translations.みんなはお気に入りを見つけてたけど。:
Everyone else found
some things they liked.
translations.実はその前に通販でたくさん買い物をしちゃったから、我慢したの。:
I actually bought a bunch
of stuff online right before
that, so I held back.
translations.そう、面白いんだよ？ カタログ見ながら、あれこれ想像するの。ただそのときは……。:
Yeah, it's pretty fun,
you know？ I look through
catalogs and imagine all
sorts of things. But then...
translations.想像だけで済まなかったか。:
You couldn't stop at
just imagining it.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、何を買ったんだろ？）:
(I wonder what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
ended up buying？)
translations.この前言ってた、通販の話だけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は何買うの？:
About that online shopping
you mentioned before, what
do you usually buy, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.んー、じゃあ、クイズ。はいっ。:
Hmm, let's make it a quiz.
Here we go.
translations.うーん、なんだろ、アクセサリーとか？:
Hmm, what could it be...
Accessories or something？
translations.ブー！ そういうものは手にとって選びたいでしょ？:
Bzzzt! Don't you want to
pick those out in person？
translations.そっか……うーん……わかんない、降参。何？:
Right... Hmm... I have
no idea. I give up. What？
translations.もう？ うん……あのね、この前はお茶碗、お箸、それとパジャマ。:
Already？ Okay... Well,
last time it was rice bowls,
chopsticks, and pajamas.
translations.ずいぶん生活感あるね。なんで通販で？:
That's pretty domestic.
Why buy that online？
translations.夫婦グッズ特集をやってて、それを見てたら……。:
They were doing a feature
on married couples' goods,
and looking at it made me...
translations.あっ、ううん！ その特集を見てたら欲しくなっただけで、実際買ったのは、自分の分だ:
Ah, no! Looking at the
feature just made me want
them. I only actually bought
them for myself, okay？
translations.通販、まだ続いてる？:
Are you still doing that
online shopping？
translations.そんなに利用してるわけじゃないよ。最近は眺めてるだけ。:
I don't really use it
that much. Lately I've just
been window shopping.
translations.じゃあ最近眺めたのは？:
So what have you been
looking at lately？
translations.気になるって。じゃあ、またクイズ？:
Now I'm curious. So, is it
quiz time again？
translations.ううん……きっと、絶対わからないと思うから。:
No... I'm sure you'd never
guess it in a million years.
translations.へえ、気になる！ なんなの？:
Whoa, now I really want
to know! What is it？
translations.あ、ごめん、溜息ついて。……あのね、スケジュール帳を落としたみたいなの。:
Ah, sorry for sighing.
...You see, I think I dropped
my planner somewhere.
translations.うん。この前行ったカフェがあやしいんだけどね。てっきりバッグの中にあると思ってた:
Yeah. I suspect I left it
at that cafe I went to
the other day. I was so
sure it was in my bag...
translations.場所わかってるなら、探しに行く？:
If you know where it is,
want to go look for it？
translations.ううん。お店には電話もして探してもらったんだけど……。:
No... I called the shop
and asked them to look
for it, but...
translations.そのまま交番にも届けたんだけど。おまわりさんは見つからないかもって……。:
I went ahead and reported
it to the police box, too.
The officer said it might
not turn up, though...
translations.ドジやっちゃったなあ。しょうがないから、新しいの買おうかな。:
I really messed up.
I guess I have no choice
but to buy a new one.
translations.そっか……見つかるといいな……。:
I see...
I hope you find it...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、スケジュール帳はでてきた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did your planner
ever turn up？
translations.ううん、ダメみたい。気にしてくれてありがとう。:
No, it doesn't look like
it. Thanks for worrying
about me.
translations.交番のおまわりさんが、近くのお店にも聞いてくれたみたいなんだけど。:
It seems the officer at
the police box even asked
the nearby shops for me.
translations.へー、警察ってそこまでしてくれるんだ。:
Wow, I didn't know the
police would go that far.
translations.うん、すごく親身になってくれて。:
Yeah, he was really kind
and helpful.
translations.そのおまわりさんって、若い人？:
Was this police officer
a young guy？
translations.え？ ううん、結構年配の男性だったけど、どうして？:
Huh？ No, he was an older
gentleman. Why do you ask？
translations.ならいいんだけど。ちょっと……なんとなく。:
Then it's fine. Just...
wondering, I guess.
translations.あ、まさか嫉妬してるの？ せっかく厚意で探してくれてるのに、ダメよ、そんなの。:
Oh, are you jealous？
He was just being nice
and looking for it.
You can't be like that.
translations.だって、「好き」の方の好意かもしれないだろ。:
Well, maybe it was 'nice'
as in he liked you.
translations.こーら、そんなにカワイイこと言わないの▼:
Hey now, don't say such
cute things, ▼
translations.スケジュール帳、新調したよ。同じデザインのものが見つかったから。:
I got a new planner.
I managed to find one
with the exact same design.
translations.そっか、しょうがないね。同じのってことは、前の気に入ってたんだ。:
I see. Well, if you got
the same one, you must've
really liked the old one.
translations.うん。デザインもそうだけど、思い入れもあったから。でもしょうがないよね。私の不注:
Yeah. The design, but it
also had sentimental value.
But it can't be helped.
It was my own carelessness.
translations.……こうなったらもう、前のは絶対どこにも出てきて欲しくないな。:
...Now that it's come to
this, I really hope the old
one never turns up anywhere.
translations.実はね……日記代わりにもしてたから。もし、誰かに見られたらって思うと、気が気じゃ:
Actually... I was using it
as a diary, too. The thought
of someone seeing it had
me worried sick.
translations.……でも、もういいの。新しいスケジュール帳に、新しい思い出を書き込んでいけばいい:
...But it's fine now.
I can just write new
memories in my new planner.
translations.この間ね、スケジュール帳が見つかったの。:
Hey, my planner turned up
the other day.
translations.うん、その日寄ったカフェのオーナーさんがね、私が取りに来ると思って保管してくれて:
Yeah, the owner of the cafe
I stopped by that day held
onto it, thinking I'd come
back.
translations.でも、私のうっかりで色々な人に迷惑かけちゃった。反省だね。:
But my carelessness ended
up bothering a lot of
people. I really need to
reflect on that.
translations.そんなに落ち込むことないよ。見つかったんだからさ。:
Don't be so down about it.
At least you found it.
translations.……うん。でもね、そのスケジュール帳は使わないで、新しい方を使うことにしようと思:
...Yeah. But you know,
I think I'm going to use
the new one instead of
the old one.
translations.だって、その間だけでも、もうあなたとの新しい思い出が書き込んであるから。古い方に:
After all, even in that
short time, I've already
written down new memories
with you. I want to make
just as many as before.
translations.この間ね、店長が、新しいサービスとはなんだろう……って悩んでたの。:
The other day, the manager
was stressing over what a
'new service' should be...
translations.へー、店長もそんなこと考えるんだ。:
Huh, even the manager
thinks about stuff
like that.
translations.きっと、私たちの分からない苦労もあるのよ。たぶん。:
I'm sure he has struggles
we don't know about.
Probably.
translations.もしかして、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。また、なんか頼まれた？:
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Did he ask you to do
something again？
translations.ただ、私たちになにかできるかなって思っただけ。:
I just wondered if there
was anything we could do
to help.
translations.ほんと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、困ってる人ほっとけないんだな。:
You really can't ignore
someone in trouble,
can you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私はデキシーズが大好きなだけ。だって、私たちが出会ったお店なんだから。:
I just really love Dexee's.
After all, it's the place
where we first met.
translations.そうだな。●たちにできること、何かあるかな。:
Yeah. I wonder if there's
anything ● can do to help.
translations.デキシーズの新サービスの話だけど、何か良いアイデア出た？:
About that new service
for Dexee's... Did you come up
with any good ideas？
translations.店内の装飾とか食器を季節に合わせられたらステキだな……って。でも大変よね。:
It'd be nice to match the
decor and tableware to the
seasons... but that'd be a
lot of work.
translations.確かに、大がかりだな。やっぱり最大のサービスは値引きなんだろうけど。:
Yeah, that's a big task.
I guess the best service
would be a discount, but...
translations.それも、難しそうね。:
That seems like it'd be
difficult, too.
translations.うーん、お客様に喜んでもらうのって、難しいのね。:
Hmm, it really is hard to
figure out how to make
customers happy.
translations.●は、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の笑顔で十分だと思うけどな。無料だし。:
● would be perfectly
happy with just ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s smile.
Plus, it's free.
translations.それじゃダメだよ。最上級の笑顔はあなただけにしか見せられないもん。:
That won't work. I can only
show my best smile to you,
you know.
translations.あなたからも、いっぱいもらってるもん。:
I get plenty from you
in return, after all.
translations.デキシーズの新しいサービスだけど。お客様の年齢や性別によって変えるべきよね。:
About the new service for
Dexee's... I think we should
tailor it to the customer's
age and gender.
translations.求めるものはそれぞれ違うだろうしね。:
Everyone wants something
different, after all.
translations.たくさん食べたいってお客様には、大盛りサービスとか。女性には、ご飯を減らしてデザ:
Like a free large portion
for customers who want to
eat a lot. Or smaller rice
portions with dessert for
women...
translations.いいね。じゃあ子供にはおもちゃ？:
That's good. And a toy
for the kids？
translations.そうそう。お年寄りには……肩たたき券？:
Exactly. And for the elderly...
a shoulder massage ticket？
translations.いいじゃん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の肩たたき券。●も欲しい。:
A shoulder massage ticket
from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sounds great.
● would like one, too.
translations.デキシーズの新サービスなんだけど、ひとつ思いついたの。:
I just thought of something
for Dexee's new service.
translations.ウェイティングのとき、名前を書いてもらうでしょ。で、お帰りの際に、名前をつけてあ:
When they're waiting, they
write their names down,
right？ Then when they leave,
we use their name to say
thank you.
translations.なるほど。……なんかアイディア思いついた割には落ち込んでる？:
Makes sense... But for someone
who just had a great idea,
you seem kind of down？
translations.実はこのアイディア、もう店長に伝えたんだけど。:
Well, I actually already told
the manager about it.
translations.最近は個人情報とかうるさいし、名前を覚えられることに不快感を感じるお客様もいるだ:
He said people are sensitive
about personal info lately.
Some customers might feel
uncomfortable if we memorize
their names.
translations.いいアイディアだと思ったんだけどな。新サービスの話は保留、って店長に言われちゃっ:
I thought it was a good idea,
but the manager said the new
service is on hold.
So that's that.
translations.（やっぱりバイトが考えるのは難しいのか……）:
(I guess it really is too
hard for part-timers to come
up with this stuff...)
translations.ねえ、『テント』って映画知ってる？:
Hey, do you know the movie
'The Tent'？
translations.うん、古い作品なんだけど。公開当時、評価されてなかったんだけどね。知る人ぞ知るっ:
Yeah, it's an older one.
It wasn't rated very well
when it came out, but it's
a hidden gem.
translations.雪山の山荘に閉じ込められた男女の話。:
It's about a group of men
and women trapped in a
mountain lodge during a
snowstorm.
translations.はは、いかにもだな。やっぱり殺人鬼が出てくるの？:
Haha, sounds typical.
Does a serial killer show up,
as expected？
translations.もちろん。出てこなきゃ、何も始まらないでしょ？:
Of course. If they don't show up, 
nothing would happen, right？
translations.雪の重みで、電話線も切れて、麓への道も寸断されちゃうの……。:
The weight of the snow cuts the 
phone lines, and the road down 
the mountain gets blocked off...
translations.ちょっと前にテレビで観たんだけど『スロープ』って映画知ってる？:
I watched it on TV a little while 
ago. Do you know the movie 
'Slope'？
translations.もしかして……ホラー？: Could it be... a horror movie？
translations.おおざっぱに言うと、そうね。でもスプラッターな感じではないの。:
Roughly speaking, yes. But it's 
not really a splatter film.
translations.でもね、殺人鬼というより、化け物かな？ 顔がないの。:
But rather than a killer, it's 
more like a monster？ It has 
no face.
translations.ううん、アメリカの映画だもん。首から上がないの。それでね……。:
No, it's an American movie. 
It has nothing from the neck up. 
And then...
translations.昨日借りてみた映画が、あまり面白くなかったの。:
The movie I rented yesterday 
wasn't very interesting.
translations.ゾンビが街を襲う王道なんだけど、オマージュってわけでもなく、ただの陳腐なパロディ:
It's a classic setup where zombies 
attack a town, but it wasn't an 
homage, just a cheap parody.
translations.せめてまだ笑えればよかったんだけど。:
If it was at least funny, 
it would have been fine.
translations.笑う？ ホラーでしょ？:
Funny？ It's a horror movie, 
right？
translations.笑えるホラー、あるでしょ？:
There are funny horror movies, 
right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。この前テレビでやってたサイコホラー観た？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did you watch that 
psycho-horror movie on TV 
the other day？
translations.そう、それそれ。たまたま観てさ。:
Yeah, that's the one. 
I just happened to watch it.
translations.私も……あ、じゃあわかったでしょ。:
Me too... Ah, then you 
understand, right？
translations.笑えるホラーがなんなのか。: What a funny horror movie is.
translations.……怖くて、途中で観るのやめちゃったぐらいなんだけど。:
...It was so scary I actually 
stopped watching it halfway 
through.
translations.全然ダメ。趣味を理解してくれとは言わないけど、ここまでなってないと、由々しき問題:
Hopeless. I won't ask you to 
understand my tastes, but if we're 
this far off, it's a serious problem...
translations.ねぇ、好きなヒーローっていた？:
Hey, did you have a favorite hero 
growing up？
translations.特撮とかアニメの？:
Like from live-action shows 
or anime？
translations.映画でも本でもいいけど。男の子ってみんな、そういうのに憧れるでしょ？:
Movies or books are fine too. 
Boys all look up to that kind of 
thing, right？
translations.うーん、そういう時期もあったなぁ。:
Hmm, I guess I had a phase 
like that.
translations.じゃあ、必殺技を練習したりした？:
Then, did you practice their 
special moves？
translations.ああ、したかも。ナントカ波～とかね。結構本気で。:
Yeah, maybe I did. Like, 
'Something-wave~'. 
Pretty seriously too.
translations.普通はどうかな。私の場合は必殺技とかじゃなくて……。:
Normally, I wonder. In my case, 
it wasn't special moves...
translations.……やっぱり恥ずかしいから、ナイショ。:
...It's actually embarrassing,
so it's a secret.
translations.最近、流行ってるヒーローものがあるみたい。:
Apparently there's a popular
superhero show right now.
translations.詳しくはわからないけど、近所の子が、よく必殺技の名前叫んで遊んでるから。このとこ:
I don't know the details,
but the neighborhood kids
are always shouting out
their special moves. Every day.
translations.へぇ。今も昔も変わらないな。:
Huh. Some things never
change, do they.
translations.それが、必殺技の名前がみんな違うの。ドラゴンスクリーム！ とか、ローリングタイガ:
But they all have different
special moves. Like,
Dragon Scream! Or...
Rolling Tiger!
translations.ヒーローがたくさんいるみたい。それでね、ヒーロー同士で戦ってるの。:
It seems there are a lot of
heroes. And they're all
fighting each other.
translations.悪者は宇宙人。一つの組織にたくさんのヒーローがいて、みんなで地球を守ってるらしい:
The bad guys are aliens.
There's a ton of heroes in
one organization, and they're
protecting the Earth, but...
translations.組織のリーダーが女の子でね。ヒーローたちがその女の子を取り合いし始めて……。:
The leader of the group is
a girl. And the heroes all
started fighting over her...
translations.（それ、ヒーローものとしてどうなのかな……）:
(I wonder if that really
counts as a hero show...)
translations.この前言った、女の子の取り合いをするヒーローの話、あるでしょ？:
You remember that hero show
I mentioned before, where
they fight over a girl？
translations.最近流行ってるっていう？:
The one you said was popular
recently？
translations.うん。あれ、クラスメイトで見てる子が何人かいたの。高校生の間でも、流行ってるみた:
Yeah. A few of my classmates
watch it. It seems to be
popular with high schoolers.
translations.一応、そうなんだけど……。でもね、カッコいい男の子がいっぱい出てくるんだって。:
Technically, yes... But
apparently it's full of
really handsome guys.
translations.ああ、ヒーローがたくさんいるから……。:
Ah, because there are so
many heroes...
translations.子供と一緒に見てるお母さんのファンも多いみたい。最近のヒーローものって、昔とはや:
It seems a lot of moms who
watch with their kids are
fans too. Modern hero shows
are really different now.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も気になってたり？:
Are you curious about it
too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.こら、ヤキモチ焼かないの。私には、私だけのヒーローがいるから、いいんだもん♪:
Hey, don't be jealous.
I've got my very own hero,
so I'm perfectly happy♪
translations.ピンチになったら、飛んできてね？:
If I'm ever in a pinch,
you'll come flying, right？
translations.小さい頃の話だけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にも、好きなヒーローがいたんだよな？:
You said you had a favorite
hero when you were little
too, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.前に必殺技を練習してたって……。:
You said before that you
used to practice special
moves...
translations.必殺技じゃないったら。……多分、言ってもわからないと思うよ？:
I told you, it wasn't a
special move. ...You
probably wouldn't know it
anyway.
translations.そんなにマイナーな番組？: Was it that obscure of a show？
translations.……古い時代劇。再放送でやってたの。:
...An old historical drama.
I saw it on reruns.
translations.編笠をかぶったお侍さんが、裾をひるがえしてくるっと振り返るの。その仕草が、男の人:
A samurai in a woven hat
would flip his hem and turn
around. Even though he was a
man, it was so sexy...
translations.ちょっと、顔の輪郭が似てるかも。アゴのラインとか首筋……。:
Your facial structure might
be a little similar. Like
your jawline and neck...
translations.ううん、なんでもないの！ ……あなたはやっぱり私のヒーローだね？:
No, it's nothing! ...You
really are my hero, aren't
you？
translations.この間、デキシーズで騒ぎがあったんだって？:
I heard there was some
commotion at Dexee's the
other day？
translations.あ、あれかな。でもそんなに騒ぐことでもないのよ。:
Ah, that. But it wasn't
really a big deal.
translations.店内を走ってた、５歳くらいの子が転んじゃって。:
A five-year-old kid was
running around the store
and tripped.
translations.うん、ちょっとヒザをすりむいただけ。でも、他のお客様の料理をこぼしちゃって……。:
Yeah, just scraped his knee.
But he spilled another
customer's food...
His mom scolded him, and
he started crying so hard.
translations.それでね、その子ったら泣きながら、わたしにしがみついて「おねえちゃ～ん」って。:
And then, while crying,
he clung to me and went,
'Big sis~'.
translations.……へえ、お母さんにも叱られちゃったから、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に甘えたくなったんだな。:
...Huh, so since his mom
scolded him, he wanted to
be comforted by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.……５歳の子供でしょ、別に？:
...He's a five-year-old kid.
Why would I be？
translations.あ、ちょっと無理してる。カワイイ▼:
Ah, you're forcing it a bit.
So cute, ▼.
translations.あれからあの子、デキシーズに来てないけど、大丈夫かな。:
That boy hasn't been back
to Dexee's since then.
I wonder if he's okay.
translations.店内で大泣きした子？:
The one who cried in
the diner？
translations.うん。時々お母さんと一緒によく来てたのに……。:
Yeah. He used to come in
with his mom a lot...
translations.お母さんに、みんなの前で怒られたのがショックだったのかな。:
Maybe he was shocked his mom
yelled at him in front of
everyone.
translations.お店のこと気に入ってくれてたのに……来なくなっちゃったら寂しいな。:
He really liked the diner...
I'd be sad if he stopped
coming altogether.
translations.そうだな。でもこればっかりは、待つしかないな。:
Yeah. But for something like
this, we just have to wait.
translations.……うん、次に来てくれたときも、いつもの笑顔でお迎えしてあげればいいよね！:
...Yeah, when he comes back,
I just need to welcome him
with my usual smile！
translations.そう！ デキシーズには▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の笑顔がないと！:
Exactly！ Dexee's isn't the
same without ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s smile！
translations.あのね、お店で転んじゃった子なんだけど。:
Hey, about the boy who fell
at the diner.
translations.うん。でも私の入ってない日で。店長のところにお母さんと一緒にお詫びに来たんだって:
Yeah. But on my day off.
He came with his mom to
apologize to the manager.
translations.それでね「おねえさんへ」って手紙を置いていってくれたの。私の似顔絵まで描いてくれ:
And he left a letter for me
saying 'To the nice lady.'
He even drew a picture of me！
translations.へえ……もしかして、その子の初恋だったりして。:
Huh... maybe you're his
first love.
translations.そんなことないと思うけど、まだ５歳よ？: I doubt it, he's only five！
translations.その年頃って年上のお姉さんに憧れたりするもんだって。:
Kids that age tend to
look up to older girls,
you know.
translations.ふうん、男の子ってそうなんだ。私が初恋の相手、か……。:
Hmm, so that's how boys are.
Me, his first love, huh...
translations.（……ダメだダメだ、５歳に嫉妬してどうする）:
(...No, no, why am I getting
jealous of a five-year-old？)
translations.うん、デキシーズにあの子がまた来てくれたの。:
Yeah, that boy came back to
Dexee's again.
translations.手紙じゃなくて、直接言いたかったんだって。でも、なかなか言い出せなくてモジモジし:
He wanted to tell me
in person, not just in
a letter. But he was too
shy to say it...
It was so cute.
translations.へえ……それ、やっぱ恋なんじゃ。:
Huh... that definitely sounds
like a crush.
translations.もう、またヤキモチ？ 私が子供と仲良くする度に妬いてたら、もたないよ？:
Jeez, jealous again？
If you get jealous every
time I'm nice to a kid,
you won't last long,
you know？
translations.心配いりません。子供だろうと大人だろうと、あなたが一番なんだから。:
Don't worry. Kids, adults,
doesn't matter. You're
always number one to me.
translations.……もう、うれしそうな顔しちゃって。今のあなたが子供みたいよ？ カワイイ▼:
...Jeez, look at that
big smile. You're the one
acting like a kid right now.
Cute ▼.
translations.お店の看板娘って、よくいうでしょ？:
You know how places have a
'poster girl'？
translations.うん、デキシーズの看板娘は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だな。:
Yeah, the poster girl for
Dexee's is definitely ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そんなことないと思うけど……ありがと♪:
I don't know about that...
but thank you♪
translations.でもね、私なんかとうていかなわない、看板犬がいるお店を見つけたの。:
But you know, I found a shop
with a mascot dog that
completely outshines me.
translations.そう。カフェなんだけどね。お店の看板の前でじっと座ってるの。:
Yeah. It's a cafe, though.
He just sits right there
in front of their sign.
translations.でしょ？ 営業時間中はだいたい、目をつぶって、気持ちよさそうにお昼寝してるんだっ:
Right？ While they're open,
he usually closes his eyes
and takes a nice little nap.
He has a beard like an old man,
and it's just so cute.
translations.はは、おじいちゃん犬か……。犬なら男でも看板娘になれるんだな。:
Haha, an old man dog...
Guess a guy can be a poster
girl if he's a dog.
translations.大丈夫。あなただって負けないくらいかわいいから、看板息子になれるよ。:
Don't worry. You're just as
cute as him, so you could
be a poster boy.
translations.（看板息子……？ なんかあまりいい響きじゃないな……）:
(A poster boy...? That doesn't
sound all that great...)
translations.この前話した看板犬のカフェ、覚えてる？:
Remember that cafe with the
mascot dog I told you about？
translations.ああ、おじいちゃんみたいな犬がいる店だろ？:
Yeah, the place with the dog
that looks like an old man？
translations.そうそう。でね、そのお店の人に、ペットの同伴ができる、ドッグカフェを紹介してもら:
Right. Well, the staff there
told me about a dog cafe where
you can bring your pets.
translations.あれ？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってペット飼ってないよな？:
Huh？ You don't have
any pets, do you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そうだけど……面白そうだったから。あ、でも……。:
I don't... but it sounded fun.
Oh, but actually...
translations.かわいい男の子を一人、飼ってます♪:
I do keep one very cute boy
as a pet♪
translations.ペット同伴のカフェの話を店長にしたら、興味もったみたい。:
I told the manager about that
pet-friendly cafe, and he
seemed interested.
translations.ペットＯＫのファミレスか……。新しいかも知れないな。:
A pet-friendly family
restaurant... That might
actually be a new concept.
translations.でしょ？ 店長も珍しく乗り気だったのよ。:
Right？ It's rare for the
manager to be so enthusiastic.
translations.……まさか、店長、本気なのか？:
...Wait, is the manager
actually serious about it？
translations.さすがにそれはないと思う、本部の許可もいるし。動物が苦手なお客様だって、いると思:
I doubt he'd go that far.
He'd need HQ's permission, and
some customers dislike pets.
translations.おもしろいとは思うけど、ちょっと難しいよね。:
It sounds like a fun idea,
but it'd be pretty tough.
translations.なんて言ってて、次バイト行ったら、店内が犬だらけだったりして……。:
We say that, but watch the
store be full of dogs the next
time we go in for our shift...
translations.なんだか映画みたい、窓ガラスをバリーンと割って、犬たちが飛び込んできたり。:
It'd be like a movie, with dogs
shattering the windows
and jumping inside.
translations.楽しそうな雰囲気を感じ取って、町中の犬がデキシーズに押し寄せるの。:
Every dog in town would sense
the fun atmosphere and
swarm into Dexee's.
translations.（それもホラー……なのか？）:
(Is that supposed to be...
a horror movie？)
translations.この間ね、デキシーズにおじいちゃんのお客様がきたの。:
The other day, an old man came
into Dexee's as a customer.
translations.おじいちゃん？ ……お年寄りのお客さん、結構いるよな？:
An old man？ ...We get a lot of
elderly customers, don't we？
translations.そうじゃなくて。あの看板犬のこと。:
No, not like that. I mean
that mascot dog.
translations.そうそう。カフェのオーナーさんに連れられてね。:
Yeah. The cafe owner
brought him along.
translations.でもうちの店、ペットＮＧでしょ？:
But our restaurant doesn't
allow pets, right？
translations.そう、だからお店の入り口に、いつもみたいに座ってた。:
Right, so he just sat by the
entrance like he always does.
translations.はは、それじゃデキシーズの看板犬だな。:
Haha, guess that makes him
Dexee's mascot dog, then.
translations.うん。午後のアイドルタイムなのに、引き寄せられて女性のお客様が結構入ってきたんだ:
Yeah. Even during the afternoon
lull, he managed to draw in
quite a few female customers.
translations.おじいちゃんのくせに、やるな……。: Not bad for an old man...
translations.それがね。実はまだ１歳なんだって、そのおじいちゃん。:
Well, about that. That old man
is actually only a year old.
translations.人間で言うと私たちと、同じくらいかな。モテモテね？:
In human years, he's about
the same age as us.
Quite a ladies' man, huh？
translations.あのね、この間廊下で後輩の女の子に声かけられたの。:
You know, the other day
an underclassman called out
to me in the hallway.
translations.なんと、恋愛相談でした。でも、知らない子なのよ？:
Believe it or not, she wanted
relationship advice. And I
didn't even know her？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に相談したくなっちゃう気持ち、分からないでもないけどさ。:
I can't say I blame her
for wanting to ask ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
for advice, though.
translations.話を聞いてたら、私っていうよりも、私たちっていうのが正しいみたい。:
But listening to her, it
wasn't really about me.
It was about us.
translations.私たちが理想のカップルなんだって。自然体で一緒にいられるのがうらやましいって。:
She said we're her ideal
couple. She's jealous of how
natural we are together.
translations.自然体か……悪い気はしないかな。:
Natural, huh... Well,
I can't say I mind hearing that.
translations.でも、自然体でいるためのアドバイスって、難しいでしょ？ 上手く答えられなかったの:
But it's hard to give advice
on how to act natural, right？
I couldn't give a good answer.
translations.確かに、普通でいるってだけだもんな……。:
True, since we're just
being our normal selves...
translations.後輩の女の子に恋愛相談されたって言ったでしょ？:
Remember that underclassman
who asked me for love advice？
translations.●たちが理想のカップルっていう？ まだ相談続いてたんだ。:
The one who called ●
and me an ideal couple？
You're still advising her？
translations.うん、実はまだ付き合ってないみたいで。:
Yeah. It turns out they're
not actually dating yet.
translations.え？ 自然体のカップルになりたいって言ってたよな。:
Huh？ But I thought she said
she wanted to be a natural
couple like us.
translations.ゆくゆくはってことだったみたい。:
I think she meant that's
what she wants eventually.
translations.そっか。ちょっと先走っちゃったな。:
I see. She was getting
a little ahead of herself.
translations.でも、彼女は真剣よ。その男の子の魅力について、１時間は語ってたから。:
But she's serious about him.
She spent an hour talking
about how amazing he is.
translations.１時間……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ずっと聞いてたの？:
An hour... Did ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ listen
to her the whole time？
translations.うん。なかなか熱こもってたな。:
Mhm. She was really
passionate about it.
translations.（その熱で告白したらいい気もするけど……）:
(I feel like she should just
use that passion to confess...)
translations.この前話したよね、片思いの女の子のこと。:
Remember that girl with the
crush I told you about？
translations.うん、恋愛相談してた子ね。:
Yeah, the one you were
giving relationship advice.
translations.私、彼女に勇気を出して告白した方がいいって伝えたんだけど。:
Well, I told her she should
gather her courage and confess.
translations.……その様子だとダメだった？:
...Judging by your face,
it didn't go well？
translations.……そうなの。それでね、失恋した日から学校を休んでるみたいなの。:
...No. And it seems like
she's been skipping school
ever since she got rejected.
translations.相当ショックだったんだな。:
She must have been
really shocked.
translations.……私のせいよね。余計なこと言ったから。:
...It's my fault, isn't it.
I said too much.
translations.そんな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が責任を感じる必要ないよ。:
Don't say that. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't
need to feel responsible.
translations.大丈夫。きっとすぐ、元気になるって。:
It'll be okay. I'm sure
she'll bounce back in no time.
translations.恋愛相談の子……学校に出てきたみたい。:
That girl I was advising...
Looks like she came to school.
translations.そっか、良かったな！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もこれで安心だ。:
Really？ That's great!
Now ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ can relax too.
translations.あなたにまで、心配かけちゃったね。:
I ended up making you
worry too, didn't I.
translations.●は別に、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が元気ならなんでもいいよ。:
It doesn't matter to ●,
as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is happy.
translations.あ、またそんなカワイイこと、サラッと言うんだから。:
Ah, you always say such
sweet things so casually.
translations.……そうだ、彼女にね、あなたも心配してたって言ったら、あなたみたいなカレシを見つ:
...Oh right, I told her you
were worried too, and she said
she'd find a guy just like you.
translations.うん、モテモテだね？ でも残念。あなたみたいなカレシなんて、他にどこにもいないの:
You're quite the ladies' man？
But too bad. There's no other
boyfriend like you, ▼.
translations.（そこまで言われると、照れるな……）:
(Hearing her say all that
makes me blush a little...)
translations.運動不足気味だし、何かスポーツでも始めようかなって思うんだけど。:
I feel a bit out of shape,
so I was thinking of
picking up a sport.
translations.ファミレスの仕事も相当運動になると思うけどな……。:
I'd think working at the
diner is a pretty good
workout on its own...
translations.まあ、汗をかくって感じじゃないな。:
Yeah, it's not exactly
something you break a
sweat doing.
translations.難しいスポーツだと、自信ないけど。いくら私でも走るのはできるし。:
I'm not confident I could
handle a hard sport, but
even I can run.
translations.あとは楽しいかどうかかな。楽しくないと続けるの難しそうだし。:
It also depends on if it's
fun. It'd be hard to keep
it up if it isn't.
translations.そうね……ちょっと考えてみる。:
You're right... I'll give
it some thought.
translations.あのね、ウォーキングを始めたの。:
You know, I started
walking for exercise.
translations.あれ？ ジョギングじゃなかったっけ？:
Huh？ I thought you were
going to start jogging？
translations.普段運動してない人が急に走るのって、危ないらしいから。トレーニングウェアも買っち:
Apparently it's dangerous
to suddenly start running
if you aren't used to it.
I even bought some new
workout clothes for it.
translations.先行投資したら、すぐにはやめられないな。:
Now that you've invested
in it, you can't quit
right away.
translations.三日坊主にはなりません！\n……たぶん。:
I won't give up after just
three days!
...Probably.
translations.●も一緒にやったら、楽しいかな。:
I wonder if it'd be fun
if ● joined me.
translations.だって。運動してるときの自分って、あまり見てていいものじゃないと思うし。:
It's just... I don't think
I look very good when
I'm exercising.
translations.……やっぱりダメ。汗だくの姿なんて見られたくないもん。:
...Actually, never mind.
I don't want you to see me
all sweaty.
translations.ウォーキングの効果、出始めたかも。:
My walking routine might
be starting to pay off.
translations.体育の時間に長距離で自己ベストが出たの。それがうれしくて。:
I got a personal best in
the long-distance run in
P.E. I was so happy.
translations.ちょっとだけ、なんだけどね。:
It was only by a little
bit, though.
translations.もしかして▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、運動が苦手って思い込んでるだけだったりして。潜在能力はす:
Maybe you just thought
you were bad at sports,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You might have
amazing hidden potential!
translations.もう、そうやっておだてる。……たしかに、他のスポーツもやってみたら楽しいかもしれ:
Jeez, you're always
flattering me... Though
it might be fun to try
some other sports, too.
translations.そう、何がいいかな……。:
Yeah. I wonder what would
be good...
translations.実は……筋肉痛みたいなの。:
Actually... my muscles
are really sore.
translations.ヨガは美容にも、心身の健康にもいいって聞いたから。:
I heard it's great for
beauty, and for your mind
and body.
translations.へえ、教室にでもいったの？:
Oh, did you go to a class
or something？
translations.ううん。ＤＶＤをレンタルしてやってみたんだけど。変なポーズが多くて。:
No. I rented a DVD and
tried it at home, but...
there were a lot of
weird poses.
translations.ダメ。あなたにだけは、言えない。あんな格好……。:
No way. I could never tell
you. Posing like that...
translations.（どんなポーズなんだ……）:
(What kind of poses was
she doing...？)
translations.デキシーズの常連さんがね、私にベビーシッターを頼めないかって……どうしようかな。:
A regular at Dexy's asked me
if I could babysit...
I wonder what I should do.
translations.きっと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の働きぶりを見て、頼みたいって思ったんだろうな。:
They probably saw how hard
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ works and wanted to ask.
translations.嬉しいけど……。私、そんな経験もないし。子供を預かるって、大変なことよ。:
I'm happy, but... I don't
have any experience. Taking
care of kids is tough.
translations.そうだよな。目はなせないし、もしものことがあったら。:
Yeah, you're right. You can't
take your eyes off them, and
what if something happens？
translations.うん、そうよね。やっぱり、今度ちゃんとお断りする。:
Yeah, exactly. I think I'll
politely decline next time.
translations.それがいいんじゃないかな。お客さんも、きっと分かってくれるよ。:
I think that's for the best.
I'm sure the customer will
understand.
translations.ちょっと、楽しみな気持ちもあったんだけどな。……楽しみは自分のときでいいよね。:
I was looking forward to it
a little bit, though... But I
guess I can save the fun for
when I have my own.
translations.育児雑誌を読んでみたんだけど、意外と面白いね。:
I tried reading a parenting
magazine, and it's actually
pretty interesting.
translations.ベビーシッターの件、断ったんじゃないの？:
Didn't you turn down that
babysitting job？
translations.お断りしたんだけど、それはそれとして。なんとなく手に取ったら面白くて、買っちゃっ:
I did, but that's a separate
thing. I just picked it up
and it was interesting, so
I ended up buying it.
translations.それ、まさか学校帰りに買ったりしてないよね？:
You didn't happen to buy it
on your way home from school,
did you？
translations.学校帰りに買ったんだけど……どうして？:
I did buy it on my way home
from school... Why？
translations.制服の女子高生が育児雑誌だよ？:
A high school girl in uniform
buying a parenting magazine？
translations.あ……。そういえばレジのお兄さん、変な感じだったかも。:
Ah... Now that you mention it,
the cashier was acting a bit
weird.
translations.学校にも持ってきてて……休み時間にちょっと読んだりしてた……。:
I brought it to school too...
I was reading it a little bit
during breaks...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、もう、育児雑誌読んでないよな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're not reading that
parenting magazine anymore,
are you？
translations.もう読んでないから、安心して。ごめんね。:
I'm not reading it anymore,
so don't worry. Sorry.
translations.●はいいんだけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方が大変だったじゃないか？:
● is fine, but wasn't it
way harder for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.クラスのみんなに、心配されちゃった。誤解とくの大変だったの。:
Everyone in class got worried.
It was so hard to clear up
the misunderstanding.
translations.デキシーズにまで噂が広まらなくてよかった。:
I'm just glad the rumors didn't
spread to Dexy's.
translations.だよな……あの二人はお喋りだし、店長は気が利かないし……。:
Yeah... Those two are gossips,
and the manager is clueless...
translations.私が軽率だったね、気をつけなきゃ。:
I was being careless. I need
to be more careful.
translations.また、お客様にベビーシッターのバイト頼まれちゃった……。:
A customer asked me to babysit
for them again...
translations.断ったのに、よっぽど▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が気に入ったんだなあ。:
Even though you turned them
down, they must really like
you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ううん、別のお客様なの。それも、外国の方……。:
No, it was a different customer.
And a foreigner, too...
translations.へえ……なんか、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の母性ってグローバルなんだな。:
Wow... I guess your maternal
instincts are global, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.母性って……これでも女子高生です！:
Maternal instincts...? I'm still
a high school girl, you know!
translations.これも経験なのかな……。:
I wonder if this is because
of my experience...
translations.経験？ ああ、親戚の子とか面倒みたことあるんだ。:
Experience？ Oh, you mean you've
taken care of relatives' kids？
translations.たまに子供みたいなんだもん、私のカレシ。:
My boyfriend acts like a kid
sometimes, after all.
translations.あなたって、小さい頃、何になりたいって思ってた？:
What did you want to be when
you grew up？
translations.●？ あんまり覚えてないな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
●？ I don't really remember.
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私はね、幼稚園の先生かな。子供の頃、幼稚園の先生に憧れなかった？:
For me, a kindergarten teacher.
Didn't you look up to your
kindergarten teachers as a kid？
translations.そういえば……何かと先生にちょっかい出してたかも。:
Now that you mention it...
I think I used to mess
with my teachers a lot.
translations.男の子ってそういうトコあるよね。好きな人にいたずらしちゃうみたいなトコ。:
Boys are just like that,
aren't they？ Always teasing
the girls they like.
translations.そうだな。どうしてかはわかんないけど。:
Yeah. I don't really know
why we do it, though.
translations.私の通ってた幼稚園の先生もそうだったの。若い女の先生で、みんなにいたずらばっかり:
My kindergarten teacher
was like that too. She was
young, and everyone was
always pranking her.
translations.その人が、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にとっての憧れの女性だった？:
Was she the woman you
looked up to, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.多分そう。でもね、顔がよく思い出せないの。こうモヤがかかってて。:
I think so. But I can't
really remember her face.
It's all kind of hazy.
translations.小さい頃だもんな……。:
Well, you were really
little back then...
translations.探せば写真、出てくるかな……。:
I wonder if I could find
a picture of her...
translations.アルバムを整理してたらね、幼稚園の先生と一緒に写った写真が出てきたの。:
I was organizing my albums,
and found a picture of me
with my kindergarten
teacher.
translations.この前話してた、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の憧れの人？:
The one you looked up to,
like you mentioned before,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そう。優しくてステキな先生。でもね驚きの新発見があったの。:
Yeah. She was so sweet and
lovely. But I made a really
surprising discovery.
translations.あのね、おばあちゃんの先生だったの。:
Well, it turns out she
was an older lady.
translations.……若い女の先生って言ってなかった？:
...Didn't you say she was
a young woman？
translations.でしょう？ 私もびっくり。子供の頃の記憶って、いい加減なんだなって。:
Right？ I was shocked too.
Childhood memories really
are unreliable, huh.
translations.はは、いい加減にもほどがあるよ。:
Haha, I'll say. That's
pretty far off.
translations.なんでだろうね、いくら小さい頃でも若い女性とおばあちゃんの区別ぐらいつくはずなの:
I wonder why. Even as a kid,
I should've been able
to tell a young woman
from an older lady...
translations.そうだ、将来の夢の話、覚えてる？:
Oh right, do you remember
talking about our dreams
for the future？
translations.将来の……ああ、結局幼稚園の先生の話になっちゃったな。おばあちゃん先生の。:
Our dreams... Ah, we ended
up talking about your
kindergarten teacher.
The older lady.
translations.そう、それ。私ね、幼稚園の先生に憧れてはいたけど、本当の夢はお嫁さんだったの。:
Yeah, that. I did look up
to my teacher, but my real
dream was to be a bride.
translations.お嫁さんか……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲らしいよね。:
A bride, huh...
That sounds like you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.当時は結構人気だったけどな、お嫁さん。時代によって、流行がありそうだけど。:
It was a pretty popular
dream back then. I guess
trends change over time.
translations.そうだな。今の子供はお嫁さんとか言わないのかも。:
Yeah. Kids these days
probably don't say they
want to be brides.
translations.私もね、小学生になる頃には小料理屋さんの女将に変わってたの。:
By the time I was in
elementary school, my dream
changed to running a
small restaurant.
translations.……お嫁さんから、小料理屋の女将って、すごいな。:
...Going from a bride to
running a restaurant is
quite the leap.
translations.背伸びしたい年頃……だったのかなあ。よくわかんないね、その頃はまだ結構ヤンチャだ:
I guess I just wanted to
act grown-up... I don't
know, I was still a pretty
rowdy kid back then.
translations.前に聞いた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の将来の夢、お嫁さんから小料理屋の女将だったよね。:
You told me before that your
dream changed from a bride
to running a restaurant,
right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.小さい頃の話だよ。: That was when I was little.
translations.……やっぱり、お嫁さん。かな。:
...I think I'd still like
to be a bride.
translations.そういうわけじゃないの。もっと具体的に考えての話です。:
Not exactly. I'm thinking
about it much more
concretely now.
translations.さあ、どうでしょう？ “ほら、なあ？”ぐらいしか言えないようだと私、また小料理屋:
Hmm, I wonder？ If all you
can say is "you know？",
I might just want to run a
restaurant again.
translations.（そしたら、●も小料理屋の大将に……か？）:
(Does that mean ● would
be the restaurant boss...？)
translations.デキシーズに、新しいバイトの子たちが入ってきたでしょう？:
You know how Dexee's got
some new part-timers？
translations.うん。また▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が指導係でしょ？:
Yeah. You're training them
again, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.指導係はいいんだけど、会話についていけないの。これがジェネレーションギャップなの:
I don't mind training them,
but I can't keep up with
their conversations. Is this
the generation gap？
translations.大げさだよ。一つか二つしか歳は変わらないのに。:
You're exaggerating. You're
only a year or two older
than them.
translations.じゃあ、あなたは私と話してて、違和感を感じたことない？:
So, do you ever feel
like something's off
when we talk?
translations.まだ、新人だから緊張してるんだろ？ すぐ慣れるよ。:
They're just new and
nervous, right? They'll
get used to it soon.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ちょっと疲れてる？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you
a little tired?
translations.新人たちの教育、大変そうだから。:
Because training the
newbies looks tough.
translations.まあね、かみ合ってないっていうかさ。:
Well, yeah. It's like
you're not clicking.
translations.空回りしてるのかな、私。今まではこんなことなかったんだけど。:
Maybe I'm just spinning
my wheels. This has never
happened before.
translations.彼女たちにも、デキシーズで働いて良かったって思って欲しいから、もうちょっとやり方:
I want them to be glad
they work at Dexee's, so
I'll try a new approach.
translations.新人バイトの子たちと、ちゃんと話してみたの。:
I had a proper talk with
the new part-timers.
translations.私のこと、恐い先輩だと思ってたんだって。それで、警戒してたみたい。:
They thought I was a
scary senior. So they
were on their guard.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が恐い……なんでそんな風に思ったんだろ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, scary...?
Why would they think that?
translations.それがね、店長が面接の時に私の名前を出したみたい。:
Well, it seems the manager
brought me up during
their interviews.
translations.“バイト頭だから、彼女の言うことを聞きなさい”って。逆らうと怖いよーなんて、付け:
He said to listen to me
since I'm in charge, and
that I'm scary if crossed.
translations.たぶん、店長なりの冗談だったんだと思うけど……。全然伝わってなかったみたい。:
I think it was just his
idea of a joke, but...
it didn't land at all.
translations.伝わってないどころか、誤解させてるんだからな。:
Didn't land? It gave them
the wrong idea entirely.
translations.ほんとよ。コラ！ って、叱っておかないと。:
I know, right? I'll have
to give him a good scolding.
translations.新人バイトの子たち、ちゃんと働いてるよな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の指導のおかげだね。:
The new part-timers are
working hard. It's thanks
to your training, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私の指導じゃなくて、彼女たちのがんばりよ。:
It's not my training,
it's their hard work.
translations.あと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とも普通に話してるし。:
Plus, they're talking to
you normally now, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.店長が変こと言わなければ、最初からギクシャクしなかったのに。:
If the manager hadn't
said anything weird, it
wouldn't have been awkward.
translations.でもひとつ良かったことは、これがきっかけで、あの子たちとじっくり話ができたってこ:
But one good thing is that
it gave me a chance to have
a real talk with them.
translations.あ、もしかして……それが店長の狙いだったりして。:
Ah, maybe... that was the
manager's plan all along.
translations.今、インスタントラーメンをアレンジするのに凝ってるの。:
I'm really into upgrading
instant ramen right now.
translations.簡単なところではお湯の代わりにミルクで作ったり、野菜をたっぷり追加したり。:
For something simple,
I use milk instead of water,
or add lots of veggies.
translations.へーっ。面白いね。健康にもよさそうだし。:
Wow, that's interesting.
Sounds healthy, too.
translations.でしょ？ あなたも食事は、健康のことも考えてね？:
Right? You should think
about your health when
you eat too, okay?
translations.ふぅん、そうなんだ？ じゃあ、これからはもう気にしなくていい？:
Hmm, is that so？
Then I guess I don't have to
worry about it anymore？
translations.ワガママなんだ。じゃあしっかり構っちゃおうっと。:
You're so demanding.
Then I'll just have to
take good care of you.
translations.インスタントラーメンアレンジの話。覚えてる？:
About my instant ramen
arrangements. Remember？
translations.うん、ミルクラーメンとかだっけ？:
Yeah, milk ramen
and stuff, right？
translations.そう。でね、新作があるの……ラーメンドリア。:
Right. And I've got a
new one... Ramen Doria.
translations.しゃもじ一杯のご飯をラーメンに入れて粉チーズを振ってオーブンへ。あとは半熟卵を落:
Put a scoop of rice in the
ramen, sprinkle parmesan,
and bake it. Then top it
with a soft-boiled egg.
translations.へー、ボリューム満点だな。他には？:
Wow, that's super filling.
Anything else？
translations.今はデザートを考えてるの。:
Right now, I'm thinking
about dessert.
translations.あ。うまく行くハズがないって顔してる。:
Ah. You've got a look that
says it'll never work.
translations.あとから泣いて食べさせてって言ってもあげないよ。後悔しないように。:
Even if you cry and beg me
for some later, I won't
share. Don't regret it.
translations.（ラーメンでデザート……どんなだ？）:
(Dessert made of ramen...
What would that be like？)
translations.前に言ってた、デザートラーメン開発はどう？:
How's the dessert ramen
development going？
translations.そう、先達がいたってこと。試してみたけど、まあまあかな。:
Yeah, someone beat me to it.
I tried it, but it was
just okay.
translations.デザートラーメンどう？ 完成した？:
How's the dessert ramen？
Is it finished？
translations.うん。美味しかったよ。ラーメンアイス。:
Yeah. It was delicious.
Ramen ice cream.
translations.へえ……それって、美味しいのかな。:
Huh... I wonder if that's
actually good.
translations.でも、もう、やめ。本末転倒だから。:
But I'm done with that.
It defeats the purpose.
translations.インスタントラーメンが多いと、栄養が偏りがちになっちゃうでしょ？ それじゃあなた:
Eating too much instant ramen
unbalances your diet, right？
That's not good for you.
translations.最初はね、でも途中から面白レシピになっちゃって。ごめんね。:
At first, yeah. But it turned
into a joke recipe halfway
through. Sorry about that.
translations.ごめんなんて、うれしいよ。野菜ラーメンもミルクラーメンもやってみよっかな。:
Don't apologize, I'm happy.
Maybe I'll try making veggie
or milk ramen myself.
translations.本当？ じゃあ、少しは目的が達成できたかな？:
Really？ Then I guess I
achieved my goal a little bit？
translations.ね、楽器ができる女の子ってどう思う？:
Hey, what do you think of
girls who play instruments？
translations.楽器か……うーん、急にどうしたの？:
Instruments... Hmm, what
brought this up so suddenly？
translations.この間ね友だちの家に行ったら、ピアノが置いてあって。ちょっと羨ましくなっちゃった:
I went to a friend's house
recently and they had a piano.
I got a little jealous.
translations.ピアノとかヴァイオリンとか……そういうの憧れちゃうな。:
I've always admired things
like the piano or violin...
translations.今から、習うっていうのは？:
What if you started
taking lessons now？
translations.そうね……部屋で練習できない楽器は難しいかな。お隣さんに悪いでしょ？:
Well... It's hard if I can't
practice in my room. I'd hate
to bother the neighbors.
translations.そうだな。うちも無理だ。:
True. I couldn't do it
at my place, either.
translations.難しいよね。簡単に買えるものでもないし……。:
It's tricky, isn't it？
Plus, they're not exactly
cheap to buy...
translations.楽器の話、覚えてる？:
Remember when we were
talking about instruments？
translations.ああ、なんか楽器をやりたいって話ね。:
Oh yeah, about how you
wanted to play one.
translations.小学生のころは、リコーダーやハーモニカを音楽で教えてくれたでしょ？ 高校ではそれ:
In elementary school, they
taught us the recorder and
harmonica, right？ We don't
get those chances now.
translations.そういえば、歌がメインだよな。他の学校は違うのかな。:
Now that you mention it,
we mostly just sing.
I wonder if other schools
are different.
translations.学校でも、もっと楽器を教えてくれればいいのに。:
I wish they'd teach us
more instruments at school.
translations.それいい。楽しそう。:
That'd be great!
It sounds so fun.
translations.はは、そこまでくると逆に大変そうだけどな。:
Haha, though taking it
that far sounds like a lot
of work.
translations.クラスでオーケストラの話だけど、実現するかもしれないよ。:
About that class orchestra
idea... It might actually
happen!
translations.音楽の先生に話したら、結構乗り気になってくれたの。:
I mentioned it to the music
teacher, and he was actually
pretty into it.
translations.へえ……先生の方も大変そうだけどな。:
Wow... Sounds like it'd be
tough on the teacher, too.
translations.面白さが勝っちゃったみたい。でも、ひとつ問題があるって。:
I think the fun factor won
out. But he said there's
one problem.
translations.みんな同じ楽器じゃないから、評価が難しいなって。:
Since everyone would play
different instruments,
grading would be hard.
translations.それに、みんなが乗り気になってくれるとは限らないしね。:
Plus, there's no guarantee
everyone in class would
be on board.
translations.クラスでオーケストラの話、なくなっちゃった。:
The class orchestra idea
ended up falling through.
translations.やっぱり難しかったか。:
Guess it was too difficult
after all.
translations.問題がたーくさん。前に話した評価の件もそうだし。:
There were sooooo many
problems. Like the grading
issue I mentioned before.
translations.楽器の確保、練習場所の確保、先生の指導力、練習時間の不足……。:
Getting enough instruments,
finding a place to practice,
the teacher's ability,
not enough time...
translations.ちょっとどうにかなりそうにないよね。:
It really didn't seem like
we could make it work.
translations.残念だな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、楽しみにしてたのに。:
That's a shame. You were
looking forward to it,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.うん……でもこれがきっかけで音楽の先生と仲良くなれたの。:
Yeah... But it did give me
a chance to get closer
to the music teacher.
translations.楽器の件も、色々相談にのってくれそう。:
It seems like he'll give me
advice on instruments, too.
translations.（ひとまず成果はあったってことかな）:
(I guess something good
came out of it, at least.)
translations.そういえば、この間すごくかわいい会話を聞いたの。:
Oh, by the way, I overheard
the cutest conversation
the other day.
translations.中学生のカップルなんだけどね。:
It was this middle school
couple.
translations.男の子が女の子に、“私服だと、雰囲気変わるね”だって。初めてのデートだったみたい:
The boy told the girl,
'You look so different in
casual clothes.' I think it
was their first date.
translations.いいね、胸キュンだ！:
Nice, that makes my heart
skip a beat!
translations.ね？ 振り返りそうになったけど、我慢したよ。:
Right？ I almost turned
around to look, but I
held myself back.
translations.かわいかったなぁ。純粋な感じで。ふふふ。:
They were so cute.
So innocent. Hehehe.
translations.……●は今でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の私服姿は、新鮮だよ。:
...Even now, seeing you in
casual clothes is still a
fresh sight for ●, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あれ、対抗意識？ ここにもかわいい男の子発見！:
Oh, feeling competitive？
I've spotted another cute
boy right here!
translations.（自分で言ってなんだけど、照れるな……）:
(I said it myself, but it's
still embarrassing...)
translations.あっ、そうそう。この前話した中学生のカップル。:
Oh, right! That middle school
couple I told you about.
translations.うん。男の子がね、ご馳走してた。“悪いから自分で払うよ”、“いいよ、俺が出すよ！:
Yeah. He was treating her.
'I feel bad, I'll pay my way,'
'No, it's on me!' They did
that right in front of me.
translations.ついつい、少し笑っちゃった。それに気がついた２人がさらに照れちゃって。それも可愛:
I couldn't help but laugh a
little. They noticed and got
even more embarrassed.
That was so cute, too.
translations.悩みがあるならお姉さんが相談に乗ってあげる！ って言いたかったくらい。:
I almost wanted to say,
'If you have any troubles,
your big sis will listen!'
translations.次に来るときも仲良しだといいなぁ。あの子たち。:
I hope they're still getting
along next time they come in.
translations.（●も負けてられないな！）:
(● can't afford to lose
to them!)
translations.そういや前に聞いた、中学生カップル、あれからデキシーズに来た？:
By the way, did that middle
school couple come back to
Dexee's since then？
translations.ううん。そう頻繁には来られないんじゃない？ お小遣いなくなっちゃうから。:
No. They probably can't come
that often, right？ They'd run
out of allowance.
translations.うん。ねえ、もし私たちが出会ったのが中学の頃だったら、どうなってたと思う？:
Yeah. Hey, what do you think
would've happened if we met
in middle school？
translations.うーん、どうだろ。中学生の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か……会ってみたかったな。:
Hmm, I wonder. A middle school
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh... I would've liked
to meet you back then.
translations.私も。きっとあなたはかわいかったんだろうな。想像しただけで、にやけちゃう。:
Me too. You must have been so
cute. Just imagining it makes
me grin.
translations.お小遣いを工面して、レストランに入ったり、映画見たり？:
Scraping together our allowance
to go to a restaurant or see
a movie？
translations.そうね、そういうもどかしさって、恋愛には大事なのかもしれないね。:
Yeah. That kind of frustration
might actually be important
in romance.
translations.もっと、ずっと一緒に居られたらってさ。:
Like how I wish we could be
together more, all the time.
translations.そうだ、今度、例の中学生カップルが店に来たら、サービスしてあげようよ。:
Oh, next time that middle
school couple comes in, we
should give them something
on the house.
translations.気持ちは分かるけど、お客様によってサービスを変えるのはダメよ。:
I get how you feel, but we
can't give special treatment
to specific customers.
translations.うん、もちろん値引きしたりとかじゃなくて、一番奥のテーブル席に案内してあげようか:
Yeah, I don't mean a discount
or anything. I was thinking
we could seat them at the
table way in the back.
translations.あ、それいいかも。あそこちょっと、個室みたいな雰囲気だから。:
Oh, that might be nice.
It has a bit of a private room
vibe back there.
translations.だろ？ きっと２人っきりの雰囲気が楽しめるよ。:
Right？ I'm sure they'd enjoy
the private atmosphere.
translations.優しい、お兄さんだね。あなたのそういうところも、大好き。:
You're such a sweet older guy.
I love that about you, too.
translations.もう、うんってなあに？ カワイイ▼:
Jeez, what's with that 'Yeah'？
You're so cute, ▼.
translations.ねぇ、男の人のほうが暑がりだよね？:
Hey, guys tend to get hot
easier, right？
translations.そうなの？ 人によると思うけど。:
Do they？ I think it depends
on the person.
translations.バイト中に思ったの。夏も冬も、室温調整を頼んでくるのは、女性客のほうが多いなって:
I noticed it at work. Summer
or winter, it's usually female
customers asking to adjust
the temperature.
translations.ああ、よく寒すぎるって言ってくるのは女性だな。:
Ah, yeah, it's usually women
who say it's too cold.
translations.でもさ、それって女性が寒がりってことだろ？:
But doesn't that just mean
women get cold easier？
translations.じゃあ、男の人のほうが鈍感？:
So, guys are just
more oblivious？
translations.そうよね、あなたも時々鈍感だもんね。:
It's true, you can be
pretty oblivious
sometimes too.
translations.（……ん？ 温度の話だよな？）:
(...Huh？ We're still
talking about the
temperature, right？)
translations.スカートって夏はいいけど、冬は寒くない？:
Skirts are fine in the
summer, but aren't they
cold in winter？
translations.寒いこともあるけど、そんなに気にならないかな。どうして？:
It can be cold, but it
doesn't really bother
me. Why do you ask？
translations.この前、男と女のどっちが暑がりで寒がりかって話、しただろ？ やっぱり女性のほうが:
Remember when we talked
about who gets hot or
cold easier？ Women are
definitely better with
the cold.
translations.冬でもスカートはいてるから？:
Because we wear skirts
even in winter？
translations.うん。真冬に生足なんて、●は絶対無理。:
Yeah. Bare legs in the
dead of winter is totally
impossible for ●.
translations.男の人だって、やってみたらきっと大丈夫だと思うよ。慣れじゃないかな。:
I'm sure guys would be
fine if they tried it.
It's just a matter of
getting used to it.
translations.あなたのスカート姿、ちょっと想像しちゃった。:
I just imagined you in
a skirt for a second.
translations.サラリーマンって夏でもスーツでしょ？ 暑くないのかな。:
Salarymen wear suits
even in summer, right？
Doesn't it get hot？
translations.そりゃ、暑いんじゃないかな。:
I'm sure it gets
pretty hot.
translations.そっか。男の人は大変だね。:
I see. Guys have it
tough, huh.
translations.女の人も大変じゃん。化粧とか肌の手入れとか男よりやること多いもんな。:
Women have it tough too.
You have way more to do
than guys, like makeup
and skincare.
translations.ふふ、そういうの気にしてくれてるんだ。:
Hehe, you actually
notice things like that.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も、寝る前にいろいろやってるんだろ？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ does a bunch of
stuff before bed too,
right？
translations.寝る前だけじゃないよ。起きてからも大変なんだから。顔洗って、保湿して、目を冷やし:
Not just before bed.
It's a lot of work after
waking up, too. Washing
my face, moisturizing,
cooling my eyes...
translations.起きたら、目が腫れてることが多いの。むくんじゃって。:
My eyes are usually
swollen when I wake up.
They get all puffy.
translations.ああ、泣いた後みたいな。:
Ah, like after you've
been crying.
translations.そう。そんな顔、あなたに見せられないでしょ？:
Right. I can't let you
see me with a face like
that, can I？
translations.●は、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がどんな顔してても平気だよ？:
● doesn't mind what
kind of face ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
makes, you know？
translations.もう……。それ、喜んでいいのかわからないなぁ。:
Jeez... I don't know if
I should be happy about
that or not.
translations.男と女のどっちが暑がりで寒がりかって話だけど……。:
About that conversation
on whether guys or girls
get hot or cold easier...
translations.ふふ、結論が出た？:
Hehe, did you reach a
conclusion？
translations.よくさ、真冬にランニングの小学生とか見るだろ？あれって大抵、男なんだよな。:
You know how you see
elementary schoolers in
tank tops in the dead of
winter？ They're usually
boys.
translations.そういえば、そうかも。:
Now that you mention it,
maybe so.
translations.それ考えると、男のほうが寒さに強いのかな？:
Thinking about that,
maybe guys are better
with the cold？
translations.そう？ でも、私は小学生の頃薄着だったよ。:
You think so？ I used to
dress pretty light when
I was in elementary
school, though.
translations.動けばあったかくなるから。たくさん着ると、動きづらくなっちゃうでしょ？:
Because you warm up when
you move around. If you
wear too much, it gets
hard to move, right？
translations.風の子だったんだな。:
Guess you were a real
child of the wind, huh.
translations.今よりは平気だったかも。あの頃は若かったな……。:
I was probably better
with it than I am now.
I was so young back
then...
translations.もう、おじいちゃんみたいなこと言って。:
Jeez, you sound like an
old man.
translations.はは。子供はみんな寒さに強いかもな。:
Haha. I guess all kids
are good with the cold.
translations.うーん……やっぱり、人によるのかな、この話は。:
Hmm... I guess it really
depends on the person.
translations.いつも思うんだけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って苦手なものないの？:
I always wonder, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Is there anything you hate？
translations.苦手なもの？ なにか、企んでるんだ。:
Things I hate？
You're plotting something.
translations.ならいいけど……そうね、前にも言ったかもしれないけど、カエルとか虫が苦手かな。:
If you say so... Well, I might
have mentioned it before, but
I don't like frogs or bugs.
translations.なるほど、まあそんなイメージだよな。:
I see. Yeah, that sounds
about right for you.
translations.小さい頃は平気だったんだけどな……いつからダメになっちゃったんだろ。:
I was fine with them when I
was little... I wonder when
I started hating them.
translations.あるよな、いつの間にかっていうの。食べ物の好き嫌いとかもさ。:
That happens, doesn't it？
Before you know it. Like with
food preferences and stuff.
translations.そうそう。ねえ、あなたの苦手なものは？:
Exactly. So, what about you？
What are you bad with？
translations.●の苦手なもの……。そうだな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の悲しい顔？ なんつって！:
●'s weak points...
Let's see, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s sad face？
Just kidding！
translations.こら、調子にのらないの♪:
Hey now, don't get
carried away♪
translations.あのね……家に虫が出て……。:
Well... a bug showed up
in my house...
translations.ああ……嫌いって言ってたもんな。:
Ah... You did say you
hated them.
translations.ご近所から有機栽培の野菜をいただいたんだけど、その中に……。:
A neighbor gave me some
organic vegetables, and
inside them was...
translations.これ以上言わせないで。:
Don't make me say
any more.
translations.野菜自体はとっても美味しかったのに……。:
The vegetables themselves
were really delicious, too...
translations.まあ美味しいから虫がつく、とか言うしね。:
Well, they say bugs only go
after the tasty ones.
translations.そうね、でもあんなに料理に苦労したの、はじめてかも……もう必死だったの。:
True, but I don't think I've
ever struggled so much to
cook... I was desperate.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲には悪いけど、その必死の表情、見てみたかったな）:
(I feel bad for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, but I
kinda wanted to see that
desperate look on her face.)
translations.また虫がいるかと思うと、野菜に触るとき、躊躇しちゃって。:
Thinking there might be
another bug makes me hesitate
when I touch the vegetables.
translations.ああ、いただき物の有機野菜？:
Ah, the organic vegetables
you were given？
translations.うん、またいただいちゃって。それ自体はうれしいんだけど……。:
Yeah, I got some more.
I'm glad to have them, but...
translations.もう、いいもん。よーしっ、今日もはりきって退治しちゃうから！:
Jeez, fine. Alright, I'm gonna
do my best to exterminate
them today, too！
translations.手袋にマスク、ゴーグルにビニールのエプロン……全部そろえたんだから。:
Gloves, a mask, goggles, and a
vinyl apron... I've got the
whole set ready.
translations.虫との対決はどうだった？:
How was your showdown
with the bugs？
translations.完全勝利です。いただき物の野菜は全部美味しくいただきました。:
Total victory. I deliciously
enjoyed all the vegetables
I received.
translations.ふふ。実はね、今回のお野菜には虫はいなかったの。:
Hehe. Actually, there weren't
any bugs in the vegetables
this time.
translations.完全装備だったのに、ちょっと肩透かしくらっちゃった。不戦勝ね。:
I was fully equipped, so it
was a bit anticlimactic.
A win by default, I guess.
translations.勝ちは勝ちだよ。実はちょっと心配だったんだ、虫、ほんとに苦手みたいだから。:
A win is a win. I was actually
a bit worried, since you
really seem to hate bugs.
translations.ありがとう……うん、やっぱりそうしよ。:
Thanks... Yeah, I think
I'll do just that.
translations.未来の旦那様の条件に、ひとつ追加。:
I'm adding a new condition
for my future husband.
translations.私が虫に困ってたら、助けてくれる人。覚えておいてね？:
Someone who'll save me
when I'm scared of bugs.
Keep that in mind, okay？
translations.（他の条件を知りたい……）:
(I wanna know what the
other conditions are...)
translations.占いか、別に嫌いじゃないけど。なんで？:
Fortunes？ I don't hate
them or anything. Why？
translations.ほら、女の子って占い好きが多いのに、男の子はそうでもないよね。なんでかなって。:
Well, lots of girls like
them, but boys don't seem
to. I wonder why.
translations.そうだな、男で占い好きって聞かないな。:
Yeah, you don't really hear
about guys being into that.
translations.女性雑誌には必ず占いページがあるじゃない？ 男性向けの雑誌はそうでもないの？:
Women's magazines always
have a horoscope section.
Do men's magazines not？
translations.確かに、占いってあんまり、印象にないな。:
True, I don't really recall
seeing them in there.
translations.男の子は占い好きじゃないのか……じゃあ占いの話ってしない方がいい？:
So boys don't like
fortunes... Should I not
talk about them, then？
translations.今日の占い、おひつじ座は、歯みがきが吉なんだって。:
Today's horoscope says
brushing your teeth brings
Aries good luck.
translations.そうなんだけど、歯みがきが吉ってどういうことか分からなくて。:
Yeah, but I don't really get
how brushing my teeth is
supposed to bring luck.
translations.歯みがきをしっかりやれってことかな？:
Maybe it means you should
brush them really well？
translations.そうだよな。何回も磨けってこと？:
True. Maybe it means you
should brush them a lot？
translations.食後以外にもかな……。:
Like, even when I haven't
just eaten...?
translations.でしょう？ 気になってしょうがないの。:
Right？ It's been bothering
me all day.
translations.（こんなに悩んでいる時点で、あんまり吉じゃないよな）:
(The fact she's stressing
over it means it's not very
lucky at all...)
translations.ねえ、風水って知ってる？:
Hey, do you know about
feng shui？
translations.方角がいいとか悪いとかだよな。詳しくはないけど。:
That's the lucky and unlucky
directions thing, right？ I
don't know much about it.
translations.簡単に紹介してる本をみつけたの。例えば、南側の窓に黄色いものを置くと金運アップと:
I found a beginner's book.
It said putting something
yellow in a south window
brings you wealth.
translations.うん。……でもね、家の中に黄色いものって、あんまりなくて。……バナナを置いておい:
Yeah... But I didn't have
many yellow things at home...
So I used a banana.
translations.もう、笑わないで。だってそれしか見当たらなくて。でもね……。:
Jeez, don't laugh. It was
all I could find. But...
translations.気がついたら、バナナ黒くなってた……。:
Before I knew it, the
banana had turned black...
translations.はは、黄色いモノじゃなくなっちゃったじゃん。:
Haha, so it wasn't a yellow
thing anymore.
translations.そういえば▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、金運アップした？ ほら、風水の。:
Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did your money luck go up？
From the feng shui, I mean.
translations.まあ、バナナ黒くなっちゃったしな。:
Well, the banana did
turn black.
translations.そうだ、玄関に赤い物を置くと仕事運アップっていうのもあったよ。試してみたら？:
Oh right, putting something
red in the entryway boosts
work luck. Wanna try it？
translations.そう、男は仕事でしょ？:
Yeah, a man's gotta work,
right？
translations.仕事ってデキシーズのこと？:
By work, do you mean
at Dexee's？
translations.……高校生なんだし、勉強のことかな。そもそも仕事運ってなんだろうね？ 出世すると:
...Since we're high
schoolers, I guess it
means studying. What even
is work luck? Like getting
promoted?
translations.出世って、●が店長になったり、学級委員になったり……。:
Getting promoted...
Like ● becoming a store
manager, or class rep...
translations.男の人がお弁当を作ってもらうとしたら、どんなのがうれしいのかな。:
If a guy were to have a
bento made for him, what
kind would make him happy?
translations.あ、ごめんごめん。友達の話。カレシのために初めてお弁当を作るからって、相談された:
Ah, sorry, sorry. It's about
a friend. She asked me for
advice on making a bento
for her boyfriend.
translations.うーん、それぞれ好みがあるだろうしな。ひとくちに“男の人”といっても。:
Hmm, everyone has their
own tastes, you know.
You can't just group all
guys together.
translations.そうよね。カレシの情報がないと、私もどうしようもないかな。:
True. Without knowing
more about her boyfriend,
I can't really help her
much.
translations.その彼女は何も教えてくれなかったの？:
Did she not tell you
anything about him?
translations.それが恥ずかしがって、ぜんぜん教えてくれなかったの。:
She was too embarrassed,
so she didn't tell me
a single thing.
translations.はは、そういうことか。: Haha, so that's how it is.
translations.そういう初々しいところが、かわいいんだけど。今度ちゃんと聞いとくね。:
That innocent side of hers
is really cute, though.
I'll be sure to ask her
properly next time.
translations.友達がカレシにお弁当を作りたいって話したでしょ？ そのカレ、運動部なんだって。:
Remember my friend who
wanted to make a bento for
her boyfriend? Turns out
he's in a sports club.
translations.じゃあ弁当も、ガッツリ食べたいタイプだろうなあ。:
Then he's probably the type
who wants a really hearty
bento.
translations.量が多くて、お腹にたまるものか。とんかつとか？:
So something filling with
big portions. Like tonkatsu?
translations.そうだね。まずはボリュームだろうな。:
Yeah. Volume is definitely
the first priority.
translations.量があって、スタミナもつきそうなもの……栄養のバランスも考えないとね。:
Something filling that gives
stamina... We have to think
about nutrition, too.
translations.なんだか▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が、お弁当を作ってあげるみたいだな……。:
It almost sounds like you're
the one making the bento,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.ええ？ こんなことで嫉妬しちゃうの？:
Huh? Are you getting jealous
over something like this?
translations.もう、私は献立のアイディアは出すけど、作るのは彼女自身だから、安心していいよ。:
Jeez. I'm just giving her
ideas for the menu. She's
making it herself, so you
can rest easy.
translations.（それでも、ちょっとだけ複雑な心境だよな……）:
(Still, I can't help but feel
a little conflicted...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の友達だけど、ちゃんと彼氏に弁当作ってあげられたのかな。:
I wonder if your friend was
able to make that bento for
her boyfriend, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.それがね、まだ何を作るか決められないみたい。:
Actually, it seems she still
hasn't decided what to make.
translations.最初だから、完璧なものを食べて欲しいんだって。:
Since it's her first time,
she wants him to eat
something perfect.
translations.もらう方は何だって嬉しいと思うけどな。:
I think the guy receiving
it would be happy with
anything.
translations.そうかもしれないけど……たしかに、考えすぎちゃうのは良くないよね。:
That might be true... Yeah,
overthinking it probably
isn't good.
translations.きっと彼氏も待ってるよ。:
I'm sure her boyfriend is
looking forward to it.
translations.うん、彼女にもそう言ってあげることにする。:
Yeah, I'll make sure to
tell her that.
translations.私も応援しなくちゃね！: I have to cheer her on, too!
translations.彼女がね、報告のメールをくれたの。ほら、カレシにお弁当を作るって言ってた子。:
She sent me an email to
report back. You know, the
girl making a bento for
her boyfriend.
translations.お、ついにか。どうだった？: Oh, finally. How did it go?
translations.カレシはおいしいって、残さず食べてくれたって。:
She said her boyfriend
called it delicious and ate
every last bite.
translations.私もなんか自分のことみたいにうれしいの。ただね……。:
I'm so happy, it feels like
it happened to me. But...
translations.それで満足しちゃって、もうお弁当は作らなくていいや、だって。:
She was so satisfied with
it, she decided she doesn't
need to make him bentos
anymore.
translations.ええ？ 一回限り？:
Huh? It was a one-time
thing?
translations.そう、レア弁当になっちゃったの。:
Yep. It became a super rare
bento.
translations.この前、大家族もののドキュメンタリーやってたでしょ？:
Did you see that documentary
about the huge family
the other day？
translations.ああ、あんなに家族がいると、大変そうだよな。:
Yeah. Having a family
that big looks like
a lot of work.
translations.そうね。でも、家族が多いのって、そのぶん楽しいことも多いんだなって思った。:
True. But I also thought
that having a big family
means a lot more fun, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大家族が理想？:
Is a big family your ideal,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.理想、っていうわけじゃないけど……子供はたくさんいてもいいかな。:
I wouldn't say it's my ideal,
but... I wouldn't mind
having a lot of kids.
translations.こういう話、ちゃんと覚えておいたほうがいいかなって。:
I just thought I should
make sure to remember
this kind of thing.
translations.もちろん、忘れちゃイヤよ？:
Of course. I'd be upset
if you forgot, you know？
translations.大家族のテレビみてから、いろいろ考えちゃうの。どんな家庭が理想？:
That big family show got me
thinking about a lot.
What's your ideal family？
translations.家庭か……●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいれば……。:
A family, huh...
As long as ● has ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.こら、ずるいよ。ちゃんと答えて。:
Hey, that's cheating.
Give me a real answer.
translations.本当のことなんだけど……。まあ、安心できる家庭がいいよな。:
But it's the truth...
Well, I guess a family where
I can feel at ease.
translations.私もホッとできるっていうのは絶対だと思う。:
I definitely agree that
feeling at ease is a must.
translations.だからさ、●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいれば、ホッとできるんだって。:
I'm telling you, ●
can relax as long as
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is around.
translations.わかってる、ありがとう。私もあなたがいれば……それは同じだから。:
I know, thank you.
If I have you...
I feel the exact same way.
translations.理想の家庭の前に、理想の夫婦を考えるべきよね。:
Before an ideal family,
we should think about
the ideal married couple.
translations.ああ、この間の続き？:
Ah, picking up where we
left off the other day？
translations.大家族もいいけれど、まず夫婦ふたりの関係が基本でしょ？:
Big families are nice,
but the couple's bond is
the foundation, right？
translations.そうだね。理想の夫婦か……。これも難しいな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
True. An ideal couple...
That's a tough one, too.
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そうね……、いつまでたっても、仲良しなかわいいふたりが理想かな。:
Hmm... I think my ideal is
a cute couple that stays
close no matter how much
time passes.
translations.年取って、かわいいってのも、ちょっとな……。:
Being called 'cute' when
we're old is a little...
translations.どうして？ よくデキシーズにいらっしゃる、高齢のご夫婦とか、ステキだと思うけど。:
Why not？ I think the older
couples who come into Dexee's
are wonderful.
translations.ああ、手をつないで来店する？:
Ah, the ones who come in
holding hands？
translations.そう、あんなふたりが理想かな。:
Yeah, a couple like them
would be my ideal.
translations.（ちょっと、先の話しすぎないかな……）:
(Aren't we getting a bit too
far ahead of ourselves...)
translations.あのさ……この前の話。:
Hey... about what we
were talking about before.
translations.最終的な理想は、あんなふたりだと思うけど、もう少し前の、ほら若いときの理想は？:
A couple like that is the
ultimate ideal, but...
what about when they're
younger？
translations.今がもう理想なの、一緒に学校行って、一緒に勉強して、一緒にバイトして。ね、ずーっ:
Right now is already
my ideal. Going to school,
studying, working our
part-time jobs together...
I want us to stay like this
forever.
translations.でしょ。あなたのいる毎日が、私の理想なの。だから、ずっと一緒にいてね。:
Right？ Every day with you
is my ideal. So please,
stay with me forever.
translations.旅番組をみるのが、最近のブームなの。各地の郷土料理と、きれいな景色、どっちも見ら:
I've been really into
travel shows lately.
You get to see local food
and beautiful scenery.
translations.それ、わかる。テレビで観ると、美味しそうなんだよなあ。:
I get that. The food always
looks so good on TV.
translations.それで、そこに行きたくなるんだけど、さすがに遠いところは無理なのよね。魚市場で新:
It makes me want to go
there, but going far away
is tough. Eating fresh fish
at a market, or mountain
veggies... Sounds nice.
translations.うーんどうかな。ただ、想像して楽しんでるだけかも。:
Hmm, I wonder. I might just
be having fun imagining it.
translations.雑誌を読んで、旅に行った気分になったり？:
So you read magazines
and feel like you've
gone on a trip？
translations.そうなの。いつか行けたらいいな、なんて考えて。:
Exactly. I just think
about how nice it'd be
to go someday.
translations.こう見えても、かなり旅慣れてるんだよ。雑誌の中ではね？:
I may not look it, but
I'm quite the seasoned
traveler. In magazines,
at least？
translations.この間、テレビで駅弁祭りってイベントを紹介してたの。:
The other day, I saw
a TV show about a
train bento festival.
translations.全国の駅弁が一堂にそろってて、壮観だったよ。列車旅行の気分。:
They had bentos from
all over the country.
It was spectacular.
Felt like a train trip.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、楽しそうだね。:
You look like you're
having fun, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.だって、みんなおいしそうだったんだもん。:
Well, they all just
looked so delicious!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は何弁当が一番気になった？:
Which bento caught
your eye the most,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.一番か……定番だけど、イカめし、かな。餅米でぷっくり膨らんだ、かわいいイカが二杯:
The most... A classic,
but probably squid rice.
It has two cute squids
stuffed plump with rice.
translations.おいしそうだった。でも、ちょっと可愛くて、食べるのかわいそうかも。:
It looked delicious.
But they were so cute,
I might feel bad
eating them.
translations.この間話した、イカめしね、試しに家で作ってみたの。:
That squid rice we
talked about before,
I tried making it.
translations.へえ、どうだった？ 美味くできた？:
Oh, how was it？
Did it turn out good？
translations.うーん、まあまあかな。でもイメージとなにか違うんだよね。なにかな？:
Hmm, it was okay.
But it felt different
from what I imagined.
I wonder why？
translations.それは、たぶん……、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、どこで食べた？:
That's probably because...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, where did
you eat it？
translations.そういうのは外で食べないとさ、それこそ電車の中とか。:
You have to eat that
kind of thing outside,
like on a train.
translations.あ、そういうことか。それは難しいなあ。:
Ah, I see.
That's a bit tough.
translations.あのね、この間料理の味は、どこで食べるかが重要って、言ってたでしょ？:
Hey, remember how I said
where you eat is important
for the taste？
translations.ああ、駅弁の話ね。やっぱりシチュエーションは大事だよな。:
Ah, the bento talk.
The situation really
is important, huh.
translations.あともう一つ大事なこと、なんだと思う？:
What do you think is the
other important thing？
translations.答えはね、たくさん作ること。:
The answer is...
making a lot of it.
translations.あ、聞いたことあるかも。:
Ah, I think I've
heard that before.
translations.そう。同じレシピで作ってもね、大きなお鍋やお釜でたっぷり作った方が断然美味しいん:
Right. Even with the
same recipe, making a
big batch in a large pot
makes it way tastier.
translations.でも不思議だよな、なんでだろ。:
It's weird, though.
I wonder why.
translations.試してみようにも、機会がないのよね。あなたが１０人前くらい食べてくれればいいんだ:
I'd like to try it, but
I never get the chance.
Unless you're willing to
eat ten servings for me.
translations.デキシーズで抹茶のメニューが人気でしょ？:
Matcha items are popular
at Dexee's, right？
translations.女性だけじゃなくて男性客も時々注文してるよな。:
Yeah, not just women,
but guys order them
sometimes too.
translations.だから、もっとメニューを増やせないかなって。抹茶ならホットでもコールドでも、いろ:
So I was wondering if we
could add to the menu.
Matcha is so versatile,
hot or cold.
translations.抹茶スイーツって、そんなに種類あるの？:
Are there really that
many matcha sweets？
translations.うん、たくさん。すぐに思いつく、抹茶パフェとかアイスじゃもう通用しないかも。:
Yeah, tons. The usual
matcha parfaits and ice
cream might not cut it
anymore.
translations.抹茶っていろんな使い方をされてるから、これからインパクトを出すのは難しそう。:
Matcha is already used in 
so many ways, so it might 
be hard to stand out.
translations.でもそこは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら、考え出せるんじゃないか？:
But knowing you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
I'm sure you can come up 
with something!
translations.あんまり期待されるとプレッシャーだけど、何か考えて店長にプレゼンしてみようかな。:
That's a lot of pressure, 
but maybe I'll brainstorm 
and pitch it to the boss.
translations.抹茶スイーツの話、したじゃない。:
You remember us talking 
about matcha sweets, right?
translations.何か考え付いた？:
Did you come up with 
anything?
translations.まだ、イメージが浮かばなくて。だから、ちゃんと勉強しておこうと思って、最近お茶を:
I couldn't get a clear 
idea. So I decided to 
study and started taking 
tea ceremony classes.
translations.スイーツを考えるために茶道!!:
Tea ceremony classes just 
to brainstorm sweets?!
translations.お客様で教室を主催されてる方がいて。期間限定で、お邪魔させてもらってるの。体験学:
One of our regulars runs 
a class. I'm just sitting 
in for a bit. It's like a 
trial experience.
translations.それでも勉強まで始めるなんて●、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のこと尊敬するな。:
Still, going as far as 
studying it, ●... 
I really respect you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そんなたいしたことじゃないんだから。大げさね。:
It's really not that big 
of a deal. You're 
exaggerating.
translations.でも、店長に話してみたら、結構前向きに検討してくれるって。それならわたしも、中途:
But when I told the boss, 
he said he'd seriously 
consider it. So I can't 
just give a half-hearted 
pitch, right?
translations.お茶って始めてみると、面白いね。お作法の一つ一つにちゃんと意味があるの。:
Tea ceremony is actually 
really fun once you start. 
Every single movement 
has a meaning to it.
translations.なんだか堅苦しそうだけど……。:
It seems kind of stiff 
and formal, though...
translations.私も最初はそう思ったよ。でもそれだけじゃないの。茶道の心って接客業みたいなところ:
I thought so too at first. 
But there's more to it. 
The spirit of tea ceremony 
is a lot like hospitality...
translations.最初はスイーツの参考にって思ってたけど、他にも学べることがたくさんある気がするな:
I only started it for 
sweets inspiration, but 
I feel like there's so 
much more I can learn.
translations.それなら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はさらに完璧なウェイトレスになるわけだ。:
In that case, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
you'll become an even 
more perfect waitress.
translations.目指してるわけじゃないけど……完璧にはほど遠いかな。:
That's not exactly my 
goal... and I'm far 
from perfect anyway.
translations.そうよ。この前だってお茶の席のあと足がしびれて転んじゃって……。:
It's true. Just the other 
day, my legs fell asleep 
during a tea session and 
I totally tripped...
translations.はは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲でもそんなことあるんだな。はははっ。:
Haha, so even you have 
moments like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. 
Hahaha.
translations.抹茶スイーツの件、どうなった？:
How did the matcha 
sweets thing go?
translations.実は……もう店長にプレゼンしたんだけど……。:
Well... I actually pitched 
it to the boss already...
translations.ダメだったんだ。でもなんで。:
It didn't go well, huh? 
But why?
translations.ちょっと気合入れすぎちゃって。:
I think I got a little 
too fired up.
translations.お茶を習ったり、本を読んでたくさん勉強したんだけど、それが裏目に出ちゃった感じ。:
I took tea classes, read 
books, and studied a ton, 
but I feel like it all 
backfired on me.
translations.肝心のお客様のことほっておいて、自分ばっかり楽しんじゃって。ただ豪華で派手なスイ:
I completely forgot about 
the customers and just had 
fun with it myself. I only 
came up with flashy, 
extravagant sweets.
translations.自分でも気づかないくらい暴走してたみたいで、店長ちょっと引いてた。自分で「茶道の:
I was so out of control 
without realizing it, the 
boss was a bit put off. 
It's embarrassing after 
I talked up the 'spirit 
of tea ceremony' so much.
translations.まあ、これも勉強になったってことで。:
Well, look at it as 
a learning experience.
translations.うん、今回は完全に失敗。:
Yeah, this was a total 
failure.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲でもこんなことあるんだな……）:
(So even ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has 
moments like this...)
translations.あの家のお爺さん、\n今日も道路の掃除してるんだ。:
That old man is out 
sweeping the street 
again today.
translations.ううん。\nただここを通ると、\nよく掃除してるから。:
No. I just see him 
cleaning a lot 
when I pass by.
translations.へえ、毎日してるのかな。:
Huh, I wonder if 
he does it every day.
translations.いい人そうだし、\n話しかけてみようかな。\n……もちろん今度ね、\n今はデート:
He seems nice, so maybe 
I'll try talking to him. 
...Some other time, though. 
We're on a date right now♪
translations.あっ……今日、\nのど飴なくなっちゃうかも。:
Ah... I might run out 
of throat drops today.
translations.いつもたくさん持ち歩いてるのに珍しいね。:
That's rare. You usually 
carry a bunch with you.
translations.うん買い置き切らせてたときに、\nちょうど買いに行けなくて。:
Yeah, I ran out of my stash 
and just haven't had time 
to go buy more.
translations.じゃ、コンビニに寄ってく？:
Should we stop by a 
convenience store, then？
translations.うーん、せっかくだし、我慢。\n節約＆ダイエット、飴のカロリーだって無視できない:
Hmm, I think I'll just 
hold off for now. 
Saving money and dieting! 
Can't ignore the calories 
in candy, you know.
translations.（そんなに気にしなくてもいいのに）:
(She really doesn't need 
to worry about that...)
translations.向こうから並んで\n歩いてくるの、近くの\n幼稚園の子たちよね。\nかわいい。:
Those kids walking in a 
line over there must be 
from the nearby preschool. 
So cute.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って\n小さい子見るとき、\n優しい顔するよね。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you always make 
such a gentle face when 
you look at little kids.
translations.そうかな？ 自分では\nわからないけど……。:
I do？ I guess I don't 
really notice it myself...
translations.きっといいお母さんに\nなると思うな。:
I bet you're gonna make 
a really great mom.
translations.ありがと……でも、\nお母さんの前に\nお嫁さんになりたい、かな？:
Thanks... But before 
I become a mom, I'd like 
to be a bride first, y'know？
translations.あっ、そこ。\n水たまりがあるから、\nもうちょっとこっち。:
Ah, watch out. 
There's a puddle there, 
so step a bit closer to me.
translations.ほんとだ、ありがとう。\nなんだかエスコートされてる気分。:
Oh, you're right, thanks. 
I feel like I'm being 
escorted or something.
translations.そんな大げさな……\n「さ、お手をどうぞ？」\nとか、そんな感じ？:
That's an exaggeration... 
Like, "Here, take my hand？" 
Something like that？
translations.あそこに建ってる古い洋館。\nずっと買い手がつかないまま\n放置されてるのよね。:
That old Western-style 
house over there. 
It's been abandoned forever 
without finding a buyer.
translations.たぶん私が生まれるずっと前から。:
Probably since way before 
I was even born.
translations.その間、ずっと放置されっぱなし？\nなんか住みついてそうだな……霊的な。:
It's just been sitting 
there all that time？ 
Feels like something might 
live there... like a ghost.
translations.え、面白そう……。\nでも虫とかネズミとかもいそうよね。\nやめといた方がいいか:
Ooh, that sounds fun... 
But there'd probably be 
bugs and mice too. 
Maybe we shouldn't.
translations.知ってるところへの移動って、\nいつも同じ道になっちゃうよね。:
When going somewhere 
familiar, we always end up 
taking the same route, huh.
translations.うん、まあ。\nあえて別の道を選ぶ理由でもないとね。:
Yeah, I guess. 
No real reason to go out 
of our way to take another.
translations.今日はたくさん、\n一緒に並んで歩きたい気分だな～。\nこれじゃダメ？:
I'm just in the mood to 
walk side-by-side with you 
a lot today~ 
Is that bad？
translations.じゃあ、ちょっとだけ別の道、\n行ってみよ？:
Then let's try taking a 
slightly different route？
translations.わっ……今すれ違った子、\nアイラインくっきり、\nまつげもパッチリ。:
Wow... That girl we just 
passed had such thick 
eyeliner and big lashes.
translations.すごいギャルメイクだな。\nうちの学校にはああいう女子いないね。:
That's some heavy gyaru 
makeup. We don't have girls 
like that at our school.
translations.うん、私も友達にはいないな……。:
Yeah, I don't have any 
friends who do that either...
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がもし\nギャルメイクをしたら……）:
(I wonder what it'd be like 
if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wore gyaru makeup...)
translations.ふふっ。\nやってみよっか？:
Hehe. 
Wanna see me try it？
translations.あの女の人のバッグから\n顔出してるの、\nトイプードルよね。:
That's a toy poodle 
poking its head out of 
that woman's bag, right？
translations.ちっちゃいな。\nまだ子供かな。:
It's so tiny. 
Must still be a puppy.
translations.大人になってもあんまり\n大きさは変わらない\nらしいよ？:
I heard they don't really 
change in size much even 
when they grow up, y'know？
translations.へえ、大きくなったら面白いのにな。\nバッグにギュウギュウに入ってて。:
Huh, it'd be funny if it
got big, though. Just
crammed into that bag.
translations.さっきすれ違ったカップル、\n人目気にせずイチャイチャしてたね。:
That couple we just passed
was being awfully flirty
in public, huh.
