▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Did something happen？
translations.大したことじゃないの。\nこの舞台を観てたらね、\nほんとにどうでもよくなっちゃ:
It's nothing major.
Watching this play made me
forget all about it.
I feel re-energized.
translations.そっか。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が元気になったら、\n観てよかったよ。:
I see.
If it cheered you up, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
then I'm glad we saw it.
translations.う～ん……最近の曲で\n歌えるのあるかな。:
Hmm... I wonder if there
are any recent songs I
can actually sing.
translations.聴いたことあっても、\n歌えない曲って多いよね。:
There are a lot of songs
you can't sing even if
you've heard them before.
translations.途中でわかんなく\nなっちゃうんだよな。:
I always end up losing
track in the middle.
translations.じゃあ一緒に歌お？\nわからないところがあったら、\nお互いフォローするの。:
Then let's sing together？
If there's a part we don't
know, we'll cover for each
other.
translations.了解。\n最後までいけるかな？:
Got it.
Think we can make it to
the end？
translations.さあ、どうでしょう。:
Well, we'll just have to
wait and see.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って実は\n歌上手いよね。:
You're actually really
good at singing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ううん……\n音ハズさないように\n必死だったんだから。:
No way...
I was trying desperately
not to sing off-key.
translations.でも、こんなにキーの\n高い曲、そのまま歌える\nなんてやっぱりすごいよ。:
But being able to sing a
song with such a high key
like that is amazing.
translations.そんなにおだてると……\n仕返しにリクエストしちゃお。:
If you flatter me like
that... I'll just have to
request a song in return.
translations.えっ、こんな難しい曲っ!?\nなんで……。:
Whoa, such a hard song!?
Why...
translations.あなたも難しい曲歌えれば、\nおあいこでしょ？\nほーらっ。:
If you can sing a hard
song too, we'll be even,
right？ Here you go.
translations.ふぅ……ちょっと休憩。\n何か飲む？:
Phew... let's take a break.
Want something to drink？
translations.飲み物もいいけど、\nここ、スイーツも人気なのよね。:
A drink sounds nice, but
the sweets here are really
popular too.
translations.……私は、\nジャンボハニートースト\nにしようかな。\nあなたは？:
...I think I'll go with
the Jumbo Honey Toast.
What about you？
translations.（“あなたは？”って、\nこれ一人で食べる気なのかな……）:
("What about you？" Wait,
is she planning to eat
that all by herself...？)
translations.観覧車に乗ってるとさ、\n閉じこめられたら、\nどうしようって思うよな。:
When you ride a Ferris
wheel, don't you wonder
what you'd do if you
got trapped inside？
translations.そんなありきたりな\nシチュエーションじゃ……。:
That's such a cliché
situation to be in...
translations.わっ、ごめん。\n●が変なこと言ったせいかな。:
Whoa, sorry.
Maybe it's because ●
said something weird.
translations.だとしたらすごいけど……。\nじゃあ、このまま\n閉じ込められてずっと\n二人っ:
If so, that's amazing...
Then try saying we'll be
trapped in here alone
together forever？
translations.ね、隣に座ってもいい？:
Hey, can I sit
next to you？
translations.細かいこと気にしないの。\nそれに女の子に重量だなんて。:
Don't worry about the
little things. Besides,
mentioning a girl's weight？
translations.ごめん、\nそういう意味じゃなくて。:
Sorry,
I didn't mean it like that.
translations.罰として、\n膝の上に座っちゃおっかなあ？:
As punishment, maybe I'll
just sit right on your lap？
translations.（……それは罰じゃないかも）:
(...That might not be
much of a punishment.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲さ、\n全然怖がってないけど、\nやっぱり平気？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you aren't scared
at all. Are you really okay？
translations.だって、いかにも人形って\nわかる作りだもん。\nもう少し……。:
I mean, it's so obvious
they're just dolls.
If they were a little...
translations.……今のは怖いっていうより、\n驚いたんだもん……。:
...That wasn't scary,
it just startled me...
translations.ここのお化け屋敷、\nもう少し工夫したら\nもっと恐くなると思うのに。:
This haunted house would
be so much scarier if they
just put in a little
more effort.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の話聞いてると、\nスタッフの話みたいに\n聞こえてくるよ。:
Listening to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
it sounds like you're one
of the staff members.
translations.それいいかも。\n一度私の好きなように\n作らせて欲しいな。:
That might be fun.
I'd love to design it
however I want just once.
translations.（本当に作らせたら、\n相当恐いのができそうだな……）:
(If they actually let her,
she'd probably make
something terrifying...)
translations.ありがとう、\n手……握っててくれて。:
Thank you...
for holding my hand.
translations.そりゃあんだけ怖がってたら、\nほっとけないよ。:
Well, I couldn't just
leave you when you were
that scared.
translations.うん、一人じゃ無理。\n誰かに手握っててもらわないと\n乗れないな……。:
Yeah, I can't do it alone.
I can't ride unless someone
is holding my hand...
translations.あ、間違えちゃった♪\n“あなたに”ね？:
Ah, my mistake♪
I meant 'unless you are,'
okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n引きつった笑顔なんだけど\n大丈夫？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, your smile is
looking a bit stiff.
Are you okay？
translations.……なんだか映画で、\nこれから事件が起こるって\nときの高揚感に似てる……。:
...It feels like that rush
in a movie right before
an incident happens...
translations.そう言われればそうかも？\n結構余裕あるね？:
Now that you mention it,
maybe？ You seem pretty
relaxed.
translations.今日は一日楽しかったね。\n疲れたけど……。:
Today was really fun.
I'm exhausted, though...
translations.まだナイトパレードが\n残ってるでしょ？\nほら……。:
We still have the night
parade left, don't we？
Look...
translations.（この雰囲気なら、\n肩を抱くくらいしても……）:
(With this atmosphere,
maybe I could put my arm
around her shoulder...)
translations.ロマンチックだね。\n……ね、寄りかかってもいい？:
It's so romantic.
...Hey, can I lean on you？
translations.はぁ……もう、\nため息しか出ない。\n言葉になんかできないよね。:
Haa... I can't help but
sigh. Words really can't
describe it, can they？
translations.夢の国か……今だけ、\n●たちも夢の国の一員\nなんだよな。:
A land of dreams...
For now, ● and I
are a part of that
dreamland too.
translations.いつもより\nロマンチストなんだ？:
Aren't you being a bit more
romantic than usual？
translations.じゃあ、今日は\n私だけの王子様になってくれる？:
Then, will you be
my very own prince
for today？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、パレード見える？\n人が多くて、これ以上前には\n出られないか……:
Can you see the parade,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ It's so crowded,
we can't get any closer...
translations.仕方ないよ。\n割り込むわけにもいかないし。:
It can't be helped.
We can't just cut in line.
translations.でも、せっかく来たのに……\n肩車でもする？:
But we came all this way...
Want a piggyback ride？
translations.それはちょっと……\n色々と問題が。\nでもね、いいの。:
That might be...
a bit problematic.
But you know, it's fine.
translations.また一緒に来る理由に\nなるでしょう？\n次は前に行けるようにしようね？:
It gives us a reason to
come back together, right？
Let's go up front next time.
translations.……もう、そんなにジロジロ見られたら、恥ずかしいでしょう？:
...Jeez, it's embarrassing
when you stare at me
like that, you know？
translations.ごめん、気をつける。できるだけ見ないようにするよ。:
Sorry, I'll be careful.
I'll try not to look.
translations.ダメ。見ないのは、ダメ。:
No. Not looking at me
is also bad.
translations.だって、そうしたら他の人のこと見ようとするでしょ？ だからダメ。:
Because then you'll try
to look at other people,
won't you？ So no.
translations.混んでるね。流れるプールなんか、みんな浸かって浮いてるだけだよ。:
It's crowded. In the lazy
river, everyone's just
soaking and floating.
translations.……どうしよっか。とりあえずプールサイドで何か飲む？:
...What should we do.
Wanna grab a drink by
the pool for now？
translations.せっかく来たんだしな……競泳用のプールは空いてるよ。:
We came all this way...
The competition pool
is pretty empty.
translations.それは……競泳用って深いよね？ 私、無理かも。:
Well... competition pools
are deep, right？
I don't think I can.
translations.大丈夫だって、他にあんまり人もいないし。●につかまってゆっくり泳げば。:
It's fine, there's hardly
anyone there. Just hold onto
● and swim slowly.
translations.あなたにつかまって？ ……でも私重いもん、一緒に沈んじゃうよ。:
Hold onto you？ ...But I'm
heavy, we'll sink together.
translations.相談なんだけど、泳げるようになった方がいいと思う？:
I have a question... Do you
think I should learn how
to swim？
translations.そうかもしれないけど……無理する必要もないよ。:
Maybe, but... there's no
need to force yourself.
translations.あ、できないと思ってる……やっぱりやる！ 個人レッスンお願いしていい？:
Ah, you think I can't...
I'm gonna do it! Can I ask
for private lessons？
translations.でも……優しく教えてね。お願いします、コーチ▼:
But... teach me gently.
Please, Coach ▼.
translations.ね……こうしてると、星空にふわふわ浮かんでるような、不思議な気分になってこない？:
Hey... floating like this,
doesn't it feel magical,
like we're in the stars？
translations.一緒に……このまま……どこか遠くに……。:
Together... just like this...
drifting somewhere
far away...
translations.流されてくのも……いいかも。:
Letting ourselves be swept
away... might be nice.
translations.本当にそんな気分よね。:
It really does feel
like that, doesn't it？
translations.えっと……星空がね。: Um... the starry sky, I mean.
translations.あと……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もね、なんつって。:
And... you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Just kidding.
translations.そんなとってつけた言い方しないの。そういうことは、照れずにちゃんと言って？:
Don't just tack it on
like that. You should say it
properly, without being shy.
translations.……星座って全部にこんなストーリーがあるのかな。:
...I wonder if all the
constellations have
stories like this.
translations.そうみたいね。興味出てきた？:
Seems like it.
Are you getting interested？
translations.……ちょっと面白そう、とは思ったよ。:
...I did think it looked
a little interesting.
translations.私も少し。ロビーに資料展示があったから、見てみよっか。:
Me too, a bit. There was an
exhibit in the lobby,
so let's go take a look.
translations.ここって、ブロックごとに色んな地域の植物があるのね。:
So, they have plants from
different regions in
each block here, huh.
translations.じゃ、世界中の気候が再現されてるってことかな。:
I guess that means they've
recreated climates from
all over the world.
translations.アマゾンの隣の部屋が、いきなりスイスの山の上だったりして。:
Like, the room next to the
Amazon might suddenly be
the top of a Swiss mountain.
translations.それ、見る方が大変だよ。:
That'd be pretty tough on
the people looking at them.
translations.ふふ、きっと見る人のことも考えてあるから、大丈夫じゃないかな。:
Hehe, I'm sure they've
thought about the visitors,
so it should be fine.
translations.……うん。でも、強過ぎないかな。:
...Yeah. But isn't it
a little too strong？
translations.うん、長居すると頭痛くなりそう。:
Yeah, I feel like I'd get a
headache if we stayed long.
translations.そうね、少しだったらいいんだけど。別のところに行く？:
Right. It's nice in small
doses, but... Want to go
somewhere else？
translations.次の部屋はなんの匂いかな♪:
I wonder what the next room
will smell like♪
translations.（そっちが楽しみ？）:
(Is that what she's
looking forward to？)
translations.珍しい植物もいいけど、庭に咲いてる普通の花にも癒されたりするよね。:
Rare plants are nice, but
normal flowers blooming in
a garden are soothing too.
translations.そうだね、こういうとこに来ると、逆にそれがわかるかも。:
Yeah, coming to a place like
this might actually make you
realize that.
translations.幸せは意外と身近にあるってことかな。:
I guess it means happiness
is surprisingly close by.
translations.……そうね、私にとっての幸せは、ほら、こんな手の届く範囲にあるよ。:
...Yeah. My happiness is
right here, see？
Well within my reach.
translations.えっと……うん、楽しかった……かな。:
Um... Yeah, I think I
had fun...
translations.もう、顔色うかがっちゃって。:
Jeez, you're totally trying
to read my expression.
translations.ごめん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の反応が気になって。:
Sorry, I was just worried
about your reaction, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私はね、すっごく楽しかった。だから許してあげます♪:
Well, I had a ton of fun.
So I'll forgive you♪
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、割と静かだったけど、つまんなかった？:
You were pretty quiet, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Were you bored？
translations.ううん、そんなことないよ。そう見えちゃうかあ。:
No, not at all.
Did it look that way？
translations.たまにあるの、こう静かに楽しんじゃうことが。:
Sometimes I just end up
enjoying things quietly
like this.
translations.うん、今のイベントは……そこそこ楽しかった、かな。:
Yeah, that event was...
pretty fun, I guess.
translations.ちょっと今のは酷すぎたよね。:
That was a bit too awful
just now, wasn't it.
translations.●もそう思った。あれで客を呼んじゃうのはなあ。:
So you thought so too, ●.
I can't believe they invite
guests for that.
translations.……はぁ。今日は勉強になったと思えばいいのかな。:
...Sigh. I guess we can just
chalk today up as a
learning experience.
translations.クラシックのコンサートってもっと堅苦しいものだと思ってた。:
I thought classical concerts
were a lot more stuffy.
translations.カジュアルだったよな、童謡からアニメソングまであって。:
It was pretty casual, huh？
They had everything from
nursery rhymes to
anime songs.
translations.うん、やっぱり知ってる曲が流れると、安心するよね。……また来たいな。:
Yeah, it's definitely a
relief when they play a
song you know.
...I want to come again.
translations.そう言ってもらえると、●もうれしいよ。:
I'm glad to hear you
say that, ●.
translations.それに、デートでクラシックのコンサートって、ちょっとかっこいいじゃない？:
Besides, going to a
classical concert for a
date is pretty cool,
don't you think？
translations.アイドルのライブって、ファンしか楽しめないかもって思ってたけど、そんなことないね:
I thought idol concerts were
only fun for the fans, but
that's not true at all.
translations.うん、そこまで詳しくないけど、最後にＭＣした……。:
Yeah, I don't know much
about them, but the one
who was the MC at the end...
translations.関西弁の？ トーク上手かったね。:
The one with the Kansai
dialect？ She was a great
talker.
translations.うん、あのトークだけで彼女のファンになっちゃったかも。:
Yeah, I think I might've
become a fan just from
listening to her talk.
translations.はは、このままハマっちゃったりして？:
Haha, think you might
get hooked？
translations.そしたら、あなたが困っちゃう？ ふふ♪:
Would that be a problem
for you？ Fufu♪
translations.やっぱり生のミュージカルっていいね。:
Live musicals really
are the best.
translations.うん、映画とは全然違うし。:
Yeah, it's totally
different from movies.
translations.始まるまでもドキドキしてたんだけど、終わったらそれ以上に興奮しちゃった。:
I was already excited
before it started, but
now that it's over, I'm
even more pumped.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がそんなになるなんて珍しいね。:
It's rare to see you get
like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.こういうの、夢見心地っていうんだろうな……。なんだか気持ちいい。:
I guess this is what
they mean by a dreamlike
state... It feels nice.
translations.……少し。なんだか熱気にあてられちゃったかな。:
...A little. I think the
heat of the moment
got to me.
translations.まるで▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が試合した後みたいだな。:
It's almost like you
were the one in the
match, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私には真似だって無理だよ。見てるだけでこんなになっちゃうんだもん。:
I couldn't even pretend
to do that. Just
watching makes me like
this.
translations.きっとリングにあがったら、ゴング鳴った瞬間にヒューって気絶しちゃうんだから。:
If I got in the ring,
I'd probably pass out
the second the bell
rings.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲さ、野球のルールわかってない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do you not know
the rules of baseball？
translations.結構きょとんとしてることが多かったからさ。:
You looked pretty
confused a lot of the
time.
translations.やっぱり……。それだと観てても楽しくなかったんじゃ……。:
I knew it... It must not
have been fun to watch,
then...
translations.ううん、楽しかったよ。周りのおじさん達と一緒に応援できたり……不思議な一体感よね:
No, it was fun. Cheering
with the older guys
around us... It was a
weird sense of unity.
translations.そんなこと気にしてたんだ。気にせず自分も楽しまなきゃダメよ？:
You were worried about
that？ You need to stop
worrying and just enjoy
yourself, okay？
translations.どうだった？ やっぱり映画系が中心？:
How was it？ Was it
mostly movie stuff？
translations.そうね……でもそれ以外だと、アクセサリーが面白かったな。:
Yeah... but besides
that, the accessories
were interesting.
translations.なんでもアリなのね。本だけじゃなくて、ＣＤとかゲームとか小物とか。:
Anything goes, huh？
Not just books, but CDs,
games, and trinkets.
translations.うん、これでも全部は見きれてないんだろうな。:
Yeah, and I bet we still
haven't seen everything.
translations.世の中には、多様な趣味がありますな？:
There sure are a lot of
diverse hobbies in the
world, huh？
translations.小学校高学年の頃かな、こうやって、カレとこのベイブリッジでデートするのに憧れてた:
Around late elementary
school, I used to dream
of going on a date with
my boyfriend at the Bay
Bridge like this.
translations.へえ、小学生の頃にか。女の子は大人だよな。:
Wow, since elementary
school？ Girls really
mature fast.
translations.そうかも。周りの友達もみんな賛同してくれたし。:
Maybe. All my friends
agreed with me, too.
translations.大げさかもしれないけど、ひとつ夢がかなってるわけだ。:
It might be an
exaggeration, but I
guess one of your dreams
came true.
translations.うん……今はもう特別なことじゃないけど、考えてみると、これってとっても素敵なこと:
Yeah... It's not a big
deal anymore, but when
you think about it, it's
a really wonderful
thing...
translations.……あんまり横、見ない方がいいと思うな。:
...I don't think you
should look to the side
too much.
translations.もうっ、声に出さないの。:
Jeez, don't say it out
loud.
translations.ごめん。……でも他にもカップル結構いるなあ……。:
Sorry. ...But there are
quite a few other
couples here...
translations.よそはよそです。あなたはイイ子だもんね？:
Never mind them. You're
a good boy, right？
translations.この前、橋を封鎖してドラマの撮影、やってたんだって。:
I heard they closed off
the bridge to film a
drama the other day.
translations.へえ。通行量多いのに、大変だな。:
Wow. There's a lot of
traffic, so that must've
been tough.
translations.早朝の、まだ車が少ないうちに撮影したみたい。私の好きな俳優が主演だから見に行きた:
They filmed early in the
morning before traffic.
My favorite actor is starring,
so I wanted to go see it.
translations.その頃、私は夢の中であなたに会ってました▼:
Around that time, I was busy
meeting you in my dreams.▼
translations.そう。イケメン俳優に勝っちゃったんだから、自慢しちゃえ♪:
Yep. You beat out a handsome
actor, so you should be proud♪
translations.ちょっと日差しが強すぎるかな。日焼け止め塗ってきた？:
The sun's a bit too strong.
Did you put on sunscreen？
translations.塗ってきたけど、これだけ強いと、あんまり効果ないかも。:
I did, but with it this
strong, it might not do much.
translations.そっか……女の子は大変だよね。: I see... Girls have it rough.
translations.でも……せっかく海に来たんだもの、楽しまなくちゃもったいないでしょ？:
But... we came all the way
to the beach. It'd be a waste
not to have fun, right？
translations.水着の境目、気になっちゃって。日焼け跡、どんな感じかなって。:
I'm worried about my tan
lines. I wonder how they look.
translations.ふぅ……遊び疲れちゃった。夕暮れの海って、眠くなるね……。:
Phew... I'm worn out.
The ocean at dusk makes
me sleepy...
translations.ほんと。家までもつかな……。:
Yeah. I wonder if I'll last
until we get home...
translations.もう、カワイイ▼ 子供みたい。:
Jeez, you're so cute, ▼.
Just like a kid.
translations.いいよ、ちょっとぐらいなら休んでも。:
It's okay, you can rest
for a little bit.
translations.静かな浜辺で波の音を聴くのもいいね。:
Listening to the waves on a
quiet beach is nice, too.
translations.夏の騒々しさが嘘みたいだ。:
It makes the summer hustle
and bustle feel like a lie.
translations.ね、好きって言って？: Hey, tell me you love me？
translations.人の少ない海って、ちょっと寂しいね。:
An empty beach is a little
lonely, isn't it？
translations.じゃあ今日は、寧々さんが人生相談に乗ってあげましょう。:
Then today, Nene-san will
listen to your life troubles.
translations.いいよ、そこまでじゃないし。それに、今は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が隣にいればいいよ。:
No, it's not that bad. Plus,
I'm happy as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
is by my side right now.
translations.あ……もう、誰も聞いてないからって、そんなこと言って……。:
Ah... Jeez, just because no
one is listening, you say
things like that...
translations.昔の青春ドラマだと“バカヤロー”って叫んで走ったりするよね？:
In old teen dramas, they'd yell
'You idiot!' and run, right？
translations.へえ、そうなんだ……古いドラマね。:
Oh, is that so...
Old dramas, huh.
translations.あっ私もそんなに詳しくはないよ？ たまたま再放送観ただけで！:
Ah, I don't know that much
about them! I just happened
to see a rerun!
translations.はは、わかってるって。ひとつしか違わないんだし。:
Haha, I know. We're only
one year apart, anyway.
translations.……そうよね。うん、ひとつしか違わないんだもん♪:
...Right. Yeah, we're only
one year apart♪
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、水槽にらんでどうしたの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, why are you glaring
at the tank？
translations.……もしかして、ずっと見てた？:
...Wait, were you watching me
this whole time？
translations.うん……マンボウのマネしてたとか。:
Yeah... Were you doing
a sunfish impression?
translations.うん、なんとなく。この子って、なんとなく愛嬌があるでしょ？:
Yeah, kinda. This little guy
is just so charming, right？
translations.（でもほっぺたふくらましてたらフグみたいだよな……）:
(But when she puffs out
her cheeks, she looks
more like a pufferfish...)
translations.マンボウって、何にも考えてないみたいでうらやましいよな。:
Sunfish look like they don't
have a care in the world.
I'm kinda jealous.
translations.でも、マンボウを食べる地域もあるみたいよ。食べられちゃうかも？:
But some places actually eat
sunfish, you know. You might
end up as someone's dinner？
translations.んー、美味しそう……かなあ？:
Hmm, I wonder...
if you'd be tasty？
translations.こっち見て言わないで……。:
Don't say that while
staring at me...
translations.ペンギンのコミカルな動きって、癒されると思わない？:
Don't you think the comical
way penguins move is
super soothing？
translations.こうやって、ヨチヨチ歩きするのが？:
You mean how they waddle
around like this？
translations.あはは！ ペンギンのマネ、上手♪:
Ahaha! You do a really good
penguin impression♪
translations.……そんなにウケるんだ……ちょっとショック。:
...I didn't think it'd be
THAT funny...
I'm a little hurt.
translations.落ち込まないの。大丈夫、カワイイから▼:
Don't be so down. It's okay,
you were really cute, ▼.
translations.ペンギンって空飛びたいって思わないのかな。:
I wonder if penguins ever
wish they could fly.
translations.あのずんぐりした身体だと、難しそうだな……。翼も相当大きくないと。:
With those chubby bodies,
it'd be pretty tough... They'd
need some huge wings.
translations.想像したら、ちょっと恐いね。:
Now that I picture it,
it's actually kinda scary.
translations.うん。ペンギンは今のかわいいままでＯＫ。:
Yeah. Penguins are perfectly
fine being cute as they are.
translations.ちょっと水槽の見え方が変わるだけなのに……幻想的。ため息出ちゃう。:
Just a slight change in how
we see the tank... So magical.
It takes my breath away.
translations.ほんとに海底にいるような感覚になるね……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？:
It really feels like we're
at the bottom of the sea...
Right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.海の底だって思うと、ちょっと怖いね。私、泳げないし……。:
Thinking about being at the
bottom of the sea is a bit
scary. Plus, I can't swim...
translations.大丈夫！ 海の底だったらどうせ泳げても関係ないから！:
It's fine! If we were at the
bottom of the sea, being able
to swim wouldn't help!
translations.えっ……もう、それ解決になってないよ。:
Eh... Geez, that doesn't
solve anything.
translations.このトンネルだけで、どれくらいの魚がいるのかな。:
I wonder how many fish
are just in this tunnel.
translations.小さいのを入れれば、数万匹らしいよ。……って書いてあった。:
If you count the small ones,
there's tens of thousands...
or so the sign says.
translations.もう、水槽の魚でお腹鳴らしちゃうなんて、男の子だね。:
Geez, your stomach growling
just from looking at fish...
You're such a boy.
translations.水族館の目玉といえば、やっぱりイルカショーかな。:
When you think of aquariums,
the main attraction has to be
the dolphin show, right？
translations.そうかも。人も一番多いし。:
Probably. It definitely draws
the biggest crowd.
translations.小さい頃、イルカの飼育員になりたい！ って言ってた気がするな。:
I think when I was little,
I used to say I wanted to be
a dolphin trainer!
translations.体験できるんじゃなかったっけ。申し込んでみる？:
Don't they have a program
for that？ Wanna sign up？
translations.……それはいい、かな。実はちょっと怖くて。:
...I think I'll pass.
I'm actually a little scared
of them.
translations.はは、じゃあ飼育員は厳しいね。:
Haha, guess being a trainer
would be pretty tough then.
translations.イルカは人間の言葉がわかるって本当かな。:
I wonder if it's true that
dolphins can understand
human words.
translations.うーん、試してみよっか。はい、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
Hmm, let's test it out.
Go ahead, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.隣にいるのが私のカレシです、って。雰囲気で伝わったかな？:
'The guy next to me is my
boyfriend.' Do you think they
got the gist of it？
translations.（伝わんないと思うけど……かわいかったな）:
(I doubt they got it...
but that was really cute.)
translations.海風に吹かれてると、気持ちいいよね。:
The sea breeze feels
so nice, doesn't it？
translations.んーっ！ 嫌なこともぜーんぶ忘れちゃえるよね。:
Mmm! It makes you forget
all your worries.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ効果あったんだ。よかったよかった。:
Haha, so it worked.
That's good.
translations.ちょっと風が出てきたけど……寒くない？:
The wind's picking up
a bit... Are you cold？
translations.少し……けど、それくらいがちょうど良いかも。だって……。:
A little... But maybe
this is just right.
Because...
translations.……体温感じるでしょ？:
...You can feel my body
heat, right？
translations.この公園、ここからの風景が一番きれいなんだって。:
They say the view from
here is the prettiest
in the park.
translations.詳しいんだ。他の人とも来たことあったりして？:
You sure know a lot.
Have you been here
with someone else？
translations.まさか！ 看板にそう書いてあったんだって。:
No way! It just said
so on the sign.
translations.ごめんなさい。一番きれいな風景、楽しも？:
Sorry. Let's enjoy
the prettiest view, okay？
translations.こうしてみると、この街でまだ知らない場所って結構あるのかもな。:
Looking around, there's
probably a lot of places
in this town I don't know.
translations.そうかもしれないね、私だってそうだもん。:
That might be true.
Even I don't know it all.
translations.うん、あなたよりは長く住んでる分、詳しいと思うけど。:
Yeah, though I've lived
here longer than you,
so I probably know more.
translations.え～？ ……オホン。では観光案内を始めます。右手に見えますのが……。:
Eh？ ...Ahem. The tour
will now begin. If you
look to your right...
translations.結構よくわからないお土産物があるよね。:
There are some pretty
weird souvenirs here.
translations.キーホルダーとかは定番だけど……なんで木刀があるんだろう。:
Keychains are standard,
but... why do they have
wooden swords？
translations.うん、タワーとはまったく関係ないし……。:
Yeah, they have nothing
to do with the tower...
translations.ここ、タワーが建つ前は道場だった……とか。だから木刀。:
Maybe this place was a
dojo before the tower was
built... Hence the swords.
translations.あーっ、そんな顔して。ほんとだもん、ここは道場だったんだもん。:
Ah, don't give me that
look. It's true, this
place used to be a dojo!
translations.（そんな意地はらなくても……）:
(You don't have to be
so stubborn about it...)
translations.この時間になるとね、港にいる船が一斉に汽笛を鳴らすの。:
At this time of day, all
the ships in the harbor
blow their whistles.
translations.へえ～、よく知ってるね。:
Wow, you sure know
your stuff.
translations.ごめんね。付き合ってもらっちゃって。:
Sorry for making you
tag along.
translations.いいよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が楽しそうなの見てると、●も楽しいし。:
It's fine. Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
having fun makes it
fun for ● too.
translations.ありがと。……じゃ、これも試着しちゃおうかな。:
Thanks. ...Well then,
maybe I'll try this on too.
translations.えっと……“うん”じゃなくてできれば、試着室から離れて欲しいな？:
Um... Instead of 'yeah',
could you maybe step away
from the fitting room？
translations.えっと……そこにかけてあるブラウス、取ってもらってもいい？:
Um... Could you hand me
that blouse hanging
over there？
translations.カーテンの隙間から……絶対こっち見ちゃダメよ？:
Through the gap in the
curtain... You absolutely
can't peek, okay？
translations.その間はなあに？ すぐにお返事。:
What's with the pause？ 
Answer right away.
translations.うん、見てるだけでも楽しい。:
Yeah, it's fun just 
looking at them.
translations.見てるだけでもか……でもやっぱり欲しかったり？:
Just looking, huh... 
But you still want one, 
right？
translations.もう、変なこと考えてない？ 二人とも高校生なんだもん、無理しちゃダメよ？:
Jeez, you're not getting 
any weird ideas, are you？ 
We're both high schoolers, 
so don't push yourself, 
okay？
translations.向こうで店員さんに、“婚約指輪をお探しですか”って。:
A clerk over there asked 
me, 'Are you looking for 
an engagement ring？'
translations.そんな風に見えちゃうのかあ……困っちゃうね？:
I guess we look like 
that... That's a bit 
embarrassing, huh？
translations.店員さんと話し込んでたけど、ここ、良く来るの？:
You were talking with the 
clerk. Do you come here 
often？
translations.なじみの店があるって、なんか大人っぽくない？:
Having a regular shop 
seems kind of grown-up, 
doesn't it？
translations.そこまでのことじゃ……もう、カワイイなあ。:
It's not that big of a 
deal... Jeez, you're so 
cute.
translations.メイクシミュレーション\nお願いできるみたい。:
It looks like we can ask 
for a makeup simulation.
translations.デジカメで撮影した\n自分の写真をもとにして、\nいろんなメイクを試せるの。\n:
You can try out different 
makeup based on a photo 
taken with a digital 
camera. Do you want to 
try it out？
translations.えーっ！ \n面白いと思うんだけどな～？:
Ehh! 
I think it'd be fun, 
though~？
translations.（そんなのカノジョに\n見られたくないって……）:
(I don't want my 
girlfriend seeing me 
like that...)
translations.この辺りまで来ると、静かだね……。:
It's quiet once you get 
around here...
translations.……静かな湖畔に起こる戦りつの連続殺人。果たして彼らは生き残ることができるのか。:
...A terrifying string of 
murders at a quiet 
lakeside. Will they be 
able to survive？
translations.最近観た映画のあおり文句。ここの雰囲気と似てるなって。:
It's the tagline for a 
movie I saw recently. 
The atmosphere here is 
similar.
translations.怖がらなくても大丈夫。その映画ね、か弱い年下の男の子を、お姉さんが助けてあげる話:
Don't worry, you don't 
need to be scared. That 
movie is about an older 
woman saving a frail 
younger boy.
translations.こういう湖って謎の生物が住んでるって、よく言われない？:
Don't they often say that 
mysterious creatures live 
in lakes like this？
translations.ここはどうだろう、ごく普通の湖だしなあ。:
I wonder about here, it's 
a pretty normal lake.
translations.もしいたら、十羽野湖だから“トッシー”？ “トワッシー”？:
If there was one, since 
it's Lake Towano, would 
it be 'Tossie'？ 'Towassie'？
translations.……なんでそういうのって“シー”を付けるんだろ。:
...Why do they always add 
'sie' to those？
translations.えっと……なんでかな。海のｓｅａじゃないよね、湖なんだもん。こっちの方がミステリ:
Umm... I wonder why. It's 
not 'sea' like the ocean, 
since it's a lake. This 
is the real mystery.
translations.湖の周囲をまわる乗馬体験ができるみたいね。予約が必要みたいだけど。:
It looks like you can 
experience horseback 
riding around the lake. 
But it seems you need a 
reservation.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って馬、大丈夫なの？:
Are you okay with horses, 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.特に苦手ではないけど……間近で見ると怖くなっちゃいそう。:
I'm not particularly bad 
with them, but... I feel 
like I'd get scared 
seeing one up close.
translations.だよなあ……たとえ大人しい馬でも、力自体はすごいし。:
Yeah... Even if it's a 
gentle horse, they're 
really strong.
translations.でもあなたが颯爽と乗りこなしてくれたら、見とれちゃうかも▼ どう？:
But if you rode one 
gallantly, I might be 
captivated, ▼. 
What do you think？
translations.遊覧船の上からだと、周りの景色がよく見えるね。:
You can see the scenery
so well from up here on
the sightseeing boat.
translations.ほんと。そんなに遠くないのに、こんなに自然がたくさんで、不思議。:
It really is. It's so close,
but there's so much nature
here. It's kind of magical.
translations.そのうちこの辺りも開発されるのかな。:
I wonder if they'll end up
developing this area too.
translations.うーん、きっと大丈夫だよ。観光スポットとして定着してるもん。:
Hmm, I'm sure it's fine.
It's already established
as a tourist spot.
translations.こうやってデートで利用するカップルもいるし？:
Plus, there are couples
like us using it for dates？
translations.そういうこと。だから安心です。:
Exactly. So there's
nothing to worry about.
translations.今日はお客さん少ないみたい。:
Looks like there aren't
many passengers today.
translations.じゃあ、貸し切り気分だな！:
Then it's like we rented
the whole boat to ourselves!
translations.船内から突然消えた乗客。果たして彼らはどこに？ 残された主人公たちに魔の手が迫る:
The passengers vanished.
Where did they go？ Evil
closes in on our heroes...
translations.はは、そんなにその展開にもっていきたい？:
Haha, do you really want
things to go that way？
translations.う～ん、これも癖みたいなものなのかな。:
Hmm, I guess it's just
a habit of mine.
translations.もうちょっと寄ってください……はい、撮ります。チーズ！:
Get a little closer...
Alright, taking it. Cheese!
translations.え？ だってせっかく旅行に来たって言ってたし、シャッター押しただけで……。:
Huh？ They said they were
on a trip, and all I did
was press the shutter...
translations.いつもよりニコニコしてなかった？:
Weren't you smiling a bit
more than usual？
translations.……うん、わかってる。でもその間ほっておかれたカノジョのケアはちゃんとすること。:
...Yeah, I know. But you'd
better make it up to the
girlfriend you ignored.
translations.はぁ……やっぱり運動不足なのかな。:
Phew... I guess I really am
out of shape.
translations.私、足手まといよね……。:
I'm just holding you back,
aren't I...
translations.そんなこと思ってないよ。早く着くのが目的じゃないし、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が辛いと意味ない:
I don't think that at all.
We're not in a rush, and it's
no fun if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hurting.
translations.ありがとう……よし、休憩はなし！ 姉ヶ崎寧々、がんばります！:
Thanks... Alright, no break!
Nene Anegasaki is gonna
do her best!
translations.……この山、意外と勾配きついよな。:
...This mountain is actually
pretty steep, huh.
translations.ここで少し休も？ 無理すると、身体の調子くずしちゃう。:
Let's rest here a bit？
If you push yourself too
hard, you'll get sick.
translations.はい、疲れには甘いもの。のど飴を食べると、身体もスーッとするよ。:
Here, something sweet for
the fatigue. A cough drop
will help refresh you.
translations.……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が食べさせてくれたら、さらに疲れがとれるかも。:
...If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ fed it to me,
I might feel even better.
translations.あ、もう、甘えんぼ。しょうがないな▼:
Aw, you big baby.
I guess I have no choice.▼
translations.……よーし、もう到着だ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、疲れてない？:
...Alright, we're here.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you tired？
translations.大丈夫。頂上に近づくと空気が澄んでて気持ちいいね。:
I'm fine. The air gets so
clear and nice as we get
closer to the top.
translations.うん、疲れてきてるはずなのに、なんか体が軽くなった気がする。:
Yeah, I should be tired,
but my body actually feels
lighter somehow.
translations.運動できてダイエットにもなりそうだし、いいことづくめだな～。:
It's good exercise, and it
might help me lose weight.
It's a win-win~.
translations.はは、そんなこと考えてたんだ。:
Haha, so that's what you
were thinking about.
translations.山全体が燃えてるみたいに真っ赤だな……。:
The whole mountain is so red,
it looks like it's on fire...
translations.とわの市の紅葉は結構有名なんだって。この前ね、雑誌の特集にも載ったみたいなの。:
Towano's autumn leaves
are pretty famous. They were
in a magazine recently.
translations.へえ、その割に人もそこまで多くないし、いいね。:
Wow, for all that, it's
not too crowded. Nice.
translations.私たちだけの秘密の庭園……は言い過ぎかな。:
Our very own secret
garden... Too much？
translations.だといいんだけどね……あ、人が来た。こんにちは～。:
I wish... Oh, someone's
coming. Hello~.
translations.山はきれいに色づいてるし、空気は気持ちいいし、来てよかったね。:
The leaves are so pretty,
and the air feels great.
I'm glad we came.
translations.紅葉よりも食欲の秋の人がいるみたいだけど？:
Seems someone's more
interested in autumn
appetites than leaves？
translations.はは……まあ体動かしてるしさ。:
Haha... Well, we are
getting some exercise.
translations.あともう少しのガマンね。ほら、行きましょ。:
Just hold out a little
longer. Come on, let's go.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大丈夫？ ケガしてない？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you okay？
You're not hurt, are you？
translations.ありがと、大丈夫。難しいなあ……。:
Thanks, I'm fine.
This is tough...
translations.初級コースに戻る？:
Wanna go back to the
beginner course？
translations.ううん、いい。だって小学生ばかりで、あの中にいると、引率の先生に間違えられるんだ:
No, I'm good. It's full
of kids, and I keep getting
mistaken for a chaperone...
translations.雪だるま。スキー場に来ると、なんとなく作りたくなるのよね。:
A snowman. I always want
to make one when I come
to a ski resort.
translations.えっとね、これが私で、こっちの少し大きいのがあなた。:
Let's see, this is me,
and this slightly bigger
one is you.
translations.じゃ、小さいのは？:
Then what about the
little one？
translations.これは……その……子供、かな？:
This is... um...
Our kid, maybe？
translations.プロスキーヤーのデモンストレーション、すごかったね。あんなに滑れたら、楽しいだろ:
That pro skier's demo
was amazing. It'd be so
fun to ski like that.
translations.あれ、反応薄い……。もしかしてさっき私がプロの人に声かけられてたから？:
Huh, weak reaction...
Is it because that pro
was talking to me earlier？
translations.そんな心配いらないのに。自慢のカレシなんだから、どーんとかまえてなさい？:
You don't need to worry.
You're my proud boyfriend,
so just act confident, okay？
translations.どうしたの、オブジェとにらめっこ？:
What's wrong？ Staring
down the sculpture？
translations.どう見ても、ねじ曲がった棒にしか見えないんだけど、これも芸術？:
It just looks like a
twisted stick to me.
Is this art, too？
translations.たぶん……私もよくわからないけど、なんとなく迫力は伝わってこない？:
Probably... I don't really
get it either, but doesn't
it feel kinda intense？
translations.迫力はあるけど……やっぱり意味がわからないよなあ。:
It's intense, sure...
But I still don't get
what it means.
translations.たぶん意味は……作った本人にしかわからないんじゃないかな……。:
I think the meaning...
is something only the
artist understands...
translations.この肖像画の人、機嫌が悪かったのかな？:
Was the person in this
portrait in a bad mood？
translations.たしかにムスッとしてるね。もうちょっと愛想振りまいてもいいと思うな。:
They do look grumpy.
I think they could've
been a bit more friendly.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がモデルだったらどんな表情する？:
What kind of face would
you make if you were
the model, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ねえ……その絵がどうかした？:
Hey... is something up
with that painting？
translations.うん。どことなく優しそうな雰囲気が、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に似てるなって思ってさ。:
Yeah. I just thought its
gentle vibe kinda looked
like you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.裸の絵を観てそんなこと言うのは、ちょっとデリカシー足りないかな。:
Saying that while looking at
a nude painting... you might
lack a little tact, huh.
translations.ごめん……変な意味で言ったんじゃなくて。:
Sorry... I didn't mean it
in a weird way.
translations.キリンって野生だと、立ったまま眠ることがあるのね。:
I hear giraffes in the wild
sometimes sleep standing up.
translations.それで熟睡できるのかな……。:
I wonder if they can sleep
soundly like that...
translations.きっと熟睡してたら、襲われちゃうんだろうね。:
If they slept soundly, they'd
probably get attacked.
translations.気が休まらないだろうなあ。それにひきかえ、ここにいるキリンは……。:
They probably never get to
relax. On the other hand,
the giraffes here...
translations.ゆるみきってるね。平和が一番、ってとこかな。:
They're completely relaxed.
Peace is the best, I guess.
translations.へえ、名前募集してるんだ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったらどんな名前つける？:
Oh, they're taking name
submissions. What name would
you give it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.赤ちゃんの名前？ そうね、夫婦の名前を一字ずつ、なんて憧れるんだけど……。:
A baby's name？ Let's see,
taking a letter from both
parents is nice, but...
translations.私の「寧」っていう字だと使いにくいよね、男の子だと特に。私、字画とかも結構気にし:
My name is hard to adapt
for a boy. Plus, I care about
stroke counts... I'd probably
stress over it a lot.
translations.（あれ、キリンの赤ちゃんの話……だよな？）:
(Wait, we're talking about
the baby giraffe... right？)
translations.この前テレビで赤ちゃんライオンを見たんだけど、かわいかったな。:
I saw a baby lion on TV
the other day. It was so cute.
translations.へえ。でもそれが大人になると……。: Oh. But when they grow up...
translations.これだもんな。かわいげがないというか。:
They turn into this. Not
exactly cute, you could say.
translations.そうかな？ 威厳はあるけど、だからこそたまに見せる仕種がかわいかったり。:
You think so？ They're regal,
but that just makes their
little quirks even cuter.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が、お前のことかわいいってさ。よかったな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ says you're cute.
Good for you.
translations.ねえ、白いライオンはいないのかな。:
Hey, are there any
white lions？
translations.説明が載ってたけど、ホワイトライオンは世界に３００頭ぐらいしかいない希少種なんだ:
The sign said white lions
are a rare species with only
about 300 in the world.
translations.そんなに少ないんだ。それじゃあ、この動物園にはいないか。見たかったな。:
That few？ Then they probably
aren't in this zoo. I really
wanted to see one.
translations.たしかに白い動物ってかっこいいよな、虎とかさ。:
White animals are definitely
cool, like tigers.
translations.あとは馬も。ね、白馬の王子様？:
And horses too. Right,
my prince on a white horse？
translations.はは、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がウサギまみれだ。:
Haha, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is covered
in rabbits.
translations.ふれあいコーナーって言っても、ちょっとふれあいすぎかも。:
It's a petting zoo, but this
might be a bit too much
petting.
translations.（ウサギに嫉妬したとは言えないよな……）:
(I can't exactly say I'm
jealous of the rabbits...)
translations.奥に爬虫類コーナーなんてあるんだな。:
There's a reptile corner
in the back.
translations.あ、苦手だっけ。:
Oh, you don't like them,
right？
translations.うん……爬虫類とかカエルとか、ああいうヌメっとした……。:
Yeah... reptiles and frogs,
those slimy things...
translations.こっちのかわいい動物にしとこ。ね？:
Let's stick to the cute
animals over here. Okay？
translations.（怖がる▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もちょっと見てみたい気もするけど……やめとこう）:
(I kinda want to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
scared, but... I shouldn't.)
translations.男の子って好きよね、こういうカメラのパーツとか、細かいもの。:
Boys really like these camera
parts and small things,
don't they.
translations.そうかもな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
Maybe so. What about you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うーん……。分解されちゃうと、どれが何の部品なんだか、さっぱり。:
Hmm... Once it's taken apart,
I have no idea what part
is what.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の場合、分解されてなくても……:
In your case, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, even if
it's not taken apart...
translations.あ、そんなこと言うんだ。その分、誰かさんが詳しければいいんですよーだ。:
Oh, is that what you think？
Well, as long as a certain
someone knows all about it,
it's fine by me.
translations.ねぇ、もしこんな風にカメラがバラバラになっちゃっても、直せる？:
Hey, if a camera got
broken apart like this,
could you fix it？
translations.程度によるかな。どうして？:
Depends on how bad it is.
Why？
translations.前にね、置き時計を落っことしてバラッバラになっちゃったことを思い出したの。もう、:
I just remembered a time
I dropped a table clock
and it completely shattered.
You couldn't even tell
what it used to be.
translations.その時計は、結局元に戻らなかったの。あなたがいたら、直してもらえたのかなぁ。:
That clock never got put
back together. I wonder if
you could've fixed it for me
if you were there.
translations.（それは●にも無理そうだな……）:
(I don't think even ●
could fix that...)
translations.撮るよ？ 趣味っていうほどじゃないけど、結構好きかな。:
I do？ Not really as a hobby,
but I like it well enough.
translations.へぇ、どんなの撮るの？:
Oh, what kind of things
do you take pictures of？
translations.何でも。空がきれいだなと思ったり、道端の花がかわいかったりすると、すぐに携帯でパ:
Anything. If I think the sky
is pretty, or a flower on
the roadside is cute, I just
snap a pic with my phone.
translations.学校だと屋上から見た景色とか、黒板のラクガキ、体育館の用具入れ、友達のお弁当なん:
At school, I'd take pictures
of the view from the roof,
doodles on the blackboard,
the gym equipment room,
my friends' lunches...
translations.わあ、見て、この人形かわいい！ これ宇宙人かな？ 地底人？:
Wow, look, this doll is
so cute！ Is it an alien？
An underground dweller？
translations.愛嬌はあると思うけど……どっちかというと、シュール？:
It has its charm, I guess...
but if anything, isn't it
kind of surreal？
translations.なぁに、それ。かわいいってこと？ かわいくないってこと？ どっち？:
What's that mean？ Is it cute
or not cute？ Which is it？
translations.えぇ？ そうだな、かわいくないこともないような気がしないでは……。:
Huh？ Well, I guess I can't
say it's entirely not cute...
translations.もう……。じゃあ、かわいくてシュールな人形ってことにしよう。ね？:
Jeez... Then let's just say
it's a cute, surreal doll.
Okay？
translations.おお、このミニチュアかっこいいな。:
Whoa, this miniature is
really cool.
translations.バイク？ ふふ、男の子だねぇ。:
A motorcycle？ Hehe,
you're such a boy.
translations.女の子はこういうの、興味ない？:
Girls aren't interested
in this kind of stuff？
translations.そうね、バイクのことはよくわからないけど、後ろになら乗ってみたいかも。:
Well, I don't know much
about motorcycles, but I
might want to ride on the
back of one.
translations.後ろに乗るのも結構大変だよ？ バランス感覚とか必要だし……。:
Riding on the back is
pretty tough, you know？
You need a good sense of
balance and stuff...
translations.あ、私には無理だって言いたいんだ。落ちないようにしがみついてればいいんでしょ？:
Oh, so you're saying I
couldn't handle it. I just
have to hold on tight so I
don't fall off, right？
Sounds easy enough.
translations.ねぇ、この箱みたいなの、何に使う道具なのかな。:
Hey, what do you think this
box-like thing is used for？
translations.どれ？ えーと、説明書には罠って書いてあるけど……。:
Which one？ Let's see...
the instructions say it's
a trap, but...
translations.ああ、ここに何かが入ると、この棒が引っ張られて扉が閉まるんだ。へぇ……。:
Ah, when something goes in
here, this stick gets pulled
and the door closes. Huh...
translations.これを部屋に置いておいたら、妖精さんが捕まるかもしれないね？:
If we left this in the room,
maybe we could catch a fairy？
translations.あ、こういうの、あなたに似合うかも。:
Oh, this kind of thing
might look good on you.
translations.●のはいいから、自分のを見てきなよ。:
Never mind ●'s, go look
at your own.
translations.こうして彼の服を選ぶのも、楽しいんだから。そうだ、全身コーディネートしてあげよう:
Picking out clothes for my
boyfriend like this is fun,
you know. Oh, I know！
Want me to coordinate a
whole outfit for you？
translations.えっ、ホント？ それじゃ、●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をコーディネートするよ。……もう少しセ:
Really？ Then ● will
coordinate an outfit for
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. ...Someday, once I
polish my fashion sense
a little more.
translations.ふふ、楽しみにしておくね▼:
Hehe, I'll be looking
forward to it, ▼.
translations.……これ、どうやって着るんだろう？:
...How are you even supposed
to wear this？
translations.それは脇から後ろに紐を通して、背中で交差させて、胸のホックに引っかけるんじゃない:
I think you pass the string
from the sides to the back,
cross it over, and then
hook it at the chest.
translations.へぇ……。女子の服ってややこしいな。:
Huh... Girls' clothes are
so complicated.
translations.男の子の服にも、そういうのがあるよね？ 使わないボタンやベルトがたくさんついてた:
Boys' clothes have things
like that too, don't they？
Like lots of buttons and
belts you don't even use.
translations.ああいうの着てみない？ いつもと違うあなたも見てみたいな。:
Why don't you try wearing
something like that？ I'd
love to see a different side
of you for a change.
translations.ねぇ、こっちのキャミソールとあっちのホルダーネック、どっちが好き？:
Hey, which do you like better?
This camisole, or that
halter neck over there？
translations.もう、さっきからそればっかり。:
Jeez, that's all you've
been saying this whole time.
translations.しょうがないよ。モデルがいいと、何でも似合っちゃうし。:
I can't help it. When the
model's this pretty,
everything looks great.
translations.もう、さっきからそればっかり……。:
Jeez, that's all you've
been saying this whole time...
translations.あ、フィーバーチャンス。……あっ、来た、ジャックポット！:
Ah, Fever Chance...
Oh, it hit! Jackpot!
translations.ふふ、今日は運がいいみたい。:
Hehe, looks like I'm
pretty lucky today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の腕がいいんだよ。:
It's just 'cause ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ got
some serious skills.
translations.そうかな？ よーし、このメダルをさらに倍にしちゃうぞ♪:
You think so? Alright, I'm gonna
double these medals!♪
translations.んー、今日は全然ダメみたい。:
Mmm, I'm just not having
any luck today.
translations.あれ、メダルなくなっちゃった？: Oh, are you out of medals？
translations.なんだ、言ってくれればよかったのに。●のがまだ余ってるから……。:
Aw, you should've told me.
● still got some left over...
translations.ふふ、ありがとう。でもあなたのプレイを見てるだけも楽しいから。横に座っていい？:
Hehe, thanks. But just
watching you play is fun too.
Can I sit next to you？
translations.もちろんいいよ。なんなら一緒にやろっか。:
Of course. We can even
play together if you want.
translations.ねぇ、見て。あそこの人、すごくたくさんのメダル……。:
Hey, look. That person over
there has so many medals...
translations.うわ、ホントだ。どうやったらあんなに出せるんだろう。:
Whoa, you're right. How do
they get so many to come out？
translations.ちょっと、偵察してこようか？: Should I go do some recon？
translations.え～、いいよそんなことしなくて。●も頑張るから、ここで見てろって。:
Eh, you don't have to do that.
● will try hard too,
so just watch me.
translations.あ、拗ねちゃった。はいはい、そばにいます。ふふ。:
Ah, you're pouting. Okay, okay,
I'll stay right here. Hehe.
translations.ダーツにもいろいろあるんだね。色や形もそうだし、重さも違うし。:
There are so many kinds of
darts. Different colors,
shapes, and even weights.
translations.重いほうが重心が安定するから、素人には扱いやすいんだ。でも、プロはもう少し軽いも:
Heavier ones have a stable
center of gravity, so they're
easier for beginners. But pros
apparently use lighter ones.
translations.すごい。詳しいんだね。: Wow. You sure know a lot.
translations.……実は、そこのポスターにそう書いてあります。:
...Actually, that's what's written
on the poster over there.
translations.あ、ホント。ふふ、正直でエライぞ？:
Oh, you're right. Hehe,
good boy for being honest.
translations.ダーツスクールとかあるのかな……。:
I wonder if there's a
darts school or something...
translations.プロが教えてくれたりする？ 探せばあると思うけど、どうして？:
Like where a pro teaches you？
I'm sure there is if you look,
but why do you ask？
translations.我流でやっててもなかなか上達しないだろ？ どうせやるなら、一度基礎を習ったほうが:
You don't really improve just
doing it your own way, right？
If I'm gonna play, I figured I
should learn the basics first.
translations.……今、負けてるから言うわけじゃないぞ？:
...I'm not just saying that
because I'm losing right
now, okay？
translations.あっ、ダブルブル！ わぁ、やったぁ！:
Ah, double bull!
Wow, I did it!
translations.おお、すごい。見事にど真ん中……。:
Whoa, amazing. Right in
the dead center...
translations.ちょっと、はしゃぎすぎたみたい。注目浴びてる……恥ずかしい……。:
I think I got a little
too excited. People are
staring...
It's embarrassing...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲があんまりかわいいから、見とれてるんじゃない？:
Isn't it just because ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ look
so cute, they're mesmerized？
translations.嫌だもう、こんなところでそんなこと……バカ。:
Jeez, saying things like that
in a place like this... idiot.
translations.惜しい！ 掠ったんだけどなぁ。:
So close! It just
grazed it, though.
translations.真っ直ぐ打つだけでも難しいのに、カーブさせたりジャンプさせたり、プロってすごいね:
It's hard enough just hitting
it straight, but making it
curve or jump... Pros are
amazing, aren't they？
translations.バラエティ番組で、芸能人同士が対決してたのをね。芸能人にも、上手い人がいっぱいい:
I saw celebrities playing
each other on a TV show.
There are a lot of good
players among them, y'know？
translations.（それはプロとは違うかも……）:
(I'm not sure that counts
as professional...)
translations.お、入った。ラッキー。: Oh, it went in. Lucky me.
translations.あっ、すごいすごい。さっきから調子いいね。:
Wow, nice shot! You've been
on a roll for a while now.
translations.勝利の女神が横でほほ笑んでくれてるからな。:
That's because the goddess
of victory is smiling
right beside me.
translations.もう、そんなこと言って。じゃあ次も頑張って▼:
Jeez, you're a flatterer.
Well, do your best on
the next one too, ▼.
translations.あ、なんだかスーパーショットが打てそうな気がしてきた。:
Ah, I feel like I could hit
a super shot right now.
translations.もう、違う意味でも調子がいいみたいね？:
Jeez, seems like you're on a
roll in more ways than one？
translations.ちょっとショットが遠い時に、こう、前にかがむでしょ。そうすると、打ちづらくて。:
When the shot is a bit far,
you lean forward like this,
right？ It makes it hard.
translations.ああ、体勢が不安定になるもんな。:
Yeah, your stance gets
unstable like that.
translations.そうじゃなくて、む……。ううん、何でもないの。そうね、体勢が不安定になるからかな:
That's not it, it's my...
No, never mind. Yeah, I guess
it's because it's unstable.
translations.わぁ、懐かしい。このＣＤ、リマスター盤が出てたんだ。:
Wow, this takes me back.
They released a remastered
version of this CD.
translations.あ、それ●も聴いてた。:
Ah, I used to listen to
that too, ●.
translations.流行ってたものね。小学校の運動会で、この曲に合わせて踊ったなあ。:
It was really popular.
I remember dancing to this
song at my elementary
school sports day.
translations.へぇ、かなり激しい曲だよね？ スピード感あるというか……。:
Really？ It's a pretty intense
song, isn't it？ It's got
a lot of speed to it...
translations.なんか含みのある言い方じゃない？ これでも小学生の頃は、機敏だったんだから。:
Are you implying something？
I'll have you know I was
very agile back in
elementary school.
translations.これ、私が初めて買ったＣＤなの。:
This is the very first CD
I ever bought.
translations.うん、当時はすごく高いもの買っちゃったって思ってたけど……。:
Yeah. At the time, I thought
I was buying something super
expensive, but...
translations.はは、今ならラクラク買える？:
Haha, and now you can buy it
with ease？
translations.うーん……ラクラクは無理かも。いつか、そうなるかな？:
Hmm... Maybe not with ease.
I wonder if I'll get to that
point someday？
translations.欲しいなって思う曲があるんだけど……。:
There's a song I've been
wanting to get, but...
translations.それがアーティストの名前もタイトルもわからないの。ＣＭで流れる曲なんだけど。:
That's the thing, I don't
know the artist or title.
It's a song from a TV ad.
translations.ああ、そういうことあるよな。知ってるかもしれないから、ちょっと歌ってみて？:
Ah, that happens sometimes.
I might know it, so why
don't you try singing a bit？
translations.うん。シャウトから始まるんだけど、そこから歌う？:
Okay. It starts with a shout,
should I start from there？
translations.ねぇ、この掃除機、空飛びそうじゃない？:
Hey, doesn't this vacuum
look like it could fly？
translations.うん。ロケットみたいに、ボンッ、ヒュ～って飛んでっちゃいそう。:
Yeah. Like a rocket, it looks
like it'd go boom and whoosh
right off into the sky.
translations.変なこと言ってるって思ってるでしょ。顔に出てるんだから。:
You think I'm saying something
weird, don't you？ It's written
all over your face.
translations.（かわいいって思ってたんだけどなぁ……）:
(I was actually thinking
about how cute she is...)
translations.ブルーレイプレイヤーかぁ。どれがいいのかな……。:
A Blu-ray player, huh...
I wonder which one is best...
translations.すぐじゃないけどね？ 家にＤＶＤプレイヤーがあるんだけど、次に買い換えるなら最新:
Not right away. We have a DVD
player at home, but I figured
if we're replacing it, we
should get the newest model.
translations.あまり詳しくないから、買う時は一緒に選んでくれる？ いつになるかわからないけど。:
I don't know much about them,
so will you help me pick
one out？ I don't know when
it'll be, though.
translations.わかった。いろいろ情報集めておくよ。:
Got it. I'll gather some
info for you.
translations.うん、ありがとう。頼れるカレシだね？:
Yeah, thanks.
You're such a reliable
boyfriend, you know？
translations.わぁ、ちっちゃいアイロン。ちょっと使うだけなら、このくらいのサイズでもいいなぁ。:
Wow, a tiny iron.
If you just need it for a
little bit, this size would
be perfect.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、自分でアイロンかけるんだ？:
You iron your own clothes,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん。ハンカチと制服のシャツくらいしかないから、毎晩ササッと済ませちゃう。:
Yeah. It's just my uniform
shirt and handkerchiefs, so
I knock it out every night.
translations.あなたは？ 洗濯してシワシワのまま着てるなんてこと……ないよね？:
What about you? You don't
just wear your clothes all
wrinkly after washing...
do you？
translations.もう……。そんな風だと、アイロンしに行ってあげたくなっちゃうじゃない。:
Jeez... When you're like
that, it makes me want to
come over and iron them
for you.
translations.このアニメ、海外で賞を取ったんだよね？:
This anime won an award
overseas, didn't it？
translations.ああ、ニュースでやってたな。もう見た？:
Yeah, I saw it on the news.
Have you watched it yet？
translations.ううん、まだなの。友達が見たらしいんだけど、絶対泣くから気をつけろって。:
No, not yet. A friend of
mine saw it and told me to
be careful because it'll
definitely make me cry.
translations.泣くと、次の日に目が腫れちゃうでしょ？ そんな顔、あなたに見せられないもの。:
If I cry, my eyes will get
all puffy the next day,
right？ I can't let you see
me with a face like that.
translations.わぁ、見て。魔法少女のコスチューム。:
Wow, look. A magical girl
costume.
translations.小さい頃は憧れたな。こんな衣装を着て、魔法のステッキを持って……。:
I used to look up to them
when I was little. Wearing
an outfit like this, holding
a magic wand...
translations.……今着ても似合うかも？:
...You might still look
good in it now, you know？
translations.やだ、やめてよ。……ホントに？ 似合うかな？:
Oh stop, no way.
...Really？ You think
it'd look good on me？
translations.あ、これアニメ化するんだ。見てみようかな……。:
Oh, this is getting an anime
adaptation. Maybe I should
check it out...
translations.えーと……『戦国を駆ける少女』？:
Let's see... 'The Girl Who
Leapt Through the Sengoku
Era'？
translations.少し前まで月刊誌で連載してた少女漫画なの。タイムスリップもので、戦国時代で恋人の:
It's a shoujo manga that was
serialized until recently.
It's a time-slip story
where she meets a warlord
in the Sengoku era who's
the past incarnation of her
boyfriend, and they fall
in love all over again...
translations.へぇ……。でも、前世っていっても別人だろ？:
Huh... But even if it's his
past life, he's a different
person, right？
translations.面影みたいなものはあるんじゃないかな。私もあなたの前世に会ったら、また恋しちゃう:
I'm sure there are traces of
him left. If I met your past
incarnation, I might just
fall in love all over again？
translations.じゃあ、現世に戻ってきたら「また会えたな」って言わなきゃいけないな。:
Then when you come back to
the present, I'll have to
say, 'We meet again.'
translations.……あ、いいかも。今のキュンとしちゃった▼:
...Oh, I like that.
My heart just skipped a beat.▼
translations.メイドさんの服。あなたも好き？:
A maid outfit.
Do you like them too？
translations.嫌いじゃないかな。清楚な感じするし。:
I don't dislike them,
I guess. They have a neat
and clean vibe.
translations.そっか……。でもデートに着ていくにはちょっと難しいから、そのうち、ね？:
I see... But it's a bit hard
to wear on a date, so maybe
someday, okay？
translations.（そのうち着てくれるんだ……）:
(She's going to wear it for
me someday...)
translations.伸びてます。さっき料理を持ってきてくれた子、可愛かったものね？:
You are. That girl who
brought our food earlier
was pretty cute, wasn't she？
translations.違うって。あれが▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だったらって考えてた……だけで……。:
That's not it. I was just
imagining what it'd be like
if that was ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
that's all...
translations.もう、それじゃ怒れないじゃない。:
Jeez... Now I can't even
be mad at you.
translations.メイドにもいろいろあるんだな……。:
There sure are a lot of
different kinds of maids...
translations.昔もあんな風にスカートが短かったり、ウサギのしっぽがついてるメイドさんがいたのか:
I wonder if there were maids
in the past with short
skirts and bunny tails
like that.
translations.そうよね……。ここにいると、本当のメイドさんがどんなだったかわからなくなってきち:
Right... Being here makes me
forget what real maids
were actually like.
translations.すごい……。あちこちに反響して、何重にも聞こえる。:
Wow... It's echoing all over,
sounding like it's layered.
translations.ねえ、この静けさって授業中の雰囲気に似てない？:
Hey, doesn't this silence
feel like being in class？
translations.お腹が鳴ったら響きそうなところ。……想像しただけで居たたまれなくなってきちゃった:
Like how if your stomach
growls, it'll echo... Just
imagining it is embarrassing.
translations.見て見て、あそこ。いろんな色の光が踊ってる。:
Look over there! There's
so many colorful lights
dancing around.
translations.ホントだ。ステンドグラスが反射してるんだな。:
You're right. It's the light
reflecting off the stained
glass.
translations.なんていうんだろう……なんだか妖精が遊んでるみたい。:
How should I put it... It's
like fairies are playing.
translations.妖精か……かわいいこと考えるな。:
Fairies, huh... That's a
cute way to think about it.
translations.やだ、もう……。なんか気取った言い方しちゃったね。:
Oh, stop... I guess that
sounded a bit pretentious.
translations.ねえ、パイプオルガンがあるでしょ？ あれって使われてるのかな。:
Hey, there's a pipe organ,
right？ I wonder if it's
still being used.
translations.どうかな。ミサなんかで使われてると思うけど。:
I wonder. I think they use
it for mass and stuff.
translations.一度弾いてみたいな。教会中に音が響いて、気分よさそう。:
I'd love to play it once.
The sound echoing through
the church would feel great.
translations.えっと、猫踏んじゃったくらいなら、多分……。:
Um, maybe something like
Chopsticks, at least...
translations.携帯電話の世界、だって。携帯カメラでこんなにきれいに撮れるんだ……。:
"The World of Cell Phones."
You can take such pretty
pictures with a phone...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もよく撮ってるよな。:
You take a lot of pictures
too, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うん。たまに見返して、色んなこと思いだすの。日記代わりみたいなものかな？:
Yeah. I look back at them
and remember all sorts of
things. Like a diary, maybe？
translations.なるほど……。ギャラリー姉ヶ崎が開けそうだな。:
I see... You could probably
open an Anegasaki Gallery.
translations.お客さんはあなただけね？\nプライベートが\nいっぱい写ってるから。:
And you'd be my only guest.
There are a lot of private
shots in there, after all.
translations.笑顔の写真が多いね。笑顔を見てると、つられて笑っちゃう。:
Lots of smiling photos.
Seeing them makes me want
to smile too.
translations.そうだな。……あ、犬が笑ってる。ほら。:
Yeah... Oh, that dog is
smiling. Look.
translations.ホントだ、ニッコリ笑ってる！ やだ、人間みたい。:
You're right, it's grinning!
Wow, it looks just like a
human.
translations.よっぽど面白いことがあったんだろうなあ。:
Something really funny must
have happened to it.
translations.近所のワンちゃんもこんな風に笑うかな？ いつもしかめっ面してるから、今度くすぐっ:
I wonder if the dog in my
neighborhood smiles like
this？ It's always scowling,
so maybe I'll tickle it
next time...
translations.ジェリービーンズの瓶をアップで撮ってるの。カラフルでツヤツヤして、一粒転がり落ち:
It's a close-up of a jar of
jelly beans. So colorful and
shiny, like one's about to
roll right out...
translations.違います。それだけ写真の出来がいいってことじゃない。:
No, I'm not. It just means
the photo is that good.
translations.乗馬クラブがあるんだ。やってみたいな……。:
There's a horseback riding
club. I'd love to try it...
translations.問題はそこなのよね。やっぱりセレブなスポーツってイメージがあるし。:
That's the problem. It
definitely has this image of
being a sport for celebs.
translations.でも▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の乗馬姿、似合うかもな。:
But you might look good
riding a horse, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私は、あなたの乗馬姿が見たいな。もちろん白馬でね？:
I'd rather see you riding
one. A white horse,
of course?
translations.牛乳アイスと牛乳ソフト、どっちがいいかな……。:
Milk ice cream or milk
soft serve... Which one
should I get...?
translations.どっちも美味そうだよ？:
They both look pretty
good to me.
translations.そうだけど、食感が全然違うでしょ？ うーん、悩むなあ……。:
I know, but the textures
are totally different!
Hmm, I can't decide...
translations.あ、牛乳フローズンヨーグルトなんてのもあるぞ。:
Oh, they've got milk
frozen yogurt, too.
translations.あん、ますます迷っちゃうじゃない。ねえ、もうあなたが決めちゃって？:
Aw, now I'm even more
torn! Hey, why don't you
just decide for me?
translations.（そんなに迷うことなのか……）:
(Is it really that hard
of a choice...?)
translations.牛もヒツジも毎日のんびりしてるから、あんなに眠そうな顔してるのかな。鳴き声も眠そ:
Cows and sheep relax all
day. Maybe that's why they
look so sleepy. Even their
cries sound tired.
translations.ほんとだ……ねむくなってきた。:
You're right... Now I'm
getting sleepy, too.
translations.ふふ。そうね、少し休もっか。:
Hehe. Yeah, let's take a
little rest.
translations.子供の頃ね、花の中には妖精が住んでると思ってたの。:
When I was a kid, I used
to think fairies lived
inside flowers.
translations.うん。それでお花に寄って来る虫に乗って、森に住む妖精さんたちに蜜を届けに行くの。:
Yeah. They'd ride the bugs
that came to the flowers
and deliver nectar to the
fairies in the forest.
translations.そうね。ヤンチャだったんだけど、中身は結構乙女なとこもあったんだから。:
Right? I was a tomboy, but
I had a pretty girly side
on the inside, too.
translations.ねえ、こういう場所に来ると、アレやりたくならない？:
Hey, coming to a place
like this makes you want
to do 'that', doesn't it?
translations.花、きれいだね……。ずっと見ていたくなっちゃう。:
The flowers are so pretty...
I could look at them forever.
translations.見てるだけだと、だんだん眠くなってくるけどな。:
Just looking at them makes
me sleepy after a while,
though.
translations.癒し効果かな？ 寝てもいいよ。膝枕してあげる▼:
Maybe it's a healing
effect? You can sleep.
I'll give you a lap pillow,
▼.
translations.あ、そっちのほうが癒されそう。:
Ah, that sounds way more
healing.
translations.お花より？ 調子いいんだから。:
More than the flowers?
You're such a smooth talker.
translations.楽しかった。一度ハーブ石けん手作りしてみたかったんだ。:
That was fun. I've always
wanted to try making my
own herb soap.
translations.そっか。体験できてよかったな。:
Yeah. I'm glad you got to
experience it.
translations.家でもできそうだし、これからは毎回手作りにしようかな。あなたの分も作ってあげるね:
I could probably do it at
home, too. Maybe I'll just
make my own from now on.
I'll make you some, too!
translations.サンキュー。でも、石けんってなかなかなくならないよな。:
Thanks. But soap takes a
while to run out, huh.
translations.全身に使えばあっという間よ。毎日ちゃーんと洗うこと。いい？:
It'll be gone in no time if
you use it on your whole
body. Make sure you wash up
properly every day. Got it?
translations.陶芸って思ったより難しいな……。:
Pottery is harder than I
thought...
translations.うん、想像してたよりずっと。ろくろが嫌いになりそう。:
Yeah, way more than I
imagined. I think I'm gonna
hate the potter's wheel.
translations.３回続けて失敗しちゃったからな。:
Well, you did mess up
three times in a row.
translations.ほんの一瞬手がぶれただけで、あっという間に崩れちゃうんだもの。おそろいのお茶碗作:
My hand shook for just a
second and it collapsed
instantly! And I really
wanted to make us matching
bowls, too...
translations.完成品に色付けだけやってみる？:
Want to try just painting
the finished ones instead?
translations.あ、それいいね。そうしよっか。:
Ah, that's a good idea.
Let's do that.
translations.そば打ちって結構力がいるんだね。筋肉痛になっちゃいそう。:
Making soba takes quite a
bit of strength. I feel like
my muscles are gonna ache.
translations.細く切るのがあんなに大変だとは……。:
I didn't think cutting it
thinly would be that hard...
translations.あなたのそば、まるでうどんみたいで……。:
Your soba is almost
like udon...
translations.あ、開き直った。そうね、歯ごたえがあって個性的だったよ？:
Ah, you're owning it.
Well, it was certainly
chewy and unique？
translations.静かだね……。鳥の鳴き声と、風の音しか聞こえない。:
It's so quiet...
I can only hear the birds
and the wind.
translations.誰も来ないな。結構大きい寺なのに。:
No one's coming.
Even though it's a
pretty big temple.
translations.二人っきりだね……。: It's just the two of us...
translations.さっきの訂正。聞こえるのは鳥の鳴き声と、風の音と、あなたの心臓の音……。:
Correction. I hear the birds,
the wind, and the sound of
your heartbeat...
translations.ねえ、この岩の染み、顔に見えない？:
Hey, doesn't the stain
on this rock look
like a face？
translations.眠ってるみたい。お寺に住んでる妖怪か、亡くなったお坊さんの幽霊か、それとも……。:
It looks like it's sleeping.
Maybe a temple yokai,
a dead monk's ghost, or...
translations.あ、怖がっちゃった。はいはい、やめてあげます。:
Ah, I scared you.
Okay, okay, I'll stop.
translations.（お寺でそういう話はシャレにならないって……）:
(Those kinds of stories
aren't funny at a temple...)
translations.お寺の隅に鐘楼があるみたい。ついてもいいのかな？:
There's a bell tower in the
corner. Can we ring it？
translations.どうだろ。時間が決まってたりするんじゃないか？:
I wonder. Don't they have
set times for that？
translations.どんな音がするのか聞いてみたかったんだけどな。:
I just wanted to hear
what it sounds like.
translations.こら、見つかったら怒られちゃうよ。子供みたいなこと言わないの。:
Hey, we'll get yelled at
if we're caught. Don't be
such a child.
translations.あ、虹が見えるよ。ほら、滝が落ちて水しぶきが上がってるとこ。:
Ah, I see a rainbow. Look,
where the waterfall crashes
and the spray goes up.
translations.ホントだ。結構ハッキリ見えるな。:
You're right. You can see it
pretty clearly.
translations.虫や小さい動物が見たら、空に虹がかかってるみたいに見えるのかな？:
If bugs or small animals
saw it, would it look like a
rainbow across the sky？
translations.そうかもな……はは、かわいいこと考えるな。:
Maybe so... Haha, that's a
cute way to think about it.
translations.もう、だって女の子だもん。:
Jeez, I am a girl,
after all.
translations.滝をじっと見てると、水の中に吸い込まれそうな気分にならない？ フラフラって。:
When you stare at a
waterfall, don't you feel
like you'll be sucked in？
Like you're dizzy.
translations.なるかな？ 言いたいことはなんとなくわかるけど。:
Do you？ I kind of get
what you mean, though.
translations.なるよ。呼ばれてるのかな……。:
I do. I wonder if it's
calling to me...
translations.危ないなあ。ちゃんとつかまえておこ。:
That's dangerous. I'd better
hold onto you tight.
translations.そうそう、手つないでおけば、吸い込まれる時も一緒だもんね。:
Right, right. If we hold
hands, we'll get sucked in
together.
translations.できれば吸い込まれないように助けたいけどね。:
I'd rather save you from
getting sucked in, though.
translations.わっ、冷たい……。この滝で修業するお坊さんは大変だね。:
Wow, it's cold... The monks
who train in this waterfall
must have it tough.
translations.こんなとこで修業するかな？:
Do they really train
in a place like this？
translations.こんなとこだからするのよ。山奥だし、近くにお寺もあるし。:
They do it *because* it's a
place like this. Deep in the
mountains, near a temple.
translations.観光客も結構来るぞ？ ●たちみたいな。:
A lot of tourists come too,
you know？ Like ● and co.
translations.んー、だったら公開修行。見られても集中を乱さない修行になるし、お布施ももらえるか:
Hmm, then it's public
training. Having people watch
helps them focus, and they
might get alms？
translations.（見て楽しいかなあ……）:
(I wonder if that'd be
fun to watch...)
translations.ねえ。そっちのお風呂、大声で歌ってるおじいさんがいたでしょ。:
Hey. There was an old man
singing loudly in the bath
on your side, wasn't there？
translations.ああ、やっぱり聞こえてたか。: Ah, so you could hear him.
translations.もうハッキリ。あんまり気持ち良さそうに歌うから、笑っちゃった。:
Loud and clear. He sounded
so happy singing, it made
me laugh.
translations.途中で一瞬聞こえなくなっただろ？ あの時、風呂で寝ちゃってたんだよ。:
He stopped for a second
halfway through, right？ He
fell asleep in the bath.
translations.ふふ、そうなんだ。いいお湯だったもんね。:
Hehe, is that so. It was
really nice water,
after all.
translations.ねえ、見た？ 鳥がすぐ近くまで飛んで来て、かわいかったんだよ。:
Hey, did you see that？
A bird flew right up
close. It was so cute.
translations.見た見た。そっか、男湯と女湯の間あたりにいたんだな。:
I did. Guess it was hanging 
out between the men's 
and women's baths.
translations.じゃあ二人で同じ鳥を見てたんだね。:
So we were both looking 
at the exact same bird.
translations.じゃあ鳥からはそっちが見えたんだな……。:
And the bird could see 
your side from there...
translations.顔真っ赤だ。ホカホカだね。:
Your face is bright red. 
You look so warm.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もほっぺた赤くなってるよ。:
Your cheeks are all 
red too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あなたが見てるからよ。もう、顔上げられないじゃない。:
That's because you're 
staring. Geez, I can't 
even look up now.
translations.二人一緒に滑るのって危ないよね？ どちらかが転んだら巻き込まれちゃうし。:
Isn't it dangerous to 
skate together？ If one of 
us falls, we both go down.
translations.反対に転びそうになったら助けてあげられるから、いいんじゃないかな。:
On the flip side, we can 
help each other if we 
slip, so isn't it fine？
translations.手を繋いだら、横に広がるでしょ？ 他の人の邪魔じゃないかな。:
If we hold hands, we'll 
take up space, right？ 
Won't we be in the way？
translations.広いから大丈夫だよ。上手い人は避けてくれるし。:
It's spacious, so it's 
fine. The pros will just 
skate around us anyway.
translations.ううん、やっぱり危ないよ。私はここで見てるから、一人で滑ってきて？ ね？:
No, it's too dangerous. 
I'll just watch from here. 
You go on ahead, okay？
translations.ほとんど滑らないだろ？ 見てるだけだとつまらないんじゃないかなって。:
You're barely skating. 
I thought you might be 
bored just watching.
translations.そんなことないよ。子供が大勢で追いかけっこしてたり、おじいさんがすごいスピードで:
Not at all. There's kids 
playing tag, an old guy 
speeding by, and someone 
spinning like a pro.
translations.それに、あなたの観察も。さっき転びそうになってたでしょ？ ふふっ。:
Plus, I get to watch you. 
You almost fell earlier, 
didn't you？ Hehe.
translations.……楽しそうだね。:
...You sure look like 
you're having fun.
translations.見てたよ？ 小さな子とずっと遊んでたでしょ。:
I saw you, you know. 
You were playing with 
that little kid forever.
translations.迷子かと思って声をかけたら、懐かれちゃってさ。親はすぐそばにいたんだけど……。:
I thought he was lost, 
but when I asked, he got 
attached. His parents 
were right there, too...
translations.今、ちょっとだけ妬いてたの。:
I was actually getting 
a little jealous.
translations.ううん。親子みたいに見えたんだもの。だからそばにいたお母さんに。:
No. You two looked just 
like father and son. 
So I was jealous of the 
mom standing nearby.
translations.びっくりした……。大丈夫。顔めがけてボールが飛んできたから驚いただけ。:
That startled me... 
I'm fine. A ball flew at 
my face, so I panicked.
translations.ごめん、●のコントロールミスだ。当たらなくて良かった……。:
Sorry, that was ●'s
bad aim. I'm glad it
didn't hit you...
translations.私がボーッとしてただけだから気にしないで？ その、ちょっとあなたに見とれてたって:
I was just spacing out, 
so don't worry about it. 
I guess I was just a bit 
mesmerized by you...
translations.あん、ごめんなさい。また空振り……。:
Ah, I'm sorry. 
I missed again...
translations.気にすんなって。疲れてない？:
Don't worry about it. 
Are you getting tired？
translations.大丈夫。あなたのほうが疲れてるんじゃない？ あちこち走らせちゃってるし……。:
I'm fine. Aren't you the 
one who's tired？ I'm 
making you run all over...
translations.いい運動になってるよ。それに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をビシバシしごくのも楽しいし。:
It's good exercise.
Plus, it's fun whipping
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ into shape.
translations.ふぅ……。ね、ちょっとだけ休憩しない？ 冷たいものでも飲も？:
Phew... Hey, wanna take 
a little break？ Let's get 
something cold to drink.
translations.１０回ラリーが続くまでやめないって言ったの、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だぞ？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was the one who said
we wouldn't stop until we
got a 10-hit rally, right？
translations.うぅ、スパルタだぁ。じゃあ、１０回続いたら頭撫でてくれる？:
Ugh, you're so strict. 
Well, if we get to 10, 
will you pat my head？
translations.それからギュッてして、ほっぺにチュッて……。:
And then a big hug,
and a kiss on the cheek...
translations.約束だよ？ よーし、頑張っちゃお▼:
It's a promise, right？
Alright, I'll do my best!▼
translations.ねえ、ランニングマシンで私の隣にいた女の人、覚えてる？:
Hey, do you remember the
woman next to me on the
treadmill？
translations.さっき▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と話してた人だろ？:
The one who was talking
to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ earlier, right？
translations.そう。あの人、もうすぐ還暦なんですって。:
Yeah. She said she's
turning sixty soon.
translations.ホントに!? ４０後半くらいかと思ってた……。:
Really!? I thought she
was in her late forties...
translations.私も。やっぱり毎日ジムに通ってるのかな。次に会ったら、若さの秘訣を聞かなくっちゃ:
Me too. I wonder if she
works out every day.
I'll have to ask her secret
next time I see her.
translations.エアロビ、ビギナーズクラスなら、なんとかついていけるみたい。:
I think I can manage
the beginner's aerobics
class.
translations.うん、見てたけど全然問題なかったよ。:
Yeah, I was watching.
You did totally fine.
translations.見てたの？ あなたの後ろにいたのに……。:
You were watching？
But I was behind you...
translations.前にでっかい鏡があったろ？ それで。:
There was a huge mirror
in front of us, remember？
translations.やだ、もう。フラフラしてたでしょ？ カッコ悪いとこ見られちゃった……。:
Oh, jeez. I was stumbling
around, wasn't I？ You saw
me looking so uncool...
translations.（一生懸命でかわいかったけどな）:
(I thought she looked cute
trying so hard, though.)
translations.ううん、あんまり。すぐに痛くなっちゃう。:
No, not really.
It hurts right away.
translations.そっか、じゃあ後ろから押してやるよ。:
I see. I'll push you
from behind, then.
translations.おはよう。朝からなんて悪かったかな。:
Morning. Was it bad of me
to call you so early？
translations.おはよう。悪いなんてこと、あるわけないじゃない。:
Morning. Of course not.
Why would it be bad？
translations.おはよう。もう、あなたの顔見たら文句言えなくなっちゃった。:
Morning. Jeez, seeing
your face makes it hard
to complain.
translations.おはよ。そんなに気を遣わないの。優しいんだから▼:
Morning. Don't worry so
much. You're so sweet.▼
translations.急に呼び出しちゃったけど、大丈夫だった？:
Sorry for calling you out
so suddenly. Was it okay？
translations.もちろん。あなたに呼び出されたら、全部放り出して来ちゃう。:
Of course. If you call me,
I'll drop everything and
come running.
translations.ふふ、そうね。責任とって、楽しませて？:
Hehe, right. You'll have to
take responsibility and
entertain me, okay？
translations.うん。あなたの嬉しそうな顔見られたしね▼:
Yeah. I got to see your
happy face, after all.▼
translations.遅くにごめん。:
Sorry for calling you
so late.
translations.時間なんて、気にしないでいいから。ね？:
You don't need to worry
about the time, okay？
translations.こんな時間に私をどうするつもり？ なんてね▼:
What do you plan to do
with me at this hour？
Just kidding.▼
translations.どんな時間でも、カレシの呼び出しって嬉しいものよ？:
No matter the time, I'm
always happy when my
boyfriend calls me.
translations.おはよう。ありがとう、来てくれて。:
Morning. Thanks for
coming out to see me.
translations.おはよう。カレシなんだから、当たり前だろ。:
Morning. I'm your boyfriend,
so it's only natural.
translations.おはよ。寝ぼけて転んだりしなかった？:
Morning. You didn't trip
while half-asleep, did you？
translations.おはよう。大丈夫、ちゃんと起きてるよ。:
Morning. I'm fine, I'm
fully awake.
translations.ふふ、朝から元気だね？ おはよ。:
Hehe, you're energetic so
early. Morning.
translations.忙しくなかった？ ごめんね。:
Were you busy？
Sorry about that.
translations.いいって。遠慮しないで。:
It's fine. You don't have
to hold back.
translations.ん、合格。早い早い。:
Mhm, you pass.
That was fast.
translations.ふふ、そんなに慌てないの。来てくれてありがとう。:
Hehe, no need to rush.
Thanks for coming.
translations.はは、呼び出してくれてありがとう。:
Haha, thanks for calling
me out.
translations.遅くにごめんね。忙しくなかった？:
Sorry it's so late.
Were you busy？
translations.こら、こんな時間に大声で呼ばないの。ふふ。:
Hey, don't yell so loud
at this hour. Hehe.
translations.こんな時間なのに、すぐ来てくれたね？ エライぞ。:
You came right away even
though it's so late？
Good boy.
translations.カレシの当然の務めです。なんてな。:
It's a boyfriend's natural
duty. Just kidding.
translations.ねえ……ちょっとだけ、歩かない？:
Hey... wanna walk for
a little bit？
translations.ちょっとそのへん歩かない？:
Wanna walk around here
for a bit？
translations.少し歩こうよ。じっとしてるより、ね？:
Let's walk a bit. Better
than standing still, right？
translations.ありがとう。もう少し一緒にいたいけど……また、ね？:
Thanks. I'd love to stay
with you a bit longer, but...
see you later, okay？
translations.名残惜しい？ ふふ、それじゃあ、またね。:
Sad to see me go？ Hehe,
well then, see you later.
translations.うん、また。楽しかった。: Yeah, see you. That was fun.
translations.まだ、ふたりでいたいけど……このへんで、ね？ バイバイ。:
I'd love to stay with you,
but... we should stop here.
Bye-bye.
translations.じゃあ、そろそろ行こうかな。またね。:
Well, I should get going.
See you later.
translations.楽しかったよね？ それじゃあ、また今度。:
That was fun, wasn't it？
Well, see you next time.
translations.うん、楽しかった。それじゃあ。: Yeah, it was fun. See you.
translations.そろそろ、このへんにしとかないとね。じゃあ、バイバイ。:
We should probably wrap
things up here. Bye-bye.
translations.ちょっと予定を教えてほしいんだけど……。:
I wanted to ask about
your schedule...
translations.一緒にいられるなら、がんばって空けるよ？ なんちゃって……ふふ。:
If it means being with
you, I'll make time？
Just kidding... hehe.
translations.今、電話しても大丈夫？:
Is it okay to call you
right now？
translations.えっと……もしかして今、都合悪い？:
Um... is this a bad time
right now？
translations.▲月▲▲日▲に、▲デート場所▲に行かない？:
Do you want to go to
▲デート場所▲ on
▲月▲ ▲日▲？
translations.明日、いっしょに▲デート場所▲に行かない？:
Do you want to go to
▲デート場所▲ together tomorrow？
translations.もし空いてたら、今から▲デート場所▲に行かない？:
If you're free, wanna go
to ▲デート場所▲ right now？
translations.よかった、空いてた～。……ね、楽しみにしてるからね？:
Good thing I'm free~.
...I'll be looking
forward to it, okay？
translations.ちょっと待ってね。……うん、大丈夫。:
Hold on a sec.
...Yeah, I'm good.
translations.えっと、明日はね……空いてました～！ ふふ、うれしい？:
Um, tomorrow I am...
completely free~!
Hehe, happy？
translations.うん、空いてる空いてる。早く明日になればいいのに。:
Yeah, I'm free. I wish
tomorrow would hurry up
and get here.
translations.もちろんＯＫ。今日は何話そっかな？:
Of course. What should
we talk about today？
translations.今からね。うん、行けるよ。すぐに支度するから。:
Right now？ Yeah, I can
go. I'll get ready right
away.
translations.あ……ごめんね、その日はちょっと空けられないの……。:
Ah... sorry, I can't
really make time on
that day...
translations.ん……その日は都合悪いから。:
Hmm... that day doesn't
work for me.
translations.明日はちょっと……。残念だけど、無理だと思う。:
Tomorrow's a bit...
It's a shame, but I don't
think I can make it.
translations.明日？ 明日は、ダメかな。:
Tomorrow？ I don't think
tomorrow works.
translations.今から？ 行きたいけど、今からは……ごめんね。:
Right now？ I'd love to
go, but right now is...
sorry.
translations.今から……そんなにすぐには無理よ。:
Right now... I can't get
ready that fast.
translations.そこも悪くないけど……他にも候補があるとうれしいんだけど、どうかな？:
That's not bad, but...
I'd love it if we had
other options. Maybe？
translations.他の日だったら、空いてるかもしれないんだけど……。:
If it were another day,
I might be free, but...
translations.なんだか噛み合わないね……ごめんね。:
Seems our schedules just
aren't lining up...
Sorry.
translations.また今度、タイミング見て誘うよ……。:
I'll invite you again
when the timing is
better...
translations.時間も決めないとね。待ち合わせ、いつにしようか？:
We need to set a time,
too. When should we
meet up？
translations.うん。じゃあ時間はそれで決定ね。:
Yeah. Then the time is
all set.
translations.（▲時刻▲に▲デート場所▲で待ち合わせか。忘れないようにしなくちゃ）:
(Meeting at ▲デート場所▲ on
▲時刻▲. I'd better
make sure I don't forget.)
translations.ねえ、帰りの時間も考えておかないと……。:
Hey, we need to think
about when we'll head
home, too...
translations.そっか……。もっと早い時間にしよう。:
I see... Let's make it
an earlier time.
translations.うーん、間に合うか不安かも。できればもう少し遅いとうれしいな。:
Hmm, I'm worried I won't
make it. I'd appreciate
it if it were a bit later.
translations.そうだね、時間遅らせよう。えっと……。:
You're right, let's push
the time back. Um...
translations.じゃあ予定に入れとくね。……ねえ、素敵なデート、したいね？:
I'll put it in my plans.
...Hey, let's have a
wonderful date, okay？
translations.うーん……次はどんなデートになるのかな？:
Hmm... I wonder what
kind of date we'll have
next time？
translations.じゃあ、また明日。今からだと、何時間後かな？:
Well then, see you
tomorrow. I wonder how
many hours that is？
translations.それじゃ、明日ね。遅刻厳禁よ？:
See you tomorrow, then.
No being late, okay？
translations.それじゃ、また後でね。場所も時間も間違えちゃダメよ？:
See you later, then.
Don't get the time or
place wrong, okay？
translations.そうなんだ。じゃあ仕方ないね……。:
I see. Well, it can't
be helped...
translations.またいつでも行けるよ。●、連絡するから。:
We can go anytime.
I'll let you know,
●.
translations.やっぱり……今の、無しでいい？:
Actually... can we forget
what I just said？
translations.ダメ。って言いたいけど……わがまま言っても仕方ないね。:
I want to say no, but...
there's no point in me
being selfish.
translations.あのさ、ごめん。この話は無しってことで……。:
Hey, I'm sorry. Let's just
forget about this...
translations.うん、遅くなっちゃいけないね。おやすみ。:
Yeah, we shouldn't stay up
too late. Goodnight.
translations.残念だけど……また誘ってね？:
It's a shame, but...
invite me again, okay？
translations.やっぱり切ってない。ありがと。:
I knew you hadn't hung up.
Thanks.
translations.うれしかったから。それじゃ……またね。:
Because it made me happy.
Well then... see you.
translations.もしかして……もう少しお話ししてたい？:
Could it be... you want to
talk a little longer？
translations.私もそうだけど、楽しみはデートのときまで取って置かなくちゃ。じゃあね。:
Me too, but we have to save
the fun for our date. Bye.
translations.……ねえ、まだ切ってないよね？:
...Hey, you haven't
hung up yet, have you？
translations.ふふ。じゃあ、ボーナスゲームね。じゃーんけーん……。:
Hehe. Bonus game time,
then. Rock, paper...
translations.ブー、時間切れ。残念でしたー。またね！:
Bzzzt, time's up.
Too bad. See you！
translations.……楽しそうだったな。:
...She sounded like she
was having fun.
translations.そう、私。……今、時間ある？:
Yeah, it's me... Do you
have some time right now？
translations.うん。ちょっと話があるんだけど、いいよね？:
Yeah. I have something
to talk about, is that okay？
translations.はい、そうです。今、ちょっといい？:
Yes, it is. Do you have
a minute right now？
translations.よかった。あのね、お願いがあるんだけど……。:
I'm glad. So, I have
a little favor to ask...
translations.あのね。デートに誘っちゃおうかな……って。予定合うといいんだけど。:
Well, I was thinking about
asking you on a date...
Hope our schedules match.
translations.今度、いっしょに出かけよ。:
Let's go out together
sometime soon.
translations.じゃーん、デートのお誘いです。:
Ta-da! This is an
invitation for a date.
translations.明日、デートできたらうれしいんだけど……どうかな？:
I'd love it if we could go
on a date tomorrow...
What do you say？
translations.明日は、予定空いてる？ 一緒にお出かけしたくなっちゃったから。:
Are you free tomorrow？
I just really wanted to
go out with you.
translations.明日、デートする……っていうのは、どう？:
How about we go on
a date tomorrow...？
translations.もし暇だったら、だけど……今から二人で出かけたいな。:
Only if you're free, but...
I'd love to go out with you
right now.
translations.私、今空いてるの。だからデートしよ？:
I'm free right now.
So let's go on a date？
translations.ね、デートしない？ 今からじゃ、無理？:
Hey, wanna go on a date？
Is right now no good？
translations.ここに行きたいんだけど、いいかな？:
I want to go here,
is that okay？
translations.あなたは、行きたい場所ある？:
Is there anywhere
you want to go？
translations.さて、じゃあどこに行きましょうか？:
Alright, so where
should we go？
translations.どうしよっかな……うん、選ばせてあげる。:
What should we do...
Yeah, I'll let you pick.
translations.うん、バッチリ。私もそこがいいな。:
Yeah, perfect.
I'd like to go there too.
translations.えっと……そこは……。他の場所じゃダメかな？:
Um... there is...
Could we go somewhere else？
translations.うーん。もっといい場所、選んで欲しいなあ？:
Hmm. I want you to pick
somewhere a bit better？
translations.わかった。じゃあ、別のとこにしよう。:
Got it. Let's pick
somewhere else then.
translations.あとは、時間ね。: Now we just need a time.
translations.時間も決めないとね？: We need to pick a time too？
translations.よかった。私、楽しみにしてるね……。:
I'm glad. I'll be looking
forward to it...
translations.メモ取ってる？ 忘れちゃダメだからね？:
Are you taking notes？
You can't forget, okay？
translations.わかってるって。忘れたりしないよ。:
I know, I know.
I won't forget.
translations.急だったけど、お願いしてよかった。ありがとね？:
It was sudden, but I'm glad
I asked. Thanks, okay？
translations.やっぱり場所選んでもらってよかったな。:
I'm really glad I had you
pick the place.
translations.（いい場所を選べたみたいだな……）:
(Looks like I picked
a good spot...)
translations.こっちから誘ったのに、\n場所決めてもらっちゃったね。:
I invited you, but I had you
decide on the place.
translations.ちゃんと場所選んでくれたね、えらいえらい。:
You picked out a nice place
for us. Good boy.
translations.はは、これくらいは。: Haha, it's the least I can do.
translations.うん……うまくいかないときもあるよね。:
Yeah... Things don't always
work out, do they.
translations.わかった、あきらめる……。ついてないなあ。:
Okay, I give up...
Just my luck.
translations.うーん、残念……。また誘うね？:
Aww, that's a shame...
I'll invite you again, okay？
translations.うん、●からも連絡するようにする。:
Yeah, ● I'll make sure
to reach out too.
translations.あ……定番のやり取りしちゃったね。:
Ah... We just did the
classic exchange, huh.
translations.早いね。そんなに待ち遠しかった？:
You're early. Were you
that excited to see me？
translations.よしよし。先に来てるなんて、えらいぞ。:
There, there. Good boy
for getting here first.
translations.あ……待たせちゃった？ 早く日陰に行こう？:
Ah... Did you wait long？
Let's get in the shade.
translations.大丈夫だよ、今来たところだから。:
It's fine, I just got
here myself.
translations.先に来てるなんて感心、感心。:
Getting here before me.
I'm impressed.
translations.そりゃ、暑い中待たせたくないし。:
Well, I didn't want you
waiting in the heat.
translations.待たせちゃった？ 暑かったでしょ？ いいこいいこ。:
Did I keep you waiting？
Was it hot？ Good boy.
translations.お待たせ。今日、寒くない？:
Sorry for the wait.
Isn't it cold today？
translations.そうだな。風邪ひかないうちに早く行こう。:
Yeah. Let's get going
before we catch a cold.
translations.手、冷たい……。そんなに待っててくれたんだ？ 格好いいんだ。:
Your hands are cold...
Did you wait that long？
You're so sweet.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲があったかいんだよ。●は大丈夫。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is just really warm.
● is fine.
translations.早いね？ もしかしたら寒くて部屋で丸まってるかなって。:
You're early？ I thought
you'd be curled up in
your room from the cold.
translations.元気だから、大丈夫。:
I've got plenty of energy,
so I'm fine.
translations.ごめん、待たせた？:
Sorry, did I keep
you waiting？
translations.ううん、セーフ。私も来たばっかりだから。:
Nope, you're safe.
I just got here too.
translations.お待たせ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。残念って？:
Sorry for the wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What's a shame？
translations.会ったとき何を話そうか考えてたとこなのに、もう来ちゃった。:
I was just thinking about
what to talk about, but
you're already here.
translations.ふふっ。会話のリードもよろしくね。:
Hehe. I'll leave leading
the conversation to you.
translations.ふふ、来た来た。待ってたよ。:
Hehe, there you are.
I've been waiting.
translations.あれ？ おかしいな、時間通りだよね？:
Huh？ That's weird,
I'm on time, right？
translations.少し早めに来たの。あわてるあなたが見たくって。:
I came a little early.
I wanted to see you panic.
translations.こっちこっち。今日も暑いね。:
Over here! It's another
hot one today, huh.
translations.走らなくても時間ぴったりだよ。\nもう汗かいちゃって、あわてんぼ。:
You didn't have to run,
you're right on time.
You're all sweaty, silly.
translations.遅れなくてよかったよ……。:
I'm just glad I wasn't
late...
translations.ううん、ちょうど。暑いのに急いでくれてありがとう。:
No, right on time. Thanks
for hurrying in this heat.
translations.少し。でもね、あなたの名前呼んだら、ちょっとだけあったかくなったかも。:
A little. But calling
your name might have
warmed me up a bit.
translations.そうだね。風邪ひかないように、いつもよりくっついてくれないと。:
Yeah. You'd better stay closer
than usual so I don't
catch a cold.
translations.寒いからね。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に風邪ひかせちゃいけないでしょ？:
It's cold out. I can't let
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ catch a cold, right？
translations.……もう。うれしいこと言ってくれちゃって。:
...Geez. You sure know how to
make a girl happy.
translations.私、そんなに待ってないよ。だから気にしないで。:
I haven't been waiting long.
So don't worry about it.
translations.んー……セーフってことにしてあげようかな？:
Hmm... I guess I can let you
slide this time？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。待たせちゃった？: ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did I keep you waiting？
translations.いいよ、これくらい。いい天気だし。:
It's fine, it wasn't long.
Besides, the weather is nice.
translations.来た来た。暑いね、今日。:
There you are.
It's hot today, huh.
translations.うん……ちょっと待たせたよね。ごめん。:
Yeah... I kept you waiting
a bit, didn't I？ Sorry.
translations.気にしない、気にしない。これくらいでへばらないから。:
Don't worry, don't worry.
I won't melt from just this.
translations.ちょっとだけね。ふう、暑い暑い。:
Just a little.
Phew, it's so hot.
translations.そんなにあわてなくても大丈夫。怒ってないよ。:
You don't have to panic so
much. I'm not mad.
translations.待たせてごめん。寒かったでしょ？:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Were you cold？
translations.ううん。待つのも、ちょっと楽しいから。:
No. Waiting for you is
kinda fun, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ごめん、寒かったよね？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, sorry, you were cold,
right？
translations.えーん、えーん、寒いよー。あっためてよー。:
Waaah, waaah, I'm freezing.
Warm me up.
translations.あはっ。その顔に免じて許してあげる！:
Ahaha. I'll forgive you just
for that face!
translations.あ、いた。ほら、こんなに冷えちゃった！:
Ah, there you are. Look,
I got so cold!
translations.私はデート、楽しみにしてたんだけど……。あなたは？:
I was really looking forward
to our date, but... were you？
translations.今からがんばって挽回すること！:
You'll just have to work hard
to make up for it now!
translations.こんなに心配させるなんて悪い子ね。……めっ！:
Making me worry like that...
you're a bad boy. ...Bad!
translations.なにかあったのかと思っちゃったじゃない、もう。:
I thought something had
happened to you, geez.
translations.ううん。でも、ちょっと体が熱いかも……。:
It's fine. But, my body might
be a little hot...
translations.いいよいいよ、今度はそっちが熱くなっちゃう。:
It's okay, it's okay.
You'll just get hot instead.
translations.え……ここで言うの？:
Eh... I have to say
it here？
translations.早く言って。暑いんだから。:
Hurry up and say it.
It's hot out.
translations.こんなに待たされるなんて、ちょっとびっくり。:
I'm a little surprised you
made me wait this long.
translations.気が緩んでる。お姉さんに甘え過ぎじゃない？:
You're getting sloppy.
Aren't you relying on your
big sister a bit too much？
translations.よろしい。じゃ、まずは日陰に避難ね。:
Good. Then first, let's
take shelter in the shade.
translations.ううん、怒ってない。でも、さびしかったな……。:
No, I'm not mad.
But I was lonely...
translations.ごめん、もうしないから！:
I'm sorry, I won't
do it again!
translations.寒い中、カノジョを待たせちゃダメでしょ。減点１。:
You shouldn't make your
girlfriend wait in the cold.
Minus one point.
translations.そうじゃなくて、溜めないように努力すること。ね？:
That's not the point.
Just try your best not to
rack them up. Okay？
translations.ショックだな。こんなに待たされるなんて。:
I'm shocked. I can't believe
you made me wait this long.
translations.寒い思いさせたぶん、今日は楽しませてね？:
Since you made me freeze,
you'd better make sure I
have fun today, okay？
translations.実は、デートのことなんだけど……急用ができて、キャンセルしないといけなくなって。:
Actually, about our date...
Something urgent came up,
so I have to cancel.
translations.嫌な予感、当たっちゃった……。わかった。じゃあ、キャンセルね。:
My bad feeling was right...
I understand. Let's cancel
for today, then.
translations.ごめん。また誘うから。:
I'm sorry. I'll ask you
out again soon.
translations.今度会うときは、代わりにいっぱい甘えさせてね？:
Next time we meet, you
have to let me act super
spoiled to make up for it？
translations.もしもし、どうしたの？ 声、なんだか暗いよ？:
Hello, what's wrong？
You sound kind of down.
translations.デートの日に急な予定が入っちゃって……。:
Something suddenly came up
on the day of our date...
translations.ごめん。本当にごめん。:
I'm sorry.
I'm so, so sorry.
translations.ううん、いい。そのかわり、埋め合わせはきちんとしてね？:
No, it's fine. But you'll
have to make it up to me
properly, okay？
translations.うん、私。なあに？ デートの話？:
Yeah, it's me. What's up？
About our date？
translations.あのさ……そのデートなんだけど……キャンセルできないかな？:
Listen... about that date...
is it possible to cancel？
translations.そうなんだ。ごめん、約束したのに……。:
Yeah. I'm sorry, even
though we promised...
translations.いいの、気を落とさないで。じゃあ、デートはまた今度ね。:
It's okay, don't feel down.
We'll just have our date
another time.
translations.実は、急いでやらないといけないことができて……。:
Actually, something urgent
came up that I have to do...
translations.そうなんだ。いきなりでごめん。:
Yeah. I'm sorry for the
sudden notice.
