No... I don't wanna hear it.
If you say it,
I really will explode...
translations.（こんな大胆な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……いつも以上だな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ being this bold...
She's even more daring
than usual...)
translations.もう、禁止ったら禁止！:
Geez, I said no comments,
and I mean it!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、いつも以上に積極的だった……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was even more
forward than usual...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……今のって……。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... What was that
just now...？
translations.ねえ……ワゴン販売のドーナツ屋さんって見かけたことある？:
Hey... have you ever seen
that doughnut truck around？
translations.ないなぁ……どうして？:
Can't say I have...
Why do you ask？
translations.友達がね、この前買って食べたらすっごく美味しかったって言うの。:
A friend told me she bought
some the other day, and they
were super delicious!
translations.美味しいドーナツ屋さんならほかにもたくさんあるだろ？:
Aren't there plenty of other
tasty doughnut places？
translations.そうなんだけど……そのドーナツは絶対私好みだ！ って言われちゃって。:
True, but... she insisted
they'd be totally my style!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲好み？ 気になるなぁ……。:
To ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s liking？
Now I'm curious...
translations.私も気になっちゃって。だけどそのお店、移動販売らしくて……全然見つからないんだよ:
I am too! But since it's
a food truck, I haven't
been able to find it at all.
translations.じゃあ、●が探してみようか？:
Then maybe ● should
try looking for it？
translations.ほんとに？ ありがとう、見つかったら一緒に食べようね♪:
Really？ Thank you!
If you find it, let's eat
some together, okay♪
translations.（あ、あれってウワサのドーナツ屋さんか？）:
(Wait, is that the doughnut
truck she mentioned？)
translations.（よし、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に買っていってやろっと）:
(All right, I'll buy some
for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ 約束のもの届けにきたよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲! I brought what
I promised!
translations.約束のもの……なんだろう？:
What you promised...
I wonder what it is？
translations.わぁ♪ ちゃんと覚えててくれたのね？ 嬉しいなぁ。:
Whoa♪ You remembered？
I'm so happy!
translations.種類は適当に選んだから、好きなの食べてよ。:
I picked a random mix,
so eat whichever you like.
translations.ほんとだぁ、遠慮なくいただきまーす♪:
Yay! Don't mind if
I do, then♪
translations.●なりに▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の好きそうなのを選んでみたんだけど……どう？:
● tried picking ones
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ might like...
How are they？
translations.……美味しい！ 大丈夫。私の好み、ちゃ～んとわかってるみたいね▼:
...Delicious! No worries.
Looks like you know my taste
really well, ▼
translations.気持ちのいい季節だなぁ。……なんか腹が減ってきた。:
Such nice weather...
Now I'm getting hungry.
translations.もう、なにそれ。……あ、そうそう、友達が美味しいクレープ屋さん見つけたって言って:
Geez, what's with that？
...Oh right! A friend said
she found a tasty crepe place.
translations.毎年、春のあいだだけワゴンでお店を開くみたい。街のあちこちに移動しながら売ってる:
Apparently they only open
in spring with a food truck,
moving all around town.
translations.あぁ、私もそのお店のクレープ食べてみたいなぁ。:
Ah, I'd really love to try
their crepes too...
translations.じゃあ、●も探してみるか。:
Then maybe ● should
look for it too.
translations.（あ、あれってウワサのクレープ屋さんか？）:
(Wait, is that the crepe
truck she mentioned？)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。クレープ屋さんが見つかったって言うから慌てて来ちゃった。:
▲主人公＊▲! You said you found
the crepe truck, so I rushed
right over.
translations.ほら、あれがウワサのクレープ屋さんだよ。:
Look, that's the crepe truck
from the rumors.
translations.わぁ、ほんと。私のイメージ通りのお店！:
Whoa, it really is!
It's just like I imagined!
translations.ふふ……そういうのも花より団子ってことになるのかな？:
Hehe... I guess that counts
as dumplings over flowers？
translations.とにかく早く買いに行こう。:
Anyway, let's hurry up
and buy some.
translations.うん。私もお腹空いてきちゃった♪:
Yeah. Now I'm starting
to get hungry too♪
translations.こら、シャキっとしないと、ますますだらけちゃうよ？:
Hey now, snap out of it,
or you'll get lazier, okay？
translations.なんか……冷たいもの食べたい。:
I really want something
cold to eat...
translations.そうね……。あっ！ 冷たいものと言えば、最近この街にジェラート屋さんが来てるって:
True... Oh! Speaking of
cold treats, I heard a gelato
place is around... Know it？
translations.知らないなぁ、どこにあるんだろ？:
I haven't heard.
Wonder where it is？
translations.ワゴンで移動販売してるから、いつどこにいるのかはわからないみたい。そういうのって:
It's a mobile truck, so
no one knows when or where
it'll be. That kind of thing
just makes you even more
curious, doesn't it？
translations.じゃあ、もし見かけたら連絡するね。一緒に食べよう♪:
Then I'll text you if I
spot it. Let's eat together♪
translations.わかった。●も見かけたら連絡するよ。:
Got it. ●'ll let you
know if I spot it, too.
translations.（あ、あれってウワサのジェラート屋さんか？）:
(Wait, is that the gelato
truck everyone's talking
about？)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。ジェラート屋さん、見つかったんだね？:
▲主人公＊▲.
You found the gelato truck？
translations.思ってた以上にかわいいお店。なんだか嬉しくなっちゃう。:
It's even cuter than I
imagined. It just makes me
so happy.
translations.テンションあがって食べ過ぎないようにしないとな。:
Better not get too excited
and eat too much, though.
translations.もう、ひとつしか食べません。でも、あなたのも少し味見させてくれるとうれしいかな？:
Hey, I'm only having one!
Though I'd love it if you
let me try some of yours？
translations.前にね、友達と秋の味覚の話になったの。でもみんなバラバラで、たくさんあるんだなぁ:
A while back, my friends
and I talked about autumn
foods. But everyone had
different favorites. There
really are so many!
translations.うん。ねえ、あなたは秋の味覚と言えばなにを思い出す？:
Yeah. Say, what comes to
mind when you think of
autumn foods？
translations.そう、それ！ 私はね、栗を連想したの。:
Yes, exactly!
For me, chestnuts were
what came to mind.
translations.いいよな、栗。そういえば、最近、甘栗の移動販売やってるみたいだね。:
Chestnuts are great.
Come to think of it, I heard
there's a roasted chestnut
truck around lately.
translations.あ、聞いたことある。でも、いつどこにいるかわからないって。:
Oh, I've heard of that!
Though no one knows when or
where it shows up.
translations.うーん、探してみるかな……。:
Hmm, maybe I'll try looking
for it...
translations.（あ、あれってウワサの甘栗屋さんか？）:
(Wait, is that the roasted
chestnut truck everyone's
talking about？)
translations.ごめんな、急に。:
Sorry to call you out so
suddenly.
translations.ううん、私は全然構わないよ。:
Not at all, I don't mind
one bit.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に渡したいものがあって、急いで持ってきたんだ。:
There was something I
wanted to give ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so I
rushed right over.
translations.私に？ なんだろ……。:
For me？
I wonder what it is...
translations.秋の味覚。一緒に食べたいなぁと思ってさ。:
An autumn treat. I thought
we could eat them together.
translations.嬉しいな、覚えててくれたなんて。ご褒美に、食べさせてあげよっかなぁ……ふふ▼:
I'm so happy you remembered.
As a reward, maybe I should
feed you one... Hehe.▼
translations.子どもの頃って……たき火して、焼き芋焼いてもらったりしなかった？:
When you were a kid... did
anyone ever roast sweet
potatoes for you over a
bonfire？
translations.あー、そういうの、あったかもね。:
Ah, yeah, I might have done
something like that.
translations.ホイルに包んである焼き芋が熱くて、火傷しそうになって。でも、甘くて香ばしくて……:
The potato wrapped in foil
was so hot you'd almost burn
yourself. But it was sweet
and fragrant... so good.
translations.そういう風景って最近見かけないよね……。それどころか、焼き芋屋さんの声もあまり聞:
You don't really see that
kind of thing anymore...
In fact, I haven't heard
the sweet potato truck
calling out lately...
translations.ああ、言われてみれば……。どこかにはいるんだろうけど。:
Yeah, now that you mention
it... They must be around
somewhere, though.
translations.ほんとにいるのかなぁ？ ああ……なんだか焼き芋が食べたくなってきちゃった。:
Are they really, I wonder？
Ah... now I'm really craving
roasted sweet potato.
translations.●も。今度見かけたら買おうかな。:
●'m craving some too.
Maybe I'll buy one next
time I see the truck.
translations.じゃあ、私のぶんもお願いね？ ふふっ♪:
Then get some for me too,
okay？ Heheh♪
translations.（あ、あれってウワサの焼き芋屋さんか？）:
(Oh, is that the sweet potato
vendor we talked about？)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、例のもの買ってきたよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I got that thing
we were talking about.
translations.焼き芋屋さんの焼き芋だよ。はい、どうぞ。:
A baked sweet potato from
the vendor! Here you go.
translations.子どものころの懐かしい味がすればいいんだけど。:
I hope it tastes like you
remember from childhood.
translations.じゃあ、確かめてみないと。:
Well, only one way
to find out!
translations.ねえ、あなたはＵＦＯって信じてる？:
Hey, do you believe
in UFOs？
translations.まあ……ないとは言い切れないところがＵＦＯだと思うなぁ。:
Well... I guess you can't
completely rule them out.
That's the thing with UFOs.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、もし私がＵＦＯを見たって言ったら信じてくれる？:
I see. Then if I told you
I saw a UFO, would you
believe me？
translations.ううん。じつは、友達が見たんだって。その子、写真まで撮っててね。“最近よく来てる:
No. Actually, a friend
of mine said she saw one.
She even took a picture!
She said, "They've been around
a lot lately, so anyone can
snap a photo"...
translations.へえ……。でも、ほんとに見られるなら●も見たいかも。:
Huh... If you can really see
them, ● would kind of
like to see one too.
translations.私も。おたがい、見つけたら報告しようね。:
Me too. Let's report back
if either of us spots one!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、あれからＵＦＯ見られた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, have you seen any
UFOs since then？
translations.なあに、胸張っちゃって。まさか、ＵＦＯを見たとか？:
What's with that puffed-up
chest？ Don't tell me... did
you actually see a UFO？
translations.実は、そうなんだよね。ほら見てよ、これが証拠写真。:
Actually, yeah! Look, here's
the photographic evidence.
translations.うそ、本当に？ ……やだっ!? なにか写ってる！:
No way, really？
...Wait, what!?
Something's actually in this!
translations.すごーい！ これ、コピーしてもいい？ 友達にも見せてあげなくちゃ！:
Amazing! Can I make a copy
of this？ I have to show
my friend!
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はトワッシーって知ってる？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do you know
about Towassie？
translations.トワッシー？ えっと……あれでしょ？ 十羽野湖に生息してるってウワサの、巨大生物:
Towassie？ Um... you mean that
giant creature rumored to live
in Lake Towano, right？
translations.なんだ、やっぱり知ってるんだ？\n●は最近知ったんだよね。:
Oh, so you do know about it？
● only heard about it
recently.
translations.このへんではわりと有名な話だと思うよ。目撃したって人も多いし。:
I think it's pretty famous
around here. A lot of people
say they've seen it.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はその話、信じてる？:
Do you believe that story,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.うーん、いるって信じたいけど……どうして誰も決定的な映像を撮れないのかって考える:
Hmm, I'd like to believe it,
but when you think about why
no one has definitive footage...
well, you know？
translations.もし、あなたが写真を持ってきたら信じちゃうけど……ふふ♪:
If you brought me a photo,
I might just believe you...
fufu♪
translations.どうしたの？ あらたまって。:
What is it？ You sound
so serious all of a sudden.
translations.実は、すごい写真が撮れたんだよ！:
Actually, I got an amazing
photo!
translations.ふふ、興奮しちゃって。よっぽどすごい写真なんだね？:
Fufu, you're so excited.
It must be a really amazing
photo, huh？
translations.大スクープだよ！ ほら、これなにかわかる？:
It's a huge scoop! Here, can
you tell what this is？
translations.そう、トワッシー！ ●、この目で見ちゃったんだ！:
Yep, Towassie! ● saw it
with my own two eyes!
translations.すごい、すごい！ やっぱりトワッシーはいたんだ。私、断然信じちゃう！:
Wow, amazing! So Towassie
really is real! I totally
believe it now!
translations.そろそろ中間テストだね。:
It's almost time for
midterms, huh？
translations.そろそろ期末テストだね。:
It's almost time for
finals, huh？
translations.そんなことないけど、目標を決めてある程度準備はしてるかな？ あなたも目標決めてみ:
Not really, but I set a goal
and got ready a bit, I guess？
Why don't you set one too？
translations.学年１０位以内をねらう: Aim for top 10 in the grade
translations.学年１００位以内をねらう: Aim for top 100 in the grade
translations.だんだん中間テストが近づいてきたよ。ちゃんと準備してる？:
Midterms are creeping up.
Have you been preparing？
translations.だんだん期末テストが近づいてきたよ。ちゃんと準備してる？:
Finals are creeping up.
Have you been preparing？
translations.まあ、ぼちぼちとはね……。: Well, bit by bit, I guess...
translations.ふ～ん。だったら、目標は何位以内か聞かせてもらおうかな？:
Hmm？ In that case, why not
tell me what rank you're
shooting for？
translations.いよいよ中間テストだね。テスト勉強頑張ってる？:
Midterms are finally here.
Have you been studying hard？
translations.いよいよ期末テストだね。テスト勉強頑張ってる？:
Finals are finally here.
Have you been studying hard？
translations.ちゃんと目標決めたほうが勉強はかどるよ。今、宣言しちゃえば？:
You study much better with
a goal. Why not declare one
right now？
translations.目標か……それじゃあ……。: A goal, huh... In that case...
translations.えっ、ムリしなくていいんだよ？:
Wait, you don't have to push
yourself, you know？
translations.わりと本気なんだけどな……。:
I was being pretty serious,
though...
translations.ふふっ……そんなこと言っちゃっていいの？:
Hehe... Are you sure you
want to make a claim
like that？
translations.ああ、男に二言はないよ。: Yeah, a man keeps his word.
translations.ずいぶん思い切ったこと言うのね……。:
You sure are making a bold
claim...
translations.目標は高くないとね。:
A goal's gotta be high,
right？
translations.わぁ……結構、やる気だったんだ？:
Whoa... You're actually pretty
pumped up, huh？
translations.ほんとに？ 取り消しはきかないからね。:
Really？ There's no taking
it back, you know.
translations.すごいじゃない。私も応援するね♪:
That's great!
I'll be cheering for you, too♪
translations.そっか。応援してるよ。: I see. I'll be rooting for you.
translations.それくらいなら余裕なんじゃない？:
Wouldn't that be pretty easy
for you？
translations.うん、あなたならできるよ。: Yeah, I know you can do it.
translations.そう言われると励みになるな。:
Hearing you say that really
gives me a boost.
translations.じゃあ、お互いベストを尽くそうね。:
Then let's both do our best,
okay？
translations.それじゃあ目標も決まったことだし、頑張ろっか。:
Now that our goals are set,
shall we give it our best？
translations.よぉし、一緒に頑張ろうね。:
All right,
let's do our best together.
translations.今日のテスト全部終了だね。どうだった？:
That's it for today's tests.
How'd it go？
translations.お疲れさま。今日のテストは上手くこなせた？:
Good job today.
Did your tests go smoothly？
translations.お疲れさまでした。日ごろの成果は出せた？:
Good work today.
Did all your studying pay off？
translations.テストは明日も続くよ。頑張ろうね。:
More tests tomorrow, too.
Let's hang in there, okay？
translations.明日の調子が今日より落ちないように、お互い頑張ろ。:
Let's both do our best
so we keep our groove tomorrow.
translations.常にベストが尽くせるように、明日も頑張ろうね♪:
Let's do our best tomorrow,
so we're always at our peak♪
translations.なにはともあれ、全部終わったね。お疲れさまでした。:
Well, whatever happens,
it's finally over! Good job.
translations.うーんっ、やっとふたりとも解放されるね！ お疲れさま。:
Mmm, we're both free at last!
Good job, you.
translations.１週間お疲れさまでした。よく頑張ったね？ よしよし▼:
Good job this whole week.
You worked so hard, didn't you？
There, there.▼
translations.試験結果の発表か……どうなってるかな。:
Exam results are posted...
I wonder how I did.
translations.うわっ！ １位に名前がある！:
Whoa!
My name's in first place!
translations.すごいね、感動しちゃった。記念撮影しておこうっと。:
Incredible, I'm so proud!
I've gotta snap a picture.
translations.えっ？ あ、そうよね。ともかく、おめでとう！:
Huh？ Ah, I suppose.
Anyway, congratulations!
translations.……１位だっ！ 夢じゃないよな!?:
...First place!
This isn't a dream, right!?
translations.信じられない……なんて言っちゃダメだよね。:
I can't believe it...
Guess I shouldn't say that,
though, huh？
translations.ううん、自分でも信じられないくらいだから。:
Nah, even I can
hardly believe it.
translations.ええっ!? まさか、１位獲っちゃうなんて……。:
What!?
You actually took first place...？
translations.やればできるんだな、●……。:
Guess I can do it if I try,
●...
translations.たくさん努力してたんだね？ がんばった！:
You put in so much effort,
didn't you？ Good job!
translations.わぁ、おめでとう！ いっぱい頑張ったもんね？:
Wow, congratulations!
You worked so hard, after all.
translations.ああ、努力が報われたな。:
Yeah,
all that effort paid off.
translations.目標達成しちゃうなんて、すごいな。:
Actually reaching your goal...
that's really impressive.
translations.よかったぁ、目標達成だ。:
Thank goodness,
I reached my goal.
translations.あ、１０位以内に入れたんだね？ おめでとう。:
Ah, you made the top ten？
Congratulations.
translations.よくがんばりました。次は、もっと高い目標かな？:
You did great!
Aiming even higher next time？
translations.よしっ！ １０位以内の目標クリアだ！:
All right!
Top ten goal cleared!
translations.今回の試験勉強は気合い入れたからな。:
I really put my all into
studying for this one.
translations.カノジョも鼻が高いなぁ。こんなに素敵なカレシがいてくれて▼:
Your girlfriend's so proud!
Having such a wonderful
boyfriend and all.▼
translations.ふぅ……１００位以内は達成だ。:
Phew... At least I made it
into the top 100.
translations.ああ、これくらいはこなせないとな。:
Yeah, this is the least
I should be able to do.
translations.じゃあ、次はもっと上目指して頑張らなくちゃ。:
Then next time, you'll have
to aim even higher!
translations.１００位以内……入ってた。よかったぁ。:
Top 100... I made it.
What a relief.
translations.とりあえず、目標達成おめでとう。:
For now, congrats on
hitting your goal!
translations.さあ、次は何位を目指すのかなぁ？:
Now then, what rank are you
aiming for next？
translations.あらら、気の抜けた顔しちゃって。余裕なかったのかな？:
Oh dear, look at that
relieved face. Were you
cutting it that close？
translations.私は大丈夫だって、信じてたよ。:
I believed you'd be
fine all along.
translations.さすがに……１位はダメか……。:
Figures... Guess 1st place
was too much to ask...
translations.ちょっと目標が高すぎたのかな？:
Maybe that goal was
a bit too high？
translations.でも、１位目指して努力したことがムダになるなんて絶対ないから。また頑張ろ。:
Working hard for first place
will never go to waste!
Let's try again, okay？
translations.ちょっと無茶な目標だったかな？:
Maybe that was too
reckless of a goal？
translations.やっぱり、徐々に目標を上げていくほうがいいのかも……。:
Maybe it's better to work
your way up step by step...
translations.さすがに……１位は言いすぎたか……。:
Saying first place was
aiming a bit too high, huh...
translations.頑張ったのにね……。:
And you worked so hard,
too...
translations.まあ、●以外のみんなも頑張ってるってことだよな。:
Well, it just means everyone
besides ● was working
hard, too.
translations.そうだね。そんなふうに謙虚に考えられるあなたって、私は好きだな▼:
That's true. I really like
that humble side of you,
though▼
translations.残念だったね……。１０位以内って、私はムリじゃないと思ったんだけどなぁ。:
That's too bad...
And here I thought top 10
was within your reach.
translations.謝らないでいいのよ？ 私のためじゃなくて自分のためにやってるんだから、ね？:
No need to apologize, okay？
You're doing this for you,
not for me, right？
translations.１０位……１０位……入ってないか……。:
Top 10... Top 10...
Didn't make it, huh...
translations.悔しい気持ちがあれば、次は達成できるんじゃないかな？:
If you're that frustrated,
I bet you'll make it
next time, right？
translations.ダメだ……１０位圏外……。:
No good... Not even
in the top 10...
translations.こらぁ、ガッカリしすぎだよ。:
Hey now, don't look
so down!
translations.次、頑張ればいいじゃない。目標を高く持ったことがカッコイイんだから……ね。:
Just do your best next time!
Aiming high in the first
place was so cool... right？
translations.げっ……１００位以内もダメか……。:
Yikes... Didn't even make
the top 100...
translations.うーん……どこがいけなかったんだろうね？:
Hmm... I wonder what
went wrong？
translations.全然ダメだったわけじゃないし……今度はいけるよ、きっと。:
It's not like you completely
bombed... I'm sure you'll
get it next time.
translations.うわ……ウソだろ……？:
Whoa... You've got
to be kidding me...？
translations.あれっ……１００位以内に入ってなかったんだ？:
Huh...？ You didn't make
the top 100 after all？
translations.まだまだ修行不足ってことかな？:
Guess that means you still
need a little more training？
translations.マジで……？ １００位入ってないのか……。:
Seriously...？
Not even in the top 100...
translations.あ……こんなこともあるんだね。:
Ah... Well, things like
this happen sometimes.
translations.ちょっとだけ自信あったのになぁ……。:
And here I thought I had
a pretty good shot...
translations.次のテストで挽回するために、特訓しないとね。:
We'll just have to do some
special training to bounce
back on the next test, okay？
translations.大変だったけど、これでほんとに全部終わったね。お疲れさまでした。:
It was tough, but that's
really the end of it all!
Good job, you worked hard.
translations.うん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もお疲れさま。:
Yeah, you worked
hard too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.これでスッキリした気持ちでデートできるね♪:
Now we can go on dates
with a clear mind♪
translations.ああ。いっぱい楽しもうな！:
Yeah. Let's make
the most of it!
translations.試験が終わったら、もうすぐ夏休みだね。なにして過ごす？:
Now that exams are over,
summer break is right around
the corner. What should we do？
translations.もちろん▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とデートだ！:
Go on dates with you,
obviously, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.試験も終わったけど、今年ももうすぐ終わりだよ？ 冬休みの予定も早く立てなくちゃね:
Exams are done, but the
year's almost over too, you
know？ We'd better plan out
winter break soon♪
translations.そうだね。たくさん一緒に過ごそうな。:
Yeah. Let's spend lots
of time together.
translations.ねえねえ、こんな噂知ってる？:
Hey, hey, have you heard
this rumor？
translations.『十羽野城の亡霊』……っていう話なんだけど。:
It's about... "The Ghost
of Towano Castle."
translations.亡霊……怪談とかそういうの？:
A ghost...？ Like a ghost
story or something？
translations.そう！ ここ最近ね、十羽野城で夜な夜なうめき声みたいなものが聞こえる……って！:
Yep! Lately, they say
groaning sounds have been
heard night after night
at Towano Castle...!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……楽しそうだね。フィクションのホラーだけじゃなくて、そういう身近な:
You look excited, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
I know you like horror
fiction, but local urban
legends too？
translations.ふふ。まあ、嫌いじゃないかな？:
Hehe. Well, I don't
dislike them, you know？
translations.ふーん。十羽野城か……行こうと思えば行けるけど……。:
Huh. Towano Castle...
I mean, we could go if
we wanted to, but...
translations.まだ出るには早いかもしれないけど……善は急げ、今からレッツゴー！:
It might be a bit early for
them, but the sooner the
better! Let's go right now!
translations.この辺りかなあ……。:
I wonder if it's
around here...
translations.結構広いもんな……少し歩いてみる？:
It's pretty big, after all...
Want to walk around a bit？
translations.ねえ、今、なにか喋った？:
Hey, did you just say
something？
translations.……少し歩いてみる？ って。:
...Just asked if you
wanted to walk around.
translations.そう……ね。なんだか気分が悪くなってきた気がするし……。:
Yeah... good idea.
I'm starting to feel a
little sick anyway...
translations.あ、ねえねえ。あの話、あれからどうなったかな。:
Oh, hey! I wonder what
ended up happening with
that story.
translations.急に声が聞こえたからビックリしちゃったけど……やっぱり気になって。もう一度行って:
Hearing that voice out of
nowhere startled me, but...
I'm still curious. Wanna go
check it out again？
translations.ありがと。じゃあ、行こう？:
Thanks! Shall we get going,
then？
translations.声が聞こえたの、この辺りかな。:
I think this is around where
we heard that voice.
translations.えー、聞こえたら聞こえたで怖いけど……聞こえないと物足りないな……。:
Aww. Hearing it was scary,
sure, but... it feels kinda
anticlimactic like this...
translations.（実際はくだらない話だし、黙っておいた方ががっかりさせずにすむよな）:
(The real truth was pretty
silly anyway. Best to keep
quiet and not let her down.)
translations.そうだ。ねえ、知ってる？:
Oh, right! Hey, have you
heard？
translations.ドラキュラ？ どんな話？:
Dracula？ What kind of
story is that？
translations.この町に洋館があるじゃない？ そこにまつわる噂なの。:
You know that Western-style
mansion in town？ There's
a rumor about that place.
translations.その洋館ではね、毎晩毎晩謎の儀式が行われてるらしいの！:
Supposedly, every single
night, they hold mysterious
rituals inside!
translations.それがわからないから、謎なの。不気味な音が聞こえてくるみたいで。:
If I knew that, it wouldn't
be a mystery! You can hear
creepy noises, apparently.
translations.気にならない？ なるよね？:
Aren't you curious？
I know you are, right？
translations.……行ってみたいんだ。:
...You want to go check it
out, don't you.
translations.じゃあ、行ってみるか……。:
Alright, let's go take
a look, then...
translations.ここ……けっこう雰囲気あるね……。:
This place... sure has an
eerie atmosphere...
translations.大丈夫。この時間なら……儀式もまだなんじゃないかな。せめて手がかりだけでも……。:
I'm fine. At this hour...
the ritual probably hasn't
started yet. If we could at
least find some clue...
translations.中の様子はよくわかんないな……。:
Can't really tell what's
going on inside...
translations.んー……正面から入れてくれたりしないかな。:
Mmm... I wonder if they'd
just let us in through the
front door.
translations.なんか、人が住んでるのかどうかも、よくわかんないな……。:
Hard to even tell if anyone
actually lives here...
translations.え？ ●？ なにも言ってないけど。:
Huh？ ●？
I didn't say anything,
though.
translations.儀式だよ！ やっぱり謎の儀式が……。:
It's the ritual!
There really is a mysterious
ritual...!
translations.ねえ、ちょっと怖くなってきたかも……。:
Hey, I think I'm starting
to get a little scared...
translations.そうね……ごめん、付き合わせて……。:
Yeah... Sorry for dragging
you along with me...
translations.ねえ……あの話、どうなったかな……。:
Hey... I wonder what
happened with that story...
translations.前は怖くなっちゃったけど、もうすごく気になって。:
I got scared before,
but now I'm just dying
to know.
translations.また付き合ってくれないかな。:
Won't you come with me
again？
translations.……儀式の音、聞こえるかな。:
...Wonder if we'll hear
the ritual sounds？
translations.聞き間違いかなあ……そんなことなかったと思うんだけど……。:
Maybe I misheard...
Though I really thought
I heard something...
translations.（ネタばらししてもいいけど……せっかくだから黙っておくか）:
(I could tell her the truth...
but I'll keep quiet for now.)
translations.そうだ、ニュースで見たんだけどね？:
Oh, right! Did you see
the news？
translations.見てないな……ビッグフットって未確認動物だっけ。:
Didn't see it...
Bigfoot's a cryptid,
right？
translations.それそれ。そのビッグフットの足跡が山で発見された、って。:
That's the one! Apparently,
they found Bigfoot's
footprints in the mountains.
translations.足跡だけ？ ビッグフット自体は目撃されてないんだ。:
Just footprints？
So nobody actually saw
Bigfoot itself.
translations.イタズラか……でもね、見つけたら賞金も出るみたいよ？:
A prank, huh... But hey,
there's a reward if you
find it, you know？
translations.賞金？ なんかすごいな……。:
A reward？ Wow, that's
pretty serious...
translations.でしょ？ んー、偶然ぱっと目の前に現れないかなあ～。:
Right？ Hmm, wouldn't it
be great if it just popped
up right in front of us~？
translations.あなたが言ったとおり、誰かのイタズラだったみたい。:
Just like you said,
it looks like it was just
someone's prank.
translations.そんなに狙ってたの？:
Were you really after
that reward？
translations.そうじゃないけど……もしかしたら、って思うだけはタダじゃない？:
Not really, but...
hoping "what if" doesn't
cost a thing, right？
translations.でもそんなに上手い話はないか。残念。:
Too good to be true,
I guess. Too bad.
translations.（●が見た物は黙っておくか……）:
(Guess I'll keep what
● saw to myself...)
translations.ねえねえ、この話、知ってる？:
Hey, hey, have you
heard this one？
translations.実はね、奥十羽野の渓谷のことなの。:
It's about the valley
in Oku-Towano, actually.
translations.そう。この世に未練を残したまま亡くなった、美しく不幸な女の幽霊！:
Yep! The tragic, beautiful
ghost of a woman who died
with lingering regrets!
translations.へえ、美人なんだ……。:
Huh, so she's
a beauty, is she...？
translations.美人って……そこに反応する？ 幽霊なんだよ？:
A beauty...？ That's what
caught your attention？
She's a ghost, you know！
translations.もう……。気になるな、この話。:
Jeez... But still,
I'm really curious
about this story.
translations.前に『渓谷の幽霊』の話、してたじゃん。:
You were talking about the
Ghost of the Valley before,
right？
translations.あれから何か新情報あった？:
Heard any new info
since then？
translations.それがなんにも。結局ただの噂だったのかな。:
Not a single thing.
Maybe it was just
a rumor after all.
translations.それがさ、実はこんなメールが来て……。:
Well, the thing is,
I actually got an email
like this...
translations.これって……幽霊からのメール……なわけ、ないよね。:
Wait... Could this be...
an email from a ghost...？
...No way, right？
translations.イタズラだろうけどさ、すごいだろ。:
It's probably just a prank,
but pretty crazy, right？
translations.あなたの仕込みじゃないでしょうね？:
You didn't set this up
yourself, did you？
translations.違う違う。ちゃんと他人から来たメールだって。:
No, no！ It really came
from someone else.
translations.えー……じゃあこれって……。:
Huh... Then what
does this mean...？
translations.（考え込んじゃった。まあ、面白がってはくれたみたいだな……）:
(She's really overthinking
it. Well, at least she
found it entertaining...)
translations.ねえねえ、この間、一緒に遊園地に行ったでしょ？:
Hey, remember when we went
to the amusement park
together the other day？
translations.そのときね、落とし物しちゃったみたい。:
I think I dropped something
while we were there.
translations.ちっちゃい巾着袋。お気に入りだったのになあ。:
A little drawstring pouch.
It was my favorite, too...
translations.そっか……遊園地に届けた？:
Oh... Did you ask
the park's lost and found？
translations.なんで？ 届けられてるかもしれないじゃん。:
Why not？ Someone might
have turned it in.
translations.『遊園地の着ぐるみお化け』！:
'The Mascot Ghost of
the Amusement Park'！
translations.あのね、最近の噂で……着ぐるみを着たお化けが、閉園後の遊園地で落とし物を拾ってる:
Well, there's a rumor...
that a ghost in a mascot
suit picks up lost items
after the park closes.
translations.しかも、そのお化けに拾われた落し物は、直接取り戻さないと……呪われちゃうの！:
And if that ghost picks up
your stuff, you'll be cursed
unless you get it back
in person！
translations.……それで届けてないのか。:
...So that's why you
haven't reported it.
translations.そうなの。ちょっと気になっちゃって。:
Yeah. I was just
a little curious.
translations.んー、とりあえず頼んでみるか。:
Hmm, well, let's at least
try asking.
translations.よかったー。入れてくれて。:
Phew, what a relief.
I'm so glad they let us in.
translations.よし。あまり遅くならないうちに探そう！:
All right. Let's search
before it gets too late！
translations.結構広いしな……もう時間も時間だし、どうする？:
It's pretty big, too...
And it's getting late.
What should we do？
translations.おーい、もうとっくに閉園だよ。なにしてるの。:
Hey, the park's been closed
for a while now.
What are you two doing？
translations.巾着袋……ああ、あったあった。:
A drawstring pouch...
Ah, here it is, here it is.
translations.いやいや、わざわざごめんね。しかし……着替えるの面倒だから、このまま見回りしてた:
No, sorry to make you
come all the way here.
Changing was a hassle,
so I just did my rounds
like this... Didn't think
it'd become a rumor.
translations.こりゃ怒られる前にやめたほうがいいな。じゃあ、君たちも早く帰りなさい。:
Guess I'd better stop before
I get chewed out.
Anyway, you two head on
home now.
translations.……よかったな、ちゃんと見つかって。:
...Glad you were able to
find it.
translations.うん、よかった。それに、呪われずにすんだしね。:
Yeah, I'm glad. And now
I won't be cursed, either!
translations.はは、結構本気にしてた？:
Haha, were you actually
believing that？
translations.（これで一件落着……だな）:
(Well... that takes care
of that, then.)
translations.来ちゃった……ねえ、入れてもらえるかな。:
We're here... Hey, do you
think they'll let us in？
translations.勝手に入るわけにもいかないしな……警備の人探して、頼んでみよう。:
We can't just barge in...
Let's look for security
and ask them.
translations.いないか……今日のとこは諦めるか。:
No one's around, huh...
Guess we'll have to give up
for today.
translations.そうね……仕方ないか。:
Yeah... Nothing we can do,
I guess.
translations.お化けに拾われてるとは限らないしさ。案内所で、届けられてないか聞いてこよ。:
A ghost might not have
picked it up anyway. Let's
check the info desk to see
if it got turned in.
translations.巾着袋……届けられてませんね。申し訳ありません。:
A drawstring pouch...
No, nothing has been
turned in. I'm so sorry.
translations.ダメか……今日のところは諦めるか。:
No luck, huh... Guess we
should give up for today.
translations.えっ？ ●、遅れて……ないよな？:
Huh？ ●, I'm not...
late, am I？
translations.大丈夫。まだ待ち合わせ時間前だよ？:
Don't worry. It's not even
our meet-up time yet？
translations.なんだ。でも待たせちゃったみたいだな。ごめん。:
Whew. But looks like I kept you
waiting anyway. Sorry.
translations.ううん、私が少しでも早く会いたかっただけなの♪:
Not at all. I just wanted
to see you a little sooner♪
translations.やめてください。私、待ち合わせしてるんです。:
Please stop.
I'm waiting for someone.
translations.今の、もしかしてキャッチセールス？:
Was that guy trying
to sell you something？
translations.そうなの。あんなの、誰がついて行くんだろうね？:
Yep. Honestly, who'd ever
go along with those guys？
translations.ごめんな、●が遅れて来たから……。:
Sorry, it's because ●
was running late...
translations.あなたのせいじゃないよ。時間もピッタリだし。ね？:
It's not your fault at all.
You're right on time. See？
translations.（そろそろ時間だな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は……）:
(It's almost time.
I wonder where ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...)
translations.もう、すぐに当てたらつまらないじゃない。:
Aw, it's no fun if you
guess it right away.
translations.はは、間違えてほしかった？:
Haha, did you want me
to get it wrong？
translations.ううん。違う女の子の名前を言ったりしたら、帰っちゃうんだから。:
Nope. If you said another
girl's name, I'd go right home.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を間違えるはずないだろ。:
There's no way I'd ever
mistake ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、遅いな。まさか何かあったんじゃ……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is late.
I hope nothing happened...)
translations.用意に時間がかかっちゃって、気が付いたら出る時間で、慌てて走ったら靴が脱げちゃっ:
It took forever to get ready,
and before I knew it,
it was time to leave! Then I ran
and my shoe came off...
translations.そんな顔するなって。無事だったんならいいよ。:
Don't make that face.
As long as you're okay,
it's totally fine.
translations.あなたの顔を見たら、気が緩んじゃった。……本当にごめんなさい。:
Seeing your face made all
the tension just melt away...
...I'm really sorry.
translations.わっ、いきなりなに？: Whoa, what's this all of a sudden？
translations.少し早く着いて、一人でぶらぶらしてたら寂しくなっちゃった。:
I got here a bit early,
and wandering around alone
just made me feel lonely.
translations.あなたは時間通りだよ。ワガママ言っちゃった▼:
You're right on time.
I was just being selfish▼
translations.すごく自然だなって。こうして待ち合わせるのも、隣に並ぶのも、全部。:
It just feels so natural.
Meeting up like this,
walking side by side... all of it.
translations.そりゃ、付き合ってるしな。: Well, we are dating, after all.
translations.ただ付き合ってるだけだとこうはいかないんじゃないかな、きっと。:
I don't think it'd feel this way
just because we're dating, though.
translations.（早く着きすぎたな。少しその辺でもぶらつくか……）:
(I got here way too early.
Maybe I'll walk around a bit
to kill some time...)
translations.あなたこそ。もう、先に来て待つ時間を楽しもうと思ったのに。:
You too! Jeez, and here I was
looking forward to enjoying
the wait before you got here.
translations.はは、そういう楽しみ方もあるのか。:
Haha, I guess that's one way
to enjoy it.
translations.そうよ？ 待つのもデートの醍醐味なんだから。:
Of course？ Waiting is half
the fun of a date, you know.
translations.あ、今日は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が先か。:
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ got here
first today, huh？
translations.今日はって言われると、いつも私が遅いみたいじゃない？:
When you say 'today,'
it makes it sound like
I'm always late, you know？
translations.そんなつもりじゃなかったけど。:
I didn't mean it
that way, though.
translations.次もあなたより先に来るんだから。その時は参りましたって言うのよ？:
I'm gonna beat you here next
time too. When I do, you'd
better admit defeat, okay？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、そろそろ来るかな……）:
(Wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ will
be here soon...)
translations.んー、なんとなくだけど。少しでも早くあなたの声を聞きたかったから。じゃ、ダメ？:
Mmm, no real reason.
I just wanted to hear your
voice as soon as I could.
Is that so bad？
translations.はは、いいよそれで。何かあったのかと思ったけど。:
Haha, works for me.
I thought something had
happened, though.
translations.もうすぐ来るかなーと思って、心の中でカウントダウンしてたの。ほとんどピッタリ！:
I figured you'd be here
any second, so I counted
down in my head.
It was almost spot-on!
translations.もうね、ジャジャーン！ って感じ。私の勘、今日は冴えてるかも♪:
It felt just like, ta-da!
My intuition might be extra
sharp today♪
translations.ねえ、喉乾かない？ お茶でもどうかな。:
Hey, aren't you thirsty？
How about getting some tea？
translations.時間、いいよね。お茶しよ。:
We've got time, right？
Let's have some tea.
translations.ねえ、喉乾かない？ 何か飲みたいな。:
Hey, aren't you thirsty？
I'd love to grab a drink.
translations.急に思い出しちゃって。あの時のこと、覚えてる？:
It just popped into my head.
Do you remember that time？
translations.ねえ、思い出しちゃった。私の誕生日のこと。:
Hey, I just remembered.
My birthday.
translations.すごく嬉しかったから。あの日のこと、覚えてる？:
I was just so happy.
Do you remember that day？
translations.あなたの誕生日。急に前のこと思い出しちゃって。:
Your birthday.
It just suddenly came back
to me.
translations.私たちが付き合い始めた記念日、前にお祝いしたよね。:
Our anniversary from when
we started dating.
We celebrated it, right？
translations.●たちの記念日か……。:
The anniversary for ●
and me, huh...
translations.ちょっとしたことで不安になるって言ってたよな:
You said little things
can make you anxious,
right？
translations.タイミングや雰囲気も大切だって言ってたよな:
You said timing and mood
matter a lot, right？
translations.誤解やすれ違いも恋愛のスパイスって言ってたよな:
You said misunderstandings
are just spice in a
romance, right？
translations.自分が子供っぽかったって言ってたよな:
You said you were being
childish, right？
translations.●が情けない顔してるって言ってたよな:
You said ● was making
a pathetic face, right？
translations.思い出ギャラリーが増えてくって言ってたよな:
You said our gallery of
memories is growing,
right？
translations.１分でも長く一緒にいたいって言ってたよな:
You said you wanted to stay
together even a minute
longer, right？
translations.クリスマスまで何日か数えるのが楽しいって言ってたよな:
You said counting the days
until Christmas is fun,
right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がプレゼントだって言ってたよな:
You said ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was
your present, right？
translations.一生忘れないって言ってたよな:
You said you'd never
forget it, right？
translations.ダメ出しする隙はないって言ってたよな:
You said there wasn't
any room to nitpick,
right？
translations.帰りたくなくなるって言ってたよな:
You said it makes you
never want to go home,
right？
translations.ご飯作るなんて当たり前になるかもって言ってたよな:
You said cooking for us
might just become second
nature, right？
translations.準備の時間も楽しいって言ってたよな:
You said the prep time
was fun too, right？
translations.生まれてくれて本当によかったって言ってくれたよな:
You said you were so glad
I was born, right？
translations.ずっと感謝しっぱなしって言ってたよな:
You said you couldn't stop
feeling grateful, right？
translations.●に会えてよかったって言ってくれたよな:
You told me you were glad
you met ●, right？
translations.甘えたいモードだって言ってたよな:
You said you were in
the mood to be spoiled,
right？
translations.もう、思い出もちゃんと大切にすること。:
Jeez, you need to cherish
our memories, too.
translations.ねえ、まだたくさん思い出作ろうね？ いろんなところに行ったり、美味しいもの食べた:
Hey, let's make lots more
memories, okay？ Going to
new places, eating good
food...
translations.そうだな。たくさんデートしよう。:
Yeah. Let's go on
lots of dates.
translations.私たち、このままどうなるのかな？:
I wonder where we'll go
from here？
translations.将来とか、そういう……。でも……そうね、今は今のことだけ考えよっか。:
Like the future and all...
But... yeah, let's just focus
on right now.
translations.私、あなたを好きになればなるほど、不安にもなる気がする……。:
I feel like the more I fall
in love with you, the more
anxious I get...
translations.幸せすぎて、あとは下がるだけかも、とか。余計なこと考えたりして。ごめんね。:
Like I'm so happy that
it can only go downhill.
I'm just overthinking things.
Sorry.
translations.……謝らないでよ。きっと、まだもっと幸せなことあるかもしれないしさ。:
...Don't apologize. I'm sure
there are even happier times
waiting for us.
translations.もし私と会ってなかったら今頃どうしてるか、考えたことある？:
Have you ever wondered what
you'd be doing right now if
we'd never met？
translations.えー？ 実際に会っちゃってるしなあ……想像つかないや。:
Huh？ Well, we did meet,
so... I can't really
imagine it.
translations.私は考えるよ。でもね、すぐ怖くなってやめちゃうの。会えて、よかった……。:
I think about it. But then
it scares me and I stop.
I'm so glad we met...
translations.ねえ、ずっとそばにいてね。離れちゃ嫌だよ？:
Hey, stay by my side.
Don't ever leave me, okay？
translations.不安になってるわけじゃないけど、やっぱり、こうやってあなたの近くにいるときが一番:
It's not that I'm anxious,
it's just... being this close
to you is what I love most...
translations.幸せすぎて怖いくらい。私、このまま消えちゃってもいいなあ……。:
I'm so happy it's scary.
I wouldn't mind just fading
away like this...
translations.いいの、消えるときもあなたと一緒だから。それならちっとも寂しくないもん。:
It's okay, because if I vanish,
I'll be with you.
I won't be lonely at all.
translations.そういうのも、いいかもな……。:
I guess that doesn't sound
so bad...
translations.ねえ、私のこと、見て？ そのまま、目を離さないで。:
Hey, look at me？
Keep looking... don't take
your eyes off me.
translations.こうしてると、二人だけの世界になったみたいでしょ。ほら、あなたの目に私しか映って:
Doing this, it feels like
it's just the two of us.
See？ I'm the only thing
reflected in your eyes.
translations.ねえ、デートのとき、いつも引き止めないんだね。どうして？:
Hey, you never try to keep me
from leaving on dates.
Why is that？
translations.ふふ、困らせちゃった。大人になったらもっとずっと一緒にいようね？ ずーっとだよ？:
Fufu, sorry to put you
on the spot. When we're older,
let's be together way longer, okay？
Forever and ever, deal？
translations.あなたと会ってから、私、変わったかな？ どう？:
Do you think I've changed
since I met you？
What do you think？
translations.どうかな、いつも見てるから……。:
Hard to say, since I'm
always looking at you...
translations.私もよくわからないの。でもね、今の方がずっと幸せってことだけは、断言できるよ。:
I'm not really sure either.
Though I can say for sure
that I'm way happier now.
translations.好きになったほうが負けって言うけど、それって私が負けっぱなしってことかな？:
They say whoever falls in love
loses. Does that mean
I'm on a total losing streak？
translations.そうかな、●の負けかもよ？:
You think？
Maybe ●'s the one who lost.
translations.ふふ、どうかな？ あなたになら負けっぱなしでもいいけどね。それくらい大好き▼:
Fufu, who knows？
Though losing to you wouldn't
bother me one bit.
That's how much I love you ▼
translations.うん、まだこんな時間。: Mm, look how early it still is.
translations.どうしたの？ この後用事？:
What's up？
Do you have plans after this？
translations.まさか……そんな予定入れるわけないよ。まだまだ一緒にいられるなって、確認。:
No way... As if I'd make
plans! Just checking that we can
still stay together longer.
translations.そうだな。今日はまだ一緒にいられるもんな。:
True. We've still got plenty
of time together today.
translations.よーし、まだまだつき合ってもらうからね？:
All right! You're hanging out
with me for a lot longer, okay？
translations.時間、まだ大丈夫だね。: We still have plenty of time.
translations.ふふ、嬉しい。いっぱい一緒にいられるんだ。:
Fufu, that makes me happy.
We get to spend so much
time together.
translations.ああ、ギリギリまでつき合うよ。:
Yeah, I'm sticking with you
until the last second.
translations.今日はまだ大丈夫だよね？:
You're still free for today,
right？
translations.時間？ そうだな、まだ早いし。:
Time-wise？ Yeah,
it's still pretty early.
translations.嬉しいな。１分でも長く一緒にいたいから。:
I'm so glad. I want to be
with you for even just
one minute longer.
translations.うん、できるだけ一緒にいよう。:
Yeah, let's stay together
as long as we can.
translations.今日はとことんつき合ってもらうからね？:
You're staying with me
all the way today, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいいなら、いつまででも。:
If you're fine with it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
for as long as you want.
translations.うん。あなたってホント、私に甘いんだから▼:
Mm-hmm. You really spoil me,
you know that ▼
translations.ねえ、今日はまだこれからだね？:
Hey, our day is just getting
started, right？
translations.帰りたいって言っても、離さないんだから。:
Even if you say you want to go
home, I won't let you go.
translations.まさか、そんなこと言わないよ。: No way, I'd never say that.
translations.時間、まだいいかな。: Do we still have some time？
translations.じゃあ、公園で少し休んでいかない？:
Then why don't we rest
at the park for a bit？
translations.ねえ、近くの公園で少し休んでいこ。:
Hey, let's take a break
at the park nearby.
translations.私が言ってるんだから、いいの。:
I'm the one suggesting it,
so of course it's fine.
translations.疲れた？ 少し休んで行こ。近くに公園があるし。:
Tired？ Let's take a break.
There's a park nearby.
translations.うん、よろしい。少しでも長く一緒にいたい乙女心でした。:
Mm, good boy. Just a girl's
heart wanting to be with you
a little bit longer.
translations.なるほど、そういうこと。: Ah, so that's what it was.
translations.寄り道してもいいかな。公園で少し休まない？:
Can we take a detour？
Why don't we rest
at the park for a bit？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が大丈夫なら、いいよ。:
If you're okay with it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
I'm fine with that.
translations.時間のことなら気にしないで。あなたの帰りが遅くなっちゃうのが、心配なだけ。:
Don't worry about the time.
I'm just worried about you
getting home too late.
translations.いいって、それこそ気にしなくていいよ。:
I'm fine, you really don't
need to worry about that.
translations.ねえねえ、まだいいでしょ。だったら、公園寄って行こ。:
Come on, you're good, right？
Let's stop by the park, then.
translations.夜の公園はカップルの定番だもんね？:
A park at night is a classic
for couples, right？
translations.ねえ、ちょっと公園に寄りたいな。:
Hey, I'd like to drop by
the park for a bit.
translations.いいよ、休んで行くか。: Sure, let's go rest a bit.
translations.うん▼ まだまだぜんぜん話し足りないもん。:
Yeah! ▼I still have so much
more I want to talk about.
translations.ずっと一緒にいるのに、不思議だよなあ。:
It's funny, even though we've
been together all day.
translations.ねえ、最近デートばっかりしてると思わない？:
Hey, don't you think we've
been going on a lot of dates
lately？
translations.まあな。ちょっと多すぎかな？:
Yeah. You think
it's too much？
translations.それはないよ。絶対にない。毎日だって構わないくらいなんだから。:
No way. Absolutely not.
I wouldn't even mind if
it were every single day.
translations.そっか。それならいいけど。:
I see. As long as
you're fine with it.
translations.でも……私はね、デートでも偶然でも、あなたと一緒にいられるなら何でもいいの。その:
Still... whether it's a date
or running into each other,
anything's fine as long as
I'm with you. Every single
moment is precious to me.
translations.ふふ、照れさせちゃった。たくさんデートしてもらって、カワイイあなたをたくさん見ら:
Fufu, made you blush.
Going on so many dates,
and seeing your cute side...
I'm so spoiled, aren't I？
translations.●は▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を満足させられてるか、いつも不安だけどな。:
● always worry about
keeping ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ satisfied,
though.
translations.最近ちょっと、デートの回数が少ないかな？:
Have we not been going on
as many dates lately？
translations.うん。学校やデキシーズでも会えるけど、それだけじゃ、ね？:
Yeah. We see each other
at school and Dixie's,
but that alone isn't...
you know？
translations.そっか。もうちょっと気をつけるよ。:
I see. I'll try to be
more mindful of that.
translations.あ、責めてるわけじゃないの。自分の時間も大切だし、会えないからってあなたへの気持:
Ah, I'm not blaming you!
Your own time is important, too,
and it's not like my feelings
for you change just because
we can't see each other...
translations.でも、寂しい思いさせたかもな。ごめん。:
Still, I might've made you
feel lonely. I'm sorry.
translations.最近のあなた、さびしんぼさんだね。:
You've been quite the lonely
boy lately, haven't you？
translations.だって、呼び出されること多いもん。:
Well, you've been calling me
out a lot, you know.
translations.それは……ただ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に会いたいだけだよ。:
That's just... I only wanted
to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.だけってことはないでしょ？ 甘えんぼさん。:
That can't be all, right？
You spoiled boy.
translations.私、嬉しいんだよ？ 遠慮されるほうが悲しいもん。さびしんぼで甘えんぼでいいの。:
I'm happy about it, you know？
It hurts more when you
hold back. Being lonely and
spoiled is totally fine.
translations.わかった。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲いいなら、それでいいよ。:
All right. If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
fine with that, I am too.
translations.最近の私、さびしんぼなの。:
I've been feeling kind of
lonely lately, you know？
translations.このところ、あなたに呼び出されることが少ないんだもん。:
Because you haven't been
asking me out as much
lately.
translations.あ、自覚してないんだ。ひどいな～、寂しいな～。:
Ah, you didn't even notice.
That's so mean~,
I feel so lonely~.
translations.困らせちゃった▼ 大丈夫、だからって大切にされてないなんて思ってないよ。こうやっ:
Did I put you on the spot？▼
Don't worry, it's not like
I don't feel cherished.
After all, we're on a date
together right now.
translations.でも、きっと寂しい思いさせちゃったな。ごめん。:
Still, I must've made you
feel lonely. I'm sorry.
translations.最近のあなたって積極的よね。:
You've been pretty forward
lately, haven't you？
translations.それってもしかして……ベタベタしすぎってこと？:
Does that mean... maybe
I've been too touchy-feely？
translations.しすぎってことはないよ？ ただ、スキンシップが多いかなって。:
I wouldn't say too much？
Just that we've had a lot
of physical affection.
translations.うーん、少し考えた方がいいのかな。:
Hmm, maybe I should tone
it down a bit.
translations.もう、そうじゃないでしょ。カップルがベタベタするのは当たり前なんだから。:
Jeez, that's not it at all.
It's totally normal for
couples to be all over
each other.
translations.じゃあ、気にせずもっと……とか。:
Then... should I not worry
and do it even more...？
translations.ねえ、私って魅力ないのかな。:
Hey, am I not attractive
to you？
translations.えっ!? そんなわけないって！:
What!? No way, that's
not true at all!
translations.だって、最近あんまり触れてくれないし……。:
Well, you haven't touched
me much lately...
translations.そりゃ、あまりベタベタするのも、ちょっと……。:
Well, I just thought being
too hands-on might be a bit
much, you know...
translations.もう……。私のこと、大切にしすぎだよ。:
Honestly... You're being
way too careful with me.
translations.そうなの。もっともっと、あなたのこと感じたい。:
It is. I want to feel you
so much more.
translations.うん……ちょっと恥ずかしいっていうのも、あってさ。:
Yeah... I guess I was just
a little embarrassed, too.
translations.ねえ、最近いっぱいキスしてくれるよね？:
Hey, you've been kissing me
a lot lately, haven't you？
translations.そんなことないよ。少なすぎることはあっても、多すぎることなんて、ないよ。:
Not at all. You could never
kiss me too much—only
too little.
translations.キス、好きなんだ？:
So you really like kissing,
huh？
translations.私も、好きよ。もしかしたら、大好きかも。:
I like it too. In fact,
I might even love it.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が喜んでくれるなら、良かった。:
If it makes ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ happy,
then I'm glad.
translations.あんまりキスしてくれないね？:
You haven't been kissing me
very much, have you？
translations.急じゃないよ。ここ最近、ずっと思ってたんだから。:
It's not sudden. I've been
thinking about it for a
while now.
translations.そうなんだ……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はキスするの、好き？:
I see... Does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like
kissing？
translations.●は、あまりしつこいのもどうかと思って……。:
● just thought being
too pushy might be bad...
translations.……それ、優しすぎるよ。心配ばかりじゃなくて、もっとワガママになってもいいのにな:
...You're way too sweet.
Instead of always worrying,
it's okay to be a little
more selfish, you know？
translations.あなたって、私の料理いつも美味しそうに食べてくれるね。:
You always look like you're
enjoying my cooking so much.
translations.美味しそうっていうか、美味しいんだけどね。:
Not just look like it—
it really is delicious.
translations.そんなに言うほどのものじゃないでしょ？:
It's not really something
to praise that much, is it？
translations.そんなことないって。少なくとも●にとってはさ。:
That's not true. At least,
not to ●.
translations.うん、うれしい……。これも相性がいいってことなのかな？:
Mm, that makes me happy...
Maybe that means we're
really compatible？
translations.そうかもね。このままいくと▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の料理なしじゃ、ダメな体になるかも。:
Maybe so. At this rate,
I won't be able to live
without ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s cooking.
translations.もう、調子にのって。:
Geez, don't go getting
carried away.
translations.ほんとだって。料理が美味しいのもそうだけどさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が●のために作ってくれ:
I mean it. Your cooking's
great, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ making
it just for ● is what
makes me the happiest.
translations.あなたって、料理の好み、はっきり言ってくれるよね。:
You're always so clear
about what you like to eat,
aren't you？
translations.ごめん……文句多くて。せっかく作ってくれるのに。:
Sorry... I complain a lot,
even though you went through
the trouble of cooking.
translations.あ……ごめんね、そうじゃなくて。それがうれしいなって話。:
Ah... sorry, not like that!
I meant that it actually
makes me happy.
translations.うん、だって、それってなんだか……。:
Yeah. Because doesn't it
kind of feel like...
translations.夫婦みたい……じゃない？:
...like we're a married
couple... don't you think？
translations.ねえ、写真、よく撮ってくれるよね？:
Hey, you take photos of me
pretty often, don't you？
translations.えっと、イヤなわけじゃないよね。:
Um, you don't mind it,
do you？
translations.そうね、撮ってもらうの、好きかな。あなたにリードされてる感じがするし。:
Well, I think I like it.
It feels like you're taking
the lead.
translations.遠慮はダメだよ。私は、あなたに振り回されちゃうくらいがちょうどいいのかも。:
No holding back, okay？
Getting dragged around by
you might be just right.
translations.そういえばあなたって、あまり写真撮ったりはしないね。:
Come to think of it, you
don't take photos very
often, do you？
translations.まあ、そうだね。もっと撮った方がいいのかな。:
Well, yeah.
Should I take more？
translations.無理に撮る必要はないと思うよ。形が残らなくても、思い出に変わりはないし。:
You don't need to force
it. Even without a photo,
the memories are still real.
translations.うん、これからも気が向いたときだけ撮るよ。そのときはよろしく。:
Yeah, I'll just snap them
when I'm in the mood.
Smile for me then, okay？
translations.はーい。お互いマイペースでいこうね？:
Will do! Let's just go at
our own pace, okay？
translations.ふふ、ふたりしてのんびりって、なんだか熟年カップルみたい▼:
Fufu, taking it easy together
makes us feel like an old
married couple ▼
translations.もっとあなた色に染めてくれてもいいんだけどな。:
You know, I wouldn't mind
if you molded me to your
tastes a bit more.
translations.ファッションの話。あまりリクエストしてこないから。:
Fashion. You never really
make requests.
translations.そうかな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は自分に合う服を知ってるみたいだから……。:
Really？ It just seems like
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ already knows what
suits her best...
translations.……そうなんだ。もしかしたら、あなたと私のセンスが似てるのかもね？:
...I see. Maybe our tastes
are just pretty similar, then？
translations.それだ。似た者カップルだ。:
That's it. We're two
peas in a pod.
translations.ふふ、似た者カップルなんだ。それならしょうがないね。:
Fufu, two peas in a pod,
huh？ Well, I guess that
can't be helped.
translations.そうそう、せっかく似合ってるんだから、無理に変えなくてもいいよ。:
Exactly. It already suits
you, so no need to force
a change.
translations.私、だんだんあなた好みになれてるかな？:
Am I slowly becoming
more your type？
translations.あ、ごめんね、ファッションの話。結構ダメ出しが多いから、大丈夫かなって。:
Ah, sorry, fashion-wise!
You give me a lot of notes,
so I wondered if I'm okay.
translations.謝ったりしないで。嬉しいんだから。:
Don't apologize!
I'm actually happy about it.
translations.ごまかさずにハッキリ言ってくれるから、ほめられた時も本気で言ってくれてるってわか:
Because you're so upfront,
when you DO compliment me,
I know you really mean it.
translations.最近、メールいっぱいくれるよね。:
You've been texting me
a lot lately, haven't you？
translations.そんなはずないでしょ。あなたからメールが届くたびに、幸せな気持ちになるんだから。:
No way! Every time 
I get a text from you, 
it makes me so happy.
translations.そうだ、一つだけ難点があるかな。あなたがカワイイことを言うたびに会いたくなっちゃ:
Oh, there's just one catch. 
Whenever you say something cute, 
I just want to see you.
translations.言ってる言ってる。自覚ないんだ。:
You do, all the time! 
You don't even realize it, huh.
translations.最近、メールの着信音聞くことが少ないな……。:
I haven't heard my text chime 
very often lately...
translations.どうしてかなー、カレシがいるはずなのになー。:
I wonder why... 
And here I'm supposed 
to have a boyfriend.
translations.ごめん、メール少ないよな……。:
Sorry, I haven't been texting 
much, have I...？
translations.そうね……でも無理はしないでね。そんなにションボリされると、罪悪感感じちゃうもん:
Yeah... But don't push yourself. 
If you look that down, 
I'll just feel guilty.
translations.まあメールすると、会いたくなるしなあ……。:
Well, whenever I text you, 
it makes me want to see you...
translations.……もう、ずるい。そんなこと言われちゃうと、おねだりできないじゃない。:
...Aw, that's not fair. 
How can I beg for texts 
when you say things like that？
translations.最近、私のこと研究してるでしょ。:
You've been studying up on me 
lately, haven't you？
translations.好きな食べ物とか、飲み物とか。デートのたびに、私の好みのお店に連れて行ってくれる:
Like the foods and drinks I like. 
On our dates, you always take me 
to places I love, right？
translations.まあ、それくらいは。: Well, that's the least I can do.
translations.そういうのをサラッとこなしちゃうの、ポイント高いよ？:
Pulling that off so casually 
earns you major points, you know？
translations.うん、カノジョとしては鼻が高いかな。:
Yep! As your girlfriend, 
I couldn't be prouder.
translations.はは、喜んでくれるなら良かった。:
Haha, I'm just glad 
it makes you happy.
translations.あのね、最近のあなた、少し……ワイルドだよね。:
You know, lately you've been 
acting a little... wild.
translations.その……スキンシップがちょっと強引かな？ たまにびっくりしちゃうもの。:
Well... you're a little forceful 
when you touch me？ 
It catches me off guard sometimes.
translations.そういうことか……。ごめん、気をつけるよ。:
Oh, that's what you mean... 
Sorry, I'll be more careful.
translations.んー、そうしてって言いたいところだけど、そうしてほしくない気もするし……。:
Mmm, I'd like to tell you to, 
but part of me kind of 
doesn't want you to, either...
translations.ちょっと強引なのもいいなって思う自分がいるのよね。思い出すと、ドキドキしちゃった:
There's a part of me that likes it 
when you're forceful. 
Just thinking about it 
makes my heart flutter.
translations.……えーと、じゃあ適度に気をつけよう、かな？:
...Uh, so I guess I'll just 
be moderately careful, then？
translations.そんなあなただから、好き。:
It's because you're like that 
that I love you.
translations.ううん、それだけじゃないね。全部ひっくるめて、やっぱりあなたが好き。:
No, not just that. 
Everything wrapped together, 
I just really love you.
translations.そういうところも好きなんだろうな。:
I guess that's another thing 
I love about you.
translations.あなたのそういうところも、私があなたを好きな理由のひとつなの。:
That part of you is just another 
reason why I love you.
translations.……そのまんまだね。でも、本当なの。:
...Pretty straightforward, huh？ 
But it's the truth.
translations.好き。そういうところも、ダメなところも、全部含めて、大好き。:
I love you. That part of you, 
the flawed parts, all of it—
I love everything about you.
translations.そんなにキョトンとしないの。もっと言わせたいの？:
Don't give me that blank look. 
Are you trying to make me 
say it more？
translations.ずっと、一緒にいたいな……。: I want to be with you forever...
translations.ずっと、一緒にいたい。迷惑じゃなければ、ずっと、あなたの隣に。:
I want to be with you forever. 
If you don't mind... 
I want to stay right by your side.
translations.迷惑だなんて。そんなわけないよ。:
Mind？ Never. 
There's no way you'd be a bother.
translations.……ありがとう、うれしい……。:
...Thank you. 
That makes me so happy...
translations.あなたがそんなだから、いけないのよね。:
It's your fault, 
for being the way you are.
translations.した、たくさんした。おかげで、あなたのことたくさん好きになっちゃった。: You did, plenty! And thanks to that, I ended up falling for you even more.
translations.責任、とってよね。: So you'd better take responsibility, okay？
translations.こうやって改めてあなたのこと思い返してみると……。: When I sit back and think about you like this...
translations.やっぱり、私ってあなたに夢中なんだな……。: I really am completely head over heels for you...
translations.そうなんです。もう、まいっちゃう。: It really is. Honestly, you're too much.
translations.あのね、こんなこと言われたら困るかもしれないけど……。: You know, hearing this might put you on the spot, but...
translations.ずっと離れたくない。私のこと、嫌いにならないでほしいの。: I never want us to be apart. Please don't ever fall out of love with me.
translations.はあ、そんなだから、どんどん好きになっちゃうんだ。: *sigh* When you're like that, I just fall for you more and more.
translations.私にここまで言わせちゃうんだもんなー。: Look at you, making me say all these embarrassing things.
translations.あなたがそんなだから、私、好きになるの止められないの。: You being like this is why I can't stop falling in love with you.
translations.でも……ふふ、止まらなくてもいっか。: Then again... hehe, maybe not stopping is just fine.
translations.ん……ごめんね。これ、うれし涙だから……。デートって、こんなに幸せになれるんだね: Mm... sorry. These are happy tears... I had no idea a date could make someone this happy... My heart's just so full...
translations.絶対に離したくない……もうずっと一人占めしたい。はあ……、好き……もう、大好き。: I never want to let you go... I want to keep you all to myself forever. *sigh*... I love you... I love you so much.
translations.好き！ もう大好き▼ 今日のデートの間ずっと、あなたのことが大好き過ぎて……おか: I love you! I love you so much▼ The whole date today, I was so in love with you... I felt like I was losing my mind.
translations.今日のデート一回分だけでも、あなたのこと、一生好きになれるぐらい。なのに、他にも: Just this one date is enough to keep me loving you for a lifetime. And yet, you've given me so many other memories, too... Am I allowed to be this happy？
translations.私、このままお姉さんぶってていいのかな。こんなに幸せにしてもらえるなんて、完全に: Can I even keep acting like the older girlfriend at this rate？ When you make me this happy, I've completely lost... Ugh, I'm so happy it's almost annoying...
translations.カワイイ…………いつもカワイイけど、今日のあなたは特別可愛かった▼ 見てるだけで: So cute... You're always cute, but you were especially adorable today▼ Just looking at you made me so happy.
translations.楽しすぎて夢みたいな一日だった……。あなたのカノジョで、私、本当によかった。: It was so fun, it felt like a dream... I'm so glad I'm your girlfriend.
translations.ここまでパーフェクトに決められたら、何も言えないよ。今日一日、本当に楽しかった。: When you pull off a date this perfectly, what can I even say？ Today was so much fun. Thank you▼
translations.楽しかった～♪ 最高のデート▼ 私のことこんなに夢中にさせて、どうしたいの。: That was so much fun~♪ The best date ever▼ Making me fall this hard for you, what are you trying to do to me？
translations.どうして帰らなきゃいけないんだろ。こんなに好きで、離れたくないのに……。: Why do we have to go home？ When I love you this much, and don't want to leave...
translations.……ううん。ねえ、もう一度キスして？ お願い。: ...Never mind. Hey, kiss me one more time？ Please.
translations.もっと一緒にいたいな……。: I want to stay together longer...
translations.これ以上引き止めたら\nいけないよね。\n……バイバイ。:
I shouldn't keep you
any longer, right？
...Bye-bye.
translations.それじゃ、おやすみなさい。今日は本当にありがとう。: Well then, good night. Thank you so much for today.
translations.ここが限界かな。さすがに帰らなくちゃ。: I guess this is as late as we can push it. We really have to head home.
translations.もっとこうしていたいけど……帰らなきゃ、ね？: I want to stay like this longer, but... we have to head home, don't we？
translations.それじゃ。気をつけて帰ってね？: All right. Get home safe, okay？
translations.はい、おしまい。それじゃあね。: And... that's a wrap! See you later.
translations.すごい人……。ライトアップまでまだ結構時間あるのにね。: Look at all these people... Even though there's still quite a while until the light-up.
translations.みんな待ちきれないんじゃない？ ●たちみたいに。:
Maybe no one can wait？
Just like us, ●.
translations.そうかも。ライトアップ、何時からかな。:
Could be. I wonder what time
the lights turn on？
translations.日が完全に落ちてからだと思うけど。:
Probably once the sun
goes all the way down.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、今のうちに夕方の桜を鑑賞しておかなくちゃ。:
I see. In that case, we better
enjoy the evening blossoms
while we still can.
translations.夜も見るのに？:
Even though we're gonna
see them tonight, too？
translations.夕方は夕方、夜は夜、でしょ？ ほら、夕日が反射して桜が真っ赤。:
Evening is evening, and night
is night, right？ Look, the
sunset is turning them so red.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の顔も夕日で赤くなってる。:
Your face is red from
the sunset too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.もう……。私じゃなくて桜を見るの。:
Geez... Look at the cherry
blossoms, not me.
translations.よろしい。……ふふ、あなたの顔も赤くなってる。:
Good. ...Hehe, your face
is turning red too.
translations.●じゃなくて桜を見るんだろ？:
Aren't you supposed to look
at the blossoms, not ●？
translations.へえ、やっぱ夕方に見るのとは全然違うな。:
Whoa, it really is totally
different from the evening.
translations.真っ暗な空に桜が白く浮かび上がって、幻想的……。:
The blossoms stand out so white
against the pitch-black sky.
It's so magical...
translations.だって、こんなにきれいで……。:
It's just... they're so
beautiful, and...
translations.ごめんね、びっくりさせて。感動しただけだから。:
Sorry for startling you.
I'm just really touched,
that's all.
translations.うん、少し驚いたけど……。:
Yeah, you surprised me a bit,
but...
translations.あなたの隣にいるから、こうなっちゃうのかな。:
Maybe I get like this
because I'm next to you.
translations.きっと、たぶん、幸せだから……。キレイなものはもっとキレイに見えるし、一人で見る:
I think... probably because
I'm just so happy...
Beautiful things look even more
beautiful, and it touches me
so much more than being alone...
translations.だから嬉し涙っていうより、幸せ涙……なのかな。:
So instead of tears of joy,
maybe they're tears of
happiness...
translations.●も、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と見られて良かったよ。:
● was glad to see
it with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too.
translations.……そんなこと言われたら、また涙が出ちゃうよ。:
...If you say that,
you'll make me cry again.
translations.……じゃあね、ぎゅってしてくれたら、許してあげる。:
...Then give me a tight hug,
and I'll forgive you.
translations.ここからの景色、まるで絵葉書みたい。夕日と、紅葉と、神社と……。:
The view from here is just like
a postcard. The sunset, the
autumn leaves, the shrine, and...
translations.はは、でもホントにきれいだ。:
Haha, but it really is
beautiful.
translations.でしょ？ 今が一番いい時間帯かな。:
Right？ This is probably
the best time of day.
translations.本番は夜のライトアップ、だろ？:
The main event is the night
light-up, right？
translations.そうでした。……でも、夜の神社ってちょっと怖い気がするね。:
That's true. ...Still, shrines
at night feel a little spooky,
don't they？
translations.人が多いから大丈夫だよ。●も一緒だし。:
There'll be plenty of people,
so it's fine. Besides, you
have ● with you, too.
translations.うん。あなたがいてくれるなら、真っ暗な墓地に二人きりでも大丈夫。:
Yeah. As long as you're
with me, I'd be fine even if
it was just the two of us in
a pitch-black graveyard.
translations.ふふ。ねえ、境内をぐるっと周ってみない？:
Hehe. Hey, want to walk
around the shrine grounds？
translations.オッケー。でも墓地はＮＧな？:
Sure. But graveyards are
off-limits, okay？
translations.行かないったら。: I told you, we're not going.
translations.ライトアップされると、印象変わるね。この世のものじゃないみたい……。:
It looks so different lit up,
doesn't it？ Almost like it's
not even from this world...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が言うと、なんかホラーみたいだな。:
When ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ says it,
it kind of sounds like horror.
translations.そんなつもりじゃないのに。……でもそうね、この光に誘われて……。:
I didn't mean it like that.
...Still, you're right.
Lured in by this light...
translations.はは、やっぱり。こういうとこに出るのはやっぱり日本の妖怪かな。:
Haha, I knew it.
If anything showed up here,
it'd be a Japanese yokai.
translations.……ねえ、なんだか妖怪や幽霊って、美人って設定が多いよね。:
...Hey, aren't ghosts and
yokai usually portrayed
as beautiful women？
translations.今日、周りにも美人が多い気がする。特にキレイなお姉さん。:
I feel like there are a lot of
beauties around today, too.
Especially gorgeous older women.
translations.キレイなお姉さんも、美人の妖怪も幽霊も見ちゃダメ。私だけ、見て。:
No looking at pretty ladies,
or beautiful yokai, or ghosts.
Look only at me.
translations.うん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だけ見てる……。: Yeah. I'm only looking at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私も、あなたしか見ないから……。: And I'll only look at you, too...
translations.上映時間まで、まだ結構あるな。:
We've still got plenty of time
before the movie starts.
translations.そうだね……。\nあ、この映画面白そう。:
Yeah...
Oh, this movie looks interesting.
translations.夢の世界にご招待だって。\n実写とアニメが\n一緒になってるみたい。:
It says 'An invitation to
a dream world.' Looks like
it combines live-action and
animation.
translations.へえ……。\nそういえば、テレビで\nＣＭやってたの観たかも。:
Huh...
Come to think of it, I might've
seen a commercial for it on TV.
translations.……こうしてると、\n観たい映画が増えちゃうね。:
...Looking around like this
makes me want to see even
more movies.
translations.そうだね。\nあと映画本編が始まる前の\n予告とかもな。:
Yeah.
Same with the trailers
before the movie starts.
translations.そうそう、映画館の陰謀よね？:
Right？ It's a conspiracy
by the movie theaters？
translations.当然の宣伝だと思うけど……\nはは、陰謀か。:
I think it's just regular
advertising, but... Haha,
a conspiracy, huh？
translations.あ、笑うなんてひどい。\nじゃあ、この映画、\n一人で観に行っちゃおうっと。:
Hey, mean of you to laugh!
Fine, then I'll just go see
this movie all by myself.
translations.情けない声出さないの。\nカワイイ▼:
Don't whine like that.
My cute ▼.
translations.結構いい席だね。近すぎず、遠すぎず……。:
These are pretty good seats.
Not too close, not too far...
translations.あまり画面に近いと、首痛くなっちゃうしね？:
If you're too close to
the screen, your neck starts
hurting, right？
translations.うん……最後、感動だったね。はぁ、泣いちゃった……。:
Yeah... That ending was so
touching. *sigh* I ended up
crying...
translations.泣いても良かったのに。男の人でも泣いてる人、いっぱいいたよ？:
It would've been fine to cry.
There were plenty of guys
crying too, you know？
translations.ガマンしちゃったんだ。私と二人きりでもガマンする？:
So you held it in. Would you
hold back even if it was
just the two of us？
translations.私は全然気にしないのになあ。むしろ、よしよしってしてあげられるのに。:
I really wouldn't mind at all.
In fact, I could've given you
a gentle 'there, there.'
translations.……でも今日泣いたの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だから、逆だよな？:
...Wait, you're the one who
cried today, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Shouldn't it be the other way？
translations.最後のシーン思い出しちゃった……。:
I just remembered that last scene
all over again...
translations.うーん、調子出ないな……。: Man, I just can't find my groove...
translations.隣のチーム。ゲームそっちのけで、ずっとイチャイチャしてるの。:
The team next to us. They're
totally ignoring the game and
flirting the whole time.
translations.もう、あなたも気になってるくせに。:
Come on, admit it, you were
curious too.
translations.まあ、あれだけベッタリくっつかれてるとな……。:
Well, when they're clinging to each
other like that, it's hard not to...
translations.カップルトーナメントって言うだけあって、本当にカップルばっかりだね。あ、あっちの:
It really is all couples, just like
they said. Oh, that team over there
looks like they're playing to win.
translations.こら、キョロキョロしない。: Hey, stop looking all over the place.
translations.はーい。じゃあ、あなただけ見てるね？:
Okaay. Then I'll just keep my eyes
on you, okay？
translations.そうじゃなくて……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の番だよ？:
That's not what I meant...
It's your turn, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ん～。だって、自信ないんだもん。:
Mmm... But I'm really not
confident about this.
translations.いいって。無理しなくていいから、気楽にね。:
It's fine. Don't push yourself,
just relax.
translations.うん、無理せず頑張れ！: Yeah, just do your best, no pressure!
translations.よーし。目指せ、脱ガーター！:
All right! Mission: keep it out
of the gutter!
translations.アベレージ１９５、優勝は王子＆バンビペアです！:
With an average of 195, our winners
are the Prince & Bambi pair!
translations.すごい、１９５だって。プロみたい。:
Wow, 195？ That's amazing.
They're like pros.
translations.私も練習しておけばよかった。足引っ張っちゃったね？:
I should've practiced beforehand too.
I really dragged you down, didn't I？
translations.気にすんなって。こういうのは楽しんだ者勝ちだろ？:
Don't worry about it. With things
like this, having fun is what counts,
right？
translations.……うん、そうだね。あなたに手取り足取り教えてもらっちゃったし▼:
...Yeah, you're right. Plus, I got you
to teach me every step of the way▼
translations.大したこと教えられなかったけど……。:
I didn't really teach you that much,
though...
translations.ううん、そのおかげでガーターから抜け出せたんだもん。ありがと。:
No, thanks to you, I managed to stay
out of the gutter. Thank you.
translations.えー、引き続き、審査員特別賞ラブラブカップル部門の発表です。:
And now, moving on to the Judges'
Special Award in the Lovey-Dovey
Couple category!
translations.それではラブラブカップルに盛大な拍手を！:
Let's give a huge round of applause
for our lovey-dovey couple!
translations.ふふ、一番嬉しい賞かも。試合に負けて勝負に勝つ、だね？:
Hehe, that might be the best award
of all. 'Lose the battle, win the
war,' right？
translations.（かなり恥ずかしいけど……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が喜んでるからいいか）:
(It's pretty embarrassing, but...
as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s happy,
it's fine.)
translations.この置物いいなあ。天使が居眠りしてる。:
I love this figurine. Look, the
angel's taking a little nap.
translations.やだ、このタヌキさん、頭の上に小鳥が乗ってる！ すごーい、かわいい～▼:
Oh my gosh, this little tanuki has
a bird on its head! Wow, it's so
cute~▼
translations.なあに？ ニコニコしちゃって。: What is it？ What're you grinning at？
translations.女の子だなあと思って。:
Just thinking you really are a girl,
after all.
translations.女の子ですよ？ 今頃気付いたんだ。:
I *am* a girl, you know？
Did you only just notice？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど。かわいいなって。:
That's not what I meant.
I just thought you were cute.
translations.あなたってたまに、そういうことをサラッと言うのよね。どんな顔すればいいのかわから:
You always drop lines like that
so casually.
It leaves me not knowing
what kind of face to make.
translations.ほら、全然意識してないし。それってちょっと問題よ？:
See？ You don't even realize it.
That's a bit of a problem, you know？
translations.妙に慣れてるみたいに思えちゃうんだから。あなたに限って心配はしてないけど。:
It makes you seem suspiciously smooth.
Not that I'm actually worried
you'd do that with anyone else.
translations.わあ、本当の星空みたい。:
Wow, it looks just like
a real starry sky.
translations.スターイルミネーションって言うだけあるな。:
It really lives up to the name
'Star Illumination'.
translations.そうだね。光がチカチカ瞬いて、きれい……。:
Yeah. The lights twinkling and
sparkling... It's so pretty...
translations.あ、ほら、本物の星空もよく見えるよ。ここから空までずっと繋がってるみたい。:
Oh, look! You can see the real
night sky clearly too. It feels like
it connects all the way up.
translations.しがみついてくるから。日が落ちて、少し気温が下がったし……。:
Because you're clinging to me.
The sun set, and the temperature
dropped a bit...
translations.寒いんじゃないの。あなたをもっと感じたかっただけ。:
I'm not cold.
I just wanted to feel you closer.
translations.星空の中に放り出されたみたいで、きれいなのに怖い気がして。だから……。:
It felt like I was tossed out into
the stars... Beautiful, but a little
scary. That's why...
translations.……うん。ふふ、子供みたいなこと言っちゃった。:
...Yeah. Hehe, listen to me,
acting like a little kid.
translations.感受性が豊かってことだろ。:
Just means you have
a sensitive soul.
translations.あ、いいこと言った。じゃあ、そういうことにしておこうかな？:
Oh, nicely said.
Maybe I'll go with that, then？
translations.もう大丈夫。あなたがいるから怖くない。:
I'm okay now.
I'm not scared with you here.
translations.宇宙に二人きりになっても、あなたとなら怖くないよ。あなたがそばにいてくれたら、何:
Even if it were just the two of us
stranded in space, I wouldn't be scared
if I'm with you. As long as you're
by my side... nothing could scare me.
translations.世界のカップル写真展か……。:
A couples photo exhibit
from around the world, huh...
translations.なんだかあてられちゃうね。みんなラブラブなんだもん。:
It's making me blush a little.
Everyone's so lovey-dovey.
translations.ラブラブっていうか、キスしてんのばっかっていうか……。:
Less 'lovey-dovey' and more like
they're almost all kissing...
translations.カップル展だし、しょうがないんじゃないかな。:
Well, it *is* a couples exhibit,
so I guess that's to be expected.
translations.これが日本のカップル展だったら、こうはいかないよな。……最近はそうでもないのか？:
If this were Japanese couples,
it wouldn't be like this at all.
...Or maybe it would nowadays？
translations.ふふ、最近は、だって。オジサンみたいなこと言ってる。:
Hehe, 'nowadays'？
You sound like an old man.
translations.ねえ、私たちだったらどんな写真を撮るかな？:
Hey, what kind of photo
do you think we'd take？
translations.そうだな……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は何かアイデアある？:
Good question...
Do you have any ideas, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そうね……んー、何でもいいかなあ。:
Well... Hmm, anything would be
fine by me, honestly.
translations.あなたと一緒にいる場面なら、いつ撮られてもオッケーってこと。誰かに見せるなら普段:
I just mean any moment with you
is fine anytime. If people are going to
see it, I'd want to show them
the way we normally are, wouldn't you？
translations.でも……ここに展示されてるようなのも、いいかも？:
Though... maybe something like
what's on display here wouldn't
be bad either？
translations.えっ、●と▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がキスしてる写真!?:
Wait, a photo of ●
and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ kissing!？
translations.……ん、やっぱりダメ。ちょっと恥ずかしいね。:
...Mm, on second thought, nope.
That's a bit too embarrassing.
translations.ねえ、私たちが写真を撮るならって話だけど……。:
Hey, about that idea of
taking a photo of us...
translations.うん、さっきの続き？:
Yeah？ Picking up where
we left off？
translations.もしね、あなたが私とのキスの写真を展示したいって言うなら、私は反対しないよ？:
If you ever wanted to put up
a photo of us kissing...
I wouldn't say no, you know？
translations.もしもの話。カップルがキスするのって、よく考えたら恥ずかしがるようなことじゃない:
It's just a 'what if.'
Couples kissing isn't really
something to be shy about.
translations.そうかもしれないけど、公開するとなるとちょっと……。:
Maybe not, but putting it
on display is a bit...
translations.そんなに困った顔しないで。実際にそんなことするつもりないから。:
Don't look so troubled.
I don't actually plan on
doing anything like that.
translations.照れちゃって。かわいいんだから、もう▼:
Look who's blushing.
You're so cute, ▼.
translations.あなたは私のものですって証明になるし、いいと思うんだけどな……。:
It'd be proof you belong
to me, though. I think
it'd be kind of nice...
translations.こういう雰囲気も悪くないなと思って。ロックって感じ？:
I was thinking this vibe
isn't bad at all.
Feels very rock, right？
translations.なあに？ 私には似合わない、みたいな顔しちゃって。:
What's that face？ Like you
think it doesn't suit me？
translations.ホント？ じゃあ、私がロックぽい格好したら、似合うと思う？:
Really？ Then if I dressed
like a rocker, do you think
it'd look good on me？
translations.ロックぽいって、例えば？:
Like a rocker？ Like what,
for example？
translations.えっと、鎖がいっぱいついてて、ジャラジャラ音がして……。:
Um, with lots of chains that
jingle and clatter...
translations.そう。それから皮の重そうなブーツをはいて、背中に龍や虎の刺繍があるの。:
Right. And heavy leather boots,
with a dragon or tiger
stitched on the back.
translations.それでね、ふわふわの羽根は必須かな。体のどこかにタトゥーがあったら完璧かも。そう:
Fluffy feathers are a must.
A tattoo somewhere would be
perfect. What do you think？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のロックって……）:
(What does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ think
rock is, anyway...？)
translations.ああ、なんでも。今日はラブソングナイトだっていうんだから、ロックはあんまり関係な:
Oh, nothing. It's Love Song
Night, so rock probably
doesn't matter anyway.
translations.そっか。どうしてこんな話になったんだっけ……。:
True. How did we even
get onto that, anyway...？
translations.お客さん、カップルばかりだね。:
Almost everyone here is
a couple, aren't they？
translations.ラブソングナイトだしな。: Well, it is Love Song Night.
translations.こういう場所に当たり前のようにいるのって、いいね。:
It's nice just being here
like it's totally natural.
translations.そうだな。●たちカップルですって感じで。:
Yeah. Like showing everyone
that ● are a couple.
translations.こういう時は恋人らしく寄り添って、ね？:
We should snuggle up like
real lovers now, right？
translations.最後の曲良かったな。初披露だったらしいけど。:
That last song was great.
Sounded like it was their
first time playing it, too.
translations.うん、すごく良かった。最後だけじゃなくて、全部。:
Yeah, it was incredible.
Not just the last one,
but all of them.
translations.そっか。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はこういうの好きなんだな。:
I see. So ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really
likes this kind of music.
translations.女の子ならみんな好きなんじゃないかな。普段はこういう曲を聞かない子でも、彼と一緒:
I think any girl would.
Even if she doesn't usually,
she'd love it with her guy.
translations.●も、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と聞いたから浸れたのかも。:
Maybe ● got so swept
away because I heard it
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そりゃ。カノジョなんだし。:
Of course. You're my
girlfriend, after all.
translations.私も、聞きながらあなたのことばかり考えてたよ。:
Me too... The whole time,
all I could think about
was you.
translations.ね、もう少しこうしててもいい？ しばらく余韻に浸ってたいの。:
Hey, can we stay like this
a little longer？ 
I want to soak it all in
for a bit.
translations.……私たち、恋愛してるんだね。:
...We really are in love,
aren't we？
translations.うん。……大好き。ずっと。:
Mm... I love you.
Always and forever.
translations.腹減る匂いだよなあ。さてと、カラオケ前に何買う？:
That smells so appetizing.
So, what should we get
before karaoke？
translations.そうね、のど飴は外せないかな。このあと、カラオケでガンガン歌うんだしね？:
Let's see, lozenges are
a must, right？ Since we're
gonna sing our hearts out!
translations.ふふ。飲み物はフリードリンクがあるから、スナックを少し買っておこうかな。……あ。:
Hehe. Drinks are unlimited,
so maybe a few snacks...
...Oh.
translations.肉まん美味しそう……。:
Those pork buns
look so good...
translations.コンビニの罠に引っかかったか。:
Fell for the convenience
store trap, huh？
translations.引っかかっちゃいました。ねえ、半分こしない？:
Guilty as charged.
Hey, wanna split one？
translations.一個ずつでもいいよ。:
We could get one each,
you know.
translations.ふたりで半分こっていうの、いいじゃない。大きいほう、あげるね？:
Isn't sharing half the fun？
I'll give you
the bigger piece!
translations.他の部屋、もう満室みたい。:
Looks like the other rooms
are full already.
translations.そうなんだ。早めに来といて良かったな。:
Really？ Good thing
we came early, then.
translations.みんな朝までいるのかな……。:
I wonder if everyone's
staying until morning...
translations.定額だし、そういう人も多いんじゃないか？:
It's a flat rate, so there's
probably a lot of them.
translations.私たちもやっちゃおうか。オールナイト。:
Maybe we should do it too.
An all-nighter.
translations.朝までカラオケくらい、友達にもやってる子いるよ？:
Some of my friends do
all-night karaoke, you know？
translations.そういうわけには……。: I can't let us do that...
translations.歌うだけじゃない。私、別に構わないよ。:
It's just singing.
I wouldn't mind at all.
translations.ダメだよ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。後でちゃんと送って行くから。:
No way, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm seeing you home properly
after this.
translations.……はあい。ノリでやっちゃえってなると思ったのになあ。:
...Fiiine. And here I thought
you'd get caught up in
the moment and agree.
translations.いいの、わかってる。私のこと本当に大事にしてくれてるんだね。……ありがと。:
It's okay, I understand.
You really do cherish me,
don't you？ ...Thank you.
translations.さ、何歌おっか。デュエットしちゃう？:
Now then, what to sing？
Wanna do a duet？
translations.……そんな顔しないで？ お詫びにあなたのために一曲歌うから、ね？:
...Don't make that face？ 
I'll sing a song just for you
to make up for it, okay？
translations.ねえ、ゲームセンターなのになんだか雰囲気が違うね。:
Hey, even though it's an arcade,
the vibe feels different today.
translations.……あそこ混んでる。何があるのかな？:
...It's crowded over there.
I wonder what's going on？
translations.……相性占いみたい。二人の相性が点数で出るんだって。:
...Looks like compatibility
fortune telling. Apparently
it scores how well we match.
translations.面白そうだな。二人の生年月日で占うのか。:
Sounds fun.
It uses both our birthdays？
translations.あっ……。ねえ、今のカップル……。:
Ah...
Hey, that couple just now...
translations.どうする？ やってみる？:
What should we do？
Wanna give it a shot？
translations.ちょっと怖い気もするけどな。:
I'm a little scared to look,
honestly.
translations.私は何点が出ても大丈夫。機械なんかに負けないんだから。:
I'm fine with any score.
I won't let some machine
beat us.
translations.そうだな。遊びだと思って……。:
Yeah. Let's just treat it
like a silly game...
translations.だって、中途半端じゃない？ ７５点だなんて。:
I mean, isn't 75 just
so middle-of-the-road？
translations.あれでも高得点らしいよ。あの機械、いい点出さないことで有名らしいから。:
That's supposed to be high.
That machine's famous for
never giving good scores.
translations.そんなの、私たちなら乗り越えちゃうと思ったんだけどな。:
Still, I thought we'd beat
the odds, you know？
translations.生年月日だけじゃ、●たちのことなんてわかんないよ。:
You can't really understand
● just from birthdays.
translations.機械が何点つけたって、●にとって▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は１００点だよ。:
Whatever the machine says,
to ●, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
a perfect 100.
translations.それを言うなら、あなたは１２０点だよ？:
If we're going there,
you're a 120, you know？
translations.ねえ。カップルらしく撮ろっか。:
Hey, let's take one
like a real couple.
translations.決まり▼ どれにしようかな～。:
It's a deal▼
Now, which one to pick...？
translations.よくわかんないな。次はこれ押すの？:
I don't really get this.
Do I press this next？
translations.カウントダウン始まっちゃってる！ ポーズポーズ！:
The countdown's already
started！ Pose, pose！
translations.ええっ、どこ見れば……、あっ……。:
Wait, where do I look...
Ah...
translations.だって、あんなに慌てて……。:
I can't help it, you were
so flustered...
translations.だから撮り直そうって……。:
That's why I said we should
retake it...
translations.これはこれでいいの。……ふふっ。:
This is cute in its own way.
...Hehe.
translations.（……まあいいか。なんか喜んでるし）:
(...Well, whatever.
She seems happy, at least.)
translations.わっ、すごい人……。:
Whoa, look at all
these people...
translations.これ全部客……じゃないよな？ 人数制限あるはずだし。:
These can't all be people
going in, right？
There's a capacity limit.
translations.入りたくても入れないファンなのかな。私たち、運が良かったんだね。:
Maybe they're fans who
couldn't get in.
We were really lucky,
weren't we？
translations.お、さっそく始まるみたいだぞ。:
Oh, looks like it's starting
already.
translations.うん。外の人たちにも聞こえるといいけど。:
Yeah. I hope the people
outside can hear it, too.
translations.……はぁ。あっという間に終わっちゃったね。……あれ？:
...Phew. That was over
in a flash. ...Wait, huh？
translations.お店の人が、出口はあっちですって。入ってきたところと違うみたい。:
The staff said the exit's
over there. Looks like it's
different from the entrance.
translations.表はファンでいっぱいで、出られないのかも。:
Maybe the front's so packed
that nobody can get out.
translations.ああ、すごい人だったもんな。:
Yeah, the crowd
was pretty crazy.
translations.……ねえ、もし私がメジャーデビューしたら、あなたもあんな風に追いかけてくれる？:
...Hey, if I ever made
my major debut, would you
chase after me like that too？
translations.んー、ちょっとやだな。:
Hmm, I kinda wouldn't
like that.
translations.だって、それは●の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲じゃなくて、みんなの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲になるってことだろ:
Because that'd mean
you're not ●'s ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
you'd be everyone's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.ふーん、それで、ちょっとイヤなだけなんだ？:
Hmm, so you'd only mind
a "little" bit？
translations.いや、すごく。ものすごーーーく。:
No, a lot.
A whooole lot.
translations.じゃあ、いつまでもあなただけの私でいてあげる▼:
Then I'll just stay
yours and yours alone forever▼
translations.まだ人がいっぱいいるね。:
There are still
so many people out here.
translations.ライブはとっくに終わったのにな。:
Even though the show's
been over for a while.
translations.ファンの人たちが残ってるのかな？:
I wonder if the fans
are lingering around？
translations.ひどいな、向こうからぶつかってきたくせに。よし……。:
That's awful, they're the ones
who bumped into you! All right...
translations.あ、行っちゃダメ。大丈夫だから、ね？:
Ah, don't go over there.
I'm fine, really. Okay？
translations.何か言い争ってるみたい。ほら、さっきの人も。:
Looks like they're arguing.
Look, that person from
before is over there too.
translations.きっとファン同士でもめてるんだよ。近寄るのやめとこ？:
It's probably a fight
between fans. Let's not
get close, okay？
translations.うん……。まったく、人のカノジョを巻き込むなよな……。:
Yeah... Seriously,
don't drag someone else's
girlfriend into it...
translations.今のはしょうがないよ。……ふふ。:
It couldn't be helped just now.
...Hehe.
translations.だってぶつかられたのは私なのに、自分のことみたいに怒ってるんだもの。:
Well, I'm the one who got
bumped into, but you're as mad
as if it happened to you.
translations.それだけで十分。さ、行こ。:
That's more than enough for me.
Come on, let's go.
translations.わあ、向こうまで\nずっと歩行者天国なんだ。\n結構長いんだね。:
Wow, it's a pedestrian
zone all the way down.
It's pretty long, huh.
translations.人が多くて見通せないな。:
There are so many people
I can't see very far.
translations.あそこで踊ってる人たち、\nみんな動物のお面つけてる。\nかわいい～▼:
The people dancing over there,
they're all wearing animal masks.
So cute~▼
translations.はは、ホントだ。\n……あ、こっち見た。:
Haha, you're right.
...Ah, they looked this way.
translations.一緒に踊ろうってこと\nなのかな……。:
Do they want us to
dance with them...？
translations.こっちに来たよ。\n行ってらっしゃい。:
They're coming over.
Off you go!
translations.私はダメ！ \n踊るなんて……。\nここで見てるから頑張って▼:
Not me!
Me, dancing...？
I'll watch from here,
so do your best▼
translations.すごいすごい！ \nちゃんと踊れてたね。:
Way to go!
You were actually dancing!
translations.適当に手足動かしてただけだよ。\n周りがフォローしてくれてたし。:
I was just flailing my limbs
around. The people around me
were covering for me.
translations.うん、かわいかった▼ \nあ、録画するの忘れちゃった。:
Yeah, you were so cute▼
Oh, I forgot to record it.
translations.お疲れ様。\nかわいくて、カッコよかったよ？:
Good job out there.
You were cute,
and pretty cool, too？
translations.複雑だけど……サンキュー。:
I have mixed feelings,
but... thanks.
translations.さっきまであんなに賑やかだったのに……。:
It was so lively just a
little while ago, and now...
translations.まさに祭りの後って感じだな。:
It really feels like
the party's over.
translations.歩行者天国も終わっちゃったしね。少し歩こっか。:
The pedestrian zone's
over now too. Shall we
walk a little bit？
translations.そろそろお店が閉まる時間みたい。:
Looks like the shops are
starting to close.
translations.この辺、早いんだよなあ。:
Things shut down early
around here.
translations.でも、昔よりマシだって友達が言ってたよ。前はもっと早くに閉まってたし、それに飲食:
A friend told me it's
better than it used to be.
They used to close earlier,
and there were barely any
restaurants around.
translations.今じゃデートコースの一つなのにな。:
Even though it's a regular
date spot now.
translations.そうだね。あなたと一緒なら、どこでもデートコースになっちゃうけど。:
True. But as long as I'm
with you, anywhere is
a date spot.
translations.はは、変なとこには連れて行かないよ。:
Haha, I'd never take you
anywhere weird.
translations.私のためにあちこちチェックしてくれてるの、知ってるよ。デートの達人だね？:
I know you scout places
out for me. A real dating
expert, aren't you？
translations.大げさだなあ。悪い気はしないけど。:
You're exaggerating.
Doesn't feel bad to hear,
though.
translations.ねえ、観覧車に乗らない？ 夕日がすごくきれい。:
Hey, want to ride the
Ferris wheel？ The sunset
is so pretty.
translations.いいけど、夜に乗ろうって言ってなかった？:
Sure, but didn't you say
you wanted to ride it
at night？
translations.夜も乗るよ？ 夕方と夜とじゃ景色が全然違うじゃない。:
We'll ride it tonight too！
The view's totally different
between sunset and night,
right？
translations.それもそうか。じゃあ、今のうちにいろいろ乗らないとな。:
Fair point. We should hit
a bunch of rides while
we can, then.
translations.うん。ジェットコースターやメリーゴーランドもね？:
Yeah. Roller coasters and
the carousel too, okay？
translations.よろしい。あとはお化け屋敷と……。:
Good boy. Next is the
haunted house, and...
translations.お化け屋敷は、夕方も夜も変わらないだろ？:
The haunted house won't be
any different at night,
though, right？
translations.あ、そっか。でも何度入ってもいいじゃない？:
Oh, right. But what's wrong
with going through more
than once？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、好きだもんな。いいよ、何でも何回でも付き合うから。:
You do love those, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Sure, I'll ride whatever
with you as many times
as you like.
translations.ありがと▼ じゃあ、メリーゴーランドには１０回くらい乗っちゃおうかな。:
Thanks▼ Then maybe
I'll ride the carousel about
ten times！
translations.わあ、素敵……。やっぱり夕方とは雰囲気が全然違うね。:
Wow, so pretty...
The atmosphere really is
totally different from dusk.
translations.ちょっと早いクリスマスみたいだな。:
Kind of feels like
an early Christmas.
translations.言えてる。ねえ、さっそく観覧車に行こ。:
Totally. Come on, let's head
straight to the Ferris wheel.
translations.了解。混んでないといいけど。:
Roger that. Hope it's not
too crowded.
translations.結構並んだな。それもカップルばっかり。:
That was quite a line.
Nothing but couples, too.
translations.しょうがないよ、夜の観覧車はデートの定番だもの。:
Can't be helped. Riding the
Ferris wheel at night is a
classic date thing.
translations.だって二人きりになれるじゃない。遊園地の中ではそんな場所、ここくらいしかないし。:
Well, you get to be alone.
In an amusement park, this is
the only place like that.
translations.ねえ、山の上のほうに明りが見える。山小屋があるのかな？:
Hey, I see a light up on
the mountain. Wonder if
there's a cabin up there？
translations.かもな。他は真っ暗だけど。:
Maybe. Everything else is
pitch black, though.
translations.あんな山小屋に二人きりってシチュエーションも、いいかも。:
Being all alone together in a
cabin like that sounds kind
of nice, too.
translations.真っ暗で怖いんじゃない？:
Wouldn't it be scary
being in the pitch black？
translations.あなたがいれば平気。今このゴンドラが止まっても、あなたがいるから怖くないよ？:
I'm fine as long as you're
here. Even if this gondola
stopped right now, I wouldn't
be scared with you around.
translations.怖いこと言うなよ……。:
Don't say scary things
like that...
translations.もう、あなたが怖がってどうするの？ ふふっ。:
Geez, why are you the one
getting scared？ Hehe.
translations.……そんなに見られたら照れるじゃない。どうかな？:
...Staring like that
makes me blush.
Well, what do you think？
translations.ありがと。ねえ、本当にカップルばっかりだね？:
Thanks. Hey, there really
are couples everywhere,
aren't there？
translations.そりゃカップルオンリーデーだからな。:
Well, it is couples'
day after all.
translations.じゃあみんなに負けないよう、いちゃいちゃしなくっちゃ。:
Then we'd better get
all lovey-dovey so we
don't lose to the rest!
translations.ね、あっち行こ？ それとも何か冷たいものでも飲む？:
Hey, let's head over there.
Or maybe grab something
cold to drink？
translations.そんなかわいい顔されると、お姉さん抱きしめたくなっちゃうな～▼:
Make a cute face like that
and big sis will just
have to hug you~▼
translations.しょうがない、このくらいで勘弁してあげますか。ホントいじめがいがあるんだから。:
Guess I'll let you off
the hook for now. You're
just too fun to tease.
