translations.まだたくさん人がいるね。この後はみんなどこに行くのかな。:
There are still so many
people out. Wonder where
they're all headed next？
translations.帰るんじゃないか？ もういい時間だし。:
Heading home, maybe？
It's getting pretty late.
translations.大人にとって夜はこれからだよ？ お酒を飲みに行ったりするんじゃないかな。:
For grown-ups, the night's
just getting started!
Probably going for drinks.
translations.大人もそう思ってるかも。私たちのこと。:
The grown-ups might feel
the same way about us.
translations.高校生が羨ましいって？ どうかな……。:
Jealous of high schoolers？
I don't know about that...
translations.だって、私たちはこれから大人になるけど、大人は高校生に戻れないじゃない。二度と戻:
We're going to be adults
soon, but they can never
go back to high school.
Never ever again, right？
translations.だから、今を大切にしなくちゃ。:
That's why we have to
make the most of now.
translations.今日の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、なんだか大人っぽいな。:
You seem kind of
grown-up today, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あら、私はいつでもお姉さんでしょ？:
Oh？ But aren't I always
your big sister？
translations.いつもはお姉さんじゃなくて、カノジョだろ？:
Usually you're my girlfriend,
not my big sister, right？
translations.……もう、そういうのずるい。ドキッとしたじゃない。:
...Jeez, that's not fair.
You made my heart flutter.
translations.そう？ さっきプールでいじめられた仕返しになったかな。:
Really？ Guess that pays
you back for teasing me
at the pool earlier.
translations.はぁ、着いた。ギリギリだったね～。:
Phew, we made it!
Just in the nick of time~.
translations.開始時間勘違いするなんてな……。:
Can't believe we got the
start time wrong...
translations.しかも二人とも。間に合って良かった。:
Both of us, too.
Glad we made it in time.
translations.面白かったね。すごい迫力。:
That was amazing.
It was so intense!
translations.３６０度スクリーンだから、どこ見ていいのか迷ったよ。:
With that 360-degree screen,
I didn't know where to look.
translations.ホントに。星が一斉にこっちに向かって流れてきた時、思わず首すくめちゃった。:
Seriously. When the stars
all came rushing at us,
I ducked without thinking.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、あの瞬間ビクッとしてたな。:
You totally flinched
back then, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.やだ、見てたの？ でもあなただって……。:
No way, you saw that？
Well, so did you...
translations.星が爆発した時、ビクッてしたでしょ。:
You jumped when that
star exploded, didn't you？
translations.もう流れちゃった。ほんの一瞬だもの。:
It's gone already.
It only lasted a split second.
translations.そっか。こんなとこでも見られるんだな。:
Oh. Didn't know you could
see them from around here.
translations.さっきプラネタリウムで言ってたね。毎晩、何百もの星が流れてるって。:
They said so at the
planetarium earlier, remember？
Hundreds fall every night.
translations.とわの市の電気が全部消えたら、たくさん見られるんだろうな。:
If all the lights in Towano
went out, I bet we'd see a ton.
translations.お願い事し放題だね。:
We could make as many
wishes as we wanted.
translations.大丈夫。もう少しこうしてていい？:
I'm okay.
Can we stay like this
a little longer？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が平気なら。:
As long as you're okay with it,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ありがとう。プラネタリウムも良かったけど、やっぱり本物の空がいいな。:
Thanks. The planetarium was
great, but nothing beats
the real sky.
translations.見える星の数じゃかなわないけどな。:
Though it can't match it
in the number of stars.
translations.写真のあなたより、本物のあなたのほうが何百倍もいいのと一緒よ？:
It's just like how the real you
is a hundred times better than
any picture, see？
translations.本物はあったかいね。: The real you is nice and warm.
translations.ねえ、ずっとあなたのそばにいさせてね？ こうしてあなたのぬくもりを感じられるくら:
Hey... let me stay by
your side forever, okay？
Close enough that I can
feel your warmth like this.
translations.夕方の植物園も面白いね。葉っぱがオレンジ色に見えて。:
The botanical garden at dusk
is pretty neat. The leaves
look all orange.
translations.昼間とは雰囲気変わるよな。:
It has a totally different vibe
than during the day.
translations.ねえ、今夜の蛍、もうこの辺りにいるのかな？:
Hey, do you think the
fireflies for tonight are
already around here？
translations.明るいから見えないだけで、もうスタンバイしてるかも。:
They might just be standing by,
hidden because it's still bright.
translations.どうだろうな。暗ければ一発でわかるんだけど。:
I wonder. If it were dark,
we'd know in a heartbeat.
translations.私、お尻が光ってなくても見たら蛍だってわかるよ？:
I can spot a firefly even if
its tail isn't glowing, you know？
translations.へえ、詳しいんだ？: Oh？ You know a lot about them.
translations.小さい頃に教えてもらったんだ。田舎では今でも蛍が見られるんだよ？:
Someone taught me when I was
little. You can still see them
in the countryside, you know？
translations.すごいな。それだけ自然が残ってるんだ。:
That's amazing. There must be
so much nature left there.
translations.それでもね、昔に比べたらかなり拓けちゃったかな。あの景色、いつかあなたにも見せて:
Even so, it's pretty developed
compared to how it used to be.
I'd love to show you that
view someday, though.
translations.カレシを田舎に連れて行くなんて、ちょっと意味深かな？:
Taking my boyfriend back to
my hometown... Sounds kind of
meaningful, doesn't it？
translations.わあ、蛍、たくさんいるね。:
Wow, there are so many
fireflies.
translations.すごいすごい。ねえ、あっちにも行ってみようよ。:
Amazing! Hey, let's go
check over there too.
translations.そんなにはしゃぐと転ぶよ。:
Don't get too excited,
you'll trip.
translations.あ、人を子供扱いしたな？ 先行っちゃうから。:
Hey, are you treating me
like a kid？ I'm leaving you
behind!
translations.（今の▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、実際子供みたいだしなあ）:
(I mean, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is
acting like a kid right now.)
translations.さっき話した、田舎の風景。歩くうちに蛍がどんどん増えて、蛍の国に迷い込んだみたい:
That scenery back home I
mentioned. As I kept walking,
more and more appeared... It was
like wandering into a firefly
kingdom.
translations.蛍の国か……。なんか幻想的だな。:
A firefly kingdom, huh...
Sounds magical.
translations.あの頃はちょっと怖い気もしたな。:
Back then, it actually felt
a little scary.
translations.ううん、あなたがいれば、きっとどこでも怖くないよ。:
Nope. As long as you're
with me, I know I won't
be scared anywhere.
translations.そうだよ？ だから、この手を離さないでね。この先もずっと。:
It is？ So don't ever let
go of this hand, okay？
Always and forever.
translations.氷の上なのに、よくあんなに動けるね……。:
It's on ice, yet they
can move like that...
Incredible.
translations.わあ……あのペア、すごく息が合ってる。ほら、ずっとまったく同じ動きをしてるの。:
Whoa... That pair is
so in sync. Look, they're
doing the exact same moves
the whole time.
translations.ホントだ。相当練習したんだろうなあ……。:
You're right. They must
have practiced like crazy...
translations.練習だけじゃないよ。相性もあると思う。:
It's not just practice.
I bet chemistry has a lot
to do with it, too.
translations.そっか、相性が良くないとパートナーとして続かないだろうな。:
True. If they didn't have
chemistry, they probably
couldn't stay partners.
translations.だよね？ あの二人、恋人同士じゃないかな。:
Right？ Don't you think
those two might be
a couple？
translations.どうかな。ペアだからってカップルなわけじゃ……。:
Hard to say. Just because
they're a pair doesn't
mean they're a couple...
translations.あんなに息が合ってるんだもん。それに二人とも安心しきった顔してるでしょ？ あれは:
They're just so in sync!
Plus, look how completely
safe they feel together.
I don't think you can make
that face unless you're
really a couple.
translations.きっとそうよ。固いきずなで結ばれた二人……ロマンチックだと思わない？:
I bet they are. Two people
bound by an unbreakable
bond... Don't you think
that's romantic？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が乙女モードだ……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is in full-on
maiden mode...)
translations.……手、絶対に離さないでね？:
...Promise you won't let
go of my hand, okay？
translations.離さないよ。ほら、もう片方の手もこっちに。:
I won't. Come on,
give me your other
hand too.
translations.やっぱり無理よ。壁から離れると立ってられないもの。:
I really can't do it!
If I let go of the wall,
I can't even stand!
translations.パートナーを信頼する……だろ？:
You gotta trust your
partner... right？
translations.……そうね、私はあなたのパートナーだもん。あなたが大丈夫って言うなら、絶対大丈夫:
...You're right. I am
your partner, after all.
If you say it's okay,
then it's definitely okay...
translations.いい？ 離すからね？ 離さないでね？:
Ready？ I'm letting go,
okay？ Don't let go of me!
translations.……せーの、はい！ ……あっ、離さないで！ 動かないで！:
...Ready, and... go!
...Ah, don't let go!
Don't move!
translations.動かないよ。足の力抜かないで、そのままそのまま……。:
I'm not moving. Keep your
legs steady, just like
that, stay right there...
translations.……あ、立ってる。私、一人で立ってる。:
...Oh, I'm standing!
I'm standing on my own!
translations.すごい。氷の上で立つなんて絶対無理だと思ってたのに。あなたのおかげよ。:
Amazing! I thought standing
on ice was totally
impossible. It's all
thanks to you!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が頑張ったんだよ。……じゃあ、ちょっと動いてみる？:
You did great, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
...Wanna try moving a bit？
translations.だ、ダメ！ 絶対動いちゃダメだよ？ 信頼してるからね？:
N-No way! Absolutely no
moving, okay？ I'm putting
my trust in you here!
translations.さすが、オシャレに気合い入ってる子が多いね。:
As expected, there are
so many girls here who
really dressed to impress.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も負けてないよ。:
You look just as great,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ありがとう。でもまだまだだから。今日は勉強して帰るの。:
Thanks. But I still have
a long way to go. I'm here
to take notes today!
translations.お待たせしました。まもなくガールズコレクションの開催です！:
Thank you for waiting!
The Girls Collection will
begin momentarily!
translations.結構内容盛りだくさんだったな。ライブとかトークとか。:
There was a lot packed in
there. Concerts, talk
shows, and everything.
translations.そうだね。でもやっぱりメインのファッションショーが素敵だったなあ。:
Yeah. But the main fashion
show was still so lovely.
translations.思ってるのとちょっと違ったけどな。ファッションショーの服って、普通じゃ着れないよ:
It wasn't quite what I
expected, though. I thought
fashion show clothes were
all unwearable stuff.
translations.ガールズコレクションは、そのまま着られるファッションが売りなの。ねえ、３番目と７:
Girls Collection is all
about wearable fashion.
Hey, what did you think
of numbers three and seven？
translations.３番目はグレーとカーキを合わせた森ガール風で、７番目はシルバーのぴったりしたワン:
The 3rd was mori girl style,
mixing gray and khaki. And
the 7th was a snug silver
dress with purple and
pink floral patterns.
translations.うーん、覚えてるような覚えてないような……。:
Hmm, I kinda remember,
kinda don't...
translations.最後のほうのインテリ風ファッションも捨てがたいのよね。スタイルはかっちりしたＯＬ:
That smart, chic look near
the end was hard to pass up
too. Cut like a crisp office
lady, but in denim and
leather, remember？
translations.そうだっけ……。すごい記憶力だな。:
Was it...？
You've got an amazing
memory.
translations.……ねえ、ちゃんと服を見てた？ もしかして、モデルさんばかり見てたんじゃない？:
...Hey, were you even
looking at the clothes？
You weren't just staring at
the models, were you？
translations.ホントかなあ、服のことあまり覚えてないみたいだし。:
I wonder~. You barely
remember the outfits,
after all.
translations.それは▲姉ヶ崎＊▲みたいに詳しくないからだって。:
That's just 'cause I don't
know fashion like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.まあ、いいでしょう。その代わり、後でお買い物に付き合ってね？ 私に似合う服を見つ:
Well, fine, I'll let it
slide. In return, come
shopping with me later,
okay？ I won't let you go
until we find something
that looks good on me.
translations.混んでるな。やっぱショーの影響か。:
It's packed.
Guess that's the fashion
show effect.
translations.モデルさんが着たのと同じ服が販売されてるんだもの。女の子なら、自分も着てみたいっ:
They're selling the exact
same clothes the models
wore! Any girl would want
to try them on, right？
translations.もちろん。私だって女の子ですからね？ それに、高校生のお財布にも優しいお値段なの:
Of course. I'm a girl too,
you know？ Plus, the prices
are super friendly on a high
schooler's wallet. That's
the real charm.
translations.それが……迷ってるうちにどんどんなくなって、欲しいのが売りきれちゃったの。:
Well... while I was trying
to decide, they went fast,
and the one I wanted
sold out.
translations.フリルのキャミとデニムパンツのコーデ、すっごく可愛かったのになあ。手に持ってたは:
That ruffled cami and denim
pants combo was so cute...
I could've sworn I had it
in my hands, but then
it just vanished...
translations.あん、もう、悔しい。もう一度見てくるね？ せっかく来たんだから、絶対何か買って帰:
Ugh, so frustrating!
I'm going to look again,
okay？ I came all this way,
I'm definitely taking
something home!
translations.●のことは気にしなくていいから、思う存分見ておいでよ。:
Don't worry about ●.
Go take your time and look
to your heart's content.
translations.ありがとう。……ねえ、こういうのちょっといいね？:
Thanks. ...Hey, isn't
something like this
kind of nice？
translations.カノジョの買い物に付き合って待つカレシの図。:
The whole 'boyfriend
waiting around while his
girlfriend shops' thing.
translations.うん。待たせてばかりでごめんね？ すぐに終わるから。:
Yep. Sorry for keeping you
waiting, okay？
I'll be done real soon.
translations.ＥＣＯの恋愛講座出張版か……。:
ECO's Love Seminar, special
roadshow edition, huh...
translations.楽しみだな～。私、ＷＥＢマガジン読んでるんだ。:
I'm so excited~. I read
their web magazine,
you know.
translations.●も。女性向けもあるんだな。:
● does too. Didn't know
they had one for women,
though.
translations.うん。男女両方の立場を理解してるなんて、どんな人なんだろうね？:
Yeah. I wonder what kind of
person understands both guys
and girls so well？
translations.それなりに経験豊富じゃないと無理だろうから……。:
You'd have to be pretty
experienced to pull that
off, so...
translations.すっごく年なのかもしれないね。私たちのお父さんくらい。:
Maybe they're super old.
Like, around our dads' age.
translations.男性じゃなかった？ 確かプロフィールにはそう書いてあったような……。:
Weren't they a guy？
I'm pretty sure that's what
the profile said...
translations.皆さま、お待たせしました！ それでは恋のカリスマＥＣＯの登場です。拍手でお迎えく:
Thank you all for waiting!
And now, here's our love
guru, ECO! Give them a
big round of applause!
translations.ボンソワーフ。は～い、ＥＣＯです。今日も悩める子羊ちゃん達のお悩みを解決しちゃう:
Bonsoir~! Yes, it's me, ECO!
Today, I'm here to solve
all you troubled little
lambs' problems once again!
translations.あれ？ 女性みたいだね？:
Huh？ Looks like a woman,
right？
translations.え、女じゃない……よな？:
Wait, that's not a woman...
is it？
translations.それじゃあ子羊ちゃん達、またお会いしましょう▼ オ・ルヴォワール。:
Well then, my little lambs,
until we meet again▼
Au revoir!
translations.……すごい熱気だったね。:
...That was some intense
energy, wasn't it？
translations.いろんなカップルがいるもんだな……。:
There really are all kinds
of couples out there...
translations.お悩み相談、私も何か質問してみれば良かったな。:
I should've asked something
during the advice session too.
translations.カレシに不満が見つからないんですけど、どうしたらいいですかって。ふふっ。:
Like, "I can't find a single
thing wrong with my boyfriend,
what should I do？" Hehe.
translations.さっきの恋愛講座について考えてたんだけど……。:
I was just thinking about
that love seminar earlier...
translations.アドバイスはためになったし面白かったけど、やっぱり他人事になっちゃうのよね。他の:
The advice was helpful and fun,
but in the end, it's about
other people. We're different.
translations.そりゃそうだ。参考にはなるけど。:
True enough.
Good to keep in mind, though.
translations.あなたは何か質問なかったの？:
Didn't you have anything
you wanted to ask？
translations.うーん、パッと思いつかないな……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は？:
Hmm, nothing really comes
to mind... What about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.さっき言ったじゃない。カレシに不満がないのが悩みですって。:
I told you already. My problem
is having nothing to complain
about with my boyfriend.
translations.そうね、あるとしたら、あなたにもっと好かれるようにするにはどうすればいいですか、:
Well, if anything, maybe "How can
I make you like me even more？"
Something like that？
translations.そう。私はあなたのことがどんどん好きになるから、あなたにもそうなってもらいたいな:
Yup. I keep falling for you
more and more, so I want you
to feel that way too.
translations.そんなの、わざわざ相談しなくたって……。:
You don't need to ask
anyone about that...
translations.十分間に合ってるっていうかさ。●も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のことが、えーと、どんどん……。:
I mean, it's already plenty.
●'s falling for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
er, more and more too...
translations.ねえ、顔真っ赤だよ？:
Hey, your face is totally red,
you know？
translations.あなたのそんな顔が見られただけで大満足。今日は来て良かった▼:
Just seeing that look on your face
makes this all worth it.
I'm so glad I came today▼
translations.ちょうどいい時期に来たな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は花に詳しいほう？:
We came at just the right time.
Do you know much about flowers,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.好きだけど、そこまで詳しくはないかな……。:
I like them, but I wouldn't say
I know that much...
translations.バラはバラでたくさんの種類があるしね。新しい品種に奥さんや恋人の名前がついてたり:
Roses have so many varieties, too.
New ones are sometimes named
after someone's wife or lover.
translations.ロマンティックよね。花と一緒に大切な人の名前が一生残るんだもの。:
It's so romantic. The name of
someone precious lives on forever,
right along with the flower.
translations.どうせなら自分の名前もつければいいのにな。▲名前▲＆寧々とかさ。:
They should put their own name on
it too while they're at it.
Like, "▲名前▲ & Nene."
translations.あ、それいい。二人の愛は永遠って感じがする。:
Oh, I like that! It really feels
like our love is forever.
translations.よし。●が名前をつける機会があれば、そうしよう。:
All right. If ● ever gets
the chance to name one,
let's do that.
translations.ホント？ 私、本気にしちゃうよ？:
Really？ You know I'm going to
take you seriously, right？
translations.えーと、可能性がないわけじゃないしな。もしもの話だけど……。:
Well, it's not like it's completely
impossible. Hypothetically, anyway...
translations.素敵……。今度品種改良について調べてみなくちゃ。:
How wonderful... I'll have to read
up on plant breeding sometime.
translations.お花、もうあんまり見えないね。:
You can barely see
the flowers anymore, huh？
translations.こう暗いとな。なんか咲いてるのはわかるけど。:
Not when it's this dark.
I can still tell something's
blooming, though.
translations.ねえ、さっきより香りが強くなったと思わない？:
Hey, don't you think their scent
got stronger than before？
translations.花の？ そういえば……。:
From the flowers？
Now that you mention it...
translations.見えないせいで、嗅覚が研ぎ澄まされてるのかな。いい香り……。:
Maybe our sense of smell gets
sharper when we can't see.
It smells so nice...
translations.こうしてたら大丈夫。……ねえ、あなたもお花の香りがするよ？:
I'm fine like this.
...Hey, you smell like flowers too,
you know？
translations.洗剤の香りかな。いい匂いだね。:
Maybe it's your detergent.
It's a really nice scent.
translations.そうかな。自分じゃよくわからないけど。:
Really？ 
I can't really tell myself.
translations.あとでメーカー教えて？ 私もあなたと同じ匂いになっちゃお。:
Tell me the brand later, okay？
Then I'll smell just like you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は今のままで、いい匂いだと思うけどな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ think you smell
great just as you are, though.
translations.そう？ シャンプーかな……。お花よりいい匂い？:
Really？ Maybe my shampoo...
Better than the flowers？
translations.調子いいんだから。じゃあこのままでいてあげる。:
You flatterer.
I'll stay just like this for you.
translations.……あなたがそうやって褒めてくれるたびに、自分のことも好きになれる気がする。:
...Every time you praise me
like that, I feel like I can
like myself a little more.
translations.じゃあもっと褒めちゃおうかな？:
Then maybe I should compliment
you even more？
translations.もう、調子のいいことばかり言ってるとこうよ。コチョコチョの刑！:
Jeez, keep sweet-talking me
and see what happens!
Tickle torture!
translations.冬はやっぱりこうじゃなくちゃね？:
Winter really isn't the same
without this, is it？
translations.冬じゃなくてもこうしてるけどな？:
Pretty sure we do this
even when it's not winter？
translations.寒い日にわざわざ海岸沿いを歩いて、恋人同士であたため合うのがいいんじゃない。:
Going all the way to the coast
on a freezing day just to keep
each other warm is the best!
translations.確かに一人じゃ来ないかもな。:
True, I probably wouldn't come
out here alone.
translations.冷たーい。顔が痛くなりそう。今年一番の冷え込みじゃない？:
Brrr, so cold! My face hurts.
Isn't this the coldest day
all year？
translations.しかも海風だしな。どこかで温かいもんでも飲もうか。:
Plus the sea breeze.
Wanna go grab something hot
to drink somewhere？
translations.もう少しここにいたいな。その代わりぎゅってしてくれる？:
I wanna stay here a bit longer.
Hold me tight instead？
translations.オッケー。じゃあ二人で耐久戦だ。:
Deal. Then let's see how long
the two of us can last.
translations.二人なら寒さに負けたりしないんだから。:
With the two of us together,
the cold won't beat us!
translations.ナイトクルーズなんて、贅沢。友達にも来たことある子、いないんじゃないかな。:
A night cruise is such a treat.
None of my friends have ever
been on one, I bet.
translations.●の周りにもいないかも……。:
● don't think anyone
I know has, either...
translations.だよね？ ねえ、陸からと船からじゃ見える景色が全然違うんだね。素敵……。:
Right？ The view from a boat
is totally different from land.
It's so gorgeous...
translations.そうだな。夜景なんて似たようなもんだと思ってたけど。:
Yeah. I figured all night views
were pretty much the same.
translations.海の上が暗いせいかな、遠くの明かりがいつもより明るく見えない？:
Maybe it's 'cause the ocean's
so dark, but don't the lights
look brighter than usual？
translations.星なんかもネオンがないとよく見えるしな？:
Stars are easier to see
without all the neon, too, right？
translations.……私たちはあの光の中に住んでるんだね。なんだか不思議。:
...We actually live inside
all those lights.
It feels kind of surreal.
translations.大丈夫。ふふ、今日一日で何回心配してもらったかな。:
I'm fine. Hehe, I wonder how
many times you've worried
about me today.
translations.今日は特に冷えるからさ。風も強いし。:
It's extra cold out today.
The wind is pretty strong, too.
translations.あなたが寒いんでしょ。手貸してみて？:
You're the one who's cold.
Let me see your hands？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の手、あったかいな。:
Your hands are so warm,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あなたが冷えてるのよ。ちゃんとあたたかくしなきゃダメじゃない。風邪引いたらどうす:
You're just freezing!
You need to stay warm.
What if you catch a cold？
translations.大丈夫だって。母親みたいなこと言うなあ。:
I'm fine. You sound just
like a mom, you know.
translations.あなたが手のかかる子供みたいなんだもの。しょうがない、お母さんがあたためてあげる:
That's 'cause you're such a
handful. Guess Mommy will just
have to warm you up.
Come here, ▼.
translations.暑いね～。干からびちゃいそう。:
So hot... I feel like
I'm gonna shrivel up.
translations.飲み物買ってくるから日影に入ってなよ。何がいい？:
I'll go buy us some drinks,
so stay in the shade, okay？
What do you want？
translations.じゃあ、あなたと同じで。いい場所探しとくね？:
Same as you, then.
I'll find a nice spot, okay？
translations.了解。あまり遠くに行かないでよ。:
Got it. Don't wander
too far, alright？
translations.えーと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はどこに……。:
Now then, where did
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ go...？
translations.そんなんじゃありません。いい加減にしてください。:
It's nothing like that.
Please leave me alone.
translations.んだよ、ほんとに男いたのか。ちっ。:
What, you really did have
a guy with you. Tch.
translations.今の奴……ナンパ？:
Was that guy...
trying to hit on you？
translations.あなたの顔見たら、ホッとしちゃって……。すごくしつこいんだもの。それに……。:
Seeing your face made me
so relieved...
He was really persistent.
And on top of that...
translations.あなたのことを悪く言うのよ？ 一人にするような男なんて捨てろとか、もういろいろ。:
He talked bad about you!
Told me to dump a guy who'd
leave me alone, and all that.
It made me so mad!
translations.あん、もう。もっとガツンと言ってやれば良かった。悔しい～！:
Ugh, seriously! I should've
given him a piece of my mind!
It's so frustrating~!
translations.（何事もなくて良かった……かな？）:
(Well... at least nothing
happened, I guess？)
translations.波の音が大きく聞こえる……。さっきまであんなに人がいたのに。:
The waves sound so loud...
Even though there were so many
people here just a while ago.
translations.だな。これなら花火振り回しても問題ないか。:
Yeah. Guess we won't bother
anyone waving sparklers around.
translations.子供みたいなこと言って。危ないことしちゃダメよ？:
Listen to you, such a kid.
No doing dangerous things, okay？
translations.冗談だって。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、どれにする？:
Just kidding. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
which one do you want？
translations.ダメ？ 私、最後まで落とさずにするの上手いんだよ。:
Is that bad？ I'm actually
really good at keeping it lit
till the very end, you know？
translations.そうなんだ。じゃあどっちが長くもつか、競争な。:
Oh yeah？ Then let's see
who lasts the longest.
translations.負けないから。はい、１本ずつ。:
I won't lose.
Here, one for each of us.
translations.なあに？ ……ぷっ、すごい顔……。:
What is it？ ...Pfft,
look at your face...
translations.あ、落ちちゃった！ ひどーい、笑わせるなんて。今のナシ！:
Ah, it fell! Mean!
Making me laugh like that...
That one doesn't count!
translations.もう、あなたってホント子供なんだから。:
Geez, you really are
such a kid.
translations.わあ、壁や床に水面の影が映ってる。きれい……。:
Wow, the ripples on the water
are reflected on the walls and
floor. It's so pretty...
translations.光の水族館っていうから、もっとキラキラした感じだと思ってたけど。:
Since they called it an aquarium
of light, I thought it'd be
a lot more dazzling, but...
translations.そこまで派手な照明じゃないね？ 魚がまぶしがるのかな。:
The lighting isn't really that
flashy, is it？ Maybe the fish
are sensitive to bright light.
translations.でもムードがあって素敵……。もし人魚がいたら、毎日こんな風景を見てるんだろうなあ:
Still, it's so romantic...
If mermaids were real, I bet this
is what they'd see every day.
translations.……ん？ なあに、人の顔をじっと見て。:
...Hm？ What are you staring
at my face for？
translations.もし▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が人魚だったらって想像してたんだけど……。:
I was just imagining what it'd be
like if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was a mermaid...
translations.え～？ あ、わかった。エッチなこと考えたんでしょ。:
Ehh？ Ah, I know! You were
thinking something naughty,
weren't you？
translations.違うって。ほら、人魚だったら泳げないと、さ。:
No, that's not it! I mean,
a mermaid has to be able
to swim, right？
translations.……どうせ泳げませんよ。もう、想像の中でくらいスイスイ泳いだっていいじゃない。:
...Fine, I can't swim.
Geez, you could at least let me
swim gracefully in your head!
translations.そうね……。腕を組んで、頭撫でてくれて、いっぱい優しくしてくれたら許してあげる。:
Well... Link arms with me,
pat my head, and spoil me
rotten. Then I'll forgive
you.
translations.……それっていつも通りじゃないか？:
...Isn't that what I
always do, though？
translations.そう？ はい、まずは腕をどうするんだっけ？:
Is it？ Well, what are
you supposed to do with
my arm first？
translations.はいはい、組ませていただきます。:
Yes, ma'am. Allow me
to take your arm.
translations.水槽の中じゃなくて、向こう側。ほら、あのカップル……。:
Not in the tank, on the
other side. Look, that
couple over there...
translations.うわ、あんなところで……。あれはちょっとくっつきすぎだな。:
Whoa, right out in the
open... They're clinging to
each other pretty hard.
translations.ね、すごいよね。いつからいたのかな。:
Right？ It's crazy. Wonder
how long they've been
like that.
translations.全然気付かなかった。誰も見てないと思ってるのかな。:
I didn't even notice.
Do they think nobody's
watching？
translations.見せつけてるんだと思うけど。:
I think they're showing
off, actually.
translations.だってほら、こっちをちらちら見てる。私たちのこと意識してるんだよ。:
Look, they keep glancing
over here. They're totally
conscious of us.
translations.……ホントだ。なんで？ ●たち別に挑発するようなことは何も……。:
...You're right. But why？
We haven't done anything to
provoke them, ●...
translations.ふふ、見るからにお似合いだからじゃない？ こう、醸し出す雰囲気とか。:
Hehe, isn't it obvious how
well-matched we are？
Like, the vibe we give off.
translations.そんなにいい雰囲気かな？:
Do we really give off
that good of a vibe？
translations.自覚ないんだ？ 私たち、さりげなく最強カップルだよ？:
You don't even realize？
We're casually the ultimate
couple, you know？
translations.いいなそれ。じゃあ、このまま普通にしてればいいか。:
I like the sound of that.
Guess we can just keep
acting normal, then.
translations.へえ、結構人が集まってるな。:
Huh, quite a crowd has
gathered.
translations.フォーマルな格好の人が多いね。私たちもそうすれば良かったかな？:
A lot of people are dressed
up. Should we have gone
formal too？
translations.「気軽にクラシックを楽しむ」って書いてあったし、いいんじゃない？:
It said 'enjoy classical
music casually,' so I think
we're fine, right？
translations.そっか。でも、こんな自然の中でクラシックコンサートなんて、すごくゼイタクな気分。:
True. Still, a classical
concert surrounded by
nature feels so luxurious.
translations.●たちもセレブの仲間入りだな。お嬢様、お手を。:
Guess we're high society
now too, ●.
May I have your hand,
my lady？
translations.もう、終わった途端にそれ？:
Jeez, the second it's over,
you yawn？
translations.ゆったりした音楽が多かったから、つい、さ。:
A lot of the music was
relaxing, so I couldn't
help it.
translations.何度か頭がガクッてなってたもんね？:
Your head nodded off a
few times there, didn't it？
translations.バレてたか……。ごめん、気になった？:
You caught me... Sorry, did
it bother you？
translations.ううん、おかげで私が眠らずに済んだもの。実は私も少し危なかったの。:
No, thanks to you I didn't
fall asleep. Honestly, I
was close a few times too.
translations.はは、それだけいい音楽だったってことかな？:
Haha, guess that just shows
how good the music was？
translations.思わず眠りに誘われるほどね？ ふふ。:
Good enough to lull us
right to sleep, huh？ Hehe.
translations.これが海なら、波の音がすごいんだろうけど。:
If this were the ocean, the
sound of the waves would
be pretty loud, though.
translations.そうだな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は湖と海、どっちが好き？:
True. Which do you like
better, the lake or the
ocean, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.んー、どっちも。それじゃダメ？:
Hmm, I like both.
Is that no good？
translations.ダメってことないよ。そっか、どっちも好きなのか。:
Nothing wrong with that.
So you like both, huh.
translations.あ、デートのリサーチのことでしょ。大丈夫よ、今日、楽しかったもん。:
Ah, you're doing date
research, aren't you？
Don't worry, I had a great
time today.
translations.私の行きたい場所を考えてくれるのも嬉しいけど……ねえ、あなたの行きたい場所ってど:
It's sweet that you think
about where I want to go,
but... where do *you*
want to go？
translations.うーん、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒ならどこでもいいな。:
Hmm, anywhere's fine
as long as I'm with you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.え～、それじゃリサーチにならないじゃない。:
Aww, that's not helping
our research at all!
translations.お互い様だろ？:
Aren't we both guilty
of that, though？
translations.もう、私たちって実はすごく安上がりなのかも。:
Geez, maybe we're actually
super low-maintenance.
translations.展示も館内の様子もいつも通りみたいね……。:
The exhibits and the hall
look just like usual...
translations.夜のナイトミュージアムに向けて、何か仕掛けが隠れてないかと思ったの。:
I was wondering if they hid
any gimmicks for the 'Night
at the Museum' later.
translations.お化け屋敷じゃないんだからさ……。:
It's not a haunted house,
you know...
translations.そうなの？ だって、ただ暗いだけじゃつまらないよね。:
Is it not？ I mean, if it's
just dark, that'd be kind
of boring, wouldn't it？
translations.とか言って、いざとなると「こわーい」って●にしがみついてるかもよ？:
You say that, but when
it starts, you might be
clinging to ● going,
'I'm so scared!'？
translations.私に限ってそんなことはありません。:
I would never do such a
thing, thank you very much.
translations.断言しなくても……。:
You didn't have to sound
so certain...
translations.でも、クラスの子がすごく怖いって言ってたの。きっと何かあるはずよ。もしかしたらこ:
Still, a classmate said
it was super scary.
There must be something!
Maybe one of the paintings
has a trick and moves
only at night.
translations.うーん、期待しすぎるとがっかりするよ？:
Hmm, don't get your hopes
up too high or you'll be
disappointed, you know？
translations.それはそれでいいの。あなたと「つまんないね」って笑えれば、それで。:
That's fine too. As long
as I can laugh with you
and say 'that was boring,'
that's all that matters.
translations.はは、じゃあほどほどに期待して待つか。:
Haha, then let's keep
our hopes reasonable
and wait.
translations.やっぱり、ただ暗いだけみたいだね？:
Looks like it really is
just dark in here, huh？
translations.そうだけど、結構雰囲気出てて楽しいな。:
Yeah, but the atmosphere
is nice. It's fun.
translations.そうね、夜の校舎みたい。暗いこともだけど、本当はいたらいけないはずの時間にいるの:
Yeah, like school at night.
Not just the dark, but
being somewhere you aren't
supposed to be at this hour.
School at night is like
that too, right？
translations.でもちょっと物足りないかな……。例えばあそこの彫刻が動き出したりすればいいのに。:
Still, it's missing a little
something... It'd be great
if that statue over there
started moving, for example.
translations.はは、本当に動いたりして。:
Haha, imagine if it
actually did.
translations.びっくりした……。すぐ横に人が立ってると思ったら……。:
You scared me... I thought
someone was standing
right next to me...
translations.ああ、絵か。この暗さだと、確かにそう見えなくもないな。:
Ah, it's a painting.
In this light, it definitely
does look like someone.
translations.なあに？ ニヤニヤしちゃって。:
What is it？ What are you
smirking at？
translations.しがみついてるなあと思って。ほら、さっき……。:
Just thinking about how
tight you're clinging to me.
You know, like earlier...
translations.え？ ……あっ、これは怖いわけじゃなくて、驚いただけで……。:
Huh？ ...Ah, this isn't
because I'm scared, I was
just startled, and...
translations.もう、そんな得意げな顔して。イジワル。:
Geez, look at that smug
face of yours. Mean.
translations.ちゃんとエスコートしてくれたら許してあげる。元はと言えば、あなたが私をほったらか:
I'll forgive you if you
escort me properly.
It's your fault for leaving
me all on my own, you know？
translations.わかったわかった。はい、腕をどうぞ。:
Alright, alright.
Here, take my arm.
translations.見て、ふわふわ▼ かわいい～。:
Look, it's so fluffy▼
So cute~
translations.へえ、ライオンなのに大人しいな。:
Huh, even though it's a
lion, it's so calm.
translations.赤ちゃんだもの。見て、手がすっごく大きいの。それに目がまん丸でかわいい。:
It's a baby, after all.
Look, its paws are huge!
And its eyes are so round
and cute.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、さっきからかわいいばっかり言ってる。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, all you've been
saying is 'cute'.
translations.だって、かわいいんだからしょうがないじゃない。あ、あくびした。やん、もう、かわい:
Well, I can't help it,
it's just so cute!
Ah, it yawned! Oh gosh,
it's way too cute~
translations.はは。女子って子供とか赤ちゃん見ると、テンション上がる気がする。:
Haha. I feel like girls
always get super excited
around kids and babies.
translations.そうかな？ 男の子は違うの？:
You think so？
Are boys not like that？
translations.うーん、上がる奴もいるかもしれないけど……。:
Hmm, maybe some guys get
excited too, but...
translations.母性本能があるかないかの違いじゃない？ ねー、そうでちゅよねー。:
Maybe it's about whether
you have maternal instincts？
Right~？ Isn't dat right~？
translations.そうかもな。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はいいお母さんになるよ。:
Could be.
You'll make a great mom,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.……なあに？ 急にそんなこと……。:
...What？ Saying something
like that out of nowhere...
translations.思ったままを言っただけだけど。:
I was just saying what came
to mind.
translations.もう、さりげなーく人を喜ばせるのが上手いんだから。いけないパパでちゅねー。:
Geez, you're so good at
casual flattery.
What a naughty papa,
isn't he~？
translations.すごい……。こんなところに夜景スポットがあったなんて、知らなかった。:
Incredible... I had no idea
there was a spot with a night
view like this around here.
translations.夜にこっちのほうまで来ること、そうないからな。:
Yeah, we don't come out this
way at night very often.
translations.じゃあ、これからはもっといっぱい来ようね？:
Then let's come here a whole
lot more from now on, okay？
translations.そうだな、たまになら……。:
Well, once in a while,
maybe...
translations.たまに、なの？ いつでもいいんだけどな。:
Just once in a while？
I'd come anytime, though.
translations.そういうわけにもいかないよ。夜遅くなるし。:
We can't really do that.
It gets late, after all.
translations.今日はいいのに？ じゃあ、次はいつならいいの？:
Even though tonight's okay？
Then when can we come next？
translations.盛り上がってるの、私一人だけなのかなあ。:
Is it just me getting all
excited here？
translations.……ふふ、私こそごめんなさい。あなたがあんまり真面目だから、ついいじめちゃった。:
...Hehe, I'm sorry too.
You're just so serious,
I couldn't help teasing you.
translations.あなたのそういうところ、ホントは大好きだよ？ すごく大切にされてるって実感する。:
I really do love that about
you, though. It makes me feel
truly treasured.
translations.でも、またこの景色を見に来ようね？ いろんな場所に行って、忘れた頃に。:
Still, let's come see this
view again, okay？ Once we've
visited lots of places and
almost forgotten about it.
translations.ずいぶん先になりそうだな。うん、いつかまた来ような。:
Sounds like a long time from
now. Yeah, let's come back
someday.
translations.んーっ、疲れたぁ。お芋、たくさん採れたね。:
Mmnh, I'm beat! We dug up
so many sweet potatoes,
didn't we？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のとこ、たくさん埋まってたよな。:
There were a ton buried
in your spot, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.日頃の行いがいいのかな？ たまにはこういうデートも楽しいね。:
Must be my good karma!
Dates like this are so much fun
once in a while.
translations.芋掘り、はじめて？:
Was that your first time
digging potatoes？
translations.小学生の頃にやったけど、あまり覚えてないな。掘ったあとにお芋争奪戦になったのはよ:
I did in elementary school,
but I barely remember.
Though I definitely remember
fighting over the big ones
after we dug them up.
translations.はは、いろんな大きさがあるもんな。:
Haha, yeah, they come in all
shapes and sizes, after all.
translations.そうなの。二人で大きなお芋を取り合って、半分に割れちゃったり。:
Right？ We fought over a big
sweet potato and snapped it
right in half.
translations.……あ、向こうでたき火の準備ができたみたいだよ。行こ？:
...Oh, looks like the bonfire
is ready over there. Shall we？
translations.焼き芋争奪戦はしちゃダメだぞ？:
No fighting over the roasted
potatoes this time, okay？
translations.あんまり食べないね、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。好きじゃないとか？:
You're not eating much, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you not like them？
translations.ううん、美味しい。でももう充分。:
No, it's delicious.
I've just had plenty.
translations.そう？ いつももっと食べる気がするけど……。:
Really？ I feel like you
usually eat a lot more...
translations.こら、デリカシーのないこと言わないの。だってお芋って、炭水化物でしょ。:
Hey, don't say insensitive
things like that. Sweet potatoes
are carbs, after all.
translations.それに、カレシの前でたくさん食べるのはちょっと勇気がいるっていうか。:
Besides, it takes a little
courage to eat a whole lot in
front of your boyfriend.
translations.……お芋、やっぱり持って帰ればよかったかなあ。:
...Maybe I should've taken
some sweet potatoes home
after all.
translations.絶対いらないって言ってたのに？:
Even though you insisted you
definitely didn't want any？
translations.だってお芋持ったままデートなんて、ムードないじゃない。:
Holding sweet potatoes
on a date totally kills
the mood, doesn't it？
translations.そうよ。手を繋いだり、抱きしめたり、キスする時にお芋が邪魔になったら、がっかりす:
It's true! If sweet potatoes
got in the way when we
hold hands, hug, or kiss...
Wouldn't you be disappointed？
translations.あ、笑うなんてひどい。真剣に言ってるんですからね？:
Hey, it's mean to laugh!
I'm being completely serious
here, you know？
translations.はいはい。でも、芋が惜しくなっちゃった？:
Alright, alright.
Are you regretting leaving
them behind now？
translations.だって、お芋って美容にいいのよ？ ビタミンや繊維もたっぷりだし、それに美味しいし:
Well, sweet potatoes are great
for beauty! They're full of
vitamins and fiber,
and they taste delicious too.
translations.（さっきと言ってることが違う気がする……）:
(I feel like she said
the exact opposite earlier...)
translations.でも女の子が焼き芋買うのって、ちょっと恥ずかしいじゃない。:
Still, it's kind of
embarrassing for a girl
to buy roasted sweet potatoes,
isn't it？
translations.なんでも。そういうものなの。:
Just because. That's just
the way it is.
translations.へぇ……。よくわからないけど、それなら●が▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の代わりに買えばいいのかな:
Huh... I don't really get it,
but could ● buy them
for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ instead？
translations.そっか、その手があったんだ。じゃあ、いざという時はお願いしちゃおうかな。:
Oh, that's an idea!
Maybe I'll ask you to do that
when the time comes.
translations.なんだか言葉にできないね。きれいすぎて、怖いくらい。:
I can't put it into words.
It's so beautiful,
it's almost scary.
translations.このまま二人で、ススキの上を歩けたらなあ。:
I wish the two of us could
just walk on top of
the pampas grass.
translations.そう。ススキの穂がね、ふわふわして気持ち良さそうじゃない？ 雲の上を歩けたらなあ:
Yeah. The plumes look so fluffy
and inviting, don't they？
Like wishing you could walk
on top of the clouds.
translations.ああ、わかるわかる。: Ah, yeah, I get what you mean.
translations.小さい頃、やっぱりこんな風にススキ野原を見てて、同じことを思ったの。それでススキ:
When I was little, I looked
at a pampas field like this
and thought the exact same thing.
So I jumped right in.
translations.ススキの中に？ それは……。:
Right into the grass？
That couldn't have ended well...
translations.そう、ススキの葉って結構鋭いでしょ？ だから切り傷だらけになっちゃった。:
Yup. Pampas leaves are pretty
sharp, you know？
So I ended up covered in cuts.
translations.ススキ野原を見ると、そのこと思い出すの。あの時も今も、考えることはあまり変わらな:
Whenever I see a pampas field,
it reminds me of that.
Guess the way I think hasn't
changed much since then.
translations.……ダメだぞ？ 突っ込んじゃ。:
...Don't you go jumping in again,
okay？
translations.しないよ。そういうところは、ちゃんと成長してます。:
I won't! I've grown up enough
to know better than that.
translations.危ないから手繋いどこう。: Let's hold hands, just to be safe.
translations.もう、子供じゃないんだから。でも、しばらくこうしていてね？ 離さないで。:
Geez, I'm not a kid.
...Still, stay like this
for a bit, okay？ Don't let go.
translations.あ、すごい。ほら、ススキの音。:
Oh, wow. Listen...
The sound of the pampas grass.
translations.風で揺れてざわざわしてる。さっきは聞こえなかったのに。:
It's rustling in the wind.
I couldn't hear it earlier.
translations.ああ、見えない分よく聞こえるな。:
Yeah. Since we can't see,
our ears pick it up better.
translations.月も出てたら最高なのにな。ちょうど雲がかかっちゃってる。:
It'd be perfect if the moon was
out too. Too bad it's behind
the clouds right now.
translations.もう少ししたら出てくるよ。: It'll come out in a little bit.
translations.そう？ それまで待ってくれる？ いつになるかわからないよ。:
You think？
Will you wait with me？
There's no telling how long
it'll take, though.
translations.あまり遅くならなければ。:
As long as it doesn't get
too late.
translations.お父さん、時間に厳しいね？:
My, aren't you strict on time,
Dad？
translations.そう。あなたって時々すごく冷静で落ち着いてて大人びたこと言うから、年下だってこと:
Yup. Sometimes you're so calm
and mature, I forget that you're
younger than me.
translations.反対にすっごく子供っぽい時もあるけどね？ あなたがそんな風だから、私もいつも自然:
Though you can be super childish
sometimes too, you know？
Because you're like that,
I can always just be myself.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も大人っぽいし子供っぽいもんな。:
Well, you can be pretty mature
and childish too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私を子供っぽいなんて言う人、あなたくらいよ。:
You're about the only one
who'd ever call me childish.
translations.お、出て来た。これで遅くならずに帰れるな？:
Hey, there it is.
Now we can head back before
it gets too late, right？
translations.あ、ちょうど出てくるところみたい。人がいっぱい待ってる。:
Oh, looks like they're coming
out right now. There's a whole
crowd waiting.
translations.あそこの正面扉から式を終えた二人が出てきて、教会の庭をぐるっと周るんだって。:
They say the couple comes
out of those front doors and
circles the church garden.
translations.どうしたの？ なんだか複雑な顔してる。:
What is it？
You've got kind of
a conflicted look on your face.
translations.ここにいる人たち、みんなただの見物客だろ？:
Everyone here is just
a spectator, right？
translations.うん、私たちと一緒。新郎新婦が、どんな人たちかもわからないし。:
Yeah, just like us.
We don't even know anything
about the bride and groom.
translations.だよなあ。知らない人に祝われて、嬉しいのかなと思って。:
Right. It just made me wonder
if being cheered by strangers
actually makes them happy.
translations.嬉しいに決まってるじゃない。おめでたいことはみんなで分かち合うものでしょ？:
Of course it does!
Happy occasions are meant
to be shared, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もこういうのに憧れてるとか？:
Do you dream of something
like this too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.それはその時になってみないとわからないな。たくさんの人に祝われるのも素敵だけど、:
I won't know until the time comes.
Being cheered by a big crowd is lovely,
but don't you think an overseas
wedding just for two sounds nice too？
translations.その時はもちろん、あなたの意見もちゃんと聞くからね？ ……あ、来た！:
When the time comes, of course
I'll get your input too, okay？
...Oh, here they come!
translations.全然知らない人なのに、友達に言うみたいにおめでとうって言っちゃった。:
Even though they're strangers,
I shouted 'congratulations'
like they were my friends.
translations.ねえ、見た？ 花嫁さんは笑顔だったけど、花婿さんは泣いてたでしょ。:
Hey, did you see？
The bride was all smiles,
but the groom was crying.
translations.見た見た。よっぽど嬉しかったんだろうな。:
Yeah, I saw.
He must've been so happy.
translations.一生懸命笑顔を作ろうとしても、すぐにくしゃって泣いちゃうの。ふふ。:
He tried so hard to smile,
but then his face would just
crumple into tears. Hehe.
translations.だって、あなたもそうなるかもって思ったら……ふふっ。:
I couldn't help it! I thought you
might do the same thing... Hehe.
translations.想像したら、かわいくてしょうがないんだもん。もしあなたが泣いちゃったら、よしよし:
I couldn't help it, the thought
was just too cute! If you cry,
I promise I'll pat your head
and comfort you, okay？
translations.●がするよ。だから思う存分泣いていいからな？:
●'ll do that for you.
So you can cry all you want, okay？
translations.今の、どういう意味だかわかってる？ 将来あなたと私が……。:
Do you realize what that implies？
That in the future, you and I...
translations.ごめん、よく聞こえなかった。なに？:
Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.
What did you say？
translations.ううん、いいの！ ちょっと気分に酔っちゃったみたい。聞かなかったことにして！:
No, it's nothing!
I guess I just got swept up
in the mood. Forget I said anything!
translations.わあ、雰囲気あるね……。:
Wow, this place has
so much atmosphere...
translations.こういうの憧れてたんだ。山奥にある温泉に、彼と二人だけで来るの。:
I've always dreamed of this.
Coming to a hot spring deep in
the mountains, just me and my boyfriend.
translations.そっか。じゃあ正解かな。:
I see. Guess we made
the right call, then.
translations.あちこちコケが生えてる。古いお寺なのかな。:
There's moss everywhere.
I wonder if it's an old temple.
translations.あっちはどうなってるのかな。: I wonder what's over that way.
translations.あ、地面もコケが多いから、気をつけて。:
Ah, the ground has a lot of moss
too, so watch your step.
translations.ありがと。つかまっていい？:
Thanks. Mind if I hold
onto you？
translations.あんまりいちゃいちゃしたら、バチがあたったりするのかな。:
Do you think the gods
will punish us if we flirt
too much？
translations.別に悪いことしてるんじゃないし、問題ないでしょ。:
We're not doing anything
wrong, so it should be
fine, right？
translations.だといいけど、ちゃんとお参りもしておこうっと。:
I hope so! But I'll still
say a proper prayer
just in case.
translations.いちゃいちゃしてても見逃してくださいって？:
Asking them to look the
other way while we flirt？
translations.露天風呂、そろそろ行かない？:
Shall we head to the
open-air bath soon？
translations.そうだな。あまり遅くなると、帰りが困るし。:
Yeah. If it gets too late,
it'll be tough getting
home.
translations.……寒っ。早く入ろう。:
...Brr, it's cold.
Better get in quick.
translations.風呂は一人占めだし、景色はいいし、ゼイタクだな……。:
Having the bath all to
myself and this view...
What a luxury...
translations.あらあら、大丈夫？:
Oh dear, are you all
right？
translations.あ、はい、大丈夫です。すみません。:
Ah, yes, I'm okay!
I'm sorry.
translations.おーい、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲～。大丈夫か？:
Heeey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲~.
Are you all right？
translations.やだ、もう。恥ずかしいから話しかけないで！:
No, stop! I'm so
embarrassed, don't talk
to me!
translations.（心配したのに怒られた……）:
(I was just worried, but
she got mad at me...)
translations.さっきどうかした？ 大きな声が聞こえたけど……。:
Did something happen
earlier？ I heard a loud
cry...
translations.あれは……ね？ 足が滑って、ちょっと打っただけで……。:
That was... well. My foot
just slipped and I bumped
myself, that's all...
translations.えっ、転んだのか？ どこ打った？ 大丈夫？:
Wait, you fell？ Where
did you hit？ Are you
okay？
translations.大丈夫大丈夫。いいの、恥ずかしいから忘れて。お願い。:
I'm fine, really! Just
forget it, it's so
embarrassing. Please？
translations.露天風呂って気持ちいいね。:
Open-air baths feel
really good, don't they.
translations.空見ながらボーッとしてたら、一瞬寝ちゃったよ。:
I zoned out looking up
at the sky and fell asleep
for a second.
translations.気持ちよかったもんね。私もずっと空を見てたの。:
It really felt wonderful.
I was looking up at the
sky the whole time, too.
translations.じゃあ、一緒に空を見てたんだな。:
Then we were looking at
the sky together, huh.
translations.ホント。一緒にお風呂に入ってたみたいだね？:
Yeah. Almost like we were
taking a bath together,
right？
translations.お茶でもいれよっと。:
I think I'll make us
some tea.
translations.こんなに安心できるんだ……。:
I feel so safe
like this...
translations.もっとでも……いいから。:
You can do more...
it's okay.
translations.私だって、ドキドキしてるんだから……。:
My heart's pounding too,
you know...
translations.照れちゃうね、こういうの。:
This kind of thing
makes me so shy.
translations.止められない……けど、いいよね。:
I can't stop...
but that's fine, right？
translations.何もかも忘れて、ずっとこのままでいたいね。:
I want to forget everything
and stay like this forever.
translations.こんなにされたらお姉さんぶれないよ、もう。:
I can't act like the older
girlfriend if you do that.
translations.そんな嬉しそうな顔しちゃって……。:
Look at that happy face
you're making...
translations.ごめん、もっと……抱きしめて。:
Sorry... hold me
a little tighter.
translations.あなたのせいだから……責任取ってよ？:
It's all your fault...
so take responsibility, okay？
translations.私が好きなとこ、全部ばれちゃってる？:
Did you figure out all
the spots I like？
translations.こんなに好きにさせちゃって、どうなっても知らないよ？:
Making me fall this hard...
don't blame me for
whatever happens next？
translations.好きすぎて……悔しいなぁ。:
I'm so in love with you...
it's almost unfair.
translations.たまには私が甘えたっていいでしょ？:
I'm allowed to be spoiled
sometimes too, right？
translations.なんだか全身、熱くなってきちゃった。:
I'm starting to feel warm
all over...
translations.ずるい。絶対私のほうが好きになっちゃってる。:
No fair. I'm definitely
falling harder here.
translations.ふふ……こうするの、気持ちいいね？:
Hehe... feels nice
doing this, doesn't it？
translations.こんな顔、他の人には見せないよ。:
I'd never show this face
to anyone else.
translations.もう言葉にしなくていいから……。:
You don't need to put it
into words anymore...
translations.うん……たぶん、そんな感じ。:
Yeah... I think
that's about right.
translations.やっぱり、照れちゃうね。:
It really is
a little embarrassing.
translations.いいよ、怒らないから。:
Go ahead,
I won't get mad.
translations.もどかしい感じも……いいかも。:
Being kept waiting like this...
is kind of nice, too.
translations.もっと大胆になってもいいんじゃない。:
You could be a little bolder,
you know.
translations.嬉しそうな顔しちゃって、もう。:
Look at that big grin...
Geez, you.
translations.今の、わざと？: Did you do that on purpose？
translations.そんなに叱られたい？:
Do you want me to scold you
that badly？
translations.はい……少しだけね？:
Here... just a little bit,
okay？
translations.しょうがないから、特別だよ？:
Can't be helped...
Special treatment for you, okay？
translations.ここならいいけど……。: I guess here is fine, but...
translations.いきなり、そういうのは……。:
Doing that all of a sudden
is a bit...
translations.なんでも許すわけじゃないよ？:
I won't let you get away
with everything, you know？
translations.怒るよ？: I'm gonna get mad, you know？
translations.お姉さんを子ども扱いなんだ？:
Treating an older girl
like a kid, are we？
translations.懐かしいな……子供になった気分。:
Brings back memories...
I feel like a kid again.
translations.安心するなぁ、こういうの。:
This kind of thing is
so comforting.
translations.髪さわるの、気持ちいい？:
Does touching my hair
feel nice？
translations.ヨシヨシ返し、されちゃった。: Look at you petting me back.
translations.うれしいけど、恥ずかしいな。:
I'm happy, but it's
pretty embarrassing.
translations.そんなに優しく撫でられたら……。: If you stroke me that gently...
translations.ん……安心して眠っちゃいそう。:
Mmm... it's so calming, 
I might fall asleep.
translations.あなたの手、ひんやりして気持ちいいよ。:
Your hands are cool... 
It feels really nice.
translations.なんだか、たまらないかも……。:
It's almost too much 
to take...
translations.ん……ちょっとマニアックじゃない？:
Mmm... aren't your tastes 
a bit niche？
translations.私の耳たぶ、柔らかいでしょ。:
My earlobes are soft, 
aren't they？
translations.一人で楽しんじゃって。:
Having fun all by yourself, 
aren't you？
translations.ゆっくり触られたら……なんだか……。:
When you touch me 
so slowly... it's kind of...
translations.ん……ずるいよ、こんな……。:
Mmm... that's not fair, 
doing that...
translations.弱点なのわかってやってるでしょ？ もう！:
You know that's my weak 
spot, don't you？ Jeez!
translations.力、抜けちゃう……。:
All my strength is draining 
away...
translations.ねえ……今の、なに？:
Hey... what was that 
just now？
translations.ふーん、こんなことするんだ。:
Hmm, so you do things 
like that, huh.
translations.気が早すぎるでしょ？:
Aren't you getting 
a bit ahead of yourself？
translations.どうしてそんなに触りたいの？:
Why do you want to touch 
me so much？
translations.困っちゃうなぁ……。:
What am I gonna do 
with you...
translations.今のは特別サービスね。:
That was a special treat, 
just for you.
translations.こんなカノジョでうれしい？:
Are you happy to have 
a girlfriend like me？
translations.私の、好きなんだ……。:
You really like mine, 
don't you...
translations.こういうの、憧れてたんだ。:
I've always dreamed 
of doing this.
translations.ちょっと動きにくいけど、いいよね♪:
It's a bit hard to walk, 
but who cares♪
translations.どこからどう見てもカップルって感じ。:
Anyone looking at us 
would know we're a couple.
translations.周りの人に見せつけちゃおっか。:
Should we show off 
for everyone around us？
translations.あなたの腕、あったかいね。ふふ▼:
Your arm is so warm. 
Hehe▼
translations.あなたのドキドキ、聞こえてるよ？:
I can hear your heart 
pounding, you know？
translations.こんなにくっついちゃいました。:
Look at us,
snuggling up so close.
translations.お互いの気持ち、合わせないとね。:
We have to keep
our feelings in sync, right？
translations.んー、付き合ってるって感じ♪:
Mm, this really feels
like we're dating♪
translations.やっぱり……照れるね。:
It really is...
a little embarrassing.
translations.男の人の手だね……。:
You really have
a man's hands...
translations.つないでくれるの、待ってたんだよ？:
I was waiting for you
to hold my hand, you know？
translations.ね、これだけで楽しくなるね？:
See？ Just doing this
makes it so fun, doesn't it？
translations.せっかくだから恋人つなぎ。ね？:
Let's interlace our fingers
like real lovers. Okay？
translations.こんなに簡単に幸せになれるんだね。:
It's so easy to be
this happy, isn't it？
translations.飽きないなぁ、あなたの感触。:
I never get tired
of your touch.
translations.よそ見するなって？:
You're telling me
not to look away？
translations.どうしてかな、泣きそうなの。:
I don't know why,
but I feel like crying.
translations.触りたかった？: Did you want to touch me？
translations.そこから、どうするの？:
What are you going to do
from there？
translations.そこは別に……。:
That spot doesn't really
do anything...
translations.イタズラ？ やり返すよ？:
Teasing me？
I'll get you back, you know？
translations.うなじ、好きなんだ？:
You like the nape
of my neck, huh？
translations.慣れてないから、なんだか……。:
I'm not used to this, 
so it feels kinda...
translations.ここ触るの、楽しいんだ？:
Is it really that fun 
touching here？
translations.男の子って、うなじ好きなの？:
Are boys really that into 
the nape of a neck？
translations.うなじだけで満足なのかな？:
Are you really satisfied 
with just my neck？
translations.私の首筋、キレイ？: Does my neck look pretty to you？
translations.変なツボ押してない？:
Aren't you hitting some 
weird pressure point？
translations.もう、わかっててやってるな？:
Jeez, you're doing that 
on purpose, aren't you？
translations.怒られないとわからない？:
Do I need to scold you 
before you learn？
translations.なんだか、少し違う感じ。:
That feels a little 
different somehow.
translations.これって……ううん。: Could this be...? No, never mind.
translations.ふふ、マニアックだなあ。:
Hehe, you've got pretty 
niche tastes, don't you？
translations.いけないことされてる気分。:
It feels like you're doing 
something naughty to me.
translations.得意げな顔しちゃって。:
Look at that smug face 
of yours.
translations.ゆっくり撫でられると、私……。:
When you stroke me 
so slowly like that, I...
translations.我慢できないよ、こんなの。:
I can't take much more 
of this...
translations.変な声出そう……。:
I feel like a weird sound's 
gonna slip out...
translations.我慢できなかったんだ？:
Couldn't hold yourself back, 
could you？
translations.ほんと、ちょっとだけだよ。: Really, just for a little bit.
translations.あんまり自信ないんだけどな……。:
I'm not really all that 
confident about it, though...
translations.いきなりそれ？: Right off the bat with that？
translations.がっつきすぎじゃない？:
Aren't you being a bit 
too eager？
translations.お手て、つねっちゃおうか？:
Should I pinch
those hands of yours？
translations.エッチな顔してるよ、ふふ。:
You have such a naughty
look on your face, hehe.
translations.ふふ、すべすべでしょ？:
Hehe, nice and smooth,
isn't it？
translations.こんなに許しちゃっていいのかな……。:
I wonder if I should really
let you do this much...
translations.あとであなたのも触っちゃおうっと。:
I'm gonna touch yours
later, just you wait.
translations.しゃべってるでしょ？:
I'm talking right now,
you know？
translations.話に戻るけど……。:
Getting back to what
I was saying...
translations.……で、さっきの続きだけど。:
...Anyway, back to what
I was saying.
translations.話、忘れそうになったでしょ。:
See, I almost forgot
what I was talking about.
translations.次のテストに備えて、勉強会でもしない？:
How about a study session
to prep for the next test？
translations.あぁ……前のテストは散々だったから……。:
Man... My last test was
such a disaster, so...
translations.あなたに今必要なのは……デートじゃなくて勉強会じゃない？:
What you need right now...
isn't a date, it's a study
session, wouldn't you say？
translations.この間のテスト、あまり良くなかったんだって？ じゃあ勉強会しなくちゃ。:
I heard your last test
didn't go so well.
Guess we need a study session.
translations.うん。じゃあ、また放課後ね。: Okay. See you after school, then.
translations.そうそう。たまにはきちんと勉強しないとね。:
That's the spirit. You've gotta
study properly once in a while.
translations.じゃあ、わたしは家で待ってるから。早く来てね。:
All right, I'll wait for you
at my place. Come over soon, okay？
translations.そう。あなたがいいなら、いいんだけど……。:
I see. Well, if you're okay
with that, that's fine, but...
translations.ふーん……どうなっても知らないから。:
Hmph... Don't blame me
for whatever happens, then.
translations.そっか。じゃあ、また今度ね。: I see. Well, maybe next time.
translations.どうぞ。遠慮しないで。:
Come on in.
Make yourself at home.
translations.引き出しとか、開けないでね？: No peeking in my drawers, okay？
translations.片付けておいたつもりだけど……。: I tried to tidy up a bit, but...
translations.●の部屋とは大違いだな。:
It's night and day
compared to ●'s room.
translations.今日は勉強会だからね？:
We're here to study today,
remember？
translations.さあ、張り切っていこうね？:
Come on, let's give it
all we've got, okay？
translations.ねえ、どれから始めたい？:
So, what do you want
to start with？
translations.どこから進める？ 苦手な教科から始めるのもいいかもね。:
Where should we start？
Might be good to tackle
your worst subject first.
translations.いい加減にしなさい。じゃあ、総合から行くよ？:
Cut it out, mister.
We'll start with General Studies, okay？
translations.どうしても？ どうしてもだったら……。:
You really want to？
Well, if you insist...
translations.そんなに言うなら、しょうがないか。:
If you insist that much,
I guess I've got no choice.
translations.もう、甘えん坊さん。しょうがないなぁ。:
Geez, what a spoiled baby.
Guess I can't say no to you.
translations.了解。それにしましょ。: Got it. Let's go with that.
translations.わかった。がんばってね？: All right. Do your best, okay？
translations.よくがんばったね。ご褒美に休憩にしようか？:
You worked hard.
How about a break as a reward？
translations.いいね。ちょうど喉が渇いてたんだ。:
Sounds good.
I was just getting thirsty.
translations.じゃあ準備してくるね。待ってて。:
I'll go get something ready.
Wait right here.
translations.えらいえらい。この調子ならなんとかなりそうだし、今のうちに休憩する？:
Good boy. At this rate you'll be fine,
so wanna take a break while we can？
translations.じゃあ、ちょっと待ってて。: Hold on just a second, then.
translations.すごーい！ ご褒美に休憩しよっか。:
Amazing!
How about a break as a reward？
translations.そうだね。じゃあちょっと。: Yeah. Just a quick one, then.
translations.がんばったもんね。: You really worked hard, after all.
translations.全問正解、おめでとう。ご褒美あげなくちゃね。:
A perfect score, congrats!
I've got to give you a reward now.
translations.すごいじゃない。そのがんばりを評価するということで……ご褒美かな？:
Look at you! In recognition of
all that hard work... a reward, maybe？
translations.よくできました▼ ふふ、ご褒美あげちゃう。:
Well done!▼
Hehe, I'll give you a treat.
translations.少し疲れてるんじゃない？ なにか飲んでリラックスしようか。:
Aren't you getting tired？
Let's have a drink and relax.
translations.すぐに入れて来るから、休んでてね。:
I'll go make some right away,
so just rest up, okay？
translations.行き詰まっちゃったかな？ 休憩入れて切り替えましょ。:
Did you hit a wall？
Let's take a break to clear your head.
translations.息抜きも必要だからね。待ってて。:
Breaks are important too, you know.
Wait right here.
translations.うーん……いったん仕切り直したほうがいいかもね。:
Hmm... it might be best to step back
and start fresh.
translations.なにか持ってくるから、ひと休みしようね？:
I'll go get something,
so let's take a little breather, okay？
translations.あなたにプレゼントしてもらった服……特別に見せてあげるね。:
The outfit you got me...
I'll give you a special look, okay？
translations.ふふ、あなたに買ってもらった服、着てみたの。どう、元気が出る？:
Hehe, I put on the clothes you bought.
How's that？ Feeling energized？
translations.じゃーん。どう？ あなたのプレゼント、似合ってるかな？:
Ta-da! How is it？
Does your present look good on me？
translations.これがご褒美。私のこんな格好、あなたにしか見せないから……。:
Here's your reward. You're the only one
who gets to see me like this...
translations.はい、ご褒美。ほら、あなたってこういうの好きでしょ？:
Here's your reward. Come on,
you like this kind of thing, don't you？
translations.あなたがとってもがんばったから……特別にね、ふふ。:
Since you worked so hard...
this is a special treat, hehe.
translations.あんまり着ない服だし……写真に残しておくのもいいかもね。:
It's not something I wear often...
maybe a photo would be nice.
translations.せっかく着たんだし、少し撮っておいてもらおうかな。:
Since I have it on,
maybe you should take a few pictures.
translations.この格好、撮りたいんでしょ？ ……いいよ。:
You want pictures of this, don't you？
...Go ahead.
translations.お待たせしました。はい、これどうぞ。:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Here, this is for you.
translations.へえ……これ、手作り？: Whoa... did you make this yourself？
translations.うん。これ食べて、このあともがんばろうね。:
Yep. Eat up, and let's keep at it
afterwards, okay？
translations.じゃあ、いただきます。: Thanks, don't mind if I do!
translations.手作り！ 食べていいの？:
It's homemade!
Can I eat it？
translations.もちろん。あなたのために作ったんだから、綺麗に食べてね？:
Of course.
I made it just for you,
so finish every bite, okay？
translations.大事に食べるよ。いただきまーす。:
I'll savor every bite.
Time to dig in!
translations.お待たせ。どうぞ、これを召し上がれ。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Here you go, eat up!
translations.ふふ、うれしそうな顔。いいよ、全部食べて。:
Hehe, look at that smile.
Go on, eat it all up.
translations.やったね。じゃあ、さっそくひと口……。:
Sweet! Well, don't mind
if I take a bite...
translations.じゃあ……続き、始めよっか。:
So... ready to pick up
where we left off？
translations.そろそろ勉強、再開する？:
Ready to get back
to studying？
translations.さて、と。そろそろ休憩は終わりかな？:
Alright then.
Break time's about over,
don't you think？
translations.そうだな。勉強再開だ。:
Yeah. Time to get back
to studying.
translations.もうひと息、がんばろうね。:
Just one last push.
We've got this!
translations.今日はここまでにしとこう。:
Let's call it a day
for now.
translations.そう？ まあ、いい区切りかもね……。:
Really？ Well, it is
a good stopping point...
translations.私の気持ち、知ってほしいな。:
I want you to know
how I feel.
translations.お姉さんに任せなさい。: Leave it to an older girl.
translations.我慢……しなくてもいい？:
I don't have to
hold back... do I？
translations.こんなに好きなのに……遠くない？:
I love you so much...
don't you feel too far away？
translations.顔、赤いよ？ 私は……もっと赤いかな。:
Your face is red, you know？
Though I think mine is...
even redder.
translations.緊張しないで。そばに行きたいだけだから……。:
Don't be nervous.
I just want to be
close to you...
translations.もっともっと、あなたを感じたいから。:
Because I want to feel you
even more.
translations.ちょっと、恥ずかしいね。:
It's a little embarrassing,
isn't it？
translations.こういうことは、お姉さんから……ね？:
Things like this should come
from the older girl... right？
translations.あなたがそうしたいなら……いいよ。:
If that's what you want...
it's okay.
translations.私が教えてあげようか？: Want me to show you how？
translations.実は……結構うれしいかも。:
Actually... I might be
pretty happy about this.
translations.上手にできるかな？: Think you can do it right？
translations.えっ……ううん、ちょっと驚いただけ。:
Huh？ ...No, I was just
a little surprised.
translations.そんなにしたくなっちゃった？: Did you want to that badly？
translations.どうしよっかなぁ……冗談。:
Hmm, what should I do...？
Just kidding.
translations.私も、そうしたかったんだ。: I wanted to do that too.
translations.ダメ、もう少し待って。: No, wait just a bit longer.
translations.あなたのしたいようにして……いいよ。:
Do whatever you'd like...
it's okay.
translations.この先は私から……ね？:
From here on,
it's my turn... okay？
translations.ぎゅってしてほしいな。: I want you to hold me tight.
translations.意外と強引なとこあるよね。:
You can be pretty pushy,
you know.
translations.ふふ……実は待ってたの。:
Hehe... To be honest,
I was waiting for that.
translations.ほんとは、私のほうからこうしたかったんだよ。:
Honestly, I wanted to be
the one doing this to you.
translations.えっと、明日って何曜日だっけ？:
Um, what day of the week
is tomorrow again？
translations.あ、肩に何かついてるよ。:
Oh, there's something
on your shoulder.
translations.近すぎず、遠すぎず……ね？:
Not too close,
not too far... right？
translations.私にしか……しちゃダメだよ。:
You can only do this...
with me, okay？
translations.あなただけだよ……。:
You're the only one...
for me.
translations.こんな風になっちゃうの……？:
How can you make me
feel like this...？
translations.力が、抜けちゃう……。:
All my strength is just
draining away...
translations.幸せすぎて……怖い。: I'm so happy... it scares me.
translations.こんな風にされちゃうなんて、私……。:
To be touched like this...
I just...
translations.私の中が、あなたでいっぱいになっちゃう……。:
Every part of me is filling
up with you...
translations.あなたも……私と同じくらい、幸せ？:
Are you... just as happy
as I am？
translations.このまま、ひとつになりたい……。:
I want us to become one
just like this...
translations.絶対……離さないでね。:
Promise you'll never...
let me go, okay？
translations.あなたのこと、誰にも渡したくない……。:
I don't want to share you 
 with anyone else...
translations.こら……こんなにして……責任、取ってね？:
Hey... Doing this to me... 
 Take responsibility, okay？
translations.こんな風に……なっちゃうんだね。:
So this is what happens 
 to me...
translations.自分が自分じゃなくなりそう……。:
I feel like I'm 
 losing myself...
translations.今の、すごく……好き。:
What you just did... 
 I really loved that.
translations.あなたの好きなように……もっと。:
Whatever you want... 
 Give me more.
translations.こんなにしちゃって……悪い子。:
Getting me like this... 
 Bad boy.
translations.もっとが……止まらないの。:
I just can't stop 
 wanting more...
translations.今以上って……あるのかな？:
Can it really get... 
 any better than this？
translations.私には、甘えてもいいよ。:
You can always act spoiled 
 with me, you know.
translations.とろけても……知らないからね。:
If I melt away... 
 it's your fault, you know.
translations.あなたから言って。大好きだよ、って。:
Say it yourself. 
 Tell me you love me.
translations.ちょっと……今は見ないで。:
Wait... 
 Don't look at me right now.
translations.私、変になってない？:
Do I look weird 
 right now？
translations.もっとしても……いいんだよ。:
You can do more, 
 you know...
translations.上手……だね？:
You're good at this... 
 aren't you？
translations.そういうの、嫌いじゃないよ。:
I don't dislike that, 
 you know.
translations.頭がふんわりしてきて……。:
My head's getting all light 
 and fuzzy...
translations.あなたが好きなら、しょうがないけど……。:
Well, if you like it, 
 I guess I can't complain...
translations.なんだかくすぐったくなってきちゃった。:
That's starting to tickle 
 a little bit.
translations.どうして……そんなに上手……なの？:
Why are you... 
 so good at this？
translations.ウソ、こんな……私……。:
No way, not like this... 
 Me...？
translations.ふぅ……声、出ちゃう……。:
Whew... A sound's gonna 
 slip out...
translations.それって……ちょっとひどいよ。:
That's... a little mean, 
 you know.
translations.嫌なら……いいけど。:
If you don't want to... 
 that's fine, but.
translations.キスしちゃっても、いいんだよ？ はい。:
You can kiss me, 
 you know？ Go ahead.
translations.上手に……できるかな？:
I wonder if I can 
 do it right...？
translations.私から……しちゃうよ？:
I'm gonna kiss you
first, then...？
translations.目、閉じなくちゃ。:
You have to close
your eyes, you know.
translations.したいなら……いいけど。:
If you want to...
I don't mind.
translations.ほら、落ち着いて。:
Come on, take a breath
and calm down.
translations.こ～ら、もう少し優しく、ね？:
Hey now... A little
gentler, okay？
translations.しょうがない子ね……。:
What am I going to do
with you...？
translations.強引なのも、嫌いじゃないよ。:
I don't mind you
being forceful, though.
translations.あ、私からしようと思ってたのに。:
Hey, I was planning
to kiss you first!
translations.私も今、同じ気持ちだったの。:
I was feeling the
exact same way just now.
translations.言わなくても、気持ち……伝わってるね。:
Even without words,
I can feel how you feel.
translations.わかるけど……ちょっと無理。:
I know how you feel,
but... not right now.
translations.自分のことばっかりは、ダメだよ。:
You can't just think
about yourself, you know.
translations.こら、それはないんじゃない？:
Hey now, that's not
very nice, is it？
translations.ダメ。ちゃんとそういう雰囲気にならないと。:
Nope. You have to set
the right mood first.
translations.もう……私も緊張してきちゃった。:
Jeez... Now you've got
me nervous, too.
translations.もしかして、わからないのかな？:
Could it be that you
don't know where...？
translations.このままでいて……いい？:
Can we stay like this...
a little longer？
translations.ん……もう、うますぎるよ。:
Mmm... Jeez, you're
way too good at this.
translations.今度は私が、気持ちよくしてあげたいな。:
Next time, I want to
make you feel good, too.
translations.お姉さん、とろけちゃった……。:
You completely melted
your older girlfriend...
translations.キスって……素敵だね。:
Kissing... really is
wonderful, isn't it？
translations.あなたも……ドキドキしてるよね？:
Your heart's racing too,
isn't it？
translations.こういう感じも、アリ……かな。:
Something like this...
isn't so bad, I guess.
translations.ふふ、そうきちゃうんだ。:
Hehe, so that's how
you're gonna play it.
translations.そんなのも……あるんだ？:
Oh... You can do that
too？
translations.恥ずかしいけど、いい感じだよ。:
It's a little embarrassing,
but it feels nice.
translations.わざとやってる？:
Are you doing that
on purpose？
translations.残念、ハズレ……ふふ。:
Too bad, that's a miss...
Hehe.
translations.いろいろ、考え過ぎかも？:
Maybe you're thinking
a bit too hard？
translations.好きなんだから……いいよね？:
I love you, so...
it's fine, right？
translations.私のこと……感じてほしいの。:
I want you to...
feel me.
translations.キス、しちゃおっかな……いいでしょ？:
Maybe I'll kiss you...
You don't mind, right？
translations.このまま、もう一度……。:
Just like this,
one more time...
translations.幸せって……こういうことなのね。:
So this is what
happiness feels like...
translations.百点満点のキスだったね。:
That was a perfect
hundred-point kiss.
translations.あなたを感じちゃった。: I felt so close to you.
translations.幸せすぎると怖いって……ほんとなんだね。:
They say being too happy
is scary... It's really true.
translations.もっともっと、好きになっちゃいそう……。:
I feel like I'm falling
even more in love with you...
translations.もうこれ以上は……ないと思う▼:
I don't think it gets
any better than this...▼
translations.気持ちはわかるけど……ね？:
I know how you feel,
but... okay？
translations.たまには私も焦らしたいし……ね？:
I want to tease you
a little, too... okay？
translations.え？ 今……ウソ？:
Huh？ Did you just...？
No way!
translations.ずるいよ、今のはナシ！:
That's not fair!
That doesn't count!
translations.ふふっ、させてあげたんだよ？:
Hehe, I let you do that,
you know？
translations.もう、うまいんだから。:
Jeez, you're way too good
at this.
translations.もう少し、幸せな気持ちでいさせて。:
Let me stay in this happy
moment a little longer.
translations.これで終わりなわけ……ないよね？:
You're not done yet...
are you？
translations.もう一回してくれないと、お仕置きだよ。:
Kiss me again, or you're
getting punished.
translations.幸せな時間をもっと……お願い。:
Just a little more bliss...
Please.
translations.あなたの好きにしていいから、もっと……。:
Do whatever you like,
just give me more...
translations.ここでやめちゃうなんて……絶対ダメ▼:
Stopping here is...
completely out of
the question▼
translations.こんなにしちゃうなんて……思ってなかった。:
I never thought we'd kiss
this many times...
translations.私、もう……。倒れちゃいたい……。:
I feel like...
I might just swoon...
translations.好き……ずっと、好き。:
I love you...
Always and forever.
translations.誰よりも愛してるから。:
I love you
more than anyone.
translations.私の中に……ずっとあなたがいるの。:
Deep inside me...
you're always there.
translations.離れられなくなっちゃった。: Now I can't let you go.
translations.唇に、全部の神経集まっちゃってる……。:
Every single nerve is
tingling in my lips...
translations.幸せすぎて倒れそう……ちゃんと受け止めてね？:
I'm so happy
I might collapse...
Catch me, okay？
translations.これ以上があったら、私壊れちゃうかも……。:
Any more than this and
I might just break...
translations.あなたのことが好きって、改めてわかっちゃった。:
It just makes me realize
all over again
how much I love you.
translations.これからもっとたくさん……するんだよね？:
We're gonna do this
a lot more from now on...
right？
translations.好きな人とのキスって……まっ白になるね。:
Kissing someone you love...
makes your mind go blank,
doesn't it.
translations.永遠の愛を誓いますか？ ……なんてね。:
Do you swear eternal love？
...Just kidding.
translations.恋人同士……って感じだね。:
We really feel like lovers,
don't we.
translations.もっとすごいキスも、あるのかな？:
I wonder if there are kisses
even more amazing than that？
translations.何度でもしたくなっちゃうね。:
It makes me want to kiss you
again and again.
translations.私の中が……あなたであふれちゃう。:
My heart is just...
overflowing with you.
translations.もう……これで、ごまかされてあげる♪:
Geez... I guess I'll let you
off the hook with that♪
translations.キスって……色んなモヤモヤも溶かしちゃうね。:
A kiss really melts away
whatever's bothering you,
doesn't it？
translations.あせらなくてもいいのに。:
You don't have to rush,
you know.
translations.私、こういうのも、好きなのかも……。:
Maybe I kind of like
this sort of thing, too...
translations.しょうがないな……いいよ、許しちゃう。:
What am I gonna do
with you... All right,
I'll forgive you.
translations.ふふ……なんだか、かわいかったよ。:
Hehe... You were
kind of cute, though.
translations.はあ……ドキドキしちゃった……。:
Haah... My heart was
beating so fast...
translations.ほんと、ばかなんだから……。:
You really are a dummy,
you know...
translations.そうだよね……男の子だもんね。:
I guess so... You are
a boy, after all.
translations.うん、嫌じゃなかったけど……。:
Yeah, I didn't hate it,
but still...
translations.こんなのばっかりじゃ、ダメだよ。:
You can't be like this
all the time, okay？
translations.今、食べさせてあげるからね。:
Hold on,
let me feed you now.
translations.もう、甘えたさんなんだから♪:
Jeez, you really love
being spoiled, don't you♪
translations.一番おいしいの選んであげるからね。:
I'll pick out the tastiest
bite for you, okay？
translations.どれが食べたいのかなぁ？:
I wonder which one
you want to eat？
translations.目を見れば、食べたいものがわかるんだから▼:
I can tell what you want
just from your eyes▼
translations.焦らないで待ってね。:
Don't be impatient,
just hold on.
translations.私に食べさせてほしいんだ？: So you want me to feed you？
translations.あなたが食べさせてくれるの？ うれしい▼:
You're gonna feed me？
I'm so happy▼
translations.私が食べたいものわかる？: Can you guess what I want？
translations.ちょっと、照れちゃうね。:
I'm actually getting
a little embarrassed.
translations.ちゃんと口まで持ってきてよ？:
Bring it all the way
to my mouth, okay？
translations.ふふっ、嬉しくなっちゃう。:
Hehe, this makes me
really happy.
translations.好き嫌いしちゃダメよ？:
No being a picky eater,
okay？
translations.ほら、もっと顔近付けて▼:
Come on,
lean in a bit closer▼
translations.食べさせるほうも緊張しちゃう。:
Being the one feeding you
makes me nervous too.
translations.ほっぺた落ちちゃうんじゃない？:
So good your cheeks could
melt right off, huh？
translations.こうして食べるとおいしさが増すでしょ？:
Doesn't it taste way better
eating like this？
translations.よく食べられました♪:
Good boy, you ate it
so nicely♪
translations.おいしいって言って？ ふふ。:
Won't you tell me
it's delicious？ Hehe.
translations.こら、ちゃんと食べないとダメでしょ。:
Hey, you have to eat
properly, you know.
translations.しょうがないなぁ……。:
What am I going to do
with you...
translations.お行儀悪い子ね。:
Look at your bad manners,
you silly boy.
translations.今度は上手に食べてよ？:
Try to eat nicely
this time, okay？
translations.ほら、口についてるから。:
Look, you've got some
on your mouth.
translations.あ……口元汚れちゃってるよ？:
Ah... you got your mouth
all messy, you know？
translations.ほらぁ、口。気づいてる？:
Look, on your mouth.
Did you notice？
translations.そこ……ついてるよ？:
Right there... you've got
something on you？
translations.取れたよ？ 子どもみたいね♪:
Got it! You're just like
a little kid♪
translations.どうして自分で取っちゃうかなぁ……。:
Why'd you have to go
and wipe it yourself...
translations.そんなに照れなくてもいいのよ？:
You don't have to be
so embarrassed, you know？
translations.一番おいしいとこ選んでくれる？:
Will you pick the tastiest
bite for me？
translations.ねぇねぇ、早く食べたいなぁ▼:
Hey, hey, I can't wait
to eat▼
translations.どれを選んでくれるのかなぁ？:
I wonder which one
you'll pick for me？
translations.私の好みはわかるよね？:
You know what I like,
right？
translations.ねぇ、私にも食べさせてくれる？: Hey, will you feed me too？
translations.食べさせてくれるカレシが好きなんだけどな▼:
I really love a boyfriend
who'll feed me, though▼
translations.ねえ、お願いしていい？: Hey, can I ask a favor？
translations.あのね……それ食べさせてほしいなぁ。:
You know... I kind of want
you to feed me that.
translations.あなたに食べさせてもらいたんだけどな？:
I was hoping you'd feed
me, though？
translations.あなたがいいと思うものを選んで♪:
Pick whichever one you
think is best♪
translations.私はねぇ……ふふっ、あなたにお任せ♪:
As for me... hehe, I'll
leave it up to you♪
translations.緊張が伝わってきちゃう。:
I can feel how nervous
you are.
translations.なにしてるのかな？:
What are you up to,
silly？
translations.もう……スネちゃうよ？:
Come on...
I'm gonna pout, you know？
translations.あなたの愛情がプラスされてる？:
Did you add an extra
dash of love in here？
translations.こんなにおいしいんだ？:
Who knew it could taste
this good？
translations.贅沢な食べかただよね▼:
What a luxurious way
to eat▼
translations.しっかり味わわなきゃね。:
Gotta make sure
to savor every bite.
translations.今日はこんなものかな？:
I guess that's enough
for today？
translations.次はもっと甘えさせてね♪:
Next time you have to
pamper me even more♪
translations.こういうの大好き♪:
I love doing stuff
like this♪
translations.お腹だけじゃなくて、心まで満たされちゃった▼:
My heart's as full
as my stomach now▼
translations.まだ続けたいって顔してる、ふふ♪:
Your face says you still
want to keep going, hehe♪
translations.クセになりそう▼:
I could really get used
to this▼
translations.恋人同士なんだなぁって改めて実感するね▼:
Really makes it sink in
that we're a couple▼
translations.あなたって甘え上手でカワイイ♪:
You're so cute when you
let yourself be spoiled♪
translations.私はこういうの好きよ？:
I really like this kind
of thing, you know？
translations.また、食べさせあいっこしようね♪:
Let's feed each other
again sometime♪
translations.ねえねえ、これ食べてみない？:
Hey, wanna try
some of this？
translations.ねえねえ……これ食べてみない？:
Hey... wanna try
some of this？
translations.ああ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も食べる？ ほら。:
Oh, do you want some
too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Here.
translations.モデルさんみたいにはできないけどね？:
Don't expect me to pose
like a real model, okay？
translations.よろしくお願いします、カメラマンさん。ふふっ。:
I'm in your hands,
Mr. Photographer. Hehe.
translations.ふふ、緊張しちゃうな。:
Hehe, I'm getting
a little nervous.
translations.えっと、私もがんばるから。:
Um, I'll do my best too,
okay？
translations.変な写真、撮ったらヤだからね？:
No taking weird photos,
got it？
translations.今日はどんな写真になるかな？ 楽しみにしてるから。:
I wonder how they'll turn out.
I'm looking forward to it!
translations.そろそろ終わりにしたほうがいいよね。:
We should probably wrap
things up soon, don't you think？
translations.ねえ、もう十分撮ったんじゃない？:
Hey, haven't you taken
enough already？
translations.そっか、いつの間にかけっこう時間たってたんだな。:
Oh, wow. Quite a bit of time
slipped by, huh.
translations.今回はここまでにしておこうよ。続きは、また今度ね。:
Let's call it for now.
We can do more next time, okay？
translations.ああ、これだけ撮ったら、十分だな。: Yeah, I got plenty of shots.
translations.ふふ、ずいぶん撮っちゃったね？:
Hehe, you took quite a lot,
didn't you？
translations.残念。またこんな風に撮ってね。:
Aww. Make sure you take
more like this again, okay？
translations.ああ。今日は夢中で撮っちゃったなぁ。:
Yeah. I totally lost myself
in shooting today.
translations.そろそろ終わりにしない？ あなたも疲れてきてるんじゃないかな。:
Why don't we stop soon？
You must be getting tired, too.
translations.……そうかも。じゃ、終わりにするか。:
...Maybe so.
Let's wrap it up, then.
translations.ストップ。そろそろいいでしょ？:
Time out! That's enough
for now, right？
translations.あぁ……ごめん、つい我を忘れて撮ってたな。:
Ah... Sorry, I completely
lost track of myself.
translations.ねえ、もう終わりにしようよ。: Hey, let's wrap it up already.
translations.お、そっか。少し撮りすぎちゃったかもな。:
Oh, right. Maybe I took
a few too many.
translations.ああ。まあ、今回はこのへんで。:
Yeah. Guess we'll leave it
at that for today.
translations.がんばってたね。上手くいった？:
You were working hard!
Did they turn out well？
translations.大丈夫。いっぱい撮ったからさ。:
Don't worry.
I got plenty of good ones.
translations.あのね、もういいんじゃないかな……？:
Um, haven't you taken
enough already...？
translations.あ、ごめん。ずっと撮りっぱなしだったもんな。:
Ah, sorry. I was snapping
away nonstop, wasn't I.
translations.ねえ、私が疲れてるって気づいてる？:
Hey, did you notice
I'm getting tired？
translations.ごめん、ちょっと疲れてきちゃった。:
Sorry, I'm getting
a little worn out.
translations.そっか……じゃあここまでにしとこう。:
I see...
Let's stop here, then.
translations.ふぅ、ちょっと緊張しちゃったかな。ごめんね。:
Phew. I guess I was a bit
too tense. Sorry.
translations.次はもっと気楽にいこうよ。:
Let's take it easy
next time.
translations.ふふ、もっと練習が必要かもね？:
Hehe, maybe I need
a little more practice？
translations.うん……まあ、今回はこんなところで。:
Yeah... Well, that's
enough for today.
translations.●も、なんだか疲れたかも……。:
Looks like ●'s
getting a bit tired, too...
translations.写真もいいけど、おしゃべりもしたいな。:
Photos are nice, but
I want to chat, too.
translations.そうだな……少し控えるか。:
Yeah... Guess I should
ease up a bit.
translations.カメラ、カメラって……あなたのカノジョはカメラじゃなくて私でしょ？:
Camera this, camera that...
I'm your girlfriend,
not the camera, right？
translations.撮ってばかりだとおしゃべりできなくて、ちょっとさびしいな……。:
If you only take photos,
we can't talk.
I'm a little lonely...
translations.ごめん……やめてくれる？:
Sorry, but...
could you please stop？
translations.これ以上はイヤ。わかるでしょ？:
No more, okay？
You understand, right？
translations.う……調子に乗りすぎたかな。:
Ugh... Did I get
too carried away？
translations.撮り過ぎ。めっ！:
You're taking way too many.
Bad boy!
translations.きれいに撮ってくれるとうれしいな。:
I'd love it if you took
a pretty picture of me.
translations.ふふ。きれいによろしくね、カメラマンさん。:
Fufu. Make me look pretty,
Mr. Photographer.
translations.心のピントが合ってれば、きれいに撮れるでしょ？ なーんてね。:
As long as your heart's
in focus, it'll turn out
pretty, right？ Just kidding!
translations.いつもと違う表情も撮ってほしいな。:
Try and capture some
expressions you don't
usually see on me, okay？
translations.素敵な写真になるといいね。:
I hope it turns out
to be a wonderful photo.
translations.写真を整理するのって、楽しいよね。:
Sorting through photos
is so much fun, isn't it？
translations.ふたりの写真、いっぱい撮ろうね。:
Let's take lots of photos
of the two of us, okay？
translations.また１枚、思い出が増えるんだね。楽しみだな。:
That's another memory made.
I can't wait.
translations.こうやってひとつずつ、思い出が増えていくんだね。:
Just like that, our memories
keep growing one by one.
translations.写真といっしょに、思い出も残っていくんだよね。:
The memories stay with us,
right along with the photos.
translations.あなたとの思い出、もっとたくさん欲しいな。:
I want to make so many
more memories with you.
translations.今日この瞬間のこと、忘れないでね。:
Don't forget this moment
today, okay？
translations.もしかして、困らせたいの？:
Are you trying to
fluster me, maybe？
translations.笑ってるうちにやめてね？:
Stop while I'm still
smiling, okay？
translations.まだちょっと恥ずかしいな。きれいに写るかな。:
I'm still a little shy.
I hope I look pretty.
translations.できるだけきれいに撮ってね。:
Make me look as pretty
as you can, okay？
translations.うーん……どの角度がかわいく見えるかな。:
Hmm... Which angle makes me
look the cutest, I wonder？
translations.どんな写真になるのか、楽しみだな。:
I'm excited to see
how it turns out.
translations.写真が増えていくのって、うれしいよね。:
It's so nice watching our
photos pile up, isn't it？
translations.私との思い出、いっぱいにしちゃおうね。:
Let's make tons of memories
together, okay？
translations.ふたりだけの大切な思い出、作ろうね。:
Let's make special memories,
just the two of us.
translations.私、今日のこと忘れないよ。あなたも……ね？:
I won't forget today.
You won't either... right？
translations.思い出が少しずつ増えていくのって、素敵だね。:
Watching our memories grow
bit by bit is so lovely.
translations.これからたくさん、楽しい思い出を作ろうね。:
Let's make lots of fun
memories from now on, okay？
translations.１枚ずつ、思い出が残ってくんだね。:
One photo at a time,
our memories stay with us.
translations.お願いだからやめてね。:
I'm asking you nicely,
please stop.
translations.こらこら、調子に乗らないの。:
Now, now, 
don't get carried away.
translations.けっこう緊張するものなんだね。:
This is actually 
pretty nerve-wracking, isn't it？
translations.私の顔、ひきつってない？:
My face isn't looking 
stiff, is it？
translations.ファインダー越しに見られるのって、恥ずかしいかも。:
Being watched through 
the viewfinder is kind of... 
embarrassing.
translations.あんまりピント合わせなくてもいいから……。:
You don't need to focus 
in so sharply, you know...？
translations.写真を撮られるのって、思ってたより恥ずかしいね。:
Getting my picture taken is 
more embarrassing than I thought.
translations.顔、熱くなってきちゃった。:
My face is starting 
to feel so hot...
translations.どんな顔をしたらいいのかわからないよ……。:
I really don't know 
what kind of face to make...
translations.あ、撮る時はちゃんと言ってね。:
Ah, make sure to let me know 
before you take it, okay？
translations.ずっと目を開けてるのって疲れるね。:
Keeping my eyes open the whole time 
is surprisingly tiring.
translations.あ！ 今、目つぶっちゃってたかも。:
Ah! I think I might've 
blinked just then.
translations.もう、どうしていきなり撮るの？:
Geez, why'd you take it 
out of nowhere？
translations.きゃっ!? もう、ちゃんと合図して。:
Eek!? Geez, 
give me a warning first!
translations.写真撮るのもけっこう手慣れてきたな。:
I'm getting pretty used to 
taking pictures now.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、いい感じでのってきたな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s really getting 
into the groove now.
translations.お、これはいいかも。: Ooh, this might be a good one.
translations.いいカメラマンはシャッターチャンスを逃さない、と。:
A good photographer never misses 
a photo op, right.
translations.今日もいい写真を撮るぞ！:
I'm gonna take some 
great photos today!
translations.今日は調子良さそうだな。: She seems in good form today.
translations.いい写真が取れるといいな。: Hope I can get some good shots.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のためにも頑張ろう！: Gotta do my best for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
translations.今日はちょっと冒険してみようかな。:
Maybe I'll try something 
a little adventurous today.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もけっこう慣れてきてるな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s getting pretty 
used to this too.
translations.よし、気分を盛り上げていこう！:
All right, let's keep 
the energy up!
translations.こういうアングルの▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も悪くないな。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks pretty great 
from this angle too.
translations.あれ？ ピントがうまく合わないな……。:
Huh？ The focus won't 
lock on properly...
translations.●がしっかりしないと、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲を緊張させちゃうな。:
If ● doesn't keep it together, 
it'll just make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ nervous.
translations.どうやって撮ればきれいに撮れるのかな。:
How can I make sure 
 this turns out pretty？
translations.ちゃんと撮れますように……。:
Please let this turn 
 out nicely...
translations.せっかくの記念なんだから、頑張らないとな。:
It's a special keepsake, 
 so I've gotta do my best.
translations.落ち着いて撮れば大丈夫……たぶん。:
If I just stay calm, 
 it'll be fine... probably.
translations.撮るほうがこんなに緊張するとは思わなかったな……。:
Didn't think taking photos 
 would make me this nervous...
translations.ふぅ。ちょっといいかな。:
Phew. Can I take 
 a quick breather？
translations.ちょっと脱力♪:
Just gonna relax 
 for a sec♪
translations.もしかして、私ばっかり楽しんでたりして？:
Wait, am I the only one 
 having fun here？
translations.今ね、すっごくいい気分▼:
I'm feeling really 
 good right now.▼
translations.素敵な思い出残そうね。:
Let's make some lovely 
 memories today.
translations.ちょっと……緊張してるかも。:
I might be... 
 a little nervous.
translations.ヘンだったら、すぐ言ってね？:
If I look weird, 
 tell me right away, okay？
translations.どうしてだろ……気分が乗らないなぁ。:
I wonder why... 
 I'm just not feeling it.
translations.今、撮らなきゃダメ？:
Do you really have 
 to take it now？
translations.きゃあっ！ もう……エッチな風。:
Eek! Geez... 
 What a naughty breeze.
translations.やだっ……見えた？ 見えてないよね？:
Oh no... Did you see？ 
 You didn't, right？
translations.それは……困る、かな。:
That's... kind of 
 a problem, you know.
translations.あの……恥ずかしくなってきた。:
Um... I'm starting 
 to feel embarrassed.
translations.そんなに見られても……困るなぁ。:
Staring like that... 
 is kind of embarrassing.
translations.ヘンなとこばっかり見ちゃダメでしょ。:
You shouldn't be staring 
 at weird spots, you know？
translations.そういうとこしか、興味ないの？:
Are those the only parts 
 you're interested in？
translations.ちょっと……エッチな視線を感じるんだけど？:
Hey... I feel a rather 
 naughty gaze on me？
translations.こら！ そんなのばっかりだと、もう撮らせないよ。:
Hey! Keep that up and 
 no more photos for you.
translations.もう……どうしていいか、わからなくなっちゃう。:
Geez... Now I don't know 
 what to do with myself.
translations.……そりゃあ、あなただって男の子だもんね。:
...Well, you're a guy 
 after all, aren't you.
translations.ねぇ……後ろ姿ばっかり見てるの？:
Hey... Are you just 
 staring at my back？
translations.あのね……気になって仕方ないんだけど。:
Hey, um... You're making 
 me super self-conscious.
translations.ヘンな写真撮ろうとしてない？:
You're not trying to take 
 weird photos, are you？
translations.もう、甘えたさんね▼:
Aw, look at you,
such a spoiled boy▼
translations.きゃっ……あんまり驚かさないで。:
Eek...
Don't startle me like that.
translations.えっ!? やだ……いたずらっ子なんだから。:
Huh!? Geez...
You're such a prankster.
translations.やっ！ もう、なんでかなあ……。:
Hey! Geez,
why are you like this...
translations.……なんかニヤケてる。まさか今の撮ってないよね？:
...You've got that smirk.
Don't tell me you took a
picture just now？
translations.もう写真撮るのやめようか？:
Maybe we should stop
taking photos now？
translations.撮られたくない写真もあるんだからね。:
There are some pictures
I don't want you taking,
you know.
translations.今、ヘンな写真撮ったでしょ？ いけないんだ。:
You just took a weird
picture, didn't you？
That's not allowed.
translations.こら。お仕置きしちゃうよ？:
Hey now.
Do I need to punish you？
translations.ん？ 何撮ってるの？:
Hmm？ What are you
taking pictures of？
translations.人、少ないよね。:
There aren't many people
around, huh.
translations.いやじゃないけど……。:
It's not that I don't like it,
but...
translations.このゲーム、好きなんだね？:
You really like this game,
don't you？
translations.ゲーム、よくやるんだ？:
Do you play games
a lot？
translations.私一人だと、こんなに\n楽しくないかも♪:
If I were playing alone,
it wouldn't be nearly
as fun♪
translations.一緒にやるのが一番だって:
Playing together is
always the best.
translations.一人のほうが集中できるかもな:
Might be easier to focus
by myself, though.
translations.私とゲームなら、\nどっちを取る？:
If it's me or games,
which one do you choose？
translations.ゲームでも、\n負けたら落ち込むよね？:
Even in games, losing still
bums you out, doesn't it？
translations.ゲームにすごく詳しかったり？:
Know a lot about games,
do you？
translations.ここで遊んでると\nあっという間だね？:
Time really flies when
we're playing here,
doesn't it？
translations.そんな気もしなくもないな:
Yeah, I guess it kind of
feels that way.
translations.ゲームが上手くなる\nコツってあるの？:
Is there a trick to
getting good at games？
translations.とにかく練習あるのみ:
Practice is all there is
to it.
translations.ねえ、これ大丈夫なのかな？:
Hey, are we gonna
be okay here？
translations.どうしたらいいのかな。: What am I supposed to do？
translations.私じゃ無理だったよ。上手なカレシでうれしい♪:
I could never do that.
I'm so happy to have such
a skilled boyfriend♪
translations.終わっちゃったね。残念。:
Aw, game over.
What a shame.
translations.惜しかったね。ギリギリだったよ。:
So close!
It was down to the wire.
translations.またチャレンジしようね？:
