so we give off the same vibe,
right？ Don't we？
translations.ざんねーん！ 正解は、O型です。そう、彼と一緒。大雑把なカップルです。:
Too bad!
The right answer is Type O.
Yup, same as him.
We're a pretty carefree couple.
translations.残念、正解は、O型でーす。そう、彼と一緒で、どっちかって言うと大雑把です。:
Too bad,
the answer is Type O!
Yup, same as him—
we're both pretty carefree,
if anything.
translations.ん？ ……ちなみに、どのあたりが？:
Hmm？ ...Out of curiosity,
what made you think that？
translations.あ、そういうところあるかも。なるほど、それでか。:
Ah, I might be like that.
I see, so that's why.
translations.どうしてぇ？そんなことないんだけどな……。:
Whyyy？ I'm not really
like that, though...
translations.まあ、そういうところもありますな。:
Well, I suppose I can be
like that at times.
translations.因みに正解は……ジャン！ O型でした。 わかりやすいって言われるんだけど……。:
By the way, the answer is...
Ta-da! Type O!
People say I'm an open book,
though...
translations.ねぇ、それじゃ、血液型相性診断。信じる？:
Hey, so do you believe in
blood type compatibility？
translations.それじゃ、血液型の相性って信じちゃいます？:
Well then, do you believe
in blood type compatibility？
translations.だよね！ じゃあ、自分と相性いいのって何型？:
Right？ So, which type
goes best with yours？
translations.ですよね！ じゃあ、自分と相性がいいのは何型だと思いますか？:
Right？ So which type do you
think is your best match？
translations.そうですか……当たるんだけどなぁ。:
Is that so...？ It's usually
pretty accurate, though.
translations.やっぱり、キッチリしてるところとか？:
Is it because they're
so organized and neat？
translations.それは……クリエイティブな感じがするからとか？:
Is that... because they feel
so creative, maybe？
translations.へぇ……ちょっとミステリアスな感じがいいとか？:
Ohh... Is it because you like
that mysterious vibe？
translations.もちろん、相性バッチリ▼ 大らか同士だし。:
Of course, that's a perfect
match ▼ Since you're
both so laid-back.
translations.違う？ じゃあ……あ、好きな人の血液型だったりして？:
No？ Then... oh, could it be
your crush's blood type？
translations.そっか……う～ん、気になるな。:
I see... Hmm, now I'm
really curious.
translations.うん。あなたとは、そういう感じが合うのかも。:
Yeah. That vibe might
really suit you.
translations.なんか、わかる気がします。うん。:
I feel like I get that.
Mm-hmm.
translations.相性バッチリのパターンだよね？それ。:
That's a match made
in heaven, isn't it？
translations.相性バッチリですよね、そういうパターン。:
That kind of pairing really
is a great match, isn't it？
translations.相性なんて、気の持ちようだし、あなたはそうなのかもね？:
Compatibility is all in your
head anyway, so maybe that's
just how it works for you？
translations.まあ、相性なんて、気の持ちようですもんね？:
Well, compatibility is all
about mindset anyway, right？
translations.それじゃ、血液型的には彼とも相性バッチリなんだ。:
So by blood type, you and
he are a perfect match too.
translations.じゃあ、彼とは血液型診断では、いまいちなんだ。:
So by blood type, you two
aren't the best match, then.
translations.実際の相性は、どういう感じ？:
How's your compatibility
in real life, though？
translations.そうだよね。うん、気にしない気にしない。:
Right？ Yeah, don't pay it
any mind, don't worry.
translations.ちょっと確認なんだけど……自分の上に兄弟、いる？:
Just checking, but... do you
have an older sibling？
translations.だと思った。下の子っていうオーラ出てるもん。じゃあ、もしかしてお兄さん、いる？:
I thought so. You've got
that younger-sibling aura.
Do you have an older brother？
translations.でしょ？ じゃあ、弟、いる？:
Right？ Then, do you
have a younger brother？
translations.大当たりー！ 当てるの得意だもん♪:
Bingo！ I'm pretty good
at guessing♪
translations.お姉さんか……言われてみれば、甘えんぼっぽい？:
An older sister, huh...
Now that you mention it,
do you like being pampered？
translations.おしい！ いると思ったんだけどなぁ。:
So close！ And here I really
thought you had one.
translations.因みに、わたしは、一人っ子です。兄弟欲しかったな。:
By the way, I'm an only
child. I always wanted
brothers and sisters.
translations.そうだ、せっかくだから聞いちゃお……。:
Oh, since I have the chance,
let me ask...
translations.せっかくだから聞いちゃいますけど……。:
Since I have the chance,
may I ask something...？
translations.彼って、昔からこんな感じ？:
Has he always been
like this？
translations.彼って、子供の頃からこうなんですか？:
Has he always been like
this, even as a kid？
translations.だったんですね？: So that's how he was, then？
translations.そっか……へぇ、意外かも。:
I see... Huh, that's
kind of surprising.
translations.そうだったんだ……わかった気がします、いろいろ。:
I see... I feel like that
explains a whole lot.
translations.彼、家でもいつも、活動的な感じ？:
Is he always super active
at home, too？
translations.彼ってお家でもやっぱり、やんちゃなんですか？:
Is he just as mischievous
around the house, too？
translations.彼って、家でもいつも、落ち着いてる感じ？:
Is he always this calm
around the house, too？
translations.彼ってお家でもやっぱり、のんびり屋さんですか？:
Is he pretty laid-back
at home, too？
translations.ふふっ、じゃあ、同じだ。安心しちゃった。:
Hehe, so he's the same.
That's a relief.
translations.ふふっ、じゃ、同じなんですね。わたしと一緒のときと。:
Hehe, then he's the same
as when he's with me.
translations.ふぅん……わたしの前では、カッコつけてるのかな？:
Hmm... I wonder if he's
just trying to act cool
around me？
translations.そうなんだ……ちょっと想像つかないです。:
Is that so...？ I can't
really picture that.
translations.わたしといる時は、どっちかっていうと、のんびーりしてる、かな？:
When he's with me,
he's more on the
laid-back side, I guess？
translations.わたしの前ではどっちかっていうと、積極的な感じ、かな？:
When he's with me,
he's more on the bolder
side, I guess？
translations.それに、いつも優しくて……。:
Plus, he's always
so sweet to me...
translations.でも、時々ちょっとクールだったり……。:
Though sometimes he can
be a little cool...
translations.彼のそういうところ、好きになったのかな……ふふっ。:
Maybe that's the part of him
I fell for... Hehe.
translations.彼のそういうところが、わたしは、好きなんだなって、思ってます。:
I think that's the part of
him that I really love.
translations.彼から、優しい人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
a really sweet person, but...
translations.彼からはクールな人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
the cool type, but...
translations.彼からは大人しい人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
on the quiet side, but...
translations.彼からは賑やかな人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
really lively, but...
translations.彼からはマジメな人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
pretty serious, but...
translations.彼からは面白い人って聞いてたけど……。:
He told me you were
really funny, but...
translations.でも、会ってみたら違って……。:
Now that I meet you,
you're not quite like that...
translations.聞いてたとおりでした。:
You're just like he said
you were.
translations.やさしいよね？ すごく。:
You really are sweet,
aren't you？
translations.やさしいんですね。ふふっ。:
You really are so sweet.
Hehe.
translations.実は、クールだよね？:
You're actually pretty
cool, aren't you？
translations.クールなんですね？ 本当は。:
You're actually quite cool,
aren't you？ Deep down.
translations.落ち着いた方ですよね、本当は。:
You're actually very
composed, aren't you？
translations.賑やかな人だなって。:
You're definitely a lively
person, aren't you.
translations.楽しい方なんだなって。:
You're such a fun person
to be around.
translations.真面目な人だよね、うん。:
You're pretty serious,
aren't you？ Yep.
translations.今日は、本当に会えて楽しかった。:
It was so much fun
meeting you today.
translations.今日は、会えて嬉しかったです。:
I'm so glad I got to
meet you today.
translations.あの、もしかして、彼の弟くん？:
Um, are you his
little brother, by chance？
translations.あの、もしかして、彼の妹さん？:
Um, are you his
little sister, by chance？
translations.あれ、じゃあ、お兄さん？:
Wait, are you his
older brother, then？
translations.あれ、じゃあ、お姉さん？:
Wait, are you his
older sister, then？
translations.その……少し顔が怖くて……。:
Um... your expression was
a little scary...
translations.やさしいんだね……そう思った。:
You're really sweet...
That's what I thought.
translations.クールな人なんだね、言われない？:
You're pretty cool,
aren't you？ Don't
people tell you that？
translations.落ち着いてるね。物静か、っていうか。:
You're so calm.
Quiet, in a way.
translations.正直すぎるっていうか……ほら、視線が。:
A little too honest,
maybe... Look where
your eyes are.
translations.……なんだかエッチな視線を感じたんだけど？:
...Felt like you were
giving me a naughty look,
though？
translations.なんだかじろじろ見てくるような、気のせいかな。:
Felt like you were staring
at me... Or is that just
my imagination？
translations.女の子のことじろじろ見るのは失礼だよ？:
It's rude to stare at a girl
like that, you know？
translations.じーっと見つめてくるんだね。なにか気になるんだ。:
You really stare right at me,
don't you. Is something
on your mind？
translations.スキンシップが好きなのかな。:
Guess you like being
touchy-feely, huh.
translations.少し行き過ぎてるかな。その、スキンシップが。:
Maybe a little too much,
though. You know,
all the touching.
translations.女の子はもっと大切に扱った方がいいと思うな。触りすぎ。:
You should treat girls
with more care.
Too much touching.
translations.会話のタイミングがマイペースなんだね。:
You really take conversations
at your own pace.
translations.すごくマイペースだね。会話のタイミング、自由過ぎるよ。:
You're so on your own time.
The way you time
conversations is too wild.
translations.緊張しやすいのかな？ もう少し話したかったね。:
Do you get nervous easily？
I wanted to talk a bit more.
translations.緊張しちゃうタイプだね。あまり話せなかったな。:
You're the type to get
nervous, huh. We didn't
really get to talk much.
translations.やさしい方なんですね……。:
You're a very kind person,
aren't you...
translations.きっと、クールな方なんですね。:
You must be a pretty cool
person, aren't you.
translations.穏やかな方なんですね。そう感じました。:
You're such a gentle person.
That's how it felt.
translations.なんだか、賑やかな方なんですね。:
You seem like a really
lively person.
translations.真面目な方なんですね。:
You're a very serious
person, aren't you.
translations.視線が……気のせいかもしれないですけど。:
Your eyes were... Well,
maybe it was just
my imagination.
translations.視線が少し気になって……ごめんなさい。:
Your stare made me a little
nervous... Sorry about that.
translations.あの、見られてる気がして……。:
Um, I felt like you were
staring at me...
translations.見てましたよね。緊張しちゃいました。:
You were staring, right？
It made me kind of nervous.
translations.見つめられて……緊張しました。はい。:
Being stared at like that...
It made me nervous. Yes.
translations.あの、スキンシップが……。なんでもないです。:
Um, all the touching was...
Never mind, it's nothing.
translations.あの、スキンシップがお好き、っていうことなんですか。:
Um... does that mean you
really like physical touch？
translations.はっきり言って、あの、触りすぎだと思います。:
To be frank, um... I think
you touched me way too much.
translations.会話のタイミングがマイペースなんですね。:
Your conversation timing is
really at your own pace.
translations.すごくマイペースですよね。あ、会話のタイミングのことなんですけど。:
You really go at your own
pace, don't you？ Ah, I mean
with conversation timing.
translations.緊張してました？ もう少しお話したかったです。:
Were you nervous？
I was hoping we could
talk a little more.
translations.緊張してたように見えました。あまりお話できなかったですね。:
You seemed pretty nervous.
We didn't really get to
talk much, did we？
translations.あなたって、似てるよね。:
You know, you look a lot like
someone.
translations.あの、似てますよね。:
Um, you really look like
someone.
translations.今男性に人気の……。:
That person who's popular
with guys right now...
translations.今女性に人気の……。:
That person who's popular
with girls right now...
translations.テレビでよく見る……。:
That person who's on TV
all the time...
translations.この間、街で見かけた……。:
That person I saw in town
the other day...
translations.みんなの憧れの……。:
That person everyone looks
up to...
translations.ふふ、そっくりなんだもん。:
Hehe, you really are the
spitting image.
translations.はい、そっくりだと思います。。:
Yes, I really think you're
the spitting image.
translations.あれ？ そっくりだと思うんだけどな。:
Huh？ But I really thought
you were the spitting image.
translations.そうですか？ 似てると思ったんですけど……。:
Is that so？
I thought you two
seemed alike, though...
translations.そう？ 似てると思ったんだけどな……。:
Really？
I thought you two
seemed so alike, though...
translations.あ、ごめんなさい。似てるかなって思ったんですけど。:
Ah, sorry about that.
I just thought you two
seemed kind of alike.
translations.これからもよろしくね。:
Take good care of me
from now on too, okay？
translations.うーん……そうでもない、かな。:
Hmm... maybe not
so much, I guess.
translations.アミューズメントスポットって楽しそう！ 連れて来てくれてありがとう。:
An amusement center
sounds like so much fun!
Thanks for bringing me.
translations.どういたしまして。●もわくわくしてきた！:
You're welcome.
I'm getting excited too,
●!
translations.また二人で遊べるね。私も来たかったんだ。:
We get to hang out
together again.
I really wanted to come!
translations.●も。さて、どれから始めるかな……。:
Me too, ●.
Now then, what should
we start with...？
translations.今日はゲーム？ メダル？ 私はどっちでもオッケーだよ。:
Are we doing video games
or medal games today？
I'm good with either!
translations.ふふ、また？ 飽きないもんね。:
Hehe, this again？
You never get tired of
it, do you.
translations.だな。めいっぱい楽しもう！:
Yeah. Let's make the
most of it!
translations.もう、またなんだ。いいよ、とことん付き合っちゃうから。:
Jeez, this again？
Alright, I'll stick with you
to the very end.
translations.ノット３０って面白かった♪ またやりたいな。:
Not 30 was really fun♪
I'd love to play again.
translations.ああ、いつでも付き合うよ。:
Sure, I'll play with you
anytime.
translations.ノット３０、クラスでやってた子がいたな。負けなしなんだって。:
Someone in my class used
to play Not 30.
They said they never lost.
translations.へえ、ってことは、何かコツがあるのか。:
Huh, so there must be
some trick to it.
translations.だるまさんが転んだって、早口だとちょっと言いにくいよね。:
Daruma-san ga koronda
is kind of a tongue-twister
if you say it fast, huh？
translations.そのもどかしさが面白いのかもな。:
Maybe that frustration
is what makes it fun.
translations.だーるまさん♪ だーるまさん♪ ……これはにらめっこだっけ。:
Daaaruma-san♪
Daaaruma-san♪
...Wait, was that for
the staring contest？
translations.この手の遊びにけっこう出てくるのかもな、だるまさん。:
Daruma-san shows up a lot
in these kinds of games,
doesn't he.
translations.スイカ割りって楽しいよね。食べにくいかたちになっちゃうのが、ちょっと残念だけど。:
Watermelon splitting is
so fun. It's just a shame
it ends up hard to eat.
translations.剣豪みたいに、真っ二つってわけにはいかないもんな。:
Yeah, not like we can
slice it cleanly in two
like a master swordsman.
translations.スイカ割り。間違えて砂浜に寝そべってる人を叩いちゃいそうで……ちょっと怖いところ:
Watermelon splitting...
I'm always scared I'll hit
someone on the sand by
mistake. It's a bit scary.
translations.叩かれたらびっくりするな……。:
I'd definitely freak out
if someone whacked me...
translations.マシュマロキャッチ、二人の相性がわかって面白いね。息合わせないとうまくいかないも:
Marshmallow toss really
tests your compatibility.
You have to be in sync
or it won't work.
translations.マシュマロ美味しいけど……食べ過ぎないようにしなきゃ。:
Marshmallows are yummy,
but... I've gotta make sure
not to eat too many.
translations.（やっぱりそこは気にするんだ……）:
(So she does worry
about that after all...)
translations.集中しすぎて寄り目になってたかも。ダーツって楽しいね♪:
I focused so hard I might
have gone cross-eyed.
Darts is so much fun♪
translations.まっすぐ飛ばすだけでもけっこう難しいもんだな。:
Just throwing it straight
is surprisingly tough.
translations.ダーツセット、部屋にあっても面白そう……。:
A dartboard in my room
sounds pretty fun...
translations.んー、ハマっちゃうかもな。:
Hmm, you might end up
getting hooked.
translations.スピード勝負は得意じゃないけど……それでも嫌いじゃないな♪:
I'm not great at Speed,
but... I still really like it♪
translations.楽しんでたもんな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。:
You definitely looked like
you were having fun, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.実はスピードでむきになって、つき指したことあるの。あなたも気をつけてね？:
Truth is, I once got so
into Speed I jammed my
finger. You be careful,
too, okay？
translations.意外とスポーツみたいだもんな、このゲーム……。:
This game's surprisingly
like a sport, huh...
translations.シャボン玉、楽しい。子供になったみたい♪:
Bubbles are so fun.
I feel like a kid again♪
translations.（無邪気な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も可愛いよな……）:
(Seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ act so
innocent is cute, too...)
translations.シャボン玉といえば、シャボンのお風呂って難しいんだよ？ なかなかキレイにあわ立た:
Speaking of soap bubbles,
bubble baths are actually
pretty tricky, you know？
They don't lather up easily.
translations.へえ、シャボンの風呂か……。:
Huh, a bubble bath,
is it...
translations.ふふ、楽しかった♪ ケンカしたときは、これで決着をつけるのもいいかもね。:
Fufu, that was fun♪
If we ever fight, maybe
we should settle things
with this.
translations.痛いのが飛んできそうだな……。:
Sounds like I'd take
a painful hit or two...
translations.このゲーム男女でやるのはフェアじゃないかもね、男の子は女の子のこと叩きにくいでし:
This game might not be fair 
to play guy versus girl.
It's hard for a boy 
to hit a girl, after all？
translations.これって、仲良しの人とやると、もっと楽しくなるゲームだね♪:
This game is so much more fun 
when you play with someone 
you're really close to♪
translations.はは、意外な駆け引きされたりしてな。:
Haha, like pulling unexpected 
mind games on each other.
translations.このゲーム、裏をかけば力がなくても勝てるよね……ふふふ。:
With this game, you can win 
without much strength if you 
outsmart them... Hehehe.
translations.面白いね、これ！ 私、やっつけるの得意かも？:
This is fun! I might actually be 
pretty good at beating them？
translations.ねえ、ほんとに宇宙人が侵略してきたら、私のこと守ってくれる？:
Hey, if aliens really did invade, 
would you protect me？
translations.もちろん、指一本触れさせないって！:
Of course! I won't let them 
lay a single finger on you!
translations.パネルの選び方に悩むね。計算しきれないかも……。:
It's hard deciding which panel 
to pick. I can't quite calculate 
it all...
translations.直感で選んじゃうのもアリじゃない？: Why not just follow your gut？
translations.目の前のメダルにつられてると、次選べなくなっちゃうね。:
If you get lured by the medals 
right in front of you, 
you're stuck on the next pick.
translations.少しは先読みもしとかないとな……。:
Yeah, gotta plan ahead 
at least a little bit...
translations.かわいいキャラがトコトコ歩いててかわい～ね。:
Watching the cute characters 
toddle along is so adorable～
translations.ほんと、動き見てるだけでも楽しいな。:
Totally. Just watching them move 
is fun on its own.
translations.ジャックポットならず、か。惜しかったね。:
No jackpot, huh？ 
That was so close.
translations.いい感じだったね♪ ジャックポットも取れたし。:
That went great♪ 
We even got the jackpot!
translations.ああ、思わず声出そうになったよ。: Yeah, I almost shouted out loud.
translations.グランドクロスっていろんな世界が出てくるから、見てるだけで満足しちゃう。:
Grand Cross shows so many 
different worlds, I'm satisfied 
just watching it.
translations.見てるだけじゃなくて、メダルもゲットしたいけどね。:
Just watching is nice, 
but I want to win some medals too.
translations.グランドクロスのジャックポット、成功すればすっごく楽しそうだったのに……残念。:
If we'd hit the Grand Cross 
jackpot, it looked like it would've 
been so fun... What a shame.
translations.次こそ、がんばって最後まで見せるから！:
Next time, I'll do my best 
and show you all the way 
to the end!
translations.グランドクロスでジャックポット取れたね！ あれには見とれちゃったな。:
We won the Grand Cross jackpot! 
I was totally mesmerized by that.
translations.メダルもじゃらじゃら出て、派手だったなー。:
Medals came pouring out, too. 
That was so flashy!
translations.フォーチュントリニティで世界中の名所が出てきてたね。地理の勉強になったりして？:
Fortune Trinity showed famous 
places all over the world. 
Maybe it's good geography study？
translations.フォーチュントリニティ、もう少しでジャックポットだったのにね。次来たときはリベン:
Fortune Trinity was so close to 
a jackpot. Time for revenge 
next visit？
translations.ああ、次こそ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に世界中の名所を見せてやるよ！:
Yeah, next time for sure, 
I'll show ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ all those 
famous sights around the world!
translations.フォーチュントリニティのジャックポット、爽快だったね！ 画面が二つに割れたりする:
Fortune Trinity's jackpot was 
so exhilarating! The screen split 
in two and everything!
translations.ああ、うれしいサプライズってやつだな。: Yeah, talk about a nice surprise.
translations.アニマロッタの動物ってどれもかわいい▼ あのヌイグルミ、クレーンゲームに入ってな:
All the animals in Anima Lotta 
are so cute, ▼ 
I wonder if those plushies are 
in any claw machines？
translations.そうだな、今度探してみるか。:
Yeah, maybe we can look for one 
next time.
translations.アニマロッタのジャックポット、見たかったな……。もう少しだったのにね？:
I really wanted to see that Anima 
Lotta jackpot... We were so close, 
weren't we？
translations.ボールがたくさん出てきて、大迫力なんだよな……。:
A ton of balls come pouring out, 
it's super intense...
translations.アニマロッタのジャックポット、おめでとう。キレイだし……感動しちゃった。:
Congrats on the Anima Lotta 
jackpot. It was so pretty... 
I was honestly moved.
translations.演出がいいんだよな。たまにしか見られないのが残念だよ。:
The presentation is so good. 
Too bad you hardly ever get 
to see it.
translations.ジャックポットチャンスになると“入って～！”って念じてるの。今日はうまくいかなか:
Whenever Jackpot Chance comes up, 
I'm praying, 'Go in!' in my head. 
Didn't work out today, though.
translations.そうなんだ？ じゃあ次に期待だな。:
Is that so？ Well, let's hope 
for better luck next time.
translations.ジャックポットチャンスの緊張感、好きだな。他の人がチャンスになってると、見に行っ:
I love the suspense of a
Jackpot Chance. When someone else
gets one, I want to go peek.
translations.次は決めてみせるから！:
I'll nail it next time,
just watch!
translations.今回の名場面は……ジャックポットを決めたときのあなたの顔、かな？:
The highlight today was...
your face when you hit that jackpot,
I think？
translations.見てたの？ 恥ずかしいな……。:
You were watching me？
Man, that's embarrassing...
translations.今日は来て良かったね。いいもの見られたもん。:
I'm so glad we came today.
I got to see something amazing.
translations.ジャックポットな？ あれが取れると気持ちいいんだよな！:
The jackpot, right？
Hitting that feels so good!
translations.遊べるだけじゃなくて、たくさんメダルが出てくるんだから、メダルゲームって一石二鳥:
You get to play and win a ton
of medals too, so medal games
are a win-win, right♪
translations.はは、たくさん出てくるとは限らないけどね……。:
Haha, though you don't always
win that many...
translations.いっぱい出てくるメダルを見てると、どんどん楽しくなってくるね。:
Watching all those medals pour out
just makes it more and more fun.
translations.はは、あんまり熱くなりすぎないようにね。:
Haha, just don't get
too carried away, okay？
translations.メダル、けっこう増えたね。リッチな気分♪:
We got quite a lot of medals.
I feel so rich♪
translations.まだまだ増やしてみせるからさ、楽しみにしてて。:
I'll win even more for us,
just you wait.
translations.メダルは減っちゃったけど、こんなに楽しかったんだからオッケーだよね？:
We lost some medals, but we had
so much fun, so it's all good, right？
translations.そうだな……そう思うことにしようかな。:
Yeah... I guess I'll look at it
that way.
translations.今日はほんとに楽しかった♪ ねえ、あなたも？:
Today was so much fun♪
Hey, did you have fun too？
translations.ふふっ。あなたが夢中になってるときの顔って、カワイイ▼:
Fufu. The look on your face
when you're totally absorbed
is so cute▼
translations.そんなに見てたの？ 気づかなかった……。:
You were looking at me that much？
I didn't even notice...
translations.時間を忘れちゃうくらい、のめりこんじゃったね。:
We got so absorbed in it,
we completely lost track of time.
translations.こんなに興奮したのってひさしぶり♪:
It's been so long since I got
this excited♪
translations.連れてきてくれてありがとう。なかなか一人じゃ来られないから。:
Thanks for bringing me along.
I'd hardly ever come here alone.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に遊べて楽しかったよ。:
I had a lot of fun playing
together with you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.なんだか上手くいった気がするし、また来たいな……いいよね。:
I feel like things went pretty well,
so I want to come again... Can we？
translations.次に来たときは、もっといい結果出しちゃおうね。応援するから。:
Next time we come, let's do even
better. I'll be cheering for you.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が応援してくれるなら、はりきっちゃうな。:
If you're cheering for me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I'll definitely give it my all.
translations.でも結果は悔しかったね。今度はがんばろ。:
The results were frustrating, though.
Let's do our best next time.
translations.やっぱり勝って帰らなきゃスッキリしないもんな。:
Yeah, it just doesn't feel right
unless we go home on a win.
translations.あとは、せっかくだから勝って終わりたかったね。:
Yeah, it would've been nice
to end it on a win.
translations.この借りは次で返そう。: We'll get our revenge next time.
translations.……だけど、もうちょっとがんばれたかもね。:
...Still, maybe we could've
done a little better.
translations.そうかもな……次は結果も出そう！:
Maybe... Next time,
let's get real results!
translations.よし、やってみるか。: Alright, let's give it a shot.
translations.シルバーか……ここは慎重に。:
Silver, huh...
Gotta be careful here.
translations.プレミア……伝説のスクラッチカード!? どんな結果が出るんだろ……。:
Premium... The legendary scratch card!?
I wonder what's gonna come out...
translations.右じゃないかな？ なんとなくだけど。:
Maybe the right one？
Just a hunch, though.
translations.私のカンだと、ここは……左。うん、左。:
My intuition says... the left.
Yep, definitely left.
translations.ここは真ん中で勝負！ ……は、どう？:
Let's go for the middle!
...What do you think？
translations.左……それとも右？ 裏をかいて真ん中とか……。:
Left... or right？
Or do the unexpected
and pick the middle...？
translations.ここは格好いいところ見せてもらおうかな？ 任せるね！:
Why don't you show me
how cool you can be？
I'm leaving it to you!
translations.あなたの直感を信じるよ。がんばって！:
I trust your intuition.
Good luck!
translations.当たった！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のカン、すごいな……。:
It's a winner! ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
intuition is amazing...
translations.当たりだ！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の期待に応えられたな。:
It's a winner! Glad I could
live up to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s
expectations.
translations.ハズレた……。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の選んだほうにすれば良かったか。:
A dud... Maybe I should've
gone with the one
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ picked.
translations.暖かくなってきたね。いい気持ち。:
It's getting warmer out.
Feels so nice.
translations.うららか……うららかってどういう意味だっけ。:
'Balmy'... Wait, what does
'balmy' actually mean again？
translations.んー、ポカポカして……眠くなっちゃうね。:
Mmm, it's so warm...
I'm getting sleepy.
translations.春の眺め……だね。:
It's such a lovely
spring view... isn't it？
translations.ねえねえ。春っぽいもの、何が見える？:
Hey, look around.
See anything that feels
like spring？
translations.どれどれ……どんな春を見つけたかな？:
Let me see... What kind
of spring did you find？
translations.春といえば……やっぱり桜？:
When you think of spring...
it's gotta be cherry blossoms？
translations.春といえば、サクランボかなあ……。:
When I think of spring,
maybe it's cherries...？
translations.私にとって、春は出会いの季節！\n普通かな。:
To me, spring is the
season of new encounters!
...A bit cliché？
translations.春といえば……変わったのど飴が出るのよね。:
When spring comes around...
they always put out weird
cough drops, don't they？
translations.暑い……けど、心地いい暑さかな。:
It's hot... but a nice,
comfortable kind of hot.
translations.紫外線が気になっちゃう季節。:
This is the season where
UV rays start worrying me.
translations.水分補給はちゃんとしないとね……。:
We need to make sure
we stay hydrated...
translations.これだけ暑いと、陽炎とか見えないかな。:
With it this hot, I wonder
if we'll see any heat shimmer？
translations.夏の雲って見てると楽しいよね。そう思わない？:
Summer clouds are so fun
to watch. Don't you think？
translations.夏の日差し、目が細くなっちゃうね。:
The summer sun just makes
you squint, doesn't it？
translations.夏か……風鈴の音って好きだな。:
Summer, huh...
I really love the sound
of wind chimes.
translations.夏は怪談。ふふ、今はそんな話しません。:
Summer means ghost stories.
Fufu, don't worry, I won't
tell one right now.
translations.この季節は、夏バテしないように献立に気を遣うんだ。:
Around this time of year,
I plan our meals carefully so
we don't get summer fatigue.
translations.涼しいかな……着る服間違えないようにしないとね。:
A bit chilly, maybe...
I'll have to be careful
what I wear.
translations.過ごしやすい季節よね、デートにもぴったり、かな。:
It's so pleasant out.
Perfect for a date, maybe？
translations.少し、夏の暑さが恋しくなっちゃうことってないかな。:
Don't you ever kind of miss
the summer heat a little？
translations.空が高いね……。秋だなあ。:
The sky feels so high...
It's really autumn, huh.
translations.ちいさい秋、何か見つけられる？:
Can you spot any little
hints of autumn anywhere？
translations.秋の風景って、カラフルで好きかな。:
Autumn scenery is so colorful.
I really like it.
translations.秋といえば、イチョウかな。たくさんあると、壮観よね。:
When I think of autumn,
it's ginkgos. Rows of them
are just magnificent.
translations.小春日和は秋なんだって、しばらく知らなかったな。:
I didn't realize for ages
that 'little spring' days
actually happen in autumn.
translations.秋といっても、食欲の秋にはしたくないんだけどなあ。:
Even if it is autumn,
I really don't want to let
my appetite get away from me.
translations.芸術の秋なら、映画鑑賞もアリだよね？:
If it's the season for arts,
watching a movie totally
counts, right？
translations.さむーい、あなたは大丈夫？:
So cold!
Are you holding up okay？
translations.はあ……息が白くなっちゃうね。:
Haaah... Look, you can see
our breath now.
translations.空気が乾いてて……お肌気をつけなきゃ。:
The air's so dry...
I've got to take good
care of my skin.
translations.一面の銀世界は……あまり見られないよね。:
A blanket of white snow...
We don't get to see that
very often around here.
translations.冬の風景、少し寂しくなっちゃうこともあるよね。:
Winter scenery can feel
a little lonely sometimes,
don't you think？
translations.空気が澄んでるから……遠くも見えるかな。:
The air is so crisp and clear...
I bet we can see pretty far.
translations.冬といえば、コタツ？ んー、恋しくなっちゃった。:
Winter means a kotatsu, right？
Mmm, now I really want one.
translations.冬はやっぱり、お鍋よね。でしょ。:
Winter's gotta be hot pot.
Right？
translations.冬はホラーの季節。日本の怪談だと夏だけどね。:
Winter is horror season.
Though Japanese ghost
stories are a summer thing.
translations.冬だからってたくさん着込んじゃうと、太く見られちゃうかな。:
If I bundle up too much
just because it's winter,
will I look chubby？
translations.早朝のお出かけも、気持ちいいね。:
Going out early in the morning
feels so nice, doesn't it？
translations.んー、眠そうな顔しても許してね。:
Mmm... forgive me if I look
a little sleepy, okay？
translations.はあ～、早く出かけると、なんだか得した気分。:
Haaah... Heading out early
makes me feel like we got
a head start on the day.
translations.太陽が昇る直前の空……こういうのもいいね。:
The sky right before sunrise...
I really like this too.
translations.この時間の風景って、いつもと違って見えるね。:
Everything at this hour
looks so different from usual,
doesn't it？
translations.こんな時間だと、まだ人も少ないかな。:
Not many people out
at this hour, huh？
translations.朝早い時間の鳥の鳴き声って、不思議とうるさく感じないね。:
Birds chirping early on
strangely doesn't feel
noisy at all, does it？
translations.日の出の瞬間って毎日あるんだよね。そうそう見ることないのって、もったいないかも。:
The sun rises every day.
It almost feels like a waste
that we rarely watch it.
translations.早朝マラソンも、朝の風物詩のひとつかな。:
Early morning joggers are
such a classic morning sight,
aren't they？
translations.ふふ。朝一番の風、なのかな。:
Fufu. I wonder if that's
the morning's very first breeze.
translations.出かけるのは朝のうちがいいよね、その方がたくさん楽しめるもん。:
Heading out in the morning
is great. That way we have
way more time to enjoy!
translations.ふふ、いつまでも眠そうにしてちゃダメよ？:
Fufu, you can't stay sleepy
forever, you know？
translations.やっぱり朝型の生活にした方がいいのかなあ。:
Maybe I really should
become a morning person...
translations.朝の風景って、やっぱり新鮮な感じがするね。:
Morning scenery always feels
so fresh and new, doesn't it？
translations.お腹が空いてくると、目に入るものが食べ物に……見えてこないよね！:
When you're hungry,
everything looks like food...
Wait, no it doesn't!
translations.まだこれから陽が高くなるんだね。:
The sun's going to get
even higher from here, huh.
translations.午後の天気はどうなるのかな。:
I wonder what the weather
will be like this afternoon？
translations.朝の空気は気持ちいいね。やっぱり早起きしないと。:
The morning air feels great.
Waking up early really is
worth it after all.
translations.朝ならではのデート、ってどんなのかな。:
I wonder what kind of date
you can only do in the morning？
translations.これから気温上がるのかな……。:
I wonder if it'll warm up
from here on out...
translations.おなかすいてない？ 大丈夫？:
Aren't you hungry？
Are you doing okay？
translations.お昼はやっぱり眠くなっちゃうね……しょうがないか。:
Afternoons always make you
sleepy, huh... Can't really
be helped, I guess.
translations.優雅にお昼寝っていうのも、いいかもね。:
An elegant afternoon nap
sounds pretty nice, too.
translations.お日様が高いね。影も短くなってる。:
The sun is so high up.
Our shadows are shorter, too.
translations.やっぱり今くらいの時間が一番活気があるね。:
This time of day really is
the liveliest, isn't it？
translations.なんだか周りがキラキラして見える、どうしてかな。:
Everything around us looks
all sparkly. I wonder why？
translations.あ、お昼のドラマ……まあいっか。今はデートだもんね。:
Ah, my afternoon soap...
Oh well! We're on a date
right now, after all.
translations.おやつは控えないといけないから、アメだけで済ませよっかな。:
I should cut back on snacks,
so maybe I'll just stick
to hard candy.
translations.お昼って、同じ献立ばかりになっちゃうことってない？:
Don't you end up eating
the same lunch over and over？
translations.今の時間が気温のピークかな。:
I guess this is the peak
temperature for today.
translations.今日の晩御飯は……って考える時間じゃない？:
Isn't it about time to start
thinking about what's for
dinner tonight？
translations.一日もそろそろ終わり……ん、それともまだまだかな。:
The day's almost over...
Hm, or do we still have
plenty of time left？
translations.小さい頃だと、もう帰らないといけない時間かな。今は、大丈夫だもんね。:
Back when we were kids,
we'd have to head home now.
We're fine today, though.
translations.ふふ。ほら、影が長くなってる。:
Fufu. Look, our shadows
are getting so long.
translations.夕焼け……なんでだろう、当たり前のものなのに見てて飽きないの。:
Sunsets... Even though
they happen every day,
I never get tired of them.
translations.……あ、ごめん。なんでもないの。あなたの顔が夕焼けで染まってるなって。:
...Ah, sorry. It's nothing.
Just noticed the sunset
glowing on your face.
translations.黄昏時……って言葉にするだけで、ちょっとロマンチックじゃない？:
"Twilight"... Just saying
the word sounds a little
romantic, doesn't it？
translations.マジックアワーってわかる？ 映画用語……なのかな、調べてみて。:
Do you know "magic hour"？
It's a movie term... I think.
Look it up sometime!
translations.そろそろ日も落ちるね……ううん、それだけ。:
The sun's about to set...
No, that's all.
translations.あ、鳥……なんの鳥だったのかな。:
Ah, a bird... I wonder
what kind it was？
translations.もう夜か……なんだか早い気がするな。:
It's night already... 
Feels like time flew by.
translations.時間を気にせず、デートできるようになりたいね。:
I wish we could go on dates 
without having to worry 
about the time.
translations.一日も終わり……かな。でもまだ寝るわけじゃないもんね。:
I guess the day's over... 
Though it's not like 
we're heading to bed yet.
translations.もう暗いね……何か見える？:
It's so dark now... 
Can you see anything？
translations.まだ飛んでる鳥がいる……よくぶつかったりしないね。:
There are still birds out... 
It's a wonder they don't 
bump into things.
translations.周りの人ももう家に帰るんだね……私たちはどうしよっか。:
Everyone around here 
is heading home... 
What should we do？
translations.気温下がってきたね。大丈夫？:
It's getting chilly out. 
Are you okay？
translations.星……もっと時間が経てばたくさん見えるかな。:
The stars... 
I wonder if we'll see more 
as it gets later？
translations.色んな夜景を見たいな……もちろん、二人一緒によ？:
I want to see all kinds 
of night views... 
Together, of course？
translations.さて、晩御飯はどうしましょうか。:
Now then... 
what should we do 
for dinner？
translations.こんな時間に一緒にいるのって……なんだか不思議ね。:
Being together this late... 
It feels kind of strange, 
doesn't it？
translations.まだ眠くないの？ もう、悪い子なんだ。:
Still not sleepy？ 
Geez, you're a bad boy.
translations.ん……ううん、まだ大丈夫。そんなに眠くないよ。:
Mm... no, I'm fine. 
I'm not that sleepy yet.
translations.ねえ、星、たくさん見える。……キレイだね。:
Look, so many stars... 
They're so pretty.
translations.真っ暗……世界に私達しかいないみたい……。:
It's pitch-black... 
Like we're the only ones 
left in the world...
translations.……ねえ、暗くて少し怖いな。離れないでね。:
...Hey, it's a little scary 
in the dark. 
Stay close to me, okay？
translations.さすがにこの時間だと冷えるね。風邪ひかないようにしないと。:
It gets so cold this late. 
We'd better be careful 
not to catch a cold.
translations.夜中の静けさが、余計に眠気を誘っちゃうね。:
The quiet at night like this 
just makes me even sleepier.
translations.……ねえ、何か聞こえる？ 気のせいかな。:
...Hey, did you hear that？ 
Or was it just 
my imagination？
translations.こんな時間に食べたらよくないよね。おなかすきませんように。:
Eating this late is bad. 
I really hope my stomach 
doesn't start rumbling.
translations.今、二人でいることって、なんだかすごいよね。:
Being together right now... 
It feels kind of amazing, 
doesn't it？
translations.ねえ、どうして眠くないの？ いつもこんな夜更かししてるってこと？:
Why aren't you sleepy？ 
Do you always stay up 
this late？
translations.さすがに眠いよ……あなたの隣で眠っちゃいそう。:
I'm definitely sleepy now... 
I might just nod off 
right next to you.
translations.何も見えない……あなた以外は、ね。:
I can't see a thing... 
Except you, that is.
translations.この星も、夜が明けたら見えなくなっちゃうんだね。そこにあるのに、不思議。:
Once dawn comes, 
we won't see these stars. 
Even though they're still 
there... it's strange.
translations.今の時間が一番気温が低いのかな……寒くない？:
Is this the coldest part 
of the night？ 
Aren't you cold？
translations.……暗くて静かで、隣にあなたがいて。安心して眠っちゃいそう。:
...It's dark and quiet, 
and you're right by my side. 
I feel so safe, 
I could just fall asleep.
translations.こんな時間に活動してるのって、私達くらいかな。:
Are we the only ones 
out and about at this hour？
translations.おなかすいてきたかも……考えないようにしなきゃ。:
I might be getting hungry... 
I'd better try not 
to think about it.
translations.晴れてよかった。やっぱりデートは天気を気にせずにしたいもんね。:
I'm glad it's clear out. 
Dates are so much better 
when you don't have to worry 
about the weather.
translations.ねえねえ。やっぱり私たちのデートに合わせて晴れてくれたのかな。ふふ。:
Hey, hey. Do you think 
the sun came out just for 
our date？ Hehe.
translations.ちゃーんと、晴れますようにってお祈りしてくれたんだ？ よしよし。:
You made sure to pray for 
clear skies, didn't you？ 
Good boy.
translations.今日は空がキレイ。気分も良くなりそうだね。:
The sky is so pretty today. 
It puts you in a good mood, 
doesn't it？
translations.天気がいいから遠くまで見えるね。空気もキレイ。:
The weather's so nice 
you can see so far. 
The air feels crisp, too.
translations.曇ってるね。雨が降らないといいけど。大丈夫かな。:
It's getting cloudy. 
I hope it doesn't rain... 
Think we'll be okay？
translations.少しくらい曇ってる方が、かえってすごしやすいかな。:
A little cloud cover might 
actually make it 
more comfortable.
translations.雲出てるね……ううん、いいの。お肌にはこっちの方がいいし、ね。:
A lot of clouds, huh... 
No, it's fine. 
Better for my skin anyway.
translations.雲が厚いね。ほら……見て？:
Those clouds are thick. 
Look... see？
translations.これくらい曇ってると、なんだか時間の感覚なくしちゃうね。:
When it's this overcast, 
you kind of lose track 
of time, don't you？
translations.降っちゃったね、雨。今日はずっとこんな感じかな。:
It started raining, huh.
Looks like it might stay
like this all day.
translations.雨のデートって、好き？ 私はこういうのも、悪くないと思うな。:
Do you like rainy dates？
Personally, I don't think
this is bad at all.
translations.雨なら雨で、デートを楽しめばいいの。そうでしょ。:
If it rains, then it rains!
We can still enjoy our date.
Right？
translations.雨、やみそうにないね。雲けっこう厚そうだもん。:
Doesn't look like the rain's
gonna stop. Those clouds
look pretty thick.
translations.水たまりできてるよね、気をつけないと。:
Puddles are forming.
We'd better watch our step.
translations.まさか雪が降るなんてね。ホワイトデート、かな。:
I never thought it'd snow.
A white date, maybe？
translations.雪かあ……そんなに激しくならなければ、雨よりかはまだ過ごしやすいかな。:
Snow, huh...
As long as it stays light,
it's nicer than rain, I think.
translations.ねえ、私雪ですべっちゃうかも。転ばないように助けてね。:
Hey, I might slip on the snow.
Keep me from falling, okay？
translations.すごい、雪。いつもと違う風景だから、道に迷っちゃったりして。:
Look at all this snow!
It changes the view so much,
we might even get lost.
translations.一面真っ白にならないかな……なったらなったで困っちゃうんだけどね。:
I wonder if it'll all turn
pure white... Though it'd be
trouble if it actually did.
translations.すごい風……何か飛ばされないように気をつけなきゃ。:
The wind is crazy...
Gotta make sure nothing
gets blown away.
translations.これだけ風が強いと、飛ばされちゃいそう。……私は重いから大丈夫、なんて思わないで:
With wind this strong,
I feel like I'll blow away...
Don't you dare go thinking
I'm too heavy, either!
translations.今日はぴったりくっついて、あなたを風よけにしちゃおっかな。:
Maybe I'll stick real close
and use you as a windbreaker.
translations.見て。雲の流れが速いね……やっぱり風強いんだ。:
Look, the clouds are
moving so fast...
The wind really is strong.
translations.木がすごく揺れてる……ちょっと怖いくらいだね。:
The trees are swaying...
It's almost a little scary.
translations.雷鳴ってる……大丈夫かなあ。:
There's thunder...
I hope we'll be okay.
translations.雷……このあたりって、避雷針あった？:
Thunder... Are there any
lightning rods around here？
translations.急に抱きついても、許してね。こう見えても、結構怖いんだから、雷。:
Forgive me if I cling to you
all of a sudden, okay？
Despite how I look,
lightning really scares me.
translations.あっ……今、稲光見えた、よね？:
Ah... You saw that flash
of lightning just now, right？
translations.音だけでも怖いのに……ビカッて明るくなると体がビクッてなっちゃう。:
The sound alone is scary,
but when it flashes bright,
I just jump every time.
translations.ここ、何があるかな。新しいもの見つかるといいね。:
I wonder what's here.
Hope we find something new.
translations.一緒に来られて良かった。うん、すごく楽しいよ。:
I'm glad we came together.
Yeah, I'm having so much fun.
translations.ここに来たかったんだ？ お目当ては何かなあ？:
You wanted to come here？
What caught your eye？
translations.やっぱり楽しい。どこでも楽しいとは思うけど……デートの場所も大切よね。:
This really is fun.
Anywhere with you is nice,
but the date spot matters too.
translations.なんだかワクワクしちゃうなあ。何か新発見あるかな。:
I'm getting kind of excited.
Think we'll discover
something new？
translations.んー、今日はなんだか気分がいいなあ……。デートも楽しいし、ね。:
Mmm, I feel great today...
Our date's lots of fun, too.
translations.ねえ、私ばっかり楽しんでるわけじゃないよね？:
Hey, I'm not the only one
having fun here, right？
translations.ふふふ。ほらほら、じっとしてたら楽しくないよ？:
Hehehe. Come on, you won't
have any fun standing still,
you know？
translations.楽しい？ 私はすごく楽しいよ。あなたもでしょ？:
Having fun？
I'm having a wonderful time.
You are too, right？
translations.はあ、このままはしゃいでたら疲れちゃうね。:
Whew, if I keep this up,
I'm gonna wear myself out.
translations.ふふふ。やだ、面白い♪: Hehehe. Oh wow, this is fun♪
translations.はあ、一緒に来られてよかった……。:
Ah, I'm so glad we came
together...
translations.きっと一人じゃ、楽しくないもんね。:
It definitely wouldn't be
as fun all by myself.
translations.二人一緒だとどこでも楽しいっていうけど……。:
People say anywhere is fun
as long as you're together,
but...
translations.ほんとかもね。あなたとだったら、きっとどこでも。:
It might be true. With you,
anywhere would be wonderful.
translations.今日のデートも、きっと大成功間違いなし！:
Today's date is definitely
gonna be a huge success!
translations.落ち着ける場所だね……ゆっくりしていこ？:
It's so relaxing here...
Wanna take our time？
translations.いいところだね……静かで、安心できて。:
What a nice place...
It's quiet and comforting.
translations.なんだか静かだね……気分が落ち着く。:
It's really quiet...
Puts my mind at ease.
translations.やっぱりここは落ち着くなあ。:
I knew it, this place is
just so calming.
translations.あ、あなたもやっぱりのんびりした顔してる。:
Ah, you've got that relaxed
look on your face too.
translations.ふふ、このまま眠くなっちゃいそう。だって、気持ちいいんだもん。:
Hehe, I could fall asleep
like this. It feels so nice.
translations.日ごろのストレスがどんどん消えてく感じがする……あ、そんなに疲れてるわけじゃない:
Feels like all my daily stress
is melting away...
Ah, not that I was *that* tired.
translations.心が安らぐ感じ……。: My heart feels so at peace...
translations.ふふ。なんでかな、落ち着くの。:
Hehe. I wonder why
it's just so calming？
translations.なんだろ……安心できる感触？:
What is it...
such a comforting feel？
translations.落ち着く……。何かこう……きっとナントカ波みたいのが出てるのよ。:
So relaxing...
There's gotta be, like,
some kind of whatever-waves
radiating in the air.
translations.なごんじゃうなあ、こうしてると。:
I feel so mellow,
just being like this.
translations.やっぱりあなたの隣は落ち着くな……。:
Being by your side really is
the most comforting place...
translations.デートに来たのにこんなにくつろいじゃうなんて……。:
We're on a date, and here I am
totally lounging around...
translations.高校生っぽくはないかな、ふふ。:
Doesn't feel very high school,
does it？ Hehe.
translations.どこに来ても、あなたが一緒なら安心。:
No matter where we go,
I feel safe with you.
translations.そうでしょ、なんでも守ってくれるもんね？:
Right？ After all,
you'll protect me from anything,
won't you？
translations.わあ…………。うん、来てよかった。:
Waaah... Yeah,
I'm really glad we came.
translations.不思議……ここにいると、なんだか幸せなの。:
It's strange... Being here
just makes me feel so happy.
translations.もう、なんだか幸せ感じちゃうな。:
Geez, I can't help feeling
so happy right now.
translations.うん、うれしいよ。気持ち、伝わってるよね。:
Yeah, I'm glad. You can tell
how I feel, can't you？
translations.あはは。なんだろう、こうしてると幸せな気分。:
Ahaha. I don't know why,
but this makes me so happy.
translations.こうしてると、心が満たされる感じがするの。気のせいじゃないよね。:
Being like this makes my heart
feel so full. It's not just
my imagination, right？
translations.ありがとう、そばにいてくれて。:
Thank you...
for staying by my side.
translations.やっぱり二人一緒がいいね。:
It really is best
when it's the two of us.
translations.はー、なんだか寝転んじゃいたくなるくらい。ふふ。:
Haaah, I almost want to lie down
right here. Hehe.
translations.なんだかリラックスできる場所だね。:
It's such a relaxing place,
isn't it？
translations.うん、ここならゆっくりできそう。ね？:
Yeah, looks like we can
take it easy here, huh？
translations.ほら、ここならリラックスできるよ。: See？ We can really relax here.
translations.はあ……あ、間抜けな顔しちゃったかな。:
Phaah... Ah, did I just make
a totally goofy face？
translations.リラックス～。はい、ご一緒に。ふふ♪:
Relaaax~. Come on,
do it with me. Hehe♪
translations.ほら、日ごろの疲れを癒しちゃお。:
Come on, let's soothe away
all our everyday fatigue.
translations.ぼけーっとした顔してる。どうしたの、疲れてた？:
You're totally zoning out.
What's up, were you tired？
translations.あはは、なんでこんなに落ち着くのかな。:
Ahaha, why do I feel
so calm here, I wonder？
translations.んー、不思議。そばにいるとリラックスできる気がする。:
Hmm, it's funny. Just being
near it makes me feel relaxed.
translations.なんでリラックスできるんだろ。形？ 色？:
Why is it so relaxing？
The shape？ The color？
translations.ふふ。ほら、あなたもリラックスしちゃお？:
Fufu. Come on, why don't you
relax a little too？
translations.はあ～……深呼吸したら落ち着けるよ。ほら、あなたも。:
*Sigh*... Taking a deep
breath really calms you down.
Here, you try too.
translations.こうしてると、面倒なこと全部忘れちゃうね……。:
When we're like this,
I forget all the annoying stuff...
translations.私と二人のときくらい、のーんびりしてほしいな。:
When it's just the two of us,
I want you to really
kick back and relax.
translations.なんだか懐かしい気がするな、ここ。:
This place feels kind of
nostalgic somehow.
translations.ここに来るとね、懐かしい気分になっちゃうの。:
Whenever I come here,
I get this nostalgic feeling.
translations.なんだろう、安心できる。親近感……っていうのかな。:
It's so comforting, somehow.
Like a sense of familiarity,
I guess？
translations.親近感のわく場所って、なんだか不思議……。:
It's funny how a place can
feel so familiar...
translations.ねえねえ、これって、なんとなく私のイメージに合わない？:
Hey, don't you think this
fits my vibe somehow？
translations.んー、なんだろう。この他人とは思えない感覚……。:
Hmm, what is this feeling...
Like I've known it forever.
translations.前世ではこういうところに一緒に住んでたとか。:
Maybe we lived somewhere
like this in a past life？
translations.ねえ、あなたもここにいると落ち着く？:
Hey, do you feel at ease
here too？
translations.実はね、私もなの。どうしてかな。:
Actually, me too.
I wonder why？
translations.んー、なんだか新発見がありそう！:
Hmm, feels like we might
discover something new!
translations.ねえねえ、何か面白いことないかな。:
Hey, hey. Think there's
anything fun around here？
translations.今日はね、何かが起きそうな気がします。なーんてね、ただの思いつき。:
I have a feeling something's
gonna happen today!
Just kidding, just a thought.
translations.ふふ。どうしてこんなにワクワクしてるのかな。:
Fufu. Why am I so excited,
I wonder？
translations.ねえ、これって……うーん、何か起きそう。:
Hey, isn't this... Hmm,
feels like something's
about to happen.
translations.ふふ、なんだか面白そう。: Fufu, this looks kind of fun.
translations.あなたとのデートのときってね……。:
Whenever I'm on a date
with you, you know...
translations.いつも、何か新しいことが起きるんじゃないかなーって気分になるの。:
I always feel like something
new is bound to happen.
translations.やっぱりあなたと一緒だと、周りの物がなんでも新鮮に感じちゃう。:
When I'm with you, everything
around us just feels so fresh.
translations.そういうことって、ないかな。: Don't you ever feel that way？
translations.あ、すごいすごい！ ……はしゃぎすぎ？:
Ah, wow, look at that!
...Am I getting too excited？
translations.ふふ。なんだかワクワクしてきちゃった。:
Fufu. I'm starting to get
really excited.
translations.実は今、結構盛り上がってます。ふふふ♪:
Truth is, I'm actually pretty
hyped right now. Fufufu♪
translations.え、ねえねえ。これすごい！:
Wait, look, look!
This is amazing!
translations.ふふ、叫んじゃった♪:
Fufu, I got carried away
and shouted♪
translations.ねえ、今日の私、はしゃいでない？:
Hey, am I acting a little
too hyper today？
translations.大丈夫ならいいの、ふふ♪:
As long as it's okay with you,
then I'm glad. Fufu♪
translations.ねえねえ、ここって何か、面白い噂とかないのかな。:
Hey, hey... isn't there any
interesting rumor about
this place？
translations.んー、ここって何かがありそうじゃない？:
Hmm, feels like there's
gotta be something here,
don't you think？
translations.私は今、目がキラキラしちゃってます。:
My eyes are sparkling
with excitement right now.
translations.ん？ 何かな何かな？:
Hm？ I wonder what it is,
what could it be～？
translations.これ、なんなのかなあ……。:
I wonder what this is
supposed to be...
translations.私が子供みたいに純粋になれるのって……。:
You know, getting to be
innocent like a kid...
translations.やっぱりあなたが隣にいるときだけみたい。:
...I guess it only happens
when you're right by my side.
translations.ねえねえ、あれって何かな……。:
Hey, hey, what do you think
that is over there...？
translations.調べてみようか、もちろん、一緒に。:
Shall we check it out？
Together, of course.
translations.ここって、何があるのかな？:
I wonder what kind of stuff
they have around here？
translations.へえ、こういうところなんだ。:
Huh, so this is what
a place like this is like.
translations.……え？ ううん、楽しいよ。:
...Hm？ No, I'm having
plenty of fun.
translations.ほら、無邪気に遊んじゃってもいいんだよ？:
Come on, it's okay to let loose
and play around, you know？
translations.これは……なんなのかな。:
What on earth...
could this be？
translations.そうじゃないよ、すごく楽しい。ゆっくりかみしめてるだけだから。:
That's not it, I'm having
a wonderful time. I'm just
savoring every moment.
translations.あなたとのデートって……。:
Dates with you...
they really are...
translations.うん、やっぱりいいな。: Yeah, they really are the best.
translations.うーん……なんだか不思議な場所ね。:
Hmm... It's kind of
a curious place, isn't it.
translations.なんだろう、ちょっと違和感を感じるところね。:
I don't know why, but something
feels a little off here.
translations.んー……さっきから、なんとなく違和感が……。:
Hmm... Something's felt
a little off for a while now...
translations.なんだか今日の私、感覚が冴えてる気がするの。:
I feel like my senses are
especially sharp today.
translations.これって……なにかな、不思議……。:
What is this...？
It's so strange...
translations.たまにね……ふと思うの。:
Sometimes, you know...
the thought just hits me.
translations.こうやって二人でいるのって、すごいことだなって。ふふ、おかしいかな。:
Just how amazing it is that
we're together like this.
Fufu, is that silly？
translations.あなたとこんな場所にいるのって……。:
Being in a place like this
with you...
translations.ここ……ちょっと落ち着かないね。:
It's kind of hard to settle down
here, isn't it.
translations.あのね。ここにいると、ソワソワしちゃうの。:
You know... being here
makes me feel all restless.
translations.ん、今日はちょっと落ち着かなくて。:
Yeah, I'm just feeling
a little restless today.
translations.うん、少しね。緊張してるの。:
Yeah, a little.
I'm actually nervous.
translations.あなたと一緒にいるのなんて、当たり前のことなのに。:
Even though being with you
should feel totally natural...
translations.今でもたまに、緊張することもあって……おかしいかな。:
I still get nervous sometimes,
even now... Is that silly？
translations.あなたを見てたら、ちょっとドキドキしちゃって。:
Just looking at you made
my heart flutter a little.
translations.ふふふ。やっぱりここ、面白い。:
Hehehe. I knew it,
this place is so fun.
translations.おかしな場所……そんな感じしない？:
Kind of a weird place...
Don't you think？
translations.ふふ。やだ、ごめん、思い出し笑いだから。:
Hehe. Oh no, sorry,
I just remembered
something funny.
translations.んー♪ ふふ、たのしーい。:
Mmm♪ Hehe,
this is so fun~
translations.なにこれ！ 面白いね？:
What is this!
Pretty neat, huh？
translations.……ううん、やっぱりふたりだと楽しいね。:
...Mm, it really is
more fun together.
translations.もう、あなたといると、ずっと笑顔になっちゃう。:
Geez, whenever I'm with you,
I just can't stop smiling.
translations.……ずーっとそうだと、いいな。:
...I hope it stays like this
forever.
translations.ここにいると、元気になれる気がするな……。:
Being here really gives me
energy, I feel like...
translations.うん、パワーがもらえる場所な気がする。:
Yeah, feels like a place
that recharges you.
translations.はい。元気元気、です。:
Yep! Full of energy,
that's me~
translations.なんだろ。いい感じ。:
I don't know what it is,
but it feels nice.
translations.あなたと一緒に出かけるとね……。:
Whenever I go out
with you...
translations.こう、気持ちがスカッとするの！ ふふ♪:
It just totally clears
my head! Hehe♪
translations.やっぱり、あなたからたくさん元気もらってるな。:
I really get so much
energy from you.
translations.私も、ちゃんと元気あげられてる？:
Do I give you
energy too, I wonder？
translations.私達は、今ここで一番幸せなカップル……よね、きっと。:
We must be the happiest
couple here right now...
right？
translations.ステキな場所……つれてきてくれて、ありがとう。:
Such a wonderful place...
Thank you for bringing me.
translations.こんなにステキなカレシとデートができて、幸せ者です♪:
On a date with such a
wonderful boyfriend...
I'm one lucky girl♪
translations.すごい……。いいのかな、こんなに楽しくて。:
Amazing...
Is it really okay to have
this much fun？
translations.ふふ、おもしろい。ね、ありがとう。:
Hehe, so fun.
Hey, thank you.
translations.私ね、あなたと一緒にいるとね、誇らしい気持ちになるの。:
You know, being with you
makes me feel so proud.
translations.私って、きっと世界一幸せなカノジョだよね。:
I must be the happiest
girlfriend in the world.
translations.そうでしょ、世界一幸せなカレシさん？:
Don't you think so,
happiest boyfriend
in the world？
translations.いいのかな、こんな場所にいて。:
Is it really okay for us
to be here？
translations.……あ、ごめんね。ちょっと不安で。:
...Ah, sorry.
I got a little nervous.
translations.デートが楽しすぎると、ちょっぴり不安になっちゃうことってない？:
When a date's this fun,
don't you ever get
a little anxious？
translations.どうしてかな……楽しいまま続くに決まってるのにね。:
Why is that, I wonder...
When obviously the fun's
just gonna keep going.
translations.うん、びっくりしちゃって。:
Yeah, it just took me
by surprise.
translations.ちょっと驚いただけ……。: I just got a little startled...
translations.こんなところに、連れて来てくれるなんて……。:
To think you'd bring me
to a place like this...
translations.少し、びっくりしちゃった。:
I was a little caught
off guard.
translations.ねえ、ここって少し……怖くない？:
Hey, isn't this place
a little... scary？
translations.うん……怖いけど、大丈夫。……たぶん。:
Yeah... I'm scared,
but I'll be okay. ...Probably.
translations.……ちょっと、イヤな予感がする。:
...I have a bad feeling
about this.
translations.ん……大丈夫かなあ……。:
Mm... I wonder if
we'll be okay...
translations.何かありそうで、怖い気がして……。:
I feel like something's
gonna happen, it's scary...
translations.ねえ。少し怖くて……。:
Hey. I'm getting kind of
scared...
translations.だって、あなたが隣にいてくれるんだもん。:
'Cause I've got you right
here next to me.
translations.ねえ、この先って何があるのかな？:
Hey, what do you think
is up ahead？
translations.ふふ、どこに向かってるのかな～♪:
Hehe, where are we
heading, I wonder~♪
translations.楽しみだね。ふふ、待ち遠しい。:
I can't wait. Hehe,
I'm so looking forward to it.
translations.移動中もお散歩って考えれば、退屈しないね。:
If we treat the walk like a
stroll, it's not boring at all.
translations.ゆっくり歩くのって、いいね。:
Taking a slow stroll like this
is really nice.
translations.ん、退屈じゃないよ？ だって、あなたが一緒だもん。:
Mm, I'm not bored at all？
After all, you're with me.
translations.カレシとカノジョが一緒に歩いてれば、それだけでデートでしょ？:
As long as a couple walks
together, that's already
a date, right？
translations.あなたと並んで歩いてると……絵になったりするのかな。ふふ。:
Walking side by side with you...
I wonder if we make a nice
picture. Hehe.
translations.ふふ、楽しいね♪ このままでもいいかも。:
Hehe, this is fun♪
I wouldn't mind if we just
kept walking like this.
translations.今の私達って、いい感じじゃない？ 恋人以上……夫婦に見られちゃったりして。:
Don't we look great together？
More than lovers... We might
even pass for husband and wife!
translations.ふふ、あーんしてあげよっか。:
Hehe, want me to feed you？
Say 'aah'!
translations.二人一緒だと、食事も楽しいね。:
Eating together like this
makes it so much more fun.
translations.ねえ……一緒に暮らしたら、いつもこんな感じなのかな……とかね。:
Hey... If we lived together,
I wonder if it'd always feel
like this... Just a thought.
translations.やっぱり長く一緒にいるには、楽しく食事ができるって大切なことよね。:
Being able to enjoy our meals
is really important if we're
gonna be together long-term.
translations.あれかわいい～、買っちゃおっかなあ。:
That's so cute~!
Maybe I should get it...
translations.んー、どうしよっかな。あなたは何か欲しいものある？:
Hmm, what should I do？
Is there anything you want？
translations.ふふ、目移りしちゃうね。:
Hehe, so many things,
I can't make up my mind.
translations.二人の記念品買っちゃおうか……それは今度でもいいかな。:
Should we get a souvenir
for both of us...?
...Or maybe next time？
translations.あなたには何がいいかな～。:
I wonder what would be
nice for you~
translations.ねえ、何か選んでくれる？:
Hey, could you pick
something out for me？
translations.将来は、こうやって毎日二人で買い物したり……。:
In the future, maybe we'll
go shopping like this
every day...
translations.もう、あなたと一緒だと、ついつい無駄遣いしちゃいそう。ちゃんと止めてね。:
Geez, when I'm with you,
I end up spending too much.
Make sure to stop me, okay？
translations.ねえねえ！ あれってなんていうんだっけ。:
Hey, hey!
What was that called again？
translations.色々ありそう……もっと見て回ろ？:
Looks like there's a lot...
Let's explore some more？
translations.この土地ならではのご飯って、何があるかな。:
Wonder what kind of local
specialties they have here？
translations.ふふ、周り切れるかな……。:
Hehe, I wonder if we'll
make it around everywhere...
translations.他に観光スポットは……っと。:
Any other sights to see...
Let's check.
translations.ねえ、私に任せきりにしてない？ ちゃーんと調べてこなきゃダメだよ。:
Hey, you aren't leaving it
all to me, are you？
You gotta do research too!
translations.知らない街を二人で歩くのって……ステキ。:
Walking through a new town
together... It's so lovely.
translations.あれ……ここって……ねえ、どっちに行けばいいの？:
Wait... Is this...？
Hey, which way should we go？
translations.このままここに住んじゃいたいくらい……よね。:
I could almost live here...
Don't you think？
translations.周りに知ってる人もいないし、もっとラブラブしてもいいんじゃない？:
No one around knows us,
so why not get a little
more lovey-dovey？
translations.私、もう少し見て周りたいな。いい？:
I'd like to look around
a little more. Okay with you？
translations.このあたりって、他に何があるのかなあ。:
I wonder what else there is
around here.
translations.もうちょっと散策してみる？:
Want to wander around
a little more？
translations.ふたりだったら何か遊べることあるかな。:
Wonder if there's anything
fun the two of us could do？
translations.退屈してない？ 何か相手しよっか。:
Bored at all？
Want me to keep you company？
translations.ステキな時間……ゆっくり流れるといいね。:
Such a lovely time...
If only time would slow down.
translations.のんびりできたね。……幸せなひととき、ね。:
That was so relaxing.
...Such a blissful time, huh.
translations.ただ歩いてるだけでも、きっと楽しいよ。:
Just walking together
is sure to be fun.
translations.歩いてれば、何か見つかるんじゃないかな。:
If we keep walking,
I bet we'll find something.
translations.もうちょっと、歩いてみよっか。:
Shall we walk
just a little more？
translations.この景色も、結構好きかな。:
I actually like this view
quite a bit.
translations.うん、話し相手だったら、いつでもどうぞ。:
Yep! If you want to chat,
I'm all yours.
translations.何も考えずに歩いてるだけでも……お互いの考えてること、なんとなくわかる気がするな:
Even just walking like this,
I feel like we know what
the other's thinking.
translations.楽しい時間だったけど、終わっちゃうのよね。また、散歩したいな。:
It was so fun, but it's
already over.
Let's go for a walk again.
translations.ふふ、楽しそう。きっと満足できると思うな。:
Hehe, looks fun!
I'm sure we'll love it.
translations.混んでないといいね、どうなのかな……。:
Hope it's not too crowded...
I wonder what it's like.
translations.ここの評判って聞いてる？ きっと楽しいと思うけど。:
Heard the word about this
place？ I bet it'll be
lots of fun, though.
translations.ふふ、楽しかった！ あなたも？:
Hehe, that was fun!
Did you like it too？
translations.そっか、こんな感じなんだ。:
Ah, so this is what it's
like.
translations.あなたと一緒でよかった。一人だと、楽しくても、寂しいもん。:
I'm glad I'm with you.
Even if it's fun,
being alone is just lonely.
translations.周りのカップルと、どっちがラブラブかな？:
I wonder who's more
lovey-dovey, us or the
other couples around us？
translations.やっぱりこういうのは、二人で楽しまないとね。:
Things like this are really
best enjoyed together, huh？
translations.ねえねえ。もっと遊んでもいいかな、楽しかったんだもん。:
Hey, hey. Can we play more？
It was just so much fun.
translations.はあ、大満足。また遊びたいな。:
Haah, so satisfied.
I definitely want to come
play again.
translations.色々あって目移りしちゃうなー。:
There's so much to see,
I don't know where to look~
translations.このあたり、もっと自然があってもいいのかもね。:
Maybe this area could use
a little more nature, huh？
translations.ん？ よさそうなお店、見つけた？:
Hmm？ Did you find
a good shop？
translations.あ、あのお店。よさそうじゃない？:
Oh, that shop over there.
Doesn't it look nice？
translations.みんな忙しそうにしてるね。私達はのんびりしよ。:
Everyone looks so busy.
Let's just take it easy.
translations.んー……ふふ、自然とキョロキョロしちゃう。:
Hmm... Hehe, I can't help
looking all around.
translations.今は人、少ないね。これはこれで、いいかな。:
Not many people right now.
This is nice in its own way.
translations.少し静か……人が少ないのかな。:
It's a little quiet...
Are there not many people？
translations.人が多いね。なんだか楽しそう。:
There's a lot of people.
Looks pretty lively!
translations.やっぱりこのあたりは賑やかだね。:
This area really is lively,
isn't it？
translations.水平線……ちゃんと見える？:
The horizon...
Can you see it clearly？
translations.海の近くはやっぱり風が気持ちいいね。:
The breeze by the sea really
feels so nice, doesn't it？
translations.潮の香り、するかな……。:
I wonder if we can smell
the sea breeze...？
translations.やっぱり海ってキレイだね……ほら。:
The sea really is pretty...
Look.
translations.海は広いな……あ、歌ったわけじゃないからね。:
The sea is so vast...
Oh, I wasn't singing that,
okay？
translations.船……見えないかな。:
Can we spot any ships,
I wonder...？
translations.人少ないね……海を独り占め、かな。:
Hardly anyone's here...
Feels like we have the sea
all to ourselves.
translations.意外に人がいないね。もったいないな。:
Surprisingly few people.
What a waste.
translations.やっぱり人が多いね、海だもん。:
Sure are a lot of people.
Well, it is the sea.
translations.人、たくさんいるね。海、汚れないといいな。:
There's so many people.
Hope the sea stays clean.
translations.水辺だからかな、空気が気持ちいい気がする。:
Maybe because we're by the
water, but the air feels so
refreshing.
translations.水面に映った景色も……ステキよね。:
The scenery reflected on
the water is lovely too,
isn't it？
translations.ねえ、お魚いないかな。:
Hey, wonder if there are
any fish？
translations.空気が湿ってる感じがする……。:
The air feels kind of
damp...
translations.水の匂いって、あるよね。:
Water has its own scent,
doesn't it？
translations.あっ……何かはねた気がするんだけど。:
Oh... I think I just saw
something splash.
translations.人少ないね。いい場所なのに。:
Hardly anyone's here.
Even though it's such a nice
spot.
translations.あんまり人いないね。静か……。:
Not many people around.
It's so quiet...
translations.人多いね……人類は水辺に集まるのです。ふふ。:
So many people... Humankind
always gathers by the water.
Hehe.
translations.人がたくさん。みんな水辺に集まってきてる。:
So many people. Everyone's
gathering by the water.
translations.空気がおいしい～……ほら、深呼吸。:
The air is so fresh~...
Come on, take a deep breath.
translations.こんな風に自然に囲まれるのって、やっぱりステキ。:
Being surrounded by nature
like this really is lovely.
translations.ん……虫、いないといいね。:
Mm... I just hope there
aren't too many bugs.
translations.この自然、長く残ってくれるといいね。:
I hope all this nature stays
like this for a long time.
translations.こうやって自然に囲まれてると若返る気がするな～……。:
Being out in nature like this
makes me feel young again~...
translations.うん、やっぱり人少ない。……落ち着くなあ。:
Yeah, hardly anyone here.
...It's so relaxing.
translations.あんまり人がいなくてよかったね。自然を満喫できるよ。:
I'm glad there aren't many
people. We can really soak in
all this nature.
translations.人多いんだ。やっぱりみんな自然を求めてるんだね。:
There's so many people.
I guess everyone's craving
a bit of nature.
translations.もう少し静かだったら、もっとよかったかもね。:
It might've been even nicer
if it were a little quieter.
translations.んー、景色、あんまり見えないね。:
Mm, you can't really see
the view, can you？
translations.なんだか暗いな……大丈夫？:
It's kind of dark...
You doing okay？
translations.明かりが少ないね……大丈夫、怖くないよ。:
Not a lot of light here...
Don't worry, I'm not scared.
translations.暗くてちょっと怖い……。:
It's so dark... It's a little
spooky, honestly.
translations.ここ、ちょっと暗いね……。:
It's a bit dim
around here...
translations.照明落としてるのかな……。:
I wonder if they dimmed
the lights...
translations.薄暗いね……怖くはないよ。:
It's pretty dim...
Not that I'm scared
or anything.
translations.ちょっと暗いね。ほら、顔見えるように、近くに来て。:
It's a little dark. Here,
come closer so I can see
your face.
translations.ねえ、手つないでいい？ だって、暗いから……。:
Hey, can I hold your hand？
I mean, since it's dark...
translations.陽が強いね……。:
The sun is pretty strong
today...
translations.んー……紫外線、大丈夫かなあ。:
Mmm... I hope the UV rays
aren't too bad.
translations.日差しが強いと、お肌がね……女の子は大変なんです。:
Harsh sun is so bad for your
skin... Being a girl is hard
work, you know？
translations.なんだか明るくてキレイな場所だね。:
It's so bright and pretty
around here.
translations.なんだろう、色合いが……照明のせいかな？:
What's with the colors...？
Maybe it's the lighting？
translations.こんなに明るくしてるんだ……。:
They really keep it bright
in here, don't they...
translations.見て、照明がキラキラしてる……。:
Look, the lighting is all
sparkly...
translations.んっ、ちょっと照明がきついね……。:
Ugh, the lights are
a bit harsh in here...
translations.思ったより、広くないんだね。: It's not as big as I thought.
translations.ここだったら、すぐ周れちゃうかな。:
We could probably walk
this whole place in no time.
translations.えっと……どこまで行っていいのかな。:
Um... How far are we allowed
to go, I wonder？
translations.……なんだか、圧迫感がある場所だね。:
...It feels a little cramped
in here, doesn't it？
translations.あ、中はこんなに狭いんだね。:
Oh, it's pretty small
inside, isn't it？
translations.ふーん、そんなに広くないんだね。: Huh, it's really not that big.
translations.ここなら、すぐに一周できちゃうね。:
We could make a full lap
around here in no time.
translations.少しだけ、窮屈なところだね。:
It's just a little tight in
here, isn't it.
translations.んー、ちょっと圧迫感、感じちゃうかも。:
Mmm, feels a bit confining,
doesn't it？
translations.広いね……ぐるっと見渡せちゃう。:
It's so wide open... You can
see all the way around.
translations.ん～、空間が広くて気持ちいい。:
Mmh, it's so open and
spacious. Feels nice.
translations.このあたり、どこまで行けるかな。:
Wonder how far we can
go around here.
translations.うーん……開放感があるね。:
Mmm... It really feels
so open and airy.
translations.見渡す限り……って感じかな。:
Feels like 'as far as the
eye can see,' doesn't it？
translations.ふふ。見て回るの大変そう。:
Hehe. Checking it all out
is gonna take some work.
translations.広くて気持ちいい場所ね。:
It's nice and open here.
Feels wonderful.
translations.建物の中なのに、開放感があるね。:
Even though we're inside,
it feels really open.
translations.ぐるーって見て回ろっか。:
Wanna take a walk
all the way around？
translations.さて、今日はどこに連れて行ってくれるの？:
Now then, where are you
taking me today？
translations.今日のデートは、どこに行くのかな。:
Wonder where we're off to
for our date today.
translations.さあ、デートのはじまりはじまり～♪:
All right, let the date
begin~♪
translations.今日のデートも楽しくなるよね、きっと。:
Today's date is gonna be
so much fun, I just know it.
translations.これから行く場所は～？ 秘密なの？:
Where are we heading now~？
Is it a secret？
translations.今日のデート、楽しみにしてたんだよ。:
I was really looking forward
to our date today, you know.
translations.デート。あなたもちゃーんと楽しみにしてた？:
Our date. Were you looking
forward to it too？
translations.そろそろ行こっか。しゅっぱーつ。:
Shall we get going？
Aaaand off we go!
translations.のんびりしてると、置いて行っちゃうよ？:
If you take too long,
I'm gonna leave you behind~
translations.ここってすっごく評判なんだよ。ちゃんと調べたんだ？:
This place has great reviews!
Did you look it up？
translations.あ、ここ来たかったんだ♪ えらいえらい。:
Ah, I wanted to come here♪
Good boy, good boy.
translations.ステキ……ふふ、ここに来たかったんだ。:
Lovely... Hehe, I really
wanted to come here.
translations.ここって面白いみたい。うんうん、合格かな。:
This place looks fun.
Yep, yep, you pass!
translations.ここ、最近評判ってウワサ。ちょっと来てみたかったんだ。:
Rumor has it this place is
really popular lately.
I kinda wanted to come see it.
translations.あ、いいね。ここで遊ぶんだ。:
Oh, nice! So this is where
we're having our fun.
translations.ここ？ うん、楽しくなるといいね。:
Here？ Yeah, let's hope
it turns out fun!
translations.あ、こんなところもあるんだ。どんな感じなのかな。:
Oh, there's a place like this
too？ Wonder what it's like.
translations.んー、あまり評判は聞かないけど。楽しいのかな。:
Hmm, haven't heard much
about it, though.
Wonder if it's fun.
translations.あ、またここなんだ。うん、いいよ。:
Oh, here again？
Sure, works for me.
translations.ここか……そういえば、前にも来たよね。:
Here, huh... Come to think
of it, we've been here before.
translations.ねえねえ、次はどこに行くの？:
Hey, hey, where are we
going next？
translations.移動する？ さて、どこに行こうかな……。:
Ready to move？ Now then,
where should we go...
translations.それじゃあ、次のところに行こ？:
Well then, shall we head to
the next spot？
translations.じゃあ……そろそろ移動しよっか。:
Well... shall we get moving
around now？
translations.次はどこにエスコートしてくれるのかな？:
Where are you gonna escort
me next, I wonder？
translations.ねえねえ、どっちに行くの？:
Hey, hey, which way
are we going？
translations.えっと……どっちに行くのがいいかな。:
Um... I wonder which way
we should go.
translations.んーどっちかな……任せた！:
Hmm, which one...
I'll leave it to you!
translations.今度はどっちにしようか？:
Which way should we go
this time？
translations.うーん、迷っちゃうね。:
Mmm, it's so hard
to choose.
translations.さて、今度はどうしよっか。:
Now then, what should
we do next？
translations.次はね……うーん……うーん……はい、パス。:
Next is... hmm...
hmm... Okay, pass!
translations.ねえねえ、どっちに行くか決めていい？ えっとね、こっち。:
Hey, can I choose which
way to go？ Let's see...
This way!
translations.さて……じゃあ、あっちにしよっか。:
All right...
Let's go that way, then.
translations.さてと。次は私が決めるね。うん、あっちにしよ。:
Now then. I'll pick this
time. Yep, let's go
over there.
translations.あれ、さっきもそっちに行ったよね。いいけど。:
Wait, didn't we just
go that way？
I don't mind, though.
translations.あ、またそっちに行くの？ はーい。:
Oh, going that way again？
Okaaay.
translations.ふう、ステキなデートだったね。ありがとう、カレシのおかげ▼:
Phew, that was such a
wonderful date. Thanks,
all thanks to my boyfriend▼
translations.んー、やっぱり楽しかった♪ 次はもっと楽しく……ね、ふふ。:
Mmm, that was so fun♪
Next time will be even
better... right？ Hehe.
translations.うん、今日のデートも満足でした。よしよし。:
Yep, today's date was
so satisfying. Good boy.
translations.がんばりやのカレシのおかげで、楽しいデートになりました。:
Thanks to my hardworking
boyfriend, we had such
a wonderful date.
translations.はぁ……楽しかった♪ 絶対、またデートしようね。:
Phew... that was fun♪
We definitely have to
go out again, okay？
translations.んー……余韻にひたっちゃうくらい、満足なデートでした。:
Mmm... That was so nice,
I'm still basking in
the afterglow.
translations.お疲れ様。疲れちゃった？ また誘ってね。:
Thanks for today.
Are you tired？
Ask me out again, okay？
translations.ん～、うん、楽しかった。またデートしようね。:
Mmm, yeah, that was fun.
Let's go on another
date soon, okay？
translations.感想？ うん、楽しかったよ。:
My thoughts？
Yeah, I had fun.
translations.なんだかあっという間のデートだったね。またしたいな。:
That date just flew by,
didn't it？ I'd love
to do it again.
translations.あれ……そっか、もう終わりか。もっとたっぷりのデートでもよかったかな。:
Huh... Wait, it's over
already？ A longer date
might've been nice, too.
translations.あ、もうデート終わり？ んー、楽しかった♪:
Ah, the date's over
already？ Mmm, that
was fun, though♪
translations.うん、楽しかった。デートはこのくらいの長さがちょうどいいね。:
Yeah, that was fun.
This length is just right
for a date, isn't it？
translations.遊んだ遊んだ。これ以上だと疲れちゃうかも。:
We really had fun!
Any more and I might've
worn myself out.
translations.デートはやっぱりこのくらいのボリュームが好きだな。短すぎず、長すぎず、ね。:
I really like dates
around this length.
Not too short, not too
long, you know？
translations.はあ……もう、遊び倒しちゃったね。疲れなかった？:
Whew... We really played
our hearts out!
Did you get tired？
translations.デートしゅうりょー！ たっぷり遊んじゃったね。:
Date over~!
We really had our fill
of fun, didn't we？
translations.ふう……お疲れ様。たくさんデートできて、楽しかったね。:
Phew... Thanks for today.
We packed so much in,
that was lots of fun.
translations.デート、楽しかったね。今日のところは前にも行ったし、次は別の場所でもいいかな……:
That was fun. We've been
to that spot before though,
so maybe somewhere else
next time...？
translations.今日のデートって、前と同じところだった？ ううん、気になっただけ。:
Was today's date the same
place as before？
No, just wondering.
translations.●。実はいいデートスポット見つけたんだけど……今から行ける？:
●. I actually found
a great date spot...
Can you go right now？
translations.今から？ せっかちなんだ。いいけど、支度があるから少し待ってね。:
Right now？ Aren't you
impatient？ Sure, but give
me a minute to get ready.
translations.やった、了解。じゃあ、また後で。:
Awesome, got it.
See you in a bit.
translations.●だけど……良さそうなデートコース考えたんだよね。良かったら、今からどう？:
It's ●... I came up
with a nice date plan.
Up for it right now？
translations.うん、オッケー。ちょうど時間空いてたの。すぐ支度するね。:
Yeah, sure! I actually
have some free time.
I'll get ready right away.
translations.ラッキー。じゃあ、後で。待ってるから。:
Lucky! See you in a bit.
I'll be waiting.
translations.もしもし、寧々だよ。どんな用事？:
Hello, Nene here.
What's going on？
translations.あのさ、いいデートスポット見つけたから誘おうと思って。今から大丈夫？:
Hey, I found a great date
spot and wanted to invite
you. Are you free now？
translations.今からか……うん、大丈夫。急いで準備しちゃう。:
Right now...？ Yeah, I can.
I'll hurry and get ready.
translations.ありがと、ゆっくりでいいよ。じゃあ。:
Thanks, take your time.
Talk to you soon.
translations.ねえねえ、お弁当持って来たんだけど……食べる？:
Hey, I brought us lunch...
Wanna have some？
translations.急いで用意したから……ちゃんとできてるといいけど。:
I threw it together
in a rush, though...
Hope it turned out okay.
translations.あ、そうだ。急だったけど……一応お弁当作ってきたんだ。どうかな？:
Oh, right. It was sudden,
but I packed us lunch.
What do you think？
translations.ふふ。お口に合うといいけど。:
Hehe. Hope it suits
your taste.
translations.合うに決まってるって！:
Are you kidding？
Of course I'll love it!
translations.ふふ。あのね、お弁当持ってきたよ。食べてくれるとうれしいんだけどなあ？:
Hehe. Guess what？ I packed
us lunch. I'd be so happy
if you ate some...？
translations.そんなに喜んじゃって。かわいい。:
Look at you getting all
excited. You're so cute.
translations.はは。そりゃ喜ぶって！: Haha. How could I not be？
translations.あ、もしもし。私だけど、今話せる？:
Oh, hello. It's me.
Can you talk right now？
translations.ああ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 大丈夫だよ。:
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah, I can talk.
translations.あのね、今日なんだけど……晩ご飯作るから、私の家で一緒に食べない？:
So, about today...
I'm cooking dinner, so want
to come eat at my place？
translations.よかった。だったら今日は先に帰って準備してるから、あとで来てね？:
Great! Then I'll head home
first to get things ready.
Come over later, okay？
translations.ほんと？ よかった♪ じゃあ準備して待ってるから、またあとでね。:
Really？ Yay♪
I'll get everything ready,
so see you in a bit.
translations.ああ、楽しみにしてる。:
Yeah, I'm looking forward
to it.
translations.そうなんだ……それじゃ残念だけど、また次の機会ね。:
Oh, I see... That's a shame,
but next time for sure,
okay？
translations.そういえば、私の家でご飯食べてもらうのって初めてじゃない？:
Come to think of it,
isn't this the first time
you've eaten at my place？
translations.そうだっけ。なんか……ドキドキするな。:
Was that so？ I'm starting
to get a little nervous...
translations.今日はゆっくりしていってね。:
Make yourself at home
tonight, okay？
translations.あのね、最近覚えた料理を食べてもらいたくて……それにするね♪:
There's a new dish I learned
recently that I wanted you
to try... So I'll make that♪
translations.私のほうでも一応メニューは考えてるけど、リクエストがあれば受け付けるよ？:
I've got a menu in mind,
but if you have a request,
I'm taking orders？
translations.そう？ だったら……最近覚えた料理があるから、それにするね。:
Oh yeah？ In that case...
I learned a new dish recently,
so I'll make that.
translations.いいの？ じゃあ、あなたが好きそうなもの考えて作るね。:
You sure？ Then I'll whip up
something I think you'll like.
translations.じゃあ、▲メニュー▲をリクエストしようかな。:
Then I think I'll request
▲メニュー▲.
translations.はーい、お待ちどうさま。自信作だから、期待してね♪:
Here you go, thanks for
waiting! It's one of my best,
so prepare to be amazed♪
translations.お待たせ。今回は、まあまあの出来かな？:
Thanks for waiting!
I think it turned out
pretty decent this time？
translations.待たせちゃってごめんね。少し失敗しちゃったかもしれないけど……。:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
I might've messed up
a little, though...
translations.ちょっと新しいのに挑戦したんだよ。どうかな？:
I tried something a bit new.
What do you think？
translations.今日の料理は私なりのアレンジを加えてるの。他とはひと味違うよ♪:
I put my own spin on
today's dish. It's got
a flavor all its own♪
translations.ねえ、ちょっと自己流のアレンジを加えてるのわかる？:
Hey, can you tell I added
my own little twist？
translations.これ、ちょっとアレンジしたの。レシピ通りもいいけど、私らしさも出したいから。:
I tweaked this a bit.
Following the recipe is fine,
but I wanted to add
my own personal touch.
translations.今日の料理はちょっとひと手間加わってるんだよ♪:
I put a little extra effort
into today's dish, you know♪
translations.私流のアレンジ料理、気に入ってくれるといいんだけど。:
I hope you like my special
take on it.
translations.私ね、和食は自信あるんだよ。:
You know, Japanese food is
definitely my specialty.
translations.和食なら、学校でも誰にも負けない自信あるかな♪:
When it comes to Japanese
cooking, I won't lose to anyone
at school♪
translations.私ね、和食の味付けは得意なの。きっと美味しいと思うよ？:
I'm really good at seasoning
Japanese food. I'm sure
you'll love it？
translations.自分で言うのもなんだけど……洋食作るのは結構得意かな？:
Not to toot my own horn, but...
I'm pretty good at making
Western food, you know？
translations.私、洋食屋さん開けそうかな？ ふふ♪:
Think I could open my own
Western diner？ Fufu♪
translations.私の作った洋食を食べたら、もう他のは食べられなくなっちゃうんだから♪:
Once you taste my Western
cooking, nothing else will
ever compare♪
translations.中華なら自信があるの。あなたにも美味しいって言ってもらえると思うな。:
I'm really confident with
Chinese food. I bet you'll
think it's delicious, too.
translations.私、中華料理の味付けには自信あるの。結構テクニックがいるのよ？:
I'm really confident with
Chinese seasoning. It takes
quite a bit of technique,
you know？
translations.中華料理なら私に任せて♪:
Just leave the Chinese food
to me♪
translations.このタイプの料理は得意なの。結構やるでしょ？ ふふ。:
I'm good at this sort of
cooking. Not bad, huh？ Fufu.
translations.最近、こういう料理を作るのが好きなの。きっと美味しいよ？:
I've really enjoyed making
this kind of food lately.
I'm sure you'll love it？
translations.色々勉強してたら、こういう料理が得意になってきたの。どう？:
After studying different
recipes, I've gotten pretty
good at this. How is it？
translations.どんな料理でも任せてくれていいよ♪ あなたに美味しいって言わせる自信はあるの▼:
You can leave any kind of
cooking to me♪ I'm sure I'll
make you say it's delicious▼
translations.最近はなんでも作れるようになってきたの。すごいでしょ？:
I can make pretty much
anything these days.
Impressive, right？
translations.どう？ なんでも作れちゃうカノジョって、嬉しいでしょ▼:
So？ Aren't you lucky to have
a girlfriend who can cook
anything▼
translations.和食って少し加減が違うだけで、全然ダメになっちゃうから……。どうかな？:
Japanese food can go wrong
with the slightest slip...
How did it turn out？
translations.和食を作るときは特別丁寧さを心がけてるんだけど……なかなか難しくて。:
I try to be extra careful
with Japanese food...
but it's pretty tricky.
translations.あなた好みの和食を作りたいのに……なかなか上手くいかなくて。でも、頑張ったから食:
I want to make it to your
taste, but it's hard to get
right. I tried my best,
so will you give it a try？
translations.洋食の味付けってどこにポイントがあるんだろう？ 物足りなかったら言ってね。:
I wonder what the secret is
to seasoning Western food...
Let me know if it's lacking,
okay？
translations.私ね、じつは洋食作るのちょっと苦手で……。だけどあなたに喜んでもらいたくて、一生:
To be honest, I'm not great
at making Western food...
But I worked really hard
to make you happy, okay？
translations.洋食って簡単そうなのに、どうしてこんなに難しいんだろ？ 愛情でカバーできてるかな:
Western food looks simple,
so why is it this hard？
I hope my love can make up
for it, though...
translations.中華料理って本当に難しくて……。少しでもあなたの好みに近づくように、努力はしてる:
Chinese food is so tricky...
I'm trying my best to match
your tastes, though...
translations.中華って、どうすれば味が決まるんだろう？ 頑張って作ったけど、口に合わなかったら:
How do you get the flavors
just right in Chinese food？
I did my best, but sorry
if it's not to your taste？
translations.一生懸命作ったんだけど……大丈夫かなぁ？ 中華作るのって……苦手かも。:
I worked really hard on it,
but is it okay...？ I might
just be bad at Chinese food.
translations.私って、こういう料理向いてないのかなぁ？ 愛情はたっぷり込めてるから……食べてく:
Maybe I'm just not cut out
for this kind of food...
I put lots of love into it,
so I hope you'll eat it.
translations.頑張ったんだけど……これじゃあなたの口には合わないかな？ こういうタイプのお料理:
I tried my best, but maybe
it isn't to your taste？
I need to practice this kind
of food a lot more...
translations.こういう料理ってまだまだ上手にできないの……。でも頑張ったから、食べてもらえると:
I'm still not very good at
this sort of food... But I
worked hard on it, so I'd
be glad if you had some.
translations.最近、料理がスランプみたい……。愛情を込めたら少しは良くなるかと思ったんだけど…:
I feel like I'm in a slump
with my cooking lately...
I hoped adding love would
help, but... how is it？
translations.なんだか、味付けがピタッと決まらないの……。それでも食べてくれる？:
The seasoning just isn't
coming together right...
Will you still eat it anyway？
translations.なかなか自信を持って出せるものが作れないんだけど……。食べてくれる？:
It's hard to make anything
I'm confident in, but...
will you still eat it？
translations.ねえ、あなたにもらったおそろいの食器だよ。やっと使えたね▼:
Look, it's the matching
dishes you gave me. We
finally got to use them▼
translations.あなたにもらった食器、気に入ってるの。ふたつ並んでるとなんだか……ね▼:
I really love the dishes
you gave me. Having the two
side by side feels kind
of... you know▼
translations.（手料理食べたらなんか力がわいてきた。いいことありそう！）:
(Her cooking really gives me
energy. Feels like something
good's gonna happen!)
translations.ねえ、私のご飯どうだった？ いい出来だったと思うんだけど。:
So, how was my cooking？
I thought it turned out
pretty well.
translations.（たしかに、自信たっぷりなだけはあるよな……）:
(She definitely has reason
to be that confident...)
translations.さて、私の作ったご飯はどうだったかな？ 素直に答えていいのよ▼:
So, how did you like what I
made？ You can be completely
honest, you know▼
translations.（さすがの味ってとこか……）:
(Delicious, just like I'd
expect from her...)
translations.ねえ、私の手料理を食べた感想は？ 褒め言葉しか聞きません……な～んてね♪:
So, what'd you think of my
cooking？ Compliments only,
please... Just kidding♪
translations.（褒め言葉しか思いつかないけど……）:
(Not like I have anything
bad to say, though...)
translations.さて……じゃあ、料理の感想聞いちゃおうかな？:
Well now... care to tell me
what you thought of it？
translations.ねえ、私の手料理……あなたの口に合った？:
So, was my cooking...
to your liking？
translations.どうだった？ ……聞くほど自信はないんだけどね。:
How was it？
...Though I'm not really
confident enough to ask.
translations.（まあ……成功とは言えない出来だったけど）:
(Well... I wouldn't exactly
call it a success, but...)
translations.ごめん……今日の料理はダメだったよね？:
Sorry... Today's food
was pretty bad, wasn't it？
translations.（いいとは言えないけど……）:
(I can't really say it was
good, but...)
translations.ごめんね……ちゃんとしたの作ってあげたかったんだけど。:
I'm sorry... I wanted to
make you something proper.
translations.（感想言ったほうがいいよな……？）:
(I should probably tell her
what I think, right...？)
translations.やっぱり？ そう言ってもらえると思った▼:
Really？ I knew you'd say
that▼
translations.なんていうか……美味しかったよ。:
How should I put it...
It was good.
translations.えっ!? 正直に言ってくれてるんなら、いいんだけど……。:
Wait, really!? As long as
you're being honest, then okay,
but...
translations.そう？ もっと喜んでもらえるかと思ったんだけど……美味しかったんならいいの。:
Really？ I thought you'd
like it more... but if it was
good, that's fine.
translations.まあ、美味しかったと思う。: Well, I thought it was good.
translations.よかったんじゃないかな？: I think it was pretty decent？
translations.ほんとに？ そうなんだ……大丈夫だったんだ。:
Really？ Oh... So it turned
out okay after all.
translations.ちょっと、好みとは違うかな？: Not quite to my taste, I guess？
translations.えっ……そうなの？ 上手く出来たと思ったんだけど……また頑張るね。:
Wait... really？ And here I
thought I nailed it...
I'll try harder next time.
translations.好みとは……ちょっと違ったかな。:
It wasn't... quite to my
taste, I guess.
translations.そうなんだ……。もっとあなたの好みを研究しなくちゃダメだね。:
I see... Guess I need to
study your tastes more, then.
translations.たしかに……好みとは違うかなぁ。:
Yeah... it really wasn't
quite to my taste.
translations.だよね……。でも、今度はもっと好みに近づけるように頑張るね。:
Right... But next time,
I'll try to make it more
to your liking.
translations.ねえ、お昼なんだけど……たまにはお弁当じゃない方がいい？:
Hey, about lunch...
Would you rather not have a
bento once in a while？
translations.なに言ってんだよ、お弁当が一番だって。:
What are you talking about？
Bento is always the best.
translations.ほんとに？ じゃあ遠慮なく作ってきちゃうから♪:
Really？ Then I won't hold
back from making them♪
translations.そうだな。学食も気分転換になっていいかもな。:
Yeah. The cafeteria might be
a nice change of pace.
translations.そうよね。いつもお弁当より、そのほうがいいよね。:
Right？ That's way better than
having a bento every day.
translations.ちょっと質問だけど……あなたって、朝ごはんはちゃんと食べてる？:
Quick question... Do you eat
breakfast properly？
translations.ん～、しっかり食べたり食べなかったり……。:
Mmm, sometimes I eat a lot,
sometimes I skip it...
translations.もしよかったらだけど、私が作りに行っちゃダメかな？:
If it's okay with you, maybe
I could come make it for you？
translations.ねえ？ また朝ごはん作りに行きたいんだけど……どうかな？:
Hey？ I'd love to make you
breakfast again... What do
you think？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲さえ良ければ、ぜひ作りに来てよ。:
If you're okay with it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
I'd love for you to come cook!
translations.私は作ってあげたいの♪ それじゃあ今度行くから、約束ね。:
I'd love to cook for you♪
So I'll come over soon,
it's a promise!
translations.朝ごはんは……なるべく自分で頑張るよ。:
For breakfast... I think I'll try
to manage on my own.
translations.そうなんだ……うん、わかった。あなたが頑張るの、応援してるね。:
Oh, really... Okay, got it.
I'll be rooting for you!
translations.私ね、最近お菓子作りに凝ってるの。あなたにも食べさせてあげたいんだけどな？:
You know, I've really gotten
into baking sweets lately.
I want you to try some, too？
translations.ほんと？ 喜んで食べるよ！:
Really？
I'd love to have some!
translations.じゃあ今度とびきり美味しいの作るから、楽しみにしててね▼:
Then I'll make something
super delicious next time!
Look forward to it, ▼
translations.（どんなお菓子が出てくるんだろう？）:
(I wonder what kind of treats
she'll make？)
translations.あのね？ また、あなたのお家に晩ご飯を作りに行きたいなぁって思ってるんだけど……:
Hey？ I was thinking I'd like
to come make dinner at your
place again... would you mind？
translations.そんなの全然かまわないよ。: I don't mind that at all!
translations.よかったぁ♪ じゃあ美味しいの作ってあげるから、期待しててね▼:
Oh, good♪ Then I'll make
something delicious for you!
Look forward to it, ▼
translations.ごめん……なるべく自分で頑張りたいと思ってたとこだから。:
Sorry... I was kind of hoping
to handle it myself, if I can.
translations.そっか……残念。だけど、自分で頑張るのはいいことだもんね。:
Oh... That's too bad.
Still, it's great that you're
trying to handle it yourself.
translations.羊が一匹……羊が二匹……あなたがいっぱい……。:
One sheep... two sheep...
so many of you...
translations.ねない子は……食べちゃうぞ……。:
If you don't go to sleep...
I'll gobble you up...
translations.早くお風呂入っちゃいなさい……。:
Hurry up and take
your bath now...
translations.こら、服のまま入ったらダメって言ったでしょ……。:
Hey, I told you not to get in
with your clothes on...
translations.お背中……流しましょうか？:
Shall I... wash
your back for you？
translations.じゅげむじゅげむごこうのすりきれかいじゃり……なんだっけ……？:
Jugemu, Jugemu, Gokō-no
surikire, kaijari... wait,
what was next...？
translations.千、万、億、兆、京、垓……。:
Thousand, million, billion,
trillion, quadrillion,
quintillion...
translations.飛んだ……飛んだよ、私のペンギン……。:
It flew... my penguin
actually flew...
translations.ねえ、私のどこが好き……？:
Hey... what do you
like about me？
translations.無礼者、わらわにそのような……んん……。:
Insolent fool, laying hands
on me like that... mmm...
translations.よいよい……そちには褒美をとらせよう。:
'Tis fine, 'tis fine...
I shall grant thee a reward.
translations.くるしゅうない、くるしゅうない……。:
Think nothing of it...
think nothing of it...
translations.ん、いいよ、素直になって？:
Mmh, it's okay...
just be honest with me？
translations.ふふっ、くすぐったいったら……もう、おかえし！:
Hehe, stop, that tickles...
Geez, take that!
translations.まだこんな時間……。早く明日になーれ♪:
It's still only this time...
Hurry up and be tomorrow♪
translations.あと一回眠ったらデート……。んー、待ちきれない。:
Just one more sleep until
our date...
Mmm, I can't wait.
translations.明日は何着ていこうかな。今のうちに決めておかなきゃ……。:
What should I wear tomorrow？
Better pick it out now...
translations.昨日も、今日も、明日もデート……だったらいいのにな。:
A date yesterday, today,
and tomorrow... If only.
translations.ふふ、今日はデートのことばっかり考えてる。:
Fufu, all I've been thinking
about today is our date.
translations.早く会いたいな。明日まで待てない……。:
I want to see you so badly.
I can't wait till tomorrow...
translations.明日～は楽しい楽しいデ～トの日♪:
Tomorrow is our super fun,
happy daaaate day♪
translations.明日は気合い入れて甘やかしちゃおうかな。ふふ▼:
Maybe I'll really go all out
spoiling you tomorrow.
Hehe▼
translations.明日の私が今までで一番きれいに見えますように……。:
I hope I look prettier
tomorrow than ever before...
translations.今からこんなにドキドキしてたら、明日はどうなっちゃうんだろう。:
If my heart's racing this much
already, what's going to
happen tomorrow？
translations.次のデートは私がリードしちゃおうかな？:
Maybe I'll take the lead
on our next date？
translations.はぁ……。昨日からデートの余韻に浸りっぱなし。:
Haaah... I've been basking
in our date ever since.
translations.昨日のところ、また一緒に行きたいな……。:
I want to go back to that place
from yesterday with you...
translations.昨日のあの顔……ふふ、かわいいんだから……。:
The face you made yesterday...
Fufu, you're so cute...
translations.昨日のこと思い出すと、顔が熱くなっちゃう……。:
Whenever I remember yesterday,
my face gets so hot...
translations.男の子の部屋って、もっと散らかってると思ってたな。:
I thought a guy's room
would be a lot messier.
translations.あの部屋、居心地いいのよね。ずっと居たいな……。:
Your room's so cozy, though.
I could stay forever...
translations.昨日、帰さないなんて言われてたら、私……。:
If you'd told me you wouldn't
let me leave yesterday, I...
