on the spot... That's such a dream.
Maybe I'll try giving them to him
like that next year♪
translations.ホワイトデー！ カレはこのお返し、どんなこと考えながら選んでくれたのかなあ……い:
White Day！
I wonder what was going through
his head when he picked out this gift...
Did he agonize over it？
Ugh, just imagining it is too cute ▼.
translations.カレと一緒に年越し……やっぱり恋人同士はコレよね▼ 夜帰る時間を気にしなくていい:
Ringing in the New Year with him...
This is definitely what lovers do ▼.
It's so wonderful not having to worry
about what time I have to head home.
I wonder how many years until that's
just our everyday normal？
translations.文化祭でした。文化祭デート、いいなあって思ってたんだ。学校でデートできるって、な:
It was the school festival.
I've always wanted a school festival date.
Going on a date at school feels like
such a special treat.
After all, the school festival is really
the only time all year that school feels
out of the ordinary.
translations.体育祭。私にとっては、かっこいいカレシを眺める日▼ スポーツをするときって、普段:
Sports Day. For me, that meant a day
to gaze at my cool boyfriend ▼.
Guys just look so much more gallant
when they're playing sports, don't they？
I burned every second into my memory♪
translations.デキシーズに新しいバイトの子が入ってきた。素直でいい子みたいだけど……すこ～し頼:
A new boy started working at Dixie's.
He seems like an honest, good kid...
though he feels a tiiiny bit unreliable.
I'll have to show him the ropes.
translations.一人前のお祝いに、お食事。先輩としてかっこよくキメるつもりだったのに……失敗した:
A meal to celebrate him learning
the ropes. I was planning to play the
cool senpai, but... totally botched it.
translations.それに、ちょっと無理矢理誘ったみたいになっちゃったかな……迷惑に思われてないとい:
Besides, I might have come on a bit
too forceful inviting him...
I hope he didn't find it annoying.
Come to think of it, eating out one-on-one
with a coworker... I don't think
I've really done that before.
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人で甘味屋さん。イヤな顔せず付き合ってくれ:
The two of us went to a sweets shop
to brainstorm ideas for the new menu.
He didn't complain once, and he even
gave me solid advice...
He's surprisingly reliable...
translations.それと私、あんな風に思われてたんだ……我ながらヘンな質問しちゃった。それにしても:
Also, so that's what he thinks of me...
Even I know that was a weird question.
Still, it really felt like a date.
That wasn't my intention at all
when I invited him, though...
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人でラーメン屋さん。女子一人じゃ入りにくか:
The two of us went to a ramen shop
to brainstorm ideas for the new menu.
It's hard for a girl to go into those alone,
so it was a big help.
He gave me advice, too...
Yeah, he might actually be reliable.
translations.それにしても……あんな質問しちゃって、ヘンに思われなかったかな。おまけに、“デー:
Still... I wonder if he thought I was
weird for asking that kind of question.
On top of that, "Could this be a date？"...
I didn't mean to blurt that out at all.
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人で高級レストラン。さすがに女子高生一人じ:
The two of us went to a fancy restaurant
to brainstorm ideas for the new menu.
A high school girl can't really go
into a place like that alone.
He gave me valuable feedback, too,
so I'm glad I asked him along.
translations.だけど、なんだか余計な、思わせぶりなことまで言っちゃった……どうしてだろ。ちょっ:
But I ended up saying unnecessary,
suggestive things... Why did I do that？
Maybe I was getting a little carried away.
It wasn't like it was a date to him, anyway.
translations.新メニューのアイディア出しのために、二人で湖畔のレストラン。ちょっと遠いし、一人:
The two of us went to a lakeside
restaurant to brainstorm ideas for the
new menu. It's a bit far, and I didn't
feel like going alone, so it worked out.
He might actually be pretty dependable.
translations.仕事して、楽しくお食事して……それだけで終わらせておけばよかったのに。余計なこと:
Doing our job, having a nice meal...
I should have just left it at that.
I ended up saying something unnecessary.
Did he think it was weird？...
translations.今日のはデート……だよね。ちゃんと、デート、って言ったし。なのに、つまらないこと:
Today was a date... right？
I mean, I specifically said "date."
Yet I kept obsessing over silly things
and couldn't enjoy myself at all at first.
What am I doing？
I was looking forward to it so much, too.
translations.私、つまんなそうにしてるように見えたかも。思い切ってカレに聞いたおかげで少しはス:
I probably looked bored to him.
Taking the plunge and asking him cleared
the air a little, but...
I wonder if that gave away how I feel...
Then again, he seems pretty dense.
translations.でもやっぱり、誘ってよかった。一緒にデートしてよかった。おかげで少し、前に進める:
Still, I'm glad I invited him.
I'm glad we went on a date together.
Thanks to that, I can take a step forward.
I already... about him...
translations.はっきり言っちゃった。抱えてた不満、吐き出したおかげでスッキリしたけど……大人気:
I went and said it straight out.
Letting out all my bottled-up frustration
felt good, but... maybe it was childish.
Even though I'm older and his senpai.
translations.カレのすることぜんぶ、気になっちゃう。気持ちが落ち着かなくなって、不安で……特に:
Everything he does catches my attention.
It makes me restless and anxious...
especially whenever other girls are around.
I had no idea I was this jealous of a person...
translations.でも、もう迷わない。それが自分だってわかっちゃったから。すぐに不安になって、嫉妬:
But I won't waver anymore.
Because I realized that's just who I am.
Getting anxious so easily, getting jealous...
I realized I don't have to hate myself
for being weak like that.
I love him.
translations.少しストレート過ぎたかな。でもカレ、鈍いもんね。あれくらいハッキリ言わないと、私:
Maybe I was a bit too direct.
But he's so dense.
If I don't spell it out that clearly,
my feelings won't get through at all.
Though... he probably still doesn't get it.
translations.そんなところもカワイイんだけど、さすがに少しじれったいかな……。なんてね、だから:
That's part of what makes him cute,
but it really is a little frustrating...
Just kidding—if he actually noticed how
I felt right now, I'd probably panic.
When I try so hard to act like the cool,
composed older girl around him.
translations.カレが、好き。もう決めたから、カレに言いたい。告白したい。:
I love him.
I've made up my mind, so I want to tell him.
I want to confess.
translations.なにを気にしてたのかな、私。悩むことなんて、なにもなかったのに。はっきり言ってよ:
What was I even worrying about？
There was nothing to fret over at all.
I'm glad I told him straight.
I feel like that brought me closer
to him again.
translations.私がお姉さんなんだもん。カレのすることはなんでも受け入れて、なんでも許してあげて:
I'm the older girl, after all.
I'll accept everything he does, forgive
him for anything, and that way, maybe
I can make him fall in love with me, too...
translations.カレのこと、好き。それさえわかっちゃったら、もう他のことなんて、なにも考えなくて:
I love him.
Now that I know that much, I don't need
to overthink anything else.
All that's left is to brace myself...
and tell him.
translations.また残って仕事しちゃった。さすがにちょっと疲れたかも。でもその分お給料はもらえる:
I stayed late and worked overtime again.
I guess I am a little tired.
Still, I get paid for it, and it's
rewarding work, so I have to keep at it.
translations.それより、あの子、一人前に心配しちゃって。まだまだ自分の仕事で覚えなきゃいけない:
More importantly, that boy was worrying
about me like he's a full-fledged pro.
Even though he's still got plenty of work
to learn for himself.
Still, it made me happy...
Nobody else at Dixie's worries about me
like that...
translations.今度観に行く映画……内容はもうわかってるけど、楽しみだな。きっとあの子と観たら、:
The movie we're going to see next time...
I already know what happens,
but I'm still excited.
Watching it with him, we can get scared
together, talk about it afterward...
There's so much to look forward to.
translations.次のお出かけはもう、デートって言ってもいいよね。理由なんてなしに、純粋に二人で遊:
I guess I can call our next outing
a date, right？
There's no work excuse, we're just hanging
out, purely the two of us.
I wonder what kind of date it'll be...
Will this finally make my feelings clear？
translations.告白、しちゃった。カレに好きだって……。もう、どうしよう。頭の中ぐちゃぐちゃで、:
I confessed.
I told him I love him...
Oh gosh, what am I going to do？
My head is a total mess, should I really
even be writing in a diary right now？
translations.今日は朝からずっといろんなこと考えすぎて……カレの前でどんな顔してたのかな。そん:
I was overthinking so many things all day...
I wonder what kind of face I was making
in front of him.
I didn't have the luxury to think about
that then, but... looking back now,
it's so embarrassing.
translations.告白して、ＯＫもらったあとの今でも……さっきからずっと顔がにやけちゃったり、急に:
Even now, after confessing and hearing
him say yes... my face has been grinning
nonstop, and then suddenly I get anxious
and sad...
I might be like this for a while.
translations.明日朝になったら、どんな気持ちになるのかな。カレシがいる生活が始まるなんて、まだ:
I wonder how I'll feel
tomorrow morning？
I still can't quite imagine
life with a boyfriend.
Still, I know it's bound
to be so much fun.
So fun and so happy,
every day will be bliss...
I can just feel it.
translations.今日、眠れるかな。目を閉じたら、きっとまた思い出しちゃう。カレの顔、声、それから:
I wonder if I'll be able
to sleep tonight？
If I close my eyes,
I know I'll just remember
it all over again.
His face, his voice,
and the way he felt.
Our... kiss...
translations.最近、テニス部に仲のいい同級生がいるの？:
Have you been getting close
to a classmate in the
tennis club lately？
translations.▲高嶺＊＊▲のことかな。:
I wonder if she
means ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
translations.最近、図書委員に仲のいい後輩がいるの？:
Have you been getting close
to an underclassman on the
library committee lately？
translations.▲小早川＊▲のことかな。:
I wonder if she
means ▲小早川＊▲.
translations.ほんとなんだ。やるー。: So it's true. Look at you~
translations.やるーって……なにが？:
'Look at me'？ What's that
supposed to mean？
translations.え、モテてるってことじゃないの？ ……違うの？:
Well, doesn't that mean you're
popular？ ...Am I wrong？
translations.テニス部の同級生とは、なにか進展した？:
Made any progress with
that classmate from the
tennis club？
translations.図書委員の後輩とは、なにか進展した？:
Made any progress with
your underclassman on the
library committee？
translations.ほらほら、どうなの？:
Come on, spill！
How is it going？
translations.進展って別に……そういうのじゃないけど。:
'Progress'？ It's not really
like that, though.
translations.えー、そうなの？ うーん、はっきりしないなあ。:
Aw, really？ Hmm, you're
being awfully vague.
translations.学校の校舎裏に来てください\nネネ:
Please come behind the
school building.
Nene
translations.どうしたの、急に。しかも学校でって。:
What's up, all of a sudden？
And why at school？
translations.うん、実はどこでもよかったんだけど……。なんとなく、気分を変えたくて。:
Yeah, anywhere would've been
fine, really... I just wanted
a change of pace, I guess.
translations.あなたと会ったとき、最初は少し頼りないかな、って思ってたの。:
When we first met, I kinda
thought you were a little
unreliable.
translations.ふふ。でも、成長してくれたよね。仕事も、それ以外でも。:
Fufu. But you've really
grown. At work, and in
other ways too.
translations.うん。私のこと気遣ってくれたり。たまに、私よりも年上みたいな、そんな感じもして…:
Yeah. Like looking out for
me. Sometimes you even felt
older than me, you know...？
translations.あ、違うの。お礼が言いたくて。:
Ah, no, that's not it.
I wanted to thank you.
translations.言ったでしょ。そんなに私は人から頼られるような人間じゃないって。:
I told you, didn't I？
I'm really not someone
people should rely on so much.
translations.無理しなくていいって言ってくれて、うれしかった。:
When you told me I didn't
have to push myself,
it made me really happy.
translations.あなたみたいな後輩ができて、本当によかった。:
I'm so glad I got a junior
like you.
translations.これからも、可愛くて……たまに頼りになる後輩でいてほしいな。:
I hope you'll always be my
cute, sometimes-dependable
junior.
translations.もちろん。●でよければだけど。:
Of course. If you're happy
with ●, that is.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に告白されたときのこと、思い出すな……）:
(Takes me back to when
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ confessed to me...)
translations.こら、あなたには可愛いカノジョがいるでしょ。めっ！:
Hey now, you already have
a cute girlfriend, don't you？
Bad boy！
translations.あれ……なんだ、夢か……。:
Huh...？ What, it was
just a dream...？
translations.（こんな夢見るなんて……カノジョに申し訳ないな）:
(Having a dream like that...
I feel so bad for
my girlfriend.)
translations.ねえ、私……少し雰囲気変わったと思わない、かな。:
Hey... don't you think
my vibe is a little
different, maybe？
translations.外見じゃなくて、内面のことなんだけど……。:
Not on the outside,
on the inside, I mean...
translations.内面……そういえば、なんか大人しいな。:
The inside... Come to think
of it, you do seem quieter.
translations.そうなの。落ち着いた感じを意識しようかなって。:
Right. I thought I'd
try to be a little more
calm and composed.
translations.たしかに……でもなんで急に。:
True... But why all
of a sudden？
translations.どうしてかな。あなたがその方が喜ぶ気がしたの。:
I wonder. I just had a feeling
you'd like me better
that way.
translations.（落ち着いた▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……やっぱりいいかもな）:
(A calm ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
That might actually be nice.)
translations.ほら。私、印象変わった感じするでしょ。:
See？ Don't you think
I give off a different
impression？
translations.えっ……うーん……そうかな？:
Huh... Hmm...
Do you think so？
translations.わからないの？ もう！ 見た目のことじゃないよ？:
You can't tell？ Jeez！
I'm not talking about
my looks, you know？
translations.えっと……なんか、押しが強い感じするね。:
Well... you do seem
a bit more assertive, I guess.
translations.ふふ、そうなの。これからは少し強気でいこうかなって。:
Fufu, that's right. I figured
I'd try being a little
bolder from now on.
translations.強気か……たしかにそんな感じかも。でもなんで？:
Bolder, huh... Yeah, maybe so.
But why？
translations.え？ うーん、あなたがそっちの方が好きなのかなって思って。:
Eh？ Well, I just thought
you might like that
better.
translations.（強気な▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か……いいかも）:
(A bolder ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh...
Might not be bad.)
translations.あのね、私、印象違って見えないかな。:
Hey, don't you think
I seem a little different？
translations.わからないんだ。しょうがないなあ、もう。よしよし。:
You really can't tell？
Jeez, what am I going to do
with you. There, there.
translations.こんなお姉さん、イヤ？:
Don't like this kind
of big sister？
translations.イヤじゃないけど。なんで急に？:
Not that I don't, but...
Why all of a sudden？
translations.こんな明るいお姉さんが、あなたは好きな気がしたから。:
Because I felt like you'd
like a cheerful big sister
like this.
translations.（明るい▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か……いいかもな）:
(A cheerful ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh...
Might be nice.)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。ウイニングバーガーってよく行く？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Do you go
to Winning Burger often？
translations.そうね、よく行くよ。学校帰りとか。:
Yeah, pretty often.
Like on the way home
from school.
translations.だよな、それが普通だよな。:
Right？ That's pretty
normal, I guess.
translations.普通かどうかわからないけど……どうして？:
I don't know about normal,
but... why do you ask？
translations.うちの学校で入ったことがない奴って、いるのかなって。:
I just wondered if there's
anyone at our school who's
never been there.
translations.んー、それはさすがに珍しいかもね。:
Hmm, that really would
be pretty rare, I guess.
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。とわのウォッチャーって知ってるよな。:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You know
Towano Watcher, right？
translations.うん、もちろん。たまにチェックするよ。:
Yeah, of course.
I check it sometimes.
translations.そっか。あまり遊びなれてない人間が、雑誌だけを頼りに他人を遊びに連れて行くのって:
I see. What do you think
about someone who doesn't go
out much...
taking someone else out
based solely on a magazine？
translations.そうね……本で読むだけじゃわからないことってあるし。:
Well... there are definitely
things you can't learn just
from reading a magazine.
translations.他に誰か引っ張ってくれる人がいればいいと思うけど。:
I think it'd be fine if there
was someone else along to
take the lead, though.
translations.（そうだよな……▲高嶺＊＊▲、大丈夫かな）:
(Yeah, true... I wonder if
▲高嶺＊＊▲ will be okay.)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。デートの付き添いのための練習に行く、ってどう思う？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What do you
think about going to practice
chaperoning a date？
translations.やっぱりそういう反応だよな。:
I figured that's how
you'd react.
translations.つまり……デートなのよね？:
So basically...
it's a date, right？
translations.あ、デートに誘われたんだ。ひゅーひゅー！:
Ooh, someone asked you out!
Woo-woo~!
translations.（▲高嶺＊＊▲のアレはデートなのかな……断らないほうがよかったかな）:
(Was that thing with ▲高嶺＊＊▲
a date？ Maybe I shouldn't
have turned her down...)
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は夜の繁華街って行ったりする？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you ever hang out
downtown at night, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.そんなことないよ。もう、人をなんだと思ってるの。:
Of course not! Geez,
what kind of person do you
think I am？
translations.うちの後輩を見かけて、ちょっと気になって。:
I saw an underclassman there,
so I was kind of worried.
translations.そっか、危ないんじゃないのかな。:
I see. That sounds pretty
dangerous, doesn't it？
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。学校に放課後私服で来るって、どういうことかな。:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Why would someone show up
at school in casual clothes？
translations.え、あまり見たことないけど……。どうしたの？:
Huh, you don't see that
very often... What's up？
translations.うーん、そうね……。家でなにかあったのかな。:
Hmm, yeah... Maybe something
happened at home？
translations.話聞いてあげたらどうかな。:
Maybe you should try
talking to them？
translations.あのさ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は深夜のコンビニって行く？:
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Do you ever go to convenience
stores late at night, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.後輩をよく見かけるから、気になるんだよな。:
I keep seeing an underclassman
there, so I'm kind of worried.
translations.それは、危ないよ。なにか事情があるのかもしれないけど……。:
That really is dangerous.
They might have their reasons,
though...
translations.なにかあったんなら、話してみて？:
If something's on your mind,
you can talk to me, okay？
translations.そういうわけじゃないんだけど……あのさ。:
It's not really that, but...
listen.
translations.いいよ……うん。私は、あなたのカノジョだよ。:
It's okay... Yeah.
I'm your girlfriend.
translations.なんか、いろいろ思い出しててさ。:
I was just thinking back on
all kinds of stuff.
translations.●たちのこと。出会って、付き合うまでもいろいろあったなー、とか。:
About ● and me.
Like how a lot happened between
when we met and started dating.
translations.わかるな……そういうの。:
I get that...
I know how that feels.
translations.うん。私はね、そういうときいつも決まって、最後に――:
Yeah. When that happens to me,
without fail, at the very end—
translations.やっぱり、あなたと付き合ってよかったって思うの。:
—I always end up thinking
I'm so glad I'm with you.
translations.そういうことは、はっきり言ってほしいな。:
I'd like you to say things like that
loud and clear, you know？
translations.うん……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と付き合えて、よかった。:
Yeah... I'm really glad
I'm going out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.今日ね、校舎裏で小さな花壇を見つけたの。誰も世話してないみたいだから、私が毎朝水:
I found a little flower bed
behind the school today.
Nobody seems to care for it,
so I might water it mornings.
translations.よかったら●も手伝うよ。:
If you want,
● can help out too.
translations.いいの？ それじゃあ、１週間だけお願いしようかな？ その間に、ちゃんと学校でやっ:
Are you sure？ In that case,
could you help for a week？
I'll ask the school to take
proper care of it by then.
translations.かまわないよ。一緒に頑張ろう。:
I don't mind at all.
Let's do this together.
translations.……大変かもしれないけど、頑張って。:
...It might be tough,
but good luck.
translations.うん……枯れかけてかわいそうだから、花がつくまで見てあげようと思って。:
Yeah... It was withering
and I felt so bad for it,
so I want to look after it
until it blooms.
translations.そっか、応援するよ。:
I see.
I'll be rooting for you.
translations.そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と花壇の世話するんだったな……:
Come to think of it,
I'm supposed to tend to
the flowers with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.今日も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と花壇の世話かな……:
Guess I'm tending the
flowers with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ today, too...
translations.今日で約束の１週間だね。一緒に水やりしてくれてありがとう。:
Today makes one week!
Thanks for watering them
with me all this time.
translations.うん。ちゃーんと学校にかけあってきました。これからは、緑化委員が世話を引き継いで:
Yep! I went and talked to the
school, so the greening
committee is taking over now.
translations.そうなんだ。ちょっと残念な気もするけど……よかったな。:
I see. A part of me's a bit
sad, but... that's good.
translations.やっぱり毎日水やりはムリだった？:
Was watering every day
too much after all？
translations.いいよ、私が勝手に言いだしたことだもん。:
It's okay. I'm the one who
brought it up anyway.
translations.またなにかあったら……今度はちゃんと手伝うから。:
If anything else comes up...
I promise I'll help next time.
translations.ストップ！ あ……違った。: Hold on! Ah... no, not it.
translations.びっくりさせてごめんね。ちょっと……消しゴム落としちゃったの。探してるんだけど、:
Sorry for startling you.
I kind of dropped my eraser.
I've been looking for it,
but I can't find it anywhere.
translations.一緒に探そうか？: Want me to help you look？
translations.●も一緒に探そうか？ どんな消しゴム？:
● can help you look, too.
What kind of eraser is it？
translations.あの……タヌキの形をした……まだ新しい消しゴムなの。ここに落としたんじゃないのか:
Well... it's tanuki-shaped...
and it's still brand new.
Maybe I didn't drop it here.
translations.タヌキか……オッケー。見かけたら拾っておくよ。:
A tanuki, huh... Got it.
I'll pick it up if I see it.
translations.ごめんね。もし見つかったらでいいから。無理しないで。:
Sorry about this. Only if you
happen to find it, okay？
Don't go out of your way.
translations.探しても見つからないんだったら、あきらめたほうが……。:
If you can't find it anywhere,
maybe you should give up...
translations.そうよね……こんなに探しても見つからないんだもの。あきらめたほうがいいよね……。:
You're right... I've searched
this much with no luck.
I should probably give up...
translations.（こだわりの消しゴムだったのかな？）:
(Was it a really special
eraser to her？)
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が消しゴム探してたな……どこか探してみるか）:
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was
looking for an eraser...
Maybe I'll check around.)
translations.もしかして、これ？: Is this it, by any chance？
translations.そう、それ！ よかったぁ。:
Yes, that's it!
What a relief.
translations.へえ、そんなにお気に入りだったんだ？:
Heh, did you really
like it that much？
translations.えっ……うん。それに物は大事にしなくちゃダメでしょ。とにかく、ありがとうね。:
Uh... yeah. Besides, you have to
take care of your things, right？
Anyway, thank you.
translations.そういえば、タヌキの消しゴムって見つかった？:
By the way, did you ever find
that tanuki eraser？
translations.そっか……●も力になれなくてごめん。:
I see... Sorry ● 
couldn't help either.
translations.そんなこと。ありがとう、探してくれて。:
Don't worry about that. 
Thanks for helping me look.
translations.困ったなぁ。明日、一人急に休むことになっちゃったんだって。:
We're in a bit of a bind. 
Apparently someone called 
out tomorrow last-minute.
translations.●でよかったら明日、入ろうか？:
If you're okay with it, 
should ● cover tomorrow？
translations.ほんと？ だったらお願いしてもいいかな。頼りにしてるからよろしくね。:
Really？ In that case, 
could I ask you to？ 
I'm counting on you!
translations.急に休むって……きっと明日は大変だろうな。:
Calling out last minute... 
Tomorrow's definitely 
gonna be rough.
translations.そうだよね……。みんなで頑張ればなんとかなるかなぁ。:
Yeah... I guess if we all 
pitch in, we'll manage 
somehow.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がいるんだし、きっと大丈夫だよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'ll be there too, 
so I'm sure it'll be fine.
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がバイト入ってくれって言ってたな……）:
(Come to think of it, 
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ asked me to cover 
a shift today...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がバイト入ってくれって言ってたな……）:
(Right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ asked me 
to cover a shift today...)
translations.のんびり行っても大丈夫だろ: Taking my time should be fine
translations.今日はごめんね。おかげですごく助かっちゃった。:
Sorry about today. 
You really saved me out 
there, thank you!
translations.困ったときはお互いさまだからさ。:
Hey, we help each other 
out when we're in a pinch.
translations.それじゃあ、また困ったときは助けてくれる？:
In that case, will you 
help me out next time 
I'm in a pinch, too？
translations.昨日、待ってたのに……バイトのこと忘れてた？:
I was waiting for you 
yesterday... 
Did you forget about work？
translations.なんとかなったからいいんだけど……来られなくなったなら連絡くらいしてほしかったな:
We managed, so it's fine, 
but if you couldn't make it, 
I wish you'd let me know.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は最近、なにか映画観た？:
Have you seen any movies 
lately, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.映画は……あっ！ ＤＶＤの返却期限、忘れてた。:
Movies... Oh! 
I forgot the due date 
on my DVD!
translations.今日は観る時間ないから、明日の夜返却かな……でも夜返しに行くのは怖いし、観ないで:
No time to watch it today, 
so tomorrow night, but going 
at night is scary... Should I 
just return it unwatched？
translations.返すのつき合おうか？: Want me to go with you？
translations.だったら夜、返しに行くの付き合おうか？:
In that case, want me to 
come along when you return 
it tomorrow night？
translations.全然迷惑じゃないって。どうせ夜はコンビニ行ったりもするしさ。:
It's no trouble at all. 
I head out to the convenience 
store at night anyway.
translations.ほんとにつき合ってもらっていいの？:
Are you really sure 
you don't mind coming？
translations.ありがとう。じゃあ、お言葉に甘えるね。:
Thank you. In that case, 
I'll take you up on it.
translations.観ないで返すの、もったいなくない？ 延滞したら？:
Isn't returning it unwatched 
a waste？ Why not just 
pay the late fee？
translations.そうだね……また借りるよりはそのほうがいいか。:
You're right... 
That's probably better 
than renting it again.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がＤＶＤ返すのに付き合うんだったな……）:
(I was supposed to go 
with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to return 
that DVD...)
translations.ごめんね、面倒なことにつき合わせちゃって。:
Sorry for dragging you along
for such a hassle.
translations.そのおかげでＤＶＤも観られたし、期限内にも返せたし、助かっちゃった。:
Thanks to you, I could watch
the DVD and return it on time.
You really saved me!
translations.なにかお礼を考えなくちゃね。:
I'll have to think of
a way to thank you.
translations.いいってば。このくらいのことならいつでも言ってよ。:
Don't worry about it. You can
ask me anytime for this kind
of thing.
translations.そう？ ならいいけど……ありがとう。:
Really？ If you say so...
Thank you.
translations.昨日、結局一人でＤＶＤ返しに行ったんだよ？ 頼りにしてたんだけどな。:
Yesterday I ended up returning
the DVD all by myself, you know？
And I was counting on you, too.
translations.とは言っても、そもそも返却期限を忘れてた私が悪いか。こっちこそごめんなさい。:
Though I guess it's my fault
for forgetting the due date
in the first place. My bad!
translations.（謝られると……逆にツライな）:
(When she apologizes...
it actually hurts worse.)
translations.あ、ゴミ……。ちゃんとこっちにゴミ箱があるのに。:
Ah, trash... Even though
there's a bin right here.
translations.ほんとだ……私、これから１週間を美化週間にしようかな。それで、バイトが始まる前に:
You're right... Maybe I'll make
this week "Clean-up Week."
I can pick up trash around Dixie's
before my shift. What do you think？
translations.それ、いいね。●も一緒にやろうかな。:
That sounds great. Maybe I'll
join in with you, ●.
translations.そんなこと言っちゃっていいの？\n１週間毎日だよ？:
Are you sure you want to say that？
It's every day for a whole week,
you know？
translations.よかった。実は私一人だと、ちょっと寂しかったのよね。:
I'm glad. To be honest, doing it
all alone felt a little lonely.
translations.よし、一緒に頑張ろう！: All right, let's do this together!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はいつも頑張るよなぁ。:
You really always work
so hard, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そう？ どうせバイトには来るんだし、そのついでと思えば大したことないもの。:
You think so？ I'm coming in for
work anyway, so it's really no
big deal if I do it then.
translations.みんな喜ぶと思うよ。:
I'm sure everyone will
really appreciate it.
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にゴミ拾いするんだったな……）:
(Come to think of it, I'm supposed
to pick up trash with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.（今日も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にゴミ拾いだな……）:
(Picking up trash with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
again today...)
translations.少し寄り道するぐらいの時間はあるな: I have time for a quick detour
translations.今日で美化週間、最終日だね。:
Today's the last day of
Clean-up Week, huh.
translations.そっか、もう１週間。: Right, it's already been a week.
translations.よく頑張りました、１週間お疲れさま。:
You did a great job!
Thanks for all your hard work
this week.
translations.でも……終わるとちょっと寂しいかも。またなにか協力してできたらいいね。:
Still... now that it's over,
it feels a little lonely.
I hope we can team up again.
translations.美化週間、ふたりでは達成できなかったね。:
We couldn't finish Clean-up Week
together after all, huh.
translations.うん……約束守れなくて、ごめん。:
Yeah... Sorry I couldn't
keep my promise.
translations.今回は“一緒に頑張ろう”って言ってくれた気持ちだけもらっとくね。:
For this time, it's the thought
that counts. Knowing you wanted
to do it together was enough.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……あれ、なんか悩み事？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Wait, is something
on your mind？
translations.あ……うん。担任の先生に頼まれた書類を作らないといけないんだけど、量が多くて。:
Ah... Yeah. My homeroom teacher
asked me to make some handouts,
but there's just so much.
translations.●も手伝うよ。そんなの生徒に頼まなきゃいいのに。:
●'ll help too.
They shouldn't be dumping
this on students anyway.
translations.ありがとう！ ごめんね、助かっちゃう。:
Thanks! Sorry about this,
but you're a real lifesaver.
translations.どうすればいい？ 今からやる？:
What should we do？
Do you want to start now？
translations.えっと……じゃあ明日にしようかな。教室に来てくれる？:
Um... let's do it tomorrow,
then. Can you come by
my classroom？
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の手伝いで書類作るんだったな……）:
(Oh right, I was supposed
to help ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ with
that paperwork...)
translations.終わったー！ ほんとにありがとう。:
All done!
Seriously, thank you
so much.
translations.一緒にやれば、結構すぐだったね。一人だと大変そうだけど……。:
That actually didn't take
long together. Would've been
rough on your own, though...
translations.ほんと、助かっちゃった。よかった……。:
You really saved me.
I'm so relieved...
translations.待ってたんだけどな、教室で。:
I was waiting for you,
you know. In my classroom.
translations.あっ！ 書類の手伝い……ごめん！:
Ah! The paperwork...
I'm so sorry!
translations.いいよ、もともと私が頼まれたことだし。:
It's fine. It was my job
in the first place, anyway.
translations.バイト頑張ってるね。特別に、私が期間限定で接客の特訓してあげようか？:
Working hard at your job, huh？
How about some special,
limited-time customer service
training from yours truly？
translations.言ったね？ じゃあ、これからしばらくバイトに入る前に特訓ね。私は甘やかさないから:
You asked for it! We'll train
before your shifts for a while.
I won't go easy on you,
so be ready, okay？
translations.それは遠慮しとこうかな……。: I think I'll pass on that...
translations.そう？ ならいいんだけど。私が特訓とか、ちょっと偉そうだったかな……。:
Oh？ Well, fair enough.
Maybe I was being a bit bossy,
offering to train you...
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が接客の特訓してくれるんだよな……）:
(Oh right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was going
to train me in
customer service...)
translations.（今日も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が接客の特訓してくれるんだよな……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s training me in
customer service today, too...)
translations.お疲れさま。ずいぶん板に付いてきたと思うよ。:
Good work! I think you've
really gotten the hang of it.
translations.自分でも少し自信ついたかも。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげだな。:
I think I've gotten more
confident myself.
It's all thanks to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.特訓はここまでかな。また何か聞きたいことがあったら、いつでも言ってね。:
That wraps up our training!
If you ever have questions,
feel free to ask anytime.
translations.うん、ありがとう。またよろしく。:
Yeah, thanks.
I'll be counting on you again.
translations.接客、あまり上達しなかったかもね……。:
Guess your customer service
didn't improve all that much...
translations.ごめん……●の頑張りが足りなかったからだな。:
Sorry... I guess ●
didn't try hard enough.
translations.ん……ううん、実務で覚えていけばいいもんね。これからも頑張って。:
Mm... nah, you can always
learn on the job.
Keep giving it your best, okay？
translations.朝って、つい二度寝しちゃうんだよね。:
In the morning, I always
end up falling back asleep.
translations.寝坊？ だったら私が毎朝メールしてあげるから、それにちゃんと返信してくるっていう:
Oversleeping？ Then how about
I text you every morning,
and you have to reply to it？
translations.メールに返信か。それ、いいかも。:
Replying by text, huh？
That might actually work.
translations.でしょ？ １週間も続ければ二度寝グセも治っちゃうんじゃないかな。:
Right？ Keep it up a week,
and I bet you'll kick that
habit of falling back asleep.
translations.うん。だけど毎朝メールなんて▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が大変じゃない？:
Yeah. But won't texting every
morning be a pain for you,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.私は平気よ？ それに、朝メールを送らなきゃって思えば私もシャキっと起きられるから:
I don't mind at all！ Besides,
knowing I have to text you
will help me wake up, too.
translations.じゃあ、お言葉に甘えてお願いしてもいい？:
Then do you mind if I take
you up on that？
translations.はい、了解。明日から１週間、頑張ろうね。:
All right, deal！ Let's both
do our best for a week,
starting tomorrow.
translations.なんか、めんどうだな……。:
Honestly, it sounds like
kind of a hassle...
translations.そう……。まあ私も朝はバタバタするし……。:
I see... Well, mornings are
pretty hectic for me, too...
translations.気を遣ってくれてありがと。:
Thanks for looking out for me,
though.
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にメール返信すんるんだったな……）:
(Oh, right, I'm supposed to
reply to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s text...)
translations.（そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にメール返信……）:
(Right, need to reply to
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s text...)
translations.１週間よく続いたね。:
You kept it up for a whole
week. Good job！
translations.うん。なんとなく１回で起きる習慣がついた気がする。:
Yeah. I feel like I finally
got in the habit of waking
up on the first try.
translations.私も早起きしなきゃって思ったら、いつもより時間にゆとりができたよ♪:
Knowing I had to get up early
gave me plenty of extra time
in the morning, too♪
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がそう言ってくれると、ホッとするよ。:
Hearing you say that is a big
relief, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そのかわり、私がモーニングメールをして欲しくなったときには協力してね？:
In return, you have to help
me out if I ever want wake-up
texts, okay？
translations.メールの返信、続かなかったね……。:
Looks like you couldn't keep
up with the replies...
translations.……私の案がイマイチだったのかな？:
...Maybe my idea wasn't
that great after all？
translations.そんなことないよ。せっかく協力してもらったのに……ごめん。:
No, that's not it. You went
out of your way to help me,
and... I'm sorry.
translations.店のメニューをバシッと覚えるコツないかな……。:
I wonder if there's a good
trick to memorizing the whole
menu...
translations.うーん、ジャンルごとに覚えるのがいいかな……。:
Hmm, maybe learning it by
category would work...？
translations.不安だったら、私が覚えるの付き合ってあげよっか。メールで私の指定したジャンルのメ:
If you're nervous, I can help
you study. I'll text you a
category, and you reply with
the items. How's that sound？
translations.メールでテストか。よし、やってみようかな。:
Quizzing by text, huh？
All right, I'll give it a shot.
translations.そうそう、やる気があってよろしい。:
That's the spirit！
I like your enthusiasm.
translations.それはちょっと……いいかな。:
That's a bit...
I think I'll pass.
translations.そうだよね……めんどうだもんね。:
Yeah, true...
It'd be kind of a hassle.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にも悪いし……自分で頑張ってみるから。:
I'd feel bad putting you out,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I'll do my best on
my own.
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がメールでメニュー覚えるの協力してくれるんだったな……:
(Oh right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was going
to help me learn the menu
over text...)
translations.（そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がメールでメニュー覚えるの協力してくれるって……）:
(Right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ offered to
help me learn the menu over
text...)
translations.メールのメニュー特訓、よく頑張りました。:
You did great with our menu
training over text！
translations.ふふっ……合格！ ちゃんと覚えられたみたいだね。:
Hehe... You passed！
Looks like you really got
them all down.
translations.よかったぁ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に協力してもらったおかげで頑張れたよ。:
Whew, what a relief.
I only managed because you
helped me out, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.せっかく覚えたんだから、これからは忘れないように頑張ってね。:
Now that you know it all,
make sure you don't forget,
okay？
translations.メールでメニューを覚える特訓だけど。:
About that menu-memorizing
training by text...
translations.残念ながら、ちょっと頑張りが足りなかったみたいだね。:
Unfortunately, looks like you
didn't try quite hard enough.
translations.協力してもらったのに……ごめん。:
After you helped me and all...
I'm sorry.
translations.家でね、ご近所のワンちゃんを預かることになったの。旅行に行く間の３泊４日間。:
We're dog-sitting for our neighbor
at my place. Just four days and
three nights while they're away.
translations.小型犬ですっごくかわいいんだけど、バイトから帰ったあとでお散歩とか……お世話のこ:
It's a really cute little dog,
but walking it after work and all...
I'm a little worried about taking
care of everything.
translations.散歩ならつき合うよ: I can come on walks with you
translations.散歩だったら●もつき合うよ。:
If it's for walks, ● can
come along too.
translations.そんな……悪いよ。:
Oh no... I'd feel bad asking
that of you.
translations.いいんだって。夜に女の子がひとりで出歩くほうが心配だから。:
Don't worry about it. I'd worry
more about a girl walking alone
at night anyway.
translations.女の子扱いしてくれるんだ？ ふふ……でも、一人じゃないよ。ワンちゃんが一緒。:
Treating me like a girl, are you？
Hehe... But I won't be alone.
The doggy will be with me.
translations.小型犬じゃ、ボディーガードにならないって。:
A tiny dog isn't gonna be much
of a bodyguard, you know.
translations.そっか。じゃあ３日間、お言葉に甘えさせてもらおうかな？:
True. In that case, maybe I'll take
you up on that for the three days？
translations.そんなに心配しなくても、なんとかなるよ。:
You don't need to worry so much,
it'll work out.
translations.そうだよね……。引き受けたんだから、しっかりしなくちゃね。:
You're right... I agreed to do it,
so I have to pull myself together.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら大丈夫だと思うな。: I think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'ll do just fine.
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が預かってる犬の散歩に付き合うんだったな……）:
(Come to think of it, I promised
to walk the dog ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is watching...)
translations.（今日も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の犬の散歩に付き合うか……）:
(Guess I'll go with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to walk
the dog again today...)
translations.やっぱり男の人が一緒だと心強いね。３日間付き添ってくれてありがとう。:
It really is reassuring having a guy
with me. Thanks for walking with me
all three days.
translations.そっか、もう飼い主さん帰ってくるんだっけ。:
Oh right, the owners are already
coming back, huh？
translations.うん。あ～あ、寂しいなぁ……もう少し一緒にいたいのに。:
Yeah. Aww, I'm gonna miss it...
I wish we could stay together
a little longer.
translations.だけど……早く飼い主さんのところに帰るほうが、ワンちゃんもうれしいよね。:
Still... I'm sure the pup will be
happier going back to its owners.
translations.やっぱり散歩に付き添うって、面倒だったよね。:
I guess coming along for walks was
a chore after all, huh？
translations.ワンちゃんのお世話をひとに頼ろうとした私がダメなのよね……気にしないで。:
It was wrong of me to rely on others
to help take care of the dog...
Don't worry about it.
translations.（……汚名返上のチャンスはあるかな？）:
(...Wonder if I'll get a chance to
redeem myself？)
translations.明日から３日間、いつもよりスタッフが少ないでしょ？ だから絶対に遅刻しないように:
Starting tomorrow, we're short-staffed
for three days, right？ So why don't
we go to work together to make sure
we're definitely not late？
translations.そこまでしなくても……: We don't need to go that far...
translations.ああ、いいよ。そういえばシフト組むの大変だって店長も言ってたな。:
Yeah, sure. Come to think of it,
the manager was saying scheduling
was tough.
translations.うん。それじゃあ明日から迎えにいくね。:
Yeah. Then I'll come pick you up
starting tomorrow.
translations.そこまでしなくても大丈夫じゃない？:
Don't you think we'll be fine
without going that far？
translations.ん……そうよね。考えすぎだったかな。:
Mm... You're right. Maybe I was
overthinking it.
translations.心配しなくたって、みんなちゃんと出勤するよ。:
Don't worry, everyone'll show up
for work on time.
translations.（そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にバイト行くんだったな……）:
(Come to think of it, I'm heading
to work together with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
translations.（今日も▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒にバイト行くか……）:
(Guess I'll head to work with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ again today...)
translations.なんとか３日間乗り切れたね。お疲れさまでした。:
We somehow made it through
those three days, huh？
Great job out there.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もお疲れさま。なんか、いつもより気合いが入った３日間だったよ。:
Good work to you too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I felt way more fired up than
usual these past three days.
translations.だからいつもより男らしく見えたのかな？:
Is that why you looked even
more manly than usual？
translations.バイト、一緒に行こうって約束したの……忘れてた？:
Did you forget our promise...
to head into work together？
translations.あ……じゃないでしょ？ 約束したことはちゃんと守らなくちゃ。:
Don't give me 'uh...'!
When you make a promise,
you have to keep it, okay？
translations.宿題って、ちゃんといつも忘れずにやってる？:
Do you always remember
to do your homework？
translations.あ、もう。じゃあ私が１週間、毎晩宿題やったかメールで確認するから、それに返信する:
Oh, jeez. How about for a week,
I text you each night to check,
and you reply back to me？
translations.オッケー！ 本当にいいの？:
Sounds good!
Are you really sure, though？
translations.うん。そうすれば私も、宿題忘れて寝ちゃったりしないで済みそうでしょ？:
Yep. That way, I won't end up
dozing off and forgetting
mine either, right？
translations.そっか、お互いの役に立つってことか。:
I see, so it helps
both of us out.
translations.そういうこと。とりあえず１週間続けてみようよ。:
Exactly. Let's give it
a try for a week.
translations.（約束か……ちょっとドキドキするな）:
(A promise, huh...
Makes my heart beat a little.)
translations.それはムリだよ……寝てたらメールにも気づかないと思うし。:
No way, that won't work...
If I'm asleep, I won't even
notice your text.
translations.う～ん……それもそっかぁ。じゃあ、またいい方法が思いついたら報告するね。:
Hmm... Yeah, fair point.
I'll let you know if I come
up with a better idea, okay？
translations.そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がメールで、宿題やってるか確認するって……:
(Oh right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said
she'd text to check
on my homework...)
translations.宿題メール。１週間続けてみて、どうだった？:
So, the homework texts.
How did that week feel？
translations.おかげで忘れずに済んだよ、助かった。:
Thanks to you, I didn't
forget once. Total lifesaver.
translations.よかった。私もこの１週間は予習復習までバッチリできたよ。:
Glad to hear it. I totally
nailed all my prep and
review this week, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はいつでも完璧そうだけど。:
Though you always seem
so perfect anyway, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そんなことないよ。これからもときどき、こういうのお願いしてもいい？:
Not at all. Mind if I ask you
to do this kind of thing
again from time to time？
translations.もちろん！ こっちこそ、よろしく。:
Of course! The pleasure's
all mine.
translations.私の宿題チェックメール……役に立たなかった？:
Did my homework check-in
texts... not help after all？
translations.だったら返信するって約束……守ってほしかったなぁ。:
Then I really wish you'd kept
your promise to reply...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、なんか難しそうな顔してるけど？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you've got kind of
a troubled look on your face？
translations.実はね、また新メニューのアイデアを出して欲しいって頼まれたんだけど……最近あまり:
Actually, they asked me to come
up with new menu ideas again...
But I haven't eaten out much,
so I'm drawing a total blank.
translations.じゃあ、また一緒に食事行こう: Let's go eat out together again
translations.だったらまた一緒に、あちこち食事しに行かない？:
Then why don't we go check
out some food places together
again？
translations.えっ……一緒に？ そんなの迷惑でしょ？:
Huh... together？ Wouldn't
that just be a hassle for you？
translations.全然大丈夫だって。一人暮らしだし、外食ばっかでも困らないよ。:
Not at all! I live alone, so
eating out all the time is
no problem for me.
translations.ほんとに？ ありがとう、じゃあお願いしちゃおうかな。:
Really？ Thank you!
Then I think I'll take you
up on that.
translations.遠慮なくどうぞ。: Go right ahead, don't hold back.
translations.相変わらず▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は大変そうだな……。:
Looks like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has her
hands full as usual...
translations.頼りにしてもらえるのは嬉しいことだから……頑張るしかないよね。:
It feels nice being relied on,
though... so I just have to
do my best, right？
translations.陰ながら応援してるよ。:
I'll be rooting for you
from the sidelines.
translations.そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に食事に行くんだったな……:
Come to think of it, I was supposed
to go eat with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に食事に行くんだった……:
Right, I was supposed to go
eat with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
translations.外食、つき合ってくれてありがとう。:
Thanks for coming out to eat
with me.
translations.こっちこそ、色々楽しめたよ。:
Not at all, I had a great
time too.
translations.新しい味も発見できたし、いいアイデアが浮かびそう♪:
I found some new flavors, too,
so I think good ideas will
start coming to me♪
translations.また、なにかあったら助けてくれる？:
Will you help me out again
if anything else comes up？
translations.外食につき合ってくれるって言うから……頼りにしてたんだけどな。:
You said you'd go out to eat
with me... I was really
counting on you, you know.
translations.今回はどうにかなりそうだからいいけど……約束破るのはよくないよ？:
It looks like I'll manage this time,
so it's okay, but... breaking
promises isn't nice, you know？
translations.うん……反省してる。: Yeah... I feel really bad about it.
translations.最近どう？ なんか仕事抱え込んだりしてない？:
How've things been lately？
You haven't been taking on
too much work, have you？
translations.それがね……新メニューを提案したら、今度は試作品を作ってくれないかって言われちゃ:
Well, you see... When I pitched
the new menu ideas, they asked
if I could make prototypes.
And within a week, too.
translations.大変だな。●でよければ、なにか手伝うよ。:
That sounds rough. If it's okay
with you, ●, I'll help out.
translations.……そんなこと言われたら、ほんとにお願いしちゃうよ？:
...If you say that, I might
actually take you up on it, you know？
translations.もちろん、構わないよ。: Of course, I don't mind at all.
translations.助かっちゃうな……それじゃあ、あなたには１週間毎日、味見をお願いしていい？:
That'd be such a help... In that
case, would you be willing to
taste-test every day for a week？
translations.味見って……そんなのでいいの？:
Taste-testing...？
Is that really all you need？
translations.自分で作ったものを自分で食べるより、ほかの人の反応を見たほうが正しく判断できると:
Rather than eating what I made
myself, I think seeing someone
else's reaction gives a much
better sense of how it turned out.
translations.責任重大だな。気合い入れて食べるよ。:
That's a big responsibility.
I'll give it my all!
translations.また大変なこと頼まれて……。:
They sure asked a lot of you
again...
translations.試作は楽しいんだけど、１週間後が期限だしプレッシャーなの。上手くいけばいいけど…:
Making prototypes is fun, but with
a one-week deadline, it's quite
a bit of pressure.
I hope it goes well...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲なら大丈夫だよ。頑張って。:
You'll do great, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hang in there.
translations.そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の試作品の味見するんだったな……:
Come to think of it, I was supposed
to taste-test ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s prototypes...
translations.そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の試作品の味見するんだった……:
Right, I was supposed to taste-test
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s prototypes...
translations.うん、自分でも納得の仕上がり！\nこれならいけるかも♪:
Yep, even I'm satisfied with
how this turned out!
This just might work♪
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の努力の結晶って感じだね。:
Feels like the culmination
of all ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s hard work.
translations.ここまでできたのも、あなたのおかげよ。１週間つき合ってくれて本当にありがとう。:
I only made it this far
thanks to you.
Thank you so much for
sticking with me all week.
translations.●はたくさん美味しいものが食べれてラッキーだったから。:
Well, ● got to eat
tons of delicious food,
so I was pretty lucky.
translations.また今度協力してもらったときは、お礼に手料理作っちゃおうかな？:
Next time you help me out,
maybe I'll make you a nice
home-cooked meal as thanks？
translations.ほんと？ それなら大歓迎だよ。:
Really？ In that case,
I'd love that.
translations.試作品の手伝い、ほんとはイヤだった？:
Did you really not want
to help with the recipes？
translations.そうじゃないんだけど……いろいろあって行きそびれたっていうか。:
It's not that, it's just...
things came up and I kind of
missed my chance to go.
translations.ふ～ん……じゃあ、私の手料理が食べたくなかったわけじゃないんだ？:
Hmm... So it's not that
you didn't want to eat
my cooking, then？
translations.うん、反省してる……。:
Yeah, I'm really sorry...
I feel bad about it.
translations.ねえ、寝る前って、誰かにおやすみって伝えたくならない？:
Hey, right before bed,
don't you ever feel like
saying good night
to someone？
translations.んー、なんとなくわかるかな。:
Hmm, yeah, I guess
I kind of get that.
translations.……じゃあさ、私に毎日おやすみメール送ってくれる？ ずっととは言わないから……と:
...Then could you text me
good night every day？
Not forever, just...
for a week, to start.
translations.本当に送ってもいいの？:
Are you really sure
it's okay if I text you？
translations.もちろん、本当に待ってるよ？:
Of course！
I'll really be waiting, okay？
translations.おやすみって……１日を締めくくるいい言葉だよね♪:
'Good night' is just such
a nice way to wrap up
the day, don't you think？♪
translations.それはどうかな……忘れたら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲をずっと待たせることになっちゃうし。:
I don't know about that...
If I forget, I'd end up
keeping ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ waiting.
translations.う～ん……それもそうだね。寝る時間が同じくらいとも限らないし……。:
Hmm... That's true, too.
It's not like we always
go to sleep at the same time...
translations.そういえば、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲におやすみメール送るんだったな……:
Come to think of it,
I'm supposed to send ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
a good-night text...
translations.そうだ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲におやすみメール……:
Right, gotta text ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
good night...
translations.うん、こっちも楽しかったから。:
Yeah, I actually had
a lot of fun doing it.
translations.ふふ、私もあなたからのメールを待ってるの楽しかったよ。:
Fufu, I loved waiting for
your texts every night, too.
translations.おやすみメール、つまらなかった？:
Were the good-night texts
that boring to you？
translations.ふーん……私はけっこう、楽しみにしてたんだけどなぁ。:
Hmph... And here I was,
actually looking forward
to them.
translations.（あれ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ 声かけても大丈夫かな）:
(Oh, is that ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Wonder if it's okay
to call out to her.)
translations.（……ちょっと違う呼び方してみるかな。苗字、名前、さん付けとかちゃん付けとか……:
(...Maybe I'll try calling her
something different.
Last name, first name,
with -san, with -chan...)
translations.ひとり？ よかったら●と一緒に……。:
Are you alone？ If you'd like,
you could come with ●...
translations.あっ……ごめんね、私ちょっと急いでるの。またね。:
Ah... Sorry, I'm kind of
in a rush right now. See you！
translations.（断られたけど、呼び方はこれでもいいのかな）:
(She turned me down,
but I wonder if calling her
that was okay.)
translations.（今のは呼び方がまずかったかな）:
(Was calling her that
a bad idea？)
translations.ひとりなんだったら、一緒に行ってもいい？:
If you're on your own,
mind if I walk with you？
translations.（今の呼び方でもよかったみたいだな）:
（Looks like that name 
worked after all.）
translations.（……今の呼び方はダメか）:
(...Guess calling her that
is a no-go.)
translations.せっかくだから、一緒に行こうよ。:
Since we're both here, 
let's go together.
translations.どうしよっかな？ ……なんてウソ。行こ♪:
Hmm, what to do？ 
...Just kidding. Let's go♪
translations.せっかく会えたんだし、一緒に行かない？:
Since we ran into each 
other, wanna walk together？
translations.しょうがないなぁ。いいよ。:
Well, can't say no 
to you. Sure.
translations.ちょっと、知り合いに用事があって……。:
Well, I kind of needed 
to see someone I know...
translations.そうなの、ごめんね……呼び止めちゃって。じゃあまた。:
Oh, really？ Sorry for 
stopping you. See you later.
translations.えっと、▲高嶺＊＊▲に用事があったんだけど……。:
Um, I actually needed 
to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲, but...
translations.そうなんだ……私、お邪魔しちゃったかな。バイバイ。:
Oh... Did I interrupt 
something？ Bye-bye.
translations.えっと、▲小早川＊▲に用事があったんだけど……。:
Um, I actually needed 
to see ▲小早川＊▲, but...
translations.ああ、えっと……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に用事があったんだ。:
Oh, um... I actually needed 
to talk to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.へえ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の説明はわかりやすいなぁ。:
Wow, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
your explanation was 
really easy to follow.
translations.役に立ててよかった。それじゃあまたね。:
Glad I could help. 
See you later, then.
translations.（もういないか……仕方ないな）:
（She's already gone... 
Guess it can't be helped.）
translations.あ……あまりよそ見しないほうがいいんじゃない？ じゃあまたね。:
Um... maybe you shouldn't 
let your eyes wander？ 
See you later.
translations.今、教室に戻る途中だったんだ。:
I was just on my way 
back to the classroom.
translations.そう。じゃあ早く戻ったほうがいいね。:
I see. You'd better 
get back quickly, then.
translations.思わず声かけちゃったけど、なにか用事の途中だった？:
I couldn't help calling out, 
but were you in the middle 
of something？
translations.そうなんだ？ 邪魔しちゃった。じゃあね。:
Oh, really？ 
Sorry to interrupt, then. 
See you later.
translations.なぁんだ……私じゃないんだね？ 残念。:
Aw... 
So it wasn't me？ 
Too bad.
translations.ちょうどよかった……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に用事があって。:
Good timing... 
I actually needed to see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.また聞きたいことがあったら、いつでもどうぞ。じゃあ、またね。:
If there's anything else 
you want to ask, anytime! 
See you later.
translations.えっ……ごめんね。私、急ぐから。:
Huh...？ Sorry, 
I'm in a bit of a rush.
translations.そろそろ教室に戻んなきゃな～……と思って。:
I was just thinking 
I should head back 
to class soon...
translations.そっか、じゃあ私も戻ろうかな。:
I see. Maybe I'll 
head back too, then.
translations.（ほんとは▲高嶺＊＊▲に話しかけるつもりだったんだけど……）:
(I was actually planning 
to talk to ▲高嶺＊＊▲, though...)
translations.（ほんとは▲小早川＊▲に話しかけるつもりだったんだけど……）:
(I was actually planning 
to talk to ▲小早川＊▲, though...)
translations.びっくりした……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲か。:
You startled me... 
Oh, it's just ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あ、私じゃ不満みたいな言いかた……寂しいなぁ。:
Aw, you make it sound 
like you're disappointed 
it's me... That hurts.
translations.ちょっと知り合いに用事があったからさ……。:
I just needed to see 
someone I know, so...
translations.そういうこと。じゃあ、私は退散するね。:
Ah, I see. 
I'll make myself scarce, then.
translations.知り合いに、用事があって……。:
I had something to take care of
with someone I know...
translations.私はお邪魔かぁ……。残念だけど、またにするね。:
Guess I'm in the way, then...
Too bad, but I'll catch you
another time.
translations.せっかく声かけてくれたのに、ごめん。:
Sorry, after you went through
the trouble of saying hi.
translations.なんだ、それなら早く言ってくれればいいのに。なぁに？:
Geez, you should've just told
me that sooner! What's up？
translations.ありがとう、助かったよ。: Thanks, that was a big help.
translations.どういたしまして。それじゃあ私は行くね。:
You're welcome.
Well, I'll be on my way!
translations.（もう、いるわけないよな……）:
(No way she's still around
by now, though...)
translations.もう、大きな声出して……聞こえちゃったら困るんじゃないの？ またね。:
Geez, don't shout like that...
Won't you get in trouble if
someone hears？ See you.
translations.ちょっと行くところがあるから……。: I've got somewhere to be, so...
translations.そうだったの？ 引き止めちゃってごめんね。:
Oh, really？
Sorry for holding you up.
translations.また今度、声かけてよ。じゃあ！:
Talk to me next time, okay？
See ya!
translations.（あれ、▲高嶺＊＊▲……見失ったか）:
(Huh... Did I lose track
of ▲高嶺＊＊▲？)
translations.（あれ、▲小早川＊▲……見失ったか）:
(Huh... Did I lose track
of ▲小早川＊▲？)
translations.（声かけて大丈夫かな？）:
(Wonder if it's okay
to call out to her？)
translations.どうって……ただ見かけたから。声かけちゃダメだったかな？:
What do you mean 'what's up'？
I just saw you. Am I not
allowed to say hi？
translations.ダメじゃないけど、ちょっと知り合いに用事があったから……。:
Not at all, I just had something
to take care of with someone
I know...
translations.あ、邪魔しちゃったんだ……ごめんね。それじゃあ私、行くから。:
Oh, so I'm in the way...
Sorry about that. Well,
I'll be going now.
translations.（なんか、気を遣わせちゃったな……）:
(Man, now I made her feel
awkward...)
translations.知り合いに声かけようとしてたとこだったから……。:
I was just about to go talk
to someone I know, so...
translations.私に用はないの？ なんて冗談……引き止めてごめんね。じゃあ、また。:
No business with me, then？
Just kidding... Sorry for holding
you up. Catch you later!
translations.ちょうどよかったよ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に聞きたいことがあったんだ。:
Good timing, actually.
There was something I wanted
to ask you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そうなの？ なにかな？: Is that so？ What is it？
translations.ありがとう、それだけわかれば大丈夫だよ。:
Thanks, that's all I
needed to know.
translations.困ったことがあったら、いつでもどうぞ♪ それじゃあ行くね。:
Whenever you need a hand,
just ask♪ Well, I'm off.
translations.（▲高嶺＊＊▲はまだいるかな……）:
(I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲
is still around...？)
translations.（▲小早川＊▲はまだいるかな……）:
(I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲
is still around...？)
translations.（待っててくれたり……するわけないか）:
(Wait up for me...？
No way, right.)
translations.こら……そんなに大きな声出さないの。用事だったらまた今度聞いてあげるから、ね。:
Hey now... Don't shout
so loud. If it's important,
I'll hear you out later, okay？
translations.（あれ……なんか、困らせちゃったか？）:
(Huh... Did I
bother her or something？)
translations.声かけてくれたのは嬉しいんだけど……もう教室に戻らないとダメなんだよな。:
I'm glad you stopped me,
but... I really have to get
back to class.
translations.もう？ じゃあ……また今度ゆっくり、ね。:
Already？ Well then...
Let's chat properly
next time, okay？
translations.すみませんっ、大丈夫ですか!? あっ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！:
I'm so sorry, are you okay！？
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
translations.うん、大丈夫みたい。じゃあ、私も急いでるから……またね。:
Yeah, I seem to be fine.
I'm in a rush too, though...
See you later.
translations.ほんとに大丈夫ならいいんだけど……。:
As long as you're
really okay...
translations.……あ、大丈夫。私もちゃんと注意してなくて、ごめんね？ じゃあ。:
...Ah, I'm fine.
I wasn't paying attention
either, sorry, okay？ Bye.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲にケガがなくてよかったよ……それじゃあ。:
I'm glad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wasn't
hurt... Well, see you.
translations.とりあえず今は急いでるから、ごめんっ。また！:
Anyway, I'm in a rush
right now, sorry! Later!
translations.あ……私のほうこそごめんね。じゃあ。:
Ah... I should be
the one apologizing. See you.
translations.私のほうこそ、ごめんね。ほら、急がなくちゃ。:
I'm sorry too.
Come on, we'd better hurry.
translations.あの……うん。……私、急ぐね？ それじゃあ。:
Um... yeah.
...I need to hurry, okay？
See you.
translations.ねえ、これ落としたんじゃないかな？:
Excuse me, didn't you
drop this？
translations.やっぱりあなただった。後ろ姿で、そうかなぁって思ったんだけど。:
I knew it was you.
I thought so from behind,
actually.
translations.どういたしまして。それじゃあ私は行かなくちゃいけないから。またね。:
You're very welcome.
Well, I've got to get going.
See you later.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が拾ってくれて助かったよ。:
Thanks for picking that up,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You saved me.
translations.ふふ、ちゃんと注意してなきゃダメだよ？:
Hehe, you have to pay
better attention, okay？
translations.素直でよろしい♪ じゃあ、またね。:
Good boy♪
Well, see you later.
translations.（年上だけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ってカワイイなぁ……）:
(She's older than me,
but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so cute...)
translations.あ、ごめん。ボーっとしてた。:
Ah, sorry.
I was spacing out.
translations.はい。シャキッとしなくちゃダメよ？ じゃあね。:
Here. You've gotta stay
sharp, okay？ See you.
translations.ごめん、なんかボーっとしちゃって。:
Sorry, I was kind of
spacing out.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲のおかげで助かったよ。ありがとう。:
You really saved me,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Thanks.
translations.お礼なんていいのよ。じゃあ私、急いでるから行くね。:
Don't mention it.
I'm in a rush though,
so I'll be going.
translations.そうだ、●も行かないと！ それじゃあ。:
Right, ● has to get
going too! See you.
translations.（次の教室って、こっちだったよな？）:
(The next classroom was
this way, right？)
translations.偶然見かけたから……。:
I just happened to spot
you, so...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の教室って、こっちだっけ？:
Was ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s classroom
over this way？
translations.ううん、次の授業は移動だから。あ……もう行くね。:
No, I have to change rooms
for next period.
Ah... I should get going.
translations.うん、いつもは違うんだけどね。今日は移動なんだって。:
Yeah. We don't usually,
but we have to today.
translations.へえ、それじゃあ偶然会ったってことか。:
Huh, so it really was just
a coincidence.
translations.ふふ、そうだね。それじゃあ、もう行かなくちゃ。バイバイ。:
Hehe, I guess so.
Well, I've gotta run.
Bye-bye.
translations.そうなんだ？ あ……でも、ごめん。●急ぐから。:
Oh, really？ Ah... sorry,
though. ●'s in a rush.
translations.そう……じゃあまたね。: I see... Well, see you later.
translations.（偶然見かけて、わざわざ話しかけてくれたのか……）:
(She spotted me and went
out of her way to say hi...)
translations.あ……そうだ●、次の教室行かないと。:
Ah... right, ● needs
to head to the next class.
translations.えっと……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、どこか行く途中だったんじゃ？:
Uh... weren't you on your
way somewhere, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.あっ、そう！ そうなの……じゃあ、行くね。:
Ah, right! That's it...
Well, I'll get going.
translations.（なんだ？ 急にあわてだして……）:
(What was that？
Panicking all of a sudden...)
translations.はい、これ。落としただろ？:
Here you go. You dropped
this, right？
translations.ありがとう。じゃあ急ぐから、またね。:
Thank you. I'm in a rush,
so see you later.
translations.あ、これ。落としただろ？:
Oh, here. You dropped this,
didn't you？
translations.気づかずに行っちゃうところだった。ありがとう。:
I would've walked off without
even noticing. Thank you.
translations.どういたしまして。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だとは思わなかったよ。:
You're welcome. Didn't
expect it to be you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.ほかの女の子がよかった？ ふふ……じゃあ、そろそろ行くね。:
Would you rather it was
another girl？ Hehe... Well,
I should get going.
translations.（まわりと比べちゃなんだけど……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はほんと、キレイだな）:
(Not to compare her to other
girls, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is
gorgeous...)
translations.あ……っと、これ。落しもの。:
Ah... um, here. You dropped
this.
translations.ありがとう。じゃあ、急ぎだから行くね。:
Thank you. Well, I'm in a
hurry, so I've gotta run.
translations.うん……あ、もう行かなきゃ。あの……ありがとうね。:
Yeah... Ah, I've gotta go.
Um... thank you.
translations.私の顔に……なにかついてる？:
Is there... something on my
face？
translations.ほら、ボーっとしてないで。:
Come on, don't just space
out like that.
translations.これは……ちょっと近いよね。:
This is... a little close,
don't you think？
translations.そんなに離れなくてもいいのに。:
You didn't have to back off
that far, you know.
translations.あ……今、わざと離れたでしょ？:
Ah... you backed away
on purpose just now,
didn't you？
translations.もっとこっち来なくて……いいの？:
Aren't you gonna come...
any closer？
translations.（つい、調子に乗っちゃったな……）:
(I got a little carried away
there...)
translations.（偶然って、なんかいいなぁ）:
(Running into each other by
chance is pretty nice.)
translations.上手くいくって思ってたよ。: I knew you could do it.
translations.うん、やっぱり期待通り。:
Yep, just as I expected.
Never doubted you.
translations.ふふ、それくらい、やっちゃうもんね。:
Hehe, of course you'd pull
something like that off.
translations.がんばったんだ。えらいえらい。:
You worked so hard!
Good boy, good boy.
translations.そうよね……あなたって、頼りになるもん。:
That's right...
You really are dependable.
translations.当然……なんて思ってる？ かっこいい。:
Thinking 'naturally'？
Look at you, Mr. Cool.
translations.大変じゃなかった？ がんばったね。:
Wasn't it tough？
You really hung in there.
translations.大丈夫大丈夫。: You'll be fine, you'll be fine.
translations.そんなに心配しなくてもいいよ。:
You don't need to worry
so much, okay？
translations.そこまで気にすることじゃないもんね。:
It's not something you need
to fret over that much anyway.
translations.あなたは強い子でしょ？ だから大丈夫。:
You're a strong boy, right？
So you'll be just fine.
translations.うん、仕方ない仕方ない。:
Yeah, it couldn't be helped,
can't be helped.
translations.落ち込まないで……ね？:
Don't let it get you down...
okay？
translations.ほーら、くよくよしない。ファイト！:
Come on now, no sulking!
You've got this!
translations.慰めてほしい？ ちょっとだけなら甘えてもいいよ。:
Want some comfort？
I'll let you lean on me
for just a little bit.
translations.ねえねえ、どうするの？: Hey, hey, what're you gonna do？
translations.うん、あなたが決めればいいと思うな。:
Mm, I think you should just
make the call yourself.
translations.どうするつもり？ もちろん……ね？:
What are you planning to do？
Of course... right？
translations.無理はしちゃダメよ？:
Don't push yourself too hard,
okay？
translations.それじゃあ、がんばらなきゃね。:
In that case,
you'd better give it your all.
translations.できるって、思ったんだ。: I knew you could do it.
translations.そうよね。無理してもしょうがないもん。:
That's true. No point
pushing yourself too hard.
translations.最近、テニス部ってどう？ ちゃんとがんばってる？:
How've things been in the
tennis club lately？
Working hard？
translations.まあぼちぼち。ウチの部そんなに厳しくないし、楽しくやってるよ。:
Pretty good, I guess.
We're not that strict,
so it's just fun.
translations.ん？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、部活に興味あるの？:
Hm？ Interested in club
activities, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ああ、違う違う。それは無理よ、バイトもあるし。私は両立できないな。:
Ah, no, no. That's impossible
with my job. I wouldn't be able
to juggle both.
translations.それは……テニス部って、男子と女子、仲良さそうじゃない？:
Well... don't the guys and girls
in the tennis club look like
they get along really well？
translations.まあ、割とそうかな。みんな仲いいね。:
Well, yeah, pretty much.
Everyone gets along great.
translations.●はどうかな……そこまででもないと思うけど……。:
●... I don't know. 
I don't think I'm that close, though...
translations.そう、なら……いいかな？: I see... Then that's fine, I guess？
translations.ねえねえ、ちょっと聞いていい？: Hey, can I ask you something？
translations.図書委員って……どんな雰囲気なの？ ほら、仲間同士。:
What's the library committee like？ 
You know, between the members.
translations.そうだな……全員がそこまで接するわけじゃないかな。:
Well... 
It's not like everyone interacts that much.
translations.そうなんだ。仲がいい人とか……いるの？:
Is that so. Do you have anyone... 
you're close with？
translations.えっ？ うーん、女子もいるかな。:
Huh？ Well... 
yeah, there are girls too.
translations.今度、のぞいてみようかな、図書室。:
Maybe I'll go take a peek 
at the library sometime.
translations.それは歓迎するけど……なんか気になる？:
You're always welcome to, but... 
is something on your mind？
translations.ううん、こっちの話だから、大丈夫。:
No, just talking to myself. 
Don't worry about it.
translations.あなたってクラスではどうなの？ 仲がいい子とかいる？:
How are you doing in class？ 
Do you have friends you're close with？
translations.そっか。デキシーズでもそうだもんね、けっこうすぐに仲良くなれるほうなのかな。:
I see. You're like that 
at Dixie's too. I guess you 
make friends pretty easily.
translations.どうかな。そこまで社交的ってわけじゃないと思うけど。:
I don't know. 
I wouldn't say I'm that outgoing.
translations.そんなことないよ。私は、あなたとは付き合いやすいって思うよ。:
That's not true. 
I think you're really 
easy to get along with.
translations.そう？ ならうれしいけど。:
Really？ 
Well, I'm glad to hear that.
translations.うーん、やっぱり女子からも人気あるのかなあ。:
Hmm, I wonder if you're popular 
with the girls, too...
translations.んー？ なにも言ってませんよ？: Hmm？ I didn't say a thing？
translations.あなたって一人暮らしじゃない。どんな感じ？:
You live on your own, right？ 
What's that like？
translations.まあ気楽なもんだよ、好き勝手にやってる感じ。:
Pretty carefree, honestly. 
I just do whatever I want.
translations.へえ、家事とかもバッチリ？:
Oh？ And you've got housework 
all handled？
translations.あ、ふふ。そうでもないんだ。: Ah, hehe. So not quite, huh.
translations.はは、まあね。誰か手伝ってくんないかなー、なんてね。:
Haha, yeah. Sure wish someone 
would help me out, though.
translations.もう、そんなこと言うと、ほんとに行っちゃうぞ？:
Geez, say things like that 
and I might actually come over, 
you know？
translations.それはうれしいけど……さすがに悪いかな。:
I'd love that, but... 
I'd feel bad making you.
translations.悪いことはないけど……ううん、そうよね。:
You shouldn't feel bad, 
but... no, you're right.
translations.テニス部に、仲のいい同級生がいるの？:
Do you have a classmate 
in the tennis club you're close with？
translations.図書委員に、仲のいい後輩がいるの？:
Is there an underclassman
on the library committee
you're close with？
translations.ううん、あんまり気にしてもしょうがないよね。:
No, no point worrying
about it too much, right？
translations.まあね。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方がよく話すよ。:
Yeah. I talk with
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ way more.
translations.（うれしそうだな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks pretty
happy about that.)
translations.ちょっと、調査したいことがあるんだけど。:
There's something I want
to investigate a little.
translations.テニス部に、仲のいい同級生がいるよね。:
You've got a close classmate
in the tennis club, right？
translations.図書委員に、仲のいい後輩がいるよね。:
You've got a close
underclassman on the
library committee, right？
translations.ふーん、いるんだ。そんなに仲いいんだ。:
Hmm, so you do.
You're really that close？
translations.そりゃあ……困るでしょ。:
Well... of course
it's a problem.
translations.悪くはないけど、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲の方が仲良いかもね。:
We get along, but I'm
closer with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そっか。ふふ、ならいいの。:
I see. Fufu,
that's fine then.
translations.ちょっと気になることがあるんだけど。:
There's something I've been
a little curious about.
translations.テニス部に、仲のいい同級生がいるって聞いて。:
I heard you're close
with a classmate in the
tennis club.
translations.図書委員に、仲のいい後輩がいるって聞いて。:
I heard you're close
with an underclassman on
the library committee.
translations.でも、私だって、あなたと仲良しでしょ？:
But hey, you and I 
are close too, right？
translations.……じゃあ、いい。負けないから。:
...Then that's fine. 
I'm not gonna lose.
translations.なんだ……ちょっと拍子抜け。:
Oh... That's a bit of 
a letdown.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲との方が、よく話すよ。:
I talk to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ 
way more, anyway.
translations.そっか……そうよね。ふふ。:
Is that so... 
Yeah, you're right. Hehe.
translations.あなたって、私といるの、退屈じゃない？:
Aren't you bored 
spending time with me？
translations.ならいいんだけど……私って、つまらない女かなって。:
That's good, then... 
I just wondered if maybe 
I'm a boring woman.
translations.どうしたの急に。ほんと、そんなことないって。:
Where's this coming from？ 
Seriously, that's not true.
translations.うん、ちょっと不安になったんだけど……。あなたがそう言ってくれるなら、大丈夫。:
Yeah, I got a bit worried, 
but... If you say so, 
then I'm okay.
translations.●なんかの意見でいいの？:
You're okay with someone 
like ●'s opinion？
translations.あなたの意見じゃなきゃ、意味ないの。:
It has to be your opinion, 
or it means nothing.
translations.どういう意味？: What do you mean by that？
translations.イジめると、ちょっとカワイイよね？:
You're kind of cute 
when you get teased, huh？
translations.ふふ、ちょっとじゃないか。だいぶカワイイ▼:
Hehe, maybe more than 
a little. Super cute▼
translations.やーだ。だって面白いんだもん。:
No way. 
It's just too fun.
translations.ふふ、まんざらじゃないって顔してるけど。:
Hehe, but your face 
says you don't mind at all.
translations.ねえねえ、あなたはキレイなお姉さんが好き？:
Hey, hey, do you like 
pretty older girls？
translations.それとも……カワイイお姉さんが好き？:
Or do you... 
like cute older girls？
translations.どうだろ……どっちも好き、かな？:
I don't know... 
I guess I like both？
translations.ははは……なんの話？:
Hahaha... 
What is this even about？
translations.（こんな洋館あったんだ……なんか雰囲気あるな……）:
(I didn't know this Western 
mansion was here... 
It's got real atmosphere...)
translations.やっぱり、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だ。どうしたの、こんなところで。:
I knew it, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. 
What are you doing 
all the way out here？
translations.そっかそっか、私もそうかな。:
I see, I see.
Guess I am too, kind of.
translations.そう？ なんか中を見てたみたいだけど。:
Really？ It looked like
you were peeking inside.
translations.……ずっと見てたの？:
...Were you watching me
the whole time？
translations.ずっとってわけじゃないけど、少し。:
Not the whole time,
just for a bit.
translations.あのね、なんだか雰囲気のある建物だなって思って。その、ホラー映画に出てきそうな。:
Well, I just thought it had
such a cool atmosphere.
Like from a horror movie.
translations.あー、わかるわかる。そっか、好きなんだっけ、ホラー。:
Ah, I get that.
Right, you love horror,
don't you？
translations.うん……やっぱり変よね、こんなところでぼーっとして。:
Yeah... It is pretty weird,
though, isn't it？ Spacing
out in a place like this.
translations.そう？ ほんと？ じゃあ、こういう建物って――:
Really？ Truly？
Well, with buildings like this――
translations.だから、門に鉄柵があれば完璧なんだけど……。:
If the gate had iron bars,
it'd be totally perfect...
translations.うん……▲姉ヶ崎＊▲がほんとにホラー好きってことは、よくわかったよ。:
Yeah... I can tell you're
really into horror, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.あっ……私、話しすぎた、かな。:
Ah... Did I talk
a bit too much？
translations.いいって、面白かったし！: Not at all, it was fun!
translations.ごめんね、つい。あまりこういう話を人にすることがなくて。:
Sorry, I got carried away.
I don't usually talk about
this stuff with people.
translations.そうなんだ、趣味仲間いないんだ。:
I see, no friends who share
the hobby, huh.
translations.ホラー好きの女子高生って、そんなにいないよ。だから、あまり人には語らないようにし:
Not many high school girls
are into horror.
So I try not to go on
about it to people, but...
translations.あなたには語っちゃった、ごめんね。もう行くから。:
I went on and on with you.
Sorry about that.
I should get going.
translations.そっか、結構話してたもんな。じゃあ、この話はまた今度。:
Yeah, we talked for a while.
Let's pick this up
another time, then.
translations.えっと……お手柔らかに。: Umm... go easy on me, though.
translations.ふふ、冗談。じゃあね。:
Fufu, just kidding.
See you later.
translations.（落ち着いて見えるけど、こういうところもあるんだな、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って）:
(She seems so mature,
but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ has this
side to her too, huh.)
translations.（ファンシーショップ……ってやつか、用はないな……）:
(A cute gift shop, huh...
Nothing here for me...)
translations.……なんだ、あなたか。おどろかせちゃった？:
...Oh, it's just you.
Did I scare you？
translations.少しね。こっちもいきなり声かけてごめん。:
A little. Sorry for calling
out so suddenly, too.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、こういうところ来るんだな、って思って。:
I was just thinking...
I didn't expect to see you
in a shop like this, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.私がここにいるの、そんなにおかしい？:
Is it really that weird
for me to be here？
translations.だってほら、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って大人っぽいし、こういうカワイイ感じっていうよりは、も:
Well, you're pretty mature,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You seem more elegant
than 'super cute'.
translations.私だって女子高生だもん、カワイイの大好きだよ？:
I'm a high school girl, too!
I love cute things,
you know？
translations.もう、ひどい。ほらほら、見て。これなんかカワイイでしょ？:
Geez, meanie.
Look, look! Isn't this
really cute？
translations.そろそろ行かなきゃ。ごめんね、つき合わせて。:
I should get going soon.
Sorry for dragging you around.
translations.いいよ。一人だとこういう店、入れないし、新鮮で楽しかった。:
Don't worry about it.
I'd never walk in here alone,
so it was a fun change of pace.
translations.そう？ ならいいけど。じゃあ、またね。:
Really？ Glad to hear it.
Well, see you later!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、こういうのもいけるのか）:
(Huh, so ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is into
stuff like this too.)
translations.そうね、あなたもお買い物？:
Yeah. Are you out
shopping too？
translations.●は通りかかっただけ。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲はなんか買うの？:
● was just passing by.
Are ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looking to
buy something？
translations.うん、いいスカートないかなーって。:
Yeah, just seeing if I can
find a nice skirt.
translations.ふーん。ここ、よく来るの？:
Huh. Do you come here
often？
translations.ちょくちょく。割と好きかな。ここで買って自分でリメイクしたり。簡単なのだけどね。:
Pretty often. I kind of like
it. I buy stuff here and
alter it myself. Just simple
things, though.
translations.そんな大したことじゃないけど……。:
It's really not that big
a deal, though...
translations.せっかくこんなところで会ったんだもん、ちょっとお互いの服、見立ててみない？:
Since we ran into each other
here, why don't we pick out
an outfit for each other？
translations.じゃあ決まり。そうだな、あなたにはね……。:
Then it's settled! Let's
see, for you...
translations.うんうん、お似合いですよ。お客様だったら、なにに合わせてもＯＫ！:
Yep, suits you perfectly!
A customer like you could
pull off anything!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ウェイトレスだけじゃなくてこういうのも得意？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you good at
this kind of thing too,
not just waitressing？
translations.そうなの。ごめん、私もう行くね。:
Yeah. Sorry, I've gotta
get going.
translations.バイバイ。……楽しかったよ、デートみたいで。:
Bye-bye. ...I had fun,
it almost felt like a date.
translations.（……たしかに、ちょっとデートみたいだったな）:
(...It really did feel a bit
like a date, though.)
translations.はあ、やっと終わった。帰るか……。:
Phew, finally done.
Time to head home...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。そっちも終わりだよな、お疲れ様。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You're done for
the day too, right？
Good work.
translations.お疲れ様。私は、まだ仕事があって。:
Good work. I actually still
have some work left to do.
translations.うん、ホールでの仕事はね。これから本部に提出する書類の作成。:
Yeah, my floor shift is.
Now I have to prepare some
documents for headquarters.
translations.んー、でも慣れちゃったから。:
Mm, but I'm used to it
by now.
translations.無理しない方がいいと思うけど……。:
You shouldn't push yourself
too hard, though...
translations.でも大丈夫、無理はしてないから。気持ちだけ受け取っておくね。:
I'm fine, really. I'm not
pushing myself. I appreciate
the thought, though.
translations.もう、寧々先輩の心配するなんて、まだ早いぞ。あなたはまず、自分の仕事をしっかり覚:
Geez, it's way too early
for you to worry about
Nene-senpai! First, you
need to master your own job.
translations.そうすれば、私もみんなも、楽になるから。:
Once you do that, it'll make
things easier for me and
everyone else, too.
translations.はい、よろしい。気をつけて帰ってね。:
Good boy.
Get home safe, okay？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。ん、なに読んでんの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hm, what are you
reading？
translations.前に、試写会に行った映画のパンフ。:
The brochure from that movie
preview we went to.
translations.気に入っちゃったんだもん。だから、また観るのも楽しみ。:
I just loved it so much.
So I can't wait to see it
again.
translations.だな。それ、見せてもらってもいい？ ２回目観る前に復習しておこっかな。:
Yeah. Mind if I see that？
Thought I'd brush up before
seeing it a second time.
translations.どうぞどうぞ。一緒に読も？:
Go right ahead!
Want to read it together？
translations.私もう休憩終わりだから、行くね。:
My break's about over,
so I've gotta go.
translations.ほんとに、楽しみだなあ……。:
I'm really looking forward
to it...
translations.今度は二人で観るから、ね？:
Because this time,
it's just the two of us,
right？
translations.（二人で映画……それって完全に……）:
(A movie with just the two
of us... That's totally a...)
translations.今日、同じ時間にあがりでしょ？\nその後時間あったら、\nご飯でも、どう？:
We get off at the same time
today, right？ If you're free
after, want to grab dinner？
translations.そっか。急だったもんね。:
I see. It was pretty short
notice, after all.
translations.そうね、そうする。じゃあ、お疲れ様。:
Sure, will do.
Good work today, then.
translations.お疲れ様。今日もがんばったね。:
Good work. You really worked
hard today, too.
translations.うーん……たしかにがんばった！:
Yeah... I definitely gave it
my all！
translations.前に話した、一人前のお祝い、今日はどう？ 一緒にご飯行く？:
How about today for that
celebration we talked about？
Want to get dinner together？
translations.今日も都合が悪くて……。:
Today's not good for me
either...
translations.しかたないよ。じゃあ、お疲れ様。:
Can't be helped.
Well, good work today.
translations.次の日曜は用事が……。:
I've got plans this coming
Sunday...
translations.そっか。じゃあ、日をずらそうかな。:
I see. Maybe we should pick
another day, then.
translations.ううん、大丈夫。じゃあ、またね。:
No, don't worry about it.
See you later, then.
translations.（迷惑かけちゃったかな）:
(Hope I didn't cause her
any trouble...)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。前に話した、新メニューのアイディア出しなんだけど……。:
▲主人公＊▲. About brainstorming
ideas for that new menu we
talked about...
translations.ごめん、次の日曜はまた用事で……。:
Sorry, next Sunday I've got
plans again...
translations.ごめん、何度も。:
Sorry for turning you down
again.
translations.しかたないよ。気にしないでね。:
It can't be helped.
Don't worry about it, okay？
translations.まだ観に行かなくてもいいかな: No need to rush to see it
translations.まだいいかな。長くやってるみたいだし。:
Maybe not just yet.
It looks like it'll be
running for a while.
translations.急いで行く必要もないしさ。:
There's no need to rush,
anyway.
translations.（さて、休憩だ……今の時間、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲もいるかな）:
(Alright, break time...
I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
around right now.)
translations.▲主人公＊▲。例の試写会の映画。どうする？:
▲主人公＊▲. What do you wanna do
about that movie from the
preview screening？
translations.そろそろ、行かなきゃな: We should go see it soon
translations.まだ観に行かなくてもいいよ: No need to go see it yet
translations.まだいいよ。しばらくやってるしさ。:
No need to rush yet.
It'll be playing for a while
anyway.
translations.まあ気が向いたら行こうよ。:
Well, we can go whenever
we feel like it.
translations.即答できなきゃダメです。正解は、初デートのお誘いです。:
You have to answer right
away! The correct answer:
an invite to our first date.
translations.じゃあ細かいことは後で決めよ。:
We can work out the details
later, then.
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲とデート……恋人同士って感じだ！）:
(A date with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Now it really feels like
we're a couple!)
translations.（初デートの待ち合わせ、ちょっと緊張するな……）:
(Meeting up for our first date...
I'm a little nervous...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、もう来てるかな……）:
(I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
here already...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。ごめん、待たせた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Sorry, did I keep
you waiting？
translations.ううん、全然。もう少し待ってもよかったくらい。:
No, not at all. In fact,
I wouldn't have minded
waiting a little longer.
translations.だって、待ってる間、楽しかったんだもん。:
Because waiting for you was
actually really fun.
translations.うん、新発見。カレシを待つのって、ちょっと楽しい。:
Yeah, a brand-new discovery.
Waiting for my boyfriend is
actually kind of fun.
translations.へえー……あ、でもできるだけ待たせないようにするよ。:
Huh... Ah, but I'll still do
my best not to keep you
waiting.
translations.大丈夫。今日は私が早く来すぎただけだから。行こ？:
Don't worry about it. I just
got here way too early today.
Shall we？
translations.今更だけど……また映画でよかったの？:
A bit late to ask, but...
were you really okay with
the movies again？
translations.うん、映画がよかったの。好きだし、それに……。:
Yeah, I wanted to see a movie.
I like them, and besides...
translations.前に一緒に観たときは、あなたのことで悩んでたから、１００％は楽しめてなかったの。:
Last time we went together,
I was worrying so much about
you that I couldn't enjoy it
100%.
translations.ふふ、謝ることじゃないでしょ。:
Fufu, no need to apologize
for that.
translations.とにかく、今日はそのリベンジも込めて。思い切り楽しんじゃうの。:
Anyway, today's my revenge
match. I'm gonna enjoy
every single second.
translations.大丈夫？ えっと、ハンカチ……。:
Are you okay？
Here, a handkerchief...
translations.ん、大丈夫だから……ごめんね。はあ……。:
Mm, I'm okay...
Sorry about that. Whew...
translations.今日は恋愛映画なんだな、ホラーじゃなくてよかったの？:
So a romance movie today.
You sure you didn't
want a horror flick？
translations.ホラーしか好きなわけじゃないよ。それに……カレシとの初デートがホラー映画なんて、:
Horror isn't the only
thing I like. Besides...
a horror movie for our
first date as a couple？
No way.
translations.顔、あんまり見ないでね。きっとぐしゃぐしゃ。:
Don't look at my face
too much, okay？
I must look a total mess.
translations.そんなことないよ。えっと……キレイだけど。:
Not at all. Uh...
you still look pretty.
translations.なんだか、結構遅くなっちゃったな。:
Man, it got pretty late
on us, huh？
translations.そうだね……今日はもう帰らないと。ごめんね、せっかくの初デートなのに。:
Yeah... I really should head
home. Sorry, especially for
our first date.
translations.うん……寄り道は、また今度の楽しみかな。:
Mm... We'll save exploring
around for next time.
translations.ねえ……またデートしてね？:
Hey... will you take me
out on another date？
translations.たくさん、デートしようね。:
Let's go on lots and
lots of dates, okay？
translations.ふふ、約束。……行こっか？:
Fufu, it's a promise.
...Shall we go？
translations.じゃあ、よろしくお願いします。: Well then, I'm in your hands.
translations.今日はありがとう。初デート、成功だね。:
Thanks for today.
First date: total success.
translations.成功か……これからも失敗しないようにがんばるよ。:
A success, huh...
I'll do my best to
keep it up from now on.
translations.ふふ、期待してるよ？:
Fufu, I've got high
expectations, you know？
translations.でも、失敗したっていいよ。:
But it's totally okay
even if you do mess up.
translations.いいことも悪いことも、なんでも一緒に経験したいから。:
The good and the bad,
I want to experience
it all with you.
translations.いいことだけじゃなくて、これからあなたとすること全部が楽しみなの。:
Not just the good stuff.
I'm looking forward
to every single thing
we do together.
translations.うん……ねえ、お別れの挨拶……。:
Yeah... Hey, how about
our goodbye...？
translations.（カノジョができて……デートして……これからどんどん楽しくなりそうだな！）:
(Got a girlfriend... went on
a date... Things are gonna
get so much fun from here！)
translations.あ、ちゃんと来た。花壇の世話……よろしくね。:
Oh, you actually came.
Take good care of the
flowerbeds, okay？
translations.（あ、花壇の世話……\n遅くなったし、また次でいいか）:
(Oh, the flowerbeds...
It's late, so I'll just
do it next time.)
translations.（あ、花壇の世話……遅くなったけど、行ってみるか）:
(Oh, the flowerbeds...
It's late, but I might
as well go check it out.)
translations.（あ、花壇の世話……遅くなったし、今日はもう帰るか）:
(Oh, the flowerbeds...
It's late, so I think
I'll just head home today.)
translations.あのさ、タヌキの形した消しゴム探してるんだけど、知らないか？:
Hey, I'm looking for
a tanuki-shaped eraser.
Seen it anywhere？
translations.あー、隣のクラスの女子が拾ったとか言ってたな……。:
Oh, yeah, a girl from the 
class next door said 
she found one...
translations.（よし、見つかった。▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に渡そう）:
(Alright, found it. 
I'll go give it to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
translations.（見つからないな……しょうがない、また今度探すか）:
(Can't find it... 
Oh well, I'll look again 
another time.)
translations.（よし、バイトがんばるぞ）:
(Alright, time to give it 
my all at work!)
translations.（なんか用事あった気がするけど……なんだっけ）:
(Feel like I had something 
to do... What was it again？)
translations.（結構時間かかったな……今からじゃもう遅いか……）:
(That took quite a while... 
Probably too late now...)
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲も来てるよな……あっ）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ should be here too... 
Ah.)
translations.あ……ちゃんと来てくれたね。さぁ、今日から頑張ろ。:
Ah... You made it. 
Alright, let's do our best 
starting today!
translations.今日もちゃんと来てくれた。えらいえらい。:
You came today too. 
Such a good boy.
translations.お疲れさま。今日もゴミ拾い頑張ろ。:
Thanks for coming. 
Let's do our best picking 
up trash today too!
translations.（結構時間くったな……もう間に合わないか）:
(That took quite a while... 
Won't make it in time now.)
translations.じゃあ、はじめるか。書類作り。:
Alright, let's get started 
on the paperwork.
translations.（結構時間くったな……今から行ってももう遅いか）:
(That took quite a while... 
Probably too late to go now.)
translations.（結構時間くったけど……行ってみるか）:
(That took quite a while, 
but... might as well go see.)
translations.はい、それじゃあ特訓始めようか。:
Alright, shall we start 
our special training？
translations.うん、今日も来た来た。特訓、始めよう。:
Yep, you're here today too! 
Let's get training.
translations.さあ、今日も特訓、気合い入れていこうね。:
Come on, let's give it 
everything we've got for 
training today!
translations.（結構時間くったな……今日はもう特訓無理か）:
(That took quite a while... 
Probably no time for special 
training today.)
translations.それじゃあ、今日から３日間よろしくね。:
Well then, looking forward 
to the next three days 
with you!
translations.待ってたよ。お散歩行こ？:
I was waiting for you. 
Wanna go for a walk？
translations.さあ、今日もボディーガードお願いします。:
Now then, I'm counting on 
my bodyguard today too!
translations.（結構時間くったな……今から▲姉ヶ崎＊▲に付き合うのは無理か）:
(That took quite a while... 
Too late to go with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ 
now, I guess.)
translations.ふふ、一緒に出勤ってちょっと照れちゃうね。:
Hehe, heading to work 
together makes me 
a little shy.
translations.さあ、今日もお仕事頑張ろ！:
Alright, let's do our best 
at work today too!
translations.（結構時間くったな……今から▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に行くのは無理か）:
(That took quite a while... 
Too late to go with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ 
now, I guess.)
translations.（結構時間くったけど……今から▲姉ヶ崎＊▲と一緒に行けるかな？）:
(That took quite a while, 
but... wonder if I can 
still go with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？)
translations.さぁて、新メニュー開発、頑張るよ！:
Alright, time to give
this new menu development
my all!
translations.うん……やっぱり一人で考えるより、誰かと一緒の方がいいね。:
Yeah... Doing this with
someone is definitely better
than brainstorming alone.
translations.ねえ、なにが食べたい？ ……これじゃあデートみたいだね、ふふ。:
Hey, what do you feel like
eating？ ...This kinda feels
like a date, doesn't it？
Hehe.
translations.もう、それだけじゃ参考にならないでしょ。ふふ。:
Geez, that doesn't really
give me much to go on,
you know？ Hehe.
translations.（結構時間くったな……今からじゃもう遅いか）:
(That ate up a lot of
time... Too late to go now,
I guess.)
translations.（結構時間くったけど……今から行けるかな）:
(Took quite a while, but...
wonder if I can still go？)
translations.それじゃあ、今日からよろしくね。厳しくて優しい評価をお願いします♪:
Well then, I'm counting on
you starting today. Firm yet
gentle feedback, please♪
translations.厳しく優しいか……難しいな。:
Firm yet gentle, huh...
That's a tall order.
translations.さて、今日もアドバイスお願いね？:
Alright, I'll be needing
your advice again today,
okay？
translations.よーし、おいしいって言わせるように頑張るからね。:
Alright! I'll do my best
to make you say it's
delicious!
translations.（結構時間くったな……今からだともう遅いか）:
(That ate up a lot of
time... Probably too late
now, I guess.)
translations.（結構時間くったけど……今からでも大丈夫かな？）:
(Took quite a while, but...
wonder if I'll still be okay？)
translations.ねえ。今、誰かとお話してた？:
Hey. Were you just talking
to someone？
translations.そうなんだ……じゃあ、行こ？:
Oh, really...?
Well, shall we go？
translations.久しぶり……でもないけど、そういえばしばらくちゃんと話してなかったっけ。:
It's been a while... Well,
not really, but come to think
of it, we haven't talked
properly in a while, have we？
translations.ふふ、あなたはカノジョの相手で忙しいみたいだし。:
Hehe, you look pretty busy
spending time with your
girlfriend, after all.
translations.今日も待ち合わせかな。邪魔しちゃ悪いから、行くね。:
Meeting up with her today, too？
I'd hate to get in the way,
so I'll get going.
translations.あ、偶然。……ねえ、カノジョって、友達の女の子と話してるだけで嫉妬するタイプ？:
Oh, what a coincidence.
...Hey, is your girlfriend
the type to get jealous if
you just talk to other girls？
translations.やっぱりカノジョができてから付き合い悪くなった気がするな……気のせい？:
I feel like you don't hang
out as much ever since you
got a girlfriend...
Or is it just me？
translations.ふふ。ちゃーんと男を磨いてるかな？:
Hehe. Are you working hard
on being a better man？
translations.あ、ねえねえ。また前みたいに頼みごとしてもいいよね。あ……やっぱりやめておいた方:
Oh, hey, hey. I can still ask
you for favors like before,
right？ Ah... maybe I'd better
not, though.
translations.カノジョと遊んでばっかりじゃなくて、バイトもきちんとね。:
Don't just fool around with
your girlfriend, make sure you
take your job seriously, too.
translations.恋人がいるのって、やっぱり楽しい？ ……ごめん、やっぱり今のナシ！:
Is having someone special
really that fun？ ...Sorry,
forget I asked that！
translations.カノジョ、最近可愛いってウワサ。幸せ者だね。:
Word is your girlfriend's
really cute lately.
You're one lucky guy.
translations.ラブラブしてる？ なーんて、オバさんくさい？:
Are you two all lovey-dovey？
...Just kidding, do I sound
like an old lady？
translations.んー、どこかぱーっと遊びに行きたいなー…………あ、ごめんね、独り言。:
Mmm, I'd love to just go
cut loose somewhere...
...Ah, sorry, just talking
to myself.
translations.ねえ、休みの日とかって、どうしてるの？ 聞くだけ野暮かな？:
Hey, what do you do on your
days off？ ...Or is it nosy
of me to even ask？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。たまにはおしゃべり付き合ってね。:
▲主人公＊▲. Chat with me
once in a while, okay？
translations.ふぁ……最近映画ばっかり観ちゃって。趣味に没頭できて、楽しいけどね。:
*yawn*... I've been doing nothing
but watching movies lately.
It's fun losing myself in
a hobby, though.
translations.最近、きちんと生活してる？ 私が心配しなくても、大丈夫かな。:
Are you taking proper care
of yourself lately？ I guess
I don't need to worry, though.
translations.テニス部の練習って、厳しいの？\n両立するのって難しそうだけど、\nがんばってね:
Is tennis practice tough？
Balancing that with work
must be hard, but do your best.
translations.図書委員の活動って、大変？ 委員の後にバイト、なんてこともあるのかな。無理しない:
Is library committee tough？
Do you ever have to work
a shift right after？
Don't push yourself too hard.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。どう、何か問題起きてない？:
▲主人公＊▲. How's it going？
Any problems pop up？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。大丈夫、ちゃんとやってるよ。:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm fine,
everything's under control.
translations.よろしい。その調子でお願いね。:
Very good. Keep up the good
work, okay？
translations.まあね、バイトとはいえ、仕事だし。:
Well, yeah. Even if it's
just part-time, it's still work.
translations.えらいえらい、応援してるぞ。:
Good boy, good boy.
I'm rooting for you!
translations.▲主人公＊▲。無理してない？:
▲主人公＊▲. You aren't
pushing yourself too hard, are you？
translations.え、ううん、大丈夫。無理してるように見えた？:
Eh, no, I'm okay.
Did I look like I was
overdoing it？
translations.そういうわけじゃないけど。バイト以外にも色々してるでしょ？:
Not necessarily. But you've
got a lot going on besides
work, right？
translations.平気だって。心配ありがと。:
I'm fine, really.
Thanks for worrying about me.
translations.今日も終わりまで、がんばろうね。:
Let's do our best until the end
of our shift today, okay？
translations.▲主人公＊▲。最近、調子はどう？:
▲主人公＊▲. How have things
been going lately？
translations.最近？ うーん、問題なくやれてると思うけど。:
Lately？ Hmm, I think I'm
managing without any problems.
translations.そっか、ならいいの。がんばって。:
I see, that's good then.
Keep at it.
translations.▲主人公＊▲。最近、何か困ったことある？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Is anything troubling
you lately？
translations.困ったこと……特にはないかな、大丈夫。:
Trouble...？ Not really,
I'm doing fine.
translations.なら安心。何か私にできることあったら、遠慮なく言ってね。:
That's a relief.
If there's anything I can do,
don't hesitate to ask, okay？
translations.うん、ありがと。頼りにしてる。:
Yeah, thanks.
I'm counting on you.
