but I don't think I can...
Hey, will you help me out？
translations.あ、修学旅行中だっけ……。:
Oh wait,
we're on a school trip...
translations.私も～……\n食べ過ぎちゃった……。:
Me too...
I ate way too much...
translations.腹ごなしに、ちょっと散歩する？\nホテルの中？:
Wanna take a walk to walk
it off？ Just around the hotel？
translations.あ、探検でしょ？\nいいよ、しよっか？:
Oh, like exploring？
Sure, let's do it!
translations.いろいろあるな……\n名産に、宇都宮餃子、\nご当地限定菓子もたくさん……。:
They've got a lot...
Local specialties, Utsunomiya
gyoza, regional snacks...
translations.うん、宇都宮餃子。\nお母さんに頼まれてるの。\n栃木だから、きっとあるって。:
Yeah, Utsunomiya gyoza.
My mom asked for some.
Said since we're in Tochigi,
they're sure to have them.
translations.あ、そうだ！\nさっき、見付けたんだけど、\nゲームコーナー、行ってみよ？:
Oh, right!
I spotted it earlier, but...
wanna check out the arcade？
translations.卓球？\nう～ん、浴衣だからなぁ……。:
Ping-pong？
Mmm, but in a yukata...
I don't know...
translations.浴衣だから、いいんだよっ！:
Being in yukatas is what
makes it great!
translations.そういうもの？\nじゃあ、やる？:
Is that how it works？
Well then, shall we？
translations.もうっ！\nテニス部なんだから、\nちょっと手加減してっ！:
Geez!
You're on the tennis team,
you should go easy on me!
translations.ウソ。右に行ったり\n左に行ったり、わざと、\nやるんだもん。裾が乱れて――:
Liar! You kept hitting left
and right on purpose!
My robe was opening up—
translations.あ……そういうこと？\nもうっ！\n男子ってサイテー！:
Wait... is that why？
Geez!
Boys are the worst!
translations.ハァ……\n誰かさんのせいで\n汗かいちゃった。:
Phew...
I got all sweaty thanks to
a certain someone.
translations.ゴメン……\nそう言えば、貸切風呂の\nチケット貰ったっけ。:
Sorry...
Come to think of it,
didn't we get tickets for
the private bath？
translations.そうしよっか！\nあ、待って、\n水着いるでしょ？:
Let's!
Wait a second,
we need swimsuits, right？
translations.（しっかりしてるよな、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って……）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really has her act
together...)
translations.あ、ほら、\nあそこじゃない？:
Oh, look!
Isn't that it over there？
translations.風情があるよね？\n入ろう！:
It's got so much charm!
Let's go in!
translations.ねぇ、木のお風呂って、\n贅沢だよね？\nお殿様みたいで。:
Hey, a wooden bath is so
luxurious, isn't it？
Like being a lord.
translations.ふふ！\nじゃあ、お背中流しましょうか？\nお殿様？:
Fufu!
Shall I wash your back,
milord？
translations.うん。\nじゃあ、先に上がって、\n外で待ってて？:
Yeah.
Can you get out first
and wait outside for me？
translations.だって、水着着たまま\n帰れないでしょ？\n着替えなきゃ……。:
I mean, we can't head back
in our swimsuits, right？
I have to change...
translations.ハァ～～！\n殿サマ気分だ！:
Aaaah!
I feel like a lord!
translations.ふふ、\n修学旅行なのにね？:
Fufu,
even though this is supposed
to be a school trip？
translations.そうだった……。\n本当の修学旅行じゃ、\nさすがに、これは無理だね？:
Oh yeah, right...
On a real school trip,
this'd never happen, huh？
translations.待って。\nそれじゃ、えぇとね。\nう～ん……。:
Wait.
In that case, let's see...
Mmm...
translations.じゃあ、ここでは休憩。\nはい。\n背中流してあげる。:
So we'll take a break here.
Come here,
I'll wash your back.
translations.はぁ……。\nいいお湯だったね～？:
Phew...
That was a nice bath,
wasn't it？
translations.いや、ほら、\n浴衣姿が、似合うなって。:
Well, you know...
That yukata really
suits you.
translations.でしょ？\n素直でよろしい。\nふふ♪:
Right？
Good boy for being honest.
Hehe♪
translations.ねぇ、今、なに考えたか、\nわかっちゃった……。:
Hey, I totally know
what you were just
thinking about...
translations.はい、ここからまた、\n修学旅行だよ？\nふふ▼:
Alright, back to our
school trip now, okay？
Hehe▼
translations.ねぇ、ちょっと、\n遠回りして、部屋に戻らない？:
Hey, want to take the long
way back to the room？
translations.なんでも。\n行こう？:
No reason.
Come on, let's go？
translations.さっきから、なんの事？:
What have you been talking
about this whole time？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nここって、キャンドルがあって、\nロマンチックじゃない？:
Hey, look...
With the candles and all,
isn't this place romantic？
translations.なにか、言いたくならない？:
Doesn't it make you want
to say something？
translations.ハァ……\nわかんないか、男子には……。:
*sigh*...
Boys just don't get it,
do they...
translations.まくら投げやらなきゃ！:
We have to have
a pillow fight!
translations.まくら投げ？\n……二人で？:
A pillow fight？
...Just the two of us？
translations.ね、やろうやろう！:
Come on, let's do it,
let's do it!
translations.う～ん……\nなんか、違う？:
Hmm...
Doesn't this feel a bit off？
translations.どっちかって言うと、\nキャッチボールだな、これは。:
Feels more like
playing catch than anything.
translations.やられた……\nじゃあ、こっちも！:
You got me...
Take this, then!
translations.ここって、ほら、\nベッドでしょ？\n修学旅行は、お布団だよね？:
I mean, look,
we've got beds here, right？
A school trip needs futons!
translations.ああ、\nそういうイメージだよね？:
Ah, yeah,
that's how you picture it,
huh？
translations.お布団なら、\nゴロゴロ出来るし、\nあ、それにほら！:
With futons, you can
roll around, and oh, look!
translations.お布団かぶって、\n怖い話とか、ね？\nあるでしょ？:
Huddling under the blankets
to tell scary stories...
That's part of it, right？
translations.それなら、ベッドでも出来るよ！: We could do that in bed too!
translations.え……\nでも、それじゃ、\nどっちかのベッドに、ほら……。:
Huh...？
B-But then we'd have to be
in the same bed, you know...
translations.なんか、ダメ……\nなんか、違う気がするもん……。:
That's just, no...
It feels completely
different...
translations.（やっぱ、そうなるか……）:
（Yeah, figured that's
how she'd take it...）
translations.私も……\nそろそろ、寝よっか？:
Me too...
Should we head to bed soon？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nアレ、やらない？:
Hey, hey...
Wanna do that thing？
translations.修学旅行で、\n電気消したら、やるでしょ？:
You know, what everyone does
on school trips
after lights out？
translations.ほら、好きな人、\n当てっこするの。:
You know, guessing
who each other's crush is!
translations.ああ……\nあるかも。\nでも、二人でやっても……。:
Ah... Yeah, maybe.
Though with just
the two of us...？
translations.いいの♪\nじゃあ、そっちから。\nまずは……。:
It's fine♪
Okay, you go first.
Starting with...
translations.同じクラスの人？: Is it someone in your class？
translations.ふふ、\nわかっちゃった▼\nきっと、相思相愛だよ？:
Hehe, I knew it▼
I bet your feelings
are mutual, you know？
translations.そうしよっか？\nあ、じゃあ、アレまたやろう？:
Shall we？
Oh, wait, wanna play
that game again？
translations.やるんだ、やっぱり……。:
So we're doing this
again, huh...？
translations.はい、いいよ？\n質問して。:
Yup! Go ahead.
Ask me a question.
translations.じゃあ、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲が\n好きな人は、同じクラス？:
Then, is the person ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
likes in your class？
translations.あれ？\nえぇと、どっちだっけ……。:
Huh？
Umm, wait, which is it...？
translations.だって、今は同級生だもん。:
Well, right now
we're classmates, after all.
translations.ふふ、じゃあ、\nべつのヒントね？\nその人は……。:
Hehe. Okay, how about
another hint？
That person is...
translations.いま、いちばん、\n私の近くにいる人……。:
And the person closest
to me right now...
translations.ふぁ……眠っ。\nちょっと、\n早起きし過ぎたかな…………。:
*Yawn*... Still sleepy.
Did I wake up
a little too early...？
translations.（おっと、\n起こさないようにしなきゃ……）:
(Whoops, I'd better not
wake her up...)
translations.（早く起きて得した……\n昨日、ちゃんと寝たからな！）:
(Waking up early paid off...
Good thing I went to sleep
on time last night!)
translations.（もう少し、\nこうしておこう……）:
(I'll just stay like this
a little longer...)
translations.修学旅行だよ～？\n早く起きない人は、\nイタズラされちゃうよ～？:
It's a school trip, you know~？
Anyone who doesn't wake up
gets pranked~
translations.カワイイ▼\nイタズラ決定で～す。:
You're so cute▼
Prank time it is~
translations.おはよう……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、今、なんかした？:
Morning...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you just
do something？
translations.起きてどっかに行ったのか？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ー？:
Did she wake up
and go somewhere？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲~？
translations.えっ？\n起きちゃったの？\nこっち来ちゃダメ！:
Huh？
You're awake？
Don't come over here!
translations.……ゴメン、\n着替え中だと思わなくて。:
...Sorry,
I had no idea you were
getting changed.
translations.んっ！\nもうっ、男子ってサイテー！:
Hmph!
Geez, boys are the worst!
translations.はぁ、\nあぶないあぶない。:
Whew,
that was a close one.
translations.誰かさんに覗かれないように、\n寝てるうちにね？:
While you were asleep,
so a certain someone
couldn't peek, right？
translations.信用ないなぁ……。:
You really don't trust me,
do you...
translations.ウソだよ♪\n朝ご飯、出来たって、\n行こう！:
Just kidding♪
Breakfast is ready,
let's go!
translations.すごぉい！\n窓いっぱい、鬼怒川！:
Amazing!
The Kinugawa River fills
the whole window!
translations.和食も洋食も\n色々あるよ！:
There's so much Japanese
and Western food!
translations.和食は\n『おばんざい』だって！\nあ、でもこの匂い……。:
They even have 'obanzai'
for the Japanese food!
Oh, but that smell...
translations.焼き立てのパンだ！\nえ～、もう、どうしよう！:
Fresh-baked bread!
Aww, what should I do!?
translations.でも、▲姉ヶ崎＊▲\n朝からそんなに食べて平気？:
Still, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
can you really eat that much
this early？
translations.だって、\nいろいろ食べたいんだもん。\n食べきれなかったら、ほら。:
Because I want to try
a bit of everything!
If I can't finish it, well...
translations.手伝って♪\nア～ンって、ね？\nふふ▼:
You'll help me♪
Say 'ahh', okay？
Ehehe▼
translations.ありがとうございました。\nまたのお越しを\nお待ちしております。:
Thank you very much.
We look forward to
having you again.
translations.よし、と……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、お待たせ！:
All right...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, sorry to keep you
waiting!
translations.いいホテルだったね！\n『鬼怒川プラザホテル』。:
That was a great hotel!
The Kinugawa Plaza Hotel.
translations.うん。\nあんな部屋、\nめったに泊まれないもんね？:
Yeah.
It's not every day you get
to stay in a room like that,
right？
translations.そうだ、記念に写真、\n撮って行こう？:
Oh, why don't we take
a souvenir photo before
we go？
translations.あ！\nじゃあ、玉と一緒に！:
Ah!
Let's take it with
the stone ball, then!
translations.ダメ、もっと男子っぽく！: No no, sound more like a guy!
translations.うん、ぐっすり！\nあれ？\n眠れなかった？:
Yep, like a log!
Huh？
Couldn't sleep？
translations.あ、あれだ。\n東武日光行き。:
Oh, that's it.
Bound for Tobu-Nikko.
translations.電車、２つしか\n繋がってないんだ。\nなんか、カワイイ▼:
There are only two cars!
That's kind of cute▼
translations.こういう時こそ、\nなにか男子っぽい知識を披露して\nポイントアップしなきゃ。:
Times like this are when
you show off manly trivia
to score points!
translations.ほら、男子は女子より、\n鉄道とか、詳しいでしょ？:
You know, guys usually know
more about trains than girls
do, right？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n鉄道に興味あったの？:
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
are you into trains？
translations.違うの。男子が、\n『知ってて当然』みたいに話して\nくれるのが好きなの。女子は:
Nope. Girls just like it
when guys explain things
like it's second nature.
translations.というワケで、ちょっと\nがっかりな２日目の始まり\nなのでした。まる。:
And so, day two starts off
a little bit disappointing.
Period.
translations.（少し、スポットのガイド\n読んどくか……）:
(Maybe I should read up on
some spots in the guide...)
translations.ハァ、ぐっすり寝ちゃった……\nやっぱり自然に囲まれてると、\n夜はよく眠れるね:
Haaah, I slept so well...
Being surrounded by nature
really helps you sleep, huh？
translations.また来たいな、鬼怒川……。:
I want to come back to
Kinugawa again someday...
translations.ほら、東武日光行き。\nあれに乗り換えだ。:
Look, that one's for Tobu-
Nikko. That's our transfer.
translations.あ、２つしか繋がってないんだ？\nカワイイね？ ね？:
Oh, it only has two cars？
Isn't that cute？ Huh？
translations.えぇと……下今市で鬼怒川方面と\n切り離して、ここから日光までは\n２両編成にな:
Well... they uncouple the
Kinugawa cars at Shimo-
Imaichi, so it's a two-car
train from here to Nikko.
translations.へぇ、そうなんだ！\nよく知ってるね～▼:
Ooh, really？
You sure know your stuff,
▼
translations.というワケで、２日目は朝から\n一歩前進の二人でした。まる。\nふふっ。:
And so, day two begins with
our couple taking a step
forward. Period.
Hehe.
translations.ねぇ、あの山。\n面白い形。\n有名な山なのかな……。:
Hey, look at that mountain.
What an interesting shape.
I wonder if it's famous...
translations.へぇ……\nでも、デコボコしてて、\nあんまり富士山ぽくないよ？:
Huh...
It's so bumpy, it doesn't
really look like Mount Fuji？
translations.じゃあ、\n男体山じゃないのかな……。:
Then maybe it's not
Mount Nantai after all...
translations.着いたーっ！\n来たな、日光！:
We made it!
Nikko, here we come!
translations.ここからが、いよいよ\n修学旅行って気がしない？\n……ね？:
Doesn't it feel like our
class trip is finally
starting now？ ...Right？
translations.あ、見えてきたよ、\n男体山。:
Oh, look, you can see it!
Mount Nantai.
translations.日光富士ともいうんだよ？\nね？:
They call it Nikko-Fuji too,
you know？ Neat, huh？
translations.着いたーっ！\nさてと、荷物を預けて\nバスに乗ろう。:
We're here!
All right, let's drop off
our bags and take the bus.
translations.うんうん。\nでも、ほら、\nその前に……ね？:
Mm-hmm.
Wait, but first...
You know what, right？
translations.ここから、\nバスでいろは坂か……。:
From here, we take the bus
up Irohazaka, huh...
translations.“いろはにほへと ちりぬるを”\n……なんだっけ？:
'Iroha nihoheto,
chirinuru wo...'
...Wait, what came next？
translations.あ、ダメ、言わないで！\n思い出すから……\nう～ん……あ、そうだ！:
Ah, wait, don't tell me!
I'm gonna remember it...
Hrmm... Oh, right!
translations.“あさきゆめみし、\nえひもせず”！\nやった！:
'Asaki yumemishi,
ehi mo sezu'!
Nailed it!
translations.なんか、短いよ？:
Isn't that, like...
way too short？
translations.あれ？\nい、ろ、は、に、ほ、へ、と……\n……。:
Huh？
I, ro, ha, ni, ho, he, to...
...
translations.２４文字しかないね……\nちょっと抜けちゃった？:
There's only 24 letters...
Did I skip a little bit？
translations.（だいぶ抜けた気がする……）:
(Pretty sure you skipped
a whole lot...)
translations.おぉ……\nさすが『いろは坂』。\nやっぱり曲がるなぁ……。:
Whoa...
They don't call it Irohazaka
for nothing. So many turns...
translations.ねぇ？\nあ、ほらほら、また！:
Right？
Ah, look look, another one!
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲って、\nこういうの苦手かと思ってた。:
I thought you weren't good
with this kind of thing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そう？\nジェットコースターは嫌だけど、\nこれは楽しいよ？ あ……。:
Really？ I hate roller coasters,
but this is fun!
...Wait.
translations.もしかして、\n恐がった方がポイント高い？\nお付き合いの前としては？:
Wait, would I score more points
if I acted scared？
For two people before dating？
translations.きゃー▼\nとか、言っちゃったりして。\nどうかな？ ふふっ！:
Like screaming, 'Eek, ▼!'
or something？
How's that sound？ Fufu!
translations.エレベーターで降りるんだ！\nへぇ……。:
We take an elevator down!
Huh, wow...
translations.あっ！\nねぇ、これ滝の音？:
Ah!
Hey, is that the waterfall？
translations.有名な景色が目の前にあるのに\n本当じゃないみたい……\n不思議……。:
Such a famous view right
in front of me, yet it doesn't
even feel real... How strange.
translations.日光にいるんだね、\n私たち……。:
We really are in Nikko,
aren't we...
translations.あれ？\nなんか、\n涙出そうになっちゃった。:
Huh？
For some reason, I feel like
crying all of a sudden.
translations.すごいね……\nねぇ、あれ全部水なんだよ？:
It's incredible...
Hey, every bit of that is water,
you know？
translations.あれ？\n私なんか変な事言ってる……\nふふっ、おかしいね？:
Huh？ Did I say something
weird...？ Hehe, I sound
silly, don't I？
translations.うん、そうなの……\nよかった。:
Yeah, it really is...
I'm glad.
translations.あなたが、そういう気持ち、\n一緒に感じてくれる人で。:
That you're someone who can
feel that way with me.
translations.きっとね、私にとって、\nすごく、大事な事なんだと思う。:
I think that's something
really important to me.
translations.おぉ、中禅寺湖か……。:
Whoa, so this is
Lake Chuzenji...
translations.あ、ほら見て！\nあっちの山！:
Ah, look!
That mountain over there!
translations.ほらほら、富士山みたいでしょ？:
See, see？ Doesn't it look
just like Mt. Fuji？
translations.ああ、そういえば！:
Oh yeah, now that you
mention it!
translations.よそのガイドさんの説明が\n聞こえちゃったんだけど、\nあれ、男体山だって。:
I overheard another guide
explaining it, and apparently
that's Mount Nantai.
translations.じゃあ、さっき電車から\n見えたのは――。:
So then, the one we saw
from the train earlier was—
translations.それも男体山。\nここから見た時に富士山に\nなるの。だから、さっきも正解。:
That's Mount Nantai, too.
It looks like Mt. Fuji from
here, so you were right!
translations.やっぱり自信無かったんだ！:
I knew you weren't
sure after all!
translations.でも、可愛いところも\nあって、いいなと\n思ったのでした。まる。ふふっ！:
Still, I thought having
such a cute side was nice.
Full stop. Heheh!
translations.う～ん、\n今日も風が強いなぁ……。:
Mmh... The wind's
really strong today, too...
translations.湖から吹いてくるな……。:
It's blowing in
from the lake...
translations.ねぇ、こんな風にしてると、\nちょっと、叫びたくならない？:
Hey, when it blows like this,
doesn't it make you
want to shout？
translations.それは、ほら。\nやっぱり、アレでしょ？\n付き合う前の二人なら。:
Well, you know.
It's gotta be *that*, right？
For two people before
they start dating.
translations.『好きだ―！ 姉ヶ崎ーっ！』\nとか。:
"I love you,
Anegasakiii!"
Something like that.
translations.だって、そういうのされた事、\nないもん。:
Well, nobody's ever done
something like that for me.
translations.やっぱり、そういのは、\nもっと真面目じゃないと。\nいつか、またね？:
Something like that really
needs to be more serious.
Maybe someday, okay？
translations.（いつか真面目に\nやらされるのか……）:
(So she's gonna make me
do it seriously someday...？)
translations.おぉっ!?\n下りも曲がるな、いろは坂！:
Whoa!?
Irohazaka's got just as
many curves on the way down!
translations.えぇっ!?\nふくろ、袋は……。:
Whaat!?
A b-bag, where's a bag...
translations.うぅ……\nどうして下りはダメなんだろ……\nもうやだ……。:
Ugh...
Why does going downhill
mess me up so bad...？
I hate this...
translations.はぁ……\nこうしてると、楽……\nごめんね？:
Haa...
Leaning like this helps...
Sorry, okay？
translations.いいけど……\nあ、これはもしかして、\nまた一歩前進の二人？:
I don't mind, but...
Wait, is this another
step forward for us？
translations.日光物産商会。\nここで昼メシの予定だけど……\nやめとく？:
Nikko Bussan Shokai.
We planned to eat lunch
here, but... want to skip it？
translations.わぁ……\nちょっと\nアンティークショップみたいね？:
Wow...
It kind of looks like
an antique shop, huh？
translations.明治創業だって。\n国の登録有形文化財らしい。:
Said it was founded in Meiji.
Apparently it's a registered
cultural property.
translations.そっかぁ……\nこれは来ないとだよね。:
I see...
Then we definitely
had to come, huh.
translations.ゆば弁当『匠』と\n『ハンバーグセット』、\nお待たせいたしました。:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is the "Takumi" Yuba Bento
and the Hamburg Steak Set.
translations.やぁ～、美味しそう♪\nゆば大好き！\nいただきま～す♪:
Ooh, looks delicious♪
I love yuba!
Time to dig in～♪
translations.（さっきまであんなに\n気持ち悪そうだったのに……）:
(And she was looking so sick
just a minute ago...)
translations.ん？\nなぁに？\nちょっとあげよっか？:
Hm？
What is it？
Want a little taste？
translations.タダじゃダメだよ？\nそっちも一口ちょうだい♪\nふふっ！:
Not for free, mister♪
You have to give me
a bite of yours, too♪
Heheh!
translations.うん、治りました。\n行こう？:
All better now!
Shall we go？
translations.いいなぁ、やっぱり……。\nねぇ、なんでこういうレトロな\n感じって、落ち着くの:
I really love this vibe...
Hey, why do retro places
feel so relaxing？
translations.だって、私たちの生まれる\nずっと前のデザインでしょ？\n懐かしいはず無いのに…:
I mean, it's from way
before we were born, right？
So why feel nostalgic...？
translations.『ゆばグラタンセット』と\n『カニクリームコロッケセット』\nお待たせいたしまし:
One Yuba Gratin Set and one
Crab Cream Croquette Set.
Thank you for waiting!
translations.そう。\n美味しいんだもん。\nちょっと、アーンする？:
Yep! It's so good.
Want an 'aah' bite？
translations.そっか……\n同級生だった。\nざんねんでした♪:
Oh right...
We're classmates today.
Too bad for you♪
translations.ねぇ、読んだ？\nここの説明。:
Hey, did you read
the sign here？
translations.この神橋は、\n日光国立公園の玄関なんだって。:
It says this Shinkyo Bridge
is the gateway to
Nikko National Park.
translations.日光国立公園って、\n世界遺産なんだよ？\nということは……。:
Nikko National Park is a
World Heritage site, right？
Which means...
translations.こっちは、もう世界遺産。\nあっちは、普通のところなの。:
Over here is World Heritage,
and over there is just
a normal place.
translations.ほら！\nもっと感動して？:
Come on!
Be a little more amazed？
translations.ハァ……\nもう、神橋から\nずいぶん歩いたけどな……。:
*sigh*... We've walked
a long way since
Shinkyo Bridge, though...
translations.歩いたよね、坂道……\nあれ？\nほら、あそこ、入り口かな？:
We have, all uphill...
Wait. Look over there!
Is that the entrance？
translations.おぉ!?\nあんな遠くに鳥居が……。:
Whoa!?
There's a torii gate
way out in the distance...
translations.ほら、がんばれ、姉ヶ崎！:
Come on, hang in there,
Anegasaki!
translations.あ……\nなんか板についてきた感じ？\nよーし、がんばっちゃうか！:
Ah... That's really starting
to roll off your tongue!
Alright, let's do this!
translations.ここでまさかの\n寧々ちゃん、ダッシュです！:
And out of nowhere,
Nene-chan makes a sprint
for it!
translations.負けた……\nそれにしても、近くで見ると、\nやっぱりデカいな？:
You beat me...
Still, up close,
it's seriously massive.
translations.ね？\nそれに、全部石なんだ。:
Right？
And it's made entirely
out of stone.
translations.ああ、石を積んだだけの\n構造なのに、日光大地震でも、\n倒れなかったらしい。:
Yeah. It's just stacked
stone, but it didn't collapse
even in the Nikko earthquake.
translations.へぇ、すごい鳥居なんだ……\nそれでそれで？:
Wow, that's amazing...
What else, what else？
translations.高さ９ｍで、江戸時代に\n出来た石の鳥居としては、\n日本最大だってさ。:
It's 9 meters tall, making it
the biggest Edo-period stone
torii in Japan, apparently.
translations.そっか……\nよく知ってるね？:
I see...
You really know your stuff？
translations.ああ、さっきガイド見て――。:
Well, I just saw it
in the guidebook—
translations.いいの、そんなの。\n男子は、知ってて当然って\n顔してて？ ふふっ、行こ？:
Shh, don't spoil it!
A guy should act like he knew
all along. Hehe, ready to go？
translations.ハァ……\nやっとここまで来たぁ……。:
Phew...
We finally made it
this far...
translations.うん、\n陽明門まで、もう少しだ。:
Yeah.
Yomeimon Gate is just
a little further.
translations.おぉ……\nここまで来ると、\n東照宮って感じだな……。:
Whoa...
Now that we're here,
it really feels
like Toshogu...
translations.ねぇ……\n極彩色っていうのかな、\n普通の神社とぜんぜん違う……。:
Hey...
Is this what they call
richly colored？
It's totally different
from a normal shrine...
translations.あ、ほら、\n『見ざる言わざる聞かざる』！:
Oh, look!
'See no evil, speak no evil,
hear no evil'!
translations.全部で８枚の彫刻があって、人が\n生まれてから子供を産むまでが\n描かれてるんだ:
There are eight carvings
in total. They depict life
from birth to having kids.
translations.６枚目が『恋愛』、だっけ？\n悩んじゃってるお猿さん。:
The sixth one is 'Love',
right？ That monkey looking
all troubled.
translations.ぜったい、悩んでるお猿さんが\n女の子だと思う。:
I bet that troubled monkey
is definitely a girl.
translations.奥の浮かれてる感じなのが、\nオス？:
And the cheerful one
in the back is a guy？
translations.そうなの。それで、\n『どうして分ってくれないの!?』\nって――。:
Right! And she's like,
'Why don't you get it!?'
and then—
translations.あらあら～、仲良くね？\n女の子泣かせちゃダメよ？:
My, my~ Play nice, you two.
You can't go making
a girl cry, you know？
translations.え？ あ、違うんです！\n私たち、そんな――ね？:
Huh？ Oh, no, not at all!
We're not—right？
translations.はい、\nホント、ケンカなんて……。:
Yeah,
we're really not fighting
or anything...
translations.あら、ホント。\n若い人っていいわね～？\nじゃあ、仲良くね？:
Well, look at that.
Youth is so wonderful~
You two stay sweet, now!
translations.このままで、行こっか……。:
Shall we keep going
like this...？
translations.（なんか、\nホントに付き合う前\nみたいな感じだな……）:
(Kind of feels like
back before we actually
started dating...)
translations.これ、全部木を彫ったんだよね？\n動物だけじゃなくて、\nお花も、一つ一つ……。:
All of this was carved
from wood, right？
Not just the animals,
every single flower, too...
translations.全部で５０８あるらしい。\n当時の装飾の最新の技術を\n集めて建てられたんだって:
Apparently there are 508
in total. They used all the
latest decorative techniques
of the era to build it.
translations.そっか……徳川家康だもんね？\n『作るのだっ！』って言ったら、\nみんな頑張るよ:
I see... It was Tokugawa
Ieyasu, after all. If he said,
'Build it!', everyone would
give it their all...
translations.……今の、徳川家康？:
...Was that supposed to be
Tokugawa Ieyasu？
translations.そうだよ？\nダメ？\nもっと、違う感じがする？:
Yep! Was it bad？
Did you imagine him
differently？
translations.作るのだっ、ホッホッホッホッ！\nあ、サンタさんになっちゃった。\nふふっ！ 行:
'Build it! Ho, ho, ho!'
Oops, now I'm Santa.
Fufu! Shall we go？
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、カワイイ……\nちょっと子供っぽくて――ハッ！\n同級生効果かっ:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is so cute...
A little childish—wait!
Is this the classmate effect!?)
translations.猫、猫……\n猫やーい……。:
Kitty, kitty...
Where are you, kitty...？
translations.ほら、門の上の真ん中。:
Look, right in the middle,
above the gate.
translations.あ、いた。\n眠ってますねぇ……ふふっ。:
Ah, there it is.
Fast asleep, isn't it...
Fufu.
translations.眠ってるって説と、実は寝た\nふりで、いつでも飛びかかれる\n恰好だって説がある:
Some say it's asleep,
while others say it's just
faking it, ready to pounce
at any second.
translations.そっか……でも、\n彫った人に聞かなかったのかな？\n左甚五郎さん、だっけ？:
Huh... But didn't anyone
ask the sculptor？
Hidari Jingoro, was it？
translations.そう言われてるけど、\nそれも、実在の人物かどうか、\nハッキリしないらしいから:
That's what they say,
but apparently it's not even
clear if he actually existed.
translations.そっか、\n永遠の謎なんだ……\nでも、私は寝てる派だな。:
I see, so it's an eternal
mystery... But I'm definitely
on team 'sleeping'.
translations.だって、ずーっと、\nああしてるんでしょ？\n私だったら、寝ちゃうと思う。:
I mean, it's stayed like that
forever, right？ If it were me,
I'd definitely fall asleep.
translations.それでは、皆さん龍の頭の下に\n集まってください。:
Now then, everyone, please
gather under the dragon's
head.
translations.ホントだ……聴こえる……。: It's true... I can hear it...
translations.このように天井と床が共鳴して、\n鈴の音のように聞こえる事から、\nこれを龍の鳴:
As the ceiling and floor
resonate like this, ringing
like a bell, this has come
to be called the dragon's cry—
translations.ゴメンゴメン！\nお守り買ってたの、\nほら、鈴のやつ。:
Sorry, sorry！
I was buying a charm—
see, the bell one.
translations.ああ、\nお坊さんが説明してたやつ？:
Oh, the one the monk
was just telling us about？
translations.だって、普通の鈴のお守りと\n違って、穴が空いてないから、\n福がもれないんだよ:
Well, unlike regular bell
charms, it doesn't have a
hole, so your good fortune
won't leak out, you know？
translations.それに、音が鳴る限り、\n御利益が続くんだって。\nかなりお買い得だと思わない？:
Plus, as long as it rings,
the blessings keep on going.
Don't you think that's
quite a bargain？
translations.そう言われると、うん……。:
When you put it that way,
yeah...
translations.どうしよう、\nお母さんにも買って行こうかな？:
Hmm, what should I do...
Maybe I should get one
for Mom, too？
translations.（しっかり者のような、\nそうじゃないような……）:
(Part of her is sensible,
part of her... not so much.)
translations.ずっと、塀が続いてる……\n二荒山神社、もうすぐだよね？:
This wall just keeps going...
Futarasan Shrine is coming
up soon, right？
translations.うん。\n疲れたなら、少し休もうか？:
Yeah. If you're tired,
want to take a short break？
translations.ありがと。\nでも平気。\nほら、行こう？:
Thanks. But I'm fine.
Come on, let's go？
translations.ここが二荒山神社なんだ……\nよかった、想像してた通り\n御利益がありそうな感じ:
So this is Futarasan Shrine...
I'm glad, it feels full of
blessings, just like I thought.
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n二荒山神社に来たかったの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you really wanted
to come to Futarasan Shrine？
translations.そうなの。\n実は、この修学旅行で、\n一番来たかったところ。:
I did. To be honest, this was
the place I wanted to visit
most on this whole trip.
translations.どこかお目当てでもあるの？:
Is there something specific
you wanted to see？
translations.うん、\n霊泉ともう一つ……\nあ、霊泉、あっちだって。:
Yeah, the sacred spring, and
one other thing... Oh, look,
the spring is over there.
translations.『智慧の水、酒の水、若水』……\nこれが飲みたかったの？:
'Water of Wisdom, Water of
Sake, Water of Youth'...
This is what you wanted
to drink？
translations.うん。\n若水を飲むと、若返るんだよ？:
Yep. If you drink the Water
of Youth, you get younger！
translations.●たち、まだ若返らなくて\nいいよ！:
We don't need to get
any younger, ●！
translations.あなたはね？\nでも私は、一年分だけ……。:
You don't, maybe.
But me, just by one year...
translations.あとは……\nあった、あそこ！:
And the other thing is...
Found it, over there！
translations.とうとう、最後のスポット\n二荒山神社か……。:
Finally at our last stop,
Futarasan Shrine...
translations.うん……\nちょっと、\n寂しくなって来ちゃったね……。:
Yeah...
It's getting a little sad,
now that it's almost over...
translations.うん、やっぱり、\n行っとこうかな？:
Yeah, maybe I really should
go drink some after all？
translations.また、一年分？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、\nそのままでいいよ。:
Another year's worth？
You're fine just the way
you are, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.そうなんだけど……\n一応、ね？\nほら、せっかくだし？:
I know, but...
Just in case, right？
Since we're already here？
translations.あ、同級生だと思って生意気～！\nいいよ、いっぱい飲んで、\n年下になっちゃお。:
Hey, getting cheeky just
because we're 'classmates'!
Fine, I'll drink a bunch and
be younger than you! Hehe！
translations.さてと、\nもう一つのお目当ても？:
All right, what about
that other thing you wanted？
translations.うん……。\nねぇ、手、繋いで行こ？:
Yeah...
Hey, let's hold hands
on the way？
translations.うん……\nお祈りすると、\n夫婦円満の御利益があるから。:
Yeah... If you pray here,
it blesses you with a happy,
peaceful marriage.
translations.もちろん、\nまだ、夫婦じゃないけど……。:
Of course, we're not
married yet, but...
translations.でも、“円満”が\n叶うとしたら、ほら……。:
If 'marital bliss' comes
true, then, you know...
translations.その前のことも、\n叶ってるはずじゃない？:
Everything before that
has to come true first,
right？
translations.ふふっ、\n揚げ足取りみたいで、\n神様、怒っちゃうかな？:
Hehe, that's kind of like
twisting their words. Think
the gods will get mad at me？
translations.神様。\n無理言ってごめんなさい。\nでも……。:
Dear gods...
Sorry for asking so much.
But...
translations.これが今の私たちの、\n素直な気持ちです。\nだから、いつか……。:
This is truly how
the two of us feel.
So someday...
translations.さてと……\n日光土産も買ったし！:
All right...
Got all my Nikko souvenirs!
translations.うん、ごめんね？\n同じもので種類が多いから、\n悩んじゃって。:
Yeah, sorry!
There were so many options,
I couldn't decide.
translations.いろいろあるからね。\nどんなの買った？:
There really are a lot.
What did you get？
translations.まず、お母さんに頼まれてた、\n生ゆばと入浴剤でしょ？\nあとは――。:
First, the fresh yuba
and bath salts Mom wanted,
right？ And then—
translations.まゆちゃん達には、\n羊羹と、ゆば饅頭。\nそして寧々ちゃんには……。:
For Mayu and the girls,
yokan and yuba manju.
And for Nene-chan...
translations.そうだよ？ 誰かさんがヤキモチ\n妬いてくれた記念でござる。\nニンニン▼:
Yep! A souvenir to mark
someone getting jealous,
that it is! Nin-nin!▼
translations.（記念にされちゃった……）:
(She made a souvenir
out of it...)
translations.ハァ～……\nこれで日光ともお別れか……\nロッカーに荷物取りに――。:
Haaah... Guess it's
goodbye to Nikko...
Better get my bags from the—
translations.ちょっと、その辺、\nお散歩しない？\nまだ時間があるでしょ？:
Want to take a little stroll
around here？
We still have time, right？
translations.ハァ～！\n修学旅行、終わっちゃうね？:
Haaah! Our class trip
is really ending, huh？
translations.うん、\nやっぱり少し寂しいな……。:
Yeah... It really is
a little lonely...
translations.ねぇ……\n同級生で、付き合う前の二人は、\n気持ち、確かめあえたのかな？:
Hey... Do you think those two
classmates, before dating...
made their feelings clear？
translations.うん……\n私も、そう思う……\nねぇ？:
Yeah... I think so too...
Hey？
translations.修学旅行、\nもう、終わっちゃうんだよ？:
The class trip is really,
truly about to end, you know？
translations.あ～あ……\nしょうがないか。\n私が勝手に決めた事だもん……。:
Ah well... Can't be helped,
I guess. I'm the one who
decided on it anyway...
translations.なんでも！\nねぇ、最後に写真、撮ってこ？:
Never mind!
Hey, let's take a photo
before we go？
translations.はぁ……\nそろそろ、電車の時間？:
Haaah... Is it almost time
for the train？
translations.うん。\nそろそろかな？:
Yeah. Just about time,
I think？
translations.ねぇ？\n同級生の二人は、この修学旅行で\nお互いの気持ち、\n確かめ合えたと思:
Hey... Do you think the two
classmates confirmed their
feelings on this trip？
translations.忘れないでね？\n“家に帰るまでが修学旅行”\nだよ？ わかる？:
Don't forget, okay？
'The trip isn't over until
you get home!' Get it？
translations.うん。 じゃあ、後でね？\nふふっ、写真撮って行こ？:
Good. See you in a bit, then.
Hehe, let's take a photo!
translations.えぇと、\n特急きぬ……だよな？\n行こうか？:
Let's see... It's the Kinu
Limited Express, right？
Shall we？
translations.ゴメン、ゴメン。\nちょっと、名残惜しくて。:
Sorry, sorry!
I'm just a little sad
to say goodbye.
translations.もう大丈夫。\nちゃんと、心に焼き付けたから。\nバイバイ、日光。:
I'm okay now.
I've burned it into my memory.
Bye-bye, Nikko.
translations.バイバイ。\nちょっと、はしゃぎ過ぎた\n寧々ちゃん。 がんばったね。:
Bye-bye to Nene-chan,
who got a little carried away.
You did good.
translations.電車は間もなく、\n春日部に停車いたします。\nWe will soon mak:
This train will soon arrive
at Kasukabe.
We will soon make 
a brief stop at KASUKABE.
translations.本当、二日間の修学旅行なんて、\nあっという間だったね……\nねぇ？:
Seriously, a two-day class
trip just flew by...
Hey？
translations.ありがとう……\n“同級生ごっこ”、\n付き合ってくれて。:
Thanks...
for playing along with
the 'classmates' game.
translations.私ね……今でも、\nときどき考えちゃうの。\n二人の学年が違う事。:
You know... even now,
I still catch myself
thinking about it.
About us in different grades.
translations.普段は忘れてるのよ？\nそんなの。\nでも、ふとした時に……。:
I forget about it normally,
of course.
But then, out of nowhere...
translations.もしかして、あなたは窮屈\nなんじゃないかなって。\nもし、わたしが同級生なら―:
I wonder if you feel
stifled around me.
Like, if I were in your grade—
translations.もっと、乱暴な話し方したり、\nのびのび出来るのかな――。:
Maybe you'd talk more roughly,
or just let loose a bit...
translations.私が年上だから、無理に大人に\nさせちゃってるのかな、\nって……。:
I wonder if me being older
makes you force yourself
to act mature, or something...
translations.そうだよね？\nでも、考えちゃうの、\nどうしても……。:
I know, right？
But I can't help it,
I just do...
translations.ほら、告白したのって、\n私の方からじゃない？ だから、\n余計に自信が無いの、:
After all, I was the one
who confessed, right？
So I guess that makes me
even more insecure.
translations.だからね？\n修学旅行の間は、\n同級生の二人になって……。:
That's why... I thought if we
could be classmates just for
our school trip...
translations.気安い同い年の女の子みたいに、\nあなたが感じてくれれば、\nそうすれば、きっと:
If you could see me as just
a girl your age that you can
be totally relaxed around...
Then maybe—
translations.つまらない事、気にしなくて\nすむような気がしたの。\n……うまく、出来たかな？:
I wouldn't have to worry
about silly things like that.
...Did it work, you think？
translations.うん……\nふふっ、よかった！\nもう、これで十分。:
Yeah...
Hehe, I'm glad！
That's more than enough.
translations.本当はね、修学旅行の間に、\n今度は、あなたから告白して\nもらえないかなぁ、っ:
Truth is, I was kind of hoping
you'd confess to me this time,
sometime during the trip.
translations.いいの、それは。\nそんなのわかるわけないもんね？\nゴメン。:
It's fine, though.
There's no way you'd know
to do that, right？ Sorry.
translations.“家に帰るまでが修学旅行”って\n言うから、まだ間に合うよ。\nだから、●と――:
They say the trip isn't over
until you get home, so it's
not too late. So, ●—
translations.ダメだよ……\nそれ以上言われたら、\n泣いちゃうよ……。:
Don't...
If you say any more,
I'm gonna cry...
translations.失礼します。\nお茶、コーヒー、ビール、\nおつまみはいかがですか？:
Excuse me.
Care for any tea, coffee,
beer, or snacks？
translations.こうして二人は、\nお付き合いを始めたのでした。\nまる。:
And so, the two of them
began dating.
The end.
translations.本当。\nやり残したこと、あるのに……。:
Really.
Even though there's still
something left undone...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n何かやり残したの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
did you leave something undone？
translations.エンディングはどうなるの？\nまだ付き合ってない、\n同級生の二人は？:
What about our ending？
What happens to the two
classmates who aren't dating？
translations.ふふっ、冗談。\nちょっぴり残念だけどね？:
Hehe, just kidding.
Though I am a little sad,
you know？
translations.楽しかった、同級生ごっこ……。\nあなたも、いつもより、\n『男子』っぽかったし:
It was fun, playing classmates...
You felt a lot more like
a 'regular boy' than usual, too.
translations.そう言う▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だって、\nいつもより、ほら……。:
You say that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
but you were... you know,
a lot more...
translations.可愛かったでしょ？ ふふっ▼\n実は、自分でもちょっと意外。:
Cuter, right？ Hehe▼
Honestly, I surprised
myself a little.
translations.同級生の私って、こんなに\n甘えちゃうんだ、って……\n本当はね、そうじゃなくて:
Like, 'Can I really act this
clingy as a classmate？'...
Though that wasn't really
the main point—
translations.なんて言うのかな……\nあなたに、もっと、\n羽を伸ばして欲しかったの。:
How should I put it...
I wanted you to be able
to spread your wings more.
translations.ほら、同級生の男子って、\n女子に偉そうにするじゃない？\nでも、私といるあなた:
You know how boys in the same
grade act all bossy to girls？
But when you're with me—
translations.少し大人びてるっていうのかな、\nときどきね、そんな風に\n感じるの……。:
You act kind of mature,
I guess you could say.
Sometimes it feels like that...
translations.もし、私が同級生の\n女の子だったら、もっと自由に\n威張ったり、怒ったりして―:
I thought if I were a girl
in your grade, you'd feel free
to act bossy or get mad—
translations.もっと、楽しかったのかな、\nなんて……。:
I just wondered...
if you would've had
more fun that way...
translations.ありがとう。 でも、\nどうしても考えちゃうのよ。\n二人が同い年ならって……。:
Thanks. But...
I can't help thinking about it.
What if we were
the same age...？
translations.もう、やめ！\n修学旅行は終わったんだし、\n私たちは、私たちだもん。 ね？:
Oh, that's enough of that！
The school trip is over,
and we are who we are. Right？
translations.エンディングって、\nどうすればいいのかな？:
What should we do
for the ending, then？
translations.まだ、間に合うよ。\nほら、“家に帰るまでが\n修学旅行”って言うし。:
There's still time.
You know what they say:
'It's not over until
you get back home.'
translations.そっかそっか……なるほどね？\nじゃあ……。:
Right, right... I see？
In that case...
translations.告白して？\nちゃんと、真面目によ？:
Confess to me？
And do it seriously, okay？
translations.よし…………。\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n●と、付き合ってください。:
All right...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲,
please go out with ●.
translations.ダメ。\nもう一度、もっと、同級生の\n男子っぽく。 はい。:
Nope.
Try again, but sound more
like a boy in my class.
Ready, go.
translations.答えは、\n“ＹＥＳ”、だから……。:
My answer is...
'yes', by the way...
translations.うん……\nやっぱりちょっと、二日間の\n修学旅行じゃ無理か……。:
Yeah...
I guess two days just isn't
enough for a school trip...
translations.じゃあ、ヒントね？\n同級生の二人は、\n結局、どうなったでしょう？:
A hint, then？
Those two classmates...
what happened to them
in the end, do you think？
translations.それは、やっぱり……\n上手く行ったと思う。:
Well, I mean...
I think things worked out
between them.
translations.お互いの気持ちを\n確かめあえたわけだから。:
Because they confirmed
how they felt about each other.
translations.それなら、旅行中に男子が\n告白するべきだったんじゃない？\nほら、よくあるでし:
If so, shouldn't the boy have
confessed during the trip？
You know how it goes, right？
translations.修学旅行で誕生するカップル。:
Couples getting together
on the school trip.
translations.ふふっ、この辺で許してあげる。\n付き合ってくれたんだもんね？\n同級生ごっこ。:
Hehe, I'll let you off the hook.
You did play along with me,
after all.
Playing classmates, I mean.
translations.なんかね、自分でもちょっと\n驚いちゃった。:
To be honest, I kind of surprised
myself a little.
translations.同級生の私って、こんなに\n甘えちゃうんだ、って……\nああいう寧々ちゃん、キラ:
Seeing how needy I get
when I'm your classmate...
Do you dislike Nene-chan
like that？
translations.ふふっ、よしよし。\nでも本当は、そうじゃなくて、\nあなたに……\nなんて言う:
Hehe, there, there.
But really, that wasn't it...
I just wanted you to...
How should I put it...？
translations.ほら、同級生の男子って、女子に\n偉そうにするじゃない？:
You know how boys act all
bossy to girls their own age？
translations.もし、私が同い年なら……\nあなたも、もっと男子って感じで\nいられるのかな、っ:
I thought if we were
the same age...
maybe you could act more like
just a typical guy.
translations.私といる時のあなたは、\nもしかして、窮屈なんじゃ\nないかなって……。:
I worried that being with me
might feel kind of stifling
for you...
translations.わかってる。\n私だって、いつもそんな風に\n考えてるわけじゃないよ？:
I know.
It's not like I'm always
thinking that way, either,
you know？
translations.でも、ときどきね、\nどうしても考えちゃうの……\n考えても、しょうがないのにね:
But sometimes...
I just can't help wondering.
Even though there's no point
in thinking about it, right？
translations.ああ、もう、やだ。\nこういうの、よくない。\nうん……。:
Oh, stop it, me.
This is no good.
Mm...
translations.そろそろお姉さんに\n戻んなきゃね？\n修学旅行は終わったんだもん。:
Time for me to go back to being
your older girlfriend, right？
The school trip is over, after all.
translations.でも、“家に帰るまでが\n修学旅行”って、\n言うからさ……。:
But you know what they say:
'The trip isn't over
until you get back home'...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n●と、付き合ってください……\n間に合うかな？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
please go out with ●...
Did I make it in time？
translations.ズルい……\n結局また、私ばっかり、\n好きにさせるんだもん……。:
That's not fair...
In the end, you always
make me fall for you more...
translations.こうして、修学旅行カップルが\nまたひと組誕生したのでした。\nまる。:
And just like that, another
school trip couple was born.
The end.
translations.間に合ったみたい……。:
Looks like you made it
in time...
translations.もうこんなところまで\n来ちゃった……。:
We're already all the way
out here...
translations.そうじゃなくて。\nほら、まだでしょ？\nエンディングが。:
Not that.
Come on, we still need
our ending, don't we？
translations.えぇと……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n●と、付き合ってください。:
Um...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, 
please go out with ●.
translations.どうしよっかな……\nもう少し、強引な感じで\n言ってくれた方が……。:
Hmm, what to do...
I kind of wanted you to be
a bit more forceful...
translations.すごく、素敵だったよ？:
That was really wonderful,
you know？
translations.ねぇ……\nなんだか、これじゃ、\n結局、私が言わせてるみたい。:
Hey...
Now it just feels like
I forced you to say it.
translations.ホント？\nじゃあ、もう一度。\n今度はそっちから……。:
Really？
Then one more time.
From you, this time...
translations.こうして二人は、\nお付き合いを始めましたとさ。\nめでたしめでたし。まる。:
And so, the two of them
started dating.
Happily ever after. The end.
translations.えぇと……\n今度は何に乗るんだっけ？:
Um...
What are we taking next,
again？
translations.もうっ、\n東京の駅って、ややこしい……。:
Jeez, 
Tokyo stations are
so confusing...
translations.ふふっ、おはよう。\n起こしてあげるから、\nまだ寝てていいよ？:
Fufu, good morning.
I'll wake you up later,
so you can keep sleeping.
translations.あ～あ、\nどうしても甘やかしちゃう。:
Ah well...
I just can't help
spoiling you.
translations.間もなく、新とわの駅です。:
We will soon arrive at
Shin-Towano Station.
translations.着いた……\nいつの間にかもう、夜だ。:
We're here...
Before I knew it,
it's already night.
translations.ね？\nなんだか、さっきまで\n日光にいたのが、嘘みたい。:
Right？
It almost feels unreal that
we were just in Nikko.
translations.いろいろあったね……\n今度の旅行も。:
A lot happened, didn't it...
On this trip, too.
translations.この旅行で、●達が\n成長したってことかな？:
Does that mean the two of us,
●, grew on this trip？
translations.よし！\n行きますか？\n明日からまた、忙しいもんね？:
Alright!
Shall we get going？
Busy again tomorrow, after all.
translations.ねぇ、熱海の時より、\n今回の方が、一緒にいる時間、\n長かったかな？:
Hey, do you think we spent
more time together this time
than back in Atami？
translations.うん……\n新記録かも。:
Yeah...
Might be a new record.
translations.そっか、うん……\nいろいろあったもんね。\nいろいろ、ハァ～～。:
I guess so, yeah...
A lot happened, after all.
So much... *sigh*.
translations.ちょっぴり自己嫌悪。\n思い出したら、だんだん\n恥ずかしくなってきちゃった。:
I'm kicking myself a bit.
Thinking back on it,
it's getting so embarrassing.
translations.がんばり過ぎちゃったかな？\n同級生の寧々ちゃん……\nなんていうか、ほら――。:
Did I try a little too hard？
Classmate Nene-chan...
How should I put it, like—
translations.あ～ん……\nダメ、もう忘れなさい！:
Aww...
Nope, just forget about it!
translations.家に着いちゃった。\nだから、修学旅行はこれで\n本当におしまい。:
We're back at my house.
So that really means
our school trip is over.
translations.また、いつかやろうか？:
Should we do it again
sometime？
translations.いいよ？\nたまには、同級生になろうね？:
Sure？
Let's be classmates again
every now and then, okay？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nちょっと思ったんだけど……。:
Hey, hey...
I was just thinking...
translations.やっぱり、最後くらい\nちゃんといつもの二人で……\nね？:
I mean, at the very end,
we should just be our usual selves...
Right？
translations.（旅行の後の、\n一人の帰り道って、\nやっぱりなんか切ないな……）:
(Walking home alone
after a trip really feels
a little lonely, doesn't it...)
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲……\nあれ、\n●、なんか忘れもの？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Wait, ●,
did you forget something？
translations.お母さんが、お惣菜、\n持って行ってあげてって。\nはい。:
Mom told me to give you
some side dishes to take home.
Here.
translations.ほら、電車の中で……\n邪魔されちゃった分。:
You know, to make up for...
when we got interrupted
on the train.
translations.うん。\nお母さんに、お礼言っとこうか？:
Yeah.
Should I thank your mom？
translations.ダメダメ！ そんな事したら、\nお母さん、話が止まらなくなって\n家に帰れなくな:
No, no! If you do that,
she won't stop talking
and you won't get home tonight？
translations.そっか、じゃあ、\nこれで。:
Got it. Well,
I'll be going then.
translations.ここって、修学旅行って感じ。\nね？:
This place really feels like
a school trip, doesn't it？
translations.なるほど、\nこういう風なんだ……\nフムフム。:
I see, so this is
how it looks...
Mm-hmm.
translations.いいな、ここからの眺め……\n来てよかった。:
The view from here is great...
I'm glad we came.
translations.そっかそっか……\n大人じゃないと、\nわからないかもね？:
I see, I see...
Maybe you need to be an adult
to appreciate it？
translations.こんな所もあるんだ。\nふぅん……。:
They have places like this, too.
Hmm...
translations.なるほど、世界遺産ですな……\nフム。:
I see, a World Heritage site,
is it... Mm-hmm.
translations.あ、ほら。\nホントの修学旅行のツアーだ。\nふふっ！:
Oh, look.
A real school trip tour!
Hehe!
translations.この辺りでも、\nもう結構、暑いんだね……。:
Even around here,
it's already pretty hot...
translations.新緑って、葉っぱの色が透けてる\nみたいで、夏よりきれい。:
The fresh greenery looks so translucent,
even prettier than in summer.
translations.暦の上ではもう秋か……\n修学旅行シーズン、\n真っ盛りだね？ ふふっ。:
By the calendar it's autumn...
Peak school trip season,
isn't it？ Hehe.
translations.あ、ちょっと涼しい風……\nやっぱり十羽野より、\n秋が早いのかな？:
Oh, a cool breeze...
I guess autumn comes earlier
here than in Towano？
translations.ちょっと、\n自由行動にする？:
Want to have some
free time for a bit？
translations.フムフム……\n中はこうなってるんだ。:
Hmm, let's see...
So this is how it looks inside.
translations.迷子になっちゃわないでね？: Make sure you don't get lost, okay？
translations.うんうん……\n素敵なお部屋、ね？:
Mm-hmm...
Such a lovely room, isn't it？
translations.お部屋、ちょっと贅沢すぎない？\n修学旅行って言うより……\nほら、ねぇ？:
Isn't this room a bit too fancy？
Less like a school trip, and more...
Well, you know？
translations.お部屋にもお風呂、\nついてるんだね？: Oh, there's a bath in our room too, huh？
translations.静か……\n川のせせらぎが聞こえる。:
It's so quiet...
I can hear the river murmuring.
translations.お茶、いれてあげよっか？\nね？:
Want me to make some tea for you？
Hmm？
translations.ん～？\nどっちだっけ？:
Hmm～？
Which way was it again？
translations.知らない駅って、\n迷子になりそう……。:
Unfamiliar stations always make me feel
like I'm gonna get lost...
translations.鬼怒太っていうんだ。\nあの鬼。\nちょっとカワイイかも？:
So his name is Kinuta.
That ogre, I mean.
Kind of cute, isn't he？
translations.鬼怒川とはもうお別れか……\nまた、いつか来るね？:
Saying goodbye to Kinugawa already...
We'll come back someday, okay？
translations.二人で日光にいるんだね……\n不思議。:
Just the two of us here in Nikko...
It feels almost unreal.
translations.また来たいな、日光……。: I'd love to visit Nikko again...
translations.日本って広いんだな……。: Japan really is huge, isn't it...
translations.ハァ～……\nマイナスイオン効果？:
Ahhh...
Must be all those negative ions？
translations.いいないいな♪\n世界旅行。:
I love this♪
A trip around the world!
translations.う～ん、\nやっぱり、遺跡がいいなぁ。:
Hmm,
the ancient ruins are definitely my favorite.
translations.うわぁ、細か～い▼: Whoa, look at all the detail!▼
translations.ん～～？\n忍者、隠れてる？:
Hmm～？
Is there a ninja hiding somewhere？
translations.みんな、木と紙だったんだね……\nうん、そういうのもいいかも。:
Everything used to be wood and paper, huh...
Yeah, I kind of like that.
translations.すごぉい……\nちょっと、大人の気分？\nふふっ。:
Incredible...
Feels a little grown-up, doesn't it？
Hehe.
translations.迷子になりそう……。: Feels like I'm gonna get lost...
translations.本当の修学旅行の人たちも、\n泊まってるかな？:
I wonder if any actual school trips
are staying here too？
translations.あれ？ さっきのカーブは、\nカウントしないのかな……。:
Huh？ Did that curve back there
not count, I wonder...？
translations.テレビで見るのと、\nやっぱり違うね……。:
It's so different seeing it in person
than on TV...
translations.来てよかったね、日光……。: I'm so glad we came to Nikko...
translations.人が入って来る前から、\nずっとここにあるんだね……。:
It's been here since long before
people ever set foot here, huh...
translations.こっち側が世界遺産、\nあっちは、普通のとこ。ふふっ。:
This side is a World Heritage site,
and that side is just normal. Hehe.
translations.小学生の子たち、\nあとで絵、描かされるのかな？\n私、ゼッタイ無理……。:
I wonder if the grade schoolers have to
draw pictures of this later？
No way I could ever do that...
translations.徳川家康、だよね？\nそっかそっか……。:
Tokugawa Ieyasu, right？
I see, I see...
translations.ちゃんと見たら、\n一日じゃ無理かも……。:
If we take our time looking around,
one day might not be enough...
translations.昔の人も、\nみんな歩いたんだよね？\n当たり前か……歩こう。:
People back then had to walk all of this,
didn't they？
Well, of course they did... Let's walk.
translations.うん、\nこれは御利益がありそう。:
Yeah,
this really feels like
it'll bring good luck.
translations.一緒に帰る約束なのに、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、遅いな……。:
We promised to go home
together, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is
taking a while...
translations.▲主人公＊▲。\nごめん、待った？:
▲主人公＊▲.
Sorry, did you wait long？
translations.これ？\nほら、行ったじゃない熱海？\nあの時の、浴衣だよ？:
This？
Come on, remember Atami？
It's the yukata from back then,
see？
translations.うん、そうだ……\nそうだけど、いや――:
Yeah, it is...
I mean, it is, but wait—
translations.また旅行したいなぁ……\n二人で一緒に、\n知らない町を歩いて、:
I'd love to travel again...
Just the two of us,
strolling through an
unfamiliar town,
translations.美味しい物食べて……\n温泉に、入っちゃったり！\nね？:
eating delicious food...
and soaking in a hot spring!
Doesn't that sound nice？
translations.ちょっと考えてたの……\n私たちにも、そろそろ、冒険が\n必要なんじゃないかなっ:
I was just thinking...
Maybe it's about time
we had an adventure, too.
translations.いつもみたいなデートもいいけど\nもっと、知らない所に行って、\n例えば……。:
Our usual dates are nice,
but going somewhere new...
For example...
translations.じゃあ、決まり！\n二人で、たくさん思い出、\n作ろうね？:
Then it's settled!
Let's make lots of memories
together, okay？
translations.約束だよ？\nそれでは、\nはじまりはじまり～！:
It's a promise, okay？
And with that,
here we go~!
translations.はぁ～～……\n今日も働いた！:
Phew...
Put in a good day's
work today!
translations.お疲れ様でした。\nよく働くねぇ、私たち。\n誰かご褒美くれないかな？:
Good work today.
We really worked hard,
didn't we？
Wonder if someone'll
give us a reward？
translations.ご褒美って言えば、\n実は、また当たったんだ！:
Speaking of rewards,
I actually won another one!
translations.あ、日光・鬼怒川！\n熱海の方？\nもう驚かないよ？:
Oh, Nikko-Kinugawa？
Or Atami？
You can't surprise me
anymore, you know？
translations.今度は、箱根。\n国内ハネムーン再発見、\n一泊二日だって!!:
This time it's Hakone.
A two-day, one-night
'Rediscover the
Domestic Honeymoon' trip!!
translations.ハネムーンって……\n新婚旅行のハネムーン？:
Honeymoon, as in...
like for newlyweds？
translations.なんでも、昭和30年代には、\n新婚旅行といえば箱根とか、\n熱海だったんだって:
Apparently back in the Showa
thirties, Hakone and Atami
were the honeymoon spots.
translations.そういう所をもう一度観光しよう\nっていう、カップル向けの\nツアーらしい。:
It's a couples' tour to
revisit those places,
or so it says.
translations.進まないっていうか、だって……\nわかってる？\n自分の言ってる事……。:
It's not that, but...
Do you realize what
you're saying...？
translations.えぇと……\nハネムーンが気になるってこと？:
Uh... so the 'honeymoon'
part is bugging you？
translations.もちろん、ただ、\nそういうテーマの旅行って\n事なんだろうけど……。:
I know it's just the
theme of the tour, of
course, but still...
translations.そうそう。\n今までの旅行と、変わらないよ？:
Right, right.
It's no different from our
other trips, right？
translations.わかってるけど、そう、はっきり\n言われると、意識しちゃうの！\nすぐ返事は出来:
I know, but hearing you
say it so bluntly makes me
conscious of it!
I can't just give you
an answer right away!
translations.ねぇ……\nさっきの話なんだけど、ね？:
Hey...
About what we were
talking about earlier？
translations.“本当の”じゃ、ないもんね？\nほら、ごっこっていうか……。:
It's not 'real', right？
Like... just playing
pretend...
translations.もうっ……\nそれで、いつ行くの？:
Geez...
So, when are we going？
translations.（ハネムーンだし、デートは\nまた別の日にしよう……。）:
(Since it's a honeymoon,
I'll save our date for
another day...)
translations.じゃあ。\n▲月▲▲日▲から、\n一泊二日のハネムーンだ！:
All right.
Starting ▲月▲▲日▲,
it's a two-day, one-night
honeymoon!
translations.ハァ～……\n今日もお仕事終了！:
Phew...
Done with work for today!
translations.よしよし。\n今日もよく働きました。:
There, there.
You worked hard today.
translations.でしょ？\n何かご褒美くれる？\nふふっ。:
Right？
Will you give me a reward？
Hehe.
translations.（そうだ！\nまた当たった\n箱根旅行の懸賞、\n誘ってみるかな……）:
(Oh, right!
Maybe I should invite her
on that Hakone sweepstakes
trip I won again...)
translations.実は、また当たったんだ、\n国内ハネムーン再発見、\n一泊二日箱根の旅！:
Actually, I won again!
The 'Rediscover Honeymoons:
2 Days, 1 Night in Hakone' trip!
translations.すごい高確率だけど、\nもう慣れたよね！:
The odds are crazy,
but we're used to it by now!
translations.ま、まあね……\nでも、う～ん……そっか。:
W-Well, yeah...
Still, hmm... I see.
translations.あれ？\n気が進まない？:
Huh？
Not feeling up for it？
translations.だって、ほら、\nどうなの、何回も行くのって？\nなんだか、縁起悪くないかな？:
I mean, look...
Going so many times...
Doesn't that seem unlucky？
translations.なるほど……\nほら、“ごっこ”なわけだし。\n練習って言うか。:
I guess...
Hey, we're just pretending.
Think of it like practice.
translations.練習、か……\nそっか。\n練習……よね？:
Practice, huh...
I see.
Just... practice, right？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n“ごっこ”なんだから、\nまた、するんだよ？:
Hey, if it's pretend,
we're doing that again, okay？
translations.ほら、この間の時みたいに、\n旅行中、ずっと……ね？:
You know, like last time...
the whole trip... okay？
translations.やった！\nそれじゃあ、\nいつにするかな……。:
All right!
Well then,
when should we go...？
translations.（デートは、また別の日にしよう\nハネムーンだし……。）:
(Let's save normal dates
for another time...
Since it's a honeymoon.)
translations.もうっ、\nもうちょっと、ロマンチックに\n言ってください。:
Geez...
Could you say that a little
more romantically, please？
translations.▲月▲▲日▲から、\nハネムーンに行こう、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？:
Let's go on our honeymoon
starting ▲月▲▲日▲,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.ねぇねぇ、\nハネムーン、だよね？\n“ごっこ”だけど。:
Hey, it's a honeymoon, right？
Even if it's pretend.
translations.箱根のこと？\nまあ、そうだけど。:
You mean Hakone？
Well, yeah, pretty much.
translations.じゃあ、ちょっとお買い物に\n行かない？ 今から。:
Then wanna go shopping
for a bit？ Right now.
translations.買い物か。\nでも、一泊だよ？\nなんか必要？:
Shopping, huh？
It's only one night, though.
Do we need anything？
translations.そうなんだけど、\nう～ん、まあ、とにかく、\n行こう？ ね？:
I know, but...
Mm, well, anyway,
let's just go, okay？
translations.観光ガイドは買ったし。\n他には……なんかある？:
We bought the guidebook.
Is there... anything else？
translations.だから、“ごっこ”するの！\n本当のハネムーンみたいに。:
That's why we're pretending!
Just like a real honeymoon.
translations.二人用の大きな旅行カバンとか、\n他にも二人で使う物を選んで、\n買ったふり。:
We'll pick out a big suitcase
for the two of us, and stuff
we'd share, then pretend
to buy them. Okay？
translations.なるほど……\nよし、行ってみよう！:
I see...
All right, let's do it!
translations.はぁ……\n買っちゃったね？\n“ふり”だけど。 ふふっ！:
Phew...
We sure bought a lot, huh？
Just pretending, though. Hehe!
translations.まあね？\nでも、やっぱり、\n●はピンクのカバンは――:
I guess？
Still, a pink suitcase for ●
is a little...
translations.あれは、いいの。\n書いて有ったんだもん。\nハネムーン特集の雑誌に。:
Oh, that's fine.
It was right there in that
honeymoon magazine special!
translations.飛行機やバスで荷物を預ける時、\nすぐに自分のってわかるのが\n便利なんだって。:
They said it's convenient
because you can spot yours
right away when you check bags
on a plane or a bus.
translations.なんか、本当っぽく\nなってきたね？\n楽しみ！:
It's starting to feel real,
isn't it？
I can't wait!
translations.じゃあ、私は、ちょっと色々\n買ってから帰るから、ここでね？:
Well, I'm gonna pick up a few
things before heading home,
so I'll leave you here, okay？
translations.（ここは、\n着いて行っちゃダメなんだよな？\nよし、帰ろう！）:
(I probably shouldn't
tag along here, right？
All right, time to head home!)
translations.ハァ～……\n朝からむしむしするね～？:
Phew...
It's so humid out already,
isn't it？
translations.まあね？ でも、\n６月って、言うじゃない？\nジューンなんとかって……ね？:
True, but... people always talk
about June, don't they？
June something-or-other... right？
translations.もちろん、“ごっこ”よ？\n“ごっこ”だから、うん。:
Just pretend, of course!
We're just playing pretend, yep.
translations.おはよう。\nやっぱり、ちょっと涼しいね？:
Good morning.
It really is a bit chilly,
isn't it？
translations.うん、向こうはもっとだろうな。:
Yeah, it'll probably be
even colder over there.
translations.紅葉の箱根か……\nうん、確かにロマンチックかも、\nほら、アレとしては……ね？:
Hakone in the fall foliage...
Yeah, that does sound romantic.
You know, for "that"... right？
translations.もうっ……\nまあ、“ごっこ”だけど？:
Jeez...
Well, even if it is
just pretend？
translations.そっか。\n“ごっこ”だけど、\nハネムーンだもんな……。:
Right.
Even if it is pretend,
it's still a honeymoon...
translations.うん……\nよろしくお願いします。:
Yeah...
Take good care of me, okay？
translations.ふふっ！\nじゃあ、しゅっぱーつ！:
Hehe!
All right, and off we go!
translations.あんまり、ハネムーンぽくは\nないよね？\n今のところ。:
It doesn't really feel
like a honeymoon, does it？
So far, at least.
translations.いつもの電車だしね？:
Well, we're just on our usual
train, aren't we？
translations.まあ、そっか。\nやっぱり、特急に乗ってからか。\nうん、期待しよっと。:
Well, true.
It won't really start until
we're on the express train.
Yep, can't wait!
translations.あ、ねぇ、これ？\nこれに乗るの？:
Oh, hey, is this it？
This is what we're riding？
translations.……どう？\nハネムーンぽくなってきた？:
...Well？
Starting to feel like
a honeymoon yet？
translations.うん。\nだって、『ロマンスカー』だよ？\nふふっ！:
Yeah.
I mean, it is a "Romancecar"!
Hehe!
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n『ロマンスカー』、\n乗るんだよね、今度も？:
Hey, hey,
we're riding the "Romancecar"
this time too, right？
translations.『ロマンスカー』、\n気に入ったみたいだね？:
Looks like you really took
a liking to the "Romancecar."
translations.だって、ロマンスですもの。\nふふっ！:
Well, it's romance, after all!
Hehe!
translations.おぉ、やっぱりカッコいいな、\n『ロマンスカー』！:
Ooh, the "Romancecar"
really is so cool!
translations.うん、カッコいい。\nふふっ、すごく\n『ロマンスカー』なのにね？:
Yeah, it is cool.
Hehe, even with a name like
"Romancecar."
translations.ねぇ！\nそれに、ほら、気がついた？\n真ん中の肘掛が付いて無いの。:
Right？
And hey, did you notice？
There's no armrest in the middle.
translations.あ、そう言えば……。\n可動式のはよくあるけど、\n肘掛自体が無いんだ……。:
Oh, now that you mention it...
Usually they just fold up,
but there isn't one at all...
translations.ね？ 私、思うんだけど、\nこういうとこが、あれなのよ、\n“ロマンス”。:
Right？ I was just thinking,
things like this are what make it
all about "romance."
translations.ね？\nついつい、二人の距離も\n縮まっちゃうでしょ▼:
Right？
It just naturally brings us
closer together, doesn't it▼
translations.う～ん……\nやっぱり特急はいいな！:
Man...
Limited expresses really
are the best!
translations.うん。\nハネムーンって感じ、\nしてきちゃった。:
Yeah.
It's really starting to feel
like a honeymoon.
translations.やっぱり、ついつい、\n距離が縮まっちゃうみたい。\nロマンスカーって、不思議▼:
See, we just can't help
getting closer together.
The Romancecar really is
magical▼
translations.ねぇねぇ、今、どの辺り？:
Hey, hey, where are we
around now？
translations.そっか。\nじゃあ、海はもっと先？:
I see.
So the ocean is further ahead？
translations.熱海の時と違って、\n陸の方を走ってるからね。:
Unlike when we went to Atami,
we're heading inland.
translations.そうだ、熱海って言えばね？\nちょっと、やったじゃない？\nハネムーンごっこ。:
Oh yeah, speaking of Atami...
remember how we played
pretend honeymoon？
translations.でも今回は、もっともっと\nだからね？ いい？:
But this time, we're taking it
way further, okay？ Deal？
translations.それは……\nうん、これから考えます。:
Well...
Yup, I'll think of something
as we go.
translations.そうそう！ 熱海って言えば、\nやってくれなかったよね？\nほら、ハネムーンごっ:
Oh, right! Speaking of Atami,
you didn't play along,
did you？
Our pretend honeymoon, I mean.
translations.あぁ……\nそう言えば。:
Ah...
Now that you mention it.
translations.今度は、ダメだからね？\nだって、そのための旅行だもん。\n……わかってるかな？:
You won't get away with it
this time, okay？
That's what this trip is for!
...Got it？ Hehe.
translations.（ちょっと、恥ずかしいけど、\nがんばろう……。）:
(It's a little embarrassing,
but I'll do my best...)
translations.そうだ。\nこの間のハネムーンでも、\n箱根の近くで見えたっけ、海？:
Oh yeah.
On our last honeymoon,
could we see the ocean
near Hakone？
translations.うん、確かそうだった。:
Yeah, I'm pretty sure
we could.
translations.ふふっ、\nなんか、おかしい。\n“この間のハネムーン”って。:
Hehe,
it sounds so funny saying
“our last honeymoon.”
translations.いいんだもん。\n楽しい事は何回したって。\nね、楽しもうね？ ふふっ！:
Who cares, though？
Fun things are great no matter
how many times you do them.
Let's have a blast, okay？
Hehe!
translations.まもなく終点、箱根湯本\nに到着いたします。\n箱根登山線・強羅方面は……。:
We will soon arrive at
the final stop, Hakone-Yumoto.
For the Hakone Tozan Line
bound for Gora...
translations.あ、ほら、箱根湯本って！\n降りるところでしょ？:
Ah, see, Hakone-Yumoto!
That's where we get off, right？
translations.よし！\nそろそろ支度しよう！:
All right!
Let's get our stuff ready!
translations.すごい……\n今まで二人で行ったところで、\n一番、観光地って感じかも。:
Wow...
Out of everywhere we've been,
this feels the most like a real
tourist spot.
translations.うん。\n箱根だからね……。:
Yeah.
It is Hakone, after all...
translations.お土産屋さんもいっぱい。\nどこまで続いてるんだろう……。:
There are so many souvenir shops.
I wonder how far they go...
translations.じゃあ、行ってみよう？: Shall we go take a look？
translations.二人は新婚さんなんだよ？\n本当のハネムーンでも、\nそんな風に独りで行っちゃう:
We're newlyweds, remember？
Would you just walk off alone
like that on a real honeymoon？
translations.（嬉しいけど、\nちょっと照れくさい……）:
(I'm happy, but
it's a little embarrassing...)
translations.うん、\n来ちゃったね、箱根……\nふふっ！:
Yup,
here we are in Hakone...
Hehe!
translations.なんでも？ ちょっと、\n思い出しちゃっただけだよ？\nこの前のハネムーン。:
Nothing at all？ I was just
remembering our last
honeymoon, that's all.
translations.あ、照れてる。\n……私もだけど。\nねぇ、まずはどうするんだっけ？:
Aw, you're blushing.
...Though I am, too.
Hey, what do we do first？
translations.（やっぱいいぞ、ハネムーン！\n“ごっこ”だけど！）:
(Honeymoons really are great!
Even if it's just pretend!)
translations.『あじさいばし』。\nほら、川岸に咲いてる！:
'Hydrangea Bridge.'
Look, they're blooming
along the riverbank!
translations.いろんな色のが咲いてる。\nきれい……。\nそう言えば、テレビでやってた。:
So many different colors.
They're gorgeous...
Oh, right, I saw this on TV.
translations.箱根にはね、\nたくさんアジサイが咲いていて、\nちょうど、シーズンなんだって。:
They said Hakone has lots
of hydrangeas, and this is
their peak season.
translations.そう言えば、\n電車からも見えたな。:
Now that you mention it,
I saw some from the train.
translations.きっと、旅行中に\nたくさん見られるよ？:
I bet we'll see plenty
during our trip, don't you think？
translations.６月の『あじさいばし』か……\nふふっ、いい感じ。\nロマンチック▼:
Hydrangea Bridge in June...
Hehe, it's so lovely.
How romantic▼
translations.うん。\nう～ん……さすがに、\nアジサイは咲いてないね？:
Yeah.
Mm... As expected,
no hydrangeas are blooming？
translations.そのかわり、ほら、\nところどころ紅葉してて、\nきれい……。:
Instead, look!
The leaves have started turning
here and there. So pretty...
translations.うん。\n上の方は、\nもっときれいだろうな……。:
Yeah.
I bet it's even prettier
higher up...
translations.だよね？\n紅葉の箱根で、\nハネムーンだもんね？:
Right？
We're on our honeymoon in
autumn Hakone, after all？
translations.ご飯を食べながら、\n紅葉を見なくちゃ！\nふふっ▼:
We've gotta enjoy the fall colors
while we eat!
Hehe▼
translations.ちょっと早いけど、この辺りで\n昼ごはん食べて行こう。:
It's a little early, but let's
grab some lunch around here.
translations.はいはーい！\n湯葉が食べたいです！:
Ooh, me, me!
I want to eat yuba!
translations.そう。\n日光でも食べたけど、\n箱根も有名なんだよ？:
Yup.
We had it in Nikko, too,
but Hakone's famous for it, too, you know？
translations.湯葉か……\nじゃあ、ちょっと探して――:
Yuba, huh...
All right, let's look for—
translations.ここ！\nここに来たかったの。\n『湯葉丼 直吉』。 いい？:
Here!
This is where I wanted to go.
'Yubadon Naokichi.' Okay？
translations.いいけど、\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、ここ知ってるの？:
Sure, but...
did you know this place, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.実は、ちょっとね？\nガイドで調べちゃった。\nほら、入ろ？:
To tell the truth, yeah？
I looked it up in a guide.
Come on, let's head in!
translations.へぇ……\n早川が見えるんだな……。:
Whoa...
You can see the Hayakawa
from here...
translations.ね？ いい感じでしょ？\nそれに、ここの湯葉は『姫の水』\nっていう湧水で作るん:
Right？ Isn't it nice？
Plus, they say their yuba is
made with spring water called
'Princess Water.'
translations.なるほどね？\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、もう\nなに頼むか決まった？:
I see.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you decide
what you want to order yet？
translations.お待たせしました。\n『湯葉丼＋湯葉刺しセット』と、\n『湯葉そば』で御座います:
Thank you for waiting.
Here's your Yuba Bowl and
Sashimi Set, and Yuba Soba.
translations.でしょ？\nこれで、湯葉丼と、湯葉刺しと\n湯葉のおそば、全部！:
Right？
This way, we get yuba bowl,
yuba sashimi, and yuba soba,
every single one!
translations.全部、一緒に食べるの。\nだって、ほら……\n新婚さんでしょ？:
We're sharing everything!
After all...
aren't we newlyweds？
translations.ふふっ、\nはい、一口どうぞ？\nア～ン……。:
Hehe...
Here, have a bite？
Say ahhh...
translations.『湯葉丼 直吉』。\nほら、入ろ？:
'Yuba-don Naokichi'.
Come on, let's go in？
translations.さて、今日はなに頼む？:
Now then, what should
we order today？
translations.今日も、『湯葉そば』と、\n『湯葉丼＋湯葉刺しセット』\nです。:
Today it's 'Yuba Soba' and
the 'Yuba Bowl + Sashimi
Set' again.
translations.やっぱり、湯葉づくしか。\nけっこうボリューム\nあるんだよね？:
All yuba again, huh？
That's actually quite
a lot of food, right？
translations.そうだよ？\n私はちょっとずつ全部。\nあなたは、たくさん食べて？:
Yup！
I'll have a bit of each,
and you eat plenty, okay？
translations.はい、召し上がれ？\nア～ン……。:
Here you go, dig in？
Say ahhh...
translations.ごちそうさまでした。\nふぅ……\n食べすぎちゃった。:
That was delicious.
Phew...
I ate way too much.
translations.ねぇねぇ、\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』、\n行くんだよね？:
Hey, hey, we're going
to the Hakone Glass
Forest Museum, right？
translations.うん。\n箱根登山鉄道に乗って、強羅だ。:
Yeah.
We'll take the Hakone Tozan
Railway to Gora.
translations.あ、カワイイ～！\nあの電車？\nあれで山を登るの？:
Ah, so cute!
That train？ We're going
up the mountain on that？
translations.へぇ……\n見かけによらず力持ちなんだ。:
Huh...
It's pretty powerful
for how it looks.
translations.次は、\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』？\nまた、あの電車に乗る？:
Next is the Hakone Glass
Forest Museum？
Taking that train again？
translations.そう。\n箱根登山鉄道で、強羅まで。:
Yeah.
On the Hakone Tozan
Railway, all the way to Gora.
translations.あった！\nカワイイ～！:
There it is!
It's so cute~!
translations.また、がんばって\n登ってね？:
Work hard climbing
up again, okay？
translations.私たち、今日はちょっと、\nお昼食べすぎちゃったけど、\n大丈夫かな？ ふふっ！:
We ate a bit too much
for lunch today, though...
Will you be okay？ Hehe!
translations.すごーい！\nアジサイの中を走ってる！:
Wow, look!
We're riding right through
the hydrangeas!
translations.どうしてこんなに\nたくさん咲いてるんだろう……\n誰かが植えてるのかな？:
I wonder why there are
so many blooming...
Did someone plant them？
translations.そっか……。\n親切な人がいるんだね？\nあ、ほらほら、また！:
I see...
How sweet of them.
Oh, look, look! Again!
translations.すごい坂！\n大丈夫？ 登れる？\nがんばれ～！ ふふっ！:
What a steep hill!
Can you make it？
You can do it! Hehe!
translations.（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、喜んでる。\nいい時期に来たな！）:
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks so happy.
We picked a great time
to visit!)
translations.きれい……\n紅葉がすごいねぇ……。:
So pretty...
The autumn leaves
are gorgeous...
translations.うん……。\n秋らしくていいね……。:
Yeah...
It really feels like
autumn. So nice...
translations.本当……\nねぇ、俳句でも\n詠んでみたくならない？:
It really does...
Hey, doesn't it make you
want to write a haiku？
translations.じゃあ、私から。\nえぇ……紅葉の……。:
I'll go first, then.
Let's see... Autumn leaves...
translations.……ダメだ！ ふふっ！\nあ、ほらまた、すごい坂！\n電車がんばれ～！:
...Nope, got nothing! Hehe!
Oh, look, another steep hill!
Hang in there, train~!
translations.着いた！\n終点、強羅駅！:
We're here!
Last stop, Gora Station!
translations.あ……\nちょっと薄着だったかな？\n箱根湯本より涼しい気がする。:
Ah...
Maybe I dressed too light？
It feels cooler here than
Hakone-Yumoto.
translations.うん、結構登ったからね。:
Yeah, we came up
pretty high, after all.
translations.電車、頑張ってたもんね？\nふふっ。\nここからは、どうするんだっけ？:
The train worked so hard,
didn't it？
Hehe. What do we do
from here again？
translations.『箱根ガラスの森美術館』まで、\nバスだよ。:
We take a bus to the
Hakone Glass Forest Museum.
translations.あ、もう忘れた？\n腕、組むの！:
Aw, did you forget already？
Link arms with me!
translations.（あ、柔らかい……\nもっと薄着でもよかったのに）:
(Ah, so soft...
She could've dressed even
lighter, though.)
translations.わっ、寒い！\nやっぱり下より寒いねっ！:
Whoa, it's cold!
Definitely colder than
down below!
translations.箱根にきた感じがするな。:
Really feels like
we're in Hakone now.
translations.うぅっ！\n寒ぅ～……。\nバスに乗るんだっけ？:
Brrr!
So chiiiilly...
We take a bus now, right？
translations.そう。\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』まで。:
Right.
To the Hakone Glass
Forest Museum.
translations.（うん。\nやっぱり薄着の季節の方が……）:
(Yeah. Though, the season
for lighter clothes really
would be nice...)
translations.おぉ、けっこうな坂道だな……。:
Whoa, that's quite a
steep hill...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、\n登りは平気なんだっけ？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're
okay going uphill, right？
translations.平気だよ。\nそれに、やっぱりこうやって\nくっついて座ってると、ほら。:
I'm fine.
Besides, sitting close
like this, you know...
translations.ハネムーンしてますって\n感じ、するじゃない？:
Doesn't it really feel like
we're on our honeymoon？
translations.今の、\n見られちゃったかな？:
Do you think...
someone saw us just now？
translations.しょうがないよね？\nだって、ハネムーンだもん。\nふふっ▼:
Can't be helped, right？
I mean, we're on our
honeymoon. Hehe▼
translations.次は、\n俵石・箱根ガラスの森前……。:
Next stop: Hyoseki -
Hakone Glass Forest...
translations.俵石・箱根ガラスの森前です。\nお降りのお客さまは、\nお忘れ物の無いよう……。:
Hyoseki - Hakone Glass
Forest. Please be sure not
to leave anything behind...
translations.『箱根ガラスの森美術館』。\nここか……。:
The Hakone Glass Forest
Museum. So this is it...
translations.うん、\n本当のヨーロッパの建物みたい。\n行った事ないけど……。:
Yeah, it looks like a real
European building.
Not that I've ever been...
translations.ねぇ、あれ、ガラスの木！\nすごくキラキラしてる……。\n電気？:
Hey, look at that glass
tree! It sparkles so much...
Is it electric lights？
translations.太陽が反射してるんじゃ\nないかな？\nなるほど、ガラスの森か！:
I think it's just the sun
reflecting. Ah, makes sense,
a forest of glass!
translations.……\nごゆっくりお楽しみください。:
……
Please take your time
and enjoy your visit.
translations.ねぇ、見てこれ！\nこのチケット！\nおもしろーい▼:
Hey, look at this!
Look at the ticket!
That's so neat▼
translations.凝ってるなぁ！:
They really put some
detail into it!
translations.着いた。\n『箱根ガラスの森美術館』！:
We're here.
The Hakone Glass Forest
Museum!
translations.ほらほら、\nクリスタルガラスの木、\nきれい……。:
Look, look!
The crystal glass tree...
It's gorgeous...
translations.太陽の光だけなのに、\nどうしてあんなに\n七色になるんだろう……。:
Even though it's just
sunlight, how does it shine
in so many colors...？
translations.あ、ねぇこれ！\nこの間のと違う！\n集めたくなっちゃうね？:
Oh, hey, look at this!
It's not like the last one!
Makes you wanna collect them,
doesn't it？
translations.本当だ。\n相変わらず凝ってるなぁ……。:
You're right.
They really put a lot of work
into these, as usual...
translations.わぁ……\n日本じゃないみたい！:
Wow...
It feels like we're not even
in Japan!
translations.うん……。\n館内が全部ヴェネチアの\nイメージらしいよ。:
Yeah...
Apparently the whole place
is modeled after Venice.
translations.なるほどねぇ……\nねぇ、色々キラキラしてる！\n行ってみよう？:
I see...
Hey, look at all the sparkles!
Let's go check it out？
translations.見て見て、これ！\nガラスのアジサイ！:
Look, look at this!
A glass hydrangea!
translations.えぇと、『オルテンシア』、か。\n２千粒のクリスタルガラスで\n出来てるって書い:
Uh, 'Ortensia', huh？
It says it's made of
2,000 crystal glass beads.
translations.２千粒！ そっか……\n本物のアジサイと一緒に\n並んでるところが、お洒落▼:
Two thousand! Wow...
Having it right by the real
hydrangeas is so stylish▼
translations.あ、見てこれ！\nススキがガラスになってる！:
Oh, look at this!
The pampas grass is glass!
translations.ガラスのススキか……。\n１００粒のクリスタル\nガラスの穂が、１００株!?:
Glass pampas grass, huh...
Each stalk has 100 crystal beads,
and there are 100 plants!?
translations.キレイ……\n風が吹くと揺れるんだ……\n秋だもんね……。:
So pretty...
They sway when the wind blows...
It really feels like autumn...
translations.光の回廊だって！\nキレイ……。:
It says 'Corridor of Light'!
So pretty...
translations.高さ９ｍ、全長１０ｍ。\nクリスタルガラスが、\n１６万粒!?:
Nine meters high, ten long.
160,000 crystal beads!?
translations.風に揺れてるね……\nどうしてこんなに\n色んな色になるんだろう……。:
They're swaying in the breeze...
I wonder how it sparkles
in so many different colors...
translations.そうだ！\nねぇねぇ？\n写真、撮ろう？:
I know!
Hey, hey...
Let's take a picture？
translations.ここを通るときは やっぱり……\nね？:
When we walk through here,
you know what we have to do...
right？
translations.う～ん！\nいいなぁ、やっぱり！\nガラスのヴェネチア！:
Mmm!
I really love this!
A Venice made of glass!
translations.山もよく見える！\n煙が見えるのは、大涌谷かな？:
Great view of the mountains, too!
Is that smoke from Owakudani？
translations.わぁ、\n今日もキラッキラだね……。:
Wow,
it's so sparkly today, too...
translations.はい、ここを通るときは？:
All right, when we walk
through here, we have to...？
translations.優しい旦那サマで良かった▼\nふふっ！:
I'm so lucky to have such a sweet
husband▼
Hehe!
translations.すごいシャンデリア。\n映画に出て来るヨーロッパ貴族の\nお屋敷みたい……。:
What an amazing chandelier.
It's like a European noble's
mansion in the movies...
translations.ねぇ、これ見て！\n細か～い！\nお花のモザイクになってるの！:
Hey, look at this!
It's so intricate!
It's a mosaic of flowers!
translations.『ミルフィオリ』……\n“千の花”っていう意味だって。\n古代ローマからある技術:
'Millefiori'...
It means 'a thousand flowers'.
Said to date back to ancient Rome.
translations.古代ローマか……\nどうやって作るんだろう……\n絵じゃないんだもんね？:
Ancient Rome, huh...
I wonder how they make it...
It's not painted on, right？
translations.『点彩花文蓋付ゴブレット』？\n杯ってことだよね？\n貴族のヒトがお酒飲んだのか:
'Lidded Goblet with Stippled
Floral Pattern'？
That means a cup, right？
Did nobles drink wine from this？
translations.高～いお酒入れないと、\n悪い気がするよね？\nあ、ほら！:
You'd feel guilty if
you didn't pour really
pricey wine in it, right？
Oh, look!
translations.後ろから見ると、透けて\nコバルトブルーになるの！\nきれいだなぁ……。:
When you look from behind,
the light shines through
into cobalt blue!
So pretty...
translations.ここは、\nミュージアムショップか。:
So this is
the museum shop.
translations.あ、見たい見たい！\nね、いいでしょ？:
Ooh, I wanna look!
Come on, can we？
translations.ほら、クリスタルガラスの\n小物とか……あ、あれ、\n『ミルフィオリ』のお皿？:
Look, crystal glassware
trinkets... Wait, is that
a millefiori plate？
translations.へぇ、ガラスを組み合わせて、\n溶かし合わせるんだって。\nやってみる？:
Huh, looks like you
combine glass pieces and
melt them together.
Wanna try it？
translations.出来た！ 自信作！\nこれが溶けると\nどうなるんだろう？:
All done! A masterpiece!
I wonder what it'll
look like once it melts？
translations.焼きあがるまで、\nしばらくかかるみたいだ。:
Looks like it'll take
a while before it's done
firing.
translations.レストランで、休憩しようか？:
Wanna take a break
at the restaurant？
translations.いいなぁ、イタリアのカフェは、\nこんな感じなのかな？\nえぇと、カフェ、テラッ:
How nice... I wonder if
Italian cafes feel like
this？ Uh, Caffe Teratte？
translations.お待たせしました。\nフルーツティーでございます。:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is your fruit tea.
translations.カワイイ！\nほら、フルーツがこんなに！:
So cute!
Look at all the fruit!
translations.ちゃんと二人ぶんだしね？\nハネムーナーにはピッタリ。\nね？ ふふっ▼:
And it's made for two,
right？ Perfect for
honeymooners.
Isn't it？ Hehe▼
translations.はい、お待たせしました。\nとても綺麗に仕上がりましたよ？:
Thank you for waiting.
It turned out beautifully,
you know？
translations.ありがとうございます！\n……どれどれ？:
Thank you so much!
...Let's see here...
translations.うんうん、イイ感じ。\nネネ・フィオレ完成！\nふふっ！:
Mm-hmm, looks great!
Nene Fiore is complete!
Hehe!
translations.まだ時間あるけど、\nもう少し、見て回る？:
We still have time.
Wanna look around a bit
more？
translations.見てこれ！\nガラスの噴水……\nフォンターナだって！:
Look at this!
A glass fountain...
It says "Fontana"!
translations.おぉ……\nガラスの粒が４万５千個か。\nだんだん驚かなくなってきた。:
Whoa... Forty-five
thousand glass beads, huh.
I'm getting used to it now.
translations.もうっ、数はいいの。\nただ、きれいだな、って見るの。\nね？:
Jeez, forget the numbers!
Just look at it and
enjoy how pretty it is.
Right？
translations.ん？\nねぇ、あっち。\nあれ。なんだろ？:
Hm？ Hey, over there.
What's that？
translations.あ、じゃあ、\n『あいじょう岬』みたいな\n事かな？:
Oh, so like the thing
at Cape Aijo？
translations.特に、そういう説明は\n無いみたいだけど……。:
It doesn't really say
anything like that, though...
translations.でも、見て？\n両端から二人で引っ張って\n鳴らすみたいよ？:
Look, though？
Looks like you ring it
by pulling from both ends
together!
translations.お互い心の中で誓うの。秘密よ？\nでも……ハネムーナーなら\nきっと、同じ事でし:
We each make a vow
in our hearts. Secret, okay？
Though... as honeymooners,
it has to be the same, right？
translations.……同じ、かな？:
...Did we make the
same vow, you think？
translations.フォンターナ！\nガラスの噴水は今日も、\nきらっきら！ ふふっ！:
Fontana!
The glass fountain is
sparkling today, too!
Heheh!
translations.そうだ、\n『誓いの鐘』、どうする？:
Oh yeah, what about
the 'Bell of Vows'？
translations.行くでしょ？\nもちろん？:
We're going, right？
Of course we are？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、少し疲れた？:
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you
a little tired？
translations.う～ん、少し。\nちょっと、はしゃぎ過ぎたかも。:
Mm, a bit.
Maybe I got a little
too excited.
translations.そっか。\nいいとこだもんな。:
I get it.
It really is a great place.
translations.うん、大好き。\nあ、あのバス？:
Yeah, I love it.
Oh, is that our bus？
translations.やっぱり、教えてくれない？\nさっきの、秘密の誓い。\n気になるんだもん。:
Won't you please tell me？
Your secret vow earlier.
I'm really curious!
translations.ううん、やっぱりダメ。\nムードが、大事だもんね？\nうん……。:
No, never mind.
The mood is important,
right？ Yeah...
translations.次は、終点、桃源台、\n桃源台でございます。\n箱根ロープウェイ、海……。:
Next is the final stop,
Togendai, Togendai.
Hakone Ropeway, Lake...
translations.わぁ、すごーい！\nこれ、芦ノ湖だよね？:
Wow, amazing!
This is Lake Ashi, right？
translations.この後、どうするんだっけ？\nちょっと、行ってみない？:
What were we doing next？
Want to go check it out？
translations.先にチェックインしよう。\nこの後は、ホテルに泊まるだけ\nだから。:
Let's check in first.
After this, we're just
staying at the hotel.
translations.そっかそっか……\nホテルに泊まるだけ、か。:
Right, right...
Just staying at
the hotel, huh.
translations.ううん！\nただ、ほら……\nやっぱり、ちょっと、ね？:
No, nothing!
It's just, well...
Kind of gets you a bit
nervous, doesn't it？
translations.（そう言われると、\n●もなんだか緊張する……）:
(When she says that,
● gets kind of
nervous, too...)
translations.ほら、見えて来た。\nここだ、『箱根レイクホテル』！:
Look, there it is.
Right here—the
'Hakone Lake Hotel'!
translations.うん。\nリゾートって感じだね。:
Yeah.
Really feels like a resort.
translations.温泉旅館もいいけど、\nハネムーンは、\nこうでなくちゃね？:
A hot spring inn is nice,
but a honeymoon's gotta
be like this, right？
translations.はい、\n連れてって、アナタ▼\nふふっ！:
Alright,
take me inside, darling▼
Heheh!
translations.はい。\nエスコートして、旦那サマ。\nふふっ！:
Now then,
escort me, hubby.
Heheh!
translations.見て見て、\nすごい、シャンデリア！\nここも、ヨーロッパ風なんだね？:
Look, look!
Wow, what a chandelier!
It's European-style
here, too？
translations.そっか……\n箱根ってヨーロッパ風のところが\n多いんだ、きっと。:
I see...
Hakone must have a lot of
European-style spots.
translations.じゃあ、\nチェックインしてくる。:
Well,
I'll go check us in.
translations.じゃあ、名前も一緒だよね？:
Then we have the same
last name, right？
translations.ねぇねぇ、書いてくれた？:
Hey, hey, did you
write it down？
translations.ちゃんと書いたよ？\n“▲苗字▲ 寧々”って。:
I wrote it properly？
“▲苗字▲ Nene”.
translations.やぁ～、口に出して\n言われると、恥ずかしい！:
Aah~ hearing you say it
out loud is so embarrassing!
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nあ、奥様にも館内施設の\nご説明いたしましょうか？:
Thank you for waiting.
Shall I explain our facilities
to your wife as well？
translations.はい、じゃあ、\nお願いできます？:
Yes, please,
if you wouldn't mind？
translations.ねぇ……\n今の、奥様ぽかった？:
Hey...
did I seem like a wife
just now？
translations.（ぽかった……\nこれはいいかも！）:
(Totally did...
This might be pretty nice!)
translations.じゃあ、\nチェックインして来るよ。:
Well,
I'll go check us in.
translations.あ、わかってるよね？\n名前？:
Ah, you know what to do,
right？ The name？
translations.ちゃんと書いてくれた？\n一緒の名前で。:
Did you write it right？
With the same last name.
translations.ちゃんと書いたよ？\n“▲苗字▲ 寧々”。:
I wrote it properly？
“▲苗字▲ Nene”.
translations.う～ん……\n慣れないよぉ、ふふ。:
Mmm...
I'm not used to this at all, hehe.
translations.いえ、あの、\n主人から聞きますので。:
No, um...
My husband will tell me.
translations.だって、\n言ってみたかったんだもん、\n“主人”って……。:
Well,
I just really wanted to say
“my husband”...
translations.うん。\nでもまあ、畳とか布団の方が\nくつろげるしさ？:
Yeah.
Tatami and futons feel
more relaxing anyway, right？
translations.そうだね、うん！\nお布団でゴロゴロしちゃおっと！:
You're right, yeah!
I'm gonna roll around
on the futon!
translations.あ、ほら！\n窓の外、山がきれいだよ？\nすごく近く見える！:
Oh, look!
The mountains outside are
so pretty？
They look so close!
translations.山の上の方だからかな？\nいいな、こういう景色！:
Maybe 'cause we're high up？
I love views like this!
translations.えぇと……\nほんのちょっと、ね？:
Um...
Just a tiny bit, yeah？
translations.そうだ、お茶、いれるね？:
Oh, I'll make us some tea,
okay？
translations.なんでもないの、\nただ、幸せだなぁって。\nでも……。:
It's nothing, really.
Just thinking how happy I am.
...Though...
translations.本当の新婚さんなら、\nこれから毎日こういう\n生活になるのになぁって。:
If we were real newlyweds,
this is how our life would be
every single day, you know？
translations.言ってみただけだよ。\nふふっ！:
Just wanted to say it.
Hehe!
translations.ねぇねぇ、ご飯の前に、\nお風呂、入りに行かない？:
Hey, hey, want to hit
the baths before dinner？
translations.ちょっと時間あるし、\nそうしよっか？:
We've got some time,
so why not？
translations.男湯が『天』で、女湯が\n『空』か……新婚なら、\nほんとは一緒に――:
Men's is 'Heaven' and women's
is 'Sky', huh... If we were
newlyweds, we'd go in together—
translations.そうだ、\n“ごっこ”でした……。:
Oh right,
we're only playing pretend...
translations.エッチ、ふふっ。\nねぇ、ロビーのとこで、\n待ち合わせね？:
Pervert, hehe.
Hey, let's meet up
at the lobby, okay？
translations.露天風呂かぁ！\nやっぱり外はいいな……。:
An outdoor bath!
Nothing beats being outside...
translations.なんかね、\nまゆ玉みたいなのがあるよ？:
Hey, there's something that
looks like a cocoon over here？
translations.まゆ？\nああ、こっちにもある。\nなんだろう？:
A cocoon？
Oh, there's one here too.
Wonder what it is？
translations.へぇ！\n入ってみようかな？:
Oh!
Maybe I'll try it out？
translations.寧々ちゃんは、こっちの\n石の桶みたいなのに入りま～す。\n……よいしょ。:
Nene-chan's gonna hop into
this stone tub over here~
...Hup.
translations.ご想像におまかせしま～す！:
I'll leave that to your
imagination~!
translations.ハァ～～……\nいい湯だった。:
Pheeew...
That was a nice bath.
translations.もうっ……\nいちいち感心しないの！:
Geez...
Don't be in awe every
single time!
translations.腕組んで、ホテルの中、\n探検しよ？:
Let's link arms and explore
the hotel, okay？
translations.あ、\nリラクゼーションルームだって。\nちょっと、覗いてみる？:
Oh,
a relaxation room.
Want to take a peek inside？
translations.ウゥッ……\nや～、くすぐったい！\nもうダメ、ムリムリっ！:
Ack...
Nooo, that tickles!
I can't, no way, no way!
translations.弱いなら、\nやらなきゃいいのに……。:
If you're that ticklish,
you shouldn't have done it...
translations.だって、ふふっ！\nねぇ、お土産コーナー行こう？:
I couldn't help it, hehe!
Hey, want to check out
the gift shop？
translations.箱根名物か。\n色々あるんだな……。:
Hakone specialties, huh.
There's so much here...
translations.寄木細工でしょ、温泉饅頭に……\nあ、温泉の素！\nこれ、買ってこうかな？:
There's marquetry,
onsen steamed buns...
Oh, hot spring bath salts!
Should I get some of these？
translations.家のお風呂で温泉？:
Hot springs in your bath
at home？
translations.そう。お母さんが友達と\n温泉に行くとね？\n必ず買ってくるの。だから。:
Yep. Whenever Mom goes
to an onsen with friends,
she always buys some.
translations.温泉気分で、ご飯食べるとね？\n美味しくなる気がするんだって。:
She says eating dinner
with that onsen vibe
makes it taste better.
translations.ねぇ、\nちょっと、大人っぽい\n雰囲気だね？:
Hey...
It's kind of a grown-up
atmosphere, isn't it？
translations.お待たせいたしました。\nこちら、『豚ロースの山賊焼』に\nなります。:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is your pork loin
sanzokuyaki.
translations.うぅ……\nでも、もうお腹いっぱいかも。\nずいぶん頑張ったんだけど。:
Ugh...
I think I'm totally full.
And I really tried, too...
translations.あれ、違うんじゃない？\nほら、\n今の私たちは……ね？:
Wait, isn't that wrong？
Come on, remember what
we are right now...？
translations.はい、お口あけてくださ～い。\nア～ン▼:
Now open wide, please～
Say ahh▼
translations.ごちそうさまでした。\nはぁ～、お腹いっぱい……。:
Thanks for the meal.
Phew, I'm stuffed...
translations.うぅ～\n食べ過ぎたかも……。:
Ugh～
I think I ate too much...
translations.食事、美味しかったしね。:
The food was really good,
though.
translations.そうなの。\nだから、旅行はどうしても……\nハァ～……。:
I know!
That's why on trips, you just
can't help it... *sigh*...
translations.少し休憩しよう。\nお茶でも淹れようか？:
Let's rest a bit.
Want me to make some tea？
translations.それはダメ。\nお茶は私が淹れるの。:
You can't do that.
I'm the one making the tea.
translations.それは、だって……\n新妻ですもの？:
Because, well...
I'm your newlywed wife,
aren't I？
translations.そ、そっか……。\nじゃあ、お願いします。:
R-Right...
Well, I'll leave it to you,
then.
translations.そうだ、ねぇねぇ？\nちょっと、\n湖の方まで行ってみない？:
Oh, hey, hey？
Want to take a walk
down by the lake？
translations.腹ごなしに丁度いいかもな……。\n行こうか？:
Might be just the thing
to walk off dinner...
Shall we go？
translations.ねぇ、見て。\nホテル、ライトアップされてる。:
Hey, look.
The hotel's all lit up.
translations.ちょっと、\n大人になった気がしない？\nふふっ、行こ♪:
Doesn't it make you feel
a little grown-up？
Hehe, let's go♪
translations.でもほら、船とか、\n遠くの灯りがきれい……。:
But look, the boats and
distant lights are so pretty...
translations.箱根に新婚旅行のカップルが\nたくさん来てた頃は、\nみんなこうして歩きながら―:
Back when lots of newlyweds
visited Hakone, they'd all
walk like this and――
translations.これから始まる二人の生活の事、\n相談してたんだよ？\nきっと。:
Talked about the new life
they were starting together,
right？ I bet they did.
translations.どんなお家がいいとか、\n子供は、何人がいいとか……。:
Like what kind of house
they'd want, or how many
kids they should have...
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲は、\nどうしたい？:
What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
What do you want？
translations.う～ん……\nお家は小さくていいから、\n家族でたくさん旅行に行きたい。:
Hmm... A small house is fine,
as long as our family gets
to travel a lot.
translations.子供は、やっぱり男の子かな。\nあなたにそっくりなの。\n……放っとけない感じ？:
For kids, definitely a boy.
One who takes after you.
...The kind you can't leave alone？
translations.でも、すごく優しくて\n笑うと、食べちゃいたくなる\nような素敵な笑顔なの……。:
But he'd be so sweet,
and have a lovely smile
you'd just want to eat up...
translations.ねぇねぇ、船には親子連れの人、\nたくさん乗ってたでしょ？\n肩車してるパパとか:
Hey, there were so many
families on the boat, right？
Like dads giving shoulder rides.
translations.あぁ、いたいた！\n大変そうだよな……。:
Oh yeah, totally!
Looked like hard work, though...
translations.でも、いつかやるんだよ？\n子供が出来たら、あなたも。:
You'll do that someday too,
you know？ Once you have kids.
translations.ふふっ、ねぇ？\nちょっと、想像できないよね？:
Hehe, right？
Kind of hard to imagine,
isn't it？
translations.でも、きっと自然に、\nそういうのが似合うように\nなるんだよ。:
But I'm sure it'll just
naturally start suiting you.
translations.うん、大丈夫。\nきっと、\n素敵なパパになるよ？:
Mm, don't worry.
I'm sure you'll make
a wonderful dad, you know？
translations.▲姉ヶ崎＊▲だって、\n素敵なママになるよ。:
You'll make a wonderful
mom too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
translations.パパになっても、\nこういうの、忘れちゃダメだよ？:
Even when you're a dad,
you can't forget things
like this, okay？
translations.あれれ？\nもしかして……恐いのかな？:
Uh-oh？
Could it be... you're scared？
translations.映画だとね、調子に乗って\n湖のほとりの森に入った\nカップルって、大抵……。:
In movies, when couples
get bold and wander into
lakeside woods, usually...
translations.いいけど……\n▲姉ヶ崎＊▲、大丈夫？:
Sure, but...
are you okay, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
translations.あ、人のせいにして。\nや～い、弱虫！:
Ah, blaming it on me!
Scaredy-cat!
translations.映画だと、ああいう左側の\n木の蔭からいきなり――:
In movies, right from the shade
of those trees on the left,
suddenly――
translations.大丈夫、木の枝だって！: It's okay, it's just a branch!
translations.わかってます、ワザとです！\nわかんないかなぁ、\nこういう乙女心。:
I know, I did it on purpose!
Don't you understand a girl's
heart at all？
translations.さて、と……。\nまだ寝るには早いけど、\nどうしようか？:
Well then...
It's still early for bed,
what should we do？
translations.お布団、敷いちゃう？:
Should we lay out
the futons？
translations.だって、ほら……\n夜は、長いんだよ？:
I mean, look...
The night is long,
you know？
translations.お布団敷いて、\nゴロゴロした方が楽でしょ？:
Isn't it nicer to lay out
the futons and just
lounge around？
translations.ねぇ……\nやっぱり、近すぎない？\nお布団……。:
Hey...
Aren't these futons
a little too close？
translations.そう……でもないと思うけど？\nほら、新婚なわけだし！:
I don't... really think so？
I mean, we are newlyweds!
translations.う～ん……\nそっか。\nだよね、新婚さんだもんね？:
Hmm...
I guess so.
We are newlyweds, after all？
translations.ねぇ、お布団に入る前に、\nお風呂……入ろうね？:
Hey, before getting into bed,
let's take a bath, okay？
translations.外、蒸し暑かったから、\n汗かいちゃった。\nさっぱりして寝たいもん。:
It was so muggy outside,
I got all sweaty.
I wanna feel clean for bed.
translations.外、寒かったから、\nもう一回温まらない？\nポカポカで寝たいでしょ？:
It was cold outside,
wanna warm up once more？
You wanna be nice and cozy
before bed, right？
translations.じゃあ、支度して行こう？:
Then let's get ready
and head over, okay？
translations.（フゥ……\nいろいろ誤解しちゃうな、\n新婚旅行ごっこ……）:
(Phew...
Playing newlyweds keeps
giving me the wrong idea...)
translations.じゃあ、また、\nロビーの前でね？:
See you in front of
the lobby, then？
translations.ちょっと、\nまゆ玉の中に入ってみるよ？:
I'm gonna go try out
the cocoon bath, okay？
translations.まゆ？\nああ、サウナか。\nじゃあ、●も～！:
Cocoon？
Oh, the sauna!
Then ● will too~!
translations.こりゃ、気持ちいいな……\nハァ～、天国だぁ……。:
Man, this feels great...
Aaah, this is heaven...
translations.夢かっ!!\n本当に天国に行く\nところだった……。:
A dream!?
I almost went to heaven
for real...!
translations.あ、やっと来た！\nずいぶん長かったね？:
Ah, there you are!
You took quite a while,
didn't you？
translations.ん？\nなんか顔、赤いけど……\nのぼせた？ 大丈夫？:
Hm？
Your face is pretty red...
Did you overheat？ You okay？
translations.（サウナで居眠りは\nゼッタイやめよう……）:
(I am definitely never
dozing off in a sauna again...)
translations.（そろそろする事も無いし、\n後は電気を消して寝るだけ――\nなんだけど……）:
(There's not much left
to do, and all that's left
is turning off the lights
and sleeping—but still...)
